`native/pause.c`:

```c
/*
 * pause.c — a Harvest Moon 64-style pause menu, for the native build.
 *
 * Ported from the recompilation (HarvestMoonSNESRecomp, hm_pause.c). Opened
 * with M on the keyboard or the right stick's click (R3), neither of which a
 * SNES pad has, so no game button is taken. The game stands still at a
 * frame's end while it is open (the host's loop, main.c), so reading and
 * writing WRAM here is as safe as the game's own code between frames; the
 * music keeps playing (the sound chip runs on its own).
 *
 * Drawn at the console's resolution, 256x224, so its pixels are the game's
 * size: a checkered floor, wooden frames with parchment inside, pixel type
 * and 16x16 item icons (ui.c). The girls' faces are the game's own sprites,
 * read from your ROM when the menu opens (kGirls).
 *
 * Pages (L / R):
 *   Tools   the hand and backpack at the top, the tool shed as a grid.
 *           Equip, swap and put away follow the game's own shed routine
 *           TakeToolFromShelf and the tool table at $81:BE0F (hm_ram.h).
 *   Hearts  the five girls' affection ($7F1F1F.., 0..999).
 *   Farm    money, shipping, stock, cows, happiness, tomorrow's weather.
 * With mouse controls on, the mouse works here too (pause_mouse).
 */
#include <math.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "native.h"
#include "ui.h"
#include "i18n.h"
#include "pause.h"
#include "config.h"
#include "mods.h"

enum { GRID_COLS = 8, GRID_ROWS = 3, LW = 256, LH = 224 };

static struct {
  bool open;
  int tab;               /* 0 tools, 1 hearts, 2 farm, 3 the crop bag (when on) */
  int an, ar, ac;        /* animals: the section (0 cows, 1 chickens), its row and column */
  int cx, cy;            /* tools cursor: cy -1 = the top slots (cx 0 hand, 1 bag) */
  char message[96];      /* the tools page's feedback line */
  bool live;             /* drawn for a second screen while the game goes on */
} s;

/* ── Game data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct { uint8_t id; const char *name; } ToolName;
/* ids are the game's own item numbers (hm_ram.h, $0921); this order is the
 * grid's. */
static const ToolName kTools[] = {
  {0x01, "Sickle"}, {0x02, "Hoe"}, {0x03, "Hammer"}, {0x04, "Ax"},
  {0x10, "Watering Can"}, {0x0E, "Milker"}, {0x0F, "Brush"}, {0x0B, "Bell"},
  {0x05, "Corn Seeds"}, {0x06, "Tomato Seeds"}, {0x07, "Potato Seeds"}, {0x08, "Turnip Seeds"},
  {0x0C, "Grass Seeds"}, {0x09, "Cow Medicine"}, {0x0A, "Miracle Potion"}, {0x0D, "Paint"},
  {0x11, "Gold Sickle"}, {0x12, "Gold Hoe"}, {0x13, "Gold Hammer"}, {0x14, "Gold Ax"},
  {0x15, "Sprinkler"}, {0x16, "Magic Beans"}, {0x17, "Blue Diamond"}, {0x18, "Blue Feather"},
};
enum { NTOOLS = sizeof kTools / sizeof kTools[0] };

static const char *tool_name(uint8_t id)
{
  if (id == 0) return T("(nothing)");
  if (id == 0x19) return T("Chicken Feed");
  if (id == 0x1A) return T("Cow Feed");
  for (int i = 0; i < NTOOLS; i++) if (kTools[i].id == id) return T(kTools[i].name);
  return "?";
}
/* a seed bag's bags (0: not a seed bag) */
static unsigned bag_count_of(uint8_t id)
{
  int k = id >= 0x05 && id <= 0x08 ? id - 0x04 : id == 0x0C ? 0 : -1;
  return k < 0 ? 0 : g_ram[HM_SEEDS_GRASS_N + k];
}
/* a little dark label with a number, its bottom-right corner at (rx, by) */
static void count_badge(int rx, int by, unsigned n)
{
  char c[12]; snprintf(c, sizeof c, "%u", n);
  int w = ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, c) + 4;
  ui_rect(rx - w, by - 8, w, 8, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx - w + 2, by - 1, c, C_CREAM);
}
/* a seed bag's count: bags; with "one seed at a time", the seeds left */
static unsigned item_count(uint8_t id)
{
  int k = id >= 0x05 && id <= 0x08 ? id - 0x04 : id == 0x0C ? 0 : -1;   /* grass, corn .. turnip */
  if (k < 0) return 0;
  unsigned bags = g_ram[HM_SEEDS_GRASS_N + k];
  if (g_cfg.single_seed && bags) return bags * 9u - g_hm_seeds_used[k];
  return bags;
}
/* The shed slot of an item: DATA16_81BE0F, bytes 6 (row) and 7 (mask) of
 * each 8-byte entry. Read from the ROM so it can never disagree with it. */
static bool shed_slot(uint8_t id, int *row, uint8_t *mask)
{
  if (id == 0 || id > 0x1A || !g_rom) return false;
  const uint8_t *e = g_rom + 0xBE0F + id * 8;   /* $81:BE0F, LoROM file offset */
  *row = e[6]; *mask = e[7];
  return *mask != 0;
}
static bool in_shed(uint8_t id)
{
  int row; uint8_t mask;
  return shed_slot(id, &row, &mask) && (g_ram[HM_SHED_ITEMS + row] & mask);
}
static void set_in_shed(uint8_t id, bool on)
{
  int row; uint8_t mask;
  if (!shed_slot(id, &row, &mask)) return;
  if (on) g_ram[HM_SHED_ITEMS + row] |= mask; else g_ram[HM_SHED_ITEMS + row] &= (uint8_t)~mask;
}
static bool player_free(void)
{
  /* Normal control, nothing carried, and the player either idle (0), in the
   * standing-still idle animation (9), walking (1) or running (2): never in
   * the middle of using, showing or dropping something. */
  uint16_t act = hm_rd16(g_ram, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  return hm_diary_loaded(g_ram) && g_ram[HM_INPUT_STATE] == 1 &&
         (act == 0 || act == 1 || act == 2 || act == 9) && g_ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND] == 0;
}

/* a tool's picture: the game's own sprite of it on the shed's shelf (the
 * shelf items $2A-$43 are the tools 1-$1A; their case 3, or 0), else the
 * drawn icon */
static void tool_icon(int x, int y, uint8_t id)
{
  uint32_t px[256];
  if (id >= 1 && id <= 0x1A && (mods_item_sprite((uint8_t)(0x29 + id), 3, px) || mods_item_sprite((uint8_t)(0x29 + id), 0, px))) {
    for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++)
      for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) if (px[j * 16 + i]) ui_px(x + i, y + j, px[j * 16 + i]);
    return;
  }
  ui_icon(x, y, id);
}

static void say(const char *m) { snprintf(s.message, sizeof s.message, "%s", m); }

/* the inventory's rows: the shed's 3, and the crop bag's when it is on */
enum { BAG_ROW = GRID_ROWS };
static int inv_rows(void) { return GRID_ROWS + (g_cfg.crop_bag ? 1 : 0); }
static bool on_bag(void) { return s.tab == 0 && s.cy == BAG_ROW; }

/* The item under the cursor (0 = none). */
static uint8_t cursor_item(void)
{
  if (s.cy == BAG_ROW) return 0;
  if (s.cy < 0) return g_ram[s.cx == 0 ? HM_TOOL_SELECTED : HM_TOOL_BACKPACK];
  int i = s.cy * GRID_COLS + s.cx;
  return i < NTOOLS && in_shed(kTools[i].id) ? kTools[i].id : 0;
}

/* Equip a shed item -- TakeToolFromShelf: the hand tool drops into an empty
 * backpack; otherwise it goes back to the shed (the game never lets an item
 * be in two places). Then the new item leaves the shed. */
static void equip_from_shed(uint8_t id)
{
  uint8_t hand = g_ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED];
  if (hand) {
    if (g_ram[HM_TOOL_BACKPACK] == 0) g_ram[HM_TOOL_BACKPACK] = hand;
    else set_in_shed(hand, true);
  }
  g_ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED] = id;
  set_in_shed(id, false);
  char m[96]; snprintf(m, sizeof m, T("Now holding: %s"), tool_name(id)); say(m);
}
static void swap_hand_bag(void)
{
  uint8_t t = g_ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED];       /* the game's own X swap */
  g_ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED] = g_ram[HM_TOOL_BACKPACK];
  g_ram[HM_TOOL_BACKPACK] = t;
  say(T("Swapped hand and backpack."));
}

static void bag_take_out(void);
static void action_a(void)
{
  if (s.tab != 0) return;
  if (on_bag()) { bag_take_out(); return; }
  if (!player_free()) { say(T("You can't change tools right now.")); return; }
  if (s.cy < 0) { if (g_ram[HM_TOOL_BACKPACK] || g_ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED]) swap_hand_bag(); return; }
  uint8_t id = cursor_item();
  if (id) equip_from_shed(id);
}
static void action_x(void)
{
  if (s.tab != 0 || on_bag()) return;
  if (!player_free()) { say(T("You can't change tools right now.")); return; }
  swap_hand_bag();
}
static void action_y(void)   /* put the hand (or the selected bag) item away */
{
  if (s.tab != 0 || on_bag()) return;
  if (!player_free()) { say(T("You can't change tools right now.")); return; }
  uint32_t where = (s.cy < 0 && s.cx == 1) ? HM_TOOL_BACKPACK : HM_TOOL_SELECTED;
  uint8_t id = g_ram[where];
  int row; uint8_t mask;
  if (!id) { say(T("Nothing to put away.")); return; }
  if (!shed_slot(id, &row, &mask) || row > 2) { say(T("That doesn't go in the tool shed.")); return; }
  set_in_shed(id, true);
  g_ram[where] = 0;
  char m[96]; snprintf(m, sizeof m, T("Put away: %s"), tool_name(id)); say(m);
}

/* ── The girls' faces: the game's own sprites, read from your ROM ────── */
/* Front-facing frame of each girl in the NPC sprite sheet ($8F:8000, file
 * 0x78000: 4bpp tiles, 16 per 0x200-byte row; a frame is 2 tiles wide, its
 * top two rows are the head) and her sprite palette ($A9:DE20.., the game's
 * OBJ palette table). Found by watching the flower festival: talking to each
 * girl raised exactly one heart counter, and the tiles she was drawn with
 * matched these ROM bytes. Hearts order: Maria, Ann, Nina, Ellen, Eve. */
static const struct { uint32_t frame, palette; } kGirls[5] = {
  { 0x078200, 0x14DE20 },   /* Maria: blue hair */
  { 0x078B00, 0x14DE20 },   /* Ann: orange ponytail */
  { 0x07B2C0, 0x14DE40 },   /* Nina: pink hair */
  { 0x07A280, 0x14DE80 },   /* Ellen: brown hair */
  { 0x07A3C0, 0x14DE40 },   /* Eve: blonde */
};
static uint32_t s_face[5][16 * 16];
static bool s_faces_ok;

static void load_faces(void)
{
  if (s_faces_ok || !g_rom) return;
  for (int g = 0; g < 5; g++) {
    uint32_t pal[16];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
      uint16_t v = g_rom[kGirls[g].palette + i * 2] | g_rom[kGirls[g].palette + i * 2 + 1] << 8;
      uint32_t r = (v & 31) << 3, gg = ((v >> 5) & 31) << 3, b = ((v >> 10) & 31) << 3;
      pal[i] = i ? (0xFF000000u | r << 16 | gg << 8 | b | (r >> 5) << 16 | (gg >> 5) << 8 | (b >> 5)) : 0;
    }
    for (int ty = 0; ty < 2; ty++)
      for (int tx = 0; tx < 2; tx++) {
        const uint8_t *t = g_rom + kGirls[g].frame + ty * 0x200 + tx * 0x20;
        for (int y = 0; y < 8; y++)
          for (int x = 0; x < 8; x++) {
            int b = 7 - x;
            int c = ((t[y * 2] >> b) & 1) | (((t[y * 2 + 1] >> b) & 1) << 1) |
                    (((t[16 + y * 2] >> b) & 1) << 2) | (((t[16 + y * 2 + 1] >> b) & 1) << 3);
            s_face[g][(ty * 8 + y) * 16 + tx * 8 + x] = pal[c];
          }
      }
  }
  s_faces_ok = true;
}

/* ── Pieces of the screen ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static const char *kDays[7] = { "Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday" };
static const char *kSeasons[4] = { "Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter" };
static const uint32_t kSeasonCol[4] = { UI_RGB(0xE8789A), UI_RGB(0x3E9A3C), UI_RGB(0xD8762A), UI_RGB(0x4A84D8) };

static void clock_face(int cx, int cy, int r)
{
  for (int y = -r - 1; y <= r + 1; y++)
    for (int x = -r - 1; x <= r + 1; x++) {
      int d2 = x * x + y * y;
      if (d2 <= r * r) ui_px(cx + x, cy + y, C_CREAM);
      else if (d2 <= (r + 1) * (r + 1) + 1) ui_px(cx + x, cy + y, C_WOOD_EDGE);
    }
  for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) {
    double a = k * M_PI / 6;
    ui_px(cx + (int)lround(sin(a) * (r - 1)), cy - (int)lround(cos(a) * (r - 1)), C_INK_SOFT);
  }
  unsigned hour = g_ram[HM_HOUR] % 12, minute = (g_ram[HM_MINUTES] % 15) * 4;
  double am = minute * M_PI / 30, ah = (hour + minute / 60.0) * M_PI / 6;
  for (int i = 1; i <= r - 2; i++)
    ui_px(cx + (int)lround(sin(am) * i), cy - (int)lround(cos(am) * i), C_INK_SOFT);
  for (int i = 1; i <= r - 5; i++)
    ui_px(cx + (int)lround(sin(ah) * i), cy - (int)lround(cos(ah) * i), C_RED);
  ui_px(cx, cy, C_WOOD_EDGE);
}

static void draw_top(void)
{
  uint8_t *r = g_ram;
  char buf[64];
  /* date and clock */
  ui_frame(4, 4, 96, 46, C_PAPER);
  int season = r[HM_SEASON] & 3;
  const char *sname = T(kSeasons[season]);
  int sw = ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, sname) + 8;
  ui_rect(9, 9, sw, 10, kSeasonCol[season]);
  ui_hline(9, 18, sw, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_text_sh(UI_SMALL, 13, 16, sname, C_CREAM);
  snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%u", r[HM_DAY]);
  int nx = ui_text(UI_BODY, 10, 36, buf, C_INK);
  ui_text(UI_SMALL, nx + 3, 36, T(kDays[r[HM_WEEKDAY] % 7]), C_INK_SOFT);
  snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, T("Year %u"), r[HM_YEAR] + 1u);
  ui_text(UI_SMALL, 10, 45, buf, C_INK_SOFT);
  clock_face(84, 21, 10);                        /* hands... */
  snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%u:%02u", r[HM_HOUR], (r[HM_MINUTES] % 15) * 4);
  ui_text_c(UI_SMALL, 84, 45, buf, C_INK);               /* ...and the time in figures */

  /* hand and backpack */
  bool on_top = s.tab == 0 && s.cy < 0;
  ui_slot(104, 8, 26, C_GREEN, C_GREEN_DARK, on_top && s.cx == 0);
  ui_slot(134, 8, 26, C_BLUE, C_BLUE_DARK, on_top && s.cx == 1);
  tool_icon(109, 13, r[HM_TOOL_SELECTED]);
  tool_icon(139, 13, r[HM_TOOL_BACKPACK]);
  { unsigned n = item_count(r[HM_TOOL_SELECTED]); if (n) count_badge(130, 34, n); }
  { unsigned n = item_count(r[HM_TOOL_BACKPACK]); if (n) count_badge(160, 34, n); }
  ui_text_c(UI_SMALL, 117, 45, T("Hand"), C_CREAM);
  ui_text_c(UI_SMALL, 147, 45, T("Bag"), C_CREAM);
  ui_text_c(UI_SMALL, 117, 44, T("Hand"), C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_text_c(UI_SMALL, 147, 44, T("Bag"), C_WOOD_EDGE);

  /* money and stamina */
  ui_frame(164, 4, 88, 46, C_PAPER);
  for (int y = -4; y <= 4; y++)                   /* coin */
    for (int x = -4; x <= 4; x++) {
      int d2 = x * x + y * y;
      if (d2 <= 16) ui_px(175 + x, 21 + y, d2 >= 10 ? C_GOLD_DARK : C_GOLD);
    }
  ui_px(174, 19, C_CREAM);
  snprintf(buf, sizeof buf, "%u G", (unsigned)hm_rd24(r, HM_MONEY) * 10u);
  ui_text_r(UI_BODY, 245, 26, buf, C_INK);
  ui_text(UI_SMALL, 170, 38, T("Stamina"), C_INK_SOFT);
  unsigned st = r[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA], mx = r[HM_MAX_STAMINA] ? r[HM_MAX_STAMINA] : 1;
  if (st > mx) st = mx;
  ui_rect(170, 41, 76, 5, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(171, 42, 74, 3, C_PAPER_DARK);
  ui_rect(171, 42, (int)(74 * st / mx), 3, st * 4 < mx ? C_RED : C_GREEN);
}

static const char *kTabs[4] = { "Inventory", "Hearts", "Farm", "Animals" };
static int ntabs(void) { return 4; }

static void draw_tabs(void)
{
  int x = 8;
  for (int t = 0; t < ntabs(); t++) {
    const char *name = T(kTabs[t]);
    int w = ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, name) + 12;
    bool on = t == s.tab;
    int y = on ? 53 : 55;
    ui_rect(x + 1, y, w - 2, 70 - y, C_WOOD_EDGE);
    ui_rect(x, y + 1, w, 69 - y, C_WOOD_EDGE);
    ui_rect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, 69 - y, on ? C_PAPER : C_WOOD);
    ui_hline(x + 2, y + 1, w - 4, on ? C_CREAM : C_WOOD_LIGHT);
    if (on) ui_text(UI_SMALL, x + 6, y + 9, name, C_INK);
    else ui_text_sh(UI_SMALL, x + 6, y + 9, name, C_CREAM);
    x += w + 2;
  }
  ui_text_sh(UI_SMALL, 250 - ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, T("L / R  tabs")), 63, T("L / R  tabs"), C_CREAM);
}

/* the crop bag (mods.c): its 9 places; the one under the cursor */
static const char *bag_name(uint8_t it, char *buf, size_t n)
{
  static const char *const names[8] = { "Corn", "Tomato", "Potato", "Turnip", "Egg", "Milk (S)", "Milk (M)", "Milk (L)" };
  if (it >= 0x10 && it <= 0x17) return T(names[it - 0x10]);
  snprintf(buf, n, "%s", T("Item"));
  return buf;
}
static unsigned bag_price(uint8_t it) { return g_rom ? g_rom[0x9FDE + 2u * it + 1] * 10u : 0; }  /* $81:9FDE */
static void bag_take_out(void)
{
  uint8_t items[9];
  int n = mods_bag_items(items);
  if (s.cx >= n) { say(n ? T("(nothing)") : T("The bag is empty.")); return; }
  if (!player_free()) { say(T("You can't take things out right now.")); return; }
  if (mods_bag_choose(s.cx)) s.open = false;            /* out as the game goes on */
}

static void draw_tools(int x, int y)
{
  /* the shed, every shed item in a fixed place; missing ones are empty */
  ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, y + 7, T("IN THE TOOL SHED"), C_INK_SOFT);
  for (int i = 0; i < NTOOLS; i++) {
    int gx = i % GRID_COLS, gy = i / GRID_COLS;
    int sx = x + gx * 21, sy = y + 11 + gy * 21;
    bool sel = s.cy == gy && s.cx == gx;
    bool have = in_shed(kTools[i].id);
    ui_rect(sx, sy, 20, 20, sel ? C_GOLD_DARK : C_PAPER_LINE);
    ui_rect(sx + 1, sy + 1, 18, 18, sel ? C_SELECT : (have ? C_PAPER : C_PAPER_DARK));
    if (have) {
      tool_icon(sx + 2, sy + 2, kTools[i].id);
      unsigned n = item_count(kTools[i].id);
      if (n) count_badge(sx + 20, sy + 20, n);
    }
  }
  /* the crop bag, under the shed: 9 places */
  int by = y + 11 + GRID_ROWS * 21 + 1;
  uint8_t bag[9];
  int bn = g_cfg.crop_bag ? mods_bag_items(bag) : 0;
  if (g_cfg.crop_bag)
    for (int i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      int sx = x + i * 18;
      bool sel = s.cy == BAG_ROW && s.cx == i;
      ui_rect(sx, by, 18, 18, sel ? C_GOLD_DARK : C_PAPER_LINE);
      ui_rect(sx + 1, by + 1, 16, 16, sel ? C_SELECT : (i < bn ? C_PAPER : C_PAPER_DARK));
      if (i < bn) mods_bag_icon(sx + 1, by + 1, bag[i]);
    }
  /* the cursor: a little hand pointing at the slot */
  int px0, py0;
  if (s.cy < 0) { px0 = 104 + s.cx * 30 - 9; py0 = 18; }
  else if (s.cy == BAG_ROW) { px0 = x + s.cx * 18 - 7; py0 = by + 5; }
  else { px0 = x + s.cx * 21 - 7; py0 = y + 11 + s.cy * 21 + 6; }
  static const char *hand[7] = { "..##....", ".#cc####", "#cccccc#", "#ccc####", "#cccc#..", ".####...", "........" };
  for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++)
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
      if (hand[j][i] == '#') ui_px(px0 + i, py0 + j, C_WOOD_EDGE);
      else if (hand[j][i] == 'c') ui_px(px0 + i, py0 + j, C_CREAM);

  /* right column: what is under the cursor */
  int rx = x + GRID_COLS * 21 + 6;
  uint8_t id = cursor_item();
  ui_rect(rx - 4, y + 2, 1, 76, C_PAPER_LINE);
  if (s.cy < 0) ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 9, s.cx == 0 ? T("In hand:") : T("In backpack:"), C_INK_SOFT);
  if (s.cy == BAG_ROW) {                        /* the crop bag's place */
    char c[48];
    snprintf(c, sizeof c, "%s  %d/9", T("Crop bag"), bn);
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 9, c, C_INK_SOFT);
    if (s.cx < bn) {
      char buf[48];
      mods_bag_icon(rx, y + 13, bag[s.cx]);
      ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 38, bag_name(bag[s.cx], buf, sizeof buf), C_INK);
      unsigned p = bag_price(bag[s.cx]);
      if (p) { snprintf(c, sizeof c, T("Sells for %u G"), p); ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 48, c, C_GREEN_DARK); }
    } else {
      ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 38, bn ? T("(nothing)") : T("The bag is empty."), C_INK_SOFT);
    }
    return;
  }
  if (id) {
    tool_icon(rx, y + 13, id);
    const char *name = tool_name(id);
    /* wrap a two-word name over two lines when it is too wide */
    char a[48]; snprintf(a, sizeof a, "%s", name);
    char *sp = strchr(a, ' ');
    if (sp && ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, a) > 58) { *sp = 0; ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 38, a, C_INK); ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 46, sp + 1, C_INK); }
    else ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 38, a, C_INK);
    unsigned bags = bag_count_of(id);
    if (bags) {                                 /* how much is left, in words */
      char c[48];
      int ly = sp && ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, name) > 58 ? y + 58 : y + 50;
      if (g_cfg.single_seed) {
        unsigned n = item_count(id);
        snprintf(c, sizeof c, n == 1 ? T("1 seed") : T("%u seeds"), n);
        ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, ly, c, C_GREEN_DARK);
        ly += 9;
      }
      snprintf(c, sizeof c, bags == 1 ? T("1 bag") : T("%u bags"), bags);
      ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, ly, c, g_cfg.single_seed ? C_INK_SOFT : C_GREEN_DARK);
    }
  } else {
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, rx, y + 38, T("(nothing)"), C_INK_SOFT);
  }
}


static uint32_t heart_colour(unsigned v)
{
  static const uint32_t tier[8] = { UI_RGB(0x5A4A5A), UI_RGB(0x8A5AC8), UI_RGB(0x4A78E0), UI_RGB(0x46A846),
                                    UI_RGB(0xE0C028), UI_RGB(0xEC8A2A), UI_RGB(0xF27AA8), UI_RGB(0xE0303A) };
  static const unsigned lim[8] = { 100, 200, 350, 450, 550, 650, 800, 1000 };
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) if (v < lim[i]) return tier[i];
  return tier[7];
}

static void draw_hearts(int x, int y)
{
  static const char *names[5] = { "Maria", "Ann", "Nina", "Ellen", "Eve" };
  load_faces();
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    int ry = y + i * 19;
    unsigned v = hm_rd16(g_ram, HM_HEARTS_BASE + i * 2);
    if (v > 999) v = 999;
    /* portrait frame */
    ui_rect(x, ry, 18, 18, C_WOOD_EDGE);
    ui_rect(x + 1, ry + 1, 16, 16, C_PAPER_DARK);
    if (s_faces_ok)
      for (int j = 0; j < 16; j++)
        for (int k = 0; k < 16; k++) ui_px(x + 1 + k, ry + 1 + j, s_face[i][j * 16 + k]);
    ui_text(UI_BODY, x + 24, ry + 13, T(names[i]), C_INK);
    unsigned full = (v + 50) / 100;
    uint32_t col = heart_colour(v);
    for (int h = 0; h < 10; h++) ui_heart(x + 76 + h * 9, ry + 6, col, (unsigned)h < full);
    char num[8]; snprintf(num, sizeof num, "%u", v);
    ui_text_r(UI_SMALL, x + 236, ry + 12, num, C_INK_SOFT);
    if (i < 4) ui_hline(x + 22, ry + 18, 214, C_PAPER_LINE);
  }
}

static void draw_farm(int x, int y)
{
  static const char *weather[12] = { "Sunny", "Rain", "Snow", "Hurricane", "Fair", "Storm",
    "Flower Festival", "Harvest Festival", "Thanksgiving",
    "Star Night Festival", "New Year", "Egg Festival" };
  uint8_t *r = g_ram;
  char v[64];
  int row = 0, col = 0;
#define ITEM(label, ...) do { snprintf(v, sizeof v, __VA_ARGS__); \
    int ix = x + col * 120, iy = y + row * 19; \
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, ix, iy + 8, T(label), C_INK_SOFT); ui_text_r(UI_BODY, ix + 114, iy + 16, v, C_INK); \
    ui_hline(ix, iy + 18, 114, C_PAPER_LINE); \
    if (++row == 5) { row = 0; col++; } } while (0)
  ITEM("Time", "%u:%02u", r[HM_HOUR], (r[HM_MINUTES] % 15) * 4);
  ITEM("Shipped today", "%u G", (unsigned)hm_rd24(r, HM_SHIPPING_MONEY) * 10u);
  ITEM("Lumber", "%u", hm_rd16(r, HM_STORED_WOOD));
  ITEM("Fodder", "%u", hm_rd16(r, HM_STORED_GRASS));
  ITEM("Cows", "%u", r[HM_COW_N]);
  ITEM("Happiness", "%u / 999", hm_rd16(r, HM_HAPPINESS));
  ITEM("Dog hugs", "%u", hm_rd16(r, HM_DOG_HUGS));
  ITEM("Tomorrow's weather", "%s", r[HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW] < 12 ? T(weather[r[HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW]]) : "?");
  ITEM("Stamina", "%u / %u", r[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA], r[HM_MAX_STAMINA]);
#undef ITEM
}

/* ── The animals: the barn's cows and the coop's chickens ─────────────
 * Their records (animals.c): a cow 16 bytes at $7E:C1C6 (+0 status: 02
 * newborn calf, 04 calf, 08 adult, 10 cranky, 20 sick, 40 pregnant; +1
 * today: 01 brushed, 02 milked, 04 talked to; +2 the map, $27 the barn;
 * +3 days left sick; +4 happiness, the milk's size: below $60 S, below $C0
 * M, else L); a chicken 8 bytes at $7E:C286 (+0: 02 egg, 04 chick, 08 hen,
 * 10 hungry; +1 the map, $28 the coop). Pictures: the game's own sprites
 * (cow $1C7, calf $1BA, hen $212, chick $217, the egg item $23). */
enum { COWS = 12, CHICKENS = 13, ROWS_SHOWN = 5 };
static const uint8_t *cow(int i) { return &g_ram[HM_COW_DATA + 16 * i]; }
static const uint8_t *hen(int i) { return &g_ram[HM_CHICKEN_DATA + 8 * i]; }
/* the animals there are, cows first: (section 0 cow / 1 chicken, slot) */
static int animal_list(int sec[COWS + CHICKENS], int slot[COWS + CHICKENS])
{
  int n = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < COWS; i++) if (cow(i)[0]) { sec[n] = 0; slot[n] = i; n++; }
  for (int i = 0; i < CHICKENS; i++) if (hen(i)[0]) { sec[n] = 1; slot[n] = i; n++; }
  return n;
}
static void animals_move(int dx, int dy)
{
  int sec[COWS + CHICKENS], slot[COWS + CHICKENS];
  int n = animal_list(sec, slot);
  (void)dx;
  if (!n) { s.ac = s.ar = 0; return; }
  if (dy) s.ac = (s.ac + n + dy) % n;
  if (s.ac >= n) s.ac = n - 1;
  if (s.ac < s.ar) s.ar = s.ac;
  if (s.ac >= s.ar + ROWS_SHOWN) s.ar = s.ac - ROWS_SHOWN + 1;
}
/* the animal's picture, the game's own sprite, in a w x h box at (x, y) */
static void animal_picture(int sec, int i, int x, int y, int w, int h)
{
  static uint32_t px[48 * 24];
  uint8_t st = sec == 0 ? cow(i)[0] : hen(i)[0];
  bool ok;
  if (sec == 0) ok = mods_sprite((st & 0x08) ? 0x1C7 : 0x1BA, false, px, w, h);
  else if (st & 0x02) {
    uint32_t e[256];
    ok = mods_item_sprite(0x23, 0, e);
    memset(px, 0, sizeof px);
    for (int j = 0; ok && j < 16 && j < h; j++)
      for (int k = 0; k < 16 && k + (w - 16) / 2 < w; k++) px[j * w + k + (w - 16) / 2] = e[j * 16 + k];
  } else ok = mods_sprite((st & 0x08) ? 0x212 : 0x217, false, px, w, h);
  if (!ok) return;
  for (int j = 0; j < h; j++)
    for (int k = 0; k < w; k++) if (px[j * w + k]) ui_px(x + k, y + j, px[j * w + k]);
}
static void animal_name(int sec, int i, char *buf, size_t n)
{
  snprintf(buf, n, "%s %d", sec == 0 ? T("Cow") : T("Chicken"), i + 1);
}
/* like the girls' hearts: a row each, the cows with ten hearts of
 * happiness (0-255; the chickens have none) */
static void draw_animals(int x, int y)
{
  int sec[COWS + CHICKENS], slot[COWS + CHICKENS];
  int n = animal_list(sec, slot);
  if (!n) { ui_text(UI_BODY, x + 4, y + 40, T("No animals yet."), C_INK_SOFT); return; }
  if (s.ac >= n) s.ac = n - 1;
  for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_SHOWN && s.ar + r < n; r++) {
    int k = s.ar + r, sc = sec[k], i = slot[k];
    int ry = y + 1 + r * 19;
    bool sel = k == s.ac;
    if (sel) ui_rect(x - 2, ry - 1, 240, 19, C_SELECT);
    ui_rect(x, ry, 36, 18, C_WOOD_EDGE);
    ui_rect(x + 1, ry + 1, 34, 16, C_PAPER_DARK);
    animal_picture(sc, i, x + 2, ry + 1, 32, 16);
    char name[32]; animal_name(sc, i, name, sizeof name);
    ui_text(UI_BODY, x + 42, ry + 13, name, C_INK);
    if (sc == 0) {
      unsigned v = cow(i)[4];
      unsigned full = (v * 10 + 127) / 255;
      uint32_t col = heart_colour(v * 1000 / 256);
      for (int h = 0; h < 10; h++) ui_heart(x + 112 + h * 9, ry + 6, col, (unsigned)h < full);
      char num[8]; snprintf(num, sizeof num, "%u", v);
      ui_text_r(UI_SMALL, x + 236, ry + 12, num, C_INK_SOFT);
    } else {
      uint8_t st = hen(i)[0];
      const char *kind = (st & 0x02) ? T("egg in the incubator") : (st & 0x04) ? T("chick") : T("hen");
      ui_text(UI_SMALL, x + 112, ry + 12, kind, C_INK_SOFT);
    }
    if (r < ROWS_SHOWN - 1 && k < n - 1) ui_hline(x + 40, ry + 18, 196, C_PAPER_LINE);
  }
  /* more above / below */
  if (s.ar > 0) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) ui_hline(x + 237 - j, y - 2 + j, 1 + 2 * j, C_WOOD_DARK);
  if (s.ar + ROWS_SHOWN < n) for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) ui_hline(x + 235 + j, y + 96 + j, 5 - 2 * j, C_WOOD_DARK);
}
static void animal_details(int x)
{
  int sec[COWS + CHICKENS], slot[COWS + CHICKENS];
  int n = animal_list(sec, slot);
  if (!n) { ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, T("No animals yet."), C_INK_SOFT); return; }
  if (s.ac >= n) s.ac = n - 1;
  int i = slot[s.ac];
  char a[96], b[128];
  if (sec[s.ac] == 0) {
    const uint8_t *c = cow(i);
    if (!c[0]) { ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, T("(empty)"), C_INK_SOFT); return; }
    bool adult = c[0] & 0x08;
    snprintf(a, sizeof a, "%s %d · %s", T("Cow"), i + 1, adult ? T("adult") : T("calf"));
    if (c[0] & 0x20) { char t[40]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, T(" · sick (%u days)"), c[3]); strncat(a, t, sizeof a - strlen(a) - 1); }
    if (c[0] & 0x40) strncat(a, T(" · pregnant"), sizeof a - strlen(a) - 1);
    if (c[0] & 0x10) strncat(a, T(" · cranky"), sizeof a - strlen(a) - 1);
    ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, a, C_INK);
    const char *milk = c[4] < 0x60 ? "S" : c[4] < 0xC0 ? "M" : "L";
    snprintf(b, sizeof b, T("Happiness %u/255"), c[4]);
    if (adult && !(c[0] & 0x40)) { char t[24]; snprintf(t, sizeof t, T(" · milk %s"), milk); strncat(b, t, sizeof b - strlen(b) - 1); }
    char t[96];
    const char *yes = T("yes"), *no = T("no");
    snprintf(t, sizeof t, " · %s %s · %s %s%s%s%s%s", T("brushed"), (c[1] & 1) ? yes : no, T("talked"), (c[1] & 4) ? yes : no,
             adult ? " · " : "", adult ? T("milked") : "", adult ? " " : "", adult ? ((c[1] & 2) ? yes : no) : "");
    strncat(b, t, sizeof b - strlen(b) - 1);
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, 205, b, C_INK_SOFT);
  } else {
    const uint8_t *h = hen(i);
    if (!h[0]) { ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, T("(empty)"), C_INK_SOFT); return; }
    const char *kind = (h[0] & 0x02) ? T("egg in the incubator") : (h[0] & 0x04) ? T("chick") : T("hen");
    snprintf(a, sizeof a, "%s %d · %s", T("Chicken"), i + 1, kind);
    if (h[0] & 0x10) strncat(a, T(" · hungry"), sizeof a - strlen(a) - 1);
    ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, a, C_INK);
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, 205, h[1] == 0x28 ? T("In the coop") : T("Outside"), C_INK_SOFT);
  }
}

static void draw_textbox(void)
{
  ui_frame(4, 176, 248, 44, C_PAPER);
  int x = 12;
  if (on_bag()) {
    if (s.message[0]) ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, s.message, C_GREEN_DARK);
    else if (!player_free()) ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, T("(only while you can move)"), C_RED);
    else ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, s.live ? T("Tap: take it out") : T("A  take it out"), C_INK);
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, 205, T("Q  put what you carry in / take the last out"), C_INK_SOFT);
  } else if (s.tab == 0) {
    if (s.message[0]) ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, s.message, C_GREEN_DARK);
    else if (!player_free()) ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, T("(only while you can move)"), C_RED);
    else ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 193, s.live ? T("Tap a tool: hold it") : T("A  equip"), C_INK);
    char help[128];
    snprintf(help, sizeof help, "%s    %s %s", T("X  hand ↔ backpack"), T("Y  put away in"), T("the tool shed"));
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, 205, help, C_INK_SOFT);
  } else if (s.tab == 3) {
    animal_details(x);
  } else if (s.tab == 1) {
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, 192, T("Marks: 200 heart event · 450 first child ·"), C_INK);
    ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, 201, T("650 second child · maximum 999"), C_INK);
  } else {
    char d[96];
    snprintf(d, sizeof d, T("%s, %s %u, Year %u"), T(kDays[g_ram[HM_WEEKDAY] % 7]),
             T(kSeasons[g_ram[HM_SEASON] & 3]), g_ram[HM_DAY], g_ram[HM_YEAR] + 1u);
    ui_text(UI_BODY, x, 196, d, C_INK);
  }
  if (s.live) ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, 214, T("Tap to choose  ·  the game goes on"), C_INK_SOFT);
  else ui_text(UI_SMALL, x, 214, T("B / M / Esc  close     ·     the game is paused"), C_INK_SOFT);
  /* the blinking-arrow corner of a game text box, standing still */
  for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) ui_hline(241 + j, 210 + j, 5 - 2 * j, C_WOOD_DARK);
}

static uint32_t s_canvas[LW * LH];

static void render(void)
{
  ui_target(s_canvas, LW, LH);
  ui_checker();
  draw_top();
  draw_tabs();
  ui_frame(4, 68, 248, 106, C_PAPER);
  if (s.tab == 0) draw_tools(12, 72);
  else if (s.tab == 1) draw_hearts(10, 73);
  else if (s.tab == 3) draw_animals(10, 72);
  else draw_farm(12, 73);
  draw_textbox();
}

/* ── Input ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void move(int dx, int dy)
{
  if (s.tab == 3) { animals_move(dx, dy); return; }
  if (s.tab != 0) { if (dx) s.tab = (s.tab + ntabs() + dx) % ntabs(); return; }
  s.message[0] = 0;
  if (dy) {
    int rows = inv_rows();
    s.cy += dy;
    if (s.cy < -1) s.cy = rows - 1;
    if (s.cy >= rows) s.cy = -1;
    if (s.cy < 0) s.cx = s.cx >= GRID_COLS / 2 ? 1 : 0;
    else if (dy > 0 && s.cy == 0) s.cx = s.cx ? 5 : 1;
    else if (s.cy < GRID_ROWS && s.cx >= GRID_COLS) s.cx = GRID_COLS - 1;
  }
  if (dx) {
    int cols = s.cy < 0 ? 2 : s.cy == BAG_ROW ? 9 : GRID_COLS;
    s.cx = (s.cx + cols + dx) % cols;
  }
}
static void tab(int dir) { s.tab = (s.tab + ntabs() + dir) % ntabs(); s.message[0] = 0; }

void pause_action(char a)
{
  switch (a) {
    case 'u': move(0, -1); break;
    case 'd': move(0, +1); break;
    case 'l': move(-1, 0); break;
    case 'r': move(+1, 0); break;
    case 'L': tab(-1); break;
    case 'R': tab(+1); break;
    case 'A': action_a(); break;
    case 'X': action_x(); break;
    case 'Y': action_y(); break;
    case 'B': s.open = false; break;
  }
}

/* ── The mouse (with mouse controls on) ───────────────────────────────
 * Pointing moves the cursor (the tabs, the hand and backpack, the shed, the
 * crop bag, the animals); a left click there is A, and on the help lines
 * does what they say (X swap, Y put away, close); the right click closes;
 * the wheel goes through the animals. (mx, my): the menu's own 256 x 224. */
static bool hit(int mx, int my, int x, int y, int w, int h) { return mx >= x && my >= y && mx < x + w && my < y + h; }
static bool text_hit(int mx, int my, int x, int base, const char *t)
{
  return hit(mx, my, x - 2, base - 9, ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, t) + 4, 12);
}
void pause_mouse(int mx, int my, bool moved, bool click, bool rclick, int wheel)
{
  if (rclick) { s.open = false; return; }
  if (wheel && s.tab == 3) animals_move(0, -wheel);
  if (mx < 0 || (!moved && !click)) return;
  for (int t = 0, x = 8; t < ntabs(); t++) {                    /* the tabs */
    int w = ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, T(kTabs[t])) + 12;
    if (hit(mx, my, x, 53, w, 17)) { if (click && s.tab != t) { s.tab = t; s.message[0] = 0; } return; }
    x += w + 2;
  }
  if (click && text_hit(mx, my, 12, 214, T("B / M / Esc  close"))) { s.open = false; return; }
  if (s.tab == 0) {
    int cx = 0, cy = -9;
    if (hit(mx, my, 104, 8, 26, 26)) { cx = 0; cy = -1; }
    else if (hit(mx, my, 134, 8, 26, 26)) { cx = 1; cy = -1; }
    for (int i = 0; i < NTOOLS && cy == -9; i++)
      if (hit(mx, my, 12 + (i % GRID_COLS) * 21, 83 + (i / GRID_COLS) * 21, 20, 20)) { cx = i % GRID_COLS; cy = i / GRID_COLS; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 9 && cy == -9 && g_cfg.crop_bag; i++)
      if (hit(mx, my, 12 + i * 18, 72 + 11 + GRID_ROWS * 21 + 1, 18, 18)) { cx = i; cy = BAG_ROW; }
    if (cy != -9) {
      if (cx != s.cx || cy != s.cy) { s.cx = cx; s.cy = cy; s.message[0] = 0; }
      if (click) action_a();
      return;
    }
    if (click && !on_bag()) {                                  /* the help line */
      const char *xs = T("X  hand ↔ backpack");
      char ys[96]; snprintf(ys, sizeof ys, "%s %s", T("Y  put away in"), T("the tool shed"));
      int x2 = 12 + ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, xs) + ui_text_w(UI_SMALL, "    ");
      if (text_hit(mx, my, 12, 205, xs)) action_x();
      else if (text_hit(mx, my, x2, 205, ys)) action_y();
    }
  } else if (s.tab == 3) {
    int sec[COWS + CHICKENS], slot[COWS + CHICKENS];
    int n = animal_list(sec, slot);
    for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_SHOWN && s.ar + r < n; r++)
      if (hit(mx, my, 8, 72 + r * 19, 242, 19)) s.ac = s.ar + r;
  }
}

/* ── Live, on a second screen (second.c) ──────────────────────────────
 * The same menu, drawn every other frame while the game goes on, and used
 * by touch: a tap is a click there (equip, swap, take out, the tabs); on
 * the Animals page a drag scrolls the list. Changes are made between two
 * frames, as the game's own code would. Before a diary is loaded: the
 * floor and a line saying so. */
void pause_live_render(uint32_t *dst)
{
  if (!hm_diary_loaded(g_ram)) {
    ui_target(dst, LW, LH);
    ui_checker();
    ui_frame(28, 92, 200, 40, C_PAPER);
    ui_text_c(UI_BODY, 128, 116, T("Load a diary to begin."), C_INK);
    return;
  }
  if (s.tab >= ntabs()) s.tab = 0;
  if (s.cy >= inv_rows() || s.cy < -1) s.cy = 0;
  s.live = true;
  render();
  s.live = false;
  memcpy(dst, s_canvas, sizeof s_canvas);
}
void pause_live_touch(int action, int x, int y)
{
  static int last_y, acc;
  if (!hm_diary_loaded(g_ram)) return;
  if (action == 0) {                                  /* down: a click there */
    last_y = y; acc = 0;
    bool keep = s.open;
    pause_mouse(x, y, true, true, false, 0);
    s.open = keep;                                    /* "close" means nothing here */
  } else if (action == 1 && s.tab == 3) {             /* a drag on the animals: scroll */
    acc += y - last_y; last_y = y;
    while (acc <= -12) { animals_move(0, +1); acc += 12; }
    while (acc >= 12) { animals_move(0, -1); acc -= 12; }
  }
}

bool pause_can_open(void) { return hm_diary_loaded(g_ram); }
void pause_open(void)
{
  s.open = true;
  s.message[0] = 0;
  if (s.tab >= ntabs()) s.tab = 0;
  if (s.cy >= inv_rows() || s.cy < -1) s.cy = 0;
}
bool pause_is_open(void) { return s.open; }

/* The menu into dst (dst_w x 224): 256 wide in the middle, the floor
 * carrying on into a widescreen picture's margins. */
void pause_draw(uint32_t *dst, int dst_w)
{
  render();
  int ox = (dst_w - LW) / 2;
  for (int y = 0; y < LH; y++)
    for (int x = 0; x < dst_w; x++) {
      int lx = x - ox;
      dst[y * dst_w + x] = (lx >= 0 && lx < LW) ? s_canvas[y * LW + lx]
                         : ((((lx >> 4) ^ (y >> 4)) & 1) ? C_CHECK_B : C_CHECK_A);
    }
}
```

`native/second.c`:

```c
/*
 * second.c — a second screen: the pause menu (pause.c), live.
 *
 * On Android (the AYN Thor and other dual-screen devices) the Java side
 * (HarvestMoonActivity, SecondScreen) puts a Presentation on the other
 * display and tells us when it shows (nativeSecondShown). Every other frame
 * the menu is drawn here, 256 x 224, and handed over (secondFrame, an int[]
 * of 0xAARRGGBB, Android's own pixel order); the touches on it come back
 * (nativeSecondTouch, on the Java UI thread) through a small queue, and are
 * applied here, on the game's thread, between two frames.
 *
 * Elsewhere there is no second screen: nothing happens.
 */
#include <string.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include "second.h"
#include "config.h"
#include "pause.h"

enum { SW = 256, SH = 224, QMAX = 64 };

void second_render(uint32_t *dst) { pause_live_render(dst); }

#ifdef SDL_PLATFORM_ANDROID
#include <jni.h>

static SDL_Mutex *s_mx;
static struct { int a, x, y; } s_q[QMAX];
static int s_qn;
static SDL_AtomicInt s_shown, s_available;
static jclass s_cls;
static jmethodID s_m_frame, s_m_enable;
static jintArray s_arr;
static uint32_t s_px[SW * SH];

JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_io_github_rodriloy_harvestmoon_HarvestMoonActivity_nativeSecondTouch(JNIEnv *env, jclass cls, jint a, jint x, jint y)
{
  (void)env; (void)cls;
  if (!s_mx) return;
  SDL_LockMutex(s_mx);
  if (a == 1 && s_qn && s_q[s_qn - 1].a == 1) { s_q[s_qn - 1].x = x; s_q[s_qn - 1].y = y; }   /* moves: the last one */
  else if (s_qn < QMAX) { s_q[s_qn].a = a; s_q[s_qn].x = x; s_q[s_qn].y = y; s_qn++; }
  SDL_UnlockMutex(s_mx);
}
JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_io_github_rodriloy_harvestmoon_HarvestMoonActivity_nativeSecondShown(JNIEnv *env, jclass cls, jboolean on)
{
  (void)env; (void)cls;
  SDL_SetAtomicInt(&s_shown, on ? 1 : 0);
}

JNIEXPORT void JNICALL Java_io_github_rodriloy_harvestmoon_HarvestMoonActivity_nativeSecondAvailable(JNIEnv *env, jclass cls, jboolean on)
{
  (void)env; (void)cls;
  SDL_SetAtomicInt(&s_available, on ? 1 : 0);
}
bool second_available(void) { return SDL_GetAtomicInt(&s_available) != 0; }

static JNIEnv *jni(void)
{
  JNIEnv *env = (JNIEnv *)SDL_GetAndroidJNIEnv();
  if (!env) return NULL;
  if (s_cls) return env;
  jobject act = (jobject)SDL_GetAndroidActivity();
  if (!act) return NULL;
  jclass c = (*env)->GetObjectClass(env, act);
  s_cls = (jclass)(*env)->NewGlobalRef(env, c);
  (*env)->DeleteLocalRef(env, c);
  (*env)->DeleteLocalRef(env, act);
  s_m_frame = (*env)->GetStaticMethodID(env, s_cls, "secondFrame", "([I)V");
  s_m_enable = (*env)->GetStaticMethodID(env, s_cls, "secondEnable", "(Z)V");
  if ((*env)->ExceptionCheck(env)) { (*env)->ExceptionClear(env); s_m_frame = s_m_enable = NULL; }
  jintArray a = (*env)->NewIntArray(env, SW * SH);
  if (a) { s_arr = (jintArray)(*env)->NewGlobalRef(env, a); (*env)->DeleteLocalRef(env, a); }
  return env;
}

void second_init(void)
{
  if (!s_mx) s_mx = SDL_CreateMutex();
  second_apply();
}
void second_apply(void)
{
  JNIEnv *env = jni();
  if (!env || !s_m_enable) return;
  (*env)->CallStaticVoidMethod(env, s_cls, s_m_enable, (jboolean)(g_cfg.second_screen ? JNI_TRUE : JNI_FALSE));
  if ((*env)->ExceptionCheck(env)) (*env)->ExceptionClear(env);
}
bool second_shown(void) { return g_cfg.second_screen && SDL_GetAtomicInt(&s_shown); }

void second_frame(void)
{
  static unsigned n;
  if (!second_shown() || !s_mx) return;
  /* the touches, in order */
  int q[QMAX][3], k = 0;
  SDL_LockMutex(s_mx);
  for (int i = 0; i < s_qn; i++) { q[i][0] = s_q[i].a; q[i][1] = s_q[i].x; q[i][2] = s_q[i].y; }
  k = s_qn; s_qn = 0;
  SDL_UnlockMutex(s_mx);
  for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) pause_live_touch(q[i][0], q[i][1], q[i][2]);
  /* the picture, 30 times a second (or at once after a touch) */
  if ((++n & 1) && !k) return;
  JNIEnv *env = jni();
  if (!env || !s_m_frame || !s_arr) return;
  pause_live_render(s_px);
  (*env)->SetIntArrayRegion(env, s_arr, 0, SW * SH, (const jint *)s_px);
  (*env)->CallStaticVoidMethod(env, s_cls, s_m_frame, s_arr);
  if ((*env)->ExceptionCheck(env)) (*env)->ExceptionClear(env);
}

#else  /* no second screen here */

void second_init(void) {}
void second_apply(void) {}
void second_frame(void) {}
bool second_shown(void) { return false; }
bool second_available(void) { return false; }

#endif

```

`native/second.h`:

```h
/* second.h — a second screen (the AYN Thor's lower one): the pause menu,
 * live, used by touch. second.c; the Android side is HarvestMoonActivity /
 * SecondScreen (android/app/src/main/java). */
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

void second_init(void);
void second_apply(void);       /* g_cfg.second_screen changed */
/* once a frame (also while a menu is open): the touches in, the picture out */
void second_frame(void);
bool second_shown(void);       /* a second screen is showing the menu */
bool second_available(void);   /* the device has another screen (the option shows only then) */
/* tests (HM_SECOND_SHOT): the picture it would show */
void second_render(uint32_t *dst);

```

`native/touch.c`:

```c
/*
 * touch.c — on-screen controls for touch screens, in the look of the game's
 * menus: a wooden cross for the arrows, A B X Y as parchment coins with the
 * SNES pad's letters, L and R as wooden tabs, Select and Start as little
 * parchment signs, and four small signs: the pause menu, the crop bag, the
 * launcher and fast forward.
 *
 * They are drawn at the game's own pixel size (the screen's height is 224
 * of them). Beside a 4:3 picture they sit in the bars, solid, on the pause
 * menu's checkered floor; when the picture fills the screen (widescreen)
 * they go over its edges, see-through (solid while pressed). Auto (the default): they show when the screen is
 * touched and hide when keys or a gamepad are used (the AYN Thor's own
 * buttons); on a phone with no gamepad they are there from the start.
 *
 * Several fingers at once. A finger that lands on the cross stays on it
 * (it may slide anywhere: the direction is from the cross's middle, eight
 * ways); one on A B X Y may slide from button to button. A touch on the
 * field, with mouse controls on, is the mouse: a tap a left click, a drag
 * the left button held (walking after the finger), a long press (half a
 * second, still) a right click.
 */
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "touch.h"
#include "config.h"
#include "ui.h"

enum { LH = 224, LW_MAX = 720, FINGERS = 10 };
enum { E_DPAD, E_A, E_B, E_X, E_Y, E_L, E_R, E_SELECT, E_START, E_MENU, E_BAG, E_LAUNCHER, E_FAST, NE };
enum { R_NONE, R_DPAD, R_FACE, R_BTN, R_MENU, R_LAUNCHER, R_BAG, R_FAST, R_FIELD };
typedef struct { int x, y, w, h; } Box;            /* the round ones: (x, y) the middle, w the radius */
typedef struct {
  bool on; SDL_FingerID id; int role; uint16_t mask;
  float lx, ly, lx0, ly0;                          /* overlay pixels */
  float wx, wy;                                    /* window pixels */
  uint64_t t0; bool moved, held, right;
} Finger;

static struct {
  bool visible;
  TouchFieldFn field;
  int lw, gx0, gx1;                                /* the overlay's width; the picture's columns */
  float scale;                                     /* output pixels per overlay pixel */
  Box e[NE];
  Finger f[FINGERS];
  int request;
  uint64_t clear_at;
  uint32_t px[LW_MAX * LH];
  SDL_Texture *tex; int tex_w;
} ts;

static const uint16_t kFace[4] = { B_A, B_B, B_X, B_Y };

static bool show_menu(void) { return g_cfg.pause_menu; }
static bool show_bag(void) { return g_cfg.pause_menu && g_cfg.crop_bag; }

static void layout(int out_w, int out_h, SDL_FRect game)
{
  ts.scale = out_h > 0 ? out_h / (float)LH : 1.0f;
  int lw = (int)(out_w / ts.scale + 0.5f);
  ts.lw = lw < 256 ? 256 : lw > LW_MAX ? LW_MAX : lw;
  ts.gx0 = (int)(game.x / ts.scale + 0.5f);
  ts.gx1 = (int)((game.x + game.w) / ts.scale + 0.5f);
  if (game.w <= 0) { ts.gx0 = 0; ts.gx1 = ts.lw; }
  int ml = ts.gx0, mr = ts.lw - ts.gx1;
  /* in the bars when they are wide enough (a 16:9 screen's are 71), else at the edges, over the picture */
  int cl = ml >= 70 ? ml / 2 : 44, cr = mr >= 70 ? ts.lw - mr / 2 : ts.lw - 44;
  Box *e = ts.e;
  e[E_DPAD] = (Box){ cl, 132, 33, 0 };
  e[E_A] = (Box){ cr + 23, 132, 12, 0 };
  e[E_B] = (Box){ cr, 155, 12, 0 };
  e[E_X] = (Box){ cr, 109, 12, 0 };
  e[E_Y] = (Box){ cr - 23, 132, 12, 0 };
  e[E_L] = (Box){ cl - 30, 10, 60, 18 };
  e[E_R] = (Box){ cr - 30, 10, 60, 18 };
  e[E_MENU] = (Box){ cl - 30, 34, 28, 18 };
  e[E_BAG] = (Box){ cl + 2, 34, 28, 18 };
  e[E_LAUNCHER] = (Box){ cr - 30, 34, 28, 18 };
  e[E_FAST] = (Box){ cr + 2, 34, 28, 18 };
  e[E_SELECT] = (Box){ cl - 24, 190, 48, 16 };
  e[E_START] = (Box){ cr - 24, 190, 48, 16 };
}

static bool round_hit(const Box *b, float x, float y)
{
  float dx = x - b->x, dy = y - b->y, r = b->w + 6.0f;
  return dx * dx + dy * dy <= r * r;
}
static bool box_hit(const Box *b, float x, float y)
{
  return x >= b->x - 3 && x < b->x + b->w + 3 && y >= b->y - 3 && y < b->y + b->h + 3;
}
static int face_at(float x, float y)
{
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (round_hit(&ts.e[E_A + i], x, y)) return i;
  return -1;
}
static uint16_t dpad_dir(float x, float y)
{
  float dx = x - ts.e[E_DPAD].x, dy = y - ts.e[E_DPAD].y;
  if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 36.0f) return 0;                    /* the middle: nothing */
  float ax = fabsf(dx), ay = fabsf(dy);
  uint16_t m = 0;
  if (ax > ay * 0.42f) m |= dx < 0 ? B_LEFT : B_RIGHT;        /* eight ways */
  if (ay > ax * 0.42f) m |= dy < 0 ? B_UP : B_DOWN;
  return m;
}

/* what a finger landing at (x, y) does */
static void land(Finger *f)
{
  float x = f->lx, y = f->ly;
  const Box *e = ts.e;
  f->role = R_NONE; f->mask = 0;
  if (ts.visible) {
    if (fabsf(x - e[E_DPAD].x) <= 42 && fabsf(y - e[E_DPAD].y) <= 42) { f->role = R_DPAD; f->mask = dpad_dir(x, y); return; }
    int k = face_at(x, y);
    if (k >= 0) { f->role = R_FACE; f->mask = kFace[k]; return; }
    if (box_hit(&e[E_L], x, y)) { f->role = R_BTN; f->mask = B_L; return; }
    if (box_hit(&e[E_R], x, y)) { f->role = R_BTN; f->mask = B_R; return; }
    if (box_hit(&e[E_SELECT], x, y)) { f->role = R_BTN; f->mask = B_SELECT; return; }
    if (box_hit(&e[E_START], x, y)) { f->role = R_BTN; f->mask = B_START; return; }
    if (show_menu() && box_hit(&e[E_MENU], x, y)) { f->role = R_MENU; ts.request = 1; return; }
    if (show_bag() && box_hit(&e[E_BAG], x, y)) { f->role = R_BAG; return; }
    if (box_hit(&e[E_LAUNCHER], x, y)) { f->role = R_LAUNCHER; ts.request = 2; return; }
    if (box_hit(&e[E_FAST], x, y)) { f->role = R_FAST; return; }
  }
  if (g_cfg.mouse && ts.field && x >= ts.gx0 && x < ts.gx1) {
    f->role = R_FIELD;
    ts.field(f->wx, f->wy, 0, false);
  }
}

static Finger *finger(SDL_FingerID id, bool make)
{
  for (int i = 0; i < FINGERS; i++) if (ts.f[i].on && ts.f[i].id == id) return &ts.f[i];
  if (!make) return NULL;
  for (int i = 0; i < FINGERS; i++)
    if (!ts.f[i].on) { memset(&ts.f[i], 0, sizeof ts.f[i]); ts.f[i].on = true; ts.f[i].id = id; return &ts.f[i]; }
  return NULL;
}

void touch_init(bool show_at_start, TouchFieldFn field)
{
  ts.field = field;
  ts.visible = g_cfg.touch == TOUCH_ALWAYS || (g_cfg.touch == TOUCH_AUTO && show_at_start);
}

void touch_event(const SDL_Event *ev, int win_w, int win_h, int out_w, int out_h, SDL_FRect game)
{
  if (ev->type != SDL_EVENT_FINGER_DOWN && ev->type != SDL_EVENT_FINGER_MOTION &&
      ev->type != SDL_EVENT_FINGER_UP && ev->type != SDL_EVENT_FINGER_CANCELED) return;
  if (ev->tfinger.touchID == SDL_MOUSE_TOUCHID) return;            /* the mouse, as a finger: not here */
  layout(out_w, out_h, game);
  bool down = ev->type == SDL_EVENT_FINGER_DOWN;
  Finger *f = finger(ev->tfinger.fingerID, down);
  if (!f) return;
  f->lx = ev->tfinger.x * out_w / ts.scale; f->ly = ev->tfinger.y * out_h / ts.scale;
  f->wx = ev->tfinger.x * win_w; f->wy = ev->tfinger.y * win_h;
  uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicks();
  if (down) {
    if (g_cfg.touch != TOUCH_OFF && !ts.visible) ts.visible = true;
    f->lx0 = f->lx; f->ly0 = f->ly; f->t0 = now;
    land(f);
    return;
  }
  if (ev->type == SDL_EVENT_FINGER_MOTION) {
    float dx = f->lx - f->lx0, dy = f->ly - f->ly0;
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy > 36.0f) f->moved = true;
    switch (f->role) {
    case R_DPAD: f->mask = dpad_dir(f->lx, f->ly); break;
    case R_FACE: { int k = face_at(f->lx, f->ly); if (k >= 0) f->mask = kFace[k]; break; }
    case R_FIELD:
      if (f->moved && !f->held && !f->right) { f->held = true; ts.field(f->wx, f->wy, 1, true); }
      else ts.field(f->wx, f->wy, 0, false);
      break;
    default: break;
    }
    return;
  }
  /* up, or taken away by the system */
  if (f->role == R_FIELD) {
    if (f->held) ts.field(f->wx, f->wy, 1, false);
    else if (!f->right && ev->type == SDL_EVENT_FINGER_UP) { ts.field(f->wx, f->wy, 1, true); ts.field(f->wx, f->wy, 1, false); }
    ts.clear_at = now + 700;
  }
  f->on = false;
}

void touch_frame(void)
{
  uint64_t now = SDL_GetTicks();
  bool field_down = false;
  for (int i = 0; i < FINGERS; i++) {
    Finger *f = &ts.f[i];
    if (!f->on || f->role != R_FIELD) continue;
    field_down = true;
    if (!f->moved && !f->held && !f->right && now - f->t0 >= 500) {   /* a long press: the right button */
      f->right = true;
      ts.field(f->wx, f->wy, 2, true);
      ts.field(f->wx, f->wy, 2, false);
    }
  }
  if (ts.clear_at && now >= ts.clear_at && !field_down) {
    ts.clear_at = 0;
    if (ts.field) ts.field(-1, -1, 0, false);
  }
}

uint16_t touch_pad(void)
{
  uint16_t m = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < FINGERS; i++)
    if (ts.f[i].on && (ts.f[i].role == R_DPAD || ts.f[i].role == R_FACE || ts.f[i].role == R_BTN)) m |= ts.f[i].mask;
  return m;
}
static bool role_held(int role)
{
  for (int i = 0; i < FINGERS; i++) if (ts.f[i].on && ts.f[i].role == role) return true;
  return false;
}
bool touch_bag(void) { return role_held(R_BAG); }
bool touch_fast(void) { return role_held(R_FAST); }
int touch_request(void) { int r = ts.request; ts.request = 0; return r; }
void touch_input_seen(uint16_t pad)
{
  if (!pad || g_cfg.touch != TOUCH_AUTO || !ts.visible) return;
  for (int i = 0; i < FINGERS; i++) if (ts.f[i].on) return;
  ts.visible = false;
}
void touch_release_all(void)
{
  for (int i = 0; i < FINGERS; i++) ts.f[i].on = false;
  ts.request = 0;
}
bool touch_visible(void) { return ts.visible && g_cfg.touch != TOUCH_OFF; }

/* ── Drawing ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void disc(int cx, int cy, int r, uint32_t c)
{
  for (int y = -r; y <= r; y++)
    for (int x = -r; x <= r; x++)
      if (x * x + y * y <= r * r + r) ui_px(cx + x, cy + y, c);
}
/* A B X Y: a parchment coin on a wooden rim, the letter in the SNES pad's
 * colour; held: the menus' highlight */
static void coin(const Box *b, const char *letter, uint32_t ink, bool held)
{
  int cx = b->x, cy = b->y, r = b->w;
  disc(cx, cy + 1, r, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  disc(cx, cy, r, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  disc(cx, cy, r - 1, C_WOOD);
  disc(cx, cy, r - 3, held ? C_SELECT : C_PAPER);
  if (!held)
    for (int y = -r + 3; y <= 0; y++)                         /* a shine on the upper left */
      for (int x = -r + 3; x <= 0; x++) {
        int d = x * x + y * y, rr = (r - 3) * (r - 3);
        if (d <= rr + r && d > (r - 4) * (r - 4)) ui_px(cx + x, cy + y, C_CREAM);
      }
  ui_text_c(UI_BODY, cx, cy + 5, letter, ink);
}
/* the cross: wood, cream arrows; the arm held darker */
static void cross(const Box *b, uint16_t held)
{
  int cx = b->x, cy = b->y, R = 31, a = 10;
  ui_rect(cx - R - 1, cy - a - 1, 2 * R + 2, 2 * a + 3, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(cx - a - 1, cy - R - 1, 2 * a + 2, 2 * R + 3, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(cx - R, cy - a, 2 * R, 2 * a, C_WOOD);
  ui_rect(cx - a, cy - R, 2 * a, 2 * R, C_WOOD);
  if (held & B_LEFT) ui_rect(cx - R, cy - a, R - a, 2 * a, C_WOOD_DARK);
  if (held & B_RIGHT) ui_rect(cx + a, cy - a, R - a, 2 * a, C_WOOD_DARK);
  if (held & B_UP) ui_rect(cx - a, cy - R, 2 * a, R - a, C_WOOD_DARK);
  if (held & B_DOWN) ui_rect(cx - a, cy + a, 2 * a, R - a, C_WOOD_DARK);
  ui_hline(cx - R, cy - a, R - a, C_WOOD_LIGHT); ui_hline(cx + a, cy - a, R - a, C_WOOD_LIGHT);
  ui_hline(cx - a, cy - R, 2 * a, C_WOOD_LIGHT);
  ui_vline(cx - a, cy - R, R - a, C_WOOD_LIGHT); ui_vline(cx - R, cy - a, 2 * a, C_WOOD_LIGHT);
  disc(cx, cy, 6, C_WOOD_DARK);
  disc(cx, cy, 4, C_WOOD);
  for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
    uint32_t c;
    c = (held & B_UP) ? C_SELECT : C_CREAM;    ui_hline(cx - k, cy - R + 5 + k, 2 * k + 1, c);
    c = (held & B_DOWN) ? C_SELECT : C_CREAM;  ui_hline(cx - k, cy + R - 5 - k, 2 * k + 1, c);
    c = (held & B_LEFT) ? C_SELECT : C_CREAM;  ui_vline(cx - R + 5 + k, cy - k, 2 * k + 1, c);
    c = (held & B_RIGHT) ? C_SELECT : C_CREAM; ui_vline(cx + R - 5 - k, cy - k, 2 * k + 1, c);
  }
}
/* L and R: wooden tabs, as the pause menu's */
static void tab(const Box *b, const char *t, bool held)
{
  ui_rect(b->x + 1, b->y, b->w - 2, b->h, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(b->x, b->y + 1, b->w, b->h - 1, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(b->x + 1, b->y + 1, b->w - 2, b->h - 2, held ? C_WOOD_DARK : C_WOOD);
  if (!held) ui_hline(b->x + 2, b->y + 1, b->w - 4, C_WOOD_LIGHT);
  ui_text_sh(UI_BODY, b->x + (b->w - ui_text_w(UI_BODY, t)) / 2, b->y + 14, t, C_CREAM);
}
/* the little parchment signs */
static void sign(const Box *b, bool held)
{
  ui_rect(b->x + 1, b->y, b->w - 2, b->h, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(b->x, b->y + 1, b->w, b->h - 2, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(b->x + 1, b->y + 1, b->w - 2, b->h - 2, held ? C_SELECT : C_PAPER);
  ui_hline(b->x + 2, b->y + b->h - 2, b->w - 4, held ? C_GOLD : C_PAPER_DARK);
}
static void sign_text(const Box *b, const char *t, bool held)
{
  sign(b, held);
  ui_text_c(UI_SMALL, b->x + b->w / 2, b->y + b->h - 5, t, C_INK);
}
static void art(int x, int y, const char *const *rows, int n, uint32_t ink, uint32_t fill)
{
  for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
    for (int i = 0; rows[j][i]; i++)
      if (rows[j][i] == '#') ui_px(x + i, y + j, ink);
      else if (rows[j][i] == 'c') ui_px(x + i, y + j, fill);
}
static void icon_menu(const Box *b, bool held)     /* the pause menu: its grid of slots */
{
  sign(b, held);
  int x = b->x + (b->w - 13) / 2, y = b->y + 4;
  for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++)
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      ui_rect(x + i * 5, y + j * 5, 4, 4, C_INK);
      ui_rect(x + i * 5 + 1, y + j * 5 + 1, 2, 2, j ? C_BLUE : C_GREEN);
    }
}
static void icon_bag(const Box *b, bool held)      /* the crop bag: a sack */
{
  static const char *sack[10] = { "...##...", "..#cc#..", "...##...", "..#cc#..", ".#cccc#.",
                                  "#cccccc#", "#cccccc#", "#cccccc#", ".#cccc#.", "..####.." };
  sign(b, held);
  art(b->x + (b->w - 8) / 2, b->y + 3, sack, 10, C_INK, C_WOOD_LIGHT);
}
static void icon_launcher(const Box *b, bool held) /* the launcher: three lines */
{
  sign(b, held);
  int x = b->x + (b->w - 12) / 2;
  for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++) ui_rect(x, b->y + 4 + j * 3, 12, 2, C_INK);
}
static void icon_fast(const Box *b, bool held)     /* fast forward: two arrows */
{
  sign(b, held);
  int x = b->x + (b->w - 12) / 2, y = b->y + 8;
  for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++) { ui_vline(x + k, y - 4 + k, 9 - 2 * k, C_INK); ui_vline(x + 6 + k, y - 4 + k, 9 - 2 * k, C_INK); }
}

static void draw_controls(bool only_held)
{
  uint16_t held = touch_pad();
  const Box *e = ts.e;
  bool menu = role_held(R_MENU), bag = role_held(R_BAG), launcher = role_held(R_LAUNCHER), fast = role_held(R_FAST);
  if (!only_held || (held & (B_UP | B_DOWN | B_LEFT | B_RIGHT))) cross(&e[E_DPAD], held);
  if (!only_held || (held & B_A)) coin(&e[E_A], "A", C_RED, held & B_A);
  if (!only_held || (held & B_B)) coin(&e[E_B], "B", C_GOLD_DARK, held & B_B);
  if (!only_held || (held & B_X)) coin(&e[E_X], "X", C_BLUE, held & B_X);
  if (!only_held || (held & B_Y)) coin(&e[E_Y], "Y", C_GREEN_DARK, held & B_Y);
  if (!only_held || (held & B_L)) tab(&e[E_L], "L", held & B_L);
  if (!only_held || (held & B_R)) tab(&e[E_R], "R", held & B_R);
  if (!only_held || (held & B_SELECT)) sign_text(&e[E_SELECT], "SELECT", held & B_SELECT);
  if (!only_held || (held & B_START)) sign_text(&e[E_START], "START", held & B_START);
  if (show_menu() && (!only_held || menu)) icon_menu(&e[E_MENU], menu);
  if (show_bag() && (!only_held || bag)) icon_bag(&e[E_BAG], bag);
  if (!only_held || launcher) icon_launcher(&e[E_LAUNCHER], launcher);
  if (!only_held || fast) icon_fast(&e[E_FAST], fast);
}

void touch_draw(SDL_Renderer *r, int out_w, int out_h, SDL_FRect game)
{
  if (!touch_visible() || out_h <= 0) return;
  layout(out_w, out_h, game);
  int lw = ts.lw;
  memset(ts.px, 0, sizeof(uint32_t) * (size_t)lw * LH);
  ui_target(ts.px, lw, LH);
  if (ts.gx0 >= 70 && lw - ts.gx1 >= 70) {
    /* bars wide enough beside the picture: there, solid, on the pause
     * menu's checkered floor (darker) */
    for (int y = 0; y < LH; y++)
      for (int x = 0; x < lw; x++)
        if (x < ts.gx0 || x >= ts.gx1) ts.px[y * lw + x] = (((x >> 4) ^ (y >> 4)) & 1) ? C_CHECK_B : C_CHECK_A;
    ui_dim(0, 0, ts.gx0, LH, 1);
    ui_dim(ts.gx1, 0, lw - ts.gx1, LH, 1);
    draw_controls(false);
  } else {
    /* the picture fills the screen (widescreen): see-through over it, so
     * nothing of the game is hidden; the ones being pressed solid */
    draw_controls(false);
    for (int i = 0; i < lw * LH; i++)
      if (ts.px[i] >> 24) ts.px[i] = (ts.px[i] & 0x00FFFFFFu) | 0x80000000u;
    draw_controls(true);
  }

  if (!ts.tex || ts.tex_w != lw) {
    if (ts.tex) SDL_DestroyTexture(ts.tex);
    ts.tex = SDL_CreateTexture(r, SDL_PIXELFORMAT_ARGB8888, SDL_TEXTUREACCESS_STREAMING, lw, LH);
    if (!ts.tex) return;
    SDL_SetTextureBlendMode(ts.tex, SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND);
    SDL_SetTextureScaleMode(ts.tex, SDL_SCALEMODE_NEAREST);
    ts.tex_w = lw;
  }
  SDL_UpdateTexture(ts.tex, NULL, ts.px, lw * 4);
  SDL_FRect dst = { 0, 0, lw * ts.scale, (float)out_h };
  SDL_RenderTexture(r, ts.tex, NULL, &dst);
}

```

`native/touch.h`:

```h
/* touch.h — on-screen controls for touch screens (phones, tablets, the AYN
 * Thor), drawn in the look of the game's menus; and touches on the field as
 * the mouse (mouse controls). touch.c. */
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

enum { TOUCH_AUTO, TOUCH_ALWAYS, TOUCH_OFF };   /* g_cfg.touch */

/* a touch on the field for the mouse controls: window pixels; x < 0: the
 * pointer goes away; button 0 a move, 1 left, 2 right */
typedef void (*TouchFieldFn)(float x, float y, int button, bool down);

void touch_init(bool gamepad_present, TouchFieldFn field);
/* a finger event while the game runs (not in the menus); `game`: where the
 * picture is on the window's output (pixels); out_w/out_h the output's size */
void touch_event(const SDL_Event *ev, int win_w, int win_h, int out_w, int out_h, SDL_FRect game);
void touch_frame(void);              /* once a frame: long presses, the pointer going */
uint16_t touch_pad(void);            /* the game's buttons held on the screen */
bool touch_bag(void);                /* the crop bag's key held */
bool touch_fast(void);               /* fast forward held */
int touch_request(void);             /* once: 1 the pause menu, 2 the launcher */
void touch_input_seen(uint16_t pad); /* keys or a gamepad used: the controls hide (auto) */
void touch_release_all(void);        /* a menu opened: every finger let go */
bool touch_visible(void);
/* over the picture, before it is presented */
void touch_draw(SDL_Renderer *r, int out_w, int out_h, SDL_FRect game);

```

`native/ui.c`:

```c
/* ui.c — drawing for the native build's own screens (see ui.h).
 *
 * The frames, slots and type follow the recompilation's pause menu
 * (HarvestMoonSNESRecomp, hm_pause.c): the same wood and parchment, the
 * same pixel fonts (Pixelify Sans and Tiny5, SIL Open Font License, see
 * fonts/) and item icons (original drawings, hm_icons.h). The night farm
 * behind the launcher is drawn here from plain shapes: no game graphics. */
#include <math.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "ui.h"
#include "hm_pixfont.h"
#include "hm_icons.h"

uint32_t *g_ui_px;
int g_ui_w, g_ui_h;

void ui_target(uint32_t *px, int w, int h) { g_ui_px = px; g_ui_w = w; g_ui_h = h; }

void ui_rect(int x, int y, int w, int h, uint32_t c)
{
  if (!(c >> 24)) return;
  int x0 = x < 0 ? 0 : x, y0 = y < 0 ? 0 : y;
  int x1 = x + w > g_ui_w ? g_ui_w : x + w, y1 = y + h > g_ui_h ? g_ui_h : y + h;
  for (int j = y0; j < y1; j++)
    for (int i = x0; i < x1; i++) g_ui_px[j * g_ui_w + i] = c;
}
void ui_hline(int x, int y, int w, uint32_t c) { ui_rect(x, y, w, 1, c); }
void ui_vline(int x, int y, int h, uint32_t c) { ui_rect(x, y, 1, h, c); }
void ui_dim(int x, int y, int w, int h, int shift)
{
  int x0 = x < 0 ? 0 : x, y0 = y < 0 ? 0 : y;
  int x1 = x + w > g_ui_w ? g_ui_w : x + w, y1 = y + h > g_ui_h ? g_ui_h : y + h;
  uint32_t m = shift == 1 ? 0x7F7F7F : shift == 2 ? 0x3F3F3F : 0x1F1F1F;
  for (int j = y0; j < y1; j++)
    for (int i = x0; i < x1; i++) {
      uint32_t *p = &g_ui_px[j * g_ui_w + i];
      *p = 0xFF000000u | ((*p >> shift) & m);
    }
}

void ui_frame(int x, int y, int w, int h, uint32_t fill)
{
  ui_rect(x + 2, y, w - 4, h, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x, y + 2, w, h - 4, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, h - 2, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x + 2, y + 1, w - 4, h - 2, C_WOOD);
  ui_rect(x + 1, y + 2, w - 2, h - 4, C_WOOD);
  ui_hline(x + 2, y + 1, w - 4, C_WOOD_SHINE);
  ui_hline(x + 2, y + 2, w - 4, C_WOOD_LIGHT);
  ui_vline(x + 1, y + 2, h - 4, C_WOOD_LIGHT);
  ui_hline(x + 2, y + h - 2, w - 4, C_WOOD_DARK);
  ui_vline(x + w - 2, y + 2, h - 4, C_WOOD_DARK);
  for (int i = x + 6; i < x + w - 6; i += 9) ui_px(i, y + 2, C_WOOD), ui_px(i + 3, y + h - 3, C_WOOD_DARK);
  ui_rect(x + 3, y + 3, w - 6, h - 6, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x + 4, y + 4, w - 8, h - 8, fill);
  if (fill == C_PAPER) {
    ui_hline(x + 4, y + 4, w - 8, C_PAPER_DARK);
    ui_vline(x + 4, y + 5, h - 9, C_PAPER_DARK);
  }
}

void ui_slot(int x, int y, int sz, uint32_t c, uint32_t cdark, bool sel)
{
  ui_rect(x + 1, y, sz - 2, sz, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x, y + 1, sz, sz - 2, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x + 1, y + 1, sz - 2, sz - 2, c);
  ui_hline(x + 2, y + sz - 2, sz - 4, cdark);
  ui_vline(x + sz - 2, y + 2, sz - 4, cdark);
  ui_rect(x + 3, y + 3, sz - 6, sz - 6, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x + 4, y + 4, sz - 8, sz - 8, sel ? C_SELECT : C_PAPER);
  ui_hline(x + 4, y + 4, sz - 8, sel ? C_GOLD : C_PAPER_DARK);
}

void ui_icon(int x, int y, uint8_t id)
{
  if (id == 0 || id >= HM_ICON_COUNT) return;
  ui_image(x, y, kHmIcons[id], 16, 16);
}
void ui_image(int x, int y, const uint32_t *p, int w, int h)
{
  for (int j = 0; j < h; j++)
    for (int i = 0; i < w; i++) ui_px(x + i, y + j, p[j * w + i]);
}

void ui_hand(int x, int y)
{
  static const char *hand[7] = { "..##....", ".#cc####", "#cccccc#", "#ccc####", "#cccc#..", ".####...", "........" };
  for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++)
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++)
      if (hand[j][i] == '#') ui_px(x + i, y + j, C_WOOD_EDGE);
      else if (hand[j][i] == 'c') ui_px(x + i, y + j, C_CREAM);
}

void ui_heart(int x, int y, uint32_t fill, bool full)
{
  static const char *art[6] = { ".##.##.", "#######", "#######", ".#####.", "..###..", "...#..." };
  for (int j = 0; j < 6; j++)
    for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
      if (art[j][i] != '#') continue;
      bool edge = j == 0 || i == 0 || i == 6 || art[j - 1][i] != '#' || (j < 5 && art[j + 1][i] != '#') ||
                  art[j][i - 1] != '#' || art[j][i + 1] != '#';
      ui_px(x + i, y + j, edge ? C_WOOD_EDGE : (full ? fill : C_PAPER_DARK));
    }
  if (full) ui_px(x + 2, y + 1, C_CREAM);
}

void ui_checker(void)
{
  int ox = (g_ui_w - 256) / 2;
  for (int y = 0; y < g_ui_h; y++)
    for (int x = 0; x < g_ui_w; x++)
      g_ui_px[y * g_ui_w + x] = ((((x - ox) >> 4) ^ (y >> 4)) & 1) ? C_CHECK_B : C_CHECK_A;
}

void ui_switch(int x, int y, bool on)
{
  ui_rect(x + 1, y, 18, 9, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x, y + 1, 20, 7, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x + 1, y + 1, 18, 7, on ? C_GREEN : C_PAPER_DARK);
  int k = on ? x + 11 : x + 1;
  ui_rect(k, y + 1, 8, 7, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(k + 1, y + 2, 6, 5, on ? C_CREAM : C_WOOD_LIGHT);
}
void ui_bar(int x, int y, int w, int v, int max)
{
  if (max < 1) max = 1;
  if (v < 0) v = 0;
  if (v > max) v = max;
  ui_rect(x, y, w, 5, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  ui_rect(x + 1, y + 1, w - 2, 3, C_PAPER_DARK);
  ui_rect(x + 1, y + 1, (w - 2) * v / max, 3, C_GREEN);
}

/* ── Text ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static const HmPixFont *font(int f) { return f == UI_SMALL ? &kPix_small : &kPix_body; }

uint32_t ui_utf8_next(const char **p)
{
  const unsigned char *s8 = (const unsigned char *)*p;
  uint32_t c = s8[0];
  int n = 1;
  if (c >= 0xF0 && s8[1] && s8[2] && s8[3]) { c = ((c & 7) << 18) | ((s8[1] & 63) << 12) | ((s8[2] & 63) << 6) | (s8[3] & 63); n = 4; }
  else if (c >= 0xE0 && s8[1] && s8[2]) { c = ((c & 15) << 12) | ((s8[1] & 63) << 6) | (s8[2] & 63); n = 3; }
  else if (c >= 0xC0 && s8[1]) { c = ((c & 31) << 6) | (s8[1] & 63); n = 2; }
  *p += n;
  return c;
}
static const HmPixGlyph *glyph(const HmPixFont *f, uint32_t cp)
{
  for (int i = 0; i < f->n; i++) if (f->g[i].cp == cp) return &f->g[i];
  for (int i = 0; i < f->n; i++) if (f->g[i].cp == '?') return &f->g[i];
  return &f->g[0];
}
int ui_text_w(int fi, const char *t)
{
  const HmPixFont *f = font(fi);
  int w = 0;
  while (*t) w += glyph(f, ui_utf8_next(&t))->adv;
  return w;
}
static int text_scaled(const HmPixFont *f, int x, int y, const char *t, uint32_t col, int k)
{
  int top = y - f->ascent * k;
  while (*t) {
    const HmPixGlyph *g = glyph(f, ui_utf8_next(&t));
    for (int j = 0; j < f->h; j++) {
      uint16_t bits = f->rows[g->off + j];
      for (int i = 0; bits; i++, bits >>= 1)
        if (bits & 1) {
          if (k == 1) ui_px(x + i, top + j, col);
          else ui_rect(x + i * k, top + j * k, k, k, col);
        }
    }
    x += g->adv * k;
  }
  return x;
}
int ui_text(int f, int x, int y, const char *t, uint32_t col) { return text_scaled(font(f), x, y, t, col, 1); }
int ui_text_sh(int f, int x, int y, const char *t, uint32_t col)
{
  ui_text(f, x + 1, y + 1, t, C_WOOD_EDGE);
  return ui_text(f, x, y, t, col);
}
void ui_text_r(int f, int rx, int y, const char *t, uint32_t col) { ui_text(f, rx - ui_text_w(f, t), y, t, col); }
void ui_text_c(int f, int cx, int y, const char *t, uint32_t col) { ui_text(f, cx - ui_text_w(f, t) / 2, y, t, col); }
int ui_text_big_w(const char *t) { return 2 * ui_text_w(UI_BODY, t); }
int ui_text_big(int x, int y, const char *t, uint32_t col, uint32_t edge)
{
  for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy += 2)
    for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx += 2)
      if (dx || dy) text_scaled(&kPix_body, x + dx, y + dy, t, edge, 2);
  text_scaled(&kPix_body, x + 2, y + 4, t, edge, 2);
  return text_scaled(&kPix_body, x, y, t, col, 2);
}
int ui_text_wrap(int fi, int x, int y, int w, int lh, int max, const char *t, uint32_t col)
{
  const HmPixFont *f = font(fi);
  int lines = 0;
  while (*t && lines < max) {
    /* the longest run of whole words that fits */
    const char *p = t, *cut = NULL;
    int width = 0;
    while (*p && *p != '\n') {
      const char *q = p;
      uint32_t cp = ui_utf8_next(&q);
      int a = glyph(f, cp)->adv;
      if (width + a > w) break;
      width += a;
      if (cp == ' ') cut = p;
      p = q;
    }
    const char *end = (!*p || *p == '\n' || !cut) ? p : cut;
    char line[256];
    size_t n = (size_t)(end - t);
    if (n >= sizeof line) n = sizeof line - 1;
    memcpy(line, t, n); line[n] = 0;
    text_scaled(f, x, y + lines * lh, line, col, 1);
    lines++;
    t = end;
    while (*t == ' ' || *t == '\n') t++;
  }
  return lines;
}

/* ── The farm by day ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint32_t hash(uint32_t x)
{
  x ^= x >> 16; x *= 0x7FEB352Du; x ^= x >> 15; x *= 0x846CA68Bu; x ^= x >> 16;
  return x;
}
static uint32_t mix(uint32_t a, uint32_t b, int t, int n)   /* a..b, t of n */
{
  int r = (int)((a >> 16) & 255), g = (int)((a >> 8) & 255), bl = (int)(a & 255);
  int r2 = (int)((b >> 16) & 255), g2 = (int)((b >> 8) & 255), b2 = (int)(b & 255);
  r += (r2 - r) * t / n; g += (g2 - g) * t / n; bl += (b2 - bl) * t / n;
  return 0xFF000000u | (uint32_t)r << 16 | (uint32_t)g << 8 | (uint32_t)bl;
}
static const uint8_t kBayer[4][4] = { { 0, 8, 2, 10 }, { 12, 4, 14, 6 }, { 3, 11, 1, 9 }, { 15, 7, 13, 5 } };

void ui_scene(uint32_t t)
{
  int W = g_ui_w, H = g_ui_h;
  int horizon = H * 62 / 100;
  /* the sky: bands of blue, lighter towards the hills, dithered into each
   * other as the console would */
  static const uint32_t sky[] = { 0x3A6ED8, 0x4478DC, 0x4E84E0, 0x5A90E6, 0x689EEA,
                                  0x78ACEE, 0x8ABAF2, 0x9CC8F4, 0xB0D6F6 };
  enum { NSKY = sizeof sky / sizeof sky[0] };
  for (int y = 0; y < horizon; y++) {
    int pos = y * (NSKY - 1) * 16 / horizon;
    int band = pos >> 4, frac = pos & 15;
    for (int x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      int b = band + (frac > kBayer[y & 3][x & 3]);
      if (b >= NSKY) b = NSKY - 1;
      g_ui_px[y * W + x] = UI_RGB(sky[b]);
    }
  }
  /* white clouds drifting slowly past, each a few round puffs */
  for (int c = 0; c < 4; c++) {
    uint32_t h = hash((uint32_t)c * 7919 + 11);
    int len = 40 + (int)(h % 30), cy = 14 + c * 17 + (int)((h >> 8) % 8);
    int cx = (int)((t / (6 + c * 2) + (h >> 12) % (uint32_t)W) % (uint32_t)(W + 2 * len)) - len;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      int px = cx + k * len / 4 + 6, py = cy - (k == 1 || k == 2 ? 4 : 0), r = (k == 1 || k == 2) ? 9 : 6;
      for (int y = py - r; y <= py + r + 2; y++)
        for (int x = px - r - 2; x <= px + r + 2; x++) {
          if ((unsigned)x >= (unsigned)W || (unsigned)y >= (unsigned)horizon) continue;
          int dx = x - px, dy = y - py;
          if (dx * dx + dy * dy * 2 > r * r * 2) continue;
          g_ui_px[y * W + x] = dy > r / 2 ? UI_RGB(0xD8E6F6) : UI_RGB(0xFFFFFF);
        }
    }
  }
  /* far hills, then near ones */
  for (int x = 0; x < W; x++) {
    int h1 = horizon - 14 - (int)(9 * sin(x * 0.021 + 1.3) + 5 * sin(x * 0.057));
    int h2 = horizon - 4 - (int)(6 * sin(x * 0.033 + 4.1) + 3 * sin(x * 0.11));
    for (int y = h1; y < H; y++) if (y >= 0) g_ui_px[y * W + x] = UI_RGB(0x6C9C8C);
    for (int y = h2; y < H; y++) if (y >= 0) g_ui_px[y * W + x] = UI_RGB(0x3E8A3A);
  }
  /* the field: furrows running towards the hills */
  for (int y = horizon; y < H; y++) {
    int depth = y - horizon;
    for (int x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      int u = (x - W / 2) * 16 / (depth + 8);
      bool furrow = ((u % 6) + 6) % 6 == 0;
      uint32_t c = depth < 6 ? 0x4A9A38 : furrow ? 0x4E9232 : 0x62B040;
      if (!furrow && ((x * 7 + y * 13) % 23) == 0) c = 0x86CC58;
      g_ui_px[y * W + x] = UI_RGB(c);
    }
  }
  /* a tree on the left, the barn and its silo */
  int base = horizon + 2;
  int tx = W * 8 / 100;
  ui_rect(tx + 6, base - 18, 3, 18, UI_RGB(0x6A4426));
  for (int j = -16; j <= 16; j++)
    for (int i = -14; i <= 14; i++)
      if (i * i * 2 + j * j * 3 < 260 + (int)(hash((uint32_t)(i * 31 + j)) % 60))
        ui_px(tx + 7 + i, base - 30 + j, UI_RGB(i + j < -6 ? 0x4CA444 : 0x2E7A2E));
  int bx = W * 18 / 100, bw = 46, bh = 26;
  ui_rect(bx, base - bh, bw, bh, UI_RGB(0xC83A2A));                 /* walls */
  for (int y = base - bh; y < base; y += 3) ui_hline(bx, y, bw, UI_RGB(0xA82E22));
  for (int j = 0; j < 14; j++) ui_rect(bx - 3 + j, base - bh - j, bw + 6 - 2 * j, 1, UI_RGB(0x7A2418));   /* roof */
  ui_rect(bx + 16, base - 16, 14, 16, UI_RGB(0xF4ECDC));             /* the door, white trim */
  ui_rect(bx + 17, base - 15, 12, 15, UI_RGB(0xA82E22));
  for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) { ui_px(bx + 17 + k, base - 15 + k * 15 / 12, UI_RGB(0xF4ECDC)); ui_px(bx + 28 - k, base - 15 + k * 15 / 12, UI_RGB(0xF4ECDC)); }
  ui_rect(bx + 20, base - bh - 8, 6, 5, UI_RGB(0x3A2A24));            /* the loft's window */
  ui_rect(bx + 22, base - bh - 8, 1, 5, UI_RGB(0x7A2418));
  int sx = bx + bw + 4;
  ui_rect(sx, base - 34, 14, 34, UI_RGB(0xC4CAD4));                  /* silo */
  for (int y = base - 34; y < base; y += 4) ui_hline(sx, y, 14, UI_RGB(0xA4ACB8));
  ui_vline(sx + 11, base - 34, 34, UI_RGB(0xA4ACB8));
  for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) ui_rect(sx + j / 2, base - 34 - 7 + j, 14 - j, 1, UI_RGB(0x7C8494));
  /* the fence in front */
  int fy = H - 22;
  for (int x = 0; x < W; x += 12) {
    ui_rect(x, fy, 3, 16, UI_RGB(0x8A5A30));
    ui_rect(x, fy, 3, 1, UI_RGB(0xC08A4A));
  }
  ui_rect(0, fy + 3, W, 2, UI_RGB(0xA06C3A));
  ui_rect(0, fy + 10, W, 2, UI_RGB(0xA06C3A));
  ui_hline(0, fy + 3, W, UI_RGB(0xC89A5A));
  ui_hline(0, fy + 10, W, UI_RGB(0xC89A5A));
  /* butterflies over the field */
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    uint32_t h = hash((uint32_t)i * 977 + 3);
    double a = t * 0.013 + (h & 255) * 0.1;
    int x = (int)(h % (uint32_t)W) + (int)(14 * sin(a + i));
    int y = horizon + 6 + (int)((h >> 9) % (uint32_t)(H - horizon - 26)) + (int)(5 * cos(a * 1.7));
    uint32_t col = (h >> 20) & 1 ? UI_RGB(0xFFFFFF) : UI_RGB(0xF8E058);
    bool open = ((t / 6 + (h >> 22)) & 1) != 0;              /* the wings flap */
    ui_px(x, y, UI_RGB(0x3A3020));
    if (open) { ui_px(x - 1, y - 1, col); ui_px(x + 1, y - 1, col); ui_px(x - 1, y, col); ui_px(x + 1, y, col); }
    else { ui_px(x, y - 1, col); ui_px(x, y - 2, col); }
  }
}
```
