`native/wife.c`:

```c
/*
 * wife.c — the wife helps on the farm (an improvement, off by default).
 *
 * The offer. With 950 hearts or more (the pause menu's ten), the second
 * time in a day the player talks to her, when her line is over, she asks
 * whether she may help on the farm: today (or tomorrow, if it is already
 * past her morning), three days or a week. The last day she helps is kept
 * in the diary (g_hm_wife_until, src/save.c).
 *
 * The help. On those days, from 6:00 until 11:00, she works on the farm:
 * she fills troughs in the barn and feed boxes in the coop, then waters dry
 * crops and tilled soil, the nearest first. At most half of each (the
 * work there was when her day began): the rest is the player's. When the
 * player is on the farm she is seen doing it: the game's own event slot $13
 * (the one the game gives her on the farm) walks from task to task, in her
 * own pictures, and talking to her gives her usual lines; she goes into the
 * barn and the coop by their doors. Elsewhere the work is done all the same,
 * a task every second and a half.
 *
 * At 11:00 she stops and does what the game has her do at midday: Maria,
 * Nina and Ellen go to their place on the farm and their chores there
 * (group $44's own picture, at (360, 360)); Ann and Eve go into the tool
 * shed.
 *
 * Her clothes (an improvement of its own, "Her old clothes some days", on
 * with or without her help). Some days (one in two, by the day) she wears
 * the clothes she wore before the wedding: her own girl's pictures instead
 * of the wife's, on the farm and at home.
 *
 * Everything here happens at the start of a GameLoop frame, where nothing of
 * the game is half done; tiles change through the game's own ChangeMapTile,
 * as the watering can's (src/toolused.c water_tile).
 */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "native.h"
#include "config.h"
#include "i18n.h"
#include "ui.h"
#include "gamefont.h"
#include "wife.h"

#define SLOT          0x0BA46u     /* the wife's event slot, $13: $7E:B586 + $40 x $13 (its fields: SLOT_*) */
#define HELP_UNTIL_HOUR 11
#define WATER_FRAMES  65           /* one watering: as long as the player's (action $0A with the can) */

enum { MARIA, ANN, NINA, ELLEN, EVE };
static const char *const kNames[5] = { "Maria", "Ann", "Nina", "Ellen", "Eve" };
/* her farm script's talking loop ($B5:xxxx), its picture table and entry (group $44) */
static const uint16_t kLoop[5] = { 0x9836, 0x9A34, 0x9C28, 0x9E10, 0xA017 };
static const uint16_t kFarmTable[5] = { 0x8AEC, 0x8AF8, 0x8B04, 0x8B04, 0x8AF8 };
static const uint8_t kFarmEntry[5] = { 0, 0, 0, 0, 3 };
/* pictures: down, down walking, up, up walking, side, side walking (the
 * side ones look left; flipped for right) */
static const uint16_t kWife[6] = { 0x2E2, 0x2E3, 0x2E4, 0x2E5, 0x2E6, 0x2E7 };
static const uint16_t kGirl[5][6] = {
  { 0x21E, 0x21F, 0x220, 0x221, 0x222, 0x223 },   /* Maria */
  { 0x226, 0x227, 0x228, 0x229, 0x22A, 0x22B },   /* Ann */
  { 0x24B, 0x24C, 0x24D, 0x24E, 0x24F, 0x250 },   /* Nina */
  { 0x23C, 0x23D, 0x23E, 0x23F, 0x240, 0x241 },   /* Ellen */
  { 0x244, 0x245, 0x246, 0x247, 0x248, 0x249 },   /* Eve */
};
/* the farm's doors (tiles) and where one stands to go in */
enum { BARN_X = 20, BARN_Y = 21, COOP_X = 28, COOP_Y = 21, SHED_X = 26, SHED_Y = 29, HOUSE_X = 8, HOUSE_Y = 20 };

enum { T_NONE, T_COWS, T_HENS, T_WATER, T_REST, T_ACTIVITY, T_DONE };
static struct {
  int day;                       /* the day the counts are for (absolute) */
  int talks;                     /* times she was talked to that day */
  bool declined, talking, want_dialog;   /* declined: told "no" today */
  /* the day's work */
  bool planned;
  int water_quota, water_done, cow_quota, cow_done, hen_quota, hen_done;
  int task;                      /* T_* */
  int px, py;                    /* her position (pixels), for the farm */
  int tx, ty;                    /* the tile she goes to */
  int path[96][2], plen, pi;     /* the tiles on the way */
  int wait;                      /* frames left for what she is doing */
  int inside;                    /* frames left in the barn / coop */
  int facing;                    /* 0 down, 1 up, 2 right, 3 left */
  unsigned frame;
  int offmap_tick;               /* away: the game minute (+1) last worked in */
  int away_left;                 /* away: things still to do this minute */
  bool spawned;                  /* we put her in slot $13 */
  bool controlled;               /* she worked here, as we moved her */
  bool moving;                   /* she took a step this frame */
  int fx, fy;                    /* where she is on the farm, while the player is indoors */
  int map;                       /* the map of the last frame */
  bool left_house;               /* she walked out of the house this morning */
  int phase;                     /* indoors: 0 to a trough, 1 filling it, 2 leaving */
  int target;                    /* indoors: the trough or box */
  /* the dialog */
  bool hop; int hop_len;          /* over a fence: the pixels of the jump */
  int sel, page;
  int shown, tick;               /* letters printed so far, frames to the next */
} W;

static int rd16(uint32_t a) { return g_ram[a] | g_ram[a + 1] << 8; }
static void wr16(uint32_t a, int v) { g_ram[a] = (uint8_t)v; g_ram[a + 1] = (uint8_t)(v >> 8); }
static int wife_of(void)
{
  int f = g_ram[HM_FLAGS_66] & 0x1F;
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) if (f & (1 << i)) return i;
  return -1;
}
static int hearts_of(int w) { return rd16(HM_HEARTS_BASE + 2u * (unsigned)w); }
static int today(void) { return g_ram[HM_YEAR] * 120 + (g_ram[HM_SEASON] & 3) * 30 + g_ram[HM_DAY]; }
static bool single_day(void) { unsigned d = (unsigned)today(); d = d * 2654435761u; return (d >> 16) & 1; }
static bool on_farm(void) { return g_ram[HM_MAP_ID] <= 3; }
static bool helping_today(void) { return g_hm_wife_until && today() <= g_hm_wife_until; }

/* ── The slot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static bool slot_is_wife(void)
{
  if (!g_ram[SLOT]) return false;
  int bank = g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK], at = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_SCRIPT);
  return bank == 0xB5 && at >= 0x8000 && at < 0xA200;
}
static void slot_picture(uint16_t sprite, bool flip)
{
  if (rd16(SLOT + SLOT_SPRITE) == sprite && ((g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_ANIMATION] & 0x40) != 0) == flip) return;
  wr16(SLOT + SLOT_SPRITE, sprite);
  wr16(SLOT + SLOT_ANIMATION, flip ? 0x40 : 0);
  g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_FLAGS] |= 0x04;                    /* the picture changed */
}
/* her clothes from before the wedding: only with that improvement on, and on its days */
static bool old_clothes(void) { return g_cfg.wife_clothes && single_day(); }
static const uint16_t *clothes(int w) { return old_clothes() ? kGirl[w] : kWife; }
/* her picture for a facing, standing or in mid-step */
static void pose(int w, int facing, bool step)
{
  const uint16_t *c = clothes(w);
  int k = facing == 0 ? 0 : facing == 1 ? 2 : 4;
  slot_picture(c[k + (step ? 1 : 0)], facing == 2);
}
/* the slot, as her farm script would have it, talking as there */
static void spawn(int w, int x, int y)
{
  memset(&g_ram[SLOT], 0, 0x40);
  g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_IN_USE] = 1;
  g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_FLAGS] = 0x03;                     /* a picture; make its game object */
  g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_FRAMES] = 1;
  wr16(SLOT + SLOT_SPRITE, clothes(w)[0]); wr16(SLOT + SLOT_LAST_SPRITE, clothes(w)[0]);
  wr16(SLOT + SLOT_X, x); wr16(SLOT + SLOT_Y, y);
  wr16(SLOT + SLOT_HOME_X, x); wr16(SLOT + SLOT_HOME_Y, y);
  wr16(SLOT + SLOT_SCRIPT, kLoop[w]); g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK] = 0xB5;
  wr16(SLOT + SLOT_ANIM_TABLE, kFarmTable[w]);
  g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_NUMBER] = 0x13;
  W.spawned = true;
}
static void place(int x, int y) { wr16(SLOT + SLOT_X, x); wr16(SLOT + SLOT_Y, y); }
/* gone through a door: out of sight (the next map's events free the slot) */
static void unspawn(void)
{
  if (g_ram[SLOT] && slot_is_wife()) place(0x0F00, 0x0F00);
  W.spawned = false;
}

/* ── The farm's tiles ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint8_t *tiles(void) { return &g_ram[on_farm() ? HM_MAP_TILES : HM_FARM_TILES]; }
/* the current map: tiles a row ($0181: 1 = 16, 2 = 32, else 64, GetTileIndex) */
static int map_w(void) { uint8_t c = g_ram[HM_MAP_WIDTH]; return c == 1 ? 16 : c == 2 ? 32 : 64; }
static uint8_t here(int x, int y) { return g_ram[HM_MAP_TILES + y * map_w() + x]; }
/* a seed or a plant not watered yet (bare tilled soil she leaves alone) */
static bool dry(uint8_t t) { return t == 0x1E || (t >= 0x20 && t <= 0x6E && !(t & 1)); }
static uint32_t props(void) { return (uint32_t)(g_ram[HM_TILE_PROPS] | g_ram[HM_TILE_PROPS + 1] << 8 | g_ram[HM_TILE_PROPS_BANK] << 16); }
static bool walkable(int x, int y)
{
  if (x < 1 || y < 1 || x >= map_w() - 1 || y >= 63) return false;
  uint8_t t = here(x, y);
  if (t >= 0xC0 && t <= 0xCF) return false;              /* never through the doors */
  return !(hm_bus_rd8(g_ram, props() + 4u * t + 2) & 0x1F);   /* as the player: seeds yes, grown plants no */
}
/* a fence she hops over (one tile: the farm's own, $A6, and the lumber
 * ones the player puts up, $05) */
static bool fence(int x, int y)
{
  if (x < 1 || y < 1 || x >= map_w() - 1 || y >= 63) return false;
  uint8_t t = here(x, y);
  return t == 0x05 || t == 0xA6;
}
static int count_dry(void)
{
  int n = 0;
  const uint8_t *t = &g_ram[HM_FARM_TILES];
  if (on_farm()) t = &g_ram[HM_MAP_TILES];
  for (int i = 0; i < 64 * 64; i++) if (dry(t[i])) n++;
  return n;
}

/* the way to a tile next to (tx, ty) (or onto it, when `onto`), the nearest
 * dry tile when tx < 0: breadth first over the walkable tiles */
static bool route(int fx, int fy, int tx, int ty, bool onto)
{
  static int16_t from[64 * 64];
  static int queue[64 * 64];
  memset(from, 0xFF, sizeof from);
  int qh = 0, qt = 0, start = fy * 64 + fx, goal = -1;
  from[start] = (int16_t)start; queue[qt++] = start;
  static const int d4[4][2] = { { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 }, { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 } };
  while (qh < qt && goal < 0) {
    int c = queue[qh++], cx = c % 64, cy = c / 64;
    if (tx < 0) {                                    /* the nearest dry tile, beside */
      for (int k = 0; k < 4 && goal < 0; k++) {
        int nx = cx + d4[k][0], ny = cy + d4[k][1];
        if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < 64 && ny < 64 && dry(here(nx, ny))) { goal = c; W.tx = nx; W.ty = ny; }
      }
    } else if ((onto && cx == tx && cy == ty) || (!onto && abs(cx - tx) + abs(cy - ty) == 1)) goal = c;
    if (goal >= 0) break;
    for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      int nx = cx + d4[k][0], ny = cy + d4[k][1], n = ny * 64 + nx;
      if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx >= 64 || ny >= 64 || from[n] != -1) continue;
      if (!walkable(nx, ny) && !(onto && nx == tx && ny == ty)) {
        int jx = nx + d4[k][0], jy = ny + d4[k][1], j = jy * 64 + jx;   /* over a fence */
        if (on_farm() && fence(nx, ny) && jx >= 0 && jy >= 0 && jx < 64 && jy < 64 && from[j] == -1 && walkable(jx, jy)) {
          from[j] = (int16_t)c; queue[qt++] = j;
        }
        continue;
      }
      from[n] = (int16_t)c; queue[qt++] = n;
    }
  }
  if (goal < 0) return false;
  int n = 0, rev[64 * 64 > 96 ? 96 : 96][2], c = goal;
  while (c != start && n < 96) { rev[n][0] = c % 64; rev[n][1] = c / 64; n++; c = from[c]; }
  if (c != start) return false;                      /* too far: not this time */
  W.plen = n; W.pi = 0; W.hop = false;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) { W.path[i][0] = rev[n - 1 - i][0]; W.path[i][1] = rev[n - 1 - i][1]; }
  if (tx >= 0) { W.tx = tx; W.ty = ty; }
  return true;
}

/* ── The work itself ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void water_now(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *regs, int x, int y)
{
  uint8_t t = tiles()[y * 64 + x];
  if (!dry(t)) return;
  uint8_t wet = (uint8_t)(t + 1);
  if (on_farm()) {
    HmRegs r = *regs;
    r.d = 0;
    r.a = wet; r.x = (uint16_t)(x * 16); r.y = (uint16_t)(y * 16);
    hm_EditTileOnMap(ram, &r);
    uint8_t change = hm_bus_rd8(ram, props() + 4u * wet);
    r = *regs; r.d = 0;
    r.a = change; r.x = (uint16_t)(x * 16); r.y = (uint16_t)(y * 16);
    hm_ChangeMapTile(ram, &r);
  } else {
    g_ram[HM_FARM_TILES + y * 64 + x] = wet;
  }
  W.water_done++;
}
/* the next empty trough of a cow of hers (an adult in the barn; a pregnant
 * one eats at trough 12), or -1 */
static int next_trough(void)
{
  if (W.cow_done >= W.cow_quota || rd16(HM_STORED_GRASS) <= 0) return -1;
  int bits = rd16(HM_COW_TROUGHS);
  for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    const uint8_t *c = &g_ram[HM_COW_DATA + 16 * i];
    if (!(c[0] & 0x08) || c[2] != 0x27) continue;
    int n = (c[0] & 0x40) ? 12 : i;
    if (!(bits & (1 << n))) return n;
  }
  return -1;
}
static int next_box(void)
{
  if (W.hen_done >= W.hen_quota || g_ram[HM_FEED_CHICKS_N] == 0) return -1;
  int bits = rd16(HM_CHICKEN_TROUGHS);
  for (int k = 0; k < 12; k++) if (!(bits & (1 << k))) return k;
  return -1;
}
static void fill_trough(int n)
{
  wr16(HM_STORED_GRASS, rd16(HM_STORED_GRASS) - 1);
  wr16(HM_COW_TROUGHS, rd16(HM_COW_TROUGHS) | 1 << n);
  g_ram[HM_COWS_FED]++;
  W.cow_done++;
}
static void fill_box(int k)
{
  g_ram[HM_FEED_CHICKS_N]--;
  wr16(HM_CHICKEN_TROUGHS, rd16(HM_CHICKEN_TROUGHS) | 1 << k);
  g_ram[HM_CHICKENS_FED]++;
  W.hen_done++;
}
/* where they are (tiles): the barn's troughs ($81:B0ED), the coop's boxes ($81:B19F) */
static void trough_at(int n, int *x, int *y)
{
  static const int rows[6] = { 17, 15, 13, 9, 7, 5 };
  if (n == 12) { *x = 12; *y = 22; } else { *x = n < 6 ? 8 : 5; *y = rows[n % 6]; }
}
static void box_at(int k, int *x, int *y) { *x = 2 + k; *y = 2; }
/* elsewhere: one trough or box, without being seen */
static bool feed_cows(void)
{
  int n = g_ram[HM_MAP_ID] == 0x27 ? -1 : next_trough();
  if (n < 0) return false;
  fill_trough(n);
  return true;
}
static bool feed_hens(void)
{
  int k = g_ram[HM_MAP_ID] == 0x28 ? -1 : next_box();
  if (k < 0) return false;
  fill_box(k);
  return true;
}

static void plan_day(void)
{
  int cows = 0, hens = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const uint8_t *c = &g_ram[HM_COW_DATA + 16 * i]; if ((c[0] & 0x08) && c[2] == 0x27) cows++; }
  for (int i = 0; i < 13; i++) { const uint8_t *h = &g_ram[HM_CHICKEN_DATA + 8 * i]; if ((h[0] & 0x08) && h[1] == 0x28) hens++; }
  int fed_c = 0, fed_h = g_ram[HM_CHICKENS_FED];
  for (int b = rd16(HM_COW_TROUGHS); b; b &= b - 1) fed_c++;
  W.cow_quota = (cows - 0) / 2; W.hen_quota = hens / 2;
  (void)fed_c; (void)fed_h;
  W.water_quota = count_dry() / 2;
  W.water_done = W.cow_done = W.hen_done = 0;
  W.task = W.cow_quota ? T_COWS : W.hen_quota ? T_HENS : T_WATER;
  W.px = W.fx = HOUSE_X * 16 + 8; W.py = W.fy = (HOUSE_Y + 1) * 16 + 8;
  W.plen = W.pi = 0; W.wait = 0; W.inside = 0; W.facing = 0;
  W.planned = true;
}

/* the next task once one is done */
static void next_task(void)
{
  W.plen = W.pi = 0; W.wait = 0;
  if (W.task == T_COWS) W.task = W.hen_quota > W.hen_done ? T_HENS : T_WATER;
  else if (W.task == T_HENS) W.task = T_WATER;
  else if (W.task == T_WATER && W.water_done >= W.water_quota) W.task = T_REST;
}

/* elsewhere than the farm: a task now and then */
static void work_away(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *regs)
{
  /* about as quick as on the farm: one thing each game minute (the clock
   * stops in the houses, and so does she) */
  int minute = g_ram[HM_HOUR] * 15 + g_ram[HM_MINUTES];
  if (W.offmap_tick == 0 || minute < W.offmap_tick - 1) W.offmap_tick = minute + 1;
  if (minute + 1 == W.offmap_tick) return;
  if (W.away_left <= 0) W.away_left = 1;
  if (--W.away_left == 0) W.offmap_tick = minute + 1;
  switch (W.task) {
  case T_COWS: if (!feed_cows()) next_task(); break;
  case T_HENS: if (!feed_hens()) next_task(); break;
  case T_WATER:
    if (W.water_done >= W.water_quota) { next_task(); break; }
    for (int i = 0; i < 64 * 64; i++)
      if (dry(g_ram[HM_FARM_TILES + i])) { water_now(ram, regs, i % 64, i / 64); return; }
    W.task = T_REST;
    break;
  default: break;
  }
}

/* one step along the way; true when there */
static bool walk(int w)
{
  if (W.pi >= W.plen) return true;
  int gx = W.path[W.pi][0] * 16 + 8, gy = W.path[W.pi][1] * 16 + 8;
  int dx = gx - W.px, dy = gy - W.py;
  int ptx = W.pi ? W.path[W.pi - 1][0] : W.px / 16, pty = W.pi ? W.path[W.pi - 1][1] : W.py / 16;
  if (!W.hop && abs(W.path[W.pi][0] - ptx) + abs(W.path[W.pi][1] - pty) == 2) {   /* the next tile is past a fence */
    W.hop = true; W.hop_len = abs(dx) + abs(dy);
    if (W.hop_len < 2) W.hop = false;
  }
  int step = W.hop ? 2 : 1;
  if (dx) { int m = abs(dx) < step ? abs(dx) : step; W.px += dx > 0 ? m : -m; W.facing = dx > 0 ? 2 : 3; }
  else if (dy) { int m = abs(dy) < step ? abs(dy) : step; W.py += dy > 0 ? m : -m; W.facing = dy > 0 ? 0 : 1; }
  W.moving = true;
  int lift = 0;
  if (W.hop) {                                       /* up and over: an arc 20 pixels high */
    int done = W.hop_len - (abs(gx - W.px) + abs(gy - W.py));
    lift = 80 * done * (W.hop_len - done) / (W.hop_len * W.hop_len);
  }
  if (W.px == gx && W.py == gy) { W.pi++; W.hop = false; lift = 0; }
  pose(w, W.facing, W.hop ? true : (W.frame / 10) & 1);
  place(W.px, W.py - lift);
  return W.pi >= W.plen;
}
static void face_tile(int w)
{
  int dx = W.tx * 16 + 8 - W.px, dy = W.ty * 16 + 8 - W.py;
  W.facing = abs(dx) > abs(dy) ? (dx > 0 ? 2 : 3) : (dy > 0 ? 0 : 1);
  pose(w, W.facing, false);
}

/* on the farm, seen */
static void work_here(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *regs, int w)
{
  int hx = W.px / 16, hy = W.py / 16;
  if (W.inside > 0) {                                /* in the barn or the coop */
    if (--W.inside == 0) {
      if (W.task == T_COWS) while (feed_cows()) {}
      else while (feed_hens()) {}
      W.px = W.tx * 16 + 8; W.py = (W.ty + 1) * 16 + 8; W.facing = 0;
      place(W.px, W.py); pose(w, 0, false);
      next_task();
    }
    return;
  }
  if (W.wait > 0) {                                  /* watering */
    if (--W.wait == 0) { water_now(ram, regs, W.tx, W.ty); next_task(); }
    return;
  }
  switch (W.task) {
  case T_COWS: case T_HENS: {
    int dx = W.task == T_COWS ? BARN_X : COOP_X, dy = W.task == T_COWS ? BARN_Y : COOP_Y;
    if (!W.plen && !route(hx, hy, dx, dy + 1, true)) { next_task(); return; }
    W.tx = dx; W.ty = dy;
    if (walk(w)) { W.inside = 150; place(0x0F00, 0x0F00); W.plen = 0; }
    return;
  }
  case T_WATER:
    if (W.water_done >= W.water_quota) { W.task = T_REST; return; }
    if (!W.plen) {
      if (!route(hx, hy, -1, -1, false)) { W.task = T_REST; return; }
    }
    if (walk(w)) {
      if (!dry(tiles()[W.ty * 64 + W.tx])) { W.plen = 0; return; }   /* the player was quicker */
      face_tile(w); W.wait = WATER_FRAMES;
    }
    return;
  case T_REST:                                       /* done: by the house's door */
    if (!W.plen && !(hx == HOUSE_X + 1 && hy == HOUSE_Y + 1)) {
      if (!route(hx, hy, HOUSE_X + 1, HOUSE_Y + 1, true)) { W.plen = 0; W.task = T_DONE; return; }
    }
    if (W.plen && walk(w)) { W.plen = 0; W.facing = 0; pose(w, 0, false); }
    return;
  default: return;
  }
}

/* a tile change on the map shown, through the game's own routine */
static void change_here(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *regs, uint8_t change, int x, int y)
{
  HmRegs r = *regs;
  r.d = 0;
  r.a = change; r.x = (uint16_t)(x * 16 + 8); r.y = (uint16_t)(y * 16 + 8);
  hm_ChangeMapTile(ram, &r);
}

/* In the barn or the coop while the player is there: she comes in by the
 * door, goes from trough to trough (box to box), fills each (the fodder
 * is drawn, change $99, as ReplaceTilesBarn does) and goes out again. */
static void work_inside(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *regs, int w, bool barn)
{
  int ex = 7, ey = barn ? 22 : 12;                   /* by the door, inside */
  if (!slot_is_wife()) {
    if (g_ram[SLOT]) { work_away(ram, regs); return; }   /* the slot is someone else's */
    W.px = ex * 16 + 8; W.py = ey * 16 + 8; W.facing = 1;
    W.plen = W.pi = 0; W.phase = 0; W.wait = 0;
    spawn(w, W.px, W.py);
    return;
  }
  if (g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_FLAGS] & 0x02) return;             /* its object comes next frame */
  W.moving = false;
  int hx = W.px / 16, hy = W.py / 16;
  switch (W.phase) {
  case 0: {
    int n = barn ? next_trough() : next_box(), tx, ty;
    if (n < 0) { W.phase = 2; W.plen = 0; break; }
    if (barn) trough_at(n, &tx, &ty); else box_at(n, &tx, &ty);
    if (!W.plen && !route(hx, hy, tx, ty, false)) {   /* no way: filled from where she is */
      if (barn) fill_trough(n); else fill_box(n);
      change_here(ram, regs, 0x99, tx, ty);
      break;
    }
    W.target = n; W.tx = tx; W.ty = ty;
    if (walk(w)) { face_tile(w); W.wait = 30; W.phase = 1; }
    break;
  }
  case 1:
    if (--W.wait > 0) break;
    if (barn) fill_trough(W.target); else fill_box(W.target);
    change_here(ram, regs, 0x99, W.tx, W.ty);
    W.phase = 0; W.plen = 0;
    break;
  default:                                           /* out by the door */
    if (!W.plen && !(hx == ex && hy == ey) && !route(hx, hy, ex, ey, true)) W.plen = 0;
    if (W.plen && !walk(w)) break;
    unspawn();
    W.fx = (barn ? BARN_X : COOP_X) * 16 + 8; W.fy = ((barn ? BARN_Y : COOP_Y) + 1) * 16 + 8;
    W.px = W.fx; W.py = W.fy;
    next_task();
    W.phase = 0;
    return;
  }
  if (!W.moving && W.phase != 2) pose(w, W.facing, false);
}

/* On a day she helps, in the morning she walks out of the house by its
 * door; later visits find her gone. */
static void leave_house(int w)
{
  if (W.left_house || !slot_is_wife() || (g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_FLAGS] & 0x02)) {
    if (slot_is_wife()) place(0x0F00, 0x0F00);
    W.left_house = W.left_house || slot_is_wife();
    return;
  }
  if (!W.plen) {
    int dx = -1, dy = -1;
    for (int y = 1; y < 63 && dx < 0; y++)          /* the door: the first door tile from the top */
      for (int x = 0; x < map_w(); x++)
        if (here(x, y) >= 0xC0 && here(x, y) <= 0xCF && rd16(SLOT + SLOT_Y) / 16 < y) { dx = x; dy = y - 1; break; }
    W.px = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_X); W.py = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_Y);
    if (dx < 0 || !route(W.px / 16, W.py / 16, dx, dy, true)) { W.left_house = true; place(0x0F00, 0x0F00); return; }
  }
  W.moving = false;
  if (walk(w)) { W.left_house = true; place(0x0F00, 0x0F00); W.plen = 0; }
}

/* at 11:00: what the game has her do at midday */
static void activity(int w)
{
  int hx = W.px / 16, hy = W.py / 16;
  bool shed = w == ANN || w == EVE;
  int gx = shed ? SHED_X : 22, gy = shed ? SHED_Y + 1 : 22;
  if (!W.plen && !(hx == gx && hy == gy) && !route(hx, hy, gx, gy, true)) W.plen = 0;
  if (W.plen && !walk(w)) return;
  if (shed) { unspawn(); W.task = T_DONE; return; }
  /* her chores, as her farm script puts her */
  W.px = 0x168; W.py = 0x168; place(W.px, W.py);
  uint32_t tab = 0xB30000u | kFarmTable[w];
  uint16_t sprite = hm_bus_rd16(g_ram, tab + 3u * kFarmEntry[w]);
  uint8_t flip = hm_bus_rd8(g_ram, tab + 3u * kFarmEntry[w] + 2);
  g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY] = kFarmEntry[w];
  slot_picture(sprite, flip & 1);
  W.task = T_DONE;
}

/* The player's buttons, before the game reads them: once her line was
 * heard today, the next A facing her is her offer (her line is not said
 * again). */
uint16_t wife_pad(uint16_t pad)
{
  static uint16_t prev;
  static bool hold;                                  /* the A that asked: kept from the game until let go */
  bool pressed = (pad & B_A) && !(prev & B_A);
  prev = pad;
  if (hold) { if (pad & B_A) return (uint16_t)(pad & ~B_A); hold = false; }
  if (!pressed || !g_cfg.wife_help || !hm_diary_loaded(g_ram) || W.declined) return pad;
  int w = wife_of();
  if (w < 0 || W.talks < 1 || today() != W.day || hearts_of(w) < 950 || g_ram[HM_HOUR] >= 18 || helping_today()) return pad;
  if ((rd16(HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x4000) || !slot_is_wife() || g_ram[HM_MAP_ID] >= HM_MAP_FIRST_PICTURE) return pad;
  if (rd16(0xD2) & 0x0010) return pad;                    /* carrying something: as the game, no talk */
  static const int ahead[4][2] = { { 0, 16 }, { 0, -16 }, { 16, 0 }, { -16, 0 } };
  int f = rd16(0xDA) & 3;
  int fx = rd16(HM_PLAYER_X) + ahead[f][0], fy = rd16(HM_PLAYER_Y) + ahead[f][1];
  int dx = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_X) - fx, dy = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_Y) - fy;
  if (abs(dx) > 12 || abs(dy) > 12) return pad;          /* not in front of her */
  W.want_dialog = true;
  hold = true;
  return (uint16_t)(pad & ~B_A);
}

/* ── Every frame ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void wife_reset(void) { memset(&W, 0, sizeof W); }

/* At the end of every frame, also while a map comes in: once she went out
 * to work, the house the game draws her in stays without her, from its
 * first frame (her slot and its game object out of sight). */
void wife_frame(uint8_t *ram)
{
  if (!g_cfg.wife_help || !hm_diary_loaded(ram) || !W.left_house || today() != W.day) return;
  int map = ram[HM_MAP_ID], hour = ram[HM_HOUR];
  if (map < 0x15 || map > 0x17 || !helping_today() || hour < 6 || hour >= HELP_UNTIL_HOUR) return;
  if (!slot_is_wife()) return;
  place(0x0F00, 0x0F00);
  int obj = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_OBJECT);
  if (!(g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_FLAGS] & 0x02) && obj < 40) {
    uint32_t o = 0x019Cu + 0x24u * (unsigned)obj;
    if (rd16(o) == 0x7777) { wr16(o + 0x08, 0x0F00); wr16(o + 0x0A, 0x0F00); }
  }
}

void wife_clean_point(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *regs)
{
  g_hm_wife_on = g_cfg.wife_help;
  if ((!g_cfg.wife_help && !g_cfg.wife_clothes) || !hm_diary_loaded(ram)) return;
  int w = wife_of();
  if (w < 0) return;
  W.frame++;
  int day = today(), hour = ram[HM_HOUR];
  if (day != W.day) { int keep_until = 0; (void)keep_until; memset(&W, 0, sizeof W); W.day = day; }

  /* the offer: the second talk of the day, once her line is over */
  bool box = rd16(HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x4000;
  if (box && !W.talking && slot_is_wife()) {
    int dx = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_X) - rd16(HM_PLAYER_X), dy = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_Y) - rd16(HM_PLAYER_Y);
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 40 * 40) { W.talking = true; W.talks++; }
  }
  if (!box && W.talking) W.talking = false;
  /* her clothes, wherever the game has her */
  if (slot_is_wife() && old_clothes()) {
    int s = rd16(SLOT + SLOT_SPRITE);
    for (int k = 0; k < 6; k++) if (s == kWife[k]) slot_picture(kGirl[w][k], g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_ANIMATION] & 0x40);
  }

  /* the help (it waits while someone talks) */
  if (!g_cfg.wife_help || !helping_today() || hour < 6 || box) return;
  if (!W.planned) plan_day();
  int map = ram[HM_MAP_ID];
  bool house = map >= 0x15 && map <= 0x17;
  if (map != W.map) {                                  /* a new map: start anew there */
    if (map <= 3) { W.px = W.fx; W.py = W.fy; }
    W.plen = W.pi = 0; W.phase = 0; W.inside = 0;
    W.map = map;
  }
  if (hour < HELP_UNTIL_HOUR) {
    if (house) { W.left_house = W.left_house || W.controlled; leave_house(w); W.left_house = W.left_house; }
    if (house && !W.left_house) return;
    if ((map == 0x27 && W.task == T_COWS) || (map == 0x28 && W.task == T_HENS)) { work_inside(ram, regs, w, map == 0x27); return; }
    if (!on_farm()) { W.spawned = W.controlled = false; work_away(ram, regs); return; }
    W.left_house = true;
    if (!slot_is_wife()) { spawn(w, W.px, W.py); return; }  /* the next frame, with its object */
    if (!(g_ram[SLOT + SLOT_FLAGS] & 0x02) && W.task != T_DONE) {
      W.controlled = true; W.moving = false;
      work_here(ram, regs, w);
      if (!W.inside && !W.moving) pose(w, W.facing, false);   /* after a talk, as she was */
      W.fx = W.px; W.fy = W.py;
    }
    return;
  }
  if (on_farm() && W.task != T_DONE) {
    if (!slot_is_wife() || !W.controlled) { W.task = T_DONE; return; }   /* the game's own midday */
    if (W.task != T_ACTIVITY) { W.task = T_ACTIVITY; W.plen = 0; }
    activity(w);
  }
}

/* ── The offer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
bool wife_dialog_wanted(void) { bool b = W.want_dialog; W.want_dialog = false; return b; }
void wife_dialog_open(void) { W.sel = 0; W.page = 0; W.shown = 0; W.tick = 0; }

static const int kDays[3] = { 1, 3, 7 };
static int s_ox;                       /* where the 256 columns start (widescreen) */
static void accept(int days)
{
  int start = g_ram[HM_HOUR] < HELP_UNTIL_HOUR ? today() : today() + 1;
  g_hm_wife_until = (uint16_t)(start + days - 1);
  W.planned = false;
}
/* The game's own text box (as on screen when she talks): 240 x 64 at
 * (8, 151), a lilac and white rounded frame, see-through checks inside
 * (every other pixel dark), white letters in the game's font, three lines
 * 16 apart from (16, 159). Her words are in English, as the game's. */
#define BOX_LILAC UI_RGB(0x8484B5)
#define BOX_WHITE UI_RGB(0xFFFFFF)
#define BOX_DARK  UI_RGB(0x424252)
static void game_box(int ox)
{
  static const char *corner[10] = {
    "......LLLL", "....LLLWWW", "...LLWWWWW", "..LLWWWWLL", ".LLWWWLL..",
    ".LWWWL....", "LLWWL.....", "LWWWL.....", "LWWL......", "LWWL......" };
  static const char edge[4] = { 'L', 'W', 'W', 'L' };
  int x0 = ox + 8, y0 = 151, w = 240, h = 64;
  for (int y = y0 + 4; y < y0 + h - 4; y++)          /* the checks */
    for (int x = x0 + 4; x < x0 + w - 4; x++)
      if ((x + y) & 1) ui_px(x, y, BOX_DARK);
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {                      /* the sides */
    uint32_t c = edge[i] == 'L' ? BOX_LILAC : BOX_WHITE;
    ui_hline(x0 + 10, y0 + i, w - 20, c); ui_hline(x0 + 10, y0 + h - 1 - i, w - 20, c);
    ui_vline(x0 + i, y0 + 10, h - 20, c); ui_vline(x0 + w - 1 - i, y0 + 10, h - 20, c);
  }
  for (int j = 0; j < 10; j++)                       /* the corners, mirrored */
    for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      char k = corner[j][i];
      if (k == '.') {
        if (j >= 4 && i >= 4 && j + i >= 9) {           /* inside: checks */
          if ((x0 + i + y0 + j) & 1) ui_px(x0 + i, y0 + j, BOX_DARK);
          if ((x0 + w - 1 - i + y0 + j) & 1) ui_px(x0 + w - 1 - i, y0 + j, BOX_DARK);
          if ((x0 + i + y0 + h - 1 - j) & 1) ui_px(x0 + i, y0 + h - 1 - j, BOX_DARK);
          if ((x0 + w - 1 - i + y0 + h - 1 - j) & 1) ui_px(x0 + w - 1 - i, y0 + h - 1 - j, BOX_DARK);
        }
        continue;
      }
      uint32_t c = k == 'L' ? BOX_LILAC : BOX_WHITE;
      ui_px(x0 + i, y0 + j, c); ui_px(x0 + w - 1 - i, y0 + j, c);
      ui_px(x0 + i, y0 + h - 1 - j, c); ui_px(x0 + w - 1 - i, y0 + h - 1 - j, c);
    }
}
/* the letters come one by one, as the game prints them (one each 4 frames,
 * each frame while A is held, $84:CF38): `*left` is how many may still be
 * drawn */
static void box_text(int x, int y, const char *t, int *left)
{
  char part[64];
  size_t n = 0;
  const char *p = t;
  while (*p && *left > 0 && n < sizeof part - 4) {
    const char *q = p;
    ui_utf8_next(&q);
    while (p < q) part[n++] = *p++;
    (*left)--;
  }
  part[n] = 0;
  gamefont_text_box(x, y, part, BOX_WHITE, BOX_DARK);
}
static void box_line(int ox, int line, const char *t, int *left) { box_text(ox + 16, 159 + 16 * line, t, left); }
static const char *const kAnswer[3] = { "Leave the farm to me,", "darling! I'll do half the", "work every morning." };
static const char *const kAsk[2] = { "Darling, may I help you", "on the farm?" };
/* the choices, on the third line: a white arrow before the one chosen */
static const char *const kOpts[4] = { "1 day", "3 days", "1 week", "No" };
static int opt_x(int i) { static const int at[4] = { 1, 8, 16, 24 }; return 16 + 8 * at[i]; }

static int letters(const char *s) { int n = 0; while (*s) { ui_utf8_next(&s); n++; } return n; }
static int page_letters(void)
{
  int n = 0;
  if (W.page == 1) for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) n += letters(kAnswer[i]);
  else {
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) n += letters(kAsk[i]);
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) n += letters(kOpts[i]);
  }
  return n;
}
bool wife_dialog_update(const UiInput *in)
{
  if (W.shown < page_letters()) {                    /* still printing */
    bool quick = g_cfg.fast_text || (in->held & B_A) || (in->held & B_B);
    if (quick || ++W.tick >= 4) { W.tick = 0; W.shown++; }
    return false;
  }
  if (W.page == 1) return in->accept || in->back || in->click || in->rclick;
  int n = 4;
  if (in->pressed & (B_UP | B_LEFT)) W.sel = (W.sel + n - 1) % n;
  if (in->pressed & (B_DOWN | B_RIGHT)) W.sel = (W.sel + 1) % n;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    int x = s_ox + opt_x(i) - 8, wdt = 8 * ((int)strlen(kOpts[i]) + 1);
    if (in->mouse_x >= x && in->mouse_x < x + wdt && in->mouse_y >= 191 && in->mouse_y < 207) {
      if (in->mouse_moved) W.sel = i;
      if (in->click) { W.sel = i; goto chosen; }
    }
  }
  if (in->back || in->rclick) { W.sel = 3; goto chosen; }
  if (!in->accept) return false;
chosen:
  if (W.sel < 3) accept(kDays[W.sel]);
  else W.declined = true;                            /* "No": not again today */
  W.page = W.sel < 3 ? 1 : 2;
  W.shown = 0; W.tick = 0;
  return W.page == 2;
}
void wife_dialog_draw(uint32_t *dst, int w)
{
  ui_target(dst, w, 224);
  int ox = (w - 256) / 2;
  s_ox = ox;
  game_box(ox);
  int left = W.shown;
  if (W.page == 1) {
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) box_line(ox, i, kAnswer[i], &left);
    return;
  }
  for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) box_line(ox, i, kAsk[i], &left);
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    box_text(ox + opt_x(i), 191, kOpts[i], &left);
    if (i == W.sel && W.shown >= page_letters()) {     /* the arrow, once all is printed */
      int ax = ox + opt_x(i) - 7, ay = 191 + 6;
      for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) ui_vline(ax + k, ay + k, 7 - 2 * k, BOX_WHITE);
    }
  }
}
```

```h
/* wife.h — the wife helps on the farm (an improvement, off by default).
 * wife.c. */
#pragma once
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "host.h"

/* at the start of every GameLoop frame (nothing of the game half done):
 * `regs` are the game's own, copied before any routine is called */
void wife_clean_point(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *regs);
bool wife_dialog_wanted(void);             /* she has just offered to help */
void wife_dialog_open(void);
bool wife_dialog_update(const UiInput *in); /* true: closed */
void wife_dialog_draw(uint32_t *dst, int w);
void wife_reset(void);                      /* a new game, a reset, another ROM */
void wife_frame(uint8_t *ram);              /* the end of every frame */
uint16_t wife_pad(uint16_t pad);            /* the buttons the game is given */
```

```txt
# --- nights.txt: force NightReset on chosen dates (live weather checks) ---
# poke 11F19 = season, 11F1B = day (today; WeatherTomorrow decides tomorrow)
```

`src/actions.c`:

```c
/*
 * actions.c — the player's actions $0F-$57 (PlayerActionPointerTable,
 * $81:D593; the first ones are in interact.c).
 *
 * Pressing A on a door-like tile with byte +1 bit 0 of its property sets
 * $096E to the tile's byte +0 and $D2 bit 6 (see interact.c); each frame
 * PlayerInteractionSelector then runs action $096E (JSR; A = $096E x 2,
 * 16 bits) until the action clears $D2 bit 6. $096F counts the action's
 * steps and $0970 its frames (both start at 0). In HM-Decomp they all sit
 * in the block of PlayerAction_0F_Tv (the TV), partly read as data; they are
 * named here PlayerAction_<number>.
 *
 * As everywhere, the bodies keep A, X, Y and C as the original leaves them.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ────────────────────────────── */
/* Direct page ($00-$FF; the hm_dp_* helpers take these offsets) */
#define BUG_PTR       0x01       /* 16b: the pointer PlayerAction_46's bug writes through */
/* $72-$74 and $7E-$80 mean different things in different routines: */
#define MONEY_ARG     0x72       /* AddMoney's amount, 24b with MONEY_ARG_HIGH */
#define MONEY_ARG_HIGH 0x74
#define ROOM_NEEDED   0x7E       /* room_for: 16 x the chickens, then the room needed */
#define ROOM_COWS     0x80       /* room_for: 16 x the cows */
#define NEST_COLUMN   0x7E       /* PlayerAction_53: the column of the tile in front */
#define TV_CHANNEL8   0x92       /* 8b, tv(): 8 x HM_TV_FORECAST */

/* WRAM $7F:1Fxx, the game's saved state: bus addresses (WRAM_LONG of the
 * ram[] offsets 0x11Fxx that hm_ram.h uses) */
#define HEARTS_MARIA  (WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 0)
#define HEARTS_ANN    (WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 2)
#define HEARTS_NINA   (WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 4)
#define HEARTS_ELLEN  (WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 6)
#define HEARTS_EVE    (WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 8)

/* ROM tables */
#define TV_TEXTS      0x81D510   /* DATA8_81D510: 8 bytes per channel, a word per season */
#define PIECE_BITS    0x81FAB4   /* DATA8_81FAB4: a word per fence piece, its bit */
#define NEST_BITS     0x81FAD4   /* DATA16_81FAD4: a word per nest, its egg bit */

typedef void Step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);

static uint32_t db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, a)); }
static uint16_t rd16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, db(r, a)); }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }

static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, Step *fn)
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, Step *fn)
{
  uint16_t ret = (uint16_t)(at + 2);
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(ret >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r);
}

/* LDA $096F (8 bits) */
static uint8_t step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t s = rd8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP);
  set_a8(r, s);
  return s;
}
/* "CMP #k" on the step in A: C, and whether it is k */
static bool is(HmRegs *r, uint8_t k)
{
  r->c = (uint8_t)r->a >= k;
  return (uint8_t)r->a == k;
}
static void next_step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)               /* INC $096F */
{
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP, (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP) + 1));
}
/* INC $0970; LDA $0970; CMP #n: has the counter reached n? */
static bool count_to(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t n)
{
  uint8_t f = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES) + 1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, f);
  set_a8(r, f);
  r->c = f >= n;
  return f == n;
}
/* $D2 &= ~bits / |= bits (16 bits; A = the new $D2) */
static void state_off(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bits)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & ~bits);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
static void state_on(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bits)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | bits);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
/* the action is over: $D2 bit 6 off */
static void done(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { state_off(ram, r, 0x0040); }
/* LDA #$02; STA $019A; [LDX #text]; LDA #$00; STA $0191; JSL StartTextBox */
static void text_x(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  set_a8(r, 2);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 2);
  set_a8(r, 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES, 0);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_StartTextBox);
}
static void say(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t text, uint16_t at)
{
  r->x = text;
  text_x(ram, r, at);
}
/* LDA $019A; CMP #$02: is the text box still waiting? */
static bool text_open(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t v = rd8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE);
  set_a8(r, v);
  r->c = v >= 2;
  return v == 2;
}
/* LDA $018F (8 bits): 0 = yes */
static bool said_no(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t v = rd8(ram, r, HM_ANSWER);
  set_a8(r, v);
  return v != 0;
}
static void map_animation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = a;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x81, hm_StartMapAnimation);
}
/* the player walks by himself: $D2 bit 7, action a, facing f ($0911 too) */
static void walk(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t action, uint16_t facing)
{
  state_on(ram, r, 0x0080);
  r->a = action;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, action);
  r->a = facing;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, facing);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, facing);
}
/* the player's own animation: action a with sprite s ($0901), UpdatePlayerObject */
static void pose(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t action, uint16_t sprite, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = action;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, action);
  r->a = sprite;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, sprite);
  jsr(ram, r, at, hm_UpdatePlayerObject);
}
/* CalculateTileInFront (A, X, Y given; JSL at a) */
static void tile_ahead(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = a; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x81, hm_CalculateTileInFront);
}
/* LDA $0973; ORA #bits; STA $0973 (8 bits) */
static void time_flag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t bits)
{
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING) | bits);
  set_a8(r, v);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING, v);
}
/* the player holds item i and the "carrying" action (4) */
static void hold(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t item)
{
  set_a8(r, item);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, item);
  r->a = 4;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 4);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The TVs: $0F PlayerAction_0F_Tv (the first house), $12 and $13 (the bigger
 * houses; their map animations start at $27 and $34 instead of 0).
 * Step 0: $D2 bit 8 (watching), the screen turns on (animation base,
 * unless $0196 bit 4); step 1: once the animation is over ($CF = 0), the
 * weather report (TvWeatherForecast), the channel's text for the season
 * (DATA8_81D510: 8 bytes per channel $0990, a word per season; $FFFF none)
 * and its picture (base + channel + 1); step 2: once the text is closed,
 * the screen turns off (animation $46, $47, $48) and $D2 bits 6 and 8 go.
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

typedef struct Tv { uint16_t base, off, at_on, at_weather, at_text, at_picture, at_off; } Tv;

static void tv(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Tv *t)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM);
    if (r->a) return;
    jsl(ram, r, t->at_weather, 0x82, hm_TvWeatherForecast);
    uint8_t ch = rd8(ram, r, HM_TV_FORECAST);
    r->a = ch;                                             /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
    uint8_t v = ch;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { r->c = v >> 7; v = (uint8_t)(v << 1); }
    *hm_dp(ram, r, TV_CHANNEL8) = v;
    uint8_t season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
    r->c = season >> 7;
    uint16_t sum = (uint16_t)((uint8_t)(season << 1) + v);  /* ASL; CLC; ADC $92 */
    r->c = sum > 0xFF;
    r->a = (uint8_t)sum;
    r->x = r->a;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, TV_TEXTS + r->x);
    r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF;
    if (r->a != 0xFFFF) {
      r->x = r->a;
      text_x(ram, r, t->at_text);
    }
    r->a = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TV_FORECAST) + 1);     /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA; INC */
    if (t->base) {                                         /* CLC; ADC #base */
      uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)r->a + t->base;
      r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
      r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
    }
    map_animation(ram, r, r->a, t->at_picture);
    next_step(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    map_animation(ram, r, t->off, t->at_off);
    done(ram, r);
    state_off(ram, r, 0x0100);
    return;
  }
  state_on(ram, r, 0x0100);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0010);
  if (!r->a) map_animation(ram, r, t->base, t->at_on);
  next_step(ram, r);
}

void hm_PlayerAction_0F_Tv(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Tv t = { 0x0000, 0x0046, 0xD73B, 0xD74E, 0xD780, 0xD78F, 0xD7A8 };
  tv(ram, r, &t);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_12(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Tv t = { 0x0027, 0x0047, 0xD9F1, 0xDA07, 0xDA39, 0xDA4C, 0xDA65 };
  tv(ram, r, &t);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_13(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Tv t = { 0x0034, 0x0048, 0xDAA7, 0xDABD, 0xDAEF, 0xDB02, 0xDB1B };
  tv(ram, r, &t);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $10 ($81:D7C5): the bed. Nothing with $7F1F6E bit 4, nor while $0878 !=
 * $087A. Step 0: "go to bed?" (text $0A); step 1: yes, skip to step 3
 * with $0973 bit 2 (sleep); no, text $0C and step 2; step 2: once closed,
 * yes goes on to step 3, no ends. Step 3: the player walks to the bed
 * (action 1, facing 3) for $16 frames, or $1E frames (and $7F1F5E bit 11)
 * when one of $7F1F66 bits 0-4 is set; then he lies down (action $19,
 * sprite $4E) and the day ends ($0973 bit 1; with the long walk, step 4
 * waits for $7F1F5E bit 12 first).
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_10(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E)) & 0x0010);
  if (r->a) { done(ram, r); return; }
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (!said_no(ram, r)) {
      next_step(ram, r);
      next_step(ram, r);
      time_flag(ram, r, 0x04);
      return;
    }
    say(ram, r, 0x000C, 0xD84D);
    next_step(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (!said_no(ram, r)) { next_step(ram, r); return; }
    done(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) {
    bool long_walk = false;
    for (uint16_t bit = 1; bit <= 0x10 && !long_walk; bit = (uint16_t)(bit << 1)) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & bit);
      long_walk = r->a != 0;
    }
    if (!long_walk) {
      walk(ram, r, 1, 3);
      if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x16)) return;
      pose(ram, r, 0x0019, 0x004E, 0xD8ED);
      time_flag(ram, r, 0x02);
      return;
    }
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) | 0x0800);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), r->a);
    walk(ram, r, 1, 3);
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x1E)) return;
    next_step(ram, r);
    pose(ram, r, 0x0019, 0x004E, 0xD94E);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 4)) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) & 0x1000);
    if (r->a) time_flag(ram, r, 0x02);
    return;
  }
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_1);
  r->c = r->a >= rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2);
  if (r->a != rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2)) { done(ram, r); return; }
  say(ram, r, 0x000A, 0xD80E);
  next_step(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $11 ($81:D979): the player walks (action $0E, facing 1) for $20 frames;
 * then $0878 = $087A = $C2 and the action ends.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_11(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    r->a = 0x00C2;
    wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_1, 0x00C2);
    wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2, 0x00C2);
    done(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  walk(ram, r, 0x000E, 0x0001);
  if (count_to(ram, r, 0x20)) next_step(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $14 ($81:DB38): the diary (the save menu): $018A = 0, then the text box
 * in mode 3 ($019A = 3, $019B bit 5, $0142 = 0, $018B = 0); when the menu
 * closes with 2 the step goes on, otherwise the action ends; step 3 goes
 * back to step 1 once the text is closed.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void diary_open(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wr16(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y, 0);
  set_a8(r, 3);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 3);
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE) | 0x20);
  set_a8(r, v);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE, v);
  next_step(ram, r);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK, 0);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_14(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) { diary_open(ram, r); return; }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    uint8_t v = rd8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE);
    set_a8(r, v);
    r->c = v >= 3;
    if (v == 3) return;
    r->c = v >= 2;
    if (v == 2) { next_step(ram, r); return; }
    done(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    set_a8(r, 1);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP, 1);
    return;
  }
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_PLACE, 0);
  next_step(ram, r);
  diary_open(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $15 ($81:DBA1): fodder from the silo: one grass less (AddGrass -1); if
 * there was some, the player holds fodder ($1A).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_15(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = 0xFFFF;
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDBA6, 0x83, hm_AddGrass);
  r->c = r->a >= 1;
  if (r->a != 1) hold(ram, r, 0x1A);
  done(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $1E ($81:DBF0): the calendar: "look at it?" (text $0371); yes: the
 * season's page (text $0372 + season).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_1E(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (!is(r, 1)) {
    say(ram, r, 0x0371, 0xDC0A);
    next_step(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
  if (!said_no(ram, r)) {
    uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)) + 0x0372;
    r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
    r->x = (uint16_t)sum;
    text_x(ram, r, 0xDC46);
  }
  done(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The girls' diaries ($26, $2D, $33, $36, $3F): "read it?" (text $23);
 * yes: the page for her hearts (text $03A6 + AffectionToHearts of her affection,
 * $7F1F1F-$7F1F27) and one happiness less (AddPlayerHappiness -1).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void girls_diary(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint32_t affection)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (!is(r, 1)) {
    say(ram, r, 0x0023, (uint16_t)(at + 0x1A));
    next_step(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
  if (!said_no(ram, r)) {
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, affection);
    jsr(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x40), hm_AffectionToHearts);
    uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)r->a + 0x03A6;
    r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
    r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
    r->x = r->a;
    text_x(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x56));
    r->a = 0xFFFF;
    jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x5F), 0x83, hm_AddPlayerHappiness);
  }
  done(ram, r);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_26(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { girls_diary(ram, r, 0xDC5E, HEARTS_MARIA); }
void hm_PlayerAction_2D(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { girls_diary(ram, r, 0xDDAC, HEARTS_NINA); }
void hm_PlayerAction_33(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { girls_diary(ram, r, 0xE2D9, HEARTS_ELLEN); }
void hm_PlayerAction_36(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { girls_diary(ram, r, 0xE394, HEARTS_ANN); }
void hm_PlayerAction_3F(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { girls_diary(ram, r, 0xE52C, HEARTS_EVE); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Taking something from a shelf ($27-$2C, $2F-$32, $34, $37-$3E): the
 * item of tile type k for spring (DATA8_82CFB4[k x 4]) in hand.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void take(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t k)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(k << 2);
  r->c = 0;
  r->x = r->a;
  hold(ram, r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, PICK_UP_ITEMS + r->x));
  done(ram, r);
}
#define TAKE(n, k) void hm_PlayerAction_##n(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { take(ram, r, k); }
TAKE(27, 0x70) TAKE(28, 0x71) TAKE(29, 0x72) TAKE(2A, 0x73) TAKE(2B, 0x74) TAKE(2C, 0x75)
TAKE(2F, 0x7E) TAKE(30, 0x7F) TAKE(31, 0x80) TAKE(32, 0x81) TAKE(34, 0x82)
TAKE(37, 0x77) TAKE(38, 0x76) TAKE(39, 0x78) TAKE(3A, 0x7D) TAKE(3B, 0x79) TAKE(3C, 0x7A)
TAKE(3D, 0x7B) TAKE(3E, 0x7C)

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The fence pieces' places ($1D, $4A-$50): the place's tile becomes $FB
 * (ChangeMapTile at $09AD / $09AF, the place's spot); if the place holds
 * a piece ($09A4 + its number) not yet put up ($7F1F78 has a bit per
 * piece, DATA8_81FAB4), the player takes it (item $1D + piece);
 * otherwise the tile is redrawn as $A1 (EditTileOnMap).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void fence_place(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t n, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = 0x00FB;
  r->x = x; wr16(ram, r, HM_EDIT_X, x);
  r->y = y; wr16(ram, r, HM_EDIT_Y, y);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTile);
  r->a = n;
  r->x = n;
  uint8_t piece = rd8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(HM_FENCE_PIECES + r->x));
  set_a8(r, piece);
  if (piece) {
    r->y = r->x;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(piece - 1);                          /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA; DEC */
    r->c = (r->a >> 15) & 1;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a << 1);
    r->x = r->a;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, PIECE_BITS + r->x) & hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_78)));
    if (!r->a) {
      r->x = r->y;
      uint16_t sum = (uint16_t)(rd8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(HM_FENCE_PIECES + r->x)) + 0x1D);
      r->c = sum > 0xFF;
      hold(ram, r, (uint8_t)sum);
      done(ram, r);
      return;
    }
  }
  r->a = 0x00A1;
  r->x = rd16(ram, r, HM_EDIT_X);
  r->y = rd16(ram, r, HM_EDIT_Y);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xF59F, 0x82, hm_EditTileOnMap);
  done(ram, r);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_1D(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fence_place(ram, r, 0x02E0, 0x01A0, 0, 0xDBE4); }
void hm_PlayerAction_4A(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fence_place(ram, r, 0x0010, 0x0030, 1, 0xF4A1); }
void hm_PlayerAction_4B(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fence_place(ram, r, 0x00B0, 0x0090, 2, 0xF4BE); }
void hm_PlayerAction_4C(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fence_place(ram, r, 0x01C0, 0x0050, 3, 0xF4DB); }
void hm_PlayerAction_4D(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fence_place(ram, r, 0x02A0, 0x0030, 4, 0xF4F7); }
void hm_PlayerAction_4E(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fence_place(ram, r, 0x0050, 0x02C0, 5, 0xF513); }
void hm_PlayerAction_4F(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fence_place(ram, r, 0x0210, 0x0250, 6, 0xF52F); }
void hm_PlayerAction_50(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fence_place(ram, r, 0x0210, 0x0330, 7, 0xF54B); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $2E ($81:DE1C): the ranch's counter. Closed before the ranch's first
 * event ($7F1F68 bit 0) or on days with $0196 bits 1 / 3 (text $03D0);
 * otherwise the menu (text $0305; B closes it). The answers:
 *   0 a cow: one a day ($7F1F5A bit 5, text $03B6), at most 12 ($7F1F0A,
 *     text $03B7); "sure?" (text $0307); then the barn must have room
 *     ($7F1F29 >= 16 x (cows + 1 + chickens), text $0306), and 5,000 G
 *     (AddMoney -500, text $0304 if not): text $0308, $7F1F5A bits 1 and
 *     5 (it comes tomorrow), one more cow, +20 happiness;
 *   1 a chicken: the same with $7F1F0B, text $030A, 1,000 G, text $0311,
 *     AddNewChicken (2), +10 happiness;
 *   2 / 3 text $030B, and $7F1F5A bit 3 / bit 2 (sell a cow / a chicken).
 * "No" to "sure?" gives text $0303.
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void day_flag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bits)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) | bits);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), r->a);
}
static void say_done(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t text, uint16_t at)
{
  say(ram, r, text, at);
  done(ram, r);
}
/* $7E = 16 x (chickens + extra_c), $80 = 16 x (cows + extra_w), $7E += $80;
 * then LDA $7F1F29; CMP $7E */
static bool room_for(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t first, uint16_t second)
{
  uint16_t a = (uint16_t)(first << 4);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ROOM_NEEDED, a);
  uint16_t b = (uint16_t)(second << 4);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ROOM_COWS, b);
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)a + b;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ROOM_NEEDED, (uint16_t)sum);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_PLANTED_GRASS));
  r->c = r->a >= (uint16_t)sum;
  return r->c;
}
/* AddMoney with -price (24 bits: $FF in $74): true if it was paid */
static bool pay(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t minus, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = minus;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MONEY_ARG, minus);
  set_a8(r, 0xFF);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_ARG_HIGH) = 0xFF;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_AddMoney);
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CMP #0 */
  return r->a == 0;
}
static void one_more(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t counter)
{
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, counter) + 1);
  set_a8(r, n);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, counter, n);
}
static void happiness(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = n;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_AddPlayerHappiness);
}

void hm_PlayerAction_2E(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD);
    if (r->a & 0x8000) {                                   /* B: close */
      jsl(ram, r, 0xE222, 0x83, hm_CloseTextBox);
      set_a8(r, 1);
      wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 1);
      r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW) & 0xFF7F);
      wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW, r->a);
      done(ram, r);
      return;
    }
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    uint8_t pick = rd8(ram, r, HM_ANSWER);
    set_a8(r, pick);
    r->c = 1;
    if (pick != 0) {
      r->c = pick >= 1;
      if (pick == 1) {
        r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) & 0x0020);
        if (r->a) { say_done(ram, r, 0x03B6, 0xDF57); return; }
        set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N)));
        r->c = (uint8_t)r->a >= 0x0C;
        if ((uint8_t)r->a == 0x0C) { say_done(ram, r, 0x03B7, 0xE169); return; }
        say(ram, r, 0x030A, 0xDF3A);
        set_a8(r, 3);
        wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP, 3);
        return;
      }
      r->c = pick >= 2;
      if (pick == 2) {
        say_done(ram, r, 0x030B, 0xDF79);
        day_flag(ram, r, 0x0008);
        return;
      }
      r->c = pick >= 3;
      if (pick == 3) {
        say_done(ram, r, 0x030B, 0xDFA8);
        day_flag(ram, r, 0x0004);
        return;
      }
    }
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) & 0x0020);
    if (r->a) { say_done(ram, r, 0x03B6, 0xDF00); return; }
    set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N)));
    r->c = (uint8_t)r->a >= 0x0C;
    if ((uint8_t)r->a == 0x0C) { say_done(ram, r, 0x03B7, 0xE03D); return; }
    say(ram, r, 0x0307, 0xDEE3);
    set_a8(r, 2);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP, 2);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {                                          /* a cow: sure? */
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (said_no(ram, r)) { say_done(ram, r, 0x0303, 0xE0DC); return; }
    if (!room_for(ram, r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N)), (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N)) + 1))) {
      say_done(ram, r, 0x0306, 0xE01B);
      return;
    }
    if (!pay(ram, r, 0xFE0C, 0xE05D)) { say_done(ram, r, 0x0304, 0xE077); return; }
    say_done(ram, r, 0x0308, 0xE099);
    day_flag(ram, r, 0x0022);
    one_more(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N));
    happiness(ram, r, 0x0014, 0xE0C6);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) {                                          /* a chicken: sure? */
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (said_no(ram, r)) { say_done(ram, r, 0x0303, 0xE20F); return; }
    if (!room_for(ram, r, (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N)) + 1), hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N)))) {
      say_done(ram, r, 0x0306, 0xE145);
      return;
    }
    if (!pay(ram, r, 0xFF9C, 0xE189)) { say_done(ram, r, 0x0304, 0xE1A3); return; }
    say_done(ram, r, 0x0311, 0xE1C4);
    r->a = 2;
    jsl(ram, r, 0xE1D9, 0x83, hm_AddNewChicken);
    day_flag(ram, r, 0x0020);
    one_more(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N));
    happiness(ram, r, 0x000A, 0xE1FA);
    return;
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68)) & 0x0001);
  if (!r->a) { done(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x000A);
  if (r->a) { say_done(ram, r, 0x03D0, 0xDE77); return; }
  say(ram, r, 0x0305, 0xDE5C);
  next_step(ram, r);
}

/* B closes the menu: CloseTextBox (at a), $019A = 1, $0128 bit 7 off */
static bool menu_cancelled(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD);
  if (!(r->a & 0x8000)) return false;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_CloseTextBox);
  set_a8(r, 1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 1);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW) & 0xFF7F);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW, r->a);
  done(ram, r);
  return true;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Signs with a menu ($40 $81:E59C, $54 $81:F86A, $55 $81:F942): the
 * question, then each answer shows its own text (an answer past the list
 * shows the first one's); B closes the menu.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct Page { uint16_t text, at; } Page;
typedef struct Sign { uint16_t question, at_question, at_close; unsigned n; Page page[5]; } Sign;

static void sign_menu(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Sign *sg)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (!is(r, 1)) {
    say(ram, r, sg->question, sg->at_question);
    next_step(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (menu_cancelled(ram, r, sg->at_close)) return;
  if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
  uint8_t pick = rd8(ram, r, HM_ANSWER);
  set_a8(r, pick);
  unsigned k = 0;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sg->n; i++) {
    r->c = pick >= i;
    if (pick == i) { k = i; break; }
  }
  say_done(ram, r, sg->page[k].text, sg->page[k].at);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_40(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Sign sg = { 0x045F, 0xE5B6, 0xE6A0, 5, {
    { 0x0460, 0xE604 }, { 0x0462, 0xE626 }, { 0x0464, 0xE648 }, { 0x0461, 0xE66A }, { 0x0463, 0xE68C } } };
  sign_menu(ram, r, &sg);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_54(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Sign sg = { 0x0455, 0xF884, 0xF91F, 3, {
    { 0x0456, 0xF8C7 }, { 0x0457, 0xF8E9 }, { 0x0458, 0xF90B } } };
  sign_menu(ram, r, &sg);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_55(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Sign sg = { 0x0459, 0xF95C, 0xFA46, 5, {
    { 0x045A, 0xF9AA }, { 0x045B, 0xF9CC }, { 0x045C, 0xF9EE }, { 0x045D, 0xFA10 }, { 0x045E, 0xFA32 } } };
  sign_menu(ram, r, &sg);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $41 ($81:E6C3): the hot spring: $D2 bit 5, action 3, and 12 stamina
 * (ChangeStamina; N clear from LDA #$0C).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_41(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  state_on(ram, r, 0x0020);
  r->a = 3;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 3);
  done(ram, r);
  set_a8(r, 0x0C);
  r->n = 0;
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE6E5, 0x81, hm_ChangeStamina);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $42 ($81:E6EA): the player walks (action 1, facing 2) for $20 frames;
 * then text $030C if $7F1F01 bit 2 is set or the tool in hand is $0B,
 * else $010E; once closed, $099F = 1, $7F1F01 bit 2 and $0196 bit 13;
 * the next frame the action ends.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_42(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    r->x = 0x030C;
    set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 1)) & 0x04));
    if (!(r->a & 0xFF)) {
      uint8_t tool = rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED);
      set_a8(r, tool);
      r->c = tool >= 0x0B;
      if (tool != 0x0B) r->x = 0x010E;
    }
    text_x(ram, r, 0xE755);
    set_a8(r, 2);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP, 2);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    set_a8(r, 3);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP, 3);
    set_a8(r, 1);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_NAME_FOR, 1);
    uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 1)) | 0x04);
    set_a8(r, v);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 1), v);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) | 0x2000);
    wr16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, r->a);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) { done(ram, r); return; }
  walk(ram, r, 1, 2);
  if (count_to(ram, r, 0x20)) {
    set_a8(r, 1);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP, 1);
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $43 ($81:E79E): the cow dealer, about the cow in event slot $09A0 (cow
 * $09A0 - $18; its record from GetCowPointer, byte +0: bits 1-2 sick or
 * pregnant, bits 4-6 its age). Steps:
 *   0  from year 2, with a healthy grown cow and once ($7F1F66 bit 15):
 *      event 8 / $7C (the cow festival entry) and step 7; otherwise event
 *      7 / $21 (the dealer comes) and step 1;
 *   1  after $40 frames: with $7F1F60 bit 13 text $0487; a sick or
 *      pregnant cow text $0310, a calf $030D (both to step 5); otherwise
 *      the offer (text $030E), step 2;
 *   2  yes: text $030F, step 3; no: text $0309, step 5;
 *   3  sold: the price ($7F1F15, 24 bits) is added, the dealer leaves
 *      (FreeEventSlot 7, event 7 / $23), the cow too (its slot: event $22),
 *      its record is cleared, one cow less, -50 happiness; step 4;
 *   4  after $42 frames: ends, or with $7F1F60 bit 13 back to the dealer;
 *   5  once the text is closed the dealer leaves; step 6;
 *   6  after $40 frames it ends; without $7F1F60 bit 13 the cow's event
 *      record gets bits $A8 in byte +1;
 *   7  after $42 frames, text $0149; step 8; 8 yes: $014B, step 9; no:
 *      $014C, step $0A;
 *   9  the cow goes to the festival: as in step 3 but with event 8 / $7D,
 *      without money, $7F1F02 bit 5 and $7F1F60 bit 13; step 4;
 *   $0A event 8 / $7D, step $0B; $0B after $42 frames as step 0's second
 *      half.
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void set_step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t s)
{
  set_a8(r, s);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP, s);
}
/* LDY #0; LDA [$72],Y; AND #mask */
static uint8_t cow_bits(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t mask)
{
  r->y = 0;
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ANIMAL_STATUS)) & mask);
  set_a8(r, v);
  return v;
}
static void event_long(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = a; r->x = 0; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x84, hm_StartEventScriptLong);
}
static void dealer_comes_at(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  event_long(ram, r, 0x0007, 0x0021, at);
  set_step(ram, r, 1);
}
static void dealer_comes(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { dealer_comes_at(ram, r, 0xE858); }  /* $81:E84D */
static bool flag_60_bit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & bit);
  return r->a != 0;
}
static bool flag_60(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { return flag_60_bit(ram, r, 0x2000); }
/* the dealer (slot a) leaves: FreeEventSlot and event a / y */
static void leaves(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t y, uint16_t at_free, uint16_t at_event)
{
  r->a = a;
  jsl(ram, r, at_free, 0x84, hm_FreeEventSlot);
  event_long(ram, r, a, y, at_event);
}
/* the animal leaves too (its slot runs event y), its record goes, one less */
typedef struct Animal { uint16_t slot; uint8_t first; uint16_t event; Step *record; uint32_t count; } Animal;
static const Animal k_cow = { HM_SOLD_COW_SLOT, 0x18, 0x0022, hm_GetCowPointer, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N) };
static const Animal k_chicken = { HM_SOLD_CHICKEN_SLOT, 0x24, 0x0024, hm_GetChickenPointer, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N) };

static void animal_record(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Animal *an, uint16_t at)
{
  uint8_t slot = rd8(ram, r, an->slot);
  r->c = slot >= an->first;
  r->a = (uint8_t)(slot - an->first);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, an->record);
}
static void animal_leaves(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Animal *an, uint16_t at_event, uint16_t at_rec)
{
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, an->slot);
  r->x = 0; r->y = an->event;
  jsl(ram, r, at_event, 0x84, hm_StartEventScript);
  animal_record(ram, r, an, at_rec);
  r->y = 0;
  set_a8(r, 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ANIMAL_STATUS), 0);
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, an->count) - 1);
  set_a8(r, n);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, an->count, n);
  set_step(ram, r, 4);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
}
static void cow_leaves(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at_event, uint16_t at_cow)
{
  animal_leaves(ram, r, &k_cow, at_event, at_cow);
}
/* its event record (SetEventSlotPointer) gets bits $A8 in byte +1 */
static void animal_stays(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t slot, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, slot);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x84, hm_SetEventSlotPointer);
  r->y = SLOT_FLAGS;
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS)) | 0xA8);
  set_a8(r, v);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS), v);
}

/* SEP; LDA #0; XBA; LDA $09A0; SEC; SBC #$18; REP; JSL GetCowPointer */
static void dealer_cow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at) { animal_record(ram, r, &k_cow, at); }

void hm_PlayerAction_43(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  uint8_t s = (uint8_t)r->a;
  int k = 0;
  for (int i = 1; i <= 0x0B && !k; i++) {
    r->c = s >= i;
    if (s == i) k = i;
  }
  switch (k) {
  case 0:
    dealer_cow(ram, r, 0xE7FF);
    if (cow_bits(ram, r, 0x06) || cow_bits(ram, r, 0x70)) { dealer_comes(ram, r); return; }
    set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)));
    if (!(r->a & 0xFF)) { dealer_comes(ram, r); return; }
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & 0x8000);
    if (r->a) { dealer_comes(ram, r); return; }
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) | 0x8000);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), r->a);
    event_long(ram, r, 0x0008, 0x007C, 0xE83F);
    set_step(ram, r, 7);
    return;
  case 1:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x40)) return;
    if (flag_60(ram, r)) {
      r->x = 0x0487;
      text_x(ram, r, 0xE902);
      set_step(ram, r, 5);
      return;
    }
    set_a8(r, 2);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 2);
    dealer_cow(ram, r, 0xE894);
    {
      uint16_t text = 0x030E, at = 0xE8B3;
      uint8_t next = 2;
      if (cow_bits(ram, r, 0x06)) { text = 0x0310; at = 0xE8CB; next = 5; }
      else if (cow_bits(ram, r, 0x70)) { text = 0x030D; at = 0xE8E3; next = 5; }
      r->x = text;
      set_a8(r, 0);
      wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES, 0);
      jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_StartTextBox);
      set_step(ram, r, next);
    }
    return;
  case 2:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (said_no(ram, r)) { say(ram, r, 0x0309, 0xE94F); set_step(ram, r, 5); return; }
    say(ram, r, 0x030F, 0xE932);
    set_step(ram, r, 3);
    return;
  case 3:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SALE_PRICE));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MONEY_ARG, r->a);
    set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SALE_PRICE_HIGH)));
    *hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_ARG_HIGH) = (uint8_t)r->a;
    jsl(ram, r, 0xE979, 0x83, hm_AddMoney);
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0007, 0x0023, 0xE982, 0xE991);
    cow_leaves(ram, r, 0xE9A3, 0xE9B4);
    happiness(ram, r, 0xFFCE, 0xE9DB);
    return;
  case 4:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    if (flag_60(ram, r)) { dealer_comes(ram, r); return; }
    done(ram, r);
    return;
  case 5:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0007, 0x0023, 0xEA22, 0xEA31);
    set_step(ram, r, 6);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    return;
  case 6:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x40)) return;
    done(ram, r);
    if (flag_60(ram, r)) return;
    animal_stays(ram, r, HM_SOLD_COW_SLOT, 0xEA73);
    return;
  case 7:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    r->x = 0x0149;
    text_x(ram, r, 0xEAAC);
    set_step(ram, r, 8);
    return;
  case 8:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (said_no(ram, r)) { say(ram, r, 0x014C, 0xEAF9); set_step(ram, r, 0x0A); return; }
    say(ram, r, 0x014B, 0xEADC);
    set_step(ram, r, 9);
    return;
  case 9:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0008, 0x007D, 0xEB18, 0xEB27);
    cow_leaves(ram, r, 0xEB39, 0xEB4A);
    {
      uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 2)) | 0x20);
      set_a8(r, v);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 2), v);
    }
    happiness(ram, r, 0xFFCE, 0xEB7B);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) | 0x2000);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), r->a);
    return;
  case 0x0A:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0008, 0x007D, 0xEBA0, 0xEBAF);
    set_step(ram, r, 0x0B);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    return;
  default:                                                 /* $0B */
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    dealer_comes(ram, r);
    return;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $44 ($81:EBD5): the same dealer for the chicken in event slot $09A1
 * (chicken $09A1 - $24, GetChickenPointer), with $7F1F60 bit 12. Step 0:
 * in autumn, once ($7F1F66 bit 14), the chicken festival entry (event 8 /
 * $7C, step 7); otherwise the dealer comes. Step 1 waits $42 frames and
 * has no sick or young check; the sale gives -20 happiness; step 6 waits
 * $42 frames; text $0148 / $014A for the festival, where the chicken
 * starts event $10 / $1F at its place (StartScriptAtTileInFront with $0985 / $0987
 * from its record +4 / +6).
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_44(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  uint8_t s = (uint8_t)r->a;
  int k = 0;
  for (int i = 1; i <= 0x0B && !k; i++) {
    r->c = s >= i;
    if (s == i) k = i;
  }
  switch (k) {
  case 0: {
    uint8_t season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
    set_a8(r, season);
    r->c = season >= 2;
    if (season != 2) { dealer_comes_at(ram, r, 0xEC6F); return; }
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & 0x4000);
    if (r->a) { dealer_comes_at(ram, r, 0xEC6F); return; }
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) | 0x4000);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), r->a);
    event_long(ram, r, 0x0008, 0x007C, 0xEC56);
    set_step(ram, r, 7);
    return;
  }
  case 1:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    if (flag_60_bit(ram, r, 0x1000)) {
      r->x = 0x0487;
      text_x(ram, r, 0xECC5);
      set_step(ram, r, 5);
      return;
    }
    r->x = 0x030E;
    text_x(ram, r, 0xECA6);
    set_step(ram, r, 2);
    return;
  case 2:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (said_no(ram, r)) { say(ram, r, 0x0309, 0xED12); set_step(ram, r, 5); return; }
    say(ram, r, 0x030F, 0xECF5);
    set_step(ram, r, 3);
    return;
  case 3:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SALE_PRICE));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MONEY_ARG, r->a);
    set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SALE_PRICE_HIGH)));
    *hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_ARG_HIGH) = (uint8_t)r->a;
    jsl(ram, r, 0xED3C, 0x83, hm_AddMoney);
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0007, 0x0023, 0xED45, 0xED54);
    animal_leaves(ram, r, &k_chicken, 0xED66, 0xED77);
    happiness(ram, r, 0xFFEC, 0xED9E);
    return;
  case 4:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    if (flag_60_bit(ram, r, 0x1000)) { dealer_comes_at(ram, r, 0xEC6F); return; }
    done(ram, r);
    return;
  case 5:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0007, 0x0023, 0xEDE5, 0xEDF4);
    set_step(ram, r, 6);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    return;
  case 6:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    done(ram, r);
    if (flag_60_bit(ram, r, 0x1000)) return;
    animal_stays(ram, r, HM_SOLD_CHICKEN_SLOT, 0xEE36);
    return;
  case 7:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    r->x = 0x0148;
    text_x(ram, r, 0xEE6F);
    set_step(ram, r, 8);
    return;
  case 8:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (said_no(ram, r)) { say(ram, r, 0x014C, 0xEEBC); set_step(ram, r, 0x0A); return; }
    say(ram, r, 0x014A, 0xEE9F);
    set_step(ram, r, 9);
    return;
  case 9:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0008, 0x007D, 0xEEDB, 0xEEEA);
    animal_leaves(ram, r, &k_chicken, 0xEEFC, 0xEF0D);
    r->y = CHICKEN_X;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, CHICKEN_X));
    wr16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, r->a);
    r->y = CHICKEN_Y;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, CHICKEN_Y));
    wr16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, r->a);
    r->a = 0x0010; r->x = 0; r->y = 0x001F;
    jsl(ram, r, 0xEF4A, 0x84, hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront);
    happiness(ram, r, 0xFFEC, 0xEF53);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) | 0x1000);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), r->a);
    return;
  case 0x0A:
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0008, 0x007D, 0xEF78, 0xEF87);
    set_step(ram, r, 0x0B);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    return;
  default:
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    dealer_comes_at(ram, r, 0xEC6F);
    return;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $45 ($81:EFAD): after 8 frames the player walks (action 1, facing 2)
 * for $20 frames; text $0317; once closed, $099F = 2 and $0196 bit 13; the
 * next frame the action ends.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_45(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    walk(ram, r, 1, 2);
    if (count_to(ram, r, 0x20)) set_step(ram, r, 2);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    r->x = 0x0317;
    text_x(ram, r, 0xF022);
    set_step(ram, r, 3);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    set_step(ram, r, 4);
    set_a8(r, 2);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_NAME_FOR, 2);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) | 0x2000);
    wr16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, r->a);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 4)) { done(ram, r); return; }
  if (count_to(ram, r, 0x08)) {
    set_step(ram, r, 1);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $46 ($81:F061): the shipper's visit: event 6 / $26 (he comes); after $42
 * frames his text: $031A, or $031B when nothing was shipped ($7F1F07-09
 * = 0); once closed he leaves (FreeEventSlot 6, event 6 / $27), and after $42
 * frames more the action ends.
 * Bug: when the low word of the shipped money is not 0 the branch to the
 * text keeps A in 16 bits, so "LDA #$00; STA $0191" is read as "LDA
 * #$8D00; STA ($01),Y": $8D00 goes to the word at ($01),Y and $0191 keeps
 * its value.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_46(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) return;
    set_a8(r, 2);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 2);
    r->x = 0x031A;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY));
    if (r->a) {                                            /* the bug */
      r->a = 0x8D00;
      uint32_t at = (((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, BUG_PTR) + r->y) & 0xFFFFFF;
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, at, 0x8D00);
      jsl(ram, r, 0xF0C4, 0x83, hm_StartTextBox);
    } else {
      set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY_HIGH)));
      if (!(r->a & 0xFF)) r->x = 0x031B;
      set_a8(r, 0);
      wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES, 0);
      jsl(ram, r, 0xF0C4, 0x83, hm_StartTextBox);
    }
    set_step(ram, r, 2);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    leaves(ram, r, 0x0006, 0x0027, 0xF0E3, 0xF0F2);
```
