```c
    set_step(ram, r, 3);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) {
    if (count_to(ram, r, 0x42)) done(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  event_long(ram, r, 0x0006, 0x0026, 0xF085);
  set_step(ram, r, 1);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $47 ($81:F121): the carpenter, about the house extension (lumber needed
 * $7F1F0E: 250 for the first, else 500; lumber in stock $7F1F0C). After
 * $20 frames (in the first spring or summer, $7F1F70 bit 2): with enough
 * lumber the offer (text $0134, or $013B for the second) and step 3, else
 * text $0137 and step 1. Step 1: once closed he leaves (event 9 / $2D on
 * slot 9), step 2, which ends after $C6 frames. Step 3: no gives text $0136;
 * yes pays 5,000 G (or 10,000 G for the second; text $0304 if not), uses
 * the lumber (AddWood), text $0135, $7F1F35 = 0 (the work starts) and
 * $7F1F66 bit 7; all three go to step 1.
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static void event_short(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = a; r->x = 0; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x84, hm_StartEventScript);
}

void hm_PlayerAction_47(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    event_short(ram, r, 0x0009, 0x002D, 0xF1E5);
    set_step(ram, r, 2);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    if (count_to(ram, r, 0xC6)) done(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (said_no(ram, r)) { say(ram, r, 0x0136, 0xF2CC); set_step(ram, r, 1); return; }
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_LUMBER_NEEDED));
    r->c = r->a >= 0x00FA;
    bool paid = r->a == 0x00FA ? pay(ram, r, 0xFE0C, 0xF259) : pay(ram, r, 0xFC18, 0xF23F);
    if (!paid) { say(ram, r, 0x0304, 0xF2B0); set_step(ram, r, 1); return; }
    r->a = (uint16_t)(~hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_LUMBER_NEEDED)) + 1); /* EOR #$FFFF; INC */
    jsl(ram, r, 0xF26E, 0x83, hm_AddWood);
    say(ram, r, 0x0135, 0xF281);
    set_step(ram, r, 1);
    set_a8(r, 0);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_BUILD_NIGHTS), 0);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) | 0x0080);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), r->a);
    return;
  }
  if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x20)) return;
  set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)));
  if (!(r->a & 0xFF)) {
    uint8_t season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
    set_a8(r, season);
    r->c = season >= 2;
    if (season < 2) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_70)) | 0x0004);
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_70), r->a);
    }
  }
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
  uint16_t offer = 0x013B, need = 0x01F4;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_LUMBER_NEEDED));
  r->c = r->a >= 0x00FA;
  if (r->a == 0x00FA) { offer = 0x0134; need = 0x00FA; }
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_STORED_WOOD));
  r->c = r->a >= need;
  if (r->c) {
    r->x = offer;
    text_x(ram, r, 0xF1A3);
    set_step(ram, r, 3);
    return;
  }
  say(ram, r, 0x0137, 0xF1C0);
  set_step(ram, r, 1);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $48 ($81:F2DA): the house extension finished: after $20 frames +50
 * happiness and text $013D, or +100 and text $0140 for the second
 * ($7F1F64 bit 7); step 1. Step 1: once closed, the first extension in the
 * first spring or summer ($7F1F70 bit 2) also gives text $025C,
 * $7F1F6E bit 14 and step 3; otherwise the carpenters leave (events $38
 * and $39 on slots 9 and $0A), step 2, which ends after $C6 frames. Step
 * 3 makes them leave once that text is closed.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void carpenters_leave(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at1, uint16_t at2)
{
  event_short(ram, r, 0x0009, 0x0038, at1);
  event_short(ram, r, 0x000A, 0x0039, at2);
  set_step(ram, r, 2);
}

void hm_PlayerAction_48(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64)) & 0x0080);
    if (!r->a) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_70)) & 0x0004);
      if (r->a) {
        r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E)) | 0x4000);
        hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), r->a);
        say(ram, r, 0x025C, 0xF386);
        set_step(ram, r, 3);
        return;
      }
    }
    carpenters_leave(ram, r, 0xF39E, 0xF3AD);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    if (count_to(ram, r, 0xC6)) done(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    carpenters_leave(ram, r, 0xF3F0, 0xF3FF);
    return;
  }
  if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x20)) return;
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64)) & 0x0080);
  if (!r->a) {
    happiness(ram, r, 0x0032, 0xF315);
    r->x = 0x013D;
  } else {
    happiness(ram, r, 0x0064, 0xF325);
    r->x = 0x0140;
  }
  text_x(ram, r, 0xF33A);
  set_step(ram, r, 1);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $49 ($81:F40E): after $20 frames text $0300; once closed, event $0B /
 * $1E (on slot $0B); the action ends $C6 frames later.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_49(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    event_short(ram, r, 0x000B, 0x001E, 0xF463);
    set_step(ram, r, 2);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    if (count_to(ram, r, 0xC6)) done(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x20)) return;
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
  say(ram, r, 0x0300, 0xF43E);
  set_step(ram, r, 1);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * A drink at the bar ($51 $81:F5B0: 200 G, $52 $81:F6D7: 300 G): the
 * offer; no: text $024D; yes: paid (text $024C) or not enough money
 * ($0213); once paid and closed the player drinks (action $19 with
 * sprite $30 / $FB) and gains 1 / 3 happiness, and $64 frames later the
 * action ends with action 0.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct Drink {
  uint16_t offer, at_offer, price, at_pay, at_paid, at_no, at_short;
  uint16_t sprite, at_pose, joy, at_joy;
} Drink;

static void drink(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Drink *d)
{
  step(ram, r);
  if (is(r, 1)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    if (said_no(ram, r)) { say(ram, r, 0x024D, d->at_no); set_step(ram, r, 3); return; }
    if (!pay(ram, r, d->price, d->at_pay)) { say(ram, r, 0x0213, d->at_short); set_step(ram, r, 3); return; }
    say(ram, r, 0x024C, d->at_paid);
    set_step(ram, r, 2);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 2)) {
    if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
    pose(ram, r, 0x0019, d->sprite, d->at_pose);
    happiness(ram, r, d->joy, d->at_joy);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES, 0);
    set_step(ram, r, 4);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 3)) {
    if (!text_open(ram, r)) done(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (is(r, 4)) {
    if (!count_to(ram, r, 0x64)) return;
    done(ram, r);
    r->a = 0;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
    return;
  }
  say(ram, r, d->offer, d->at_offer);
  next_step(ram, r);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_51(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Drink d = { 0x024B, 0xF5DF, 0xFFEC, 0xF60B, 0xF625, 0xF642, 0xF65F,
                           0x0030, 0xF686, 0x0001, 0xF68E };
  drink(ram, r, &d);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_52(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Drink d = { 0x024A, 0xF706, 0xFFE2, 0xF732, 0xF74C, 0xF769, 0xF786,
                           0x00FB, 0xF7AE, 0x0003, 0xF7B6 };
  drink(ram, r, &d);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $53 ($81:F7FF): an egg from a nest of the coop: the player holds an egg
 * ($14); the nest is the one of DATA16_83CA10 (13 nests, X - 8) whose
 * column is the tile in front's, and its egg bit in $7F1F45 (DATA16_81FAD4)
 * goes.
 * Bug: with no nest in that column the search loops for ever ("BRA" to
 * itself at $81:F856); the rewrite returns (the fuzz keeps the player
 * where the tile in front is always a nest's column).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void hm_PlayerAction_53(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 0, 0, 0xF80E);
  hold(ram, r, 0x14);
  done(ram, r);
  uint16_t v = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { r->c = v & 1; v = (uint16_t)(v >> 1); }
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) { r->c = v >> 15; v = (uint16_t)(v << 1); }
  r->a = v;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, NEST_COLUMN, v);
  for (r->y = 0; r->y < 0x0D; r->y++) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(r->y << 2);
    r->x = r->a;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, CHICKEN_PLACES + r->x) - 8);
    r->c = r->a >= v;
    if (r->a == v) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(r->y << 1);
      r->c = 0;
      r->x = r->a;
      r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, NEST_BITS + r->x) & hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEN_EGGS)));
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEN_EGGS), r->a);
      return;
    }
  }
}

/* $56 ($81:FA69): it ends at the second frame. */
void hm_PlayerAction_56(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (count_to(ram, r, 0x02)) done(ram, r);
}

/* $57 ($81:FA84): text $0491 with $7F1F66 bit 1, else $0246. */
void hm_PlayerAction_57(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->x = 0x0491;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & 0x0002);
  if (!r->a) r->x = 0x0246;
  text_x(ram, r, 0xFAA3);
  done(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $35 ($81:E36E): a sound: effect $24 of bank 7, then 120 frames of wait
 * (PlayEffectWithSongInstrument); the noises of the item in hand loaded again ($0119 = 0,
 * ToolUsedSound2); the action is over.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerAction_35(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  set_a8(r, 0x24);                                         /* SEP #$20; REP #$10 */
  r->x = 0x0007;
  r->y = 0x0078;
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE37A, 0x83, hm_PlayEffectWithSongInstrument);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_LOADED_TOOL_SOUND, 0);
  r->p = entry;
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE383, 0x82, hm_ToolUsedSound2);
  r->p = entry;
  done(ram, r);
}

```

`src/animals.c`:

```c
/*
 * animals.c — where the barn and the coop live in RAM.
 *
 * GetCowPointer ($83:C9A7) and GetChickenPointer ($83:C995): A = slot,
 * returns the long pointer $7E:xxxx to that animal's record in $72-$74.
 * Cows are 16-byte records at $7E:C1C6, chickens 8-byte records at $7E:C286.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* $7E / $80 are scratch, a different thing in each routine: */
#define HAPPINESS_CHANGE   0x7E      /* AddCowHappiness: the change */
#define OLD_HAPPINESS      0x80      /* AddCowHappiness: the happiness before it */
#define NEW_ANIMAL_SOURCE  0x7E      /* AddNewChicken / AddNewCow: where it comes from (A) */
#define MUL_FACTOR         0x7E      /* StartEnding: Multiply16's second factor, then the
                                      * dividend (DivisionUnsigned) */
#define DIVISOR            0x80      /* StartEnding: DivisionUnsigned's divisor */

/* ROM tables */
#define HEN_EGG_FLAGS      0x83CA78  /* ROM: dw 1 << n */

static void slot_pointer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t base, unsigned shift)
{
  uint16_t ptr = (uint16_t)((uint16_t)(r->a << shift) + base);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ptr);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR_BANK) = 0x7E;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((ptr & 0xFF00) | 0x7E);   /* SEP #$20; LDA #$7E keeps B */
}

void hm_GetCowPointer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)    { slot_pointer(ram, r, HM_COW_DATA & 0xFFFF, 4); }
void hm_GetChickenPointer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { slot_pointer(ram, r, HM_CHICKEN_DATA & 0xFFFF, 3); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AddCowHappiness ($84:A5D4, JSL, RTL; a local label inside the event
 * command Event_CowFrame in HM-Decomp). $72-$74 = the cow's record
 * (GetCowPointer), A = signed change. Byte +4 of the record is the cow's
 * happiness, kept in 0..255.
 * Leftovers: $7E = change, $80 = old happiness, Y = 4. A = old + change
 * with its low byte replaced by the stored value when it was clamped;
 * C = 0 when it fits, 1 when it went over 255, the add's carry when it went
 * below 0.
 * CowFeedingAndStatus calls it with -8, -16, -24 (not fed), -12 (gets
 * sick) and -30.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_AddCowHappiness(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t change = r->a;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HAPPINESS_CHANGE, change);
  r->y = COW_HAPPINESS;
  uint32_t at = hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, COW_HAPPINESS);
  uint16_t old = hm_bus_rd8(ram, at);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OLD_HAPPINESS, old);
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)old + change;
  uint16_t a = (uint16_t)sum;
  if (a & 0x8000) {                     /* below 0 */
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, at, 0);
    r->a = a & 0xFF00;
    r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  } else if (a >= 256) {                /* over 255 */
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, at, 255);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((a & 0xFF00) | 0xFF);
    r->c = 1;
  } else {
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, at, (uint8_t)a);
    r->a = a;
    r->c = 0;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CowFeedingAndStatus ($83:BC5A, JSL, RTL; no compiled body: it runs in the
 * recompiler's interpreter). The animals' night, called from NightReset.
 *
 * Cow record (16 bytes, GetCowPointer):
 *   +0 status: 01 exists, 02 newborn calf, 04 calf, 08 adult, 10 cranky,
 *              20 sick, 40 pregnant, 80 just gave birth
 *   +1 flags (bits 0-2 are daily and cleared every night; 80 = got the
 *      miracle potion today)
 *   +2 where it is (map; $27 = barn, 0-3 = the farm)
 *   +3 a counter: days as a calf, days left cranky / sick / pregnant
 *   +4 happiness (AddCowHappiness)   +5 days out of the barn (cranky at 10)
 * Chicken record (8 bytes, GetChickenPointer):
 *   +0 status: 01 exists, 02 egg, 04 chick, 08 hen, 10 hungry
 *   +1 where it is ($28 = coop, 0-3 = the farm)   +2 a counter
 *
 * 1. Feeding (skipped when $7F1F60 bit 0 is set), cows 0..11 that are not
 *    newborn calves:
 *    - Calves on the farm just graze (eat one grown grass tile).
 *    - Grown cows in the barn are fed if their stall has fodder ($0932, one
 *      bit per stall; pregnant cows use stall 12).
 *    - Grown cows on the farm graze; with no grass, or in the rain, they go
 *      hungry; snow, hurricane and the winter storm cost happiness.
 *    - A hungry cow loses happiness and may fall sick (1 in 4 hungry, 1 in
 *      2 in snow or hurricane, 1 in 8 in the winter storm) unless pregnant,
 *      given the potion or already sick: then happiness -12, and the
 *      player's happiness -30; sick for 7 days.
 *    - Then a cow 10 days out of the barn, or one left out ($7F1F5A bit
 *      $1000: 1 in 16, -8 happiness; or $0196 bit $0400) turns cranky for
 *      3 days (happiness -30).
 * 2. Growing up, cows 0..11 (always): daily flags cleared; a newborn calf
 *    becomes a calf after 14 days, a calf an adult after 21 ($7F1F6E bit
 *    $1000 is set on growing up and for every adult). Cranky and sick days
 *    count down; a cow sick to the end dies (unless tomorrow is a festival,
 *    or $0196 has 0002/0008/0010): cow_N - 1, $7F1F6E bit $0040 (funeral),
 *    $0937 = which cow. A cow given the potion becomes pregnant; a
 *    pregnant cow counts down with the global $7F1F12 and gives birth in
 *    the barn: $7F1F64 bit 8, and $7F1F2B = 20 / 50 / 100 by happiness
 *    (below 96 / below 192 / higher).
 * 3. Chickens, feeding (skipped like 1): a chicken with no stage dies
 *    (chicks_N - 1, player's happiness -30); hens in the coop eat from the
 *    feed box ($0931); on the farm they graze; unfed hens get hungry. On
 *    a $0196 $0410 night one hen left outside (not in the coop) is lost.
 * 4. Chickens, growing (always): an egg hatches after 3 nights if there is
 *    room (fewer than 12 chickens), a chick becomes a hen after 7.
 * 5. Chickens, eggs: $7F1F45 = one bit per hen in the coop that is not
 *    hungry (table $83:CA78); hungry hens count down instead.
 * 6. If $7F1F68 bit $0100, $7F1F32 counts up to 21.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define COW_EXISTS      0x01
#define COW_NEWBORN     0x02
#define COW_CALF        0x04
#define COW_ADULT       0x08
#define COW_CRANKY      0x10
#define COW_SICK        0x20
#define COW_PREGNANT    0x40
#define COW_GAVE_BIRTH  0x80
#define COW_POTION      0x80   /* in +1 */
#define MAP_BARN        0x27
#define MAP_COOP        0x28
#define HEN_EXISTS      0x01
#define HEN_EGG         0x02
#define HEN_CHICK       0x04
#define HEN_ADULT       0x08
#define HEN_HUNGRY      0x10

static uint8_t s_nowhere;
/* [$72],Y: a field of the animal record; LDY #off first, as the game does. */
static uint8_t *field(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t off)
{
  r->y = off;
  uint8_t *p = hm_bus_ram(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, off));
  return p ? p : &s_nowhere;
}

typedef void (*HmRoutine)(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);
static void call(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, uint8_t bank, HmRoutine fn)
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
static void cow_happiness(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, int16_t change, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)change;
  call(ram, r, ret, 0x84, hm_AddCowHappiness);
}
static void player_happiness(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, int16_t change, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)change;
  call(ram, r, ret, 0x83, hm_AddPlayerHappiness);
}
static bool one_in(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t n, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | n);
  call(ram, r, ret, 0x80, hm_RNGReturn0toA);
  return (uint8_t)r->a == 0;
}
static void graze(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret) { call(ram, r, ret, 0x82, hm_CowEatsGrass); }
static bool grass_eaten(const uint8_t *ram) { return hm_rd16(ram, HM_GROWN_GRASS_N) != 0; }
static uint16_t weather_flags(const uint8_t *ram) { return hm_rd16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS); }

/* PHX; PHX; TXA; JSL Get...Pointer; PLX (one copy of X stays pushed). */
static void animal_begin(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t i, uint16_t ret, HmRoutine get)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(i >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)i);
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(i >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)i);
  r->a = i;
  call(ram, r, ret, 0x83, get);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
}
static void animal_end(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)    /* PLX at the bottom */
{
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
}

/* 1. ── feeding the cows ── */
static void cow_cranky(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_PREGNANT) return;
  if (*field(ram, r, COW_DAILY) & COW_POTION) return;
  if (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_SICK) return;
  *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) |= COW_CRANKY;
  *field(ram, r, COW_DAYS) = 3;
  *field(ram, r, COW_HITS) = 0;
  cow_happiness(ram, r, -30, 0xBE2B);
}

static void cow_after_meal(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (*field(ram, r, COW_HITS) == 10) { cow_cranky(ram, r); return; }
  if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x1000) {
    if (*field(ram, r, COW_MAP) == MAP_BARN) return;
    if (one_in(ram, r, 16, 0xBDC8)) {
      cow_happiness(ram, r, -8, 0xBDD3);
      cow_cranky(ram, r);
      return;
    }
  }
  /* GAME BUG: when we got here through the 1-in-16 roll above (cow outside,
   * $7F1F5A bit $1000, roll not 0), RNGReturn0toA has left X in 8-bit mode
   * and nothing sets it back to 16 bits. If $0196 bit $0400 is also set,
   * the next instruction, LDY.W #$0002 at $83:BDE1, runs with an 8-bit X:
   * the CPU takes A0 02 as the whole instruction and the leftover 00 is a
   * BRK. The game goes off the rails there. The rewrite does what the code
   * meant (check the map, maybe turn cranky); that case is left out of the
   * comparison. */
  if (!(weather_flags(ram) & 0x0400)) return;
  if (*field(ram, r, COW_MAP) == MAP_BARN) return;
  cow_cranky(ram, r);
}

/* Hungry: lose happiness, then 1 in `sick_odds` of falling sick. */
static void cow_hungry(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, int16_t change, uint16_t ret, uint8_t sick_odds)
{
  cow_happiness(ram, r, change, ret);
  if (one_in(ram, r, sick_odds, 0xBD56) &&
      !(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_PREGNANT) &&
      !(*field(ram, r, COW_DAILY) & COW_POTION) &&
      !(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_SICK)) {
    *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) |= COW_SICK;
    *field(ram, r, COW_DAYS) = 7;
    cow_happiness(ram, r, -12, 0xBD94);
    player_happiness(ram, r, -30, 0xBD9D);
  }
  cow_after_meal(ram, r);
}

static void feed_cow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t i)
{
  uint8_t status = *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  if (!(status & COW_EXISTS) || (status & COW_NEWBORN)) return;
  if (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_CALF) {
    if (*field(ram, r, COW_MAP) < 4) graze(ram, r, 0xBE3E);
    return;
  }
  if (*field(ram, r, COW_MAP) == MAP_BARN) {
    uint16_t stall = (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_PREGNANT) ? 12 : i;
    if (hm_bus_rd16(ram, FEED_BOX_BITS + 2u * stall) & hm_rd16(ram, HM_COW_TROUGHS))
      cow_after_meal(ram, r);
    else
      cow_hungry(ram, r, -8, 0xBD18, 4);
    return;
  }
  if (*field(ram, r, COW_MAP) >= 4) { cow_hungry(ram, r, -8, 0xBD18, 4); return; }
  graze(ram, r, 0xBCE3);
  uint16_t w = weather_flags(ram);
  if (!grass_eaten(ram) || (w & 0x0002)) cow_hungry(ram, r, -8, 0xBD18, 4);
  else if (w & 0x0008) cow_hungry(ram, r, -16, 0xBD28, 2);
  else if (w & 0x0010) cow_hungry(ram, r, -24, 0xBD38, 2);
  else if (w & 0x0200) cow_hungry(ram, r, -8, 0xBD48, 8);
  else cow_after_meal(ram, r);
}

/* 2. ── the cows grow up ── */
static void cow_birth(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (*field(ram, r, COW_MAP) != MAP_BARN) return;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_64, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_64) | 0x0008);
  uint8_t *status = field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  *status = (uint8_t)((*status | COW_GAVE_BIRTH) & ~COW_PREGNANT);
  ram[HM_NEWBORN_HAPPINESS] = 20;
  uint8_t happiness = *field(ram, r, COW_HAPPINESS);
  if (happiness >= 192) ram[HM_NEWBORN_HAPPINESS] = 100;
  else if (happiness >= 96) ram[HM_NEWBORN_HAPPINESS] = 50;
}

static void cow_dies_if_sick(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t i)
{
  if (weather_flags(ram) & 0x001A) return;
  if (ram[HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW] >= 6) return;       /* festival tomorrow */
  *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) = 0;
  ram[HM_COW_N]--;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) | 0x0040);
  ram[HM_DEAD_COW] = (uint8_t)i;
}

static void cow_grows(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t i)
{
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_EXISTS)) return;
  (void)field(ram, r, COW_HAPPINESS);              /* LDA happiness, unused */
  *field(ram, r, COW_DAILY) &= 0xF8;
  uint8_t status = *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  if (status & COW_NEWBORN) {
    if (++*field(ram, r, COW_DAYS) == 14) {
      *field(ram, r, COW_DAYS) = 0;
      uint8_t *s = field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
      *s = (uint8_t)((*s | COW_CALF) & ~COW_NEWBORN);
    }
    return;
  }
  if (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_CALF) {
    if (++*field(ram, r, COW_DAYS) == 21) {
      *field(ram, r, COW_DAYS) = 0;
      uint8_t *s = field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
      *s = (uint8_t)((*s | COW_ADULT) & ~COW_CALF);
      *field(ram, r, COW_DAYS) = 0;
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) | 0x1000);
    }
    return;
  }
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) | 0x1000);
  if (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_CRANKY) {
    if (--*field(ram, r, COW_DAYS) == 0) *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) &= ~COW_CRANKY;
    return;
  }
  if (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_SICK) {
    uint8_t *days = field(ram, r, COW_DAYS);
    if (*days == 0 || --*days == 0) cow_dies_if_sick(ram, r, i);
    return;
  }
  if (*field(ram, r, COW_DAILY) & COW_POTION) {
    *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) |= COW_PREGNANT;
    *field(ram, r, COW_DAILY) &= 0x7F;
    return;
  }
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_PREGNANT)) return;
  uint8_t *days = field(ram, r, COW_DAYS);
  if (*days != 0) {
    (*days)--;
    if (--ram[HM_PREGNANCY_DAYS] != 0) return;
  }
  cow_birth(ram, r);
}

/* 3. ── feeding the chickens ── */
static void feed_hen(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & HEN_EXISTS)) return;
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & (HEN_EGG | HEN_CHICK | HEN_ADULT))) {
    *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) = 0;              /* no stage: it dies */
    ram[HM_CHICKEN_N]--;
    player_happiness(ram, r, -30, 0xC083);
  }
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & HEN_ADULT)) return;
  bool fed;
  if (*field(ram, r, CHICKEN_MAP) == MAP_COOP) {
    if (ram[HM_CHICKENS_FED]) { ram[HM_CHICKENS_FED]--; return; }
    fed = false;
  } else if (*field(ram, r, CHICKEN_MAP) >= 4) {
    fed = false;
  } else {
    graze(ram, r, 0xC0BB);
    fed = grass_eaten(ram) && !(weather_flags(ram) & 0x020A);
  }
  if (!fed) {
    *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) |= HEN_HUNGRY;
    *field(ram, r, CHICKEN_DAYS) = 3;
  }
  if (!(weather_flags(ram) & 0x0410)) return;
  if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & 0x0020) return;  /* only one per night */
  if (*field(ram, r, CHICKEN_MAP) >= 4) return;
  *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) = HEN_EXISTS;      /* lost: dies tomorrow */
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) | 0x0020);
}

/* 4. ── the chickens grow up ── */
static void hen_grows(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & HEN_EXISTS)) return;
  if (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & HEN_EGG) {
    uint8_t *nights = field(ram, r, CHICKEN_DAYS);
    if (*nights != 3 && ++*nights != 3) return;
    if (ram[HM_CHICKEN_N] == 12) return;          /* no room: keeps waiting */
    *field(ram, r, CHICKEN_DAYS) = 0;
    uint8_t *s = field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
    *s = (uint8_t)((*s | HEN_CHICK) & 0xBD);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, CHICKEN_X), 0x00D8);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, CHICKEN_Y), 0x00B8);
    r->y = CHICKEN_Y;
    ram[HM_CHICKEN_N]++;
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & 0xDFFF);
    return;
  }
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & HEN_CHICK)) return;
  if (++*field(ram, r, CHICKEN_DAYS) != 7) return;
  *field(ram, r, CHICKEN_DAYS) = 0;
  uint8_t *s = field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  *s = (uint8_t)((*s | HEN_ADULT) & ~HEN_CHICK);
  *field(ram, r, CHICKEN_DAYS) = 0;
}

/* 5. ── who lays an egg tomorrow ── */
static void hen_lays(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t i)
{
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & HEN_EXISTS)) return;
  if (!(*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & HEN_ADULT)) return;
  if (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & HEN_HUNGRY) {
    uint8_t *nights = field(ram, r, CHICKEN_DAYS);
    if (--*nights == 0) *field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) &= ~HEN_HUNGRY;
    return;
  }
  if (*field(ram, r, CHICKEN_MAP) != MAP_COOP) return;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_HEN_EGGS, hm_bus_rd16(ram, HEN_EGG_FLAGS + 2u * i) | hm_rd16(ram, HM_HEN_EGGS));
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) | 0x0400);
}

void hm_CowFeedingAndStatus(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  bool feeding = !(hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0x0001);
  if (feeding) {
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
      animal_begin(ram, r, i, 0xBC73, hm_GetCowPointer);
      feed_cow(ram, r, i);
      animal_end(ram, r);
    }
  }
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & 0xEFBF);
  for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    animal_begin(ram, r, i, 0xBE63, hm_GetCowPointer);
    cow_grows(ram, r, i);
    animal_end(ram, r);
  }
  if (!(hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0x0001)) {
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & 0xFFDF);
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
      animal_begin(ram, r, i, 0xC04C, hm_GetChickenPointer);
      feed_hen(ram, r);
      animal_end(ram, r);
    }
  }
  for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
    animal_begin(ram, r, i, 0xC132, hm_GetChickenPointer);
    hen_grows(ram, r);
    animal_end(ram, r);
  }
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_HEN_EGGS, 0);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & 0xFBFF);
  for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 13; i++) {
    animal_begin(ram, r, i, 0xC207, hm_GetChickenPointer);
    hen_lays(ram, r, i);
    animal_end(ram, r);
  }

  r->x = 13;
  r->c = 1;                                        /* CPX #13 matched */
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_68) & 0x0100;
  if (r->a) {
    uint8_t v = ram[HM_HORSE_AGE];
    r->c = v >= 0x15;
    if (v != 0x15) ram[HM_HORSE_AGE] = ++v;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(0x0100 | v);
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * New animals. Both look for the first free record (bit 0 of its status
 * clear), clear it and fill it in; A = 0 if there was room, 1 if not (13
 * chickens / 12 cows). Neither touches the animal counts $7F1F0A/0B: the
 * callers do.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* the search: X = first free slot (or `slots` if none), $72 = its record */
static uint16_t free_slot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t slots, uint16_t ret,
                          void (*pointer)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  uint16_t x = 0;
  do {
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(x >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)x);   /* PHX */
    r->a = r->x = x;                                                     /* TXA */
    hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
    pointer(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                                  /* PLX */
    r->y = ANIMAL_STATUS;
    uint8_t in_use = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ANIMAL_STATUS)) & 1;
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | in_use);
    if (!in_use) break;
    x++;
  } while (x != slots);
  r->x = x;
  r->c = x >= slots;                                                     /* CPX */
  return x;
}
static void put8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t v)
{
  r->y = at;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, at), v);
}
static void put16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint16_t v)
{
  r->y = at;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, at), v);
}
/* its place from a table of (x, y) words: TXA; ASL; ASL; TAX ... */
static void spawn_from_table(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t table,
                             uint16_t at_x, uint16_t at_y)
{
  uint16_t slot = r->x;
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)(slot << 2);
  r->c = (slot >> 14) & 1;                               /* the second ASL */
  put16(ram, r, at_x, hm_bus_rd16(ram, (table + x) & 0xFFFFFF));
  x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (table + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  put16(ram, r, at_y, r->a);
  r->x = x;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AddNewChicken ($83:C807, JSL, RTL). A = where it comes from:
 *   1 bought: status $09, at its slot's place in the coop ($83:CA10);
 *   2 hatched: status $09, +1 = season + 4, at (238, 318);
 *   anything else: status $43, at (E8, B8).
 * +1 is first set to $28 (the coop map), +2 to 0.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_AddNewChicken(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t source = r->a;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, NEW_ANIMAL_SOURCE, source);
  uint16_t slot = free_slot(ram, r, 13, 0xC815, hm_GetChickenPointer);
  if (slot == 13) { r->a = 1; return; }

  for (uint16_t y = 0; y < 8; y++) put8(ram, r, y, 0);
  r->y = 8; r->c = 1;                                    /* CPY #8 */
  put8(ram, r, CHICKEN_MAP, 0x28);
  put8(ram, r, CHICKEN_DAYS, 0x00);
  r->a = 0;
  r->c = source >= 1;                                    /* CMP #1 */
  if (source == 1) {
    put8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS, 0x09);
    spawn_from_table(ram, r, CHICKEN_PLACES, CHICKEN_X, CHICKEN_Y);
  } else if (r->c = source >= 2, source == 2) {          /* CMP #2 */
    put8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS, 0x09);
    uint8_t s = ram[HM_SEASON];
    r->c = (unsigned)s + 4 > 0xFF;                       /* CLC; ADC #4 */
    put8(ram, r, CHICKEN_MAP, (uint8_t)(s + 4));
    put16(ram, r, CHICKEN_X, 0x0238);
    put16(ram, r, CHICKEN_Y, 0x0318);
  } else {
    put8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS, 0x43);
    put16(ram, r, CHICKEN_X, 0x00E8);
    put16(ram, r, CHICKEN_Y, 0x00B8);
  }
  r->a = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AddNewCow ($83:C8DC, JSL, RTL). A = 0 bought, anything else born. The
 * record: status $05 (a young cow), +2 = $27 (the barn), pregnancy,
 * happiness and +5 = 0, and its slot's place in the barn ($83:CA44). A
 * calf born on the farm is a baby (status $03), starts with the happiness
 * the birth left in $7F1F2B, and gives the player +70 happiness.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_AddNewCow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t source = r->a;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, NEW_ANIMAL_SOURCE, source);
  uint16_t slot = free_slot(ram, r, 12, 0xC8EA, hm_GetCowPointer);
  if (slot == 12) { r->a = 1; return; }

  for (uint16_t y = 0; y < 16; y++) put8(ram, r, y, 0);
  r->c = 1;                                              /* CPY #$10 */
  put8(ram, r, COW_MAP, 0x27);
  put8(ram, r, COW_DAYS, 0);
  put8(ram, r, COW_HAPPINESS, 0);
  put8(ram, r, COW_HITS, 0);
  put8(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0);
  put8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS, 0x05);
  r->a = 0x0005;
  if (source != 0) {                                     /* born */
    put8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS, 0x03);
    put8(ram, r, COW_HAPPINESS, ram[HM_NEWBORN_HAPPINESS]);
    r->a = 70;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xC96C, 0x83);
    hm_AddPlayerHappiness(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
  spawn_from_table(ram, r, COW_PLACES, COW_X, COW_Y);
  r->a = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PlaceAnimalsOnMap ($83:C296, JSL, RTL; CODE_83C296 in HM-Decomp). On
 * entering a map: every chicken, cow, the dog and the horse that is on
 * this map gets its event script started (StartScriptAtTileInFront) at its place
 * ($0985/$0987 = where).
 *
 * "On this map" groups the maps: an animal on map m shows on map t when
 *   m 00-03 and t 00-03 (the farm, any season),  m 04-07 and t 04-07,
 *   m 08-0F and t 0C-0F,  m 10-13 and t 10-13,  m 14-17 and t 15-17,
 *   m 31+ and t 31+,  otherwise only m = t.
 * (The horse's test lacks the 14-17 group: a horse on maps 14-17 shows
 * only on that very map.)
 *
 * Chickens (13; skipped if status bit $20): event $24 + n with script
 *   0 (bit $02; then the script's byte [$CC] = 3), 1 (bit $04),
 *   2 (bit $08; $093B + 2n = 0) or $5F; at the record's +4/+6.
 * Cows (12): in the barn (map $27) at their stall ($83:CA44; entry 12 for
 *   a cow with status bits $C0), elsewhere at the record's +8/+A. Event
 *   $18 + n with script 3 (bit $02), 4 (bit $04), or for bit $08: 8 (bit
 *   $40), 7 ($20), 6 ($10), 5 (bit $80, which is then cleared); scripts
 *   $17 / $2F / 9 instead of 3 / 4 / 5 when $0196 bit 1 (rain) is set and
 *   the cow is not in the barn. Then $0953 + 2n = 0.
 * The dog (owned: $7F1F68 bit $80; not while game state bit $0800): event
 *   $16 script $11 at $7F1F2C/2E on map $7F1F30; $7F1F58 = 1, $0938 = 0.
 * The horse (owned: $7F1F68 bit $0100; not while game state bit $0010):
 *   event $17 at (110, 140) on map $7F1F31, script $10 when grown
 *   ($7F1F32 = $15) or $13 as a foal; $0939 = 0.
 * Registers are left as the last path set them (they are compared).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint8_t lda8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
  return v;
}
static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}

/* the map test; the animal's map is loaded again before each compare
 * (from the record with LDY #y_m, or from a fixed address: y_m = NO_Y) */
#define NO_Y 0xFFFF
static bool same_place(HmRegs *r, uint8_t m, uint8_t t, uint16_t y_m, int groups)
{
  static const struct { uint8_t below, lo, hi; } GROUP[5] = {
    { 0x04, 0x00, 0x04 }, { 0x08, 0x04, 0x08 }, { 0x10, 0x0C, 0x10 },
    { 0x14, 0x10, 0x14 }, { 0x18, 0x15, 0x18 } };
  for (int g = 0; g < groups; g++) {
    if (y_m != NO_Y) r->y = y_m;
    lda8(r, m);
    r->c = m >= GROUP[g].below;
    if (m < GROUP[g].below) {
      lda8(r, t);
      if (g > 0) {
        r->c = t >= GROUP[g].lo;
        if (t < GROUP[g].lo) return false;
      }
      r->c = t >= GROUP[g].hi;
      return t < GROUP[g].hi;
    }
  }
  if (y_m != NO_Y) r->y = y_m;
  lda8(r, m);
  r->c = m >= 0x31;
  if (m >= 0x31) {
    lda8(r, t);
    r->c = t >= 0x31;
    return t >= 0x31;
  }
  if (y_m != NO_Y) r->y = y_m;
  lda8(r, m);
  r->c = m >= t;                                         /* CMP $22 */
  return m == t;
}

static uint8_t record8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  return hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, at));
}
static uint16_t record16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  return hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, at));
}
/* LDY #0; LDA [$72]; AND #bit */
static uint8_t status_bit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t bit)
{
  r->y = ANIMAL_STATUS;
  return lda8(r, record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & bit);
}
/* REP; LDA [$72],Y (+x / +y) into $0985 / $0987 */
static void place_from_record(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  r->y = at;     r->a = record16(ram, r, at);     hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, r->a);
  r->y = at + 2; r->a = record16(ram, r, at + 2); hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, r->a);
}
/* TXA; CLC; ADC #base; LDX #0; (LDY script); JSL StartScriptAtTileInFront */
static void start_script(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n, uint16_t base, uint16_t script,
                         uint16_t ret)
{
  r->c = (uint32_t)n + base > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(n + base);
  r->x = 0; r->y = script;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* PLA; PHA; ASL; TAX; STZ base,X (16-bit) */
static void clear_word_of_slot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t base)
{
  uint16_t n = pull16(ram, r);
  push16(ram, r, n);
  r->c = n >> 15;
  r->a = r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 1);
  hm_wr16(ram, (uint16_t)(base + r->x), 0);
}

static void place_chickens(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t map)
{
  for (uint16_t n = 0; n < 13; n++) {
    push16(ram, r, n); push16(ram, r, n);                /* PHX; PHX */
    r->a = r->x = n;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xC2A3, 0x83);
    hm_GetChickenPointer(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    r->x = pull16(ram, r);                               /* PLX */
    if (!status_bit(ram, r, 0x01) || status_bit(ram, r, 0x20)) goto next;
    if (!same_place(r, record8(ram, r, CHICKEN_MAP), map, CHICKEN_MAP, 5)) goto next;
    place_from_record(ram, r, CHICKEN_X);
    if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x02)) {
      start_script(ram, r, r->x, 0x24, 0, 0xC39D);
      r->y = 0;
      lda8(r, 3);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, 0), 3); /* STA [$CC],Y */
    } else if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x04)) {
      start_script(ram, r, r->x, 0x24, 1, 0xC3C6);
    } else if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x08)) {
      start_script(ram, r, r->x, 0x24, 2, 0xC3E4);
      clear_word_of_slot(ram, r, HM_CHICKEN_TIMERS);
    } else {
      start_script(ram, r, r->x, 0x24, 0x5F, 0xC400);
    }
  next:
    r->x = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);               /* PLX; INX */
    r->c = r->x >= 13;
  }
}

/* raining ($0196 bit 1) and the cow not in the barn: the wet script */
static uint16_t cow_script(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t wet, uint16_t dry)
{
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0002;
  if (r->a) {
    r->y = COW_MAP;
    uint8_t m = lda8(r, record8(ram, r, COW_MAP));
    r->c = m >= 0x27;
    if (m != 0x27) return wet;
  }
  return dry;
}

static void place_cows(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t map)
{
  for (uint16_t n = 0; n < 12; n++) {
    push16(ram, r, n); push16(ram, r, n);
    r->a = r->x = n;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xC418, 0x83);
    hm_GetCowPointer(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    r->x = pull16(ram, r);
    if (!status_bit(ram, r, 0x01)) goto next;
    lda8(r, map);
    r->c = map >= 0x27;
    if (map == 0x27) {                                   /* in the barn */
      r->y = COW_MAP;
      uint8_t m = lda8(r, record8(ram, r, COW_MAP));
      r->c = m >= 0x27;
      if (m != 0x27) goto next;
      push16(ram, r, r->x);                              /* PHX */
      uint16_t stall = status_bit(ram, r, 0xC0) ? 12 : r->x;
      r->x = (uint16_t)(stall << 2);
      r->c = (stall >> 14) & 1;                          /* ASL; ASL */
      r->y = COW_X;
      r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, COW_PLACES + r->x);
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, r->a);
      r->x = (uint16_t)(r->x + 2);
      r->y = COW_Y;
      r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, COW_PLACES + r->x);
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, r->a);
      r->x = pull16(ram, r);                             /* PLX */
    } else {
      if (!same_place(r, record8(ram, r, COW_MAP), map, COW_MAP, 5)) goto next;
      place_from_record(ram, r, COW_X);
    }

    uint16_t script, ret;            /* one JSL per branch: its own return */
    if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x02)) {
      script = cow_script(ram, r, 0x17, 3); ret = 0xC565;
    } else if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x04)) {
      script = cow_script(ram, r, 0x2F, 4); ret = 0xC5A9;
    } else if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x08)) {
      ret = 0xC631;
      if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x80)) {
        r->y = ANIMAL_STATUS;
        uint8_t st = lda8(r, record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x7F);
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ANIMAL_STATUS), st);
        script = 5;
      } else if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x40)) script = 8;
      else if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x20)) script = 7;
      else if (status_bit(ram, r, 0x10)) script = 6;
      else script = cow_script(ram, r, 9, 5);
    } else {
      goto next;
    }
    start_script(ram, r, r->x, 0x18, script, ret);
    clear_word_of_slot(ram, r, HM_COW_TIMERS);
  next:
    r->x = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);
    r->c = r->x >= 12;
  }
}

void hm_PlaceAnimalsOnMap(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  place_chickens(ram, r, map);
  place_cows(ram, r, map);

  /* the dog */
  if ((r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_68) & 0x0080)
      && !(r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0800)
      && same_place(r, ram[HM_DOG_MAP], map, NO_Y, 5)) {
    r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_DOG_X); hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, r->a);
    r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_DOG_Y); hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, r->a);
    r->a = 0x0016; r->x = 0; r->y = 0x0011;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xC725, 0x84);
    hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    r->a = 1;
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_DOG_MOOD, 1);
    ram[HM_DOG_TIMER] = 0;
  }

  /* the horse */
  if ((r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_68) & 0x0100)
      && !(r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0010)
      && same_place(r, ram[HM_HORSE_MAP], map, NO_Y, 4)) {
    r->a = 0x0110; hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, 0x0110);
    r->a = 0x0140; hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, 0x0140);
    r->y = 0x0013;
    uint8_t age = lda8(r, ram[HM_HORSE_AGE]);
    r->c = age >= 0x15;
    if (age == 0x15) r->y = 0x0010;                      /* grown */
    r->a = 0x0017; r->x = 0;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xC800, 0x84);
    hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    ram[HM_HORSE_TIMER] = 0;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * UnusedBarnCoopCheck ($83:C9BA, JSL, RTL) and the routine right after its
 * RTL ($83:C9E5): how many chickens (of 13) / cows (of 12) there are, the
 * records whose bit 0 of the first byte is set. Nothing calls them (an early
 * version of the count; the game counts elsewhere).
 * Leftovers: A = Y = the count, X = 13 / 12, C = 1 (CPX).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void count_animals(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t slots, uint16_t ret,
                          void (*pointer)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  uint16_t count = 0;
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x != slots; x++) {
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(count >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)count);  /* PHY */
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(x >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)x);          /* PHX */
    r->a = x;                                                                   /* TXA */
    hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
    pointer(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                                         /* PLX */
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                                         /* PLY */
    if (hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ANIMAL_STATUS)) & 1) count++;
  }
  r->x = slots;
  r->y = count;
  r->a = count;                                                                 /* TYA */
  r->c = 1;
}
void hm_UnusedBarnCoopCheck(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { count_animals(ram, r, 13, 0xC9C8, hm_GetChickenPointer); }
void hm_UnusedBarnCheck(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)     { count_animals(ram, r, 12, 0xC9F3, hm_GetCowPointer); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * StartEnding ($83:F4D8, JSR, RTS; reached with a JMP on summer 30 of year
 * 3, the last day): the start of the ending. Starts event script $2E in
 * slot 0 (StartEventScriptLong), clears $0196 and $7F1F47 and sets
 * $7F1F5E bit 1. The cow the ending shows is the one with the highest
 * byte +04 (affection), the last one on a tie; its name (+0C-+0F) goes to
 * $0889-$088F, one letter per word (all $B1, blank, if there is no cow),
 * and $09B5 = its +04. Then the ranch's development: the farm count
 * (CalculateFarmDevelopment) x 10 / $127 (295 developed tiles = 10 %),
 * at most 100 (%), in $7F1F56.
 * Leftovers: $7E / $80 of the division, A = the percentage, C from the
 * last compare; X = 12, Y and $72-$74 of the last cow and the math.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_StartEnding(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = 0; r->x = 0x002E; r->y = 0;
  call(ram, r, 0xF4E6, 0x84, hm_StartEventScriptLong);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) | 0x0002);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), r->a);
  r->a &= 0xFF00;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_ENDING_STEP), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_FESTIVAL_BEST, 0);
  r->a = 0x00B1;
  for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 4; i++)
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, ((uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_TEXT_NAME) + 2u * i, 0x00B1);
  for (uint16_t cow = 0; cow != 12; cow++) {
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(cow >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)cow);   /* PHX */
    r->a = cow;
    call(ram, r, 0xF521, 0x83, hm_GetCowPointer);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (*field(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x01));
    if (r->a & 0xFF) {
      uint8_t love = *field(ram, r, COW_HAPPINESS);
      uint8_t best = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_FESTIVAL_BEST);
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | love);
      r->c = love >= best;
      if (r->c) {
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_FESTIVAL_BEST, love);
        for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
          r->a = *field(ram, r, (uint8_t)(COW_NAME + i));  /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
          hm_bus_wr16(ram, ((uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_TEXT_NAME) + 2u * i, r->a);
        }
      }
    }
    uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);                           /* PLX */
    r->x = (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
    r->x = (uint16_t)(cow + 1);
    r->c = 1;
  }
  call(ram, r, 0xF57F, 0x82, hm_CalculateFarmDevelopment);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MUL_FACTOR, hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_RANCH_DEVELOPMENT)));
  r->a = 0x000A;
  /* the flags Multiply16 saves (PHP): 16-bit, N = Z = V = 0 (the last
   * ADC of CalculateFarmDevelopment cannot overflow), C = 1 (its last
   * CPY), D and I as on entry */
  uint8_t keep_p = r->p;
  r->p = (uint8_t)((r->p & 0x0C) | 0x01);
  call(ram, r, 0xF58E, 0x83, hm_Multiply16);
  r->p = keep_p;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MUL_FACTOR, r->a);
  r->a = 0x0127;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DIVISOR, 0x0127);
  call(ram, r, 0xF59B, 0x83, hm_DivisionUnsigned);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_RANCH_DEVELOPMENT), r->a);
  r->c = r->a >= 0x0064;
  if (r->c) { r->a = 0x0064; hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_RANCH_DEVELOPMENT), 0x0064); }
}

```

`src/audio.c`:

```c
/*
 * audio.c — talking to the sound chip (the SPC700, see GUIDE.md 2.7).
 *
 * The SNES's sound runs on its own processor; the main CPU only sees four
 * one-byte "ports" ($2140-$2143, APUIO0-3) shared with it. The game's
 * protocol, as these routines use it:
 *
 *   1. wait until port 3 reads the same twice in a row (the other
 *      processor may be changing it) and then reads 1: "ready";
 *   2. write the command in ports 0-2 and 2 in port 3: "here it is";
 *   3. wait until port 3 reads 4 (simple commands) or 8 (commands with
 *      arguments): "done";
 *   4. write 0 in port 3.
 *
 * Command $0A plays a sound effect: $0114-$0116 = its arguments (a letter
 * of text sets them to 3, 6, $0A). $0B with an argument in A, $0C alone.
 * Before sending, PlaySoundEffect asks (port 0 bit 4) whether the chip is busy
 * and, if so, drops the sound.
 *
 * The ports are addressed with the data bank (STA.W $2140), as the original.
 * The checker replays what the chip answered (see g_hm_apu in hm_decomp.h).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* Direct page */
#define DATA_PTR          0x0A   /* 24b $0A-$0C: the bytes being sent to the chip */
#define DATA_PTR_BANK     0x0C   /* 8b: DATA_PTR's bank */
#define SOUND_COMMAND     0x92   /* 8b: the command SoundStartCommand sends */
#define STEADY_READ       0x93   /* 8b: the first of two reads of port 3 */
#define SOUND_ARG         0x94   /* 8b: the command's argument / the instrument being sent */
#define LIST_END          0x84   /* 16b: LoadSongInstruments: where the song's list ends */
/* $7E and $80 mean a different thing in each routine: */
#define MATH_FACTOR       0x7E   /* 16b: Multiply16's second factor */
#define DIVIDEND          0x7E   /* 16b: DivisionUnsigned's dividend, then the remainder */
#define DIVISOR           0x80   /* 16b: DivisionUnsigned's divisor */
#define GROUP_COUNT       0x80   /* 16b: groups_of_3's result (DIVISOR before) */
#define SONG_LIST         0x7E   /* 16b: PickMapMusic: the map's list of four songs */

/* WRAM of the data bank (through db_addr / rd8) */
#define INSTRUMENTS       0x0104   /* 11 bytes $0104-$010E: the instruments sent to the chip */
#define SONG_INSTRUMENT_COUNT 0x010F /* 8b: how many of them the song brought */
#define SONG_ARG          0x0111   /* 8b: command $08's first argument */
#define FADE_ARG          0x0112   /* 8b: command $09's first argument */
#define SONG_SPEED        0x0113   /* 8b: the second argument of commands $08 / $09 */
#define SOUND_PARAM       0x0116   /* 8b: its third argument */

/* ROM */
#define SOUND_DATA        0xB2D120 /* the sound program's data ($3F2 bytes) */

static uint32_t db_addr(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t addr) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | addr; }
static uint8_t port(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, int n) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(APUIO0 + n))); }
static void set_port(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, int n, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(APUIO0 + n)), v); }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, a)); }

static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(ret >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
}

/* "LDA $2143; STA $93; LDA $2143; CMP $93; BNE": until port 3 reads the
 * same twice in a row. */
static void wait_steady(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t second;
  do {
    *hm_dp(ram, r, STEADY_READ) = port(ram, r, 3);
    second = port(ram, r, 3);
  } while (second != *hm_dp(ram, r, STEADY_READ));
}
/* Steady, then a third read must be `v`; if not, start over. */
static void wait_steady_then(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t v)
{
  do wait_steady(ram, r); while (port(ram, r, 3) != v);
}
/* Write a command: ports 0-2, then 2 in port 3. */
static void send(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t p0, uint8_t p1, uint8_t p2)
{
  set_port(ram, r, 0, p0);
  set_port(ram, r, 1, p1);
  set_port(ram, r, 2, p2);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 2);
}
/* The 8-bit A a routine leaves: its low byte, the high byte untouched. */
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SoundChipBusy ($83:8EE4, JSR, RTS): waits for "ready" and returns
 * A = port 0 & $10 (nonzero: the chip is busy). C = 1 (from CMP).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SoundChipBusy(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  set_a8(r, port(ram, r, 0) & 0x10);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SoundChipBusyOrPlaying ($83:8EC9, JSR, RTS): the same with A = port 0 & $11.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SoundChipBusyOrPlaying(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  set_a8(r, port(ram, r, 0) & 0x11);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SoundStartCommand ($83:8E8B, JSR, RTS): sends the simple command $92 (ports
 * 1-2 = 0) and waits for "done" (4). Unlike the others, after the first
 * steady read it only waits for 1 (it does not check steadiness again).
 * Leftovers: A = 4 (the last read), C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SoundStartCommand(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wait_steady(ram, r);
  while (port(ram, r, 3) != 1) {}
  send(ram, r, *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND), 0, 0);
  wait_steady(ram, r);
  while (port(ram, r, 3) != 4) {}
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  set_a8(r, 4);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PlaySoundEffect ($83:8DDF, JSL, RTL): play sound effect $0114-$0116. If the
 * chip is busy (SoundChipBusy), nothing. Otherwise it sends command $0A
 * (SoundStartCommand), then the three arguments, and waits for "done" (8).
 * Leftovers: A = 8, C = 1; or those of SoundChipBusy.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_DDF_READY   0x8DE1
#define RET_DDF_COMMAND 0x8DEC

void hm_PlaySoundEffect(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  jsr(ram, r, RET_DDF_READY, hm_SoundChipBusy);
  if (r->a & 0xFF) return;                            /* busy */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x0A;
  jsr(ram, r, RET_DDF_COMMAND, hm_SoundStartCommand);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  send(ram, r, rd8(ram, r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT), rd8(ram, r, HM_SOUND_BANK), rd8(ram, r, SOUND_PARAM));
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 8);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  set_a8(r, 8);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PlaySoundEffect0A ($83:8332, JSL, RTL): PlaySoundEffect with $0116 = $0A.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_332_SOUND   0x833C

void hm_PlaySoundEffect0A(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_a8(r, 0x0A);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, SOUND_PARAM), 0x0A);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_332_SOUND, 0x83);
  hm_PlaySoundEffect(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SoundCommand0C ($83:8E7F, JSL, RTL): sends command $0C.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_E7F_COMMAND 0x8E89

void hm_SoundCommand0C(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_a8(r, 0x0C);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x0C;
  jsr(ram, r, RET_E7F_COMMAND, hm_SoundStartCommand);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SoundCommand0B ($83:8E32, JSL, RTL): A (low byte) = argument. Sends command
 * $0B, then the argument in port 0, and waits for "done" (8).
 * $94 = the argument. Leftovers: A = 8, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_E32_COMMAND 0x8E3E

void hm_SoundCommand0B(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG) = (uint8_t)r->a;
  set_a8(r, 0x0B);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x0B;
  jsr(ram, r, RET_E32_COMMAND, hm_SoundStartCommand);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  send(ram, r, *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG), 0, 0);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 8);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  set_a8(r, 8);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The music. $0110 = the song wanted, $0117 = the one playing. Command $09
 * (SoundCommand09IfBusy) and $08 (SoundCommand08) take two arguments, $07
 * (SoundCommand07) and $04 (DropInstrumentsFrom) one.
 *
 * SoundCommand09IfBusy ($83:8D8B, JSL, RTL): command $09 with $0112 / $0113. Only
 * when SoundChipBusyOrPlaying says the chip is busy (port 0 & $11 not 0); otherwise it
 * returns at once.
 * Leftovers: A = 8 and C = 1 when sent; SoundChipBusyOrPlaying's otherwise.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_D8B_BUSY    0x8D8F
#define RET_D8B_COMMAND 0x8D9A

void hm_SoundCommand09IfBusy(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  jsr(ram, r, RET_D8B_BUSY, hm_SoundChipBusyOrPlaying);
  if ((r->a & 0xFF) == 0) return;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x09;
  jsr(ram, r, RET_D8B_COMMAND, hm_SoundStartCommand);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  send(ram, r, rd8(ram, r, FADE_ARG), rd8(ram, r, SONG_SPEED), 0);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 8);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  set_a8(r, 8);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SoundCommand07 ($83:8CF3, JSL, RTL): sends command $07 by itself (without
 * SoundStartCommand) and waits for 4. A is kept in $94 but never sent.
 * Leftovers: A = 4, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SoundCommand07(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG) = (uint8_t)r->a;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x07;
  wait_steady(ram, r);
  while (port(ram, r, 3) != 1) {}
  send(ram, r, 0x07, 0, 0);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 4);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  set_a8(r, 4);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SoundCommand08 ($83:8D39, JSL, RTL; HM-Decomp says $83:8D38, the RTL of
 * SoundCommand07): waits while the chip is busy, then command $08 with
 * $0111 / $0113. Leftovers: A = 8, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_D39_BUSY    0x8D3B
#define RET_D39_COMMAND 0x8D46

void hm_SoundCommand08(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  do jsr(ram, r, RET_D39_BUSY, hm_SoundChipBusyOrPlaying); while (r->a & 0xFF);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x08;
  jsr(ram, r, RET_D39_COMMAND, hm_SoundStartCommand);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  send(ram, r, rd8(ram, r, SONG_ARG), rd8(ram, r, SONG_SPEED), 0);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 8);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  set_a8(r, 8);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DropInstrumentsFrom ($83:89C7, JSL, RTL): A = n. Command $04 with n (when n is
 * 0 it first waits until the chip is not busy), then clears $0104 + n up to
 * $010E. Unlike the others, the final wait for 8 is a plain loop (no
 * "same twice" check).
 * Leftovers: $94 = n, A = 0, X = $0B, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_9C7_BUSY    0x89D2
#define RET_9C7_COMMAND 0x89DD

void hm_DropInstrumentsFrom(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)r->a;
  hm_push8(ram, r, n);                                       /* PHA */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG) = n;
  if (n == 0)
    do jsr(ram, r, RET_9C7_BUSY, hm_SoundChipBusyOrPlaying); while (r->a & 0xFF);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x04;
  jsr(ram, r, RET_9C7_COMMAND, hm_SoundStartCommand);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  send(ram, r, n, 0, 0);
  while (port(ram, r, 3) != 8) {}
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  hm_pull8(ram, r);                                          /* PLA */
  for (uint16_t x = n; x != 0x0B; x++) hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(INSTRUMENTS + x)), 0);
  r->a = 0;
  r->x = 0x0B;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * When the song changes ($0110 != $0117 and something is playing):
 * FadeOutSong ($83:841F) sends command $09 with 1, $10; FadeOutSongSlowly
 * ($83:8401) with 1, $40 (its "nothing playing" branch jumps to the RTL
 * of the routine before it, $83:8400). StartSong ($83:8380): if the new
 * song is not 0, $FF nor the one playing, command $08 with 1, $40; then
 * $0119 = 0. All JSL, RTL.
 * Leftovers: A's low byte = the last value compared, C from the compare,
 * or those of SoundCommand09IfBusy / SoundCommand08.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void change_song(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t speed, uint16_t ret)
{
  uint8_t want = rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG), playing = rd8(ram, r, HM_PLAYING_SONG);
  set_a8(r, want);
  r->c = want >= playing;
  if (want == playing) return;
  set_a8(r, playing);
  if (playing == 0) return;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, FADE_ARG), 0x01);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, SONG_SPEED), speed);
  set_a8(r, speed);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
  hm_SoundCommand09IfBusy(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
void hm_FadeOutSong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { change_song(ram, r, 0x10, 0x843B); }
void hm_FadeOutSongSlowly(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { change_song(ram, r, 0x40, 0x841D); }

void hm_StartSong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t want = rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG), playing = rd8(ram, r, HM_PLAYING_SONG);
  set_a8(r, want);
  if (want != 0) {
    r->c = want >= playing;
    if (want != playing) {
      r->c = want == 0xFF;                                   /* CMP #$FF */
      if (want != 0xFF) {
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, SONG_ARG), 0x01);
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, SONG_SPEED), 0x40);
        set_a8(r, 0x40);
        hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x839D, 0x83);
        hm_SoundCommand08(ram, r);
        hm_rtl(ram, r);
      }
    }
  }
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_LOADED_TOOL_SOUND), 0);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Uploads: the instruments (samples) and the songs travel to the chip 3
 * bytes at a time; after each group the CPU waits for port 3 = 0, clears
 * it and waits for 1 again.
 *
 *   UNK_Audio_Table3 ($83:90EF)  10 bytes per instrument (40): a word for
 *                                the first command, 3 + 2 bytes for the
 *                                next two, a long pointer to the samples
 *   UNK_Audio_Table5 ($83:8EFF)  the size of each instrument's samples
 *   UNK_Audio_Table6 ($83:8F83)  14 bytes per song (26): a long pointer to
 *                                its data, then its 11 instruments (0 =
 *                                none)
 *   UNK_Audio_Table7 ($83:8F4F)  the size of each song's data
 *   UNK_Audio_Table2 ($83:927F)  the instrument of each sound effect
 *   UNK_Audio_Table4 ($83:92B1)  the 10 instruments always loaded
 * Sizes are in bytes; they are sent as a count of 3-byte groups (rounded
 * up, with DivisionUnsigned).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define AUDIO_TABLE2 0x83927F
#define AUDIO_TABLE3 0x8390EF
#define AUDIO_TABLE4 0x8392B1
#define AUDIO_TABLE5 0x838EFF
#define AUDIO_TABLE6 0x838F83
#define AUDIO_TABLE7 0x838F4F

static uint8_t rom8(uint8_t *ram, uint32_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, a & 0xFFFFFF); }
static uint16_t rom16(uint8_t *ram, uint32_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, a & 0xFFFFFF); }
static void jsl83(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* A x $7E with Multiply16 (JSL), from 16-bit code right after LDA #k:
 * its PHP saves the flags of that moment: C = 1 (every caller has just
 * compared equal), N = Z = 0, 16-bit A / X, and V, D, I as they came in. */
static void times(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  r->c = 1;
  r->p = (uint8_t)((entry & 0x4C) | 0x01);
  jsl83(ram, r, ret, hm_Multiply16);
  r->p = entry;
}
/* bytes -> groups of 3, rounded up: $80 (DivisionUnsigned leaves Y = 0) */
static uint16_t groups_of_3(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bytes, uint16_t ret)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DIVIDEND, bytes);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DIVISOR, 3);
  jsl83(ram, r, ret, hm_DivisionUnsigned);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, GROUP_COUNT, r->a);
  if (hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DIVIDEND)) hm_dp_w16(ram, r, GROUP_COUNT, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, GROUP_COUNT) + 1));
  return hm_dp_r16(ram, r, GROUP_COUNT);
}
/* after a command's group: "done" (4), clear, then "ready" again */
static void next_group(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 4);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  wait_steady(ram, r);
  while (port(ram, r, 3) != 1) {}
}
/* 3 bytes from [$0A],Y */
static void send_3(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t b[3];
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) b[i] = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DATA_PTR, (uint16_t)(r->y + i)));
  r->y = (uint16_t)(r->y + 3);
  r->x = (uint16_t)(r->x - 1);
  send(ram, r, b[0], b[1], b[2]);
}

/* Instrument $94, its command already sent and answered: the three
 * header groups from Table3, the count, then the samples. Leftovers: $0A-$0C
 * = the samples, $80 = the count; A = count's low byte : 1, X = 0, Y =
 * 3 count, C = 1. */
static void send_instrument(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret_times, uint16_t ret_divide)
{
  uint8_t ins = *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MATH_FACTOR, ins);
  r->a = 0x000A;
  times(ram, r, ret_times);                                /* X = 10 ins */
  uint16_t x = r->a;
  uint16_t w = rom16(ram, AUDIO_TABLE3 + x);
  send(ram, r, ins, (uint8_t)w, (uint8_t)(w >> 8));
  x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
  next_group(ram, r);
  send(ram, r, rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE3 + x), rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE3 + x + 1), rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE3 + x + 2));
  x = (uint16_t)(x + 3);
  next_group(ram, r);
  send(ram, r, rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE3 + x), rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE3 + x + 1), 0);
  x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
  next_group(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DATA_PTR, rom16(ram, AUDIO_TABLE3 + x));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DATA_PTR_BANK) = rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE3 + x + 2);
  uint16_t count = groups_of_3(ram, r, rom16(ram, AUDIO_TABLE5 + (uint8_t)(ins << 1)), ret_divide);
  r->x = count;
  send(ram, r, (uint8_t)count, (uint8_t)(count >> 8), 0);
  r->y = 0;
  next_group(ram, r);
  do {
    send_3(ram, r);
    wait_steady_then(ram, r, 0);
    set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
    wait_steady(ram, r);
    while (port(ram, r, 3) != 1) {}
  } while (r->x != 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((count & 0xFF) << 8 | 1);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * LoadEffectInstrument ($83:8AFF, JSL, RTL): command $03, the instrument of sound
 * effect $0114 (Table2), noted in $0104 + $0103 ($0103 counts them).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_LoadEffectInstrument(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->x = 0;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x03;
  jsr(ram, r, 0x8B0C, hm_SoundStartCommand);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t ins = rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE2 + rd8(ram, r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG) = ins;
  uint8_t n = rd8(ram, r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(INSTRUMENTS + n)), ins);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), (uint8_t)(n + 1));
  send_instrument(ram, r, 0x8B4A, 0x8C54);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * LoadSongInstruments ($83:878C, JSL, RTL): the instruments of song $0110 (its 11 in
 * Table6, skipping the 0s), each with command $03, noted in $0104-$010E;
 * $0103 and $010F count them. Quirk: when the list ends with 0s,
 * instrument 6 is sent as well (and not noted).
 * Leftovers: $84 = where the list ends, X = $84, Y = how many were sent,
 * A from the last instrument, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_LoadSongInstruments(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, SONG_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), 0);
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x != 0x0B; x++) hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(INSTRUMENTS + x)), 0);
  r->y = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MATH_FACTOR, rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG));
  r->a = 0x000E;
  times(ram, r, 0x87B5);
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)(r->a + 3);
  uint16_t end = (uint16_t)(r->a + 0x0E);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LIST_END, end);
  for (;;) {
    uint8_t ins = rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE6 + x);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG) = ins;
    if (ins) {
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(INSTRUMENTS + r->y)), ins);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT) + 1));
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, SONG_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, SONG_INSTRUMENT_COUNT) + 1));
    } else {
      do x++; while (x != end && rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE6 + x) == 0);
      if (x != end) continue;                              /* found one: back to the top */
      *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG) = 0x06;
      x--;
    }
    r->x = x;
    *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x03;
    jsr(ram, r, 0x87EF, hm_SoundStartCommand);
    wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
    uint16_t y = r->y;
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(x >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)x);   /* PHX; PHY */
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(y >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)y);
    send_instrument(ram, r, 0x8816, 0x8920);
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
    x = (uint16_t)(x + 1);
    r->y = (uint16_t)(y + 1);
    r->x = x;
    if (x == end) break;
  }
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * LoadDefaultInstruments ($83:8598, JSL, RTL): the 10 instruments of Table4 (0 =
 * skip), each with command $02. Leftovers: X = 10, A from the last one
 * sent (or Table4's last 0), C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_LoadDefaultInstruments(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x != 0x0A; x++) {
    uint8_t ins = rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE4 + x);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_ARG) = ins;
    set_a8(r, ins);
    r->x = x;
    if (!ins) continue;
    *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x02;
    jsr(ram, r, 0x85B8, hm_SoundStartCommand);
    wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(x >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)x);   /* PHX */
    send_instrument(ram, r, 0x85DE, 0x86E8);
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
  }
  r->x = 0x0A;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SendSongData ($83:8A26, JSL, RTL): command $05, the data of song $0110
 * (Table6's pointer, Table7's size). The wait for the count's "done" is a
 * plain loop, and each group starts by clearing port 3.
 * Leftovers: A = the count's high byte : 0, X = 0, Y = 3 count, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SendSongData(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x05;
  jsr(ram, r, 0x8A30, hm_SoundStartCommand);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t song = rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG);
  uint16_t count = groups_of_3(ram, r, rom16(ram, AUDIO_TABLE7 + (uint8_t)(song << 1)), 0x8A5E);
  send(ram, r, (uint8_t)count, (uint8_t)(count >> 8), 0);
  while (port(ram, r, 3) != 4) {}
  r->y = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MATH_FACTOR, song);
  r->a = 0x000E;
  times(ram, r, 0x8A98);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DATA_PTR, rom16(ram, AUDIO_TABLE6 + r->a));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DATA_PTR_BANK) = rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE6 + (uint16_t)(r->a + 2));
  r->x = count;
  do {
    set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
    wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
    send_3(ram, r);
    wait_steady_then(ram, r, 0);
    set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  } while (r->x != 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(count & 0xFF00);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SendSoundData ($83:84D3, JSL, RTL): command $01, then $3F2 bytes from
 * $B2:D120 (the sound program's data). Here each group waits for "ready"
 * with the full check and nothing waits after the last one.
 * Leftovers: A = the count's high byte : 0, X = 0, Y = 3 count, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SendSoundData(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOUND_COMMAND) = 0x01;
  jsr(ram, r, 0x84DD, hm_SoundStartCommand);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
  uint16_t count = groups_of_3(ram, r, 0x03F2, 0x8502);
  send(ram, r, (uint8_t)count, (uint8_t)(count >> 8), 0);
  wait_steady_then(ram, r, 4);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  r->y = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DATA_PTR, (uint16_t)SOUND_DATA);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DATA_PTR_BANK) = (uint8_t)(SOUND_DATA >> 16);
  r->x = count;
  do {
    wait_steady_then(ram, r, 1);
    send_3(ram, r);
    wait_steady_then(ram, r, 0);
    set_port(ram, r, 3, 0);
  } while (r->x != 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(count & 0xFF00);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PickMapMusic ($80:95DE, JSL, RTL): which music the map being entered ($22)
 * asks for, into $0110:
 *   - from 6 pm (hour 18) on, none ($FF), except on map $1E;
 *   - $0196 bit 4: song $16; else $0196 bit 1: maps $57-$5A none (0),
 *     $31-$56 song $13, $15-$30 song $14, below $15 song $13, and from $5B
 *     on, as normal;
 *   - normally the map's entry in Mayby_Table_AudioTracksbySeason
 *     ($80:B8E7, one word per map: $FFFF = none, 0 stays in $0110), a list
 *     of four songs, one per season (read with the data bank).
 * Leftovers: A, X, Y and C as each way out leaves them (see the code).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define TRACKS_BY_MAP 0x80B8E7

void hm_PickMapMusic(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 0x1E;
  if (map != 0x1E) {
    uint8_t hour = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR));
    set_a8(r, hour);
    r->c = hour >= 18;
    if (r->c) {                                       /* Max7E0110 */
      set_a8(r, 0xFF);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WANTED_SONG), 0xFF);
      return;
    }
  }
  hm_PickMapMusicAnyHour(ram, r);
}
/* $80:95F5, PickMapMusic past its 6 pm test (NightReset calls it there: the
 * new day's music even at night) */
void hm_PickMapMusicAnyHour(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WANTED_SONG), 0);
  uint16_t flags = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS));
  if (flags & 0x0010) {
    r->a = 0x0016;
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WANTED_SONG), 0x16);
    return;
  }
  r->a = flags & 0x0002;
  if (r->a) {
    r->a = map;
    r->c = map >= 0x5B;
    if (!r->c) {
      r->c = map >= 0x57;
      if (r->c) return;
      uint8_t song = 0x13;
      r->c = map >= 0x31;
      if (!r->c) { r->c = map >= 0x15; if (r->c) song = 0x14; }
      r->a = song;
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WANTED_SONG), song);
      return;
    }
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(map << 1);                        /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA; ASL */
  r->c = 0;
  r->x = r->a;
  uint16_t list = hm_bus_rd16(ram, TRACKS_BY_MAP + r->x);
  r->a = list;
  r->c = list == 0xFFFF;                              /* CMP #$FFFF */
  if (list == 0xFFFF) return;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SONG_LIST, list);
  uint8_t season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
  r->y = season;
  uint8_t song = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (db_addr(r, list) + season) & 0xFFFFFF);   /* LDA ($7E),Y */
  r->a = song;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WANTED_SONG), song);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * UploadSoundProgram ($83:843D, JSL, RTL; at power-on, from RESET): the sound
 * program goes to the chip with the protocol of its boot ROM (the "IPL"):
 *   1. wait until ports 0-1 read $BBAA (the chip is waiting);
 *   2. the block's address ($0500) in ports 2-3, 1 in port 1 ("data
 *      follows"), $CC in port 0; wait for the $CC back;
 *   3. $FD6 bytes from [$0A] (the caller gives $AD:8000): each byte in
 *      port 1 and its index (0, 1, 2... wrapping at $FF) in port 0, with
 *      one 16-bit store (which writes port 1 first), each once the chip
 *      echoed the previous index;
 *   4. the address $0500 again, 0 in port 1 ("run it") and in port 0 the
 *      last index + 4 (4 if that wraps to 0); wait for its echo.
 * The original loops back to 3 while an overflow (V) says another block
 * follows, but its second header is built with X = 0, which never sets
 * it: there is only one block.
 * Leftovers: A = the last value of port 0 (high byte 0), X = 0, Y = $FD6,
 * the flags as they were (PHP / PLP); the stack below keeps the PHA'd
 * values.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define IPL_BLOCK_SIZE 0x0FD6
#define IPL_ADDRESS    0x0500

/* CMP $2140 (8-bit) until port 0 reads v */
static void wait_echo(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t v)
{
  while (port(ram, r, 0) != v) {}
}

void hm_UploadSoundProgram(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t flags = r->p;
  hm_push8(ram, r, flags);                                    /* PHP */
  r->y = 0;
  for (;;) {                                                  /* CMP $2140 (16-bit) */
    uint8_t lo = port(ram, r, 0), hi = port(ram, r, 1);
    if (lo == 0xAA && hi == 0xBB) break;
  }
  hm_push8(ram, r, 0xCC);                                     /* PHA */
  set_port(ram, r, 2, (uint8_t)IPL_ADDRESS);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, (uint8_t)(IPL_ADDRESS >> 8));
  set_port(ram, r, 1, 1);                                     /* CPX #1; ROL: data follows */
  hm_pull8(ram, r);                                           /* PLA */
  set_port(ram, r, 0, 0xCC);
  wait_echo(ram, r, 0xCC);

  uint8_t index = 0;
  for (uint16_t left = IPL_BLOCK_SIZE; left; left--) {
    uint8_t byte = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DATA_PTR, r->y));
    r->y++;
    if (left != IPL_BLOCK_SIZE) {
      wait_echo(ram, r, index);
      index++;
    }
    set_port(ram, r, 1, byte);                                /* STA $2140 (16-bit): */
    set_port(ram, r, 0, index);                               /* $2141 goes first */
  }
  wait_echo(ram, r, index);
  uint8_t start = (uint8_t)(index + 4);                       /* ADC #3 after CMP (C = 1) */
  if (start == 0) start = 4;                                  /* again: 0 + 3 + the carry */
  hm_push8(ram, r, start);                                    /* PHA */
  r->x = 0;
  set_port(ram, r, 2, (uint8_t)IPL_ADDRESS);
  set_port(ram, r, 3, (uint8_t)(IPL_ADDRESS >> 8));
  set_port(ram, r, 1, 0);                                     /* run it */
  hm_pull8(ram, r);                                           /* PLA */
  set_port(ram, r, 0, start);
```
