```c
  wait_echo(ram, r, start);
  r->a = start;
  hm_pull8(ram, r);                                           /* PLP */
  r->c = flags & 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * UnusedCountInstrument ($83:8376, JSL, RTL; nothing calls it): one more instrument
 * noted, $0103 + 1 (the count LoadDefaultInstruments and LoadSongInstruments keep).
 * Leftovers: A's low byte = the new count; X, Y, C untouched.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_UnusedCountInstrument(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT) + 1);
  set_a8(r, n);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), n);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PrepareSoundEffect ($83:833E, JSL, RTL): a sound effect, $0114. If the
 * instrument slot $0104 + $0103 is taken, the instruments from $0103 + 1
 * on are dropped first (DropInstrumentsFrom) and a frame is waited (WaitForNMI);
 * then, if the effect has an instrument (Table2), it is sent
 * (LoadEffectInstrument).
 * WaitForNMI saves the flags: there they are those DropInstrumentsFrom leaves
 * (8-bit A, 16-bit indexes, Z and C set, N clear) with V, D and I of the
 * entry.
 * Leftovers: those of LoadEffectInstrument, or A = 0 and X = $0114 (C as it was, or
 * 1 after DropInstrumentsFrom).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PrepareSoundEffect(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT);                 /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $0103 */
  r->x = r->a;                                             /* TAX */
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(INSTRUMENTS + r->x)));
  if ((uint8_t)r->a) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(r->x + 1);                           /* TXA; INC A */
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8359, 0x83);
    hm_DropInstrumentsFrom(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    r->p = (uint8_t)((entry & 0x4C) | 0x23);
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x835D, 0x80);
    hm_WaitForNMI(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    r->p = entry;
  }
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT);                     /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $0114 */
  r->x = r->a;
  set_a8(r, rom8(ram, AUDIO_TABLE2 + r->x));
  if (!(uint8_t)r->a) return;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8374, 0x83);
  hm_LoadEffectInstrument(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* JSL to a routine of bank $83 (`ret` = the JSL's last byte) */
static void call83(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* JSL WaitForNMIATimes with the flags `p` (it saves them) */
static void wait_frames(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, uint8_t p)
{
  uint8_t keep = r->p;
  r->p = p;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x80);
  hm_WaitForNMIATimes(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->p = keep;
}
/* the flags after a 16-bit load of `a` (REP #$30): N, Z, the carry `c`,
 * and V, D, I of `p` */
static uint8_t flags16(uint8_t p, uint16_t a, uint8_t c)
{
  return (uint8_t)((p & 0x4C) | (a & 0x8000 ? 0x80 : 0) | (a ? 0 : 0x02) | (c & 1));
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SetSong ($83:83A4, JSL, RTL): the song changes to $0110. If it is
 * not the one playing ($0117): the instruments from 0 on are dropped
 * (DropInstrumentsFrom with 0, which first waits until the chip is not busy) and,
 * unless the song is 0 or $FF, the song is sent (SendSongData) with its
 * instruments (LoadSongInstruments). Then the sound effect 3 of bank 6 with the
 * song's instrument ($0118 = the song, 0 for $FF; $0103 from the table
 * $80:B8CD), PrepareSoundEffect.
 * The bytes $83:83C9-$83:83CF (clear $0110) are never reached.
 * PrepareSoundEffect keeps V, D and I of its entry flags: V is 0 after
 * LoadSongInstruments (its ADC), as it was otherwise.
 * Leftovers: those of PrepareSoundEffect.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define SONG_INSTRUMENTS 0x80B8CD

void hm_SetSong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p, p = entry;
  uint8_t want = rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG), playing = rd8(ram, r, HM_PLAYING_SONG);
  set_a8(r, want);
  r->c = want >= playing;
  if (want != playing) {
    set_a8(r, 0);
    call83(ram, r, 0x83B3, hm_DropInstrumentsFrom);
    uint8_t v = rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG);
    set_a8(r, v);
    if (v) {
      r->c = v >= 0xFF;
      if (v != 0xFF) {
        call83(ram, r, 0x83C2, hm_SendSongData);
        call83(ram, r, 0x83C6, hm_LoadSongInstruments);
        p &= (uint8_t)~0x40;
      }
    }
  }
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_SOUND_BANK), 0x06);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT), 0x03);
  uint8_t song = rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG);
  r->a = song;                                               /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_SONG_LOADED), song);
  r->c = song >= 0xFF;
  if (song == 0xFF) {
    set_a8(r, 0);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_SONG_LOADED), 0);
  }
  r->x = r->a;                                               /* TAX */
  set_a8(r, rom8(ram, SONG_INSTRUMENTS + r->x));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), (uint8_t)r->a);
  r->p = p;
  call83(ram, r, 0x83FF, hm_PrepareSoundEffect);
  r->p = entry;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PlayEffectWithSongInstrument ($83:82FE, JSL, RTL): sound effect A of bank X with the
 * instrument of the song playing ($0118: table $80:B8CD + 1), PrepareSoundEffect,
 * played (PlaySoundEffect0A); then Y frames are waited (WaitForNMIATimes; Y = 0
 * would be 65536).
 * Leftovers: A = 0, Y as it came, X from PlaySoundEffect0A, the flags of
 * WaitForNMIATimes's entry (PLP): 16-bit, N and Z of Y, the carry of
 * PlaySoundEffect0A.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayEffectWithSongInstrument(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT), (uint8_t)r->a); /* SEP #$20; REP #$10 */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(r->y >> 8));                    /* PHY */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)r->y);
  r->a = r->x;                                               /* REP #$20; TXA */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_SOUND_BANK), (uint8_t)r->a);
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, HM_SONG_LOADED);
  r->x = r->a;
  set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(rom8(ram, SONG_INSTRUMENTS + r->x) + 1));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), (uint8_t)r->a);
  call83(ram, r, 0x8324, hm_PrepareSoundEffect);
  call83(ram, r, 0x8328, hm_PlaySoundEffect0A);
  uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);                             /* REP #$30; PLY; TYA */
  r->y = (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
  r->a = r->y;
  wait_frames(ram, r, 0x8330, flags16(entry, r->a, r->c));
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ChangeMusic ($83:82C6, JSL, RTL): the music changes to song A: the old
 * one fades (FadeOutSong), the new one is set ($0110, SetSong,
 * StartSong) and noted as playing ($0117); after 180 frames
 * (WaitForNMIATimes $B4) the music of the map being entered ($098B, to
 * $22) is chosen (PickMapMusic) and faded in (FadeOutSongSlowly).
 * Leftovers: those of FadeOutSongSlowly.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ChangeMusic(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p, p = entry;
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)r->a);                           /* SEP #$20; REP #$10; PHA */
  call83(ram, r, 0x82CE, hm_FadeOutSong);
  set_a8(r, hm_pull8(ram, r));                               /* PLA */
  uint8_t song = (uint8_t)r->a;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WANTED_SONG), song);
  /* SetSong sends the song (and its ADC clears V) when it changes */
  if (song != rd8(ram, r, HM_PLAYING_SONG) && song != 0 && song != 0xFF) p &= (uint8_t)~0x40;
  call83(ram, r, 0x82D8, hm_SetSong);
  call83(ram, r, 0x82DC, hm_StartSong);
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_PLAYING_SONG), (uint8_t)r->a);
  r->a = 0x00B4;                                             /* REP #$30; LDA #$B4 */
  uint8_t pw = flags16(p, r->a, r->c);
  wait_frames(ram, r, 0x82ED, pw);
  uint8_t map = rd8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP);              /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, map);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID) = map;
  r->p = (uint8_t)((pw & ~0x82) | 0x20 | (map & 0x80) | (map ? 0 : 0x02));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x82F8, 0x80);
  hm_PickMapMusic(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  call83(ram, r, 0x82FC, hm_FadeOutSongSlowly);
  r->p = entry;
}
```

`src/calendar.c`:

```c
/*
 * calendar.c — the date shown on screen.
 *
 * LoadDateNames ($82:89D6, JSL, RTL). Copies the names for today into the
 * text buffers the diary and the calendar print (16-bit text codes, see
 * people.c): the season ($08B3, 6 codes, from the ROM table $82:8AD9, 16
 * bytes per season), the weekday ($08BF, 9 codes, $82:8B19, 32 bytes per
 * day) and the day's ordinal suffix ($08D1, 2 codes, $82:8BF9).
 *
 * Quirk: the suffix is "st", "nd", "rd" only for days 1, 2 and 3; every
 * other day gets "th" — so the game says 21th, 22th and 23th.
 *
 * Leftovers: X = the last table offset read, A = the last code, C from the
 * day comparisons.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* ROM tables of text codes */
#define SEASON_NAMES    0x828AD9  /* 16 bytes per season */
#define WEEKDAY_NAMES   0x828B19  /* 32 bytes per weekday */
#define ORDINAL_NAMES   0x828BF9  /* 4 bytes per suffix: st, nd, rd, th */

/* The text buffers (data bank WRAM) */
#define WEEKDAY_TEXT    0x008BF   /* 9 x 16b */
#define ORDINAL_TEXT    0x008D1   /* 2 x 16b */

/* Copies `n` words from table + x; leaves X/A as the original's INX pairs. */
static void copy_text(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t table, uint16_t x, uint32_t to, int n)
{
  for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
    if (k) x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, table + x);
    hm_wr16(ram, to + 2u * k, r->a);
  }
  r->x = x;
}

void hm_LoadDateNames(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  copy_text(ram, r, SEASON_NAMES, (uint16_t)(ram[HM_SEASON] << 4), HM_SEASON_TEXT, 6);
  copy_text(ram, r, WEEKDAY_NAMES, (uint16_t)(ram[HM_WEEKDAY] << 5), WEEKDAY_TEXT, 9);

  uint8_t day = ram[HM_DAY];
  uint16_t x;
  if (day == 1)      { x = 0; r->c = 1; }
  else if (day == 2) { x = 4; r->c = 1; }
  else if (day == 3) { x = 8; r->c = 1; }
  else               { x = 12; r->c = day >= 3; }
  copy_text(ram, r, ORDINAL_NAMES, x, ORDINAL_TEXT, 2);
}
```

`src/collision.c`:

```c
/*
 * collision.c — can something move there? The checks the player (and the
 * objects) make before taking a step.
 *
 * Inputs in the direct page: $DF / $E1 the position (x, y) of who moves,
 * $E3 how far ahead to look, $E5 / $E7 the step (x, y) and A the direction:
 * 0 down (y grows), 1 up, 2 right (x grows), 3 left. (HM-Decomp's button
 * constants swap left and right: on the SNES pad $0100 is Right, $0200
 * Left, so its PlayerActionLeft is really "right".)
 *
 *   CollideMap  the map: tests the two corners of the side that moves (6 pixels
 *          each way from the middle) against the tile properties.
 *   CollideTileCorner  one corner: is that point of the tile solid?
 *   CollideEventObjects  the objects of the event slots: is one of them in the way?
 *   CollidePlayer  the player: is the player in the way?
 *
 * They answer A = 0 (free) or not 0 (blocked) and, for the map, how far one
 * can still go.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ────────────────────────────── */

/* Direct page */
#define COLLIDE_RESULT 0x7E   /* 16b: CollideMap's answer: (first blocked) << 1 |
                                 (second blocked) */
#define LOOK_X       0x80     /* 16b: CollideEventObjects / CollidePlayer: the point
                                 looked at */
#define LOOK_Y       0x82     /* 16b */
#define POINT_X      0x86     /* 16b: CollideTileCorner: the point */
#define POINT_Y      0x88     /* 16b */
#define TILE_X       0x8A     /* 16b: the tile's corner */
#define TILE_Y       0x8C     /* 16b */
#define OBJECT_FOUND 0x8C     /* 16b: CollideEventObjects: 1 = an object blocks (the
                                 same word as TILE_Y) */
#define SOLID_TO     0x8E     /* 16b: where the tile's solid part ends in it (16, or 8) */
#define SOLID_FROM   0x90     /* 16b: where it starts (0, or 8) */
#define TILE_PROPERTY 0x92    /* 8b: the tile's property (GetTileProperty) */

/* WRAM */
#define SLOTS        0xB586   /* the event slots, $7E:B586, 49 of $40 bytes */

static uint16_t dp16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a) { return hm_dp_r16(ram, r, a); }
static void set16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a, uint16_t v) { hm_dp_w16(ram, r, a, v); }
static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}
/* ADC / SBC with the carry, 16 bits */
static uint16_t adc(HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b)
{
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)a + b + r->c;
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  return (uint16_t)s;
}
static uint16_t sbc(HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b)
{
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)a - b - (r->c ? 0 : 1);
  r->c = s <= 0xFFFF;
  return (uint16_t)s;
}
static uint16_t add(HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b) { r->c = 0; return adc(r, a, b); }
static uint16_t sub(HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b) { r->c = 1; return sbc(r, a, b); }

/* The native build's "walk through the crops" (g_hm_crops_passable, off in
 * the checking build): a crop tile (seeds and every stage, 1E..6F) of the
 * farm does not block the player. Only the player: whoever moves is at the
 * player's place ($DF / $E1 = $D6 / $D8); the cows, the dog and the horse
 * keep the game's rule. The point is the one just looked at ($86 / $88);
 * the farm is 64 tiles wide. */
static bool crop_for_player(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r)
{
  if (ram[HM_MAP_ID] > 3) return false;
  if (dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X) != dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X) || dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y) != dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y)) return false;
  uint16_t x = dp16(ram, r, POINT_X), y = dp16(ram, r, POINT_Y);
  if (x >= 0x400 || y >= 0x400) return false;
  uint8_t t = hm_bus_rd8(ram, ((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + HM_MAP_TILES + (uint16_t)((y >> 4) * 64 + (x >> 4)));
  return t >= 0x1E && t <= 0x6F;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CollideTileCorner ($83:B0F6, JSR, RTS). X, Y = a point; A = 0 for the first corner,
 * 1 for the second. Reads the tile's property (GetTileProperty):
 *   bit 0       the whole tile is solid;
 *   bits 1 / 2  only the half with x & 8 clear / set is solid;
 *   bits 3 / 4  only the half with y & 8 clear / set is solid;
 *   none        free, except that carrying something ($D2 bit 4) the tile
 *               types $C0-$CF block.
 * Returns A = 1 blocked, 0 free. Leaves for CollideMap: $86 / $88 the point,
 * $8A / $8C the tile's corner, $8E / $90 = 16 / 0 (8 when a half blocks and
 * the step on that axis is 0); the tile type in $E9 (first corner) or $EB
 * (second).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_CollideTileCorner(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t which = r->a;
  push16(ram, r, which);                                   /* PHA */
  set16(ram, r, POINT_X, r->x);
  set16(ram, r, POINT_Y, r->y);
  set16(ram, r, TILE_X, r->x & 0xFFF0);
  set16(ram, r, TILE_Y, r->y & 0xFFF0);
  set16(ram, r, SOLID_TO, 0x0010);
  set16(ram, r, SOLID_FROM, 0x0000);
  r->a = 0x0002;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xB119, 0x82);
  hm_GetTileProperty(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  uint8_t prop = (uint8_t)r->a;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, TILE_PROPERTY) = prop;
  r->a = pull16(ram, r);
  r->c = r->a >= 1;                                        /* CMP #1 */
  set16(ram, r, r->a == 1 ? HM_COLLIDE_TILE_2 : HM_COLLIDE_TILE_1, r->x);

  bool blocked;
  if (prop & 0x01) {
    blocked = true;
  } else if (prop & 0x02) {
    if (dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y) == 0) set16(ram, r, SOLID_TO, 8);
    blocked = !(dp16(ram, r, POINT_X) & 8);
  } else if (prop & 0x04) {
    if (dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y) == 0) set16(ram, r, SOLID_FROM, 8);
    blocked = (dp16(ram, r, POINT_X) & 8) != 0;
  } else if (prop & 0x08) {
    if (dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X) == 0) set16(ram, r, SOLID_TO, 8);
    blocked = !(dp16(ram, r, POINT_Y) & 8);
  } else if (prop & 0x10) {
    if (dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X) == 0) set16(ram, r, SOLID_FROM, 8);
    blocked = (dp16(ram, r, POINT_Y) & 8) != 0;
  } else {
    blocked = false;
    if (dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0010) {            /* carrying */
      r->c = r->x >= 0xC0;
      if (r->c) {
        r->c = r->x >= 0xD0;
        blocked = !r->c;
      }
    }
  }
  if (blocked && g_hm_crops_passable && crop_for_player(ram, r)) blocked = false;
  r->a = blocked ? 1 : 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CollideMap ($83:AF37, JSL, RTL): the map. A = direction. The two corners are
 * the front side's ends, 6 pixels to each side; the front is $E3 + the step
 * + 6 pixels ahead. A = (first blocked) << 1 | (second blocked), and when
 * blocked, Y (for y moves) or X (for x moves) = how far into the tile the
 * point is, so the caller can slide or stop at the edge.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct Corner { uint16_t ret1, ret2; } Corner;

static void corner(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t which, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = which;
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(ret >> 8));                   /* JSR CollideTileCorner */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)ret);
  hm_CollideTileCorner(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
}
/* the two calls: the first corner at (x1, y1); then the second, after
 * keeping the first answer and the margin `keep` ($8E or $90) of the first
 * call on the stack. `along_y`: the first point's y was pushed (y moves),
 * otherwise its x. Returns the code; `kept` = the margin of the first call. */
static uint16_t two_corners(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, bool along_y, uint16_t first, unsigned keep,
                            uint16_t second, const Corner *c, uint16_t *kept)
{
  push16(ram, r, first);                                   /* PHA */
  if (along_y) r->y = first; else r->x = first;            /* TAY / TAX */
  corner(ram, r, 0, c->ret1);
  uint16_t p = pull16(ram, r);                             /* PLY / PLX */
  if (along_y) r->y = p; else r->x = p;
  push16(ram, r, r->a);                                    /* PHA: the first answer */
  push16(ram, r, dp16(ram, r, keep));                      /* LDA $8E / $90; PHA */
  r->a = second;
  if (along_y) r->x = second; else r->y = second;
  corner(ram, r, 1, c->ret2);
  set16(ram, r, COLLIDE_RESULT, r->a);
  *kept = pull16(ram, r);                                  /* PLY / PLX */
  if (along_y) r->y = *kept; else r->x = *kept;
  uint16_t first_answer = pull16(ram, r);                  /* PLA */
  r->a = (uint16_t)((uint16_t)(first_answer << 1) | dp16(ram, r, COLLIDE_RESULT));
  r->c = (first_answer & 0x8000) != 0;                     /* ASL */
  set16(ram, r, COLLIDE_RESULT, r->a);
  return r->a;
}

void hm_CollideMap(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Corner C[4] = { { 0xAF5E, 0xAF72 }, { 0xAFC6, 0xAFDA },
                               { 0xB02E, 0xB042 }, { 0xB094, 0xB0A8 } };
  uint16_t dir = r->a;
  r->c = (dir & 0x8000) != 0;                              /* ASL; TAX */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(dir << 1);
  uint16_t x = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X), y = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y);
  uint16_t e3 = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD), e5 = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X), e7 = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y);
  uint16_t code, kept;
  switch (dir) {
  case 0:                                                  /* y grows */
    r->x = sub(r, x, 6);
    { uint16_t f = adc(r, adc(r, add(r, y, e7), 6), e3);
      code = two_corners(ram, r, true, f, SOLID_FROM, add(r, x, 6), &C[0], &kept); }
    if (!code) { set16(ram, r, COLLIDE_RESULT, 0); r->y = 0; break; }
    r->c = code >= 3;
    if (code != 3) { r->c = code >= 2; if (code == 2) set16(ram, r, SOLID_FROM, r->y); }
    r->a = sbc(r, sub(r, dp16(ram, r, POINT_Y), dp16(ram, r, TILE_Y)), dp16(ram, r, SOLID_FROM));
    r->y = (uint16_t)(r->a + 1);
    break;
  case 1:                                                  /* y shrinks */
    r->x = sub(r, x, 6);
    { uint16_t f = sbc(r, sbc(r, sub(r, y, e7), 6), e3);
      code = two_corners(ram, r, true, f, SOLID_TO, add(r, x, 6), &C[1], &kept); }
    if (!code) { set16(ram, r, COLLIDE_RESULT, 0); r->y = 0; break; }
    r->c = code >= 3;
    if (code != 3) { r->c = code >= 2; if (code == 2) set16(ram, r, SOLID_TO, r->y); }
    r->a = sub(r, add(r, dp16(ram, r, TILE_Y), dp16(ram, r, SOLID_TO)), dp16(ram, r, POINT_Y));
    r->y = r->a;
    break;
  case 2:                                                  /* x grows */
    { uint16_t f = adc(r, adc(r, add(r, x, e5), 6), e3);
      r->y = sub(r, y, 6);                                 /* (PHA; TAX in two_corners) */
      code = two_corners(ram, r, false, f, SOLID_FROM, add(r, y, 6), &C[2], &kept); }
    if (!code) { set16(ram, r, COLLIDE_RESULT, 0); r->x = 0; break; }
    r->c = code >= 3;
    if (code != 3) { r->c = code >= 2; if (code == 2) set16(ram, r, SOLID_FROM, r->x); }
    r->a = sbc(r, sub(r, dp16(ram, r, POINT_X), dp16(ram, r, TILE_X)), dp16(ram, r, SOLID_FROM));
    r->x = (uint16_t)(r->a + 1);
    break;
  default:                                                 /* 3: x shrinks */
    { uint16_t f = sbc(r, sbc(r, sub(r, x, e5), 6), e3);
      r->y = sub(r, y, 6);
      code = two_corners(ram, r, false, f, SOLID_TO, add(r, y, 6), &C[3], &kept); }
    if (!code) { set16(ram, r, COLLIDE_RESULT, 0); r->x = 0; break; }
    r->c = code >= 3;
    if (code != 3) { r->c = code >= 2; if (code == 2) set16(ram, r, SOLID_TO, r->x); }
    r->a = sub(r, add(r, dp16(ram, r, TILE_X), dp16(ram, r, SOLID_TO)), dp16(ram, r, POINT_X));
    r->x = r->a;
    break;
  }
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, COLLIDE_RESULT);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CollideEventObjects ($83:AD91, JSL, RTL): the event objects. A = direction. The point
 * looked at is 12 pixels plus the step and $E3 ahead; an object is in the
 * way when its position (+$1A, +$1C of its slot) is within 12 pixels of it
 * on both axes. Every slot's byte +$0C is cleared, and set to 1 on the
 * first objects found (until one without bit 1 of its byte +0, which stops
 * the search: objects with that bit do not block). With $7F1F60 bit $4000
 * nothing blocks.
 * Returns A = 1, X = Y = 0 if blocked; else A = 0, X = $E5, Y = $E7.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_CollideEventObjects(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t dir = r->a;
  r->x = dir;                                              /* TAX */
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x4000;
  if (!r->a) {
    r->c = (dir & 0x8000) != 0;                            /* TXA; ASL; TAX */
    r->x = (uint16_t)(dir << 1);
    uint16_t x = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X), y = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y);
    uint16_t e3 = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD), e5 = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X), e7 = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y);
    uint16_t px, py;
    switch (dir) {
    case 0: px = add(r, x, 0x0C); py = adc(r, adc(r, add(r, y, e7), e3), 0x0C); break;
    case 1: px = add(r, x, 0x0C); py = add(r, sbc(r, sub(r, y, e7), e3), 0x0C); break;
    case 2: px = adc(r, adc(r, add(r, x, e5), e3), 0x0C); py = add(r, y, 0x0C); break;
    default: px = add(r, sbc(r, sub(r, x, e5), e3), 0x0C); py = add(r, y, 0x0C); break;
    }
    set16(ram, r, LOOK_X, px);
    set16(ram, r, LOOK_Y, py);

    uint16_t saved_cc = dp16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT);
    uint8_t saved_ce = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK);
    push16(ram, r, saved_cc);
    hm_push8(ram, r, saved_ce);
    set16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOTS);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK) = 0x7E;
    set16(ram, r, OBJECT_FOUND, 0);
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 0x31; i++) {
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_PRESSED), 0);
      uint8_t used = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_IN_USE));
      if (used) {
        r->a = sub(r, px, hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_X)));
        r->c = r->a >= 0x19;
        if (!r->c) {
          r->a = sub(r, py, hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_Y)));
          r->c = r->a >= 0x19;
          if (!r->c && dp16(ram, r, OBJECT_FOUND) == 0) {
            hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_PRESSED), 1);
            uint8_t b = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_IN_USE));
            if (!(b & 2)) set16(ram, r, OBJECT_FOUND, 1);
          }
        }
      }
      set16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, add(r, dp16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT), 0x40));
      r->c = (uint16_t)(i + 1) >= 0x31;                    /* INX; CPX #$31 */
    }
    bool hit = dp16(ram, r, OBJECT_FOUND) != 0;
    *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK) = hm_pull8(ram, r);
    set16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, pull16(ram, r));
    if (hit) {
      r->x = 0; r->y = 0; r->a = 1;
      return;
    }
  }
  r->x = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X);
  r->y = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y);
  r->a = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CollidePlayer ($83:AEC3, JSL, RTL): the player. A = direction. The point is the
 * position plus the step (no $E3 here); the player is in the way when
 * within 12 pixels of it on both axes.
 * Returns A = 1, X = Y = 0 if so; else A = 0, X = $E5, Y = $E7.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_CollidePlayer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t dir = r->a;
  r->c = (dir & 0x8000) != 0;
  r->x = (uint16_t)(dir << 1);
  uint16_t x = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X), y = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y);
  uint16_t e5 = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X), e7 = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y);
  uint16_t px = x, py = y;
  switch (dir) {
  case 0: py = add(r, y, e7); break;
  case 1: py = sub(r, y, e7); break;
  case 2: px = add(r, x, e5); break;
  default: px = sub(r, x, e5); break;
  }
  set16(ram, r, LOOK_X, px);
  set16(ram, r, LOOK_Y, py);
  r->a = add(r, sub(r, px, dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X)), 0x0C);
  r->c = r->a >= 0x19;
  if (!r->c) {
    r->a = add(r, sub(r, py, dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y)), 0x0C);
    r->c = r->a >= 0x19;
    if (!r->c) {
      r->a = 1; r->x = 0; r->y = 0;
      return;
    }
  }
  r->a = 0;
  r->x = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X);
  r->y = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y);
}

```

`src/coloranim.c`:

```c
/*
 * coloranim.c — colour animations (palette cycling): water, lights,
 * flowers... 16 channels change one palette colour each, step by step.
 *
 * A channel ($42 + 3 n: a 24-bit pointer; $014A + n: frames left of this
 * step; $015A + n: the colour; $016A + n: the palette row) walks a list of
 * steps of 3 bytes: the colour (a word) and how many frames it stays (a
 * byte). $FFFF ends the list; $FFFE <pointer 24> jumps (a loop).
 *
 *   StartColourAnimation   start channel X with the list at [$72] (colour A,
 *                      row Y)
 *   RunColourAnimations        every frame: advance every channel and, if one ran,
 *                      send the palette ($7F:0900) to the console
 *   Zeroes...          stop channels
 *   StartMapColourAnimations  starts the animations of the map for this part
 *                      of the day: Subrutines_Table ($80:BEEC) has 6 words
 *                      per map (5 parts of the day, then a word that, when
 *                      not $FFFF, means "only in autumn and winter")
 *   Colours_<place>_<part of the day>  the 51 routines of that table:
 *                      each starts some channels (the lists are in bank
 *                      $80). The parts of the day: Day (until 15:00, the
 *                      early morning too), Afternoon (15-16), Evening (17),
 *                      Night (from 18). A place given as Map<number> is a
 *                      map not named yet.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* WRAM of the data bank: one byte per channel (+ n) */
#define DELAY   0x014A          /* 8b: frames left of this step */
#define COLOUR  0x015A          /* 8b: the colour it changes */
#define ROW     0x016A          /* 8b: the palette row */
#define PALETTE_COPY    0x0900  /* the palette ($7F:0900, HM_CGRAM_SHADOW) */

/* Direct page */
#define CHANNEL_LIST    0x42    /* 24b per channel ($42 + 3 n): where its list is */
#define CHANNEL_LIST_BANK 0x44  /* 8b: its bank */
#define LIST_POINTER    0x72    /* 24b $72-$74: the list worked on; StartColourAnimation's
                                   argument */
#define LIST_BANK       0x74    /* 8b: its bank */
#define DMA_SOURCE      0x72    /* 24b: AddProgrammedDMA's source (= LIST_POINTER) */
#define DMA_SOURCE_BANK 0x74    /* 8b */
#define DMA_CHANNEL     0x27    /* 8b: AddProgrammedDMA's channel (dma.c) */
#define DMA_B_ADDRESS   0x29    /* 8b: its destination register */
#define CHANNEL_N       0x7E    /* 16b: times3's channel number; StartMapColourAnimations:
                                   the part of the day */
#define MAP_ROW         0x80    /* 16b: StartMapColourAnimations: the map, then 6 x the
                                   map (its row of Subrutines_Table) */
#define UNKNOWN_92      0x92    /* 8b: RunColourAnimations clears it */
#define ANY_RAN         0x93    /* 8b: 1 = a channel ran this frame (send the palette) */

/* A step of a list (3 bytes) */
#define STEP_COLOUR     0       /* 16b: the colour; $FFFF the end, $FFFE a jump */
#define STEP_FRAMES     2       /* 8b: how many frames it stays */
#define JUMP_TO         2       /* 16b after $FFFE: where the list goes on */
#define JUMP_BANK       4       /* 8b: its bank */

static uint32_t db_addr(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint16_t dp16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a) { return hm_dp_r16(ram, r, a); }
static void set16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a, uint16_t v) { hm_dp_w16(ram, r, a, v); }
static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}
/* TYA; STA $7E; ASL; CLC; ADC $7E; TAX: the channel's pointer offset */
static uint16_t times3(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n)
{
  set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_N, n);
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(n << 1) + n;
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = r->x = (uint16_t)s;
  return r->x;
}

/* StartColourAnimation ($80:8E48, JSL, RTL; 8-bit A, X, Y) */
void hm_StartColourAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(COLOUR + r->x)), (uint8_t)r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)r->y);   /* TYA (8 bits) */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(ROW + r->x)), (uint8_t)r->y);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(DELAY + r->x)), 0);
  uint16_t n = r->x;                                    /* TXA (16-bit A) */
  set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_N, n);
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(n << 1) + n;
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  r->x = (uint8_t)s;                                    /* TAX (8-bit X) */
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, LIST_POINTER);
  set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + r->x, r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, LIST_BANK));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + r->x) = *hm_dp(ram, r, LIST_BANK);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * RunColourAnimations ($80:8E69), every frame. Channels 0-3 run only while it
 * rains or snows ($0196 bits 1 / 3); from channel 4 on, the first empty
 * channel ends the loop, so they must be used in order.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_RunColourAnimations(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  *hm_dp(ram, r, UNKNOWN_92) = 0;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, ANY_RAN) = 0;
  r->y = 0;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS)) & 0x000A;
  if (!r->a) r->y = 4;
  for (;;) {
    uint16_t x = times3(ram, r, r->y);
    r->a = dp16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x);
    bool set = r->a != 0;
    if (!set) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x));
      set = *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x) != 0;
    }
    if (!set) {
      r->c = r->y >= 4;
      if (r->c) break;                                  /* the end of the channels */
      goto next;
    }
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 1);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, ANY_RAN) = 1;
    push16(ram, r, r->y);                               /* PHY */
    set16(ram, r, LIST_POINTER, dp16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x));
    *hm_dp(ram, r, LIST_BANK) = *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((dp16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x) & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x));
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, LIST_POINTER, STEP_COLOUR));
    r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF;
    if (r->a == 0xFFFF) {                               /* the end of the list */
      set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x, 0);
      *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x) = 0;
    } else {
      r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFE;
      if (r->a == 0xFFFE) {                             /* a jump */
        r->y = 2;
        r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, LIST_POINTER, JUMP_TO));
        set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x, r->a);
        r->y = 4;
        uint8_t bank = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, LIST_POINTER, JUMP_BANK));
        r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | bank);
        *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x) = bank;
        set16(ram, r, LIST_POINTER, dp16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x));
        *hm_dp(ram, r, LIST_BANK) = bank;
        r->a = (uint16_t)((dp16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x) & 0xFF00) | bank);
      }
    }
    r->y = pull16(ram, r);                              /* PLY; TYX */
    r->x = r->y;
    uint8_t wait = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(DELAY + r->x)));
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | wait);
    if (wait) {                                         /* still waiting */
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(DELAY + r->x)), (uint8_t)(wait - 1));
      goto next;
    }
    push16(ram, r, r->y);                               /* PHY */
    uint8_t row = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(ROW + r->x)));
    push16(ram, r, row);                                /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA; PHA */
    uint8_t col = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(COLOUR + r->x)));
    push16(ram, r, col);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, LIST_POINTER, STEP_COLOUR));
    r->x = pull16(ram, r);                              /* PLX; PLY */
    r->y = pull16(ram, r);
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8EEE, 0x80);
    hm_SetPaletteColour(ram, r);                              /* the new colour */
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    r->y = pull16(ram, r);                              /* PLY; PHY; TYX */
    push16(ram, r, r->y);
    r->x = r->y;
    uint8_t frames = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, LIST_POINTER, STEP_FRAMES));
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | frames);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(DELAY + r->x)), frames);
    r->y = pull16(ram, r);
    x = times3(ram, r, r->y);
    uint32_t p = (uint32_t)dp16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x) + 3; /* the next step */
    set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x, (uint16_t)p);
    uint16_t b = (uint16_t)(*hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x) + (p > 0xFFFF));
    r->c = b > 0xFF;
    r->a = (uint16_t)((p & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)b);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x) = (uint8_t)b;
  next:
    times3(ram, r, r->y);
    r->y = (uint16_t)(r->y + 1);
    r->c = r->y >= 0x10;
    if (r->y == 0x10) break;
  }
  if (!*hm_dp(ram, r, ANY_RAN)) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a & 0xFF00);
    return;
  }
  /* send the palette: channel 5, to $2122 (CGRAM), from $7F:0900 */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = 5;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS) = BBAD_CGDATA;
  r->y = 0x0100;
  r->x = 0;
  set16(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE, PALETTE_COPY);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE_BANK) = 0x7F;
  r->a = 0x097F;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8F50, 0x80);
  hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* StopAllColourAnimations ($80:8FAB): stop all 16 channels; StopColourAnimationsFrom
 * ($80:8F92): from channel Y on (Y must be below 16, or it goes round
 * 65536 times); StopColourAnimation ($80:8F82): channel A. */
static void stop_from(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y)
{
  do {
    uint16_t x = times3(ram, r, y);
    set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x, 0);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x) = 0;
    y = (uint16_t)(y + 1);
    r->c = y >= 0x10;
  } while (y != 0x10);
  r->y = y;
}
void hm_StopAllColourAnimations(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { stop_from(ram, r, 0); }
void hm_StopColourAnimationsFrom(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { stop_from(ram, r, r->y); }
void hm_StopColourAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t x = times3(ram, r, r->a);
  set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST + x, 0);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANNEL_LIST_BANK + x) = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The 51 routines of Subrutines_Table: each starts some channels. One line
 * per channel: the list (24-bit), the colour, the row, the channel... as
 * StartColourAnimation takes them, and the JSL's return address.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct Start { uint16_t list; uint8_t bank, colour, channel, row; uint16_t ret; } Start;

static void start_all(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Start *s, unsigned n)
{
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    r->a = s[i].list;                                   /* REP #$20; SEP #$10 */
    set16(ram, r, LIST_POINTER, s[i].list);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((s[i].list & 0xFF00) | s[i].bank);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, LIST_BANK) = s[i].bank;
    r->a = (uint16_t)((s[i].list & 0xFF00) | s[i].colour);
    r->x = s[i].channel;
    r->y = s[i].row;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, s[i].ret, 0x80);
    hm_StartColourAnimation(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
}
#define STARTS(name, ...)                                                        \
  void hm_##name(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                                        \
  {                                                                              \
    static const Start s[] = { __VA_ARGS__ };                                   \
    start_all(ram, r, s, sizeof s / sizeof s[0]);                                \
  }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * StartMapColourAnimations ($80:9553, JSL, RTL)
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define SUB_TABLE 0xBEEC   /* Subrutines_Table, read with the data bank */

static void (*sub_at(uint16_t pc))(uint8_t *, HmRegs *)
{
  static const struct { uint16_t pc; void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *); } T[] = {
    { 0xC36C, hm_Colours_FarmSpringSummer_Day },
    { 0xC3D9, hm_Colours_FarmSpringSummer_Afternoon },

    { 0xCFFA, hm_Colours_TownWinter_Night },
    { 0xD067, hm_Colours_MountainSpring_Day },
    { 0xD125, hm_Colours_MountainSpring_Afternoon },
    { 0xD1E3, hm_Colours_MountainSpring_Evening },
    { 0xD2A1, hm_Colours_MountainSpring_Night },
    { 0xD344, hm_Colours_MountainSummer_Day },
    { 0xD402, hm_Colours_MountainSummer_Afternoon },
    { 0xD4C0, hm_Colours_MountainSummer_Evening },

    { 0xDD09, hm_Colours_Map21 },

  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof T / sizeof T[0]; i++) if (T[i].pc == pc) return T[i].fn;
  return 0;
}

void hm_StartMapColourAnimations(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t starts[4] = { 7, 15, 17, 18 };
  uint8_t h = (uint8_t)hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | h);
  uint16_t part = 0;
  for (; part < 4; part++) {
    r->c = h >= starts[part];
    if (!r->c) break;
  }
  r->x = part;
  set16(ram, r, CHANNEL_N, part);                       /* the part of the day */
  uint16_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);             /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $22 */
  set16(ram, r, MAP_ROW, map);
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(map << 2) + map;    /* ASL; ASL; CLC; ADC; ADC */
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + map + (s > 0xFFFF);
  uint16_t six = (uint16_t)s;
  set16(ram, r, MAP_ROW, six);
  uint32_t t = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(six << 1) + 0x0A;   /* ASL; CLC; ADC #10 */
  r->x = (uint16_t)t;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(SUB_TABLE + r->x)));
  r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF;
  if (r->a != 0xFFFF) {                                 /* autumn and winter only */
    uint8_t season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | season);
    r->c = season >= 2;
    if (!r->c) return;
  }
  uint32_t u = (uint32_t)six + part;                    /* CLC; ADC $7E; ASL */
  uint16_t i = (uint16_t)u;
  r->c = (i >> 15) & 1;
  r->x = (uint16_t)(i << 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(SUB_TABLE + r->x)));
  r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF;
  if (r->a == 0xFFFF) return;
  uint16_t pc = hm_bus_rd16(ram, ((uint32_t)r->pb << 16) | (uint16_t)(SUB_TABLE + r->x));
  void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *) = sub_at(pc);
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(0x95B1 >> 8));            /* JSR (Subrutines_Table,X) */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)0x95B1);
  if (fn) fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
}

```

`src/day.c`:

```c
/*
 * day.c — the clock and the new day.
 *
 * UpdateTime runs once a frame from the game loop: a second a frame, the
 * hours of the day, and at night NightReset, which turns the calendar and
 * does everything that happens while the player sleeps, then wakes him
 * up in his house.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

typedef void Fn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* WRAM of the data bank ($0100-$1FFF; through db / rd8 / wr8) */
#define UNKNOWN_0972      0x0972   /* 8b: cleared by FirstNightReset, not read here */
#define SAVE_SLOT         0x098E   /* 8b: the diary slot (0 or 1) */
#define UNKNOWN_098F      0x098F   /* 8b: cleared by FirstNightReset, not read here */

/* Direct page */
#define NMI_STATUS        0x00   /* 8b: set by the NMI */
#define PALETTE_TARGET    0x04   /* 24b $04-$06: the palette the colours move to */
#define PALETTE_TARGET_BANK 0x06
#define DMA_WAITING       0x28   /* 8b: the DMA channels to start, one bit each */
#define COLOUR_LIST_0     0x42   /* 24b: colour animation channel 0's list ($42 + 3 n) */
#define COLOUR_LIST_0_BANK 0x44
#define COLOUR_LIST_1     0x45   /* 24b: channel 1's */
#define COLOUR_LIST_1_BANK 0x47
#define COLOUR_LIST_2     0x48   /* 24b: channel 2's */
#define COLOUR_LIST_2_BANK 0x4A
#define MONEY_AMOUNT      0x72   /* 24b $72-$74: what AddMoney adds */
#define MONEY_AMOUNT_BANK 0x74   /* 8b: its third byte */

static uint32_t db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, a)); }
static uint16_t rd16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, db(r, a)); }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }

/* JSL at `at` to a routine of `bank`. Those that wait frames save the
 * flags (PHP): r->p carries the carry as it is now, 8-bit A, 16-bit
 * indexes, and D and I of the entry (N, Z and V are not followed:
 * HM_LOOSE). */
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, Fn *fn)
{
  uint8_t keep = r->p;
  r->p = (uint8_t)((keep & 0x0C) | 0x20 | (r->c & 1));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->p = keep;
}
/* LDA.L addr; AND #mask (16 bits) */
static bool flag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t mask)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, addr) & mask);
  return r->a != 0;
}
static void flag_on(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t bits)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, addr) | bits);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, addr, r->a);
}
static void flag_off(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t bits)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, addr) & ~bits);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, addr, r->a);
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA.L addr; ORA #bits; STA.L addr */
static void bits_on8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint8_t bits)
{
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, addr) | bits);
  set_a8(r, v);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, addr, v);
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA.L addr; INC; STA.L addr; CMP #n: true when it got to n */
static bool count8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint8_t n)
{
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, addr) + 1);
  set_a8(r, v);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, addr, v);
  r->c = v >= n;
  return v == n;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * NightReset ($82:82AC, JSL, RTL; UpdateTime jumps here when $0973 bit 1
 * is set, the player went to bed): the new day.
 *  - The calendar: the weekday (0-6), the day (1-30), the season (0-3)
 *    and the year; on a new year, the damage odds of 4 (winter's, with
 *    LoadDamageProbabilities) and ClimateFarmDamageCheck.
 *  - The music stops (FadeOutSongSlowly with $0117 = $FF), the screen fades out
 *    (from 15, 3 frames a level, to 1) and is blanked; map $0F for the
 *    music of the day.
 *  - Today's special days: $7F1F64 bits 4-5 and $7F1F70 bit 1 from
 *    $0196 bits 4, 9 and 8, around SetWeatherFlags (which makes the new
 *    $0196); the new day's music (PickMapMusic past its 6 pm test).
 *  - 6:00:00, and the night's work: LoadDateNames,
 *    NightlyFarmTilesCheck, ClimateFarmDamagePrep, CowFeedingAndStatus,
 *    WeatherTomorrow, FindMostLovedName, WifePregnancyAndChildren.
 *  - The player rested: the state ($D2 = 1, action 0, facing down), the
 *    stamina full ($0918 = $0917), the shipped goods' money paid
 *    (AddMoney, $7F1F07-$7F1F09 then 0), the animals not fed, the day's
 *    flags ($7F1F5A-$7F1F62, $7F1F74-$7F1F78) cleared, $7F1F68 bit 0 (a
 *    day went by).
 *  - The story: $7F1F66 bit 5 becomes bit 6; while the house is being
 *    built ($7F1F66 bit 7), on the 4th night ($7F1F35) it is done: bit 8,
 *    500 wood needed for the next one ($7F1F0E), and the house's level
 *    ($7F1F64 bit 6, then bit 7). $7F1F68 bit 11 becomes bit 12; with bit
 *    15, the gold hammer in the shed ($7F1F02 bit 2). $7F1F6A bit 7: the
 *    first time bits 1 and 8; the second the hoe goes (from the hands
 *    $0921, the backpack $0923 and the shed's $7F1F00 bit 1) for the gold
 *    one ($7F1F02 bit 1). $7F1F6A bit 10 becomes bit 11. Five visits
 *    ($7F1F6A bits 12 and 14, $7F1F6C bits 0, 2 and 4) count nights in
 *    $09A3 and on the third their next bit takes over. $7F1F6E bit 15:
 *    the hoe back in the shed ($7F1F02 bit 0). $0196 bit 4: $7F1F60 bit
 *    0.
 *  - The diary: with $0973 bit 2, SaveGameSlot of slot $098E.
 *  - A trick: holding L, R and Select ($0124 = $2030) makes it summer 30
 *    of the third year, the last day.
 *  - The clock stops, the hands are emptied ($091D), $D2 bit 1 off; the
 *    player wakes in the house ($15) at (136, 120) (EnterMap),
 *    with 20 of stamina more (ChangeStamina); unless $7F1F5E bit 2, the
 *    breakfast ($0924 = 0-3, RNGReturn0toA) and $D2 bit 2.
 * Leftovers: those of RNGReturn0toA (or of ChangeStamina, with A = 4).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void visit_nights(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t now, uint16_t next)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, addr, now) || flag(ram, r, addr, next)) return;
  if (!count8(ram, r, db(r, HM_VISIT_NIGHTS), 3)) return;
  flag_on(ram, r, addr, next);
  flag_off(ram, r, addr, now);
}

static void new_date(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t wd = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY)) + 1);
  r->c = wd >= 7;
  if (wd == 7) wd = 0;
  set_a8(r, wd);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY), wd);
  uint8_t day = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY)) + 1);
  set_a8(r, day);
  r->c = day >= 0x1F;
  if (day == 0x1F) {
    uint8_t season = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)) + 1);
    set_a8(r, season);
    r->c = season >= 4;
    if (season == 4) {
      uint8_t year = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)) + 1);
      set_a8(r, year);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR), year);
      r->a = 0x0004;                                       /* REP #$20 */
      hm_push8(ram, r, 0x82); hm_push8(ram, r, 0xE5);      /* JSR */
      hm_LoadDamageProbabilities(ram, r);
      hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
      jsl(ram, r, 0x82E6, 0x82, hm_ClimateFarmDamageCheck);
      season = 0;
      set_a8(r, 0);
    }
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), season);
    day = 1;
    set_a8(r, 1);
  }
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), day);
}

static void story(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0020)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0020);
    flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0040);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0080) && count8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_BUILD_NIGHTS), 4)) {
    flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0100);
    r->a = 500;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_LUMBER_NEEDED), 500);
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0080);
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0040)) flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0080);
    else flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0040);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0800)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0800);
    flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x1000);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x8000)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x8000);
    bits_on8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 2), 0x04);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0080)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0080);
    if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0100)) flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0102);
    else {
      static const uint16_t places[2] = { HM_TOOL_SELECTED, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK };
      for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
        uint8_t v = rd8(ram, r, places[i]);
        set_a8(r, v);
        r->c = v >= 2;
        if (v == 2) wr8(ram, r, places[i], 0);
      }
      uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS)) & 0xFD);
      set_a8(r, v);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), v);
      bits_on8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 2), 0x02);
    }
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0400) && !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0800)) {
    flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0800);
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0400);
  }
  visit_nights(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x1000, 0x2000);
  visit_nights(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x4000, 0x8000);
  visit_nights(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x0001, 0x0002);
  visit_nights(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x0004, 0x0008);
  visit_nights(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x0010, 0x0020);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x8000)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x8000);
    bits_on8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 2), 0x01);
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0010);
  if (r->a) flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), 0x0001);
}

void hm_NightReset(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  new_date(ram, r);
  set_a8(r, 0xFF);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_PLAYING_SONG, 0xFF);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8301, 0x83, hm_FadeOutSongSlowly);
  set_a8(r, 0x0F); *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_FADE_FROM) = 0x0F;
  set_a8(r, 0x03); *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_FADE_FRAMES) = 0x03;
  set_a8(r, 0x01); *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_FADE_TO) = 0x01;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8313, 0x80, hm_ScreenFadeOut);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8317, 0x80, hm_ForceBlank);
  set_a8(r, 0x0F);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID) = 0x0F;

  flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0030);        /* REP #$30 */
  flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_70), 0x0002);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0010);
  if (r->a) flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0020);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x834E, 0x82, hm_SetWeatherFlags);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0200);
  if (r->a) flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0010);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0100);
  if (r->a) flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_70), 0x0002);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x837C, 0x80, hm_PickMapMusicAnyHour);

  set_a8(r, 0x06);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), 6);
  set_a8(r, 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_MINUTES), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SECONDS), 0);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8394, 0x82, hm_LoadDateNames);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8398, 0x82, hm_NightlyFarmTilesCheck);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x839C, 0x82, hm_ClimateFarmDamagePrep);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x83A0, 0x83, hm_CowFeedingAndStatus);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x83A4, 0x82, hm_WeatherTomorrow);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x83A8, 0x82, hm_FindMostLovedName);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x83AC, 0x82, hm_WifePregnancyAndChildren);

  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TIMER, 0);                        /* REP #$20 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  uint8_t max = rd8(ram, r, HM_MAX_STAMINA);               /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, max);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_CURRENT_STAMINA, max);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_IDLE_TIMER, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0001); /* REP #$30 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, 0);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY));   /* the shipped goods' money */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MONEY_AMOUNT, r->a);
  set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY_HIGH)));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_AMOUNT_BANK) = (uint8_t)r->a;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x83FB, 0x83, hm_AddMoney);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY_HIGH), 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_COWS_FED, 0);                             /* the animals fed */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_CHICKENS_FED, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_COW_TROUGHS, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_CHICKEN_TROUGHS, 0);
  static const uint32_t days_flags[] = {
    WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60),
    WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_62), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_76), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_78) };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 8; i++) hm_bus_wr16(ram, days_flags[i], 0);
  flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001);
  story(ram, r);

  uint8_t clock = rd8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING);            /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, clock & 0x04);
  if (clock & 0x04) {
    r->a = rd8(ram, r, SAVE_SLOT);                         /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
    jsl(ram, r, 0x870E, 0x83, hm_SaveGameSlot);
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)((rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD) & 0x2030) ^ 0x2030); /* REP #$20 */
  if (!r->a) {
    set_a8(r, 0x02); hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR), 0x02);
    set_a8(r, 0x01); hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 0x01);
    set_a8(r, 0x1E); hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x1E);
  }
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING, 0);                         /* SEP #$20 */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(0xFFFD & hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE)); /* REP #$30 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0x0088;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_X, 0x0088);
  r->a = 0x0078;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_Y, 0x0078);
  set_a8(r, 0x15);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP, 0x15);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x875E, 0x80, hm_EnterMap);
  set_a8(r, 0x14);                                         /* SEP #$20; REP #$10; LDA #$14 */
  r->n = 0;                                                /* (ChangeStamina reads its N) */
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8768, 0x81, hm_ChangeStamina);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) & 0x0004); /* REP #$30 */
  if (r->a) return;
  set_a8(r, 0x03);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x877B, 0x80, hm_RNGReturn0toA);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_MEAL_CHOICE, (uint8_t)r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0004);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * UpdateTime ($82:8000, JSL, RTL; once a frame): the clock ($0973).
 *  - Bit 1 (the player went to bed): the new day (NightReset).
 *  - Bit 0 off: the clock is stopped.
 *  - $7F1F5A bit 10: the shipping box's talk (ShippingSceneDialogue)
 *    instead.
 *  - A second a frame; 60 seconds a minute and 15 minutes an hour (so an
 *    hour is 900 frames, 15 s); the clock does not go past 18:00. On each
 *    new hour, the lunch (HaveLunch) and the shipping (ShippingScene); at
 *    18:00, unless $7F1F5E bit 15, the music stops (FadeOutSongSlowly with
 *    $0117 = $FF, then $0110 = $FF).
 *  - Then the palette of the hour (SetPaletteToLoad); if it changed, the
 *    colour cycles go (StopColourAnimationsFrom from 4) and the new ones
 *    start (StartMapColourAnimations).
 * Leftovers: those of the routines called, or of the tests.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_UpdateTime(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t clock = rd8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING);            /* SEP #$20; REP #$10 */
  set_a8(r, clock & 0x02);
  if (clock & 0x02) { hm_NightReset(ram, r); return; }     /* JMP */
  set_a8(r, clock & 0x01);
  if (!(clock & 0x01)) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) & 0x0400); /* REP #$20 */
  if (r->a) { hm_ShippingSceneDialogue(ram, r); return; }  /* JMP */
  if (count8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SECONDS), 60)) {
    set_a8(r, 0);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SECONDS), 0);
    if (count8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_MINUTES), 15)) {
      set_a8(r, 0);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_MINUTES), 0);
      uint8_t hour = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR));
      set_a8(r, hour);
      r->c = hour >= 18;
      if (hour != 18) {
        set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(hour + 1));
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), (uint8_t)(hour + 1));
        jsl(ram, r, 0x805B, 0x82, hm_HaveLunch);
        jsl(ram, r, 0x805F, 0x82, hm_ShippingScene);
        hour = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR));        /* SEP #$20 */
        set_a8(r, hour);
        r->c = hour >= 18;
        if (hour == 18) {
          r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) & 0x8000); /* REP #$20 */
          if (!r->a) {
            set_a8(r, 0xFF);
            wr8(ram, r, HM_PLAYING_SONG, 0xFF);
            jsl(ram, r, 0x8081, 0x83, hm_FadeOutSongSlowly);
            set_a8(r, 0xFF);
            wr8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG, 0xFF);
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  uint8_t palette = rd8(ram, r, HM_LOADED_PALETTE);        /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, palette);
  hm_push8(ram, r, palette);                               /* PHA */
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8092, 0x80, hm_SetPaletteToLoad);
  palette = hm_pull8(ram, r);                              /* SEP #$20; PLA */
  set_a8(r, palette);
  uint8_t now = rd8(ram, r, HM_LOADED_PALETTE);
  r->c = palette >= now;
  if (palette == now) return;
  r->y = 0x0004;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x80A1, 0x80, hm_StopColourAnimationsFrom);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x80A5, 0x80, hm_StartMapColourAnimations);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * FirstNightReset ($83:ABF0, JSL, RTL; when a game starts, new or loaded):
 * the day's state from zero: the scroll and DMA bytes, the money shipped,
 * the date's names (LoadDateNames), the player's state and position
 * ($D2 = 1, action 0, facing down, stamina full), what he holds, the
 * sounds ($0110-$0118), the animals fed, the map ($098B = 0), the day's
 * flags ($7F1F5A-$7F1F62, $7F1F74-$7F1F7A), 6:00:00; the wood the next
 * house needs: 250, or 500 once it was built once ($7F1F64 bit 6). Then
 * one frame (WaitForNMI).
 * Leftovers: those of WaitForNMI.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void zero8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const uint16_t *a, unsigned n)
{
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) wr8(ram, r, a[i], 0);
}
static void zero16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const uint16_t *a, unsigned n)
{
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) wr16(ram, r, a[i], 0);
}
static void zero_dp8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const uint8_t *a, unsigned n)
{
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) *hm_dp(ram, r, a[i]) = 0;
}
static void zero_dp16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const uint8_t *a, unsigned n)
{
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) hm_dp_w16(ram, r, a[i], 0);
}
#define N(t) (sizeof t / sizeof t[0])

void hm_FirstNightReset(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t w1[] = { HM_TEXT_NUMBER, HM_TEXT_X, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT };
  static const uint16_t b1[] = { HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE, HM_INPUT_STATE };
  static const uint8_t dpw1[] = { PALETTE_TARGET, COLOUR_LIST_0, COLOUR_LIST_1, COLOUR_LIST_2 };
  static const uint8_t dpb1[] = { DMA_WAITING, PALETTE_TARGET_BANK, COLOUR_LIST_0_BANK,
                                  COLOUR_LIST_1_BANK, COLOUR_LIST_2_BANK };
  zero16(ram, r, w1, N(w1));
  zero8(ram, r, b1, N(b1));
  zero_dp16(ram, r, dpw1, N(dpw1));
  zero_dp8(ram, r, dpb1, N(dpb1));
  r->a = 0;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY_HIGH), 0);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xAC2E, 0x82, hm_LoadDateNames);

  static const uint16_t b2[] = { HM_TOOL_HITS, HM_DOOR_STEP, UNKNOWN_0972, HM_STEP_COUNT, HM_NAME_PAGE,
                                 HM_NAME_COUNT, HM_ARROW_BLINK };
  static const uint16_t w2[] = { HM_PLAYER_TILE_1, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2, HM_TIME_RUNNING, HM_FOOTPRINT_X,
                                 HM_FOOTPRINT_Y, HM_NAME_CELL };
  static const uint8_t dpw2[] = { HM_GAME_STATE, HM_COLLIDE_TILE_1, HM_COLLIDE_TILE_2, HM_MAP_ANIM,
                                  HM_PLAYER_X, HM_PLAYER_Y };
  static const uint8_t dpb2[] = { HM_MAP_ANIM_BANK };
  zero8(ram, r, b2, N(b2));
  zero16(ram, r, w2, N(w2));
  zero_dp16(ram, r, dpw2, N(dpw2));
  zero_dp8(ram, r, dpb2, N(dpb2));
  set_a8(r, 0x06);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), 6);
  set_a8(r, 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_MINUTES), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SECONDS), 0);
  r->a = 0;                                                /* REP #$20 */
  for (uint32_t f = WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A); f <= WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_62); f += 2) hm_bus_wr16(ram, f, 0);
  for (uint32_t f = WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74); f <= WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_7A); f += 2) hm_bus_wr16(ram, f, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0001); /* REP #$30 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TIMER, 0);
  uint8_t max = rd8(ram, r, HM_MAX_STAMINA);               /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, max);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_CURRENT_STAMINA, max);

  static const uint16_t b3[] = { HM_STEP_SOUND_TIMER, HM_TOOL_FRAMES, HM_IDLE_TIMER, HM_TV_FORECAST,
                                 HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, HM_SHOWN_ITEM, HM_PICKED_TILE_BYTE, HM_CARRIED_SLOT,
                                 HM_SOW_STEP, UNKNOWN_098F, HM_EXHAUSTION, HM_TOOL_SOUND_CHOICE,
                                 HM_WANTED_SONG, HM_SOUND_EFFECT, HM_PLAYING_SONG, HM_SONG_LOADED,
                                 HM_COWS_FED, HM_CHICKENS_FED, HM_TRANSITION_MAP, HM_CAMERA_FRAMES };
  static const uint16_t w3[] = { HM_COW_TROUGHS, HM_CHICKEN_TROUGHS, HM_OAM_SIZE_USED, HM_CAMERA_SPEED_X,
                                 HM_CAMERA_SPEED_Y };
  zero8(ram, r, b3, N(b3));
  zero16(ram, r, w3, N(w3));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT, 0);
  r->a = 250;                                              /* REP #$30 */
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_LUMBER_NEEDED), 250);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0040)) { r->a = 500; hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_LUMBER_NEEDED), 500); }
  *hm_dp(ram, r, NMI_STATUS) = 0;                          /* SEP #$20 */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_UNKNOWN_0148, 0);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xAD8C, 0x80, hm_WaitForNMI);
}

 * changes nothing.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_UnusedEndlessLoop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { (void)ram; (void)r; }
```
