`src/decompress.c`:

```c
/*
 * decompress.c — the game's compressed data (LZSS).
 *
 * DecompressTileMap ($83:81F8, JSL, RTL): [$72] -> [$75]. The data starts
 * with its size (a word; then two more bytes that are skipped) and then
 * groups of one control byte and 8 items. Each bit of the control byte,
 * lowest first, says what the next item is:
 *   1  a literal byte, copied as it is;
 *   0  two bytes: a distance of 11 bits (low byte, then the top 3 bits of
 *      the second byte) and a length (its low 5 bits + 3, so 3-34): copy
 *      that many bytes from that place of the window.
 * The window is the last 2 KB written, kept at $7F:0000-$7F:07FF (cleared
 * at the start; the writing starts at $07DE = 2048 - 34, the usual LZSS
 * layout). It stops when the size is used up (with size 0 it would run
 * 65536 bytes).
 * Leftovers: A = 0, X = the last window index used, the flags (and the
 * 8 / 16-bit widths) back as they were (PHP / PLP).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ────────────────────────────── */

#define WINDOW 0x7F0000          /* 2 KB: the last bytes written (bus address) */

/* Direct page */
#define SOURCE        0x72       /* 24b $72-$74: the compressed data */
#define DEST          0x75       /* 24b $75-$77: where the output goes */
#define SIZE_LEFT     0x7E       /* 16b: bytes still to write */
#define CONTROL       0x80       /* 16b: the control byte, shifted right per item */
#define CONTROL_BITS  0x82       /* 16b: its bits left - 1 (negative = read a new one) */
#define WINDOW_POS    0x84       /* 16b: where the next byte goes in the window */
#define COPY_FROM     0x86       /* 16b: a copy's place in the window */
#define COPY_LEFT     0x88       /* 16b: a copy's bytes left */

static uint16_t dp16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a) { return hm_dp_r16(ram, r, a); }
static void set16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a, uint16_t v) { hm_dp_w16(ram, r, a, v); }
/* LDA [$72]; INC $72; AND #$00FF */
static uint8_t next_byte(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t b = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SOURCE, 0));
  set16(ram, r, SOURCE, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, SOURCE) + 1));
  return b;
}
/* STA [$75]; INC $75; DEC $7E: false when the size is used up */
static bool put(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t b)
{
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DEST, 0), b);
  set16(ram, r, DEST, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, DEST) + 1));
  uint16_t left = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, SIZE_LEFT) - 1);
  set16(ram, r, SIZE_LEFT, left);
  if (!left) return false;
  r->x = dp16(ram, r, WINDOW_POS);                         /* and into the window */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WINDOW + r->x, b);
  set16(ram, r, WINDOW_POS, (uint16_t)((r->x + 1) & 0x07FF));
  return true;
}

void hm_DecompressTileMap(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, r->p);                                  /* PHP */
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x < 0x0800; x += 2) hm_bus_wr16(ram, WINDOW + x, 0);
  r->x = 0x0800;
  set16(ram, r, SIZE_LEFT, hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SOURCE, 0)));
  set16(ram, r, SOURCE, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, SOURCE) + 4));
  set16(ram, r, CONTROL, 0);
  set16(ram, r, CONTROL_BITS, 0);
  set16(ram, r, WINDOW_POS, 0x07DE);
  for (;;) {
    uint16_t bit = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, CONTROL_BITS) - 1);   /* DEC $82 */
    set16(ram, r, CONTROL_BITS, bit);
    if (bit & 0x8000) {                                    /* a new control byte */
      set16(ram, r, CONTROL, next_byte(ram, r));
      set16(ram, r, CONTROL_BITS, 7);
    }
    uint16_t control = dp16(ram, r, CONTROL);
    set16(ram, r, CONTROL, (uint16_t)(control >> 1));      /* LSR $80 */
    if (control & 1) {                                     /* a literal */
      if (!put(ram, r, next_byte(ram, r))) break;
      continue;
    }
    uint8_t low = next_byte(ram, r);
    uint8_t second = next_byte(ram, r);
    r->x = second;
    set16(ram, r, COPY_LEFT, (uint16_t)((second & 0x1F) + 3));
    set16(ram, r, COPY_FROM, (uint16_t)((uint16_t)(second & 0xE0) << 3 | low));
    bool more = true;
    do {
      r->x = dp16(ram, r, COPY_FROM);
      more = put(ram, r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WINDOW + r->x));
      if (!more) break;
      set16(ram, r, COPY_FROM, (uint16_t)((dp16(ram, r, COPY_FROM) + 1) & 0x07FF));
      set16(ram, r, COPY_LEFT, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, COPY_LEFT) - 1));
    } while (dp16(ram, r, COPY_LEFT) != 0);
    if (!more) break;
  }
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, SIZE_LEFT);                          /* 0 */
  r->c = hm_pull8(ram, r) & 1;                             /* PLP */
}

```

`src/demo.c`:

```c
/*
 * demo.c — the demos the title screen shows when nobody presses a button:
 * the game plays itself on a farm of its own, driven by an event script.
 *
 * Both routines set up a fresh game (the farm's map from the ROM, a day's
 * flags from zero, a few tools and seeds), start the demo's script (group
 * $47), load its map, and then run the game a frame at a time, as GameLoop
 * does, until the script says it is over ($7F1F5C bit 2). Then the
 * chickens go, $95 = 9 and $90 = 0, and back to the title screen's demo
 * check (IntroScreen, $82:D871, JML).
 * The checks stop after the first frame (the JMP back to the wait) or at
 * that JML (HM_TOLOOP).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* Direct page */
#define NMI_STATUS        0x00   /* 8b: set by the NMI (UpdateGraphics), cleared each frame */

typedef void Fn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);

static uint32_t db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, a)); }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }

/* JSL at `at` to a routine of `bank`. Those that wait frames save the
 * flags (PHP): r->p carries the carry, 8-bit A, 16-bit indexes, D and I
 * of the entry (N, Z and V are not followed: HM_LOOSE). */
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, Fn *fn)
{
  uint8_t keep = r->p;
  r->p = (uint8_t)((keep & 0x0C) | 0x20 | (r->c & 1));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->p = keep;
}

/* What a demo starts from. The two differ in a few bytes: */
typedef struct {
  uint16_t base;        /* the routine's address: the code is laid out the same from there */
  uint16_t flags60;     /* $7F1F60 */
  uint8_t shed2;        /* $7F1F01: the shed's second row of tools */
  bool demo;            /* DemoPresentation: its own seeds, $08FD/$08FF, and $7F1F49 kept */
} Demo;

/* the fade out (from 15, 3 frames a level, to 1) and the fresh day */
static void fresh_game(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Demo *d)
{
  set_a8(r, 0x0F); *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_FADE_FROM) = 0x0F;    /* SEP #$20; REP #$10 */
  set_a8(r, 0x03); *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_FADE_FRAMES) = 0x03;
  set_a8(r, 0x01); *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_FADE_TO) = 0x01;
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(d->base + 0x10), 0x80, hm_ScreenFadeOut);
  set_a8(r, 0x06);                                         /* SEP #$20: 6:00:00 */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), 6);
  set_a8(r, 0x00);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_MINUTES), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SECONDS), 0);
  set_a8(r, 0x01);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_INTRO_STAGE) = 0x01;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_FADE_TO) = 0;
  r->a = 0;                                                /* REP #$20: the day's flags */
  static const uint32_t day[] = { WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_76), WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_78) };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 7; i++) hm_bus_wr16(ram, day[i], 0);
  r->a = d->flags60;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), d->flags60);
  r->a = 0;                                                /* the story's */
  for (uint32_t f = WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64); f <= WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_72); f += 2) hm_bus_wr16(ram, f, 0);
  if (!d->demo) hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_INTRO_STEP), 0); /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, 0x8F); hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0x8F); /* the shed */
  set_a8(r, d->shed2); hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 1), d->shed2);
  set_a8(r, 0x00); hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 2), 0); hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 3), 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED, 0);                        /* nothing in the hands */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK, 0);
  set_a8(r, 0x01);                                         /* seeds: one bag each */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_SEEDS_GRASS_N, 1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_SEEDS_TURNIP_N, 1);
  if (!d->demo) { wr8(ram, r, HM_SEEDS_CORN_N, 1); wr8(ram, r, HM_SEEDS_TOMATO_N, 1); }
  else { wr16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS, 0); wr16(ram, r, HM_WAIT_FRAMES, 0); } /* REP #$20 */
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TIMER, 0);                        /* REP #$20: the player */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0001);   /* REP #$30 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING, 0);                         /* SEP #$20: the clock stopped */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 0);                /* spring */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(0xFFFD & hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE));   /* REP #$30 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_COW_TROUGHS, 0);                         /* the animals fed */
  wr16(ram, r, HM_CHICKEN_TROUGHS, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & 0xFFFB);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), r->a);
}
/* the screen and objects cleared, the farm's map from the ROM, BG3 */
static void fresh_screen(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x80, hm_ZeroesVRAM);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 4), 0x80, hm_ZeroesCGRAM);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 8), 0x80, hm_StopAllColourAnimations);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 12), 0x85, hm_ClearSpriteDataTables);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 16), 0x85, hm_InitializeOBJs);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 20), 0x81, hm_ClearItemRecords);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 24), 0x84, hm_ClearAllEventSlots);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 28), 0x82, hm_LoadDefaultFarmMap);
  r->a = 0x0100;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  wr16(ram, r, HM_BG3_Y, 0x0100);
}
/* LDA #0; LDX #$47; LDY #script; JSL StartEventScriptLong */
static void demo_script(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t script, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = 0; r->x = 0x0047; r->y = script;                  /* REP #$30 */
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x84, hm_StartEventScriptLong);
}
/* the scripts run once, and map $098B is entered (its music, its load) */
static void demo_map(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x84, hm_RunEventSlots);
  uint8_t map = rd8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP);            /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, map);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID) = map;
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x0B), 0x80, hm_PickMapMusic);
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP));               /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x14), 0x80, hm_LoadAndShowMap);
  r->y = 0;                                                /* REP #$30 */
}
/* one frame: the wait ($90 = 0; the NMI comes back to the LDA $00 at
 * `wait`), the game's work from `work` */
static void demo_frame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t wait, uint16_t work, uint8_t entry)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MENU_FRAMES, 0);                    /* REP #$20; STZ $90 */
  for (;;) {
    uint8_t ready = *hm_dp(ram, r, NMI_STATUS);            /* SEP #$20; LDA $00; BEQ */
    set_a8(r, ready);
    if (ready) break;
    hm_nmi(ram, r, wait, (uint8_t)(entry | 0x20));
  }
  r->a = 0x1800;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET, 0x1800);
  hm_game_frame(ram, r, work);
}
/* the end: the chickens' first 8 bytes cleared, $95 = 9, $90 = 0 */
static void demo_end(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  for (r->x = 0; r->x != 8; r->x++) {                      /* REP #$30; SEP #$20 */
    set_a8(r, 0);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_DATA) + r->x, 0);
  }
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CPX #8 */
}
static void demo_leave(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_a8(r, 0x09);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_INTRO_STAGE) = 0x09;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MENU_FRAMES, 0);                    /* REP #$20 */
  g_hm_next = 0x82D871;
  /* JML IntroScreen's demo check: the check stops here (HM_TOLOOP) */
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * FirstDemo ($82:D1C0, JML from the title screen): the first demo:
 * script 0 of group $47; $7F1F60 = $0108, $7F1F49 = 0, the shed's second
 * row $88, a bag of grass, turnip, corn and tomato seeds.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_FirstDemo(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Demo d = { 0xD1C0, 0x0108, 0x88, false };
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  fresh_game(ram, r, &d);
  fresh_screen(ram, r, 0xD2F3);
  demo_script(ram, r, 0, 0xD326);
  demo_map(ram, r, 0xD32A);
  hm_DemoFrame(ram, r);
  (void)entry;
}
/* its frames ($82:D347) */
void hm_DemoFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  demo_frame(ram, r, 0xD34D, 0xD358, r->p);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & 0x0004); /* REP #$20 */
  if (!r->a) {
    *hm_dp(ram, r, NMI_STATUS) = 0;                              /* SEP #$20; STZ $00 */
    g_hm_next = 0x82D347;
    return;                                                /* JMP back to the wait: the check stops */
  }
  demo_end(ram, r);
  demo_leave(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DemoPresentation ($82:D3C7, JML from the title screen): the other
 * demos, one after the other: $7F1F48 (0-$0B) picks the script of group
 * $47 (2, 4, 6, 7, 9, $0B, $0D, $11, $15, $17, $19, $1B; any other value
 * as 0) and becomes the next one (after $0B, 0 again). $7F1F60 = 8, the
 * shed's second row $EC, a bag of grass and turnip seeds, $08FD/$08FF =
 * 0. It also ends with $7F1F60 bit 7, and, if it ended on the farm (map
 * below 4), the farm's map is kept (CopyCurrentMapToFarmMap).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_DemoPresentation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Demo d = { 0xD3C7, 0x0008, 0xEC, true };
  static const uint8_t SCRIPTS[12] = { 0x02, 0x04, 0x06, 0x07, 0x09, 0x0B, 0x0D, 0x11, 0x15, 0x17, 0x19, 0x1B };
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  fresh_game(ram, r, &d);
  fresh_screen(ram, r, 0xD4F4);
  uint8_t step = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DEMO_STEP)); /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, step);
  for (uint8_t k = 1; k <= 0x0B && step; k++) {            /* CMP #k; BNE */
    r->c = step >= k;
    if (step == k) break;
  }
  uint8_t which = step <= 0x0B ? step : 0;
  demo_script(ram, r, SCRIPTS[which], (uint16_t)(0xD57F + 0x1A * which));
  uint8_t next = which == 0x0B ? 0 : (uint8_t)(which + 1);
  set_a8(r, next);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DEMO_STEP), next);
  demo_map(ram, r, 0xD6AC);
  hm_DemoPresentationFrame(ram, r);
  (void)entry;
}
/* its frames ($82:D6C9) */
void hm_DemoPresentationFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  demo_frame(ram, r, 0xD6CF, 0xD6DA, r->p);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & 0x0004); /* REP #$20 */
  if (!r->a) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0080);
    if (!r->a) {
      *hm_dp(ram, r, NMI_STATUS) = 0;                            /* SEP #$20; STZ $00 */
      g_hm_next = 0x82D6C9;
      return;                                              /* JMP back to the wait: the check stops */
    }
  }
  demo_end(ram, r);
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);                 /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 4;
  if (map < 4) jsl(ram, r, 0xD74C, 0x82, hm_CopyCurrentMapToFarmMap);
  demo_leave(ram, r);
}
```

`src/dma.c`:

```c
/*
 * dma.c — the "programmed DMA" queue: copies to VRAM / CGRAM that the game
 * prepares during the frame and the NMI then starts all at once.
 *
 * Direct page:
 *   $27 next free channel     $28 channels to start (one bit each)
 *   $29 destination register (B-bus: $18 = VRAM data, else CGRAM...)
 *   $2A+ch  VRAM address-mode byte per channel (written to $2115 later)
 *   $32+2ch destination address per channel (VRAM / CGRAM address)
 *   $72-$74 source (24-bit)   $C7 budget of bytes left this frame
 * The channel itself is set up directly in the DMA registers $43x0-$43x6.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here (as in video.c) ────────────── */

/* Direct page */
#define DMA_CHANNEL     0x27   /* 8b: the channel to set up next */
#define DMA_WAITING     0x28   /* 8b: the channels to start, one bit each */
#define DMA_B_ADDRESS   0x29   /* 8b: the destination register (B-bus, $21xx) */
#define DMA_VMAIN       0x2A   /* 8b + channel: the VRAM address mode */
#define DMA_DESTINATION 0x32   /* 16b + 2 channel: the VRAM / CGRAM address */
#define DMA_SOURCE      0x72   /* 24b $72-$74: the source */
#define DMA_SOURCE_BANK 0x74   /* 8b: its bank */
#define LETTER_EXTRA    0x7E   /* 16b: CopyLetterToVram's 16 x A (extra bytes per half) */

/* The DMA registers: $4300 + 16 x channel (through the data bank) */
#define DMA_REGS        0x4300u
#define DMAP            0      /* 8b: the transfer mode */
#define BBAD            1      /* 8b: the B-bus register */
#define A1T             2      /* 16b: the source address */
#define A1B             4      /* 8b: the source bank */
#define DAS             5      /* 16b: the size */

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AddProgrammedDMA ($80:8A33, JSL, RTL). A = VRAM address mode for the
 * channel, X = destination address, Y = size in bytes; uses channel $27
 * and destination register $29.
 *   $32+2ch = X, $2A+ch = A,
 *   $43c0 = 1 (two registers, for VRAM $18) or 0 (one register),
 *   $43c1 = $29, $43c2-4 = source $72-$74, $43c5-6 = Y,
 *   $C7 -= Y (read back from the size register), $28 |= 1 << ch.
 * The registers are written with the data bank (STA.W $4300,X).
 * Leftovers: A = the new $28, X = channel, C = 0.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_AddProgrammedDMA(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t mode = r->a, dest = r->x, size = r->y;
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(mode >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)mode);   /* PHA */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(dest >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)dest);   /* TXA; PHA */
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);

  uint8_t ch = *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DMA_DESTINATION + 2u * ch, dest);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_VMAIN + ch) = (uint8_t)mode;

  uint32_t regs = ((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + DMA_REGS + (uint16_t)(ch << 4);
  uint8_t to = *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, regs + DMAP, to == BBAD_VRAM ? 0x01 : 0x00);  /* DMAPx */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, regs + BBAD, to);                             /* BBADx */
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, regs + A1T, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE));  /* A1TxL/H */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, regs + A1B, *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE_BANK)); /* A1Bx */
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, regs + DAS, size);                           /* DASxL/H */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET) - hm_bus_rd16(ram, regs + DAS)));

  uint8_t *to_start = hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_WAITING);
  *to_start |= hm_bus_rd8(ram, DMA_CHANNEL_BITS + ch);
  r->a = *to_start;
  r->x = ch;
  r->c = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * RemoveProgrammedDMA ($80:8AA0, JSL, RTL). Takes channel $27 out of the
 * channels to start ($28 &= ~(1 << ch)); its registers stay as they were.
 * With 8-bit A and 16-bit X, TAX copies the whole accumulator, so the
 * table index is (high byte of A : $27): the callers always have 0 there.
 * Leftovers: A = (high byte of A : the new $28), X = that index.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_RemoveProgrammedDMA(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->x = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL));
  uint8_t flag = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (DMA_CHANNEL_BITS + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  uint8_t *to_start = hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_WAITING);
  *to_start = (uint8_t)(~flag & *to_start);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | *to_start);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DrawTilemapBlock2x2 ($83:81B7, JSL, RTL). Draws a 2x2 block of BG3 tilemap
 * entries: X = VRAM address of its top row, $72-$74 = the 4 words (two
 * per row). Two 4-byte DMAs: channel 6 for the top row, channel 7 for the
 * bottom one (X + $20, one tilemap row below; source $72 + 4).
 * Used for the text box arrow (DrawTextBoxArrow).
 * Leftovers: those of the second AddProgrammedDMA; Y = 4.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_1B7_TOP     0x81CF
#define RET_1B7_BOTTOM  0x81F6

void hm_DrawTilemapBlock2x2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t top = r->x;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = 6;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS) = BBAD_VRAM;          /* VRAM data port */
  r->y = 4;
  r->a = 0x0080;
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(top >> 8));              /* PHX */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)top);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_1B7_TOP, 0x80);
  hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = 7;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS) = BBAD_VRAM;
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                 /* PLX */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(top + 0x20);
  r->y = 4;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE) + 4));
  r->a = 0x0080;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_1B7_BOTTOM, 0x80);
  hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CopyLetterToVram ($83:8166, JSL, RTL). Copies one letter of the font to VRAM:
 * X = VRAM address, $72-$74 = its graphics, A = extra width (0: one 8x8
 * tile of 16 bytes per half; each unit adds 16 bytes). Two DMAs: the top
 * half on channel 6, the bottom half (source + $100, VRAM X + $80) on
 * channel 7. $7E = 16 A.
 * Leftovers: those of the second AddProgrammedDMA; Y = 16 + 16 A.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_166_TOP     0x818A
#define RET_166_BOTTOM  0x81B5

void hm_CopyLetterToVram(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t extra = (uint16_t)(r->a << 4), top = r->x;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LETTER_EXTRA, extra);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = 6;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS) = BBAD_VRAM;          /* VRAM data port */
  r->y = (uint16_t)(0x10 + extra);
  r->a = 0x0080;
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(top >> 8));              /* PHX */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)top);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_166_TOP, 0x80);
  hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = 7;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS) = BBAD_VRAM;
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                 /* PLX */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(top + 0x80);
  r->y = (uint16_t)(0x10 + extra);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE) + 0x100));
  r->a = 0x0080;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_166_BOTTOM, 0x80);
  hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

```

`src/ending.c`:

```c
/*
 * ending.c — the game's ending.
 *
 * RanchMasteryCalculator ($83:F26D, reached with JMP from the ending's
 * script command table at $83:ECF7, returns with RTS). The "ranch
 * mastery" score the ending judges you by ($7F1F54, 0..999):
 *
 *   money          low word of the money / 128, at most 78
 *                  (= 99,840 G; the money is kept in tens of G)
 *   cows, chickens 3 points each
 *   max stamina    (max - 100) / 2   (it starts at 100)
 *   hearts         each of the five girls: (hearts & $1FF) / 16
 *   shipped crops  tomatoes, corn, potatoes, turnips: (n & $1FF) / 16
 *   happiness      / 32
 *   house          +16 first extension, +16 second
 *   children       +16 each
 *   painted house  +32 if any part is painted
 *   clock          +22        turtle shell  +21
 *   development    the ranch development score / 2 (see farm.c)
 *   each cow       happiness / 8, at most 25
 *   then capped at 999.
 *
 * Bugs of the original (HM-Decomp notes them too): the hearts and the
 * shipped counts are cut with AND #$01FF instead of being capped, so 512
 * shipped turnips count as 0 and 600 hearts as 88 (5 points). The money
 * uses only the low 16 bits of the 24-bit amount: 655,360 G count as 0.
 * The cow and chicken counts are multiplied in 8 bits (above 85 animals
 * they would wrap; the game never has that many).
 *
 * Then it starts the ending's next script (StartEventScriptLong, group 0,
 * script $46, slot $0C), sets $7F1F47 = $25 and $7F1F5E bit $8000.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The game's saved state, $7F:1Fxx (ram[] offsets 0x11Fxx), and one
 * data-bank variable. */
#define RANCH_MASTERY      0x11F54   /* $7F1F54, 16b: the score worked out here */

/* A cow's record (see animals.c) */

#define RET_COW_POINTER    0xF46D    /* JSL GetCowPointer at $83:F46A */
#define RET_NEXT_SCRIPT    0xF4C0    /* JSL StartEventScriptLong at $83:F4BD */

static uint16_t score(uint8_t *ram) { return hm_rd16(ram, RANCH_MASTERY); }
/* CLC; ADC ranch_mastery; STA (with the carry it is given) */
static void add_score(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t points, unsigned carry)
{
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)points + score(ram) + carry;
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
  hm_wr16(ram, RANCH_MASTERY, r->a);
}
/* an animal count times 3, done in 8 bits: ASL; CLC; ADC n; then the
 * 16-bit ADC keeps the carry of the 8-bit one */
static void add_three_each(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t n)
{
  uint8_t doubled = (uint8_t)(n << 1);
  unsigned sum8 = (unsigned)doubled + n;
  add_score(ram, r, (uint8_t)sum8, sum8 > 0xFF);
}
/* (value & $1FF) / 16 */
static void add_sixteenths(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t at)
{
  add_score(ram, r, (uint16_t)((hm_rd16(ram, at) & 0x01FF) >> 4), 0);
}
/* LDA flags; AND #bit; BEQ: if set, + points */
static void bonus(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t flags, uint16_t bit, uint16_t points)
{
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, flags) & bit;
  if (r->a) add_score(ram, r, points, 0);
}

void hm_RanchMasteryCalculator(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t money = (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_MONEY) >> 7);
  r->c = money >= 78;                                    /* CMP #78 */
  if (money >= 78) money = 78;
  hm_wr16(ram, RANCH_MASTERY, money);
  r->a = money;

  add_three_each(ram, r, ram[HM_COW_N]);
  add_three_each(ram, r, ram[HM_CHICKEN_N]);

  uint8_t max = ram[HM_MAX_STAMINA];
  add_score(ram, r, (uint8_t)(max - 100) >> 1, 0);

  for (int girl = 0; girl < 5; girl++) add_sixteenths(ram, r, HM_HEARTS_BASE + 2u * girl);
  add_sixteenths(ram, r, HM_SHIPPED_TOMATOES);
  add_sixteenths(ram, r, HM_SHIPPED_CORN);
  add_sixteenths(ram, r, HM_SHIPPED_POTATOES);
  add_sixteenths(ram, r, HM_SHIPPED_TURNIPS);
  add_score(ram, r, (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_HAPPINESS) >> 5), 0);

  bonus(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x0080, 16);                 /* house: second extension */
  bonus(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x0040, 16);                 /* house: first extension */
  bonus(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6E, 0x0008, 16);                 /* first child */
  bonus(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6E, 0x0004, 16);                 /* second child */
  bonus(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_66, 0x001F, 32);                 /* painted house */
  bonus(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6E, 0x4000, 22);                 /* clock */
  bonus(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6C, 0x1000, 21);                 /* turtle shell */
  add_score(ram, r, (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_RANCH_DEVELOPMENT) >> 1), 0);

  for (uint16_t cow = 0; cow < 12; cow++) {
    r->x = cow;                                          /* LDX #0 / INX */
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(cow >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)cow);   /* PHX */
    r->a = cow;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_COW_POINTER, 0x83);
    hm_GetCowPointer(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    uint32_t record = hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ANIMAL_STATUS);
    uint8_t status = hm_bus_rd8(ram, record);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (status & 1));
    r->y = 0;
    if (status & 1) {                                    /* the cow exists */
      r->y = 4;
      uint8_t points = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, COW_HAPPINESS)) >> 3);
      r->c = points >= 25;
      if (points >= 25) points = 25;
      add_score(ram, r, points, 0);
    }
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                  /* PLX */
    r->x = (uint16_t)(cow + 1);
    r->c = r->x >= 12;                                   /* CPX #12 */
  }

  r->a = score(ram);
  r->c = r->a >= 999;
  if (r->a >= 999) { r->a = 999; hm_wr16(ram, RANCH_MASTERY, 999); }

  r->a = 0; r->x = 0x0046; r->y = 0x000C;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_NEXT_SCRIPT, 0x84);
  hm_StartEventScriptLong(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  ram[HM_ENDING_STEP] = 0x25;
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5E) | 0x8000;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5E, r->a);
}

```

`src/eventcmds.c`:

```c
/*
 * eventcmds.c — commands of the event scripts (bank $84).
 *
 * An event script runs in a CC slot (see events.c): $CC-$CE points at the
 * slot, $C9 is the position in the script. Each command is a routine
 * (JSR / RTS) that does its work, moves $C9 past its bytes and usually
 * counts a frame in the slot's +10.
 *
 * Slot fields used here: +00 in use, +01 flags, +0C "can be picked up",
 * +0E state ($E0 = being sold), +10 frame counter (16b), +1A / +1C the
 * position (16b), +3F the slot's number (animals: chickens $24 + n, cows
 * $18 + n; see PlaceAnimalsOnMap in animals.c).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h.
 *
 * Direct page ($00-$FF; the hm_dp_* helpers take these offsets). The
 * scratch variables $7E-$94 mean different things in different commands:
 * each is named by its main role and its comment lists the others. */
#define DP_POINTER        0x72   /* 24b with $74: a long pointer. Mainly the animal's record
                                    ([$72],Y, GetChickenPointer / GetCowPointer); in the
                                    Jump / Set commands the address argument; StartOtherSlot
                                    and FreeOtherSlot keep this slot's pointer in it; the
                                    animation commands point it at the animation table */
#define DP_POINTER_BANK   0x74   /* 8b: DP_POINTER's bank */
#define DP_VALUE          0x7E   /* 16b scratch. Mainly the command's value: the bit mask,
                                    the word to compare with, the amount to add, the low
                                    bound (24-bit ones with DP_VALUE_HI). Finding the way to
                                    the player (dog, cow, horse): |dx|. The cow's hit(): the
                                    script number */
#define DP_VALUE_HI       0x80   /* scratch. Mainly the third byte of a 24-bit DP_VALUE;
                                    JumpIfBetweenValue: the high bound + 1; finding the way
                                    to the player: |dy| */
#define DP_DX_NEGATIVE    0x82   /* 16b scratch. Finding the way to the player: 1 when dx
                                    is negative. JumpIfBetweenValueLong: the high bound + 1
                                    (24-bit, with $84) */
#define DP_DY_NEGATIVE    0x84   /* 16b scratch. Finding the way to the player: 1 when dy
                                    is negative. JumpIfBetweenValueLong: the third byte of
                                    the high bound */
#define DP_CMP_LOW        0x92   /* 8b scratch. Mainly the byte to compare with (the low
                                    bound in JumpIfBetween); the fades: the starting
                                    brightness; to_shed: the item's bit in the shed */
#define DP_CMP_HIGH       0x93   /* 8b scratch. JumpIfBetween: the high bound + 1; the
                                    fades: frames per brightness level */

/* WRAM of the data bank ($0100-$1FFF; ram[] offsets, or through dbw / abs_db) */
#define JOY_A             0x0080

/* ROM tables */
#define EVENT_FLAG_BITS   0x8494D3   /* dw 1 << n, Events_Flags_Table */
#define INVERSE_FLAG_BITS 0x8494F3   /* Events_Inverse_Flags_Tables: ~(1 << n) */
#define WAIT_BITS         0x84B4D2   /* dw $0400, $0800, $0100, $0200, $8000 */
#define FLAG_BITS_84      0x84C014   /* DATA16_84C014: dw 1 << n */
#define ANIM_TABLE_BANK   0xB3       /* the bank of the animation tables (+33 points there) */

/* Slot numbers (see PlaceAnimalsOnMap in animals.c) */
#define MOLE_SLOT         0x0011
#define DOG_SLOT          0x0016
#define HORSE_SLOT        0x0017

/* Fields of an animal record ([$72],Y): cows 16 bytes at $7E:C1C6, chickens
 * 8 bytes at $7E:C286 */

#define COW_STATUS_RUNS_AWAY 0x10
#define MAP_BARN          0x27
#define MAP_COOP          0x28

/* ── access through [$CC] (the slot) and [$72] (an animal record) ─────── */
static uint8_t lda8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
  return v;
}
static uint8_t slot8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y)
{
  r->y = y;
  return hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, y));
}
static uint16_t slot16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y)
{
  r->y = y;
  return hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, y));
}
static void slot_w8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint8_t v)
{
  r->y = y;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, y), v);
}
static void slot_w16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint16_t v)
{
  r->y = y;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, y), v);
}
static uint8_t record8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y)
{
  r->y = y;
  return hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, y));
}
/* LDA [$CC],Y; CLC; ADC #1; STA */
static void count_frame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t v = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_FRAMES);
  r->c = v == 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(v + 1);
  slot_w16(ram, r, SLOT_FRAMES, r->a);
}
/* LDY #$3F; LDA [$CC],Y; SEC; SBC #base; XBA; LDA #0; XBA: the animal's
 * number, 8 bits, in a clean 16-bit A */
static uint16_t animal_number(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t base)
{
  uint8_t slot = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER);
  r->c = slot >= base;
  r->a = (uint8_t)(slot - base);
  return r->a;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Event_ChickenFrame ($84:9857, JSR, RTS). A chicken's every frame
 * (one command byte):
 *   - its record (GetChickenPointer) follows the slot's position;
 *   - being sold (slot +0E = $E0, chicken status bit $08, $7F1F5A bit 3):
 *     the sale: price $32 in $7F1F15/17, $09A1 = its slot, dialog $44
 *     ($096E-$0970), game state bit $40, the player idle, +0E = 0,
 *     +01 &= $57;
 *   - picked up: when the slot allows it (+0C), the player presses A with
 *     empty hands and is free to (not using a tool, not in a menu or a
 *     scene: actions $0A, $0C, $0D, $1B, $17, $04 and game state bits
 *     $04, $40, $0800 and $7F1F60 bits $06 all block it), and the chicken
 *     can be carried (status bits $0E, not $40): it is marked carried
 *     (status $20), $0920 = its slot, the slot stops (+00 = 0, +01 |= $40)
 *     and the player holds it (action 4): item $26 for a chick (status
 *     $04), $25 for a hen (status $08);
 *   - otherwise a hen (status $08) counts its timer ($093B + 2 n) up to
 *     $200; then it starts script $5D ($DE >= $55) or $5C on its slot.
 * Each frame +10 counts one (not when picked up).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static bool player_free_to_pick_up(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t BUSY_ACTIONS[] = { 0x000A, 0x000C, 0x000D, 0x001B };
  if (lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_PRESSED)) == 0) { r->c = 1; return false; } /* CMP #0 */
  uint16_t action = r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    r->c = action >= BUSY_ACTIONS[i];
    if (action == BUSY_ACTIONS[i]) return false;
  }
  uint16_t state = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE);
  if ((r->a = state & 0x0004)) return false;
  if ((r->a = state & 0x0040)) return false;
  if ((r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0x0006)) return false;
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_PAD1_NEW);
  if (!(r->a & JOY_A)) return false;                                   /* BIT #$80 */
  if ((r->a = state & 0x0800)) return false;
  r->a = action;
  r->c = action >= 0x0017;
  if (action == 0x0017) return false;
  r->c = action >= 0x0004;
  if (action == 0x0004) return false;
  return lda8(r, ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND]) == 0;
}

/* returns true when it ends the command early (the chicken was taken) */
static bool pick_up(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t status = record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  if (lda8(r, status & 0x40)) return false;
  if (!lda8(r, status & 0x0E)) return false;
  status = lda8(r, status | 0x20);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, ANIMAL_STATUS), status);
  ram[HM_CARRIED_SLOT] = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER));
  lda8(r, 0);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, 0);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x40));
  count_frame(ram, r);
  uint8_t slot = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER));
  r->c = slot >= CHICKEN_SLOT0;
  if (slot < CHICKEN_SLOT0) return false;
  uint8_t item;
  if (lda8(r, record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x04)) item = 0x26;     /* a chick */
  else if (lda8(r, record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x08)) item = 0x25; /* a hen */
  else return false;
  ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND] = lda8(r, item);
  r->a = 4;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 4);
  return true;
}

static void hen_timer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!lda8(r, record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x08)) return;
  uint16_t n = animal_number(ram, r, CHICKEN_SLOT0);
  r->c = (n >> 15) & 1;                                                /* ASL */
  r->a = r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 1);
  uint16_t timer = r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_CHICKEN_TIMERS + r->x);
  r->c = timer >= 0x0200;
  if (timer != 0x0200) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(timer + 1);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_CHICKEN_TIMERS + r->x, r->a);
    return;
  }
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_CHICKEN_TIMERS + r->x, 0);
  uint8_t de = lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_RNG_LAST));
  r->c = de >= 0x55;
  uint16_t script = de >= 0x55 ? 0x005D : 0x005C;
  uint16_t ret = de >= 0x55 ? 0x9A1F : 0x9A3D;
  r->a = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER);                                   /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA */
  r->x = 0; r->y = script;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_StartEventScript(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

static void sell(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0xFFF7;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A, r->a);
  r->a = 0x0032;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_SALE_PRICE, 0x0032);                                 /* the price */
  ram[HM_SALE_PRICE + 2] = lda8(r, 0);
  ram[HM_SOLD_CHICKEN_SLOT] = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER));
  ram[HM_INTERACTION] = lda8(r, 0x44);
  ram[HM_INTERACTION_STEP] = 0; ram[HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES] = 0;
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0040;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STATE, lda8(r, 0));
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) & 0x57));
}

void hm_Event_ChickenFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t pc = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);
  r->c = pc == 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(pc + 1);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, r->a);

  r->a = animal_number(ram, r, CHICKEN_SLOT0);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9878, 0x83);
  hm_GetChickenPointer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_X);
  r->y = CHICKEN_X; hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, CHICKEN_X), r->a);
  r->a = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_Y);
  r->y = CHICKEN_Y; hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, CHICKEN_Y), r->a);

  uint8_t state = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STATE));
  r->c = state >= 0xE0;
  if (state == 0xE0 && lda8(r, record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x08)
      && (r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x0008)) {
    sell(ram, r);
  } else if (player_free_to_pick_up(ram, r)) {
    if (pick_up(ram, r)) return;
  } else {
    hen_timer(ram, r);
  }
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Event_DogFrame ($84:AF06, JSR, RTS). The dog's every frame (slot
 * $16, one command byte):
 *   - its position goes to $7F1F2C / $7F1F2E;
 *   - a hug: the player presses A next to it, free as for picking up a
 *     chicken (see above; also not while game state bit $10): the slot
 *     stops (+00 = 0, +01 |= $40), game state bit $0800, +1 hug
 *     ($7F1F52);
 *   - otherwise every $78 frames ($0938 counts; 2 seconds) its mood
 *     changes. $7F1F58 holds one mood bit (1, 2, 4, 8 or $10) and the
 *     random byte $DE picks a script for slot $16 (StartEventScript)
 *     and maybe the next mood:
 *       1:   < $40 script $3D, mood 2;  < $C0: by $DE again, < $33 $3E,
 *            < $66 / < $99 $40, < $CC $47, else $48, mood $10
 *       2:   < $2A $3C mood 1;  < $54 $41 mood 4;  < $7E $49;  < $A8 $44
 *       4:   < $2A $3D mood 2;  < $54 $45 mood 8;  < $7E $43
 *       8:   < $2A $41 mood 4;  < $54 $46
 *       $10: < $40 $3C mood 1
 *     (otherwise it keeps doing what it does);
 *   - called ($7F1F60 bit $10): the counter restarts, the slot gets
 *     flags $28 and script $3F, speed +08 = $20 and the direction +0F
 *     towards the player along the longer axis (1 down, 2 up, 4 right,
 *     8 left, from where the player stands); $7E / $80 = |dx| / |dy|,
 *     $82 / $84 = 1 when dx / dy is negative.
 * Each frame +10 counts one.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct Mood { uint16_t below; uint8_t script; uint16_t clear, set, ret; } Mood;
#define ALWAYS 0x100   /* taken without a comparison (BRA) */

static void dog_script(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t script, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = DOG_SLOT; r->x = 0; r->y = script;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_StartEventScript(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
static void set_mood(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t clear, uint16_t set)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((hm_rd16(ram, HM_DOG_MOOD) & ~clear) | set);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_DOG_MOOD, r->a);
}
/* the first entry whose `below` the random byte is under (C from each
 * CMP); none: nothing happens */
static void choose(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t de, const Mood *m, int n)
{
  lda8(r, de);
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (m[i].below != ALWAYS) {
      r->c = de >= m[i].below;
      if (de >= m[i].below) continue;
    }
    dog_script(ram, r, m[i].script, m[i].ret);
    if (m[i].clear | m[i].set) set_mood(ram, r, m[i].clear, m[i].set);
    return;
  }
}

static void dog_mood(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Mood MOOD_2[] = {
    { 0x2A, 0x3C, 0x02, 0x01, 0xB125 }, { 0x54, 0x41, 0x02, 0x04, 0xB147 },
    { 0x7E, 0x49, 0, 0, 0xB169 },       { 0xA8, 0x44, 0, 0, 0xB17B } };
  static const Mood MOOD_4[] = {
    { 0x2A, 0x3D, 0x04, 0x02, 0xB1A2 }, { 0x54, 0x45, 0x04, 0x08, 0xB1C4 },
    { 0x7E, 0x43, 0, 0, 0xB1E6 } };
  static const Mood MOOD_8[] = {
    { 0x2A, 0x41, 0x08, 0x04, 0xB209 }, { 0x54, 0x46, 0, 0, 0xB22A } };
  static const Mood MOOD_10[] = { { 0x40, 0x3C, 0x10, 0x01, 0xB248 } };
  static const Mood MOOD_1_PLAY[] = {
    { 0x33, 0x3E, 0x01, 0x10, 0xB0B7 }, { 0x66, 0x40, 0x01, 0x10, 0xB0C8 },
    { 0x99, 0x40, 0x01, 0x10, 0xB0D9 }, { 0xCC, 0x47, 0x01, 0x10, 0xB0EA },
    { ALWAYS, 0x48, 0x01, 0x10, 0xB0FB } };

  uint8_t de = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_RNG_LAST);
  uint16_t mood = hm_rd16(ram, HM_DOG_MOOD);
  if ((r->a = mood & 0x0001)) {
    lda8(r, de);
    r->c = de >= 0x40;
    if (de < 0x40) {
      dog_script(ram, r, 0x3D, 0xB06A);
      set_mood(ram, r, 0x01, 0x02);
      return;
    }
    r->c = de >= 0x80;
    if (de >= 0x80) {
      r->c = de >= 0xC0;
      if (de >= 0xC0) return;
    }
    choose(ram, r, de, MOOD_1_PLAY, 5);
  } else if ((r->a = mood & 0x0002)) {
    choose(ram, r, de, MOOD_2, 4);
  } else if ((r->a = mood & 0x0004)) {
    choose(ram, r, de, MOOD_4, 3);
  } else if ((r->a = mood & 0x0008)) {
    choose(ram, r, de, MOOD_8, 2);
  } else if ((r->a = mood & 0x0010)) {
    choose(ram, r, de, MOOD_10, 1);
  }
}

/* the free-hands test of the dog: the chicken's, in a slightly different
 * order and also blocked by game state bit $10 */
static bool player_free_to_hug(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t BUSY_ACTIONS[] = { 0x000A, 0x000C, 0x000D, 0x001B };
  if (lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_PRESSED)) == 0) { r->c = 1; return false; }
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    uint16_t action = r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
    r->c = action >= BUSY_ACTIONS[i];
    if (action == BUSY_ACTIONS[i]) return false;
  }
  uint16_t state = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE);
  if ((r->a = state & 0x0004)) return false;
  if ((r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0x0006)) return false;
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_PAD1_NEW);
  if (!(r->a & JOY_A)) return false;
  if (lda8(r, ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND])) return false;
  if ((r->a = state & 0x0800)) return false;
  if ((r->a = state & 0x0010)) return false;
  uint16_t action = r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  r->c = action >= 0x0017;
  if (action == 0x0017) return false;
  r->a = action;
  r->c = action >= 0x0004;
  return action != 0x0004;
}

/* |a - b| into dp `out`; dp `negative` = 1 if a < b */
static uint16_t distance(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b, unsigned out,
                         unsigned negative)
{
  r->c = a >= b;
  uint16_t d = (uint16_t)(a - b);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, out, d);
  r->a = d;
  if (d & 0x8000) {
    d = (uint16_t)(-d);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, out, d);
    r->a = 1;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, negative, 1);
  }
  return d;
}

static void dog_called(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  ram[HM_DOG_TIMER] = 0;
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x28));
  r->a = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER);                       /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA */
  r->x = 0; r->y = 0x003F;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xB2AD, 0x84);
  hm_StartEventScript(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE, 0);
  uint16_t dx = distance(ram, r, slot16(ram, r, SLOT_X), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X),
                         DP_VALUE, DP_DX_NEGATIVE);
  uint16_t dy = distance(ram, r, slot16(ram, r, SLOT_Y), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y),
                         DP_VALUE_HI, DP_DY_NEGATIVE);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT, lda8(r, 0x20));
  r->a = dy;
  r->c = dy >= dx;
  uint8_t direction;
  if (dy >= dx) direction = (r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE)) ? 0x01 : 0x02;
  else          direction = (r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE)) ? 0x04 : 0x08;
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FORCED_DIR, lda8(r, direction));
}

void hm_Event_DogFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t pc = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);
  r->c = pc == 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(pc + 1);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, r->a);
  r->a = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_X); hm_wr16(ram, HM_DOG_X, r->a);
  r->a = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_Y); hm_wr16(ram, HM_DOG_Y, r->a);

  if (player_free_to_hug(ram, r)) {
    slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, lda8(r, 0));
    slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x40));
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0800;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_DOG_HUGS) + 1);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_DOG_HUGS, r->a);
  } else {
    uint8_t t = lda8(r, ram[HM_DOG_TIMER]);
    r->c = t >= 0x78;
    if (t != 0x78) {
      ram[HM_DOG_TIMER] = lda8(r, (uint8_t)(t + 1));
    } else {
      ram[HM_DOG_TIMER] = 0;
      dog_mood(ram, r);
    }
  }
  if ((r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0x0010)) dog_called(ram, r);
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * The small commands. $C9-$CB points at the command byte; arguments
 * follow it. Each command moves $C9 on with CLC; ADC (A = the new $C9, C
 * its carry), which is what most of them leave behind.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
static void advance(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n)
{
  uint16_t pc = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);
  r->c = (uint32_t)pc + n > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(pc + n);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, r->a);
}
static void step_back(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)            /* SEC; SBC #1 */
{
  uint16_t pc = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);
  r->c = pc >= 1;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(pc - 1);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, r->a);
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA [$C9] */
static uint8_t arg8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  return lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, 0)));
}
/* LDA #0; XBA; LDA [$C9]: the byte in a clean 16-bit A */
static uint16_t arg8_word(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  return r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, 0));
}
/* REP #$20; LDA [$C9] */
static uint16_t arg16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  return r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, 0));
}
/* jump: $C9 = the word at [$C9] */
static void jump(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, arg16(ram, r));
}
/* LDA #0; XBA; LDA [$C9]; ASL; TAX; LDA Events_Flags_Table,X */
static uint16_t flag_bit_arg(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t n = arg8_word(ram, r);
  r->c = (n >> 15) & 1;
  r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 1);
  return r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, EVENT_FLAG_BITS + r->x);
}
/* the 24-bit address argument of the Jumpif commands: $72-$74 */
static void address_arg(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_POINTER, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_POINTER_BANK) = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_SetWantedSong ($84:89BB): $0110 = the argument (a sound request).
 * Two bytes. */
void hm_Event_SetWantedSong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_WANTED_SONG] = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_TimeRunning ($84:89E3) / Event_TimeStopped ($84:8A0D): the clock
 * runs or stops ($0973), with $7F1F5C bit 0 = stopped and $0196 bit $20
 * = running. */
void hm_Event_TimeRunning(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_TIME_RUNNING] = lda8(r, 1);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C) & 0xFFFE; hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C, r->a);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) | 0x0020;  hm_wr16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, r->a);
}
void hm_Event_TimeStopped(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_TIME_RUNNING] = lda8(r, 0);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C) | 0x0001; hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C, r->a);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0xFFDF;  hm_wr16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, r->a);
}

/* Event_SetHour ($84:8A39): the hour = the argument. */
void hm_Event_SetHour(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_HOUR] = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_DoNothing ($84:8A58): nothing; one byte. */
void hm_Event_DoNothing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { advance(ram, r, 1); }

/* Event_SetPlayerPosition ($84:8A65): X, Y words; also the transition's
 * destination ($017D / $017F). */
void hm_Event_SetPlayerPosition(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TRANSITION_X, arg16(ram, r)); hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X, r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TRANSITION_Y, arg16(ram, r)); hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y, r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_SetTransitionDest ($84:8A94): $098B = the map to go to. */
void hm_Event_SetTransitionDest(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_TRANSITION_MAP] = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* Event_SetPlayerDirection ($84:8ABF): facing = the argument (also $0911
 * and the animation request $0901). */
void hm_Event_SetPlayerDirection(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint16_t d = arg8_word(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, d);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_PLAYER_TURN, d);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, d);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_DisablePlayerControl ($84:8AE7) / Event_EnablePlayerControl
 * ($84:8CFD): game state bit $4000 off / on; turning it off also clears
 * $08FD / $08FF. */
void hm_Event_DisablePlayerControl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0xBFFF;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS, 0);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_WAIT_FRAMES, 0);
}
void hm_Event_EnablePlayerControl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x4000;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}

/* Event_StartOtherSlot ($84:8B08): start another slot (argument 1) on a
 * script of the same bank (word argument 2, the bank taken from this
 * slot's +32): it is reset (ResetCurrentEventSlotLong) and +3F = its
 * number; then $CC goes back to this slot. Four bytes. */
void hm_Event_StartOtherSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_POINTER, r->a);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_POINTER_BANK) = lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK));
  hm_push8(ram, r, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK)));      /* PHA */
  r->a = arg8_word(ram, r);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8B36, 0x84);
  hm_SetEventSlotPointer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK, lda8(r, hm_pull8(ram, r)));    /* PLA */
  hm_push8(ram, r, arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w16(ram, r, SLOT_SCRIPT, arg16(ram, r));
  hm_push8(ram, r, 0x8B); hm_push8(ram, r, 0x5F);                  /* JSR */
  hm_ResetCurrentEventSlotLong(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER, lda8(r, hm_pull8(ram, r)));
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_POINTER);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, r->a);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK) = lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_POINTER_BANK));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_SetSceneFlag ($84:8BAC): $7F1F7A |= bit n. Event_UNKCompare-
 * set7Aflag ($84:8BDC): waits until bit n of $7F1F7A is set (otherwise
 * $C9 steps back onto the command and +10 counts a frame). */
void hm_Event_SetSceneFlag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = flag_bit_arg(ram, r) | hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_7A);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_7A, r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}
void hm_Event_WaitForSceneFlag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = flag_bit_arg(ram, r) & hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_7A);
  if (r->a) { advance(ram, r, 1); return; }
  step_back(ram, r);
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* Event_MoveSlot ($84:8C22): the slot's +03, +04, the low byte of
 * +10, and +05 = +06 from four argument bytes; +01 |= $20. */
void hm_Event_MoveSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_X, arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_Y, arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FRAMES, arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t v = arg8(ram, r);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_DELAY, v);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_TIMER, v);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x20));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_FreeOwnSlot ($84:8CE2): the slot is no longer in use (and
 * $C9 does not move). */
void hm_Event_FreeOwnSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, lda8(r, 0));
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* Event_JumpToInstruction ($84:8D13): goto the word argument. */
void hm_Event_JumpToInstruction(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  jump(ram, r);
}

/* Event_WaitFrames ($84:8D24): the slot's +10 = the word argument. */
void hm_Event_WaitFrames(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w16(ram, r, SLOT_FRAMES, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_JumpIfFlagSet ($84:8D44): address (24-bit), bit number, target:
 * goto target if that bit of the word at the address is set. */
void hm_Event_JumpIfFlagSet(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, flag_bit_arg(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, 0)) & hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  if (r->a) jump(ram, r);
  else advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_JumpIfEquals ($84:8DA5): address, value, target: goto target if
 * the byte at the address equals the value. */
void hm_Event_JumpIfEquals(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW) = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t v = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, 0)));
  uint8_t k = *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW);
  r->c = v >= k;
  if (v == k) jump(ram, r);
  else advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_JumpIfBetween ($84:8DFB): address, low, high, target: goto target
 * if low <= byte <= high (the high bound + 1 is kept in 8 bits: $FF means
 * nothing is below it). */
void hm_Event_JumpIfBetween(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW) = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_HIGH) = lda8(r, (uint8_t)(arg8(ram, r) + 1));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint32_t at = hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, 0);
  uint8_t v = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, at));
  r->c = v >= *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW);
  if (v >= *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW)) {
    v = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, at));
    r->c = v >= *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_HIGH);
    if (v < *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_HIGH)) { jump(ram, r); return; }
  }
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_GetRNG ($84:8E68): the slot's +0D = a roll of an n-sided die. */
void hm_Event_GetRNG(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  arg8(ram, r);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8E7B, 0x80);
  hm_RNGReturn0toA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_ROLL, (uint8_t)r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_JumpIfEqualsRNG ($84:8E90): value, target: goto target if the
 * last roll (+0D) equals the value. */
void hm_Event_JumpIfEqualsRNG(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW, arg16(ram, r));
  uint8_t roll = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_ROLL));
  uint8_t k = *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW);
  r->c = roll >= k;
  if (roll == k) {
    advance(ram, r, 1);
    jump(ram, r);
  } else {
    advance(ram, r, 3);
  }
}

/* Event_SetPlayerAnimation ($84:8EC9): $0901 = the word argument (the
 * player's animation), $090F = the byte argument * 64, game state bit
 * $2000. */
void hm_Event_SetPlayerAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint16_t v = arg8_word(ram, r);
  r->c = (v >> 10) & 1;                                  /* the 6th ASL */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(v << 6);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_PLAYER_FLIP, r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x2000;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * More commands: values at any address, picking things up, waits.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
static uint32_t at72(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y)
{
  return hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, y);
}
/* the word / 24-bit value at [$72] */
static uint16_t value16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, at72(ram, r, 0)); }

/* ── Jumps on values ─────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Event_JumpIfEqualsValue ($84:B666): address, word, target: goto target
 * if the word at the address equals it. */
void hm_Event_JumpIfEqualsValue(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint16_t v = r->a = value16(ram, r);
  r->c = v >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  if (v == hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE)) jump(ram, r);
  else advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_JumpIfEqualsValueLong ($84:B6BC): the same with a 24-bit value. */
void hm_Event_JumpIfEqualsValueLong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_VALUE_HI) = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint16_t low = r->a = value16(ram, r);
  r->c = low >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  if (low == hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE)) {
    r->y = 2;
    uint8_t high = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, at72(ram, r, 2)));
    r->c = high >= *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_VALUE_HI);
    if (high == *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_VALUE_HI)) { jump(ram, r); return; }
  }
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_JumpIfBetweenValue ($84:B72D): address, low, high (words),
 * target: goto target if low <= word <= high (high + 1 in 16 bits). */
void hm_Event_JumpIfBetweenValue(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(arg16(ram, r) + 1);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE_HI, r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint16_t v = r->a = value16(ram, r);
  r->c = v >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  if (v >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE)) {
    v = r->a = value16(ram, r);
    r->c = v >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE_HI);
    if (v < hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE_HI)) { jump(ram, r); return; }
  }
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_JumpIfBetweenValueLong ($84:B79A): the same with 24-bit values
 * (each compare is CMP on the low word, then SBC on the high byte). */
static bool at_least24(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, unsigned bound)
{
  uint16_t low = r->a = value16(ram, r);
  r->c = low >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, bound);                  /* CMP */
  r->y = 2;
  uint8_t high = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, at72(ram, r, 2)));
  unsigned borrow = !r->c;
  r->c = (unsigned)high >= (unsigned)*hm_dp(ram, r, bound + 2) + borrow;   /* SBC */
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)(high - *hm_dp(ram, r, bound + 2) - borrow));
  return r->c;
}
void hm_Event_JumpIfBetweenValueLong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, arg16(ram, r)); advance(ram, r, 2);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_VALUE_HI) = arg8(ram, r);     advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE, arg16(ram, r)); advance(ram, r, 2);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE) = arg8(ram, r);     advance(ram, r, 1);
  /* high + 1, 24 bits */
  uint16_t low = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE);
  r->c = low == 0xFFFF;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE, (uint16_t)(low + 1));
  uint8_t high = *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE);
  unsigned sum = (unsigned)high + r->c;
  r->c = sum > 0xFF;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE) = lda8(r, (uint8_t)sum);
  if (at_least24(ram, r, 0x7E) && !at_least24(ram, r, 0x82)) {
    jump(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_JumpIfAnswer ($84:919D): value, target: goto target if $018F
 * equals the value. */
void hm_Event_JumpIfAnswer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW) = arg8(ram, r);
  uint8_t v = lda8(r, ram[HM_ANSWER]);
  r->c = v >= *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW);
  if (v == *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW)) {
    advance(ram, r, 1);
    jump(ram, r);
  } else {
    advance(ram, r, 3);
  }
}

/* ── Values ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Event_SetFlag ($84:9306): address, bit: the word at the address |= the
 * bit. */
void hm_Event_SetFlag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, flag_bit_arg(ram, r));
  r->a = value16(ram, r) | hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, at72(ram, r, 0), r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_StoreValue ($84:A90F): address, word: store it. */
void hm_Event_StoreValue(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, at72(ram, r, 0), arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

/* Event_SetValueByte ($84:B84C): address, byte: store it. */
void hm_Event_SetValueByte(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, at72(ram, r, 0), arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_SetValueLong ($84:B889): address, 24-bit value: store it. */
void hm_Event_SetValueLong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, at72(ram, r, 0), arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint8_t high = arg8(ram, r);
  r->y = 2;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, at72(ram, r, 2), high);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_AddToByteClamped ($84:91D2; not about text): address, signed byte:
 * add it to the byte at the address, kept in 0..255. */
void hm_Event_AddToByteClamped(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  uint8_t d = (uint8_t)arg8_word(ram, r);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(int16_t)(int8_t)d;                     /* BPL; XBA; LDA #$FF; XBA */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint16_t v = hm_bus_rd8(ram, at72(ram, r, 0));
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)v + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
  if (r->a & 0x8000) {
    lda8(r, 0);                                            /* below 0 */
  } else {
    r->c = r->a >= 0x00FF;
    if (r->a >= 0x00FF) lda8(r, 0xFF);                     /* above 255 */
  }
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, at72(ram, r, 0), (uint8_t)r->a);
}

/* Event_AddToWordMax999 ($84:B5A9): address, signed word: add it to the
 * word at the address, kept in 0..999. */
void hm_Event_AddToWordMax999(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)value16(ram, r) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, at72(ram, r, 0), r->a);
  if (r->a & 0x8000) {
    r->a = 0;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, at72(ram, r, 0), 0);
    return;
  }
  r->c = r->a >= 999;
  if (r->a >= 999) {
    r->a = 999;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, at72(ram, r, 0), 999);
  }
}

/* Event_ChangeMoney ($84:B602): two 24-bit arguments; the first is read
 * and then overwritten by the second (quirk: only the second counts),
 * which is added to the money (AddMoney, signed, in tens of G). If the
 * money would go below 0 it becomes 0: the script never "can't pay". */
void hm_Event_ChangeMoney(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);                                     /* read, then lost */
  address_arg(ram, r);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xB651, 0x83);
  hm_AddMoney(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  if (r->a != 0) {                                         /* would be negative */
    r->a = 0;
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_MONEY, 0);
    ram[HM_MONEY_HIGH] = lda8(r, 0);
  }
}

/* ── The slot ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Event_SetSlotSprite ($84:8F9B): +16 = word, +14 = byte * 64, +01 |= 4. */
void hm_Event_SetSlotSprite(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w16(ram, r, SLOT_SPRITE, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint16_t v = arg8_word(ram, r);
  r->c = (v >> 10) & 1;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(v << 6);
  slot_w16(ram, r, SLOT_ANIMATION, r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x04));
}

/* start a walk: +36 = word, +07 = +08 = byte, +01 |= flags, and the
 * starting point +1E / +20 = the position +1A / +1C */
static void start_walk(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t flags)
{
  slot_w16(ram, r, SLOT_WALK_TABLE, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint8_t v = arg8(ram, r);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_WALK_STEPS, v);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT, v);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | flags));
  r->a = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_X); slot_w16(ram, r, SLOT_HOME_X, r->a);
  r->a = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_Y); slot_w16(ram, r, SLOT_HOME_Y, r->a);
}

/* Event_WanderInArea ($84:923F): +09, +0A, +0B (= +05 = +06), then a
 * walk with flags $28. */
void hm_Event_WanderInArea(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_RANGE_X, arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_RANGE_Y, arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t v = arg8(ram, r);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_WALK_DELAY, v);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_DELAY, v);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_TIMER, v);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  start_walk(ram, r, 0x28);
}

/* Event_WanderFreely ($84:9777): +0B (= +05 = +06), then a walk with
 * flags $A8. */
void hm_Event_WanderFreely(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t v = arg8(ram, r);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_WALK_DELAY, v);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_DELAY, v);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_TIMER, v);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  start_walk(ram, r, 0xA8);
}

/* Event_MakeSlotPassable ($84:BA51): +00 |= 2. */
void hm_Event_MakeSlotPassable(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE) | 0x02));
}

/* ── Waiting for the player ──────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Event_WalkPlayer ($84:B389) / 13 ($84:B427): a wait. The first
 * frame: $08FD |= the allowed input (table $84:B4D2: entry n; 13 also
 * adds entry 4, $8000), $08FF = frames, game state bit $1000, and the
 * script stays on the command. Then each frame $08FF counts down; at 0
 * everything is cleared, the player goes idle and the script moves on
 * (4 bytes). */
static void wait_frames(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, bool also_entry_4)
{
  if ((r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x1000)) {
    uint16_t left = r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_WAIT_FRAMES);
    if (left) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(left - 1);
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_WAIT_FRAMES, r->a);
      count_frame(ram, r);
      return;
    }
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS, 0);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_WAIT_FRAMES, 0);
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0xEFFF;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
    r->a = 0;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
    advance(ram, r, 4);
    return;
  }
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint16_t n = arg8_word(ram, r);
  r->c = (n >> 15) & 1;
  r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WAIT_BITS + r->x) | hm_rd16(ram, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS, r->a);
  if (also_entry_4) {
    r->x = 8;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WAIT_BITS + 8) | hm_rd16(ram, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS, r->a);
  }
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_WAIT_FRAMES, arg16(ram, r));
  uint16_t pc = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);          /* back onto the command */
  r->c = pc >= 2;                                          /* SEC; SBC #2 */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(pc - 2);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, r->a);
  count_frame(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x1000;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
void hm_Event_WalkPlayer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { wait_frames(ram, r, false); }
void hm_Event_RunPlayer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { wait_frames(ram, r, true); }

/* Event_WaitUntilSkippable ($84:B365): wait until $7F1F5A bit $8000. */
void hm_Event_WaitUntilSkippable(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if ((r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x8000)) advance(ram, r, 1);
  else count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* ── Picking things up: the mole, the fish, ... ──────────────────────── */

/* the free-hands tests, in each command's own order */
enum { T_SLOT_0C, T_BUSY, T_STATE, T_FLAGS_60, T_JOY_A, T_ITEM, T_ACTION };
typedef struct Test { uint8_t kind; uint16_t value; } Test;

static bool free_hands(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Test *t, int n)
{
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    switch (t[i].kind) {
    case T_SLOT_0C:
      if (lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_PRESSED)) == 0) { r->c = 1; return false; }
      break;
    case T_BUSY: {                         /* LDA action; CMP #v, each reloaded */
      static const uint16_t busy[] = { 0x000A, 0x000C, 0x000D, 0x001B };
      for (unsigned k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
        uint16_t action = r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
        r->c = action >= busy[k];
        if (action == busy[k]) return false;
      }
      break;
    }
    case T_STATE:
      if ((r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & t[i].value)) return false;
      break;
    case T_FLAGS_60:
      if ((r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0x0006)) return false;
      break;
    case T_JOY_A:
      r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_PAD1_NEW);
      if (!(r->a & JOY_A)) return false;
      break;
    case T_ITEM:
      if (lda8(r, ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND])) return false;
      break;
    case T_ACTION: {
      uint16_t action = r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
      r->c = action >= t[i].value;
      if (action == t[i].value) return false;
      break;
    }
    }
  }
  return true;
}
/* taken: the slot stops, the player carries `item` (action 4) */
static void carry(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t item, bool remember_slot)
{
  if (remember_slot) ram[HM_CARRIED_SLOT] = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER));
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, lda8(r, 0));
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x40));
  count_frame(ram, r);
  ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND] = lda8(r, item);
  r->a = 4;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 4);
}

static const Test FREE_LONG[] = {
  { T_SLOT_0C, 0 }, { T_BUSY, 0 }, { T_STATE, 0x0004 }, { T_FLAGS_60, 0 }, { T_JOY_A, 0 },
  { T_STATE, 0x0800 }, { T_ACTION, 0x0017 }, { T_ITEM, 0 } };
static const Test FREE_SHORT[] = {
  { T_SLOT_0C, 0 }, { T_BUSY, 0 }, { T_STATE, 0x0004 }, { T_FLAGS_60, 0 }, { T_JOY_A, 0 },
  { T_ITEM, 0 } };

/* Event_PickUpMole ($84:A94C): the mole after the hoe finds it. Picked
 * up: item $29. Otherwise every $B4 frames (3 seconds, $093A), half the
 * time ($DE bit 7) it starts script $81 on slot $11. */
void hm_Event_PickUpMole(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  if (free_hands(ram, r, FREE_LONG, 8)) { carry(ram, r, 0x29, true); return; }
  uint8_t t = lda8(r, ram[HM_MOLE_TIMER]);
  r->c = t >= 0xB4;
  if (t != 0xB4) {
    ram[HM_MOLE_TIMER] = lda8(r, (uint8_t)(t + 1));
  } else {
    ram[HM_MOLE_TIMER] = 0;
    if (lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_RNG_LAST) & 0x80)) {
      r->a = MOLE_SLOT; r->x = 0; r->y = 0x0081;
      hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xAA4E, 0x84);
      hm_StartEventScript(ram, r);
      hm_rtl(ram, r);
    }
  }
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* Event_PickUpFish ($84:AA5D): picked up: item $07 (a fish). */
void hm_Event_PickUpFish(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  if (free_hands(ram, r, FREE_SHORT, 6)) { carry(ram, r, 0x07, true); return; }
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* Event_PickUpPowerBerry ($84:B93C): picked up: item $08 (the slot is not
 * remembered in $0920). */
void hm_Event_PickUpPowerBerry(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  if (free_hands(ram, r, FREE_LONG, 8)) { carry(ram, r, 0x08, false); return; }
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* ── The player, places, flags ───────────────────────────────────────── */

/* Event_SetItemOnHand ($84:B556): the player carries the item (action 4).
 * Event_ChangeItemOnHand ($84:B4DC): the item, and game state bit 2.
 * Event_DropItemAnimation ($84:B57B): action 5 (put it down). */
void hm_Event_SetItemOnHand(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND] = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = 4;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 4);
}
void hm_Event_ChangeItemOnHand(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND] = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0002;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
void hm_Event_DropItemAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = 5;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 5);
}

/* Event_TransitionToMap ($84:B52D): go to map n ($098B; $0196 bit $4000
 * starts the transition). Event_TransitionToHouse ($84:B503): go home
 * (map $15) and $7F1F60 bit $20. */
void hm_Event_TransitionToMap(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_TRANSITION_MAP] = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) | 0x4000;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, r->a);
}
void hm_Event_TransitionToHouse(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  ram[HM_TRANSITION_MAP] = lda8(r, 0x15);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) | 0x4000;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, r->a);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) | 0x0020;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60, r->a);
}

/* Event_MapScrolling ($84:9513): the camera moves by itself: X speed, Y
 * speed (words) for n frames ($087C / $087E / $0880). */
void hm_Event_MapScrolling(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_CAMERA_SPEED_X, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_CAMERA_SPEED_Y, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  ram[HM_CAMERA_FRAMES] = arg8(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* flags of $7F1F5C / $7F1F60: Event_IgnoreTileProperties ($84:B58F) / Event_UseTileProperties
 * ($84:BB31) bit 3 of $7F1F5C; Event_DisableTools ($84:BB4B) bit 15 of
 * $7F1F60. */
void hm_Event_IgnoreTileProperties(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C) | 0x0008; hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C, r->a);
}
void hm_Event_UseTileProperties(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C) & 0xFFF7; hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C, r->a);
}
void hm_Event_DisableTools(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) | 0x8000; hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60, r->a);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Event_CowFrame ($84:9AD4, JSR, RTS). A cow's every frame (one
 * command byte). The cow's record is [$72] (GetCowPointer, 16 bytes):
 *   +00 status: $02 calf, $04 young, $08 adult, $10 runs away from the
 *       player, $20 sick, $40 pregnant / in labour
 *   +01 today's flags: $01 brushed, $02 milked, $04 talked to, $08 moving,
 *       $80 bred
 *   +02 map, +03 days pregnant ($15 = just bred), +04 happiness,
 *   +05 times hit (up to 10), +08 / +0A position
 * $0953 + 2 n: a timer per cow that counts to $100 between wanderings.
 * The slot's +02 is the cow's colour / kind (0-3): every script has four
 * versions, one per kind.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
static void rec_w8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint8_t v)
{
  r->y = y;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, y), v);
}
static void rec_w16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint16_t v)
{
  r->y = y;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, y), v);
}
static void rec_or(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint8_t bits)
{
  rec_w8(ram, r, y, lda8(r, (uint8_t)(record8(ram, r, y) | bits)));
}
static void rec_and(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint8_t bits)
{
  rec_w8(ram, r, y, lda8(r, (uint8_t)(record8(ram, r, y) & bits)));
}
/* StartEventScript: script `script` on the cow's own slot */
```
