```c
static void cow_script(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t script, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER);
  r->x = 0;
  r->y = script;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_StartEventScript(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* the slot's +02 picks one of four versions of a script; any other value
 * falls into the first */
static void cow_script4(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t first, uint16_t ret)
{
  uint8_t kind = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY);
  cow_script(ram, r, (uint16_t)(first + (kind <= 3 ? kind : 0)), ret);
}
static void cow_happier(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = n;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_AddCowHappiness(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* X = 2 n: the cow's timer */
static uint16_t cow_timer_x(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->x = (uint16_t)(animal_number(ram, r, COW_SLOT0) << 1);
  return r->x;
}
/* the timer: true when it reached $100 (and starts again from 0) */
static bool cow_timer_done(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t x = cow_timer_x(ram, r);
  uint16_t t = hm_rd16(ram, HM_COW_TIMERS + x);
  if (t != 0x0100) { hm_wr16(ram, HM_COW_TIMERS + x, (uint16_t)(t + 1)); return false; }
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_COW_TIMERS + x, 0);
  return true;
}
/* adult cows: the script by how it feels */
static uint16_t adult_script(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t sick, uint16_t runs, uint16_t normal)
{
  uint8_t st = record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  r->x = (st & 0x20) ? sick : (st & 0x10) ? runs : normal;
  return r->x;
}

/* the reaction after talking, brushing...: by its age */
static bool reaction(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   /* true: on to the wandering */
{
  uint8_t st = record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  if (st & 0x30) return true;                         /* sick or runs away: none */
  if (st & 0x02) { cow_script4(ram, r, 0x64, 0x9D42); return false; }
  if (st & 0x04) { cow_script4(ram, r, 0x60, 0x9DBA); return false; }
  if (st & 0x40) cow_script4(ram, r, 0x82, 0xA0B8);
  else           cow_script4(ram, r, 0x0C, 0xA0B8);
  return true;
}

static bool talk(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++)                    /* $0889-$088F: what it says */
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_TEXT_NAME + 2 * i, record8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(COW_NAME + i)));
  uint8_t st = record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  uint16_t text = (st & 0x40) ? (record8(ram, r, COW_DAYS) ? 0x0032 : 0x0145)
                : (st & 0x20) ? 0x0031 : (st & 0x10) ? 0x0030 : 0x002F;
  ram[HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES] = 0;
  ram[HM_INPUT_STATE] = lda8(r, 2);
  r->x = text;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9C75, 0x83);
  hm_StartTextBox(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  if (record8(ram, r, COW_DAILY) & 0x04) return true; /* already talked to today */
  rec_or(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0x04);
  cow_happier(ram, r, 1, 0x9C97);
  return reaction(ram, r);
}

static bool milk(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!(record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x08) || (record8(ram, r, COW_DAILY) & 0x02)
      || (record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x70))
    return true;
  rec_or(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0x02);
  uint8_t h = record8(ram, r, COW_HAPPINESS);
  ram[HM_ITEM_ON_HAND] = h < 0x60 ? 0x15 : h < 0xC0 ? 0x16 : 0x17; /* milk S / M / L */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 4);
  cow_script4(ram, r, 0x0C, 0xA0B8);
  return true;
}

static bool brush(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (record8(ram, r, COW_DAILY) & 0x01) return true;
  rec_or(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0x01);
  cow_happier(ram, r, 3, 0x9ECF);
  return reaction(ram, r);
}

static bool hit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)            /* a tool hits it */
{
  uint8_t st = record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  uint16_t script = (st & 0x08) ? 0x0A : (st & 0x04) ? 0x68 : (st & 0x02) ? 0x6A : 0x0A;
  uint8_t kind = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY);
  if (kind != 0 && kind != 2) script++;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, script);
  if (record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x70) return true;
  cow_script(ram, r, script, 0x9FA7);
  uint8_t hits = record8(ram, r, COW_HITS);
  if (hits != 0x0A) rec_w8(ram, r, COW_HITS, (uint8_t)(hits + 1));
  return true;
}

static bool breed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)          /* the miracle potion worked */
{
  if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_64) & 0x0004) return true;
  if (ram[HM_COW_N] == 0x0C) return true;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_64, (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_64) | 0x0004));
  rec_and(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS, 0xCF);
  rec_or(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0x80);
  cow_happier(ram, r, 10, 0x9E92);
  rec_w8(ram, r, COW_DAYS, 0x15);
  ram[HM_PREGNANCY_DAYS] = 0x15;
  ram[HM_COW_N]++;
  cow_script4(ram, r, 0x0C, 0xA0B8);
  return true;
}

static bool cured(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)          /* the medicine worked */
{
  rec_and(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS, 0xDF);
  rec_w8(ram, r, COW_DAYS, 0);
  cow_script4(ram, r, 0x0C, 0xA0B8);
  return true;
}

static bool use_tool(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t t = ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED];
  if (t == 0) return true;
  if (t < 0x05 || (t >= 0x11 && t < 0x15)) return hit(ram, r);
  if (t == 0x0E) return milk(ram, r);
  if (t == 0x0F) return brush(ram, r);
  return true;
}

/* 849B45: the player and the cow. true: go on to the wandering (84A0B9),
 * false: straight to the moving part (84A46E). */
static bool interact(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t BUSY[] = { 0x000A, 0x000C, 0x000D, 0x001B };
  if (slot8(ram, r, SLOT_PRESSED) == 0) return true;
  uint16_t action = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (action == BUSY[i]) return true;
  uint16_t state = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE);
  if ((state & 0x0004) || (state & 0x0040) || (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0x0006)) return true;
  if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_PAD1_NEW) & JOY_A) return talk(ram, r);
  if (record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x08) {
    if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x0100) return breed(ram, r);
    if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x0080) return cured(ram, r);
  }
  if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x0040) return use_tool(ram, r);
  return true;
}

/* 84A0B9: every $100 frames the cow starts a wandering script, by age
 * and the dice ($DE); the moving flag (+01 $08) is set for the first. */
static void wander(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t CALF[4] = { 0x78, 0x79, 0x7A, 0x7B }, YOUNG[4] = { 0x74, 0x76, 0x77, 0x75 };
  static const uint16_t RET_CALF[4] = { 0xA144, 0xA16F, 0xA19A, 0xA1C5 };
  static const uint16_t RET_YOUNG[4] = { 0xA231, 0xA25C, 0xA287, 0xA2B2 };
  uint8_t st = record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  if (st & 0x08) {
    if (!cow_timer_done(ram, r) || (record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & 0x40)) return;
    static const struct { uint8_t below; uint16_t sick, runs, normal, ret; } ADULT[5] = {
      { 0x33, 0x6C, 0x70, 0x5E, 0xA34E }, { 0x66, 0x6D, 0x71, 0x51, 0xA395 },
      { 0x99, 0x6E, 0x72, 0x53, 0xA3DC }, { 0xCC, 0x6F, 0x73, 0x54, 0xA423 },
      { 0x00, 0x6D, 0x71, 0x55, 0xA46A },
    };
    uint8_t dice = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_RNG_LAST);
    unsigned k = 0;
    while (k < 4 && dice >= ADULT[k].below) k++;
    if (k == 0) rec_or(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0x08); else rec_and(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0xF7);
    uint16_t s = adult_script(ram, r, ADULT[k].sick, ADULT[k].runs, ADULT[k].normal);
    cow_script(ram, r, s, ADULT[k].ret);
    return;
  }
  const uint16_t *ids, *rets;
  if (st & 0x04)      { ids = YOUNG; rets = RET_YOUNG; }
  else if (st & 0x02) { ids = CALF; rets = RET_CALF; }
  else return;
  if (!cow_timer_done(ram, r)) return;
  uint8_t dice = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_RNG_LAST);
  unsigned k = dice < 0x40 ? 0 : dice < 0x80 ? 1 : dice < 0xC0 ? 2 : 3;
  if (k == 0) rec_or(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0x08); else rec_and(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0xF7);
  cow_script(ram, r, ids[k], rets[k]);
}

/* 84A607 / 84A740: start moving (once: +01 $08), its timer back to 0 */
static void start_moving(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const uint16_t ret[3])
{
  if (record8(ram, r, COW_DAILY) & 0x08) return;
  rec_or(ram, r, COW_DAILY, 0x08);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_COW_TIMERS + cow_timer_x(ram, r), 0);
  uint8_t st = record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS);
  uint16_t script, at;
  if (st & 0x08) {
    if (st & 0x40) return;
    script = adult_script(ram, r, 0x6C, 0x70, 0x5E); at = ret[2];
  } else if (st & 0x04) { script = 0x74; at = ret[1]; }
  else if (st & 0x02)   { script = 0x78; at = ret[0]; }
  else return;
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x28));
  cow_script(ram, r, script, at);
}

/* 84A84A: face the player (or away from it, status $10) */
static void face_player(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE, 0);
  uint16_t dx = distance(ram, r, slot16(ram, r, SLOT_X), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X),
                         DP_VALUE, DP_DX_NEGATIVE);
  uint16_t dy = distance(ram, r, slot16(ram, r, SLOT_Y), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y),
                         DP_VALUE_HI, DP_DY_NEGATIVE);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT, lda8(r, 0x20));
  bool away = record8(ram, r, ANIMAL_STATUS) & COW_STATUS_RUNS_AWAY;
  uint8_t direction;
  if (dy >= dx) direction = (hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE) != 0) != away ? 0x01 : 0x02;
  else          direction = (hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE) != 0) != away ? 0x04 : 0x08;
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FORCED_DIR, lda8(r, direction));
}

void hm_Event_CowFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  animal_number(ram, r, COW_SLOT0);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9AF5, 0x83);
  hm_GetCowPointer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  rec_w16(ram, r, COW_X, slot16(ram, r, SLOT_X));    /* the record follows the slot */
  rec_w16(ram, r, COW_Y, slot16(ram, r, SLOT_Y));

  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  uint8_t state = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STATE);
  if (map == MAP_BARN && state == 0xC2) {             /* 84A595: back in the barn */
    slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, 0);
    slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x40));
    rec_w8(ram, r, COW_MAP, ram[HM_SEASON]);
    rec_w16(ram, r, COW_X, 0x0148);
    rec_w16(ram, r, COW_Y, 0x0178);
  } else if (map < 0x04 && state == 0xE0 && (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x0004)) {
    /* 84A498: sold (the price by happiness: 500, 800 or 1000) */
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A, (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0xFFFB));
    uint8_t h = record8(ram, r, COW_HAPPINESS);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_SALE_PRICE, h < 0x60 ? 0x01F4 : h < 0xC0 ? 0x0320 : 0x03E8);
    ram[HM_SALE_PRICE + 2] = 0;
    ram[HM_SOLD_COW_SLOT] = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER);
    ram[HM_INTERACTION] = 0x43; ram[HM_INTERACTION_STEP] = 0; ram[HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES] = 0; /* its dialog */
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0040));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
    slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STATE, 0);
    slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) & 0x57));
  } else if (map < 0x04 && state == 0xE1) {           /* 84A540: off the farm, to the barn */
    slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, 0);
    slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x40));
    r->x = (uint16_t)(animal_number(ram, r, COW_SLOT0) << 2);
    rec_w8(ram, r, COW_MAP, MAP_BARN);
    /* the same word for both coordinates (no INX in between) */
    rec_w16(ram, r, COW_X, hm_bus_rd16(ram, COW_PLACES + r->x));
    rec_w16(ram, r, COW_Y, hm_bus_rd16(ram, COW_PLACES + r->x));
  } else if (interact(ram, r)) {
    wander(ram, r);
  }

  /* 84A46E: moving */
  static const uint16_t RET_MOVE[3] = { 0xA688, 0xA6BA, 0xA70D };
  static const uint16_t RET_CALLED[3] = { 0xA7C1, 0xA7F3, 0xA849 };
  bool called = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5A) & 0x0010;   /* the bell */
  if (!called && slot8(ram, r, SLOT_PRESSED) != 0) {
    start_moving(ram, r, RET_MOVE);
    uint16_t dir = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION); /* the way the player looks */
    static const uint8_t FACE[4] = { 0x01, 0x02, 0x04, 0x08 };
    if (dir < 4) slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FORCED_DIR, lda8(r, FACE[dir]));
    else called = true;
  }
  if (called) {
    start_moving(ram, r, RET_CALLED);
    face_player(ram, r);
  }
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Commands 50-59 ($84:BBDA-$84:C013). HM-Decomp labels only the first
 * (Event_PutDownCarried); the others are named by their number here.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
static uint32_t dbw(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static void push16b(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16b(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}
/* LDA #0; CLC; ADC $DA; STA $0901: the player's standing animation */
static void stand(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint32_t s = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)s;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, dbw(r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST), r->a);
}
/* a carried chicken (slot $24 + n) goes back to its place in the coop */
static void chicken_home(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret)
{
  uint8_t slot = hm_bus_rd8(ram, dbw(r, HM_CARRIED_SLOT));
  uint16_t s = (uint16_t)(slot - CHICKEN_SLOT0);
  r->c = slot >= CHICKEN_SLOT0;
  uint16_t n = (uint8_t)s;
  r->a = n;
  push16b(ram, r, n);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
  hm_GetChickenPointer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->y = CHICKEN_MAP;
  lda8(r, MAP_COOP);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, CHICKEN_MAP), MAP_COOP);
  r->y = ANIMAL_STATUS;
  uint8_t f = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, ANIMAL_STATUS)) & 0xDF); /* not carried */
  lda8(r, f);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, ANIMAL_STATUS), f);
  n = pull16b(ram, r);
  r->c = (n >> 14) & 1;                                    /* ASL; ASL */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 2);
  uint32_t x = (uint32_t)hm_bus_rd16(ram, CHICKEN_PLACES + r->x) + 0x10;
  r->c = x > 0xFFFF;
  r->y = CHICKEN_X;
  r->a = (uint16_t)x;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, CHICKEN_X), r->a);
  r->x = (uint16_t)(r->x + 2);
  r->y = CHICKEN_Y;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, CHICKEN_PLACES + r->x);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, CHICKEN_Y), r->a);
  lda8(r, (uint8_t)r->a);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND & 0xFFFF), 0);
}
/* the carried dog goes back to the farm (the map of this season) */
static bool dog_home(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0800;
  if (!r->a) return false;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(0x0800 ^ 0xFFFF) & hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  uint8_t season = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_MAP), season);
  r->a = 0x0078; hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_X), 0x0078);
  r->a = 0x01A8; hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_Y), 0x01A8);
  return true;
}

/* Command 50, Event_PutDownCarried ($84:BBDA): put down what is carried
 * when an event starts: a chicken goes back to the coop, any other item
 * disappears, the dog goes back to the farm; the player stands. */
void hm_Event_PutDownCarried(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t item = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, dbw(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND & 0xFFFF)));
  if (item) {
    r->c = item >= 0x25;
    if (item != 0x25) r->c = item >= 0x26;
    if (item == 0x25 || item == 0x26) chicken_home(ram, r, 0xBC19);
    else hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND & 0xFFFF), 0);
    stand(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (dog_home(ram, r)) stand(ram, r);
}
/* Command 51 ($84:BC9C): the same without the animation, and only item
 * $29 disappears (other items stay in the hands). */
void hm_Event_Cmd51_PutDownCarriedQuietly(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t item = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, dbw(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND & 0xFFFF)));
  if (item) {
    r->c = item >= 0x25;
    if (item != 0x25) r->c = item >= 0x26;
    if (item == 0x25 || item == 0x26) { chicken_home(ram, r, 0xBCD7); return; }
    r->c = item >= 0x29;
    if (item == 0x29) hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND & 0xFFFF), 0);
    return;
  }
  dog_home(ram, r);
}
/* Commands 52 / 53 ($84:BD44 / $84:BE0D): if the player pressed A on this
 * object (CollideEventObjects set its +$0C) with free hands and not busy, the object
 * goes away (+0 = 0, +1 bit 6) and $7F1F60 bit 1 (53: bit 2) is set.
 * Either way the slot's frame count +$10 goes up. */
static void pressed_on(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t flag)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  bool ok = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_PRESSED)) != 0;
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CMP #0 */
  static const uint16_t busy[] = { 0x0A, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x1B };
  for (unsigned i = 0; ok && i < 4; i++) {
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
    r->c = r->a >= busy[i];
    if (r->a == busy[i]) ok = false;
  }
  if (ok) { r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0004; ok = !r->a; }
  if (ok) { r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0006; ok = !r->a; }
  if (ok) { r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, dbw(r, HM_PAD1_NEW)); ok = (r->a & 0x0080) != 0; }
  if (ok) { r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0800; ok = !r->a; }
  if (ok) { ok = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, dbw(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND & 0xFFFF))) == 0; }
  if (!ok) { count_frame(ram, r); return; }
  lda8(r, 0);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, 0);
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x40);
  lda8(r, v);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, v);
  count_frame(ram, r);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) | flag);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), r->a);
}
void hm_Event_Cmd52_PickUpChild1(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { pressed_on(ram, r, 0x0002); }
void hm_Event_Cmd53_PickUpChild2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { pressed_on(ram, r, 0x0004); }

/* Command 54 ($84:BED6): <text word> <lines byte>: a text box that closes
 * by itself (input mode 6, TextBoxAutoClose: after 120 frames). */
void hm_Event_Cmd54_AutoCloseTextBox(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->x = arg16(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint8_t lines = arg8(ram, r);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES), lines);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, dbw(r, HM_TEXT_AUTO_CLOSE_TIMER), 0);
  lda8(r, 6);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_INPUT_STATE), 6);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xBF07, 0x83);
  hm_StartTextBox(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  count_frame(ram, r);
}
/* Command 55 ($84:BF20): <address 24> <bit byte> <target word>: if that bit
 * of the word at the address is clear, jump to the target; else go on. */
void hm_Event_Cmd55_JumpIfBitClear(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  uint16_t n = arg8_word(ram, r);
  r->c = (n >> 15) & 1;
  r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, FLAG_BITS_84 + r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, 0)) & hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  if (!r->a) { jump(ram, r); return; }
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}
/* Command 56 ($84:BF81): use the tool in hand, if any. */
void hm_Event_Cmd56_UseToolInHand(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  if (!lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, dbw(r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED & 0xFFFF)))) return;
  r->a = 0x000A;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0x000A);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xBF9E, 0x82);
  hm_StartToolAnimation(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* Command 57 ($84:BFA0): <byte>: change the stamina by it (ChangeStamina). */
void hm_Event_Cmd57_ChangeStamina(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->n = arg8(ram, r) >> 7;                                /* ChangeStamina reads N */
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xBFB3, 0x81);
  hm_ChangeStamina(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}
/* Command 58 ($84:BFBF): <tile byte> <x word> <y word>: set that tile type
 * on the farm (EditFarmTile). */
void hm_Event_Cmd58_SetFarmTile(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_push8(ram, r, arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  push16b(ram, r, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  push16b(ram, r, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  r->y = pull16b(ram, r);
  r->x = pull16b(ram, r);
  lda8(r, hm_pull8(ram, r));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xBFFE, 0x82);
  hm_EditFarmTile(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* Command 59 ($84:C000): the player's action $1C. */
void hm_Event_Cmd59_SwapTools(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->a = 0x001C;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0x001C);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Event_HorseFrame ($84:AB27, command 37), every frame, for an object of
 * group $17 that the player can carry (probably the child: putting it down
 * starts script $17/$14). $7F1F5C holds its requests: bit 4 "the player
 * touches it", 6 face the way of +2, 10 walk towards the player, 11 / 5
 * see below. $0939 counts 120 frames between idle animations, chosen by
 * the random byte $DE. With $7F1F32 = $15 the idle and face scripts differ.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
static void group17(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t script, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = HORSE_SLOT; r->x = 0; r->y = script;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_StartEventScript(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
static void request(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t and_mask, uint16_t or_mask)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & and_mask) | or_mask);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), r->a);
}
static bool asked(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & bit;
  return r->a != 0;
}
/* LDA $0939; CMP #$78; ... : true when the 120 frames are up (reset) */
static bool idle_time(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t t = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, dbw(r, HM_HORSE_TIMER)));
  r->c = t >= 0x78;
  if (t != 0x78) {
    lda8(r, (uint8_t)(t + 1));
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_HORSE_TIMER), (uint8_t)(t + 1));
    return false;
  }
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_HORSE_TIMER), 0);
  return true;
}
/* walk towards the player, along the longer axis (as the dog does) */
static void towards_player(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t script, uint16_t ret)
{
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_HORSE_TIMER), 0);
  uint8_t f = (uint8_t)(slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x28);
  lda8(r, f);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, f);
  r->a = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER);                       /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA */
  r->x = 0; r->y = script;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_StartEventScript(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE, 0);
  static const struct { uint16_t y; unsigned pos, out, neg; } A[2] = {
    { SLOT_X, HM_PLAYER_X, DP_VALUE, DP_DX_NEGATIVE },
    { SLOT_Y, HM_PLAYER_Y, DP_VALUE_HI, DP_DY_NEGATIVE } };
  for (unsigned k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
    uint16_t v = slot16(ram, r, A[k].y);
    uint16_t p = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, A[k].pos);
    r->c = v >= p;
    uint16_t d = (uint16_t)(v - p);
    r->a = d;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, A[k].out, d);
    if (d & 0x8000) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(~d + 1);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, A[k].out, r->a);
      r->a = 1;
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, A[k].neg, 1);
    }
  }
  lda8(r, 0x20);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT, 0x20);                  /* speed */
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE_HI);
  r->c = r->a >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_VALUE);
  uint8_t dir;
  if (r->c) { r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_DY_NEGATIVE); dir = r->a ? 1 : 2; }
  else { r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_DX_NEGATIVE); dir = r->a ? 4 : 8; }
  lda8(r, dir);
  slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FORCED_DIR, dir);
}

void hm_Event_HorseFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  request(ram, r, 0xFFEF, 0);                              /* not touched (yet) */
  uint8_t place = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HORSE_AGE)));
  r->c = place >= 0x15;
  if (place != 0x15) {
    if (idle_time(ram, r)) group17(ram, r, 0x0080, 0xAB6F);
    goto end;
  }
  if (asked(ram, r, 0x0040)) {                             /* face the way of +2 */
    static const uint16_t face[4] = { 0x28, 0x29, 0x2A, 0x2B };
    uint8_t w = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY));
    uint16_t script = 0x28;
    for (uint8_t k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
      r->c = w >= k;
      if (w == k) { script = face[k]; break; }
    }
    group17(ram, r, script, 0xABD1);
    request(ram, r, 0xFFBF, 0);
  }
  if (!asked(ram, r, 0x0800)) {
    if (asked(ram, r, 0x0020)) {                           /* taken in the arms */
      r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0010);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
      request(ram, r, 0xFFDF, 0);
      lda8(r, 0);
      slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_IN_USE, 0);
      uint8_t f = (uint8_t)(slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x40);
      lda8(r, f);
      slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, f);
      lda8(r, 0);
      slot_w8(ram, r, SLOT_PRESSED, 0);
      count_frame(ram, r);
      return;
    }
    /* pressed A on it? (the same tests as picking up an animal) */
    bool ok = lda8(r, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_PRESSED)) != 0;
    r->c = 1;
    static const uint16_t busy[] = { 0x0A, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x1B };
    for (unsigned i = 0; ok && i < 4; i++) {
      r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
      r->c = r->a >= busy[i];
      if (r->a == busy[i]) ok = false;
    }
    if (ok) { r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0004; ok = !r->a; }
    if (ok) { r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0006; ok = !r->a; }
    if (ok) {
      request(ram, r, 0xFFFF, 0x0010);                     /* touched */
      r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, dbw(r, HM_PAD1_NEW));
      ok = (r->a & 0x0080) != 0;
    }
    if (ok) {                                              /* room in front? */
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, r->a = 0x000D);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X));
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y));
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X, 0);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y, 0);
      r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, dbw(r, HM_PLAYER_FACING));
      hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xAC84, 0x83);
      hm_CollideMap(ram, r);
      hm_rtl(ram, r);
      ok = r->a == 0;
      for (unsigned at = HM_COLLIDE_TILE_1; ok && at <= HM_COLLIDE_TILE_2; at += 2) {
        uint16_t v = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, at);
        r->a = (uint16_t)(v - 0xC0);
        r->c = r->a >= 0x10;
        ok = r->c;
      }
    }
    if (ok) {
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, r->a = 0x0020);
      r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, dbw(r, HM_PLAYER_FACING));
      hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xACB5, 0x83);
      hm_CollideEventObjects(ram, r);
      hm_rtl(ram, r);
      r->c = 1;                                            /* CMP #0 */
      ok = r->a == 0;
    }
    if (ok) {
      if ((r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0002)) goto end;
      if ((r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0800)) goto end;
      r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
      r->c = r->a >= 4;
      if (r->a == 4) goto end;
      r->a = 0x0017;
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0x0017);         /* pick it up */
      goto end;
    }
  }
  /* idle: every 120 frames an animation chosen by $DE */
  request(ram, r, 0xF7FF, 0);
  if (idle_time(ram, r)) {
    static const struct { uint8_t below; uint16_t script, ret; } I[] = {
      { 0x24, 0x4B, 0xAD3C }, { 0x48, 0x4B, 0xAD3C }, { 0x6C, 0x4D, 0xAD4E },
      { 0x90, 0x4E, 0xAD60 }, { 0xB4, 0x4F, 0xAD72 }, { 0xD8, 0x4F, 0xAD72 },
    };
    uint8_t de = lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_RNG_LAST));
    unsigned i = 0;
    for (; i < 6; i++) {
      r->c = de >= I[i].below;
      if (!r->c) break;
    }
    if (i < 6) group17(ram, r, I[i].script, I[i].ret);
    else group17(ram, r, 0x50, 0xAD84);
  }
end:
  if (asked(ram, r, 0x0400)) {                             /* walk to the player */
    uint8_t p = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HORSE_AGE)));
    r->c = p >= 0x15;
    if (p == 0x15) towards_player(ram, r, 0x4C, 0xAE32);
    else towards_player(ram, r, 0x4A, 0xAE66);
  }
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * More commands.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
/* Event_ResetFlag ($84:93C9; commands 38, 39, 40 all point here, so
 * Event_ResetFlagD / DD are the same code): <address 24> <bit>: clear that
 * bit of the word at the address. HM-Decomp's address comment says
 * $80:93C9. */
void hm_Event_ResetFlag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  address_arg(ram, r);
  uint16_t n = arg8_word(ram, r);
  r->c = (n >> 15) & 1;
  r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, INVERSE_FLAG_BITS + r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_VALUE, r->a);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, 0)) & r->a;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, DP_POINTER, 0), r->a);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
}

/* Event_EditTileOnMap ($84:BA10, command 75): <tile> <x word> <y word>:
 * set that tile type on the current map (command 58 does it on the farm). */
void hm_Event_EditTileOnMap(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_push8(ram, r, arg8(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  push16b(ram, r, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  push16b(ram, r, arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  r->y = pull16b(ram, r);
  r->x = pull16b(ram, r);
  lda8(r, hm_pull8(ram, r));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xBA4F, 0x82);
  hm_EditTileOnMap(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* Event_StartTextBox / Event_StartTextBoxCopy ($84:8FEF / $84:9034,
 * commands 28 / 29, the same code): <text word> <lines>: open a text box
 * (input mode 2). */
static void start_text(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->x = arg16(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES), arg8(ram, r));
  lda8(r, 2);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, HM_INPUT_STATE), 2);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
  hm_StartTextBox(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  count_frame(ram, r);
}
void hm_Event_StartTextBox(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)     { start_text(ram, r, 0x901B); }
void hm_Event_StartTextBoxCopy(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { start_text(ram, r, 0x9060); }

/* Event_ReturnToolsToShed ($84:BB65, not in the command table: nothing runs it):
 * put the tool in hand and the one in the backpack back in the shed (its
 * bit in $7F1F00 + byte +6 of the item's entry). */
static void to_shed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = 0;                                                /* LDA #0; XBA */
  uint8_t item = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, dbw(r, at)));
  if (!item) return;
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)((item << 3) + 6);                /* ASL x3; CLC; ADC #6 */
  r->c = 0;
  r->x = x;
  uint8_t place = hm_bus_rd8(ram, SHED_ITEM_TABLE + x);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((x & 0xFF00) | place);
  hm_push8(ram, r, place);                                 /* PHA */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(x + 1);
  uint8_t bit = hm_bus_rd8(ram, SHED_ITEM_TABLE + r->x);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW) = bit;
  hm_pull8(ram, r);                                        /* PLA; XBA; LDA #0; XBA */
  r->a = r->x = place;
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + r->x) | bit);
  r->a = v;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + r->x, v);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, dbw(r, at), 0);
}
void hm_Event_ReturnToolsToShed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  to_shed(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED);
  to_shed(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Destroying objects from a script.
 * Event_DestroyOwnObject ($84:B34B): the slot's own game object (+12).
 * Event_FreeOtherSlot ($84:9375): <slot>: frees that slot and destroys
 * its object, then goes back to its own slot ($72-$74 keep it meanwhile).
 * Event_SetStandingAnimation ($84:9810): <word>: +33 = the word, then the
 * animation from the table at $B3:<word> (SetSlotAnimation), and +01 bit 2.
 * (JSR, RTS each, like every command.)
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_Event_DestroyOwnObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->y = SLOT_OBJECT;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_OBJECT));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xB363, 0x85);
  hm_DestroyGameObject(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

void hm_Event_FreeOtherSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_POINTER, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT)); /* keep our slot */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_POINTER_BANK) = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK);
  arg8_word(ram, r);                                       /* the other slot */
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9397, 0x84);
  hm_SetEventSlotPointer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->y = SLOT_IN_USE;
  r->a &= 0xFF00;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_IN_USE), 0);
  r->y = SLOT_OBJECT;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_OBJECT));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x93BB, 0x85);
  hm_DestroyGameObject(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DP_POINTER);                    /* back to ours */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_POINTER_BANK));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK) = (uint8_t)r->a;
}

void hm_Event_SetStandingAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint16_t word = arg16(ram, r);
  r->y = SLOT_ANIM_TABLE;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_TABLE), word);
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_TABLE));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_POINTER, r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | ANIM_TABLE_BANK);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_POINTER_BANK) = ANIM_TABLE_BANK;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9841, 0x84);
  hm_SetSlotAnimation(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->y = SLOT_FLAGS;
  uint8_t flags = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS)) | 0x04);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | flags);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS), flags);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Choosing a slot's animation.
 * Event_SetSlotAnimation ($84:957D): <table word> <entry>; Event_SetSlotAnimationPlayerDir
 * ($84:B8D9): <table word>, the entry being the player's direction ($DA).
 * Both: +33 = the table ($B3:<word>), +02 = the entry, +01 bits 0-1 set,
 * the animation read (SetSlotAnimation), and the slot's frame counter +10 one up.
 * Leftovers: A = the new +10, Y = $10, C from that add.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* +02 already written: the flags, the animation, the frame counter */
static void set_animation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->y = SLOT_FLAGS;
  uint8_t flags = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS)) | 0x03);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | flags);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS), flags);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_TABLE));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_POINTER, r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | ANIM_TABLE_BANK);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_POINTER_BANK) = ANIM_TABLE_BANK;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_SetSlotAnimation(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->y = SLOT_FRAMES;
  uint16_t frames = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FRAMES));
  r->c = frames == 0xFFFF;                                 /* CLC; ADC #1 */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(frames + 1);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FRAMES), r->a);
}

void hm_Event_SetSlotAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->y = SLOT_ANIM_TABLE;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_TABLE), arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint8_t entry = arg8(ram, r);
  r->y = SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY), entry);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  set_animation(ram, r, 0x95D9);
}

void hm_Event_SetSlotAnimationPlayerDir(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->y = SLOT_ANIM_TABLE;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_TABLE), arg16(ram, r));
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);           /* the player's direction */
  r->y = SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY), (uint8_t)r->a);
  set_animation(ram, r, 0xB92D);
}

/* Event_PlaceSlot ($84:8F0A): <x word> <y word> <table word> <entry>:
 * puts the slot at (x, y) (+1A / +1C) with that animation (as command 8). */
void hm_Event_PlaceSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t at[3] = { SLOT_X, SLOT_Y, SLOT_ANIM_TABLE };
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    advance(ram, r, (uint16_t)(i ? 2 : 1));
    r->y = at[i];
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, at[i]), arg16(ram, r));
  }
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint8_t entry = arg8(ram, r);
  r->y = SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY), entry);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  set_animation(ram, r, 0x8F8C);
}

/* the slot turns to face the player (+02 = the player's direction with
 * bit 0 flipped: the opposite one), stops (+03 / +04 / +0C = 0, +08 =
 * +07), takes the animation of that side and gets +01 bits 2 and 4 */
static void turn_to_player(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->y = SLOT_WALK_STEPS;
  uint8_t b = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_WALK_STEPS)));
  r->y = SLOT_STEPS_LEFT;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT), b);
  static const uint8_t cleared[3] = { SLOT_STEP_X, SLOT_STEP_Y, SLOT_PRESSED };
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    r->y = cleared[i];
    lda8(r, 0);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, cleared[i]), 0);
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION) ^ 0x0001);
  r->y = SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY), (uint8_t)r->a);
  r->y = SLOT_ANIM_TABLE;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_TABLE));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DP_POINTER, r->a);
  lda8(r, ANIM_TABLE_BANK);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_POINTER_BANK) = ANIM_TABLE_BANK;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_SetSlotAnimation(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->y = SLOT_FLAGS;
  uint8_t flags = lda8(r, (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS)) | 0x14));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS), flags);
}

/* Event_FacePlayerIfSpokenTo ($84:BA72): <address>: if the player talked to the
 * slot (+0C, see PressAOnTile), is not in action $0A and $7F1F5E bit 6 is set,
 * the slot turns to face the player (+02 = the player's direction with bit 0
 * flipped: the opposite one), stops (+03 / +04 / +0C = 0, +08 = +07), gets
 * +01 bits 2 and 4, a frame (+10 one up), and the script jumps to the
 * address. Otherwise the address is skipped. */
void hm_Event_FacePlayerIfSpokenTo(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->y = SLOT_PRESSED;
  uint8_t talked = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_PRESSED)));
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CMP #0 */
  bool turn = talked != 0;
  if (turn) {
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
    r->c = r->a >= 0x0A;
    turn = r->a != 0x0A;
  }
  if (turn) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) & 0x0040);
    turn = r->a != 0;
  }
  if (!turn) { advance(ram, r, 2); return; }
  jump(ram, r);
  turn_to_player(ram, r, 0xBB03);
  r->y = SLOT_FRAMES;
  uint16_t frames = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FRAMES));
  r->c = frames == 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(frames + 1);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FRAMES), r->a);
}

/* Event_ChangeToWantedSong ($84:8CA8): <byte, unused>: the music changes to the
 * one asked for in $0110, if it is not the one playing (FadeOutSongSlowly). */
void hm_Event_ChangeToWantedSong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8CB7, 0x83);
  hm_FadeOutSongSlowly(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* Event_StartMapAnimation ($84:9553): <word>: starts the map animation of that
 * number (StartMapAnimation), one frame. */
void hm_Event_StartMapAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  arg16(ram, r);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9564, 0x81);
  hm_StartMapAnimation(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  count_frame(ram, r);
}

/* Event_TalkIfSpokenTo ($84:9079, commands $1E and $1F) and
 * Event_TalkOrTakeShownItem ($84:9633, command $2D): talking to someone. If the
 * player talked to the slot (+0C), is not using or showing a tool nor
 * whistling (actions $0A, $0C, $0D, $1B), carries nothing ($D2 bit 2),
 * $7F1F60 bits 1-2 are clear and A was just pressed: the slot faces the
 * player, $096E-$0970 = $56, 0, 0, $D2 |= $40, the player stops (action
 * 0) and the script jumps to <address>. Command $2D has two addresses:
 * the second one when the player holds something up (action 5 with an
 * item: that item also goes to $091E). Otherwise the addresses are
 * skipped. Either way, one frame. */
/* LDA.W / STA.W: the data bank's address */
static uint32_t abs_db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }

static void talk_to_slot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, unsigned addresses, uint16_t ret)
{
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  r->y = SLOT_PRESSED;
  uint8_t talked = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_PRESSED)));
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CMP #0 */
  bool go = talked != 0;
  static const uint16_t busy[4] = { 0x0A, 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x1B };
  for (int i = 0; go && i < 4; i++) {
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
    r->c = r->a >= busy[i];
    go = r->a != busy[i];
  }
  if (go) { r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0004; go = !r->a; }
  if (go) { r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0006; go = !r->a; }
  if (go) { r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PAD1_NEW)); go = (r->a & 0x0080) != 0; } /* BIT #$80 */
  if (!go) {
    advance(ram, r, (uint16_t)(2 * addresses));
    count_frame(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (addresses == 2) {
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
    r->c = r->a >= 5;
    if (r->a == 5) {
      uint8_t item = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND))); /* in hand */
      if (item) {
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_SHOWN_ITEM), item);
        advance(ram, r, 2);
      }
    }
  }
  jump(ram, r);
  turn_to_player(ram, r, ret);
  lda8(r, 0x56);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_INTERACTION), 0x56);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES), 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0040);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  count_frame(ram, r);
}
void hm_Event_TalkIfSpokenTo(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { talk_to_slot(ram, r, 1, 0x9145); }
void hm_Event_TalkOrTakeShownItem(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { talk_to_slot(ram, r, 2, 0x971F); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Event_ScreenFadeIn ($84:8B83) and Event_ScreenFadeOut ($84:8CB9) (JSR,
 * RTS): skip the command's 2 bytes and fade the screen in (from 3 to 15)
 * or out (from 15 to 0), 3 frames a level (ScreenFadeIn / ScreenFadeOut).
 * The fades save the flags (PHP in SetBrightness and WaitForNMI), so
 * they are followed: 8-bit A, 16-bit indexes, N clear, Z from the last
 * load (the target: set only for the fade-out's 0), V and C of the second
 * ADC, D and I of the entry.
 * Leftovers: those of the fade.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void event_fade(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t from, uint8_t to, uint16_t ret,
                       void (*fade)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint16_t before = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t v = before == 0x7FFF ? 0x40 : 0;                 /* the ADC's overflow */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_LOW) = from;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DP_CMP_HIGH) = 3;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_FADE_TO) = to;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | to);
  r->p = (uint8_t)((entry & 0x0C) | 0x20 | v | r->c | (to ? 0 : 0x02));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x80);
  fade(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->p = entry;
}
void hm_Event_ScreenFadeIn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { event_fade(ram, r, 0x03, 0x0F, 0x8BAA, hm_ScreenFadeIn); }
void hm_Event_ScreenFadeOut(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { event_fade(ram, r, 0x0F, 0x00, 0x8CE0, hm_ScreenFadeOut); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Event_PlayEffectAndWait ($84:95E8, JSR, RTS; HM-Decomp's comment gives bank
 * $80): command [effect] [bank, word] [frames, word]: plays the sound
 * effect and waits the frames (PlayEffectWithSongInstrument), then reloads the noises of
 * the item in hand ($0119 = 0 forgets the last one, ToolUsedSound2).
 * PlayEffectWithSongInstrument keeps V, D and I of its entry flags; V is the third ADC's.
 * Leftovers: A = $C9 (past the command), C from that ADC, X and Y from
 * ToolUsedSound2 / PlayEffectWithSongInstrument.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_Event_PlayEffectAndWait(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint8_t effect = arg8(ram, r);
  hm_push8(ram, r, effect);                                /* PHA (8-bit) */
  advance(ram, r, 1);
  uint16_t bank = arg16(ram, r);
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(bank >> 8));                  /* PHA (16-bit) */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)bank);
  uint16_t before = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);
  advance(ram, r, 2);
  uint8_t v = (before == 0x7FFE || before == 0x7FFF) ? 0x40 : 0;
  r->y = arg16(ram, r);                                    /* TAY */
  uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);                           /* PLX */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | hm_pull8(ram, r));   /* SEP #$20; PLA */
  r->p = (uint8_t)((entry & 0x0C) | v);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x961E, 0x83);
  hm_PlayEffectWithSongInstrument(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_LOADED_TOOL_SOUND, 0); /* STZ $0119 */
  r->p = (uint8_t)(entry & 0x0C);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9627, 0x82);
  hm_ToolUsedSound2(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->p = entry;
  advance(ram, r, 2);
}

```

`src/events.c`:

```c
/*
 * events.c — the event system: the "CC structures".
 *
 * Everything scripted (cutscenes, villagers walking, the dog, festival
 * crowds, animals doing things...) runs as an event script in one of the
 * CC slots: 64-byte structures from $7E:B586 (slot n at $7E:B586 + 64 n).
 * The direct-page pointer $CC-$CE points at the slot being worked on, and
 * the script code reads fields through it ([$CC],Y).
 *
 * Fields used so far (offsets in the slot):
 *   +00 in use (1)        +01 flags         +03..06, +0C, +0F  state bytes
 *   +10 +12 +14 timers / counters (16b)     +1A +1C  X, Y position (16b)
 *   +30 +32  script pointer (16b offset + bank)    +3F  the slot's own number
 *
 * Scripts live in ROM: Events_Bank_Table ($84:94CD) points at a table of
 * 24-bit "group" pointers at $B3:8000; each group is a table of 16-bit
 * script offsets in the group's bank.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */
#define CC_SLOTS_BASE      0xB586   /* $7E:B586 */
#define CC_SLOT_SIZE       64
#define EVENTS_BANK_TABLE  0x8494CD /* ROM: dl $B38000, $B48000 */

/* Direct page. The scratch words $7E / $80 mean a different thing in each
 * routine (each is left behind as a leftover): */
#define SLOT_OFFSET        0x7E   /* 16b: SetEventSlotPointer: 64 x the slot number */
#define SCRIPT_GROUP       0x7E   /* 16b: starting a script: the group */
#define SCRIPT_NUMBER      0x80   /* 16b: and the script's number in it */
#define STEP_DX            0x7E   /* 16b: StepSlot: the step across (sign-extended) */
#define STEP_DY            0x80   /* 16b: and down */
#define AREA_RANGE         0x7E   /* 16b: the area check: the range (+09 / +0A) */
#define AREA_POS           0x80   /* 16b: and the slot's position */
#define ANIM_ENTRY         0x7E   /* 16b: SetSlotAnimation: the entry (the slot's +02) */
#define SPRITE_NOW         0x7E   /* 16b: UpdateSlotSprite: the slot's sprite (+16) */
/* Long pointers: */
#define ANIM_TABLE         0x72   /* 24b $72-$74: the animation table (SetSlotAnimation) */
#define ANIM_TABLE_BANK    0x74   /* 8b: its bank */
#define GROUPS_LONG        0x72   /* 24b: StartEventScriptLong: the table of groups ... */
#define GROUP_LONG         0xC9   /* 24b: ... and the group's table of scripts */
#define GROUPS_SHORT       0x75   /* 24b: StartEventScript: the same two */
#define GROUP_SHORT        0x78
#define WANDER_TIMER       0x92   /* 8b: WanderSlot: a copy of the step timer (+06) */

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SetEventSlotPointer ($84:887C, JSL, RTL). A = slot number; $CC-$CE = its address
 * ($7E:B586 + 64 A). Leftovers: $7E = 64 A; A = (high byte of the address)
 * : $7E; C = carry of the add.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SetEventSlotPointer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t offset = (uint16_t)(r->a << 6);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SLOT_OFFSET, offset);
  uint32_t address = (uint32_t)CC_SLOTS_BASE + offset;
  r->c = address > 0xFFFF;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, (uint16_t)address);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK) = 0x7E;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((address & 0xFF00) | 0x7E);  /* SEP #$20; LDA #$7E */
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ResetCurrentEventSlotLong ($84:88D4, JSR, RTS — despite the name).
 * Marks the slot at $CC as in use and clears its state: bytes +01, +03..06,
 * +0C, +0F and words +10, +12, +14, +1A, +1C. Ends with A = 0, Y = $14.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ResetCurrentEventSlotLong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t bytes[] = { SLOT_FLAGS, SLOT_FORCED_DIR, SLOT_STEP_X, SLOT_STEP_Y, SLOT_STEP_DELAY,
                                   SLOT_STEP_TIMER, SLOT_PRESSED };
  static const uint8_t words[] = { SLOT_FRAMES, SLOT_X, SLOT_Y, SLOT_OBJECT, SLOT_ANIMATION };
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_IN_USE), 1);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof bytes; i++)
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, bytes[i]), 0);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof words; i++)
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, words[i]), 0);
  r->a = 0;
  r->y = SLOT_ANIMATION;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ResetCurrentEventSlotShort ($84:8961, JSR, RTS). The short reset:
 * marks the slot in use, sets +01 to 1 and clears +03..06, +0F and the word
 * +10. Ends with A = 0, Y = $10.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ResetCurrentEventSlotShort(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t zero_bytes[] = { SLOT_FORCED_DIR, SLOT_STEP_X, SLOT_STEP_Y, SLOT_STEP_DELAY, SLOT_STEP_TIMER };
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_IN_USE), 1);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS), 1);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof zero_bytes; i++)
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, zero_bytes[i]), 0);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FRAMES), 0);
  r->a = 0;
  r->y = SLOT_FRAMES;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Starting an event script: StartScriptAtTileInFront, StartEventScriptLong and
 * StartEventScript ($84:80F8, $84:8097, $84:803F; JSL, RTL).
 *   A = CC slot, X = script group, Y = script number in the group.
 * They point the slot ($CC, SetEventSlotPointer) at the script: +30 = the 16-bit
 * offset, entry `script` of the group's table, +32 = its bank. The group's
 * table is entry `group` (24-bit) of $B3:8000 (only the first entry of
 * Events_Bank_Table is used). Then:
 *  - Long: full reset, +3F = the slot's number;
 *  - StartScriptAtTileInFront: the same, and it also places the event on the tile in
 *    front of the player (+1A/+1C);
 *  - Short: short reset, and the script pointer is also left in $C9-$CB
 *    (Long uses $72-$74 / $C9-$CB for the tables, Short $75-$77 / $78-$7A).
 * Leftovers: $7E = group, $80 = script number; X = 2; C = bit 15 of the
 * script number (its ASL).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct ScriptStart {
  uint16_t ret_set_pointer, ret_reset;   /* where their JSL / JSR return */
  uint8_t table_dp, group_dp;            /* $72 / $C9 or $75 / $78 */
  bool short_reset;
} ScriptStart;

static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(ret >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
}

static void start_script(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const ScriptStart *s)
{
  uint16_t group = r->x, script = r->y;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, s->ret_set_pointer, 0x84);
  hm_SetEventSlotPointer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);

  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SCRIPT_GROUP, group);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SCRIPT_NUMBER, script);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, s->table_dp, hm_bus_rd16(ram, EVENTS_BANK_TABLE));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, s->table_dp + 2) = hm_bus_rd8(ram, EVENTS_BANK_TABLE + 2);
  uint16_t y = (uint16_t)(group * 3);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, s->group_dp, hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, s->table_dp, y)));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, s->group_dp + 2) = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, s->table_dp, (uint16_t)(y + 2)));
  r->c = (script >> 15) & 1;                     /* ASL of $80 */
  uint16_t offset = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, s->group_dp, (uint16_t)(script << 1)));
  uint8_t bank = *hm_dp(ram, r, s->group_dp + 2);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_SCRIPT), offset);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK), bank);
  r->x = 2;
  if (s->short_reset) {
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, offset);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_BANK) = bank;
    jsr(ram, r, s->ret_reset, hm_ResetCurrentEventSlotShort);
  } else {
    jsr(ram, r, s->ret_reset, hm_ResetCurrentEventSlotLong);
  }
}

/* PHA ... PLA around the start, then +3F = the slot's number. */
static uint16_t start_script_numbered(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const ScriptStart *s)
{
  uint16_t slot = r->a;
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(slot >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)slot);
  start_script(ram, r, s);
  uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  slot = (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_NUMBER), (uint8_t)slot);
  r->a = slot;
  r->y = SLOT_NUMBER;
  return slot;
}

void hm_StartEventScript(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const ScriptStart s = { 0x8044, 0x8095, GROUPS_SHORT, GROUP_SHORT, true };
  start_script(ram, r, &s);
}

void hm_StartEventScriptLong(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const ScriptStart s = { 0x809D, 0x80EA, GROUPS_LONG, GROUP_LONG, false };
  start_script_numbered(ram, r, &s);
}

void hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const ScriptStart s = { 0x80FE, 0x814B, GROUPS_LONG, GROUP_LONG, false };
  start_script_numbered(ram, r, &s);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_X), hm_rd16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X));
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_Y), r->a);
  r->y = SLOT_Y;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ClearAllEventSlots ($84:8000, JSL, RTL): frees the 49 script slots
 * (the first byte of each to 0), each through SetEventSlotPointer.
 * Leftovers: $CC-$CE = the last slot, X = $31, Y = 0, C = 1, A = what
 * SetEventSlotPointer left with its low byte 0.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_CLEAR_ALL 0x800A

void hm_ClearAllEventSlots(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x != 0x31; x++) {
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(x >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)x);   /* PHX */
    r->a = x;                                                            /* TXA */
    hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_CLEAR_ALL, 0x84);
    hm_SetEventSlotPointer(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    r->y = SLOT_IN_USE;
    r->a &= 0xFF00;
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_IN_USE), 0);
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                                  /* PLX */
  }
  r->x = 0x31;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SetSlotAnimation ($84:8895, JSL, RTL): the slot's animation from a table at
 * [$72]: 3 bytes per entry, entry = the slot's +02. The word goes to +16,
 * the byte (x 64) to +14.
 * Leftovers: $7E = the entry, A = byte x 64, Y = $14, C = 0.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SetSlotAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t entry = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ANIM_ENTRY, entry);
  uint16_t y = (uint16_t)(entry * 3);
  uint16_t word = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, ANIM_TABLE, y));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(y >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)y);   /* PHY */
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_SPRITE), word);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                                  /* PLY */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, ANIM_TABLE, (uint16_t)(y + 2))) << 6);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_ANIMATION), r->a);
  r->y = SLOT_ANIMATION;
  r->c = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * FreeEventSlot ($84:8020, JSL, RTL): frees slot A (its +00 = 0, through
 * SetEventSlotPointer: $CC-$CE then point at it) and destroys its game object (the
 * slot's +12, DestroyGameObject).
 * Leftovers: those of DestroyGameObject.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_FreeEventSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8025, 0x84);
  hm_SetEventSlotPointer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->y = SLOT_IN_USE;
  r->a &= 0xFF00;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_IN_USE), 0);
  r->y = SLOT_OBJECT;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_OBJECT));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x803D, 0x85);
  hm_DestroyGameObject(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * StepSlot ($84:8331, JSR, RTS): one step of a slot's walk. Only if +01
 * bit 5 (walking): the step timer +06 goes down; at 0 it is reloaded from
 * +05 and the slot moves by (+03, +04), signed bytes, added to its
 * position (+1A, +1C).
 * Leftovers: $7E / $80 = the step, A = the new Y (or the timer, or the
 * flags), Y = the last field touched, C from the add.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint8_t slot8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  r->y = at;
  uint8_t v = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, at));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
  return v;
}

void hm_StepSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!(slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) & 0x20)) { r->a &= 0xFF20; return; }  /* AND #$20 */
  uint8_t timer = (uint8_t)(slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_TIMER) - 1);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_STEP_TIMER), timer);
  if (slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_TIMER)) return;
  uint8_t reload = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_DELAY);
  r->y = SLOT_STEP_TIMER;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_STEP_TIMER), reload);
  int8_t dx = (int8_t)slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_X);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, STEP_DX, (uint16_t)(int16_t)dx);
  int8_t dy = (int8_t)slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_Y);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, STEP_DY, (uint16_t)(int16_t)dy);
  static const uint8_t at[2] = { SLOT_X, SLOT_Y };
  for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    r->y = at[i];
    uint16_t pos = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, at[i]));
    uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)pos + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, i ? STEP_DY : STEP_DX);
    r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
    r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, at[i]), r->a);
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * WanderSlot ($84:83CC, JSR, RTS): a slot that wanders on its own (+01
 * bit 3: villagers in town, the animals in the barn...). Each time its
 * step timers agree (+05 == +06, that is, right after a step):
 *  - if no steps are left (+08 = 0) it picks a new walk of +07 steps: the
 *    direction +0F if the script forced one (1 down, 2 up, 4 right,
 *    8 left), else $DE (0 down, 1 up, 2 right, 3 left; others: stand
 *    still);
 *  - otherwise it keeps going one step less (+08 - 1).
 * A slot without +01 bit 7 ("free") never leaves its area: the home
 * position (+1E, +20) plus or minus the range (+09 across, +0A down); a
 * step that would go past it makes the slot stand still instead (no step,
 * +08 = 0, the standing animation from the table at +33).
 * Starting a walk: direction +02, step (+03, +04) = (0, 1) down,
 * (0, -1) up, (1, 0) right, (-1, 0) left, the step delay +0B to +05/+06,
 * the walking animation from the table at +36. Either way +01 |= 4 (the
 * animation changed).
 * Then, when moving, it looks ahead ($DF/$E1 = the position, $E5/$E7 =
 * the step size, $E3 = 0):
 *  - with +01 bit 7, the map (CollideMap; the tile type of the first corner
 *    goes to +0E): blocked, or a tile $FF or $C0-$CF ahead, stops it;
 *  - the tile $EB of the second corner (also when CollideMap was not called:
 *    then it is whatever the last check left there), the same way;
 *  - the player in the way (CollidePlayer) stops it too.
 * Tile $E1 (a door?) only lets the slots numbered $18-$23 (+3F) through.
 * Stopping: no step, +05/+06 = +0B, and the forced direction is cleared.
 * Leftovers: $92 = +06; $7E/$80 from the area check; $72-$74 = the
 * animation table; A, Y and C as each way out leaves them.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_STAND_ANIM   0x86DC   /* JSL SetSlotAnimation at $84:86D9 */
#define RET_WALK_ANIM    0x8706   /* JSL SetSlotAnimation at $84:8703 */
#define RET_LOOK_MAP     0x87B1   /* JSL CollideMap at $84:87AE */
#define RET_LOOK_PLAYER  0x8810   /* JSL CollidePlayer at $84:880D */
#define ANIMATION_BANK   0xB3

static void put8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t v)
{
  r->y = at;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, at), v);
}
static void store8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)   /* STA [$CC],Y */
{
  r->y = at;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, at), (uint8_t)r->a);
}
static uint16_t slot16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  r->y = at;
  return r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, at));
}
/* A = 0; LDA (8 bits): the byte zero-extended */
static uint16_t slot8_ext(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = 0;
  return slot8(ram, r, at);
}

/* the area: true if the slot may go on. `across`: x (+1A against +1E,
 * range +09), else y (+1C, +20, +0A); `ahead`: the side the step goes to
 * (down / right). */
static bool inside_area(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, bool across, bool ahead)
{
  uint16_t range = slot8_ext(ram, r, across ? SLOT_RANGE_X : SLOT_RANGE_Y);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, AREA_RANGE, range);
  uint16_t pos = slot16(ram, r, across ? SLOT_X : SLOT_Y);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, AREA_POS, pos);
  uint16_t home = slot16(ram, r, across ? SLOT_HOME_X : SLOT_HOME_Y);
  uint32_t edge = ahead ? (uint32_t)home + range : (uint32_t)home - range + 0x10000;
  r->a = (uint16_t)edge;                         /* CLC; ADC / SEC; SBC */
  r->c = r->a >= pos;                            /* CMP $80 */
  return ahead ? r->c : !r->c;
}

/* the slot's animation from the table at +33 (standing) or +36 (walking),
 * then +01 |= 4 */
static void set_slot_animation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t table, uint16_t ret)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ANIM_TABLE, slot16(ram, r, table));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | ANIMATION_BANK);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, ANIM_TABLE_BANK) = ANIMATION_BANK;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84);
  hm_SetSlotAnimation(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  put8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) | 0x04);
}

static void stand_still(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)        /* .CODE_8486B3 */
{
  put8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_X, 0);
  put8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_Y, 0);
  put8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT, 0);
  set_slot_animation(ram, r, SLOT_ANIM_TABLE, RET_STAND_ANIM);
}

static void stop_here(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)          /* .CODE_848817 */
{
  put8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_X, 0);
  put8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_Y, 0);
  slot8(ram, r, SLOT_WALK_DELAY);
  store8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_DELAY);
  store8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_TIMER);
  put8(ram, r, SLOT_FORCED_DIR, 0);
}

/* a tile type ahead: 0 = go on, 1 = stop, 2 = tile $E1 */
static int tile_ahead(HmRegs *r, uint16_t tile)
{
  r->a = tile;
  if (tile == 0x00FF) { r->c = 1; return 1; }
  if (tile == 0x00E1) { r->c = 1; return 2; }
  r->c = tile >= 0x00C0;
  if (!r->c) return 0;
  r->c = tile >= 0x00D0;
  return r->c ? 0 : 1;
}
/* tile $E1: only the slots numbered $18-$23 go through */
static bool may_pass_e1(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t self = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_NUMBER);
  r->c = self >= CHICKEN_SLOT0;
  if (r->c) return false;
  r->c = self >= COW_SLOT0;
  return r->c;
}

void hm_WanderSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t flags = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (flags & 0x08));
  if (!(flags & 0x08)) return;
  uint8_t timer = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_TIMER);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, WANDER_TIMER) = timer;
  uint8_t delay = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_DELAY);
  r->c = delay >= timer;
  if (delay != timer) return;

  /* the direction to start, or -1 to go on, -2 to stand still */
  int dir;
  if (slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT) == 0) {
    slot8(ram, r, SLOT_WALK_STEPS);
    store8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT);
    uint8_t forced = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FORCED_DIR);
    static const uint8_t forced_bit[4] = { 1, 2, 4, 8 };
    dir = -2;
    for (int i = 0; forced && i < 4; i++)
      if (forced == forced_bit[i]) { dir = i; break; }
    if (dir == -2) {
      uint8_t random = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_RNG_LAST);
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | random);
      if (random < 4) dir = random;
    }
  } else if (slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) & 0x80) {
    r->a &= 0xFF80;
    dir = -1;
  } else {
    /* going on: the area, on the side of the current direction (0-3;
     * anything else counts as down). (The carry of the comparisons here
     * and in the choice above never survives: the area check or
     * SetSlotAnimation sets it.) */
    uint8_t now = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY);
    switch (now < 4 ? now : 0) {
    case 0:  dir = inside_area(ram, r, false, true) ? -1 : -2; break;
    case 1:  dir = inside_area(ram, r, false, false) ? -1 : -2; break;
    case 2:  dir = inside_area(ram, r, true, true) ? -1 : -2; break;
    default: dir = inside_area(ram, r, true, false) ? -1 : -2; break;
    }
  }

  if (dir >= 0) {
    if (slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) & 0x80) {
      r->a &= 0xFF80;
    } else if (!inside_area(ram, r, dir >= 2, !(dir & 1))) {
      dir = -2;
    }
  }
  if (dir == -2) {
    stand_still(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  if (dir >= 0) {
    static const int8_t step[4][2] = { { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 }, { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 } };
    slot8(ram, r, SLOT_WALK_DELAY);
    store8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_DELAY);
    store8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_TIMER);
    put8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_X, (uint8_t)step[dir][0]);
    put8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_Y, (uint8_t)step[dir][1]);
    put8(ram, r, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY, (uint8_t)dir);
    set_slot_animation(ram, r, SLOT_WALK_TABLE, RET_WALK_ANIM);
  } else {
    slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT);
    put8(ram, r, SLOT_STEPS_LEFT, (uint8_t)(r->a - 1));
  }

  /* looking ahead */
  int8_t dx = (int8_t)slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_X);
  if (!dx && !slot8(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_Y)) return;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X, slot16(ram, r, SLOT_X));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y, slot16(ram, r, SLOT_Y));
  int8_t sx = (int8_t)slot8_ext(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_X);
  if (sx < 0) r->a = (uint8_t)-sx;               /* EOR #$FF; INC (8 bits) */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X, r->a);
  int8_t sy = (int8_t)slot8_ext(ram, r, SLOT_STEP_Y);
  if (sy < 0) r->a = (uint8_t)-sy;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y, r->a);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, 0);

  int ahead;
  if (slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) & 0x80) {
    r->a &= 0xFF80;
    slot8_ext(ram, r, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY);
    hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_LOOK_MAP, 0x83);
    hm_CollideMap(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    uint16_t blocked = r->a;
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(blocked >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)blocked);  /* PHA */
    uint16_t first = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_TILE_1);
    r->a = first;
    store8(ram, r, SLOT_STATE);
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);          /* PLA */
    r->a = blocked;
    r->c = 1;                                    /* CMP #0 */
    if (blocked) { stop_here(ram, r); return; }
    ahead = tile_ahead(r, first);
    if (ahead == 2) ahead = may_pass_e1(ram, r) ? 0 : 1;
    if (ahead) { stop_here(ram, r); return; }
  }
  ahead = tile_ahead(r, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_TILE_2));
  if (ahead == 2) ahead = may_pass_e1(ram, r) ? 0 : 1;
  if (ahead) { stop_here(ram, r); return; }

  slot8_ext(ram, r, SLOT_ANIM_ENTRY);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_LOOK_PLAYER, 0x83);
  hm_CollidePlayer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->c = 1;                                      /* CMP #0 */
  if (r->a) stop_here(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * UpdateSlotSprite ($84:8286, JSR, RTS): a slot's sprite, each frame. Unless
 * +01 bit 4 (frozen), the slot first wanders (WanderSlot) and steps
 * (StepSlot). Then its game object (+12) gets the slot's position (+1A,
 * +1C), animation (+14) and sprite (+16), through $A5, $9F, $9B, $9D, $A1;
 * and by +01:
 *   bit 6  destroy the object (DestroyGameObject);
 *   bit 1  create it (CreateGameObject; the new object goes to +12);
 *   bit 2  the sprite changed (+16 != +18, the last one): ChangeGameObjectSprite;
 *   none   just move it (MoveGameObject).
 * Then +18 = +16 and the one-time bits 1, 2 and 4 of +01 are cleared
 * (AND #$E9).
 * Leftovers: A = the new +01, Y = 1; X and C from the object routine.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_WANDER       0x8297   /* JSR WanderSlot at $84:8295 */
#define RET_STEP         0x829A   /* JSR StepSlot at $84:8298 */
#define RET_MOVE_OBJECT  0x82DC   /* JSL MoveGameObject at $84:82D9 */
#define RET_NEW_OBJECT   0x82E2   /* JSL CreateGameObject at $84:82DF */
#define RET_NEW_SPRITE   0x8307   /* JSL ChangeGameObjectSprite at $84:8304 */
#define RET_DROP_OBJECT  0x830D   /* JSL DestroyGameObject at $84:830A */

static void object_call(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x85);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

void hm_UpdateSlotSprite(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t flags = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (flags & 0x10));
  if (!(flags & 0x10)) {
    jsr(ram, r, RET_WANDER, hm_WanderSlot);
    jsr(ram, r, RET_STEP, hm_StepSlot);
  }
  static const struct { uint8_t field, dp; } to_object[5] = {
    { SLOT_OBJECT, HM_OBJ_NUMBER }, { SLOT_ANIMATION, HM_OBJ_FLIP }, { SLOT_X, HM_OBJ_X }, { SLOT_Y, HM_OBJ_Y },
    { SLOT_SPRITE, HM_OBJ_SPRITE } };
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, to_object[i].dp, slot16(ram, r, to_object[i].field));

  flags = slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS);
  if (flags & 0x40) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x40);
    object_call(ram, r, RET_DROP_OBJECT, hm_DestroyGameObject);
  } else if (flags & 0x02) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x02);
    object_call(ram, r, RET_NEW_OBJECT, hm_CreateGameObject);
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER);
    r->y = SLOT_OBJECT;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_OBJECT), r->a);
  } else if (flags & 0x04) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x04);
    uint16_t sprite = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_SPRITE);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SPRITE_NOW, sprite);
    uint16_t last = slot16(ram, r, SLOT_LAST_SPRITE);
    r->c = last >= sprite;                       /* CMP $7E */
    if (last != sprite) object_call(ram, r, RET_NEW_SPRITE, hm_ChangeGameObjectSprite);
  } else {
    r->a &= 0xFF00;
    object_call(ram, r, RET_MOVE_OBJECT, hm_MoveGameObject);
  }
  slot16(ram, r, SLOT_SPRITE);
  r->y = SLOT_LAST_SPRITE;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_LAST_SPRITE), r->a);
  put8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS, slot8(ram, r, SLOT_FLAGS) & 0xE9);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * EventInstructionInterpreter ($84:8249, JSR, RTS): one command of the
 * script of the slot at $CC: $C9-$CB = its position (+30, +32), the
 * command's routine from EventInstructionPointers ($84:9419, 90 words,
 * JSR (abs,X)); then the new position goes back to the slot.
 * Leftovers: A = $CB (8-bit A), Y = $32, X and C those of the command.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void (*const EVENT_COMMANDS[90])(uint8_t *, HmRegs *) = {
  hm_Event_SetWantedSong, hm_Event_TimeRunning, hm_Event_TimeStopped, hm_Event_SetHour,
  hm_Event_DoNothing, hm_Event_SetPlayerPosition, hm_Event_SetTransitionDest, hm_Event_SetPlayerDirection,
  hm_Event_DisablePlayerControl, hm_Event_StartOtherSlot, hm_Event_ScreenFadeIn, hm_Event_SetSceneFlag,
  hm_Event_WaitForSceneFlag, hm_Event_MoveSlot, hm_Event_ChangeToWantedSong, hm_Event_ScreenFadeOut,
  hm_Event_FreeOwnSlot, hm_Event_EnablePlayerControl, hm_Event_JumpToInstruction, hm_Event_WaitFrames,
  hm_Event_JumpIfFlagSet, hm_Event_JumpIfEquals, hm_Event_JumpIfBetween, hm_Event_GetRNG,
  hm_Event_JumpIfEqualsRNG, hm_Event_SetPlayerAnimation, hm_Event_PlaceSlot, hm_Event_SetSlotSprite,
  hm_Event_StartTextBox, hm_Event_StartTextBoxCopy, hm_Event_TalkIfSpokenTo, hm_Event_TalkIfSpokenTo,
  hm_Event_JumpIfAnswer, hm_Event_AddToByteClamped, hm_Event_WanderInArea, hm_Event_SetFlag,
  hm_Event_TimeOfDayPalette, hm_Event_FreeOtherSlot, hm_Event_ResetFlag, hm_Event_ResetFlag,
  hm_Event_ResetFlag, hm_Event_MapScrolling, hm_Event_StartMapAnimation, hm_Event_SetSlotAnimation,
  hm_Event_PlayEffectAndWait, hm_Event_TalkOrTakeShownItem, hm_Event_WanderFreely, hm_Event_SetStandingAnimation,
  hm_Event_ChickenFrame, hm_Event_CowFrame, hm_Event_StoreValue, hm_Event_PickUpMole,
  hm_Event_PickUpFish, hm_Event_HorseFrame, hm_Event_DogFrame, hm_Event_DestroyOwnObject,
  hm_Event_WaitUntilSkippable, hm_Event_WalkPlayer, hm_Event_RunPlayer, hm_Event_ChangeItemOnHand,
  hm_Event_TransitionToHouse, hm_Event_TransitionToMap, hm_Event_SetItemOnHand, hm_Event_DropItemAnimation,
  hm_Event_IgnoreTileProperties, hm_Event_AddToWordMax999, hm_Event_ChangeMoney, hm_Event_JumpIfEqualsValue,
  hm_Event_JumpIfEqualsValueLong, hm_Event_JumpIfBetweenValue, hm_Event_JumpIfBetweenValueLong, hm_Event_SetValueByte,
  hm_Event_SetValueLong, hm_Event_SetSlotAnimationPlayerDir, hm_Event_PickUpPowerBerry, hm_Event_EditTileOnMap,
  hm_Event_MakeSlotPassable, hm_Event_FacePlayerIfSpokenTo, hm_Event_UseTileProperties, hm_Event_DisableTools,
  hm_Event_PutDownCarried, hm_Event_Cmd51_PutDownCarriedQuietly, hm_Event_Cmd52_PickUpChild1, hm_Event_Cmd53_PickUpChild2,
  hm_Event_Cmd54_AutoCloseTextBox, hm_Event_Cmd55_JumpIfBitClear, hm_Event_Cmd56_UseToolInHand, hm_Event_Cmd57_ChangeStamina,
  hm_Event_Cmd58_SetFarmTile, hm_Event_Cmd59_SwapTools,
};

void hm_EventInstructionInterpreter(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->y = SLOT_SCRIPT;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_SCRIPT));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, r->a);
  r->y = SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK;
  uint8_t bank = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | bank);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_BANK) = bank;
  uint8_t cmd = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, 0));   /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA [$C9] */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(cmd << 1);                                    /* REP #$20; ASL; TAX */
  r->c = 0;
  r->x = r->a;
  if (cmd < 90) jsr(ram, r, 0x826C, EVENT_COMMANDS[cmd]);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);                        /* REP #$30 */
  r->y = SLOT_SCRIPT;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_SCRIPT), r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_BANK));
  r->y = SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_SCRIPT_BANK), (uint8_t)r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * RunEventSlots ($84:816F, JSL, RTL): every frame, unless a text box
 * waits ($019A = 2 or 6) or the player is in action 3: a random number to
 * $DE (GetRNG) and then each of the 49 slots in use (+00 bit 0): while its
 * wait (+10) is 0 its script runs one command after another
 * (EventInstructionInterpreter; +03/+04 cleared first unless +01 bit 3),
 * else the wait goes down by one (and at 0 the script runs this same
 * frame); $DE + $33 for the next slot; a slot with a sprite (+01 bit 0)
 * gets it updated (UpdateSlotSprite). At the end the one-frame bits are cleared:
 * $7F1F5A bits 4, 6, 7, 8; $7F1F5C bit 10; $7F1F5E bit 6; $7F1F60 bit 4.
 * Leftovers: A = the new $7F1F60, C = 1 (or that of the compare that
 * stopped it), X = $31 after the slots.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_RunEventSlots(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t input = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_INPUT_STATE);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | input);
  r->c = input >= 2;
  bool skip = input == 2;
  if (!skip) { r->c = input >= 6; skip = input == 6; }
  if (!skip) {
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
    r->c = r->a >= 3;
    skip = r->a == 3;
  }
  if (!skip) {
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8193, 0x83);
    hm_GetRNG(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_RNG_LAST) = (uint8_t)r->a;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, CC_SLOTS_BASE);
    r->a = 0xB57E;                                              /* SEP #$20; LDA #$7E */
    *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT_BANK) = 0x7E;
    r->x = 0;
    do {
      hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(r->x >> 8));                   /* PHX */
      hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)r->x);
      r->y = SLOT_IN_USE;
      uint8_t used = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_IN_USE));
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (used & 0x01));
      if (used & 0x01) {
        r->y = SLOT_FRAMES;
        r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FRAMES));
        if (r->a) {                                             /* DEC A; STA */
          r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a - 1);
          hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FRAMES), r->a);
        }
        for (;;) {
          r->y = SLOT_FRAMES;
          r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FRAMES));
          if (r->a) break;
          r->y = SLOT_FLAGS;
          uint8_t flags = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_FLAGS));
          r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (flags & 0x08));
          if (!(flags & 0x08)) {
            r->y = SLOT_STEP_X;
            r->a = 0;
            hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, SLOT_STEP_X), 0);
          }
```
