```c
    show_text(ram, r, text, 0xAEB5);
    return;
  }
  if (!below(r, 0xC0)) {                                   /* a door with opening hours */
    r->y = at;
    r->c = (type >> 14) & 1;
    uint8_t rule_no = table8(ram, r, at);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, RULE_NUMBER) = rule_no;
    r->y = (uint16_t)(at + 1);
    uint8_t text = table8(ram, r, r->y);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, RULE_TEXT) = text;
    r->a = text;
    if (!text) return;
    r->c = 0;                                              /* ASL x3 of a byte */
    r->x = (uint16_t)((uint16_t)(rule_no << 3) + 3);
    uint8_t rule = hm_bus_rd8(ram, DOOR_TABLE + r->x);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->x & 0xFF00) | rule);
    if (!rule_applies(ram, r, rule)) return;
    r->a = text;                                           /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $93 */
    show_text(ram, r, text, 0xAE98);
    return;
  }

  /* the rest: things to pick up, or people and animals */
  uint8_t season = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)));
  r->c = season >= 2;                                      /* CMP #2; CMP #3 */
  if (season != 2) r->c = season >= 3;
  if (season == 2 || season == 3) {
    static const uint8_t bare[] = { 0x38, 0x39, 0x52, 0x53, 0x60, 0x61, 0x6E, 0x6F };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof bare; i++) {
      r->c = type >= bare[i];
      if (type == bare[i]) return;
    }
  }
  r->a = at;
  r->c = (type >> 14) & 1;
  r->y = (uint16_t)(at + 1);
  if (lda8(r, table8(ram, r, r->y)) & 0x80) {              /* pick it up */
    r->y = at;
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_PICKED_TILE_BYTE), lda8(r, table8(ram, r, at)));
    set16(ram, r, PICK_AT, at);
    uint32_t s = (uint32_t)at + hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)); /* CLC; ADC $7E */
    r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
    r->x = (uint16_t)s;
    r->a = (uint16_t)s;
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND), lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, PICK_UP_ITEMS + r->x)));
    r->a = 4;
    set16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 4);
    return;
  }
  r->y = (uint16_t)(at + 2);
  if (lda8(r, table8(ram, r, r->y)) & 0x01) {
    r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0020;           /* (both ways return) */
    return;
  }
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X, dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X));
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y, dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y));
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X, 0);
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y, 0);
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, 0x0010);
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xAEFE, 0x83);
  hm_CollideEventObjects(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The player's actions ($096E, set by pressing A on a door-like tile: see
 * PressAOnTile), run by PlayerInteractionSelector through the table $81:D593
 * (JSR, RTS each). Most entries are a lone RTS (Unused01-11). The others
 * end by clearing $D2 bit 6 (the "an action is pending" bit):
 *   2 GetFenceFromStack ($81:D644): take lumber from the stack (AddWood
 *     with -2): if there was enough, you hold item $57 and $D4 = 4 (the
 *     "carrying" action);
 *   6 / 7 PlayerAction_06_MapAnimation11 / PlayerAction_07_MapAnimation12: start map animation $11 / $12.
 * Leftovers: A = the new $D2, C from the last compare.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void action_done(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & ~0x0040);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}

void hm_GetFenceFromStack(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = 0xFFFE;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD64C, 0x83);
  hm_AddWood(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->c = r->a >= 1;                                         /* CMP #1 */
  if (r->a != 1) {                                          /* 1 = none left */
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0x57);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0x0004);
  }
  action_done(ram, r);
}

static void map_animation_action(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t animation, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = animation;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x81);
  hm_StartMapAnimation(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  action_done(ram, r);
}
void hm_PlayerAction_06_MapAnimation11(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { map_animation_action(ram, r, 0x11, 0xD6EA); }
void hm_PlayerAction_07_MapAnimation12(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { map_animation_action(ram, r, 0x12, 0xD700); }

/* the actions that do nothing: a lone RTS. Also the other routines that
 * are only a return: COP_Return ($80:872A, RTS), ScreenTransitionReturn
 * ($80:972B, RTL), ShippingReturn ($82:81BF, RTL; the end ShippingScene
 * and the next routine share) and CODE_83F4D7 ($83:F4D7, RTS). */
void hm_ActionNothing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { (void)ram; (void)r; }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PlayerAction_04_Jingle ($81:D670, JSR, RTS): action 4, run every frame while it
 * lasts. The first time ($096F != 1): the sound effect $19 of bank 6 with
 * the song's instrument (PrepareSoundEffect, played by PlaySoundEffect0A), $7F1F5A
 * bit 4, the map animation $44 (StartMapAnimation), $096F + 1. Then it
 * counts $0970 up to $20: there the action is over ($D2 bit 6 cleared) and
 * the noises of the item in hand are loaded again ($0119 = 0,
 * ToolUsedSound2).
 * PrepareSoundEffect keeps V, D and I of the entry flags (nothing here changes
 * them).
 * Leftovers: those of StartMapAnimation / ToolUsedSound2, or A = the
 * counter and C from its compare.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint32_t db_at(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }

void hm_PlayerAction_04_Jingle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  uint8_t state = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_at(r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | state);
  r->c = state >= 1;
  if (state != 1) {
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_at(r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT), 0x19);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_at(r, HM_SOUND_BANK), 0x06);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_at(r, HM_SONG_LOADED));      /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
    r->x = r->a;
    uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, (SONG_INSTRUMENTS + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF) + 1);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | n);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_at(r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), n);
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD69D, 0x83);
    hm_PrepareSoundEffect(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD6A1, 0x83);
    hm_PlaySoundEffect0A(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) | 0x0010);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), r->a);
    r->a = 0x0044;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD6B7, 0x81);
    hm_StartMapAnimation(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_at(r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP), (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_at(r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP)) + 1));
    return;
  }
  uint8_t count = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_at(r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES)) + 1);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_at(r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES), count);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | count);
  r->c = count >= 0x20;
  if (count != 0x20) return;
  action_done(ram, r);                                       /* REP #$30 */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_at(r, HM_LOADED_TOOL_SOUND), 0);
  r->p = entry;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD6DF, 0x82);
  hm_ToolUsedSound2(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->p = entry;
}

```

`src/intro.c`:

```c
/*
 * intro.c — from the power-on to the game: the title screen and its
 * menus, the new game and the saved one.
 *
 * IntroScreen ($82:D75E, from RESET) sets up the Natsume logo and then
 * runs a frame at a time ($82:D80D): it waits for the NMI, runs the
 * colour cycles (RunColourAnimations) and the joypad (InputTypeSelector), then the
 * part of the intro of $95 (the stage):
 *   0  the logo, 2 seconds (120 frames), then it fades out: stage 1;
 *   1  the parents' scene: a small game (script 0 of group 9) played on its
 *      own frames ($82:D93F, as GameLoop does) until the script ends
 *      ($7F1F5C bit 2), then the title's pictures: stage 2;
 *   2  the title slides in (BG2 right one pixel every other frame, BG1 to
 *      0), then a second's pause ($96 to $3C): stage 3;
 *   3  BG1 / BG2 up to 0: stage 6;
 *   6, 9  the title screen's background (map $5C; 9 also clears the
 *      screen first), faded in: stage 4;
 *   4  a second (BG2 drifting), then the menu's marks (colour cycles,
 *      StartColourAnimation) with the choice $098D: stage 5;
 *   5  the menu: BG2 drifting, the marks again when the choice changed
 *      ($97, set by the menu's inputs), and the demo's count $90 + 1;
 *   7  the new game's file screen (map $5E, the two files' frames and
 *      names), on its own frames ($82:E0EB);
 *   8  the saved game's file screen: ContinueFileScreen;
 *   10 the first demo: FirstDemo;
 * and at the end of each frame ($82:D871, "democheck"), after 600 frames
 * of the menu (10 s), the other demos (DemoPresentation).
 * The file screens go back to the title ($94 = 1, $82:DEC5), or start the
 * game ($94 = 2): StartFromNewGame, StartFromLoad.
 *
 * Nothing here returns: each check stops at the end of one frame (the
 * jump back to the frame's start) or where it goes on to another of these
 * routines (HM_TOLOOP). IntroFrame, _D93F, _E0EB and ContinueFileScreenFrame
 * check one frame of each loop on its own.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* Direct page */
#define NMI_STATUS        0x00   /* 8b: set by the NMI (UpdateGraphics), cleared each frame */
#define DMA_CHANNEL       0x27   /* 8b: AddProgrammedDMA's channel (dma.c) */
#define DMA_B_ADDRESS     0x29   /* 8b: its destination register (B-bus, $21xx) */
#define DMA_SOURCE        0x72   /* 24b $72-$74: colours(): the DMA's source */
#define DMA_SOURCE_BANK   0x74   /* 8b: its bank */
#define CYCLE_TABLE       0x72   /* 24b: cycle(): StartColourAnimation's table (the same
                                    bytes as DMA_SOURCE) */
#define CYCLE_TABLE_BANK  0x74   /* 8b: its bank */
#define COUNT             0x94   /* 8b: the stage's frames; the file screens: their answer
                                    (1 back to the title, 2 start the game) */
#define DRIFT_TIMER       0x96   /* 8b: the background drifts every other frame; the title's
                                    second of pause */
#define OAM_USED          0xAF   /* 16b: PrepareOAMData's bytes of the sprite table filled
                                    (objects.c; $AF has other uses there) */

/* WRAM of the data bank */
#define BG3_X             0x0144 /* 16b: BG3's scroll, across */
#define SAVE_SLOT         0x098E /* 8b: the diary slot chosen (0 or 1) */

/* ROM: colours ($A9:xxxx, 512 bytes each) and colour cycles ($82:xxxx) */
#define TITLE_COLOURS     0xD800 /* $A9:D800: the title's pictures */
#define LOGO_COLOURS      0xDA00 /* $A9:DA00: the logo */
#define FILE_COLOURS      0x8C00 /* $A9:8C00: the file screens */
#define MENU_CYCLE_1      0xF2A4 /* $82:F2A4, $82:F2B5: the title menu's two colour cycles */
#define MENU_CYCLE_2      0xF2B5

typedef void Fn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);

static uint32_t db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, a)); }
static uint16_t rd16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, db(r, a)); }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }
static uint8_t dp8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, unsigned a) { return *hm_dp(ram, r, a); }
static void set_dp8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, unsigned a, uint8_t v) { *hm_dp(ram, r, a) = v; }

/* JSL at `at` to a routine of `bank`. Those that wait frames save the
 * flags (PHP): r->p carries the carry, 8-bit A, the index width `x8`, D
 * and I of the entry (N, Z and V are not followed: HM_LOOSE). */
static void call(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, Fn *fn, int x8)
{
  uint8_t keep = r->p;
  r->p = (uint8_t)((keep & 0x0C) | 0x20 | (x8 ? 0x10 : 0) | (r->c & 1));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->p = keep;
}
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, Fn *fn) { call(ram, r, at, bank, fn, 0); }
/* JSR to a routine of this bank, returning to `ret` */
static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, Fn *fn)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(ret >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
}
/* the fades: $92 from, $93 frames a level, $94 to */
static void fade(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t from, uint8_t frames, uint8_t to, uint16_t at, Fn *fn)
{
  set_a8(r, from); set_dp8(ram, r, HM_FADE_FROM, from);    /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, frames); set_dp8(ram, r, HM_FADE_FRAMES, frames);
  set_a8(r, to); set_dp8(ram, r, HM_FADE_TO, to);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x80, fn);
}
static void fade_out(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t frames, uint16_t at) { fade(ram, r, 0x0F, frames, 0x01, at, hm_ScreenFadeOut); }
static void fade_in(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t from, uint8_t frames, uint16_t at) { fade(ram, r, from, frames, 0x0F, at, hm_ScreenFadeIn); }
/* SEP #$20; LDA #map; STA $22 (and the routine at `at`) */
static void map_is(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t map)
{
  set_a8(r, map);
  set_dp8(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID, map);
}
/* a picture's colours to CGRAM: channel 0, $200 bytes from $A9:`from` */
static void colours(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t from, uint16_t at)
{
  set_a8(r, 0); set_dp8(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL, 0);           /* SEP #$20; REP #$10 */
  set_a8(r, 0x22); set_dp8(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS, 0x22);
  r->y = 0x0200; r->x = 0;                                 /* REP #$20 */
  r->a = from;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE, from);
  set_a8(r, 0xA9); set_dp8(ram, r, DMA_SOURCE_BANK, 0xA9); /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x80, hm_AddProgrammedDMA);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 4), 0x80, hm_StartLastPreparedDMA);
}
/* the music of map $22 changes (FadeOutSong, 20, 22) and is noted as the
 * one playing ($0117) */
static void new_music(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_FadeOutSong);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 4), 0x83, hm_SetSong);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 8), 0x83, hm_StartSong);
  uint8_t song = rd8(ram, r, HM_WANTED_SONG);              /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, song);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_PLAYING_SONG, song);
}
/* the screen lit, one frame */
static void lit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x80, hm_ResetForceBlank);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 4), 0x80, hm_WaitForNMI);
}
/* everything of the old picture cleared, from `at` (JSLs 4 bytes apart):
 * ZeroesVRAM, ZeroesCGRAM, StopAllColourAnimations, ClearSpriteDataTables,
 * InitializeOBJs, ClearItemRecords, ClearAllEventSlots */
static void clear_all(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  static const struct { uint8_t bank; Fn *fn; } ALL[7] = {
    { 0x80, hm_ZeroesVRAM }, { 0x80, hm_ZeroesCGRAM }, { 0x80, hm_StopAllColourAnimations },
    { 0x85, hm_ClearSpriteDataTables }, { 0x85, hm_InitializeOBJs }, { 0x81, hm_ClearItemRecords },
    { 0x84, hm_ClearAllEventSlots },
  };
  for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 4 * i), ALL[i].bank, ALL[i].fn);
}
/* STZ of words (REP #$20) */
static void zero_words(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const uint16_t *a, unsigned n)
{
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++) wr16(ram, r, a[i], 0);
}
static const uint16_t SCROLLS[4] = { HM_CAM_X, HM_CAM_Y, HM_BG2_X, HM_BG2_Y };
static const uint16_t ALL_SCROLLS[6] = { HM_CAM_X, HM_CAM_Y, HM_BG2_X, HM_BG2_Y, BG3_X, HM_BG3_Y };
/* $D6, $D8 (the player), $017D, $017F (where to), $0196 */
static void no_place(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_X, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_Y, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, 0);
}
/* a colour cycle (StartColourAnimation) from $82:`table`: A = which, X / Y
 * the cycle's numbers, with 8-bit indexes */
static void cycle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t table, uint8_t a, uint8_t x, uint8_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = table;                                            /* REP #$20; SEP #$10 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CYCLE_TABLE, table);
  set_a8(r, 0x82); set_dp8(ram, r, CYCLE_TABLE_BANK, 0x82);   /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, a);
  r->x = x; r->y = y;
  call(ram, r, at, 0x80, hm_StartColourAnimation, 1);
}
#define MARK_ON  0xF2C9   /* the menu's chosen line */
#define MARK_OFF 0xF2DA
/* the menu's three lines' marks, the one of $098D (0-2) lit; the calls
 * at `at`, + $1B, + $36 */
static void menu_marks(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t choice, uint16_t at)
{
  static const struct { uint8_t a, x, y; } LINE[3] = { { 0x0D, 6, 7 }, { 0x0F, 7, 7 }, { 0x09, 8, 2 } };
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
    cycle(ram, r, i == choice ? MARK_ON : MARK_OFF, LINE[i].a, LINE[i].x, LINE[i].y, (uint16_t)(at + 0x1B * i));
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA $098D; CMP #1; BNE; CMP #2; BNE: the menu's choice */
static uint8_t choice_of(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t c = rd8(ram, r, HM_TITLE_CURSOR);
  set_a8(r, c);
  r->c = c >= 1;
  if (c == 1) return 1;
  r->c = c >= 2;
  return c == 2 ? 2 : 0;
}
#define FILE_ON  0xF2E2   /* the chosen file's frame */
#define FILE_OFF 0xF2F9
/* the two files' frames, the one of slot $098E lit: the calls at `at`
 * and `at2` */
static void file_marks(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, bool second, uint16_t at, uint16_t at2)
{
  cycle(ram, r, second ? FILE_OFF : FILE_ON, 6, 4, 0, at);
  cycle(ram, r, second ? FILE_ON : FILE_OFF, 6, 5, 1, at2);
}
/* the background drifts one pixel every other frame ($96) */
static void drift(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t d = dp8(ram, r, DRIFT_TIMER);                    /* SEP #$20; LDA $96; CMP #1 */
  set_a8(r, d);
  r->c = d >= 1;
  if (d == 1) {
    set_dp8(ram, r, DRIFT_TIMER, 0);
    wr16(ram, r, HM_BG2_X, (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_BG2_X) + 1)); /* REP #$20; INC; DEC */
    wr16(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y, (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y) - 1));
  } else {
    set_dp8(ram, r, DRIFT_TIMER, (uint8_t)(d + 1));
  }
}
/* LDA $0140; INC; STA (REP #$20) */
static void bg2_right(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_BG2_X) + 1);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_BG2_X, r->a);
}
/* SEP #$20; INC $94 */
static void count_up(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { set_dp8(ram, r, COUNT, (uint8_t)(dp8(ram, r, COUNT) + 1)); }
/* SEP #$20; LDA #s; STA $95; STZ $94 */
static void next_stage(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t s)
{
  set_a8(r, s);
  set_dp8(ram, r, HM_INTRO_STAGE, s);
  set_dp8(ram, r, COUNT, 0);
}
/* the NMI's wait loop (LDA $00 at `at`; the NMI comes back to it) */
static void wait_nmi(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t entry)
{
  for (;;) {
    uint8_t ready = dp8(ram, r, NMI_STATUS);               /* SEP #$20; LDA $00; BEQ */
    set_a8(r, ready);
    if (ready) break;
    hm_nmi(ram, r, at, (uint8_t)(entry | 0x20));
  }
}

/* $82:D871, the end of each frame: $00 cleared; after 600 frames of the
 * menu (JMP DemoPresentation) or round again (BRA $82:D80D): the check
 * stops at either */
static void democheck(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_dp8(ram, r, NMI_STATUS, 0);                          /* SEP #$20; STZ $00 */
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_MENU_FRAMES);                /* REP #$20; CMP #600 */
  r->c = r->a >= 0x0258;
  g_hm_next = r->a == 0x0258 ? 0x82D3C7 : 0x82D80D;        /* BNE; JMP DemoPresentation / BRA */
}

/* stage 0: the logo for 120 frames, then the fade */
static void logo(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->y = 0;
  do {
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(r->y >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)r->y);   /* PHY */
    jsl(ram, r, 0xD887, 0x80, hm_WaitForNMI);
    uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);                         /* REP #$30; PLY; INY */
    r->y = (uint16_t)((lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8) + 1);
    r->c = r->y >= 0x0078;
  } while (r->y != 0x0078);
  fade_out(ram, r, 3, 0xD8A2);
  next_stage(ram, r, 1);
  democheck(ram, r);
}

/* stage 1's frames ($82:D93F): as GameLoop's; false when the scene goes on
 * (the check stops: JMP back) */
static bool parents_frame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t entry)
{
  wait_nmi(ram, r, 0xD941, entry);
  r->a = 0x1800;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET, 0x1800);
  hm_game_frame(ram, r, 0xD94C);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & 0x0004); /* REP #$20 */
  if (!r->a) { set_dp8(ram, r, NMI_STATUS, 0); g_hm_next = 0x82D93F; return false; }   /* SEP #$20; STZ $00; JMP $D93F */
  return true;
}
/* the scene is over ($82:D9B3): unless it is the demo's end ($95 = 9), the
 * title's pictures (map $5B, palette $6D, colours from $A9:D800), BG1 and
 * BG2 at ($100, $100), its music, faded in: stage 2 */
static void parents_end(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t s = dp8(ram, r, HM_INTRO_STAGE);                 /* SEP #$20; CMP #9 */
  set_a8(r, s);
  r->c = s >= 9;
  if (s == 9) { democheck(ram, r); return; }               /* JMP $D871 */
  fade_out(ram, r, 3, 0xD9CC);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD9D0, 0x80, hm_ForceBlank);
  set_a8(r, 0x03);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD9D8, 0x80, hm_ManageGraphicPresets);
  clear_all(ram, r, 0xD9DC);
  map_is(ram, r, 0x5B);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD9FE, 0x80, hm_BackgroundsManager);
  r->a = 0x006D;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDA07, 0x80, hm_LoadFirstHalfPaletteToWRAM);
  colours(ram, r, TITLE_COLOURS, 0xDA2A);
  r->a = 0x0100;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  static const uint16_t AT[4] = { HM_CAM_X, HM_BG2_X, HM_CAM_Y, HM_BG2_Y };
  for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) wr16(ram, r, AT[i], 0x0100);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDA4C, 0x80, hm_PickMapMusic);
  new_music(ram, r, 0xDA50);
  lit(ram, r, 0xDA64);
  fade_in(ram, r, 0x01, 6, 0xDA7A);
  next_stage(ram, r, 2);
  set_dp8(ram, r, DRIFT_TIMER, 0);
  democheck(ram, r);
}
/* stage 1: the parents' scene: the game set up (the player standing,
 * BG3 off screen), script 0 of group 9, map $098B entered (its music
 * changed), and its frames */
static void parents(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t entry)
{
  clear_all(ram, r, 0xD8B2);                               /* REP #$30 */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0001);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, 0);
  r->a = 0x0100;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  wr16(ram, r, HM_BG3_Y, 0x0100);
  r->a = 0; r->x = 0x0009; r->y = 0;                       /* REP #$30 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD90A, 0x84, hm_StartEventScriptLong);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD90E, 0x84, hm_RunEventSlots);
  map_is(ram, r, rd8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP));          /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD919, 0x80, hm_PickMapMusic);
  new_music(ram, r, 0xD91D);
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP));               /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD936, 0x80, hm_LoadAndShowMap);
  r->y = 0;                                                /* REP #$30 */
  if (parents_frame(ram, r, entry)) parents_end(ram, r);
}

/* stage 2: the title slides in */
static void title_in(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t c = (uint8_t)(dp8(ram, r, COUNT) & 0x01);        /* SEP #$20; LDA $94; AND #1 */
  set_a8(r, c);
  if (!c) {
    bg2_right(ram, r);                                     /* REP #$20 */
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_CAM_X);
    if (!r->a) {                                           /* in place: a second's pause */
      uint8_t p = (uint8_t)(dp8(ram, r, DRIFT_TIMER) + 1); /* SEP #$20 */
      set_a8(r, p);
      set_dp8(ram, r, DRIFT_TIMER, p);
      r->c = p >= 0x3C;
      if (p == 0x3C) { next_stage(ram, r, 3); democheck(ram, r); return; }
    } else {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a - 1);
      wr16(ram, r, HM_CAM_X, r->a);
    }
  }
  count_up(ram, r);
  democheck(ram, r);
}
/* stage 6 / 9 / the way back from a file screen ($82:DBB2 on): the title
 * screen's background (map $5C, its music), faded in, and stage 4 */
static void title_screen(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t W[4] = { HM_CAM_X, HM_CAM_Y, HM_BG2_X, HM_BG2_Y };
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MENU_FRAMES, 0);                    /* REP #$20 */
  zero_words(ram, r, W, 4);
  no_place(ram, r);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDBCF, 0x80, hm_BackgroundsManager);
  new_music(ram, r, 0xDBD3);
  lit(ram, r, 0xDBE7);
  fade_in(ram, r, 0x01, 1, 0xDBFD);
  next_stage(ram, r, 4);
  democheck(ram, r);
}
/* the music of map $5C (PickMapMusic, FadeOutSongSlowly) and the fast fade out */
static void title_music_out(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  map_is(ram, r, 0x5C);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x80, hm_PickMapMusic);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 4), 0x83, hm_FadeOutSongSlowly);
  fade_out(ram, r, 1, (uint16_t)(at + 0x16));
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x1A), 0x80, hm_ForceBlank);
}
static void stage6(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  title_music_out(ram, r, 0xDB94);
  title_screen(ram, r);
}
/* stage 3: BG1 and BG2 up to 0 (then stage 6's code) */
static void title_up(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t c = (uint8_t)(dp8(ram, r, COUNT) & 0x01);        /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, c);
  if (!c) {
    bg2_right(ram, r);                                     /* REP #$20 */
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_CAM_Y);
    if (!r->a) { stage6(ram, r); return; }                 /* JMP $DB8E */
    r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a - 1);
    wr16(ram, r, HM_CAM_Y, r->a);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y) - 1);
    wr16(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y, r->a);
  }
  count_up(ram, r);
  democheck(ram, r);
}
/* stage 9: the whole screen cleared first, then as stage 6 */
static void stage9(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  title_music_out(ram, r, 0xDAFB);
  set_a8(r, 0x03);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDB1D, 0x80, hm_ManageGraphicPresets);
  clear_all(ram, r, 0xDB21);
  no_place(ram, r);                                        /* REP #$20 */
  map_is(ram, r, 0x5B);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDB52, 0x80, hm_BackgroundsManager);
  r->a = 0x006D;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDB5B, 0x80, hm_LoadFirstHalfPaletteToWRAM);
  colours(ram, r, TITLE_COLOURS, 0xDB7E);
  map_is(ram, r, 0x5C);
  title_screen(ram, r);                                    /* BRA $DBB2 */
}
/* stage 4: a second, then the menu's marks: stage 5 */
static void menu_in(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t c = (uint8_t)(dp8(ram, r, COUNT) & 0x01);        /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, c);
  if (!c) bg2_right(ram, r);                               /* REP #$20 */
  uint8_t n = dp8(ram, r, COUNT);                          /* SEP #$20; CMP #$3C */
  set_a8(r, n);
  r->c = n >= 0x3C;
  if (n != 0x3C) { count_up(ram, r); democheck(ram, r); return; }
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDC32, 0x80, hm_StopAllColourAnimations);
  cycle(ram, r, MENU_CYCLE_1, 0x0A, 4, 7, 0xDC4D);
  cycle(ram, r, MENU_CYCLE_2, 0x0B, 5, 7, 0xDC68);
  static const uint16_t AT[3] = { 0xDC98, 0xDCED, 0xDD42 };
  uint8_t choice = choice_of(ram, r);
  menu_marks(ram, r, choice, AT[choice]);
  next_stage(ram, r, 5);
  democheck(ram, r);
}
/* stage 5: the menu */
static void menu(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t c = (uint8_t)(dp8(ram, r, COUNT) & 0x01);        /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, c);
  if (!c) bg2_right(ram, r);                               /* REP #$20 */
  count_up(ram, r);
  uint8_t changed = dp8(ram, r, HM_MENU_REDRAW);           /* LDA $97 */
  set_a8(r, changed);
  if (changed) {
    set_dp8(ram, r, HM_MENU_REDRAW, 0);
    static const uint16_t AT[3] = { 0xDDD5, 0xDE2A, 0xDE7F };
    uint8_t choice = choice_of(ram, r);
    menu_marks(ram, r, choice, AT[choice]);
  }
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MENU_FRAMES, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_MENU_FRAMES) + 1)); /* REP #$30; INC $90 */
  democheck(ram, r);
}

/* $82:DEC5: from a file screen back to the title: as stage 9, without
 * clearing the objects, both pictures loaded, $90 = 0 */
static void back_to_title(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  title_music_out(ram, r, 0xDECB);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDEE9, 0x80, hm_ZeroesVRAM);
  set_a8(r, 0x03);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDEF1, 0x80, hm_ManageGraphicPresets);
  zero_words(ram, r, SCROLLS, 4);                          /* REP #$20 */
  no_place(ram, r);
  map_is(ram, r, 0x5B);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDF16, 0x80, hm_BackgroundsManager);
  map_is(ram, r, 0x5C);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDF20, 0x80, hm_BackgroundsManager);
  r->a = 0x006D;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xDF29, 0x80, hm_LoadFirstHalfPaletteToWRAM);
  colours(ram, r, TITLE_COLOURS, 0xDF4C);
  new_music(ram, r, 0xDF54);
  lit(ram, r, 0xDF68);
  fade_in(ram, r, 0x01, 1, 0xDF7E);
  next_stage(ram, r, 4);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MENU_FRAMES, 0);                    /* REP #$20 */
  democheck(ram, r);
}

/* a file screen's start: map $5E's music, the screen (preset 4, palette
 * $6F, colours from $A9:8C00), the two files' frames (DrawScreenBars) and
 * contents (DrawSaveFileLine, Y = `kind`: 0 the new game's, 1 the saved
 * game's); the calls from `at` on (the routine's own address) */
static void file_screen_start(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint16_t kind)
{
  map_is(ram, r, 0x5E);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x06), 0x80, hm_PickMapMusic);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x0A), 0x83, hm_FadeOutSongSlowly);
  fade_out(ram, r, 3, (uint16_t)(at + 0x1C));
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x20), 0x80, hm_ForceBlank);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x24), 0x80, hm_ZeroesVRAM);
  set_a8(r, 0x04);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x2C), 0x80, hm_ManageGraphicPresets);
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x30), 0x80, hm_BackgroundsManager);
  r->a = 0x006F;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x39), 0x80, hm_LoadFirstHalfPaletteToWRAM);
  colours(ram, r, FILE_COLOURS, (uint16_t)(at + 0x5C));
  jsr(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x66), hm_DrawScreenBars);
  for (uint16_t f = 0; f < 2; f++) {                       /* REP #$30 */
    r->a = f; r->y = kind;
    jsr(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x71 + 0x0B * f), hm_DrawSaveFileLine);
  }
  jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 0x7D), 0x80, hm_StopAllColourAnimations);
}
/* a file screen's end of start: the scrolls at 0 (`scrolls` first, the
 * new game's), the music, the screen lit and faded in, $94 / $96 / $97 = 0 */
static void file_screen_lit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t music)
{
  new_music(ram, r, music);
  lit(ram, r, (uint16_t)(music + 0x14));
  fade_in(ram, r, 0x03, 3, (uint16_t)(music + 0x2A));
  set_dp8(ram, r, COUNT, 0);                               /* SEP #$20 */
  set_dp8(ram, r, DRIFT_TIMER, 0);
  set_dp8(ram, r, HM_MENU_REDRAW, 0);
}
/* a file screen's frame's end: the drift; $94 = 1 back to the title, 2
 * the game (the check stops at the JML), else round again (stops) */
static void file_screen_end(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t back, uint32_t start)
{
  drift(ram, r);
  uint8_t c = dp8(ram, r, COUNT);                          /* SEP #$20; CMP #1 */
  set_a8(r, c);
  r->c = c >= 1;
  if (c == 1) { back_to_title(ram, r); return; }
  r->c = c >= 2;
  if (c == 2) { g_hm_next = start; return; }               /* JML StartFromNewGame / StartFromLoad */
  set_dp8(ram, r, NMI_STATUS, 0);                          /* STZ $00; JML back */
  g_hm_next = back;
}
/* LoadGameSlotResume of slot A; with no saved game there (X = 0), BG1's
 * x = 0 */
static void slot_resume(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t slot, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = slot;                                             /* REP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_LoadGameSlotResume);
  r->c = 1;                                                /* REP #$30; CPX #0 */
  if (r->x == 0) { r->a = 0; wr16(ram, r, HM_CAM_X, 0); }
}

/* stage 7's frames ($82:E0EB): the new game's file screen */
static void new_file_frame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t entry)
{
  wait_nmi(ram, r, 0xE0ED, entry);
  r->a = 0x1800;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET, 0x1800);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE0F8, 0x80, hm_RunColourAnimations);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE0FC, 0x84, hm_InputTypeSelector);
  uint8_t changed = dp8(ram, r, HM_MENU_REDRAW);           /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, changed);
  if (changed) {
    set_dp8(ram, r, HM_MENU_REDRAW, 0);
    uint8_t slot = rd8(ram, r, SAVE_SLOT);
    set_a8(r, slot);
    if (!slot) { slot_resume(ram, r, 0, 0xE11A); file_marks(ram, r, false, 0xE148, 0xE163); }
    else       { slot_resume(ram, r, 1, 0xE170); file_marks(ram, r, true, 0xE19E, 0xE1B9); }
  }
  file_screen_end(ram, r, 0x82E0EB, 0x82E7F9);
}
/* stage 7: the new game's file screen */
static void new_file(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t entry)
{
  file_screen_start(ram, r, 0xDF92, 0);
  zero_words(ram, r, ALL_SCROLLS, 6);                      /* REP #$20 */
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, SAVE_SLOT);                           /* SEP #$20; LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE02F, 0x83, hm_LoadGameSlotResume);
  r->c = 1;                                                /* REP #$30; CPX #0 */
  uint8_t slot = rd8(ram, r, SAVE_SLOT);                   /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, slot);
  file_marks(ram, r, slot != 0, slot ? 0xE096 : 0xE05C, slot ? 0xE0B1 : 0xE077);
  file_screen_lit(ram, r, 0xE0B5);
  new_file_frame(ram, r, entry);
}

/* one frame of the intro ($82:D80D) */
static void intro_frame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t entry)
{
  wait_nmi(ram, r, 0xD80F, entry);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD813, 0x80, hm_RunColourAnimations);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD817, 0x84, hm_InputTypeSelector);
  uint8_t s = dp8(ram, r, HM_INTRO_STAGE);                 /* SEP #$20; LDA $95 */
  set_a8(r, s);
  if (!s) { logo(ram, r); return; }
  for (uint8_t k = 1; k <= 0x0A; k++) {                    /* CMP #k; BNE */
    r->c = s >= k;
    if (s == k) break;
  }
  switch (s) {
  case 1: parents(ram, r, entry); return;
  case 2: title_in(ram, r); return;
  case 3: title_up(ram, r); return;
  case 4: menu_in(ram, r); return;
  case 5: menu(ram, r); return;
  case 6: stage6(ram, r); return;
  case 7: new_file(ram, r, entry); return;
  case 8: g_hm_next = 0x82E1F1; return;                    /* JML ContinueFileScreen: the check stops */
  case 9: stage9(ram, r); return;
  case 10: g_hm_next = 0x82D1C0; return;                   /* JML FirstDemo: the check stops */
  default: democheck(ram, r); return;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * IntroScreen ($82:D75E, JML from RESET): the controls to the title
 * ($019A = 4), the menu's choice $098D = 2 ("continue") when the saved
 * games failed their check ($7F1F60 bit 11) and 0 otherwise; the demos
 * from the first ($7F1F48 / $7F1F49 = 0); the farm's map from the ROM;
 * the logo (preset 3, map $5D, palette $6E, colours from $A9:DA00), the
 * scrolls at 0, the screen lit and faded in; $97 = 0, $90 = 0, $AF = 1.
 * Then its frames.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_IntroScreen(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  set_a8(r, 0x04);                                         /* REP #$30; SEP #$20 */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 0x04);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TITLE_CURSOR, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0800); /* REP #$20 */
  if (r->a) { set_a8(r, 0x02); wr8(ram, r, HM_TITLE_CURSOR, 0x02); }
  set_a8(r, 0x00);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DEMO_STEP), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_INTRO_STEP), 0);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD78A, 0x82, hm_LoadDefaultFarmMap);
  set_a8(r, 0x03);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD792, 0x80, hm_ManageGraphicPresets);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD796, 0x80, hm_ForceBlank);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD79A, 0x80, hm_ZeroesVRAM);
  map_is(ram, r, 0x5D);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD7A4, 0x80, hm_BackgroundsManager);
  r->a = 0x006E;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xD7AD, 0x80, hm_LoadFirstHalfPaletteToWRAM);
  colours(ram, r, LOGO_COLOURS, 0xD7D0);
  zero_words(ram, r, SCROLLS, 4);                          /* REP #$20 */
  lit(ram, r, 0xD7E6);
  fade_in(ram, r, 0x03, 3, 0xD7FC);
  set_dp8(ram, r, HM_MENU_REDRAW, 0);                      /* SEP #$20 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MENU_FRAMES, 0);                    /* REP #$20 */
  r->a = 0x0001;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OAM_USED, 0x0001);
  intro_frame(ram, r, entry);                              /* the check stops after it */
}
/* the frames on their own: $82:D80D (the intro's), $82:D93F (the parents'
 * scene's), $82:E0EB (the new game's file screen's) */
void hm_IntroFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { intro_frame(ram, r, r->p); }
void hm_ParentsSceneFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (parents_frame(ram, r, r->p)) parents_end(ram, r);
}
void hm_NewFileScreenFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { new_file_frame(ram, r, r->p); }
void hm_IntroDemoCheck(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { democheck(ram, r); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ContinueFileScreen ($82:E1F1, stage 8, JML): the saved game's file screen: as
 * the new game's, with the files' contents of the saved games, and its
 * frames ($82:E337): a changed choice ($97) lights the other file's frame;
 * $94 = 1 back to the title, 2 the saved game (StartFromLoad).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void load_file_frame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t entry)
{
  wait_nmi(ram, r, 0xE339, entry);
  r->a = 0x1800;                                           /* REP #$20 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET, 0x1800);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE344, 0x80, hm_RunColourAnimations);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE348, 0x84, hm_InputTypeSelector);
  uint8_t changed = dp8(ram, r, HM_MENU_REDRAW);           /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, changed);
  if (changed) {
    set_dp8(ram, r, HM_MENU_REDRAW, 0);
    uint8_t slot = rd8(ram, r, SAVE_SLOT);
    set_a8(r, slot);
    file_marks(ram, r, slot != 0, slot ? 0xE3B2 : 0xE378, slot ? 0xE3CD : 0xE393);
  }
  file_screen_end(ram, r, 0x82E337, 0x82E7E9);             /* SUB_82E3D1 */
}
void hm_ContinueFileScreen(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  file_screen_start(ram, r, 0xE1F1, 1);
  uint8_t slot = rd8(ram, r, SAVE_SLOT);                   /* SEP #$20 */
  set_a8(r, slot);
  file_marks(ram, r, slot != 0, slot ? 0xE2CE : 0xE294, slot ? 0xE2E9 : 0xE2AF);
  zero_words(ram, r, ALL_SCROLLS, 6);                      /* REP #$20 */
  file_screen_lit(ram, r, 0xE301);
  load_file_frame(ram, r, entry);
}
void hm_ContinueFileScreenFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { load_file_frame(ram, r, r->p); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * StartFromLoad ($82:E7E9, JML): the saved game of slot $098E
 * (LoadGameSlot) and its first day (SpawnAfterLoad, JML).
 * StartFromNewGame ($82:E7F9, JML): a new game (NewGameSetup) and its
 * first day.
 * UnusedRewritePlayerName ($82:E801, nothing reaches it): the player's name written
 * again ($099F = 0, NamesScreen).
 * The checks stop where SpawnAfterLoad goes into GameLoop, or after the
 * names screen's first frame.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_StartFromLoad(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, SAVE_SLOT);                           /* SEP #$20; LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE7F1, 0x83, hm_LoadGameSlot);
  hm_SpawnAfterLoad(ram, r);                               /* JML */
}
void hm_StartFromNewGame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  jsl(ram, r, 0xE7F9, 0x83, hm_NewGameSetup);
  hm_SpawnAfterLoad(ram, r);                               /* JML */
}
void hm_UnusedRewritePlayerName(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_a8(r, 0x00);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_NAME_FOR, 0);
  hm_NamesScreen(ram, r);                               /* JML */
}

```

`src/items.c`:

```c
/*
 * items.c — the things the player puts down or throws (items as map
 * objects).
 *
 * An item that leaves the player's hands becomes a map object (see
 * objects.c, RunItemsOnMap): its record keeps the item ($0984 while it is worked
 * on), a state ($0976) and its sprite. PutItemDown puts it down; then, each
 * frame, RunItemRoutine runs the item's own routine (table DATA8_8197C0, one
 * per item), which acts by the state: lands, breaks, is eaten...
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ROM tables */
#define ITEM_SPRITES  0x8196AF   /* DATA8_8196AF: per item, a pointer to its sprites */
#define FOOD_TABLE    0x819FC6   /* DATA8_819FC6: per item - 1, its text and stamina */
#define FOOD_STAMINA  2          /*   in an entry: the stamina */
#define PRICE_TABLE   0x819FDE   /* Items_Price_Table: per item, a tile and a price */
#define PRICE_VALUE   1          /*   in an entry: the price */
#define SALE_TABLE    0x81A094   /* DATA8_81A094: per item, its text and a money byte */
#define SALE_MONEY    2          /*   in an entry: the money */
#define SHOP_TABLE    0x81A1A5   /* DATA8_81A1A5: 12 bytes per shop article: +0 the
                                  * "buy it?" text, */
#define SHOP_THANKS   2          /*   the "thank you" text, */
#define SHOP_NO       4          /*   the "no" text, (+6 the "not enough money" text) */
#define SHOP_TILE     8          /*   the counter's tile, */
#define SHOP_PRICE    9          /*   the price (24 bits, negative) */
#define TILE_CHANGES  0x81A2AD   /* DATA8_81A2AD: per item, the tile it leaves (0: none) */
#define ITEM_SOUNDS   0x81A308   /* DATA8_81A308: per item, whether it makes a sound */
#define SPOT_TABLE    0x81A363   /* DATA8_81A363: X, Y of the bins and boxes */
#define SPOT_Y        2          /*   in an entry: Y */
#define SHELF_Y       2          /*   +0 X, +2 Y, */
#define SHELF_TILE    4          /*   +4 the tile (ChangeMapTile's arguments), */
#define SHELF_ROW     6          /*   +6 a row of HM_SHED_ITEMS, +7 its bit */

/* Data-bank variables. The item being worked on (a copy of its map object's
 * record, see objects.c): */
#define OBJECT        0x0978     /* DB: its game object */
#define ITEM_SPRITE_SHOWN 0x097C /* DB: the sprite its game object shows */
/* Others: */
#define EGG_SPOT      0x09AC     /* DB: the festival egg place in front (1-5) */

/* The map objects (objects.c) */
#define ITEM_RECORD_SIZE 0x10

/* Direct page */
#define MAP_OBJ_PTR   0x07       /* long $07-$09: the map object worked on */
#define MAP_OBJ_PTR_BANK 0x09
/* $22 is HM_MAP_ID (hm_ram.h) */
#define SPRITE_LIST   0x72       /* GetItemSprite: long $72-$74, the item's sprite list */
#define SPRITE_LIST_BANK 0x74
#define MONEY         0x72       /* AddMoney's amount (24b, $72-$74) */
#define MONEY_HIGH    0x74
#define TEMP_7E       0x7E       /* scratch: what times3 (and GetItemSprite) multiply */
#define SHORT_OF      0x80       /* shop_answer: 4 if the money was short, else 0 */
#define SHED_BIT      0x92       /* PutToolOnShelf: the tool's bit (TakeToolFromShelf: its
                                  * complement) */

static uint32_t db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * GetItemSprite ($81:80B7, JSL, RTL; the start of HM-Decomp's GetItemSprite
 * block): the sprite of item $0984 for the case Y (a facing, + 2 when put
 * down): DATA8_8196AF gives the item's list (3 bytes per item), and in it
 * 3 bytes per case: the sprite (to $097A) and a byte that x 64 is the flip
 * ($097E).
 * Leftovers: $72-$74 = the list, $7E = Y, A = the flip, Y = 3 Y + 2,
 * X = 3 item + 2, C = 0.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_GetItemSprite(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t item = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, item);
  r->x = (uint16_t)(item * 3);                             /* ASL; CLC; ADC (no carry) */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SPRITE_LIST, hm_bus_rd16(ram, ITEM_SPRITES + r->x));
  r->x = (uint16_t)(r->x + 2);
  uint8_t bank = hm_bus_rd8(ram, ITEM_SPRITES + r->x);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SPRITE_LIST_BANK) = bank;
  uint16_t which = r->y;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, which);
  uint32_t y3 = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(which << 1) + which;  /* ASL; CLC; ADC $7E */
  r->y = (uint16_t)y3;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_SPRITE), hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SPRITE_LIST, r->y)));
  r->y = (uint16_t)(r->y + 2);
  uint16_t flip = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SPRITE_LIST, r->y)) << 6);
  r->c = 0;                                                /* the last ASL */
  r->a = flip;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_FLIP), flip);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PutItemDown ($81:8000, JSL, RTL): the item in hand ($091D) is put down
 * in front of the player: a map object in state 0 ($0974 = $0975 = 1,
 * $0976 = 0) with the item's sprite for the player's facing (+ 2), two
 * pixels below the player (SpawnMapObject). Then the tile in front, and if
 * the item leaves something on the map (DATA8_81A2AD), that tile type
 * (from the map's property table) is put there; and if the item makes a
 * sound (DATA8_81A308), sound effect 8 of bank 6.
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PutItemDown(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS), 1);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_ROUTINE), 1);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_STATE), 0);
  uint8_t item = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM), item);
  uint32_t sum = 2u + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
  r->y = r->a;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8025, 0x81);
  hm_GetItemSprite(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_X), r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y) + 2);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_Y), r->a);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8037, 0x81);
  hm_SpawnMapObject(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = 1; r->x = 0; r->y = 0;
  /* the native build's "walk through crops": the player can stand closer
   * to a crop than the game expects, so the tile in front (16 pixels
   * ahead) may not be the one A looked at (7 pixels ahead, PlayerKeyA):
   * then the crop was picked from one tile and the other one changed (the
   * crop could be picked again and again). The change goes where A
   * looked. */
  if (g_hm_crops_passable) { r->a = 0; r->x = 7; r->y = 7; }
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8046, 0x81);
  hm_CalculateTileInFront(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  if (g_hm_bag_take) { g_hm_bag_take = 0; return; }   /* the native build's bag: out of it */

  uint16_t it = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM));
  r->x = it;
  uint8_t change = hm_bus_rd8(ram, TILE_CHANGES + it);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((it & 0xFF00) | change);
  if (change) {
    r->c = (change >> 6) & 1;                              /* ASL; ASL (16 bits) */
    r->y = (uint16_t)(change << 2);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_TILE_PROPS, r->y)); /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA [$0D],Y */
    r->x = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db(r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X));
    r->y = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db(r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y));
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8071, 0x81);
    hm_ChangeMapTile(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
  it = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM));
  r->x = it;
  uint8_t sound = hm_bus_rd8(ram, ITEM_SOUNDS + it);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((it & 0xFF00) | sound);
  if (!sound) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x06);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT), 0x08);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_SOUND_BANK), 0x06);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x8098, 0x83);
  hm_PlaySoundEffect0A(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * The item routines (the rest of HM-Decomp's GetItemSprite block).
 *
 * RunItemRoutine calls one per item (table DATA8_8197C0) with JSR, every frame
 * while the item is a map object. Most just call one of six state machines
 * (JSR); each machine picks, by the item's state ($0976), one of the steps
 * below (JMP), which does its part and maybe moves to another state:
 *
 *   ItemCommonSteps (most items)   0 hold, 2 carried, 3 dropped, 4 gone,
 *                              5-6 offered for sale, 7 binned, 8 shipped
 *   ItemFoodSteps (food, 1-8)    as 8188E5 but 0 asks "eat it?", 1 eats
 *   ItemFodderSteps (item $1A)     0, 2, 3 = into a feed box, 4, 8
 *   ItemPlaceableSteps (items $0D-$0F, $57)  0, 2 thrown, 3 lands, 4 gone
 *   ItemAnimalSteps (items $25, $26, $29) 0, 2 thrown, 3 = an animal set down
 *   ItemShopGoodsSteps (shop goods)   0 "buy it?", 1 answer, 2 put back, 3 bought
 *
 * The bodies keep A, X, Y and C as the original leaves them: X and Y are
 * 16 bits throughout, A changes width as the original does (an 8-bit load
 * keeps A's high byte).
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
typedef void Step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);

static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, a)); }
static uint16_t rd16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, db(r, a)); }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }

/* JSL at `at` to a routine of `bank`; JSR at `at` (same bank) */
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, Step *fn)
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, Step *fn)
{
  uint16_t ret = (uint16_t)(at + 2);
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(ret >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r);
}

/* "STA $7E; ASL A; CLC; ADC $7E" (16 bits): 3 v, C = the add's carry */
static uint16_t times3(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, v);
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(v << 1) + v;
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  return (uint16_t)sum;
}
/* "CLC; ADC #k" (16 bits) */
static uint16_t add16(HmRegs *r, uint16_t v, uint16_t k)
{
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)v + k;
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  return (uint16_t)sum;
}
/* "LDA #$00; XBA; LDA $0984" (8 bits): A = the item, high byte 0 */
static uint16_t item_word(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM);
  return r->a;
}

/* LDA $0978; STA $A5; JSL DestroyGameObject (at a); then JSL FreeMapObject (at b,
 * if any): the item's game object, and its map object, go away */
static void remove_object(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b)
{
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, OBJECT);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
  jsl(ram, r, a, 0x85, hm_DestroyGameObject);
  if (b) jsl(ram, r, b, 0x81, hm_FreeMapObject);
}
/* the player stops (action 0) and no longer holds anything ($D2 bit 1) */
static void hands_free(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & ~0x0002);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
static void hands_full(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0002);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
static void set_state(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t s)
{
  set_a8(r, s);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_STATE, s);
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA #$02; STA $019A; [X = text]; LDA #$00; STA $0191;
 * JSL StartTextBox (at a) */
static void say(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  set_a8(r, 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES, 0);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_StartTextBox);
}
static void wait_for_input(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_a8(r, 2);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 2);
}
/* "LDA $019A; CMP #$02": still waiting for the text box? */
static bool text_open(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t v = rd8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE);
  set_a8(r, v);
  r->c = v >= 2;
  return v == 2;
}
/* LDY #y; JSL GetItemSprite (at a): the sprite of case y */
static void sprite(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x81, hm_GetItemSprite);
}
/* CalculateTileInFront (A, X, Y given; at a) */
static void tile_ahead(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = a; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x81, hm_CalculateTileInFront);
}
/* GetTileProperty of the tile in front (A = which byte; at a):
 * X = its type, A = the property */
static void tile_property(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t at)
{
  r->x = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
  r->y = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
  r->a = a;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x82, hm_GetTileProperty);
}
/* "CPX #k" */
static bool cpx(HmRegs *r, uint16_t k)
{
  r->c = r->x >= k;
  return r->x == k;
}
/* the item where the player is, two pixels lower ($0980 / $0982) */
static void follow_player(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_X, r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y) + 2);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_Y, r->a);
}
/* the item at the tile in front */
static void to_tile_ahead(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_X, r->a);
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_Y, r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The machines ($81:883A-$81:8922, JSR, RTS): by the state, JMP to a step;
 * a state with no step just returns. Leftovers: A's low byte = the state,
 * C = the last CMP (the entry's C for state 0), or the step's.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void machine(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, Step *zero, const uint8_t *states, Step *const *steps, int n)
{
  uint8_t s = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_STATE);
  set_a8(r, s);
  if (s == 0) { zero(ram, r); return; }
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    r->c = s >= states[i];
    if (s == states[i]) { steps[i](ram, r); return; }
  }
}

void hm_ItemFoodSteps(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t s[] = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 };
  static Step *const f[] = { hm_FoodEatAnswer, hm_ItemCarried, hm_ItemLands, hm_ItemRemoveMapObject,
                             hm_ItemAskToSell, hm_ItemSellAnswer, hm_ItemWaitMapAnimation, hm_ItemFinished };
  machine(ram, r, hm_FoodAskToEat, s, f, 8);
}
void hm_ItemCommonSteps(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t s[] = { 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 };
  static Step *const f[] = { hm_ItemCarried, hm_ItemLands, hm_ItemRemoveMapObject, hm_ItemAskToSell,
                             hm_ItemSellAnswer, hm_ItemWaitMapAnimation, hm_ItemFinished };
  machine(ram, r, hm_ItemTakeInHand, s, f, 7);
}
void hm_ItemFodderSteps(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t s[] = { 2, 3, 4, 8 };
  static Step *const f[] = { hm_ItemCarried, hm_FodderIntoFeedBox, hm_ItemRemoveMapObject, hm_ItemFinished };
  machine(ram, r, hm_ItemTakeInHand, s, f, 4);
}
void hm_ItemPlaceableSteps(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t s[] = { 2, 3, 4 };
  static Step *const f[] = { hm_PlaceableCarried, hm_PlaceableLands, hm_PlaceableGone };
  machine(ram, r, hm_ItemTakeInHand, s, f, 3);
}
void hm_ItemAnimalSteps(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t s[] = { 2, 3 };
  static Step *const f[] = { hm_AnimalCarried, hm_AnimalSetDown };
  machine(ram, r, hm_ItemTakeInHand, s, f, 2);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ItemShopGoodsSteps ($81:8923, JSR, RTS): the goods of a shop (items $1B-$1D and
 * $44-$56), picked up from the counter. DATA8_81A1A5 has 12 bytes per
 * article (items $44-$56 first, then $1B-$1D): +0 the "buy it?" text, +2
 * the "thank you" text, +4 the "no" text, +6 the "not enough money" text,
 * +8 the counter's tile and +9 the price (24 bits, negative: it is added
 * to the money).
 *   state 0: the question; state 1: on yes, pay (AddMoney): thanks and
 *   state 3, or "not enough money" and state 2; on no, that text and as
 *   state 2; state 2: once the text is closed, the article goes back on
 *   the counter (its tile) and the player's hands are free; state 3: the
 *   same without the tile, except for items $49, $56 and $1B-$1D, which
 *   stay in his hands; then state $FF (the item routine finishes the
 *   purchase).
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* SEP #$20; LDA $0984; CMP #$44; ...: the article's number, A = it (with
 * the high byte A had for the items below $44) */
static uint16_t article(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t it = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM);
  if (it < 0x44) {
    uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(it - 0x1B);                      /* SEC; SBC #$1B */
    uint16_t sum = (uint16_t)(v + 0x13);                   /* CLC; ADC #$13 */
    r->c = sum > 0xFF;
    set_a8(r, (uint8_t)sum);
  } else {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(it - 0x44);                          /* LDA #0; XBA; ... SEC; SBC */
    r->c = 1;
  }
  return r->a;
}
/* REP #$20; STA $7E; ASL; CLC; ADC $7E; ASL; ASL: the article x 12 */
static uint16_t article_x12(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t v = times3(ram, r, r->a);
  r->c = (v >> 15) & 1; v = (uint16_t)(v << 1);
  r->c = (v >> 15) & 1; v = (uint16_t)(v << 1);
  return v;
}

static void shop_ask(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)              /* CODE_81893F */
{
  wait_for_input(ram, r);
  article(ram, r);
  r->x = article_x12(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SHOP_TABLE + r->x);
  r->x = r->a;
  say(ram, r, 0x897B);
  set_state(ram, r, 1);
}

static void shop_put_back(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)         /* CODE_818AA0 */
{
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x8AA7, 0);
  hands_free(ram, r);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8ABE, 0x81, hm_FreeMapObject);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 6, 6, 0x8AD2);
  article(ram, r);
  r->x = add16(r, article_x12(ram, r), SHOP_TILE);
  uint8_t tile = hm_bus_rd8(ram, SHOP_TABLE + r->x);
  r->a = tile;                                             /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA */
  r->x = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
  r->y = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8B13, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTile);
}

static void shop_answer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)           /* CODE_818989 */
{
  if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
  uint8_t no = rd8(ram, r, HM_ANSWER);
  set_a8(r, no);
  if (no) {                                                /* CODE_818A4E */
    wait_for_input(ram, r);
    article(ram, r);
    r->x = add16(r, article_x12(ram, r), SHOP_NO);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SHOP_TABLE + r->x);
    r->x = r->a;
    say(ram, r, 0x8A8E);
    shop_put_back(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  article(ram, r);
  r->x = add16(r, article_x12(ram, r), SHOP_PRICE);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SHOP_TABLE + r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MONEY, r->a);
  r->x = (uint16_t)(r->x + 2);
  set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, SHOP_TABLE + r->x));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_HIGH) = (uint8_t)r->a;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x89DA, 0x83, hm_AddMoney);
  uint16_t short_of = r->a ? 4 : 0;                        /* BEQ on AddMoney's A */
  if (short_of) r->a = 4;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SHORT_OF, short_of);
  wait_for_input(ram, r);
  article(ram, r);
  uint16_t v = add16(r, article_x12(ram, r), SHOP_THANKS);
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)v + short_of + r->c;            /* ADC $80 (no CLC) */
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->x = (uint16_t)sum;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SHOP_TABLE + r->x);
  r->x = r->a;
  say(ram, r, 0x8A2D);
  r->a = short_of;                                         /* REP #$20; LDA $80 */
  set_state(ram, r, short_of ? 2 : 3);
}

static void shop_wait(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)             /* CODE_818A94 */
{
  if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
  shop_put_back(ram, r);
}

static void shop_sold(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)             /* CODE_818B19 */
{
  if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
  uint8_t it = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM);
  set_a8(r, it);
  static const uint8_t kept[] = { 0x49, 0x56, 0x1B, 0x1C, 0x1D };
  bool keep = false;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof kept && !keep; i++) {
    r->c = it >= kept[i];
    keep = it == kept[i];
  }
  if (!keep) {
    remove_object(ram, r, 0x8B43, 0);
    hands_free(ram, r);
    jsl(ram, r, 0x8B5A, 0x81, hm_FreeMapObject);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  }
  set_state(ram, r, 0xFF);
}

void hm_ItemShopGoodsSteps(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t s[] = { 1, 2, 3 };
  static Step *const f[] = { shop_answer, shop_wait, shop_sold };
  machine(ram, r, shop_ask, s, f, 3);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Food (items 1-8, ItemFoodSteps). DATA8_819FC6 has 3 bytes per food: the
 * "eat it?" text and the stamina it gives.
 * FoodAskToEat (state 0): the sprite in hand (case 1) and the question;
 * state 1. FoodEatAnswer (state 1): once answered: yes, the player eats
 * (action 8, $D2 bit 15 cleared), the item goes and ChangeStamina gets the
 * food's value; no, the player stops and holds it (state 2).
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint16_t food_entry(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  item_word(ram, r);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)(r->a - 1));   /* DEC A (8 bits) */
  return times3(ram, r, r->a);
}

void hm_FoodAskToEat(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  sprite(ram, r, 1, 0x8B70);
  r->x = food_entry(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, FOOD_TABLE + r->x);
  r->x = r->a;
  wait_for_input(ram, r);
  say(ram, r, 0x8B97);
  set_state(ram, r, 1);
}

void hm_FoodEatAnswer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
  uint8_t no = rd8(ram, r, HM_ANSWER);
  set_a8(r, no);
  if (no) {                                                /* CODE_818C0C */
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
    hands_full(ram, r);
    set_state(ram, r, 2);
    return;
  }
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 8);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x7FFF);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x8BD3, 0x8BD7);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  r->x = (uint16_t)(food_entry(ram, r) + FOOD_STAMINA);
  uint8_t stamina = hm_bus_rd8(ram, FOOD_TABLE + r->x);
  set_a8(r, stamina);
  r->n = stamina >> 7;                                     /* ChangeStamina reads N */
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8BFA, 0x81, hm_ChangeStamina);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & ~0x0002);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The common steps.
 * ItemTakeInHand (state 0): the sprite in hand (case 1); state 2.
 * ItemFinished (state 8): the item goes, the player stops with free hands.
 * ItemRemoveMapObject (state 4): its map object goes (FreeMapObject).
 * ItemWaitMapAnimation (state 7): once the map animation is over ($CF-$D1 = 0) the
 * map object goes and $D2 bit 0 is set.
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ItemTakeInHand(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  sprite(ram, r, 1, 0x9015);
  set_state(ram, r, 2);
}

void hm_ItemFinished(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x9028, 0x902C);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  hands_free(ram, r);
}

void hm_ItemRemoveMapObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  jsl(ram, r, 0x968F, 0x81, hm_FreeMapObject);
}

void hm_ItemWaitMapAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM);
  if (r->a) return;
  set_a8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM_BANK));
  if (r->a & 0xFF) return;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x96A1, 0x81, hm_FreeMapObject);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0001);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Carrying and throwing.
 * While carried (state 2) the item follows the player, two pixels lower,
 * with the sprite in hand (case 1); while he jumps (action 3) the sprite of
 * the jump (case $0B, $0974 bit 2) until its animation ends ($A7 = $FFFF
 * from ReadGameObject). When he throws it (action 5), if nothing is in the way
 * (CollideEventObjects) it flies (case 6 + his facing, state 3).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void carried(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at_hand, uint16_t at_jump, uint16_t at_anim)
{
  follow_player(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  r->c = r->a >= 3;
  if (r->a == 3) {
    uint8_t f = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS);
    set_a8(r, f & 0x04);
    if (!(f & 0x04)) {
      sprite(ram, r, 0x0B, at_jump);
      f = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS) | 0x04);
      set_a8(r, f);
      wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS, f);
      return;
    }
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, OBJECT);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
    jsl(ram, r, at_anim, 0x85, hm_ReadGameObject);
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_RESULT);
    r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF;
    if (r->a != 0xFFFF) return;
  }
  sprite(ram, r, 1, at_hand);
  uint8_t f = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS) & 0xFB);
  set_a8(r, f);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS, f);
}
/* REP #$30; LDA $D4; CMP #$05: is the player throwing it? */
static bool throwing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  r->c = r->a >= 5;
  return r->a == 5;
}
/* CollideEventObjects from the player's place, 16 pixels ahead (at a): A != 0 when
 * something is in the way; then CMP #0 (C = 1) */
static bool in_the_way(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, 0x0010);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_CollideEventObjects);
  r->c = 1;
  return r->a != 0;
}
/* LDA #6; CLC; ADC $DA; TAY; JSL GetItemSprite (at a); state 3: it flies */
static void fly(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = add16(r, 6, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION));
  sprite(ram, r, r->a, at);
  set_state(ram, r, 3);
}
static void stop_throw(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
}
/* CPX #1, #2, #7, #8 (ground: 1 is returned), then A = 0..5 and CPX #$F0,
 * #$F9..#$FD (a bin or a box: 2 + its number); 0 when none */
static int landing(HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t ground[] = { 0x01, 0x02, 0x07, 0x08 };
  static const uint16_t bins[] = { 0xF0, 0xF9, 0xFA, 0xFB, 0xFC, 0xFD };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++)
    if (cpx(r, ground[i])) return 1;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)i;
    if (cpx(r, bins[i])) return 2 + (int)i;
  }
  return 0;
}

/* PlaceableCarried (state 2 of ItemPlaceableSteps): carried; thrown only towards
 * ground or a bin. */
void hm_PlaceableCarried(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  carried(ram, r, 0x8C43, 0x8C61, 0x8C78);
  if (!throwing(ram, r)) return;
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 6, 6, 0x8C9C);
  tile_property(ram, r, 2, 0x8CAB);
  if (landing(r) && !in_the_way(ram, r, 0x8D0E)) {
    fly(ram, r, 0x8D20);
    return;
  }
  stop_throw(ram, r);
}

/* CODE_818DAB: the item lands on the tile in front: that tile becomes the
 * item's (Items_Price_Table, first byte) and the item goes. */
static void land_here(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 6, 6, 0x8DB6);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(item_word(ram, r) << 1);
  r->c = 0;                                                /* ASL of a byte */
  r->x = r->a;
  set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, PRICE_TABLE + r->x));
  r->x = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
  r->y = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8DD2, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTile);
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x8DDD, 0x8DE1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
}
/* CODE_818DEC / CODE_819631: into bin or box A: the item goes to its
 * place (DATA8_81A363), sprite $CA, state 4. */
static void into_spot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->c = (r->a >> 15) & 1; r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a << 1);
  r->c = (r->a >> 15) & 1; r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a << 1);
  r->x = r->a;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SPOT_TABLE + r->x);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_X, r->a);
  r->x = (uint16_t)(r->x + SPOT_Y);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SPOT_TABLE + r->x);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_Y, r->a);
  r->a = 0x00CA;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_SPRITE, 0x00CA);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  set_state(ram, r, 4);
}

/* PlaceableLands (state 3 of ItemPlaceableSteps): where it lands: ground, a bin, or
 * neither (the throw stops). */
void hm_PlaceableLands(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 6, 6, 0x8D43);
  tile_property(ram, r, 2, 0x8D52);
  int where = landing(r);
  if (where == 1) { land_here(ram, r); return; }
  if (where) { into_spot(ram, r); return; }
  stop_throw(ram, r);
}

/* PlaceableGone (state 4 of ItemPlaceableSteps): the map object goes. */
void hm_PlaceableGone(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8E16, 0x81, hm_FreeMapObject);
}

/* AnimalSetDown (state 3 of ItemAnimalSteps): an animal ($0920) set down: for
 * $25 / $26 its record keeps this map and the tile in front (and loses
 * bit 5 of its flags); then its walk starts (StartScriptAtTileInFront: script 1 for
 * $26, 2 for $25, $31 otherwise) and the item goes. */
void hm_AnimalSetDown(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t h = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND);
  set_a8(r, h);
  r->c = h >= 0x29;
  if (h != 0x29) {
    uint8_t who = rd8(ram, r, HM_CARRIED_SLOT);
    r->c = who >= 0x24;
    r->a = (uint8_t)(who - 0x24);
    jsl(ram, r, 0x8E2F, 0x83, hm_GetChickenPointer);
    r->y = CHICKEN_MAP;
    set_a8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID));
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, CHICKEN_MAP), (uint8_t)r->a);
    r->y = ANIMAL_STATUS;
    set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ANIMAL_STATUS)) & 0xDF));
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, ANIMAL_STATUS), (uint8_t)r->a);
    r->y = CHICKEN_X;
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, CHICKEN_X), r->a);
    r->y = CHICKEN_Y;
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, CHICKEN_Y), r->a);
  }
  r->y = 1;
  h = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND);
  set_a8(r, h);
  r->c = h >= 0x26;
  if (h != 0x26) {
    r->y = 2;
    r->c = h >= 0x25;
    if (h != 0x25) r->y = 0x31;
  }
  r->a = rd8(ram, r, HM_CARRIED_SLOT);
  r->x = 0;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8E7D, 0x84, hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront);
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x8E88, 0x8E8C);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
}

/* FodderIntoFeedBox (state 3 of ItemFodderSteps, item $1A): fodder thrown into a
 * feed box of the barn (map $27) or the coop ($28), tile types $E2-$EE:
 * that box's bit in $0932 / $0934 and one more in $0930 / $0931, and the
 * fodder lands (CODE_818DAB). Anywhere else, as any dropped item. */
void hm_FodderIntoFeedBox(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 6, 6, 0x8EA8);
  tile_property(ram, r, 0, 0x8EB7);
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 0x27;
  uint16_t flags = HM_COW_TROUGHS, count = HM_COWS_FED;
  if (map != 0x27) {
    r->c = map >= 0x28;
    if (map != 0x28) { hm_ItemLands(ram, r); return; }
    flags = HM_CHICKEN_TROUGHS; count = HM_CHICKENS_FED;
  }
  if (r->x < 0xE2 || r->x >= 0xEF) {
    r->c = r->x >= 0xE2;
    hm_ItemLands(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->x - 0xE2) << 1);                   /* SEC; SBC; ASL */
  r->c = 0;
  r->x = r->a;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, FEED_BOX_BITS + r->x) | rd16(ram, r, flags));
  wr16(ram, r, flags, r->a);
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, count) + 1);
  set_a8(r, n);
  wr8(ram, r, count, n);
  land_here(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Selling. DATA8_81A094 has 3 bytes per item: the "sell it?" text and the
 * money (in tens of G).
 * ItemAskToSell (state 5): the question; state 6.
 * ItemSellAnswer (state 6): once answered: yes (and the item can be sold:
 * text $0313 means it cannot) text $02FA, the item goes and its money is
 * added; no, text $0303; both "no" and unsellable give it back to the
 * player (sprite in hand at his place $090B / $090D, state 2, holding).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ItemAskToSell(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wait_for_input(ram, r);
  item_word(ram, r);
  r->x = times3(ram, r, r->a);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SALE_TABLE + r->x);
  r->x = r->a;
  say(ram, r, 0x8F4C);
  set_state(ram, r, 6);
}

static void give_back(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)             /* CODE_818FEA */
{
  sprite(ram, r, 1, 0x8FEF);
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_SCREEN_X);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_X, r->a);
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_SCREEN_Y);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_Y, r->a);
  set_state(ram, r, 2);
  hands_full(ram, r);
}

void hm_ItemSellAnswer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (text_open(ram, r)) return;
  uint8_t no = rd8(ram, r, HM_ANSWER);
  set_a8(r, no);
  if (no) {
    wait_for_input(ram, r);
    r->x = 0x0303;
    say(ram, r, 0x8FE6);
    give_back(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  item_word(ram, r);
  r->x = times3(ram, r, r->a);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SALE_TABLE + r->x);
  r->c = r->a >= 0x0313;
  if (r->a == 0x0313) { give_back(ram, r); return; }
  wait_for_input(ram, r);
  r->x = 0x02FA;
  say(ram, r, 0x8F95);
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x8FA0, 0x8FA4);
  item_word(ram, r);
  r->x = (uint16_t)(times3(ram, r, r->a) + SALE_MONEY);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, SALE_TABLE + r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MONEY, r->a);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_HIGH) = 0;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8FCC, 0x83, hm_AddMoney);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
}

/* the item's price (Items_Price_Table, second byte) to the day's shipping
 * money ($7F1F07, 24 bits), and $7F1F5E bit 0 (something was shipped) */
static void ship(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t price)
{
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)price + hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY), (uint16_t)sum);
  uint16_t hi = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY + 2)) + (sum > 0xFFFF));
  r->c = hi > 0xFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((sum & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)hi);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY + 2), (uint8_t)hi);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) | 0x0001);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), r->a);
}
/* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $0984; REP #$20; ASL; TAX; INX; SEP #$20; LDA.L
 * Items_Price_Table,X: the item's price */
static uint8_t price_of(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(item_word(ram, r) << 1);
  r->c = 0;
  r->x = (uint16_t)(r->a + PRICE_VALUE);
  uint8_t p = hm_bus_rd8(ram, PRICE_TABLE + r->x);
  set_a8(r, p);
  return p;
}
static bool before_5pm(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t h = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR));
  set_a8(r, h);
  r->c = h >= 0x11;
  return h < 0x11;
}

/* ItemCarried (state 2): carried. Thrown on a Sunday before 5 pm in town
 * (maps 4-7, $0196 bit 1 clear) at a stall tile ($F0) with a sellable item:
 * it is put there and offered (state 5). Thrown at an object (CollideEventObjects): put
 * at the tile in front and, with $7F1F5C bit 4 and a price before 5 pm,
 * shipped ($7F1F5C bit 6 too); state 8. Otherwise it flies. */
void hm_ItemCarried(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  carried(ram, r, 0x9068, 0x9086, 0x909D);
  if (!throwing(ram, r)) return;
  if (in_the_way(ram, r, 0x90CB)) {                        /* CODE_819195 */
    tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 0, 0, 0x91A0);
    to_tile_ahead(ram, r);
    sprite(ram, r, 0, 0x91B5);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & 0x0010);
    if (r->a) {
      uint8_t p = price_of(ram, r);
      if (p && before_5pm(ram, r)) {
        ship(ram, r, p);
        r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) | 0x0040);
        hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), r->a);
      }
    }
    set_state(ram, r, 8);
    return;
  }
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 4;
  if (map < 4) goto flies;
  r->c = map >= 8;
  if (map >= 8) goto flies;
  set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY)));
  if (r->a & 0xFF) goto flies;
  if (!before_5pm(ram, r)) goto flies;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0002);
  if (r->a) goto flies;
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 0, 0, 0x9117);
  tile_property(ram, r, 0, 0x9126);
  if (!cpx(r, 0xF0)) goto flies;
  item_word(ram, r);
  r->x = times3(ram, r, r->a);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SALE_TABLE + r->x);
  if (!r->a) goto flies;
  to_tile_ahead(ram, r);
  sprite(ram, r, 0, 0x915D);
  set_state(ram, r, 5);
  hands_free(ram, r);
  return;
flies:
  fly(ram, r, 0x9187);
}

/* AnimalCarried (state 2 of ItemAnimalSteps, an animal carried): thrown only
 * where it can stand: the tiles 0, 1 and 2 ahead free (property bits 0-4
 * clear, not type $FF) and the first not $E1 nor $C0-$CF. */
void hm_AnimalCarried(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  carried(ram, r, 0x9247, 0x9265, 0x927C);
  if (!throwing(ram, r)) return;
  if (in_the_way(ram, r, 0x92AA)) goto stop;
  static const struct { uint16_t a, xy, at_tile, at_prop; } look[] = {
    { 0, 7, 0x92C3, 0x92D2 }, { 1, 0x0A, 0x92F2, 0x9301 }, { 1, 0, 0x9321, 0x9330 },
  };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    tile_ahead(ram, r, look[i].a, look[i].xy, look[i].xy, look[i].at_tile);
    tile_property(ram, r, 2, look[i].at_prop);
    set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(r->a & 0x1F));
    if (r->a & 0xFF) goto stop;
    if (cpx(r, 0xFF)) goto stop;
  }
  if (cpx(r, 0xE1)) goto stop;
  r->c = r->x >= 0xC0;
  if (r->x >= 0xC0) {
    r->c = r->x >= 0xD0;
    if (r->x < 0xD0) goto stop;
  }
  fly(ram, r, 0x9362);
  return;
stop:
  stop_throw(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ItemLands (state 3): where a dropped or thrown item lands.
 *  - On the farm (maps 0-3), in the barn or the coop, at a shipping bin
 *    (tile $F2; HM-Decomp's Dropedonsaleplace): an item with a price is
 *    shipped (before 5 pm; after, it is simply lost) and the bin's
 *    animation plays ($24, $25 in the barn, $26 in the coop); state 7.
 *  - An egg ($14) put in the coop's incubator (tile $F7) when no egg is
 *    hatching ($7F1F6E bit 13): a chick is on its way (event $14, AddNewChicken,
 *    the incubator's tile), and 5 happiness (Droped_on_special_place).
 *  - On the farm, into a bin or a box (tiles $F0, $F9-$FD); on the
 *    mountain (maps $10-$14), into the spring ($F0: item 7 before 5 pm,
 *    once a day, $7F1F66 bit 13, starts an event) or the pond ($F4):
 *    the item goes there (state 4).
 *  - Otherwise it falls (sprite case $0A) on the tile in front; state 4.
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void falls(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                  /* CODE_81965B */
{
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  sprite(ram, r, 0x0A, 0x9667);
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 2, 0, 0, 0x9676);
  to_tile_ahead(ram, r);
  set_state(ram, r, 4);
}

static void into_spring(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)            /* CODE_8195F4 */
{
  uint8_t h = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND);
  set_a8(r, h);
  r->c = h >= 7;
  if (h == 7 && before_5pm(ram, r)) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & 0x2000);
    if (!r->a) {
```
