```c
      r->a = 0; r->x = 0x0010; r->y = 0;
      jsl(ram, r, 0x961B, 0x84, hm_StartEventScriptLong);
      r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) | 0x2000);
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), r->a);
    }
  }
  r->a = 6;
  into_spot(ram, r);
}

static void not_hatching(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)           /* .nothatchableegg */
{
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 4;
  if (map < 4) {                                           /* .onthefarm */
    tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 6, 6, 0x959B);
    tile_property(ram, r, 2, 0x95AA);
    static const uint16_t bins[] = { 0xF0, 0xF9, 0xFA, 0xFB, 0xFC, 0xFD };
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)i;
      if (cpx(r, bins[i])) { into_spot(ram, r); return; }
    }
    falls(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  r->c = map >= 0x10;
  if (map < 0x10) { falls(ram, r); return; }
  r->c = map >= 0x15;
  if (map >= 0x15) { falls(ram, r); return; }
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 6, 6, 0x9562);
  tile_property(ram, r, 2, 0x9571);
  r->a = 6;
  if (cpx(r, 0xF0)) { into_spring(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = 7;
  if (cpx(r, 0xF4)) { into_spot(ram, r); return; }
  falls(ram, r);
}

static void special_place(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)          /* Droped_on_special_place */
{
  uint8_t h = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND);
  set_a8(r, h);
  r->c = h >= 0x14;
  if (h != 0x14) { not_hatching(ram, r); return; }
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 0x28;
  if (map != 0x28) { not_hatching(ram, r); return; }
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 1, 0, 0, 0x94B9);
  tile_property(ram, r, 0, 0x94C8);
  if (!cpx(r, 0xF7)) { not_hatching(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E)) & 0x2000);
  if (r->a) { not_hatching(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = 0x0014; r->x = 0; r->y = 0;                       /* .alreadyhatchingegg */
  jsl(ram, r, 0x94ED, 0x84, hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront);
  r->y = 0;
  set_a8(r, 3);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, 0), 3);
  r->a = 0;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x9501, 0x83, hm_AddNewChicken);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E)) | 0x2000);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), r->a);
  r->a = 0x00A1; r->x = 0x00E0; r->y = 0x00B0;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x951B, 0x82, hm_EditTileOnMap);
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x9526, 0x952A);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  r->a = 5;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x9538, 0x83, hm_AddPlayerHappiness);
}

static void shipping_bin(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)           /* Dropedonsaleplace */
{
  uint8_t p = price_of(ram, r);
  if (!p) { special_place(ram, r); return; }
  if (before_5pm(ram, r)) ship(ram, r, p);
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x9415, 0);
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 0x27;
  uint16_t anim = 0x24, at = 0x9430;
  if (map == 0x27) { anim = 0x25; at = 0x9454; }
  else {
    r->c = map >= 0x28;
    if (map == 0x28) { anim = 0x26; at = 0x9478; }
  }
  r->a = anim;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x81, hm_StartMapAnimation);
  set_state(ram, r, 7);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & ~0x0001);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
}

void hm_ItemLands(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 4;
  bool bins = map < 4;
  if (!bins) {
    r->c = map >= 0x27;
    bins = map == 0x27;
    if (!bins) { r->c = map >= 0x28; bins = map == 0x28; }
  }
  if (!bins) { special_place(ram, r); return; }
  tile_ahead(ram, r, 2, 0, 0, 0x93A2);
  tile_property(ram, r, 0, 0x93B1);
  if (!cpx(r, 0xF2)) { special_place(ram, r); return; }
  shipping_bin(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The items' own routines ($81:80FE-$81:87C2, JSR, RTS; DATA8_8197C0 gives
 * one per item, some shared). Named here ItemObject_<first item that uses
 * it>; HM-Decomp has no labels for them.
 *  - most only run their machine;
 *  - the crops ($10-$13) count one more shipped (corn, tomatoes, potatoes,
 *    turnips) in the frame they are shipped ($7F1F5E bit 0);
 *  - items $1E-$22 (with $7F1F74 bit 5 they vanish at once): put down where
 *    their place is (state 0: $09AC must be their number, else the tile
 *    becomes $FC, the item goes and text $038D shows), the tile at
 *    $09AD / $09AF becomes $A1; once dropped, $7F1F74 bit 6;
 *  - the shop goods, once bought (state $FF): items $1B-$1D become $58-$5A
 *    and $49 becomes $19, $56 becomes 6 (in hand, state 0); a seed bag or a
 *    tool goes to the shed (its bit in $7F1F00-$7F1F03), leaves the
 *    player's tool slots if it was there, and a bag counts one more (up to
 *    255); a gold tool also takes the plain one's place; fodder fills its
 *    counter (12).
 *  - the 26 tools ($2A-$43, PutToolOnShelf + TakeToolFromShelf) wait for the
 *    frame routines and stay in the original.
 * Leftovers: the machine's, then the loads and compares after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define ITEM_JSR(name, at, machine_fn) \
  void hm_##name(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { jsr(ram, r, at, machine_fn); }
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_01_Mushroom, 0x80FE, hm_ItemFoodSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_02_PoisonMushroom, 0x8102, hm_ItemFoodSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_03_WildGrapes, 0x8106, hm_ItemFoodSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_04_TropicalFruit, 0x810A, hm_ItemFoodSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_05_FullmoonBerry, 0x810E, hm_ItemFoodSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_06_Cake, 0x8112, hm_ItemFoodSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_07_Fish, 0x8116, hm_ItemFoodSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_08_PowerBerry, 0x811A, hm_ItemFoodSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_09_Weed, 0x811E, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_0A_FallWeed, 0x8122, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_0D_Stone, 0x8126, hm_ItemPlaceableSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_0E_SnowyStone, 0x812A, hm_ItemPlaceableSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_0F_Fence, 0x812E, hm_ItemPlaceableSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_14_Egg, 0x8192, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_15_SmallMilk, 0x8196, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_16_MediumMilk, 0x819A, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_17_LargeMilk, 0x819E, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_18_Herb, 0x81A2, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_19_Flower, 0x81A6, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_1A_Fodder, 0x81AA, hm_ItemFodderSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_24_WeatherVane, 0x83B7, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_25_Hen, 0x83BB, hm_ItemAnimalSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_26_Chick, 0x83BF, hm_ItemAnimalSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_29_Mole, 0x83C5, hm_ItemAnimalSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_58_LilacPerfume, 0x87B7, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_59_RosePerfume, 0x87BB, hm_ItemCommonSteps)
ITEM_JSR(ItemObject_5A_VioletPerfume, 0x87BF, hm_ItemCommonSteps)

/* $23, $27, $28: nothing (RTS) */
void hm_ItemObject_23_Nothing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { (void)ram; (void)r; }
void hm_ItemObject_27_Nothing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { (void)ram; (void)r; }
void hm_ItemObject_28_Nothing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { (void)ram; (void)r; }

static void crop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint32_t counter)
{
  jsr(ram, r, at, hm_ItemCommonSteps);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) & 0x0001);
  if (!r->a) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, counter) + 1);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, counter, r->a);
}
void hm_ItemObject_10_Corn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { crop(ram, r, 0x8132, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPED_CORN)); } /* corn */
void hm_ItemObject_11_Tomato(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { crop(ram, r, 0x814A, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPED_TOMATOES)); } /* tomatoes */
void hm_ItemObject_12_Potato(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { crop(ram, r, 0x8162, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPED_POTATOES)); } /* potatoes */
void hm_ItemObject_13_Turnip(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { crop(ram, r, 0x817A, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPED_TURNIPS)); } /* turnips */

/* LDA $0976; CMP #$FF: bought? */
static bool bought(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  jsr(ram, r, at, hm_ItemShopGoodsSteps);
  uint8_t s = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_STATE);
  set_a8(r, s);
  r->c = s >= 0xFF;
  return s == 0xFF;
}
/* it becomes another item, in hand */
static void becomes(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t item)
{
  if (!bought(ram, r, at)) return;
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_STATE, 0);
  set_a8(r, item);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM, item);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, item);
}
void hm_ItemObject_1B_ShopLilacPerfume(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { becomes(ram, r, 0x81AE, 0x58); }
void hm_ItemObject_1C_ShopRosePerfume(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { becomes(ram, r, 0x81C8, 0x59); }
void hm_ItemObject_1D_ShopVioletPerfume(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { becomes(ram, r, 0x81E2, 0x5A); }
void hm_ItemObject_49_ShopFlower(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { becomes(ram, r, 0x85C5, 0x19); }
void hm_ItemObject_56_ShopCake(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { becomes(ram, r, 0x879D, 0x06); }

/* LDA.L row; ORA #bit; STA.L row (8 bits) */
static void shed_add(HmRegs *r, uint8_t *ram, uint32_t row, uint8_t bit)
{
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, row) | bit);
  set_a8(r, v);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, row, v);
}
/* the tool leaves the player's slots ($0921 in hand, $0923 in the bag) */
static void out_of_slots(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t tool)
{
  static const uint16_t slots[] = { HM_TOOL_SELECTED, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    uint8_t v = rd8(ram, r, slots[i]);
    set_a8(r, v);
    r->c = v >= tool;
    if (v == tool) wr8(ram, r, slots[i], 0);
  }
}
/* a bag: to the shed, out of the slots, one more (up to 255) */
static void seed_bag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint32_t row, uint8_t bit,
                     uint8_t tool, uint16_t count)
{
  if (!bought(ram, r, at)) return;
  shed_add(r, ram, row, bit);
  out_of_slots(ram, r, tool);
  uint8_t n = rd8(ram, r, count);
  set_a8(r, n);
  r->c = n >= 0xFF;
  if (n == 0xFF) return;
  set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(n + 1));
  wr8(ram, r, count, (uint8_t)(n + 1));
}
void hm_ItemObject_44_ShopGrassSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { seed_bag(ram, r, 0x8499, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 1, 0x08, 0x0C, HM_SEEDS_GRASS_N); }
void hm_ItemObject_45_ShopCornSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { seed_bag(ram, r, 0x84D5, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0x10, 0x05, HM_SEEDS_CORN_N); }
void hm_ItemObject_46_ShopTomatoSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { seed_bag(ram, r, 0x8511, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0x20, 0x06, HM_SEEDS_TOMATO_N); }
void hm_ItemObject_47_ShopPotatoSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { seed_bag(ram, r, 0x854D, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0x40, 0x07, HM_SEEDS_POTATO_N); }
void hm_ItemObject_48_ShopTurnipSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { seed_bag(ram, r, 0x8589, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0x80, 0x08, HM_SEEDS_TURNIP_N); }

/* something for the shed only */
static void to_shed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint32_t row, uint8_t bit)
{
  if (bought(ram, r, at)) shed_add(r, ram, row, bit);
}
void hm_ItemObject_4A_ShopPaint(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { to_shed(ram, r, 0x85DF, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 1, 0x10); }
void hm_ItemObject_4B_ShopMilker(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { to_shed(ram, r, 0x85F6, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 1, 0x20); }
void hm_ItemObject_4C_ShopBrush(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { to_shed(ram, r, 0x860D, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 1, 0x40); }
void hm_ItemObject_52_ShopCowMedicine(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { to_shed(ram, r, 0x8737, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 1, 0x01); }
void hm_ItemObject_53_ShopMiraclePotion(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { to_shed(ram, r, 0x874E, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 1, 0x02); }

/* a gold tool: to the shed in place of the plain one, out of the slots */
static void gold_tool(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bit,
                      uint32_t old_row, uint8_t keep, uint8_t tool)
{
  if (!bought(ram, r, at)) return;
  shed_add(r, ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 2, bit);
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, old_row) & keep);
  set_a8(r, v);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, old_row, v);
  out_of_slots(ram, r, tool);
}
void hm_ItemObject_4D_ShopGoldSickle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { gold_tool(ram, r, 0x8624, 0x01, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0xFE, 0x01); }
void hm_ItemObject_4E_ShopGoldHoe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { gold_tool(ram, r, 0x865B, 0x02, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0xFD, 0x02); }
void hm_ItemObject_4F_ShopGoldHammer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { gold_tool(ram, r, 0x8692, 0x04, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0xFB, 0x03); }
void hm_ItemObject_50_ShopGoldAxe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { gold_tool(ram, r, 0x86C9, 0x08, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS), 0xF7, 0x04); }
void hm_ItemObject_51_ShopSprinkler(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { gold_tool(ram, r, 0x8700, 0x10, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 1, 0x7F, 0x10); }

/* fodder: its shed bit, and its counter full (12) */
static void fodder(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bit, uint16_t count)
{
  if (!bought(ram, r, at)) return;
  shed_add(r, ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + 3, bit);
  set_a8(r, 0x0C);
  wr8(ram, r, count, 0x0C);
}
void hm_ItemObject_54_ShopChickenFeed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fodder(ram, r, 0x8765, 0x01, HM_FEED_CHICKS_N); }
void hm_ItemObject_55_ShopCowFeed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fodder(ram, r, 0x8781, 0x02, HM_FEED_COW_N); }

/* items $1E-$22 */
static void vanish(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                  /* CODE_818337 */
{
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x833E, 0x8342);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  hands_free(ram, r);
}
static void placed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                  /* CODE_81835E */
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74)) | 0x0040);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74), r->a);
}
static void wrong_place(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)             /* CODE_81836C */
{
  r->a = 0x00FC;
  r->x = rd16(ram, r, HM_EDIT_X);
  r->y = rd16(ram, r, HM_EDIT_Y);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8377, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTile);
  remove_object(ram, r, 0x8382, 0x8386);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);
  hands_free(ram, r);
  wait_for_input(ram, r);
  r->x = 0x038D;
  say(ram, r, 0x83B1);
}
static void piece(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t n, uint16_t at_edit, uint16_t at_jsr)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74)) & 0x0020);
  if (r->a) { vanish(ram, r); placed(ram, r); return; }
  uint8_t s = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_STATE);
  set_a8(r, s);
  if (s == 0) {
    uint8_t k = rd8(ram, r, EGG_SPOT);
    set_a8(r, k);
    r->c = k >= n;
    if (k != n) { wrong_place(ram, r); return; }
    r->a = 0x00A1;
    r->x = rd16(ram, r, HM_EDIT_X);
    r->y = rd16(ram, r, HM_EDIT_Y);
    jsl(ram, r, at_edit, 0x82, hm_EditTileOnMap);
  }
  jsr(ram, r, at_jsr, hm_ItemCommonSteps);
  s = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_STATE);
  set_a8(r, s);
  r->c = s >= 3;
  if (s == 3) placed(ram, r);
}
void hm_ItemObject_1E_FestivalEgg1(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { piece(ram, r, 1, 0x8228, 0x822C); }
void hm_ItemObject_1F_FestivalEgg2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { piece(ram, r, 2, 0x826A, 0x826E); }
void hm_ItemObject_20_FestivalEgg3(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { piece(ram, r, 3, 0x82AC, 0x82B0); }
void hm_ItemObject_21_FestivalEgg4(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { piece(ram, r, 4, 0x82EB, 0x82EF); }
void hm_ItemObject_22_FestivalEgg5(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { piece(ram, r, 5, 0x8324, 0x8328); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PutToolOnShelf ($81:A94A, JSL, RTL): a tool goes back on its shelf. Only
 * with something in the bag ($0923). The tool in hand ($0921) has an
 * 8-byte entry at $81:BE0F: +0 X, +2 Y, +4 the tile (ChangeMapTile's
 * arguments), +6 a row of the shed's flags ($7F:1F00 + it), +7 its bit.
 * If the shop it belongs to is the map shown (tools 1-$18: map $26, tool
 * $19: map $28, from $1A: map $27), its place on the shelf is redrawn and
 * sent at once (StartProgrammedDMA). Then, wherever the player is (and for
 * tool 0 too), its bit is set in the shed's row.
 * Leftovers: A = the row's new value (high byte 0), X = Y = the row, C = 0;
 * with the bag empty, A's low byte 0 and the rest untouched.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PutToolOnShelf(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK));
  if (!rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK)) return;
  uint8_t tool = rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED);
  set_a8(r, tool);
  if (tool) {
    uint8_t shop = tool < 0x19 ? 0x26 : tool == 0x19 ? 0x28 : 0x27;
    uint8_t map = rd8(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);                  /* LDA $0022 (absolute) */
    set_a8(r, map);
    if (map == shop) {
      uint16_t x = (uint16_t)(tool * 8);
      uint16_t tx = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SHED_ITEM_TABLE + x), ty = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SHED_ITEM_TABLE + x + SHELF_Y);
      hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(tx >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)tx);   /* PHA; PHA; PLY; PLX */
      hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(ty >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)ty);
      hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
      r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SHED_ITEM_TABLE + x + SHELF_TILE);
      r->x = tx;
      r->y = ty;
      jsl(ram, r, 0xA9A6, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTile);
      jsl(ram, r, 0xA9AA, 0x80, hm_StartProgrammedDMA);
    }
  }
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)(tool * 8 + SHELF_ROW);
  uint8_t row = hm_bus_rd8(ram, SHED_ITEM_TABLE + x), bit = hm_bus_rd8(ram, SHED_ITEM_TABLE + x + 1);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SHED_BIT) = bit;
  r->x = r->y = row;
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + row) | bit);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + row, v);
  r->a = v;
  r->c = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * TakeToolFromShelf ($81:87C3, JSR, RTS): a tool taken off the shelf (items
 * $29 + n, n = 1-$1A: the tools as shop articles). If the bag is empty
 * ($0923) the tool in hand goes into it; the new one is in hand ($0921 =
 * item - $29) and its bit in the shed's rows is cleared (the entry at
 * $81:BE0F, as for PutToolOnShelf). The player's action ends ($D4 = 0, $D2
 * bit 1 cleared), the item's game object goes (DestroyGameObject) with the
 * extra drawing of the map refreshed (FreeMapObject), nothing is held
 * ($091D = 0) and the new tool's noises are loaded (ToolUsedSound2).
 * Leftovers: those of ToolUsedSound2.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_TakeToolFromShelf(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK));
  if (!rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK)) {
    set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED));
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK, (uint8_t)r->a);
  }
  uint8_t item = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM);
  uint8_t tool = (uint8_t)(item - 0x29);                     /* SEC; SBC #$29 */
  r->c = item >= 0x29;
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED, tool);
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)((tool << 3) + SHELF_ROW);          /* ASL x3; CLC; ADC #6 */
  r->c = 0;
  uint8_t row = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (SHED_ITEM_TABLE + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  uint8_t bit = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (SHED_ITEM_TABLE + x + 1) & 0xFFFFFF);
  hm_push8(ram, r, row);                                     /* PHA ... PLA */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SHED_BIT) = (uint8_t)~bit;
  hm_pull8(ram, r);
  r->x = row;                                                /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA; TAX */
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + row) & ~bit);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + row, v);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);                    /* REP #$30 */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & ~0x0002);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, OBJECT);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8828, 0x85, hm_DestroyGameObject);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x882C, 0x81, hm_FreeMapObject);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND, 0);                           /* SEP #$20; STZ $091D */
  r->p = entry;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8835, 0x82, hm_ToolUsedSound2);
  r->p = entry;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The 26 tools as items ($2A-$43, $81:83C9 + 8 n): each frame the tool in
 * hand goes back on its shelf (PutToolOnShelf) and this one is taken
 * (TakeToolFromShelf): picking a tool off the shed's wall swaps it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define TOOL_ITEM(name, at)                                   \
  void hm_##name(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                     \
  {                                                           \
    jsl(ram, r, at, 0x81, hm_PutToolOnShelf);                    \
    jsr(ram, r, (uint16_t)((at) + 4), hm_TakeToolFromShelf);        \
  }
TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_2A_Sickle, 0x83C9) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_2B_Hoe, 0x83D1) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_2C_Hammer, 0x83D9)
TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_2D_Axe, 0x83E1) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_2E_CornSeeds, 0x83E9) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_2F_TomatoSeeds, 0x83F1)
TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_30_PotatoSeeds, 0x83F9) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_31_TurnipSeeds, 0x8401) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_32_CowMedicine, 0x8409)
TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_33_MiraclePotion, 0x8411) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_34_Bell, 0x8419) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_35_GrassSeeds, 0x8421)
TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_36_Paint, 0x8429) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_37_Milker, 0x8431) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_38_Brush, 0x8439)
TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_39_WateringCan, 0x8441) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_3A_GoldSickle, 0x8449) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_3B_GoldHoe, 0x8451)
TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_3C_GoldHammer, 0x8459) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_3D_GoldAxe, 0x8461) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_3E_Sprinkler, 0x8469)

TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_42_ChickenFeed, 0x8489) TOOL_ITEM(ItemObject_43_CowFeed, 0x8491)

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * RunItemRoutine ($81:809A, JSR, RTS): each frame, the routine of the item
 * being worked on ($0984), through the table DATA8_8197C0 (JSR (abs,X),
 * X = 2 item, A's high byte 0); then bit 0 of $7F1F5E (an item shipped
 * this frame) is cleared. Items 1-$5A have a routine; the table's entry
 * for item 0 points at $81:FFFF and the game never has it here.
 * Leftovers: A = the new $7F1F5E, X and Y those of the item's routine.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static Step *const ITEM_ROUTINES[0x5A] = {
  hm_ItemObject_01_Mushroom, hm_ItemObject_02_PoisonMushroom, hm_ItemObject_03_WildGrapes, hm_ItemObject_04_TropicalFruit,

  hm_ItemObject_09_Weed, hm_ItemObject_0A_FallWeed, hm_ItemObject_09_Weed, hm_ItemObject_09_Weed,
  hm_ItemObject_0D_Stone, hm_ItemObject_0E_SnowyStone, hm_ItemObject_0F_Fence, hm_ItemObject_10_Corn,
  hm_ItemObject_11_Tomato, hm_ItemObject_12_Potato, hm_ItemObject_13_Turnip, hm_ItemObject_14_Egg,
  hm_ItemObject_15_SmallMilk, hm_ItemObject_16_MediumMilk, hm_ItemObject_17_LargeMilk, hm_ItemObject_18_Herb,
  hm_ItemObject_19_Flower, hm_ItemObject_1A_Fodder, hm_ItemObject_1B_ShopLilacPerfume, hm_ItemObject_1C_ShopRosePerfume,
  hm_ItemObject_1D_ShopVioletPerfume, hm_ItemObject_1E_FestivalEgg1, hm_ItemObject_1F_FestivalEgg2, hm_ItemObject_20_FestivalEgg3,
  hm_ItemObject_21_FestivalEgg4, hm_ItemObject_22_FestivalEgg5, hm_ItemObject_23_Nothing, hm_ItemObject_24_WeatherVane,
  hm_ItemObject_25_Hen, hm_ItemObject_26_Chick, hm_ItemObject_27_Nothing, hm_ItemObject_28_Nothing,
  hm_ItemObject_29_Mole, hm_ItemObject_2A_Sickle, hm_ItemObject_2B_Hoe, hm_ItemObject_2C_Hammer,
  hm_ItemObject_2D_Axe, hm_ItemObject_2E_CornSeeds, hm_ItemObject_2F_TomatoSeeds, hm_ItemObject_30_PotatoSeeds,
  hm_ItemObject_31_TurnipSeeds, hm_ItemObject_32_CowMedicine, hm_ItemObject_33_MiraclePotion, hm_ItemObject_34_Bell,
  hm_ItemObject_35_GrassSeeds, hm_ItemObject_36_Paint, hm_ItemObject_37_Milker, hm_ItemObject_38_Brush,
  hm_ItemObject_39_WateringCan, hm_ItemObject_3A_GoldSickle, hm_ItemObject_3B_GoldHoe, hm_ItemObject_3C_GoldHammer,
  hm_ItemObject_3D_GoldAxe, hm_ItemObject_3E_Sprinkler, hm_ItemObject_3F_MagicBeans, hm_ItemObject_40_GemSeed,
  hm_ItemObject_41_BlueFeather, hm_ItemObject_42_ChickenFeed, hm_ItemObject_43_CowFeed, hm_ItemObject_44_ShopGrassSeeds,
  hm_ItemObject_45_ShopCornSeeds, hm_ItemObject_46_ShopTomatoSeeds, hm_ItemObject_47_ShopPotatoSeeds, hm_ItemObject_48_ShopTurnipSeeds,

void hm_RunItemRoutine(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t item = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM);
  r->a = (uint8_t)(item << 1);                               /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA; ASL */
  r->c = item >> 7;
  r->x = r->a;
  if (item >= 1 && item <= 0x5A) jsr(ram, r, 0x80A6, ITEM_ROUTINES[item - 1]);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) & 0xFFFE); /* REP #$30 */
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * RunItemsOnMap ($81:A383, JSL, RTL; HM-Decomp's name): the items left on the map,
 * every frame. Ten records of 16 bytes at $7E:B4E6 ($07-$09 points at the
 * one worked on): +0 flags (bit 0 in use, bit 1 drawn on the map, bit 2
 * kept off screen), +1 the routine (1 = RunItemRoutine, through the table
 * $81:A58B; 0 = none), +2 the state, +3 the item, +4 its game object,
 * +6 / +8 its sprite and the last one, +$A-$E the flip and the position.
 * For each record in use the fields are copied to $0974-$0982 (the item
 * being worked on), the object is placed (ReadGameObject: $A7 = $FFFD when
 * it fell out of the map, $FFFF when it is on screen); out of the map it
 * is destroyed (DestroyGameObject) and, if drawn on the map, the map's extras
 * are redrawn (FreeMapObject); off screen it is skipped unless bit 2. Then
 * the routine runs and everything is copied back; the object follows
 * (MoveGameObject) and gets the new sprite if it changed (ChangeGameObjectSprite).
 * Only routine 1 exists: the table's other words are the bytes of the
 * code after it.
 * Leftovers: A = $B586 (the pointer past the last record), X = $0A, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint32_t rec_at(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y) { r->y = y; return hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, y); }

void hm_RunItemsOnMap(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t bytes[4] = { HM_ITEM_FLAGS, HM_ITEM_ROUTINE, HM_ITEM_STATE, HM_ITEM };
  static const uint16_t words[6] = { OBJECT, HM_ITEM_SPRITE, ITEM_SPRITE_SHOWN, HM_ITEM_FLIP, HM_ITEM_X, HM_ITEM_Y };
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, (uint16_t)WRAM_LONG(HM_MAP_OBJECTS));
  r->a = 0xB47E;                                             /* SEP #$20; LDA #$7E */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR_BANK) = (uint8_t)(WRAM_LONG(HM_MAP_OBJECTS) >> 16);
  r->x = 0;
  for (;;) {
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(r->x >> 8));                  /* PHX */
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)r->x);
    uint8_t flags = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_FLAGS));
    set_a8(r, flags & 0x01);
    if (flags & 0x01) {
      for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, rec_at(ram, r, (uint16_t)i)));
        wr8(ram, r, bytes[i], (uint8_t)r->a);
      }
      for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
        r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, rec_at(ram, r, (uint16_t)(MOBJ_GOBJ + 2 * i)));
        wr16(ram, r, words[i], r->a);
        if (i == 0) hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
      }
      jsl(ram, r, 0xA3F5, 0x85, hm_ReadGameObject);
      r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_RESULT);
      bool run = true;
      r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFD;
      if (r->a == 0xFFFD) {                                  /* out of the map */
        r->a = rd16(ram, r, OBJECT);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
        jsl(ram, r, 0xA420, 0x85, hm_DestroyGameObject);
        set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS) & 0x02);
        if (r->a & 0xFF) jsl(ram, r, 0xA42D, 0x81, hm_FreeMapObject);
      } else {
        r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF;
        if (r->a != 0xFFFF) {                                /* off screen */
          set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS) & 0x04);
          run = (r->a & 0xFF) != 0;
        }
      }
      if (run) {
        r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, rec_at(ram, r, MOBJ_ROUTINE));   /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
        r->c = (r->a & 0x8000) != 0;                          /* ASL (16-bit) */
        r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a << 1);
        r->x = r->a;
        r->c = 1;                                            /* CPX #0 */
        if (r->x) {
          if (r->x == 2) jsr(ram, r, 0xA444, hm_RunItemRoutine);
          static const uint16_t back8[3][2] = { { MOBJ_FLAGS, HM_ITEM_FLAGS }, { MOBJ_STATE, HM_ITEM_STATE }, { MOBJ_ITEM, HM_ITEM } };
          for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, back8[i][1]));
            hm_bus_wr8(ram, rec_at(ram, r, back8[i][0]), (uint8_t)r->a);
          }
          static const uint8_t to_dp[6] = { HM_OBJ_NUMBER, 0, 0, HM_OBJ_FLIP, HM_OBJ_X, HM_OBJ_Y };
          for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
            r->a = rd16(ram, r, words[i]);
            hm_bus_wr16(ram, rec_at(ram, r, (uint16_t)(MOBJ_GOBJ + 2 * i)), r->a);
            if (to_dp[i]) hm_dp_w16(ram, r, to_dp[i], r->a);
          }
          jsl(ram, r, 0xA49B, 0x85, hm_MoveGameObject);
          r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_ITEM_SPRITE);
          uint16_t last = rd16(ram, r, ITEM_SPRITE_SHOWN);
          r->c = r->a >= last;
          if (r->a != last) {
            hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_SPRITE, r->a);
            hm_bus_wr16(ram, rec_at(ram, r, MOBJ_SPRITE_SHOWN), r->a);
            jsl(ram, r, 0xA4AE, 0x85, hm_ChangeGameObjectSprite);
          }
        }
      }
    }
    uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);                           /* REP #$30; PLX */
    r->x = (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
    uint32_t next = (uint32_t)hm_dp_r16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR) + ITEM_RECORD_SIZE;
    r->a = (uint16_t)next;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, r->a);
    r->x++;
    r->c = r->x >= 0x0A;
    if (r->x == 0x0A) return;
  }
}
```

`src/joypad.c`:

```c
/*
 * joypad.c — reading the controllers, once a frame.
 *
 * ReadJoypad ($80:872B, JSR, RTS; the game runs the copy in bank $00):
 *   - waits until the console has finished its automatic reading of the
 *     pads ($4212 bit 0);
 *   - keeps last frame's buttons ($0126, $0132) and reads the new ones from
 *     $4218 (pad 1) and $421A (pad 2) into $0124 and $0130;
 *   - works out what is useful from them, for pad 1:
 *       $0128  buttons pressed this frame (not held last frame),
 *       $012A  buttons let go this frame,
 *       $012C  "autorepeat": the new presses, plus every held button again
 *              while it is kept down (used by the menus, see below);
 *     and for pad 2 the same ($0134, $0136, $0138; nothing reads them).
 *   - $23 counts the frames some button has been held (0 when none). When
 *     it reaches 30 (half a second) the held buttons count as pressed again
 *     ($012C) and it goes back to 25: from then on every 5 frames, so a
 *     cursor held down keeps moving.
 * If $00 is not 0 another branch runs (it never does): it reads only the
 * low bytes, pad 1 into $012E and pad 2 into $0130, and leaves $0124 as it
 * was.
 * Leftovers: A = $0124's high byte : the counter $23; X, Y and the flags
 * (with the 8 / 16-bit widths) back as they were (PHP / PLP).
 *
 * Quirks: the "let go" word of pad 2 ($0136) is worked out from pad 1's
 * register, a typo that does not matter since pad 2 is never used. $012E
 * and $013A are ORed into the buttons read and then cleared: they are
 * always 0.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

/* `.W` addresses go through the data bank (DB): $4212 and $4218 are the
 * console's registers only when DB is a bank that has them. */
static uint32_t abs_(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_(r, a)); }
static uint16_t rd16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_(r, a)); }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_(r, a), v); }

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ────────────────────────────── */

/* WRAM of the data bank: pad 1 */
#define PAD1_EXTRA    0x012E   /* 16b: ORed into the buttons read, then cleared */
/* pad 2: the same (nothing reads them) */
#define PAD2_REPEAT   0x0138
#define PAD2_EXTRA    0x013A

/* Direct page */
#define DP_LOW_BYTES_ONLY 0x00 /* 8b: not 0 = read only the low bytes (never) */
#define HELD          0x23     /* 16b: frames some button has been held */

void hm_ReadJoypad(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, r->p);                                      /* PHP */
  while (rd8(ram, r, HVBJOY) & 0x01) { }                      /* still reading */

  wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_LAST, rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD));
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD2_LAST, rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD2_HELD));
  if (*hm_dp(ram, r, DP_LOW_BYTES_ONLY)) {                     /* never */
    wr8(ram, r, PAD1_EXTRA, rd8(ram, r, JOY1L));
    wr8(ram, r, HM_PAD2_HELD, rd8(ram, r, JOY2L));
  } else {
    wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD, rd16(ram, r, JOY1L) | rd16(ram, r, PAD1_EXTRA));
    wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD2_HELD, rd16(ram, r, JOY2L) | rd16(ram, r, PAD2_EXTRA));
    wr16(ram, r, PAD1_EXTRA, 0);
    wr16(ram, r, PAD2_EXTRA, 0);
  }

  uint16_t last1 = rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_LAST), last2 = rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD2_LAST);
  uint16_t pressed1 = (rd16(ram, r, JOY1L) ^ last1) & rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW, pressed1);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_REPEAT, pressed1);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_UP, (rd16(ram, r, JOY1L) ^ last1) & last1);
  uint16_t pressed2 = (rd16(ram, r, JOY2L) ^ last2) & rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD2_HELD);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD2_NEW, pressed2);
  wr16(ram, r, PAD2_REPEAT, pressed2);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD2_UP, (rd16(ram, r, JOY1L) ^ last2) & last2); /* pad 1's register */

  /* the hold counter (a word: INC / STZ run with 16-bit A) */
  uint16_t buttons = rd16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HELD, buttons ? (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HELD) + 1) : 0);
  if (*hm_dp(ram, r, HELD) == 30) {
    wr16(ram, r, HM_PAD1_REPEAT, buttons);                     /* held: again */
    *hm_dp(ram, r, HELD) = 25;
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)((buttons & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, HELD));
  hm_pull8(ram, r);                                            /* PLP */
}

```

`src/mapedit.c`:

```c
/*
 * mapedit.c — changing tiles of the current map (a tool hits the ground, a
 * crop grows, a fence breaks...).
 *
 * A map exists three times: the tile types the game logic reads
 * ($09B6, GetTileContent), the full BG1 tilemap in WRAM ($7E:2000, what
 * the screen shows, see MEMORIA.md) and the 64x64 window of it in VRAM.
 * Changing a tile updates the first two here; CODE_81A688 then queues DMA
 * transfers for the VRAM (that part writes DMA registers and is not
 * rewritten yet).
 *
 * The "tile changes" table $81:B363 has 6 bytes per entry:
 *   +0 word  offset of the graphics in $A6:A096
 *   +2 byte  rows (of 16x16 tiles)      +3 byte  columns
 *   +4 word  the tile type to write in $09B6 (0 = leave it)
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ────────────────────────────── */
/* ROM tables */
#define TILE_CHANGES      0x81B363   /* the tile changes, 6 bytes each: */
#define CHG_GFX           0          /*   16b: the graphics' offset in TILE_GRAPHICS */
#define CHG_ROWS          2          /*   8b: rows of 16x16 tiles */
#define CHG_COLS          3          /*   8b: columns */
#define CHG_TYPE          4          /*   16b: the tile type to write (0 = leave it) */
#define TILE_GRAPHICS     0xA6A096   /* ROM, bank $A6 */
#define MAP_ANIMATIONS    0x81B963   /* 3 bytes each: a long pointer to a map animation */
#define MAP_ANIM_BANK_AT  2          /*   8b: the pointer's bank */
#define JOINS             0x82B02A   /* DATA8_82B02A: 16 entries */
/* A map animation's steps (7 bytes, at [HM_MAP_ANIM]) */
#define STEP_CHANGE       0          /* 16b: the tile change ($FFFF end, $FFFE jump) */
#define STEP_X            2          /* 16b: where, pixels */
#define STEP_Y            4          /* 16b */
#define STEP_FRAMES       6          /* 8b: frames to wait after it */
#define STEP_BYTES        7
#define JUMP_ADDR         2          /* in a $FFFE step: 16b the address to go on at, */
#define JUMP_BANK         4          /*   8b its bank */

/* WRAM */
#define BG1_TILEMAP       0x2000     /* $7E:2000: the map's whole BG1 tilemap (bank $7E) */
#define ANIMATION_WAIT    0x0989     /* DB: frames left before the map animation's next step */
#define VRAM_TILEMAP      0x6000     /* VRAM: the 64x64 window of the BG1 tilemap */

/* Direct page. $72-$99 mean different things in different routines: the names
 * below say whose use each one is. ReadTileChange's results (also read by its
 * callers): */
#define CHANGE_GFX        0x7E   /* 16b: the graphics' offset in TILE_GRAPHICS */
#define CHANGE_COLS       0x80   /* 16b: the columns (the callers then make it 4 x: the
                                  * bytes of a row of the graphics) */
#define CHANGE_ROWS       0x82   /* 16b: the rows */
#define CHANGE_TYPE       0x84   /* 16b: the tile type to write (0 = none) */
/* The graphics being copied: */
#define SOURCE_PTR        0x72   /* long $72-$74: the graphics (AddProgrammedDMA's source) */
#define SOURCE_BANK       0x74
/* DrawTileChange's own uses: */
#define DRAW_COL          0x7E   /* first the tilemap offset of the column (CHANGE_GFX
                                  * after ReadTileChange) */
#define DRAW_ROW          0x80   /* first the tilemap offset of the row (CHANGE_COLS
                                  * after ReadTileChange) */
#define DRAW_STRIDE       0x88   /* tilemap bytes from one row to the next */
#define DRAW_START        0x86   /* the tilemap offset of the top-left corner */
#define TILEMAP_PTR       0x75   /* long $75-$77: where the row goes in BG1_TILEMAP */
#define TILEMAP_PTR_BANK  0x77
#define GFX_ROW_PTR       0x78   /* long $78-$7A: the start of the graphics' row */
#define GFX_ROW_PTR_BANK  0x7A
#define SCREEN_SKIP       0x8E   /* $40 once the row crossed into the next screen */
#define CROSSED           0x90   /* bytes done in the row (+ $40 at a screen crossing) */
/* SetTileTypeBlock's own uses (DrawWholeMap: TILE_X / TILE_Y too): */
#define BLOCK_TYPE        0x99   /* 8b: the tile type */
#define TILE_X            0x82   /* 16b: the position, pixels (CHANGE_ROWS elsewhere) */
#define TILE_Y            0x84   /* 16b (CHANGE_TYPE elsewhere) */
#define BLOCK_COLS        0x86   /* 16b: the block's columns */
#define BLOCK_ROWS        0x88   /* 16b: its rows */
#define BLOCK_ROW16       0x8E   /* 8b (read as 16b): 16 x the row */
#define BLOCK_COL16       0x90   /* 8b (read as 16b): 16 x the column */
/* QueueTileGraphicsDMA's own uses: */
#define QUEUE_COL         0x7E   /* the tile's column (CHANGE_GFX after ReadTileChange) */
#define QUEUE_ROW         0x80   /* the tile's row (CHANGE_COLS after ReadTileChange) */
#define QUEUE_VRAM        0x86   /* the VRAM address of the top-left corner */
#define ROW_SOURCE        0x75   /* long $75-$77: the start of the graphics' row */
#define ROW_SOURCE_BANK   0x77
#define FIRST_CHANNEL     0x92   /* 8b: the pair's first DMA channel (2, then 0) */
#define DMA_CHANNEL       0x27   /* 8b: AddProgrammedDMA's channel */
#define DMA_B_ADDRESS     0x29   /* 8b: its destination register (B-bus, $21xx) */
/* DrawWholeMap's own uses: */
#define JOIN_MASK         0x86   /* the neighbours of the same kind (left 8, right 2,
                                  * up 4, down 1) */
#define JOIN_ADD          0x94   /* 8b: JOINS[mask] - 1, added to the drawing */
/* The map animation (StartMapAnimation, RunMapAnimation): */
#define ANIM_ENTRY        0x7E   /* StartMapAnimation: the entry asked for */
#define JUMP_PTR          0x72   /* RunMapAnimation: long $72-$74, a jump's target */
#define JUMP_PTR_BANK     0x74
/* Others: */
#define MAP_OBJ_PTR       0x07   /* long $07-$09: the map object worked on (objects.c) */

static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReadTileChange ($81:A801, JSL, RTL). A = entry of the tile-changes table;
 * $7E = graphics offset, $82 = rows, $80 = columns, $84 = tile type.
 * Leftovers: A = $84, X = 6 A + 4, C from the 6 A sum.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReadTileChange(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t n = r->a;
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(n << 2) + n;      /* ASL; ASL; CLC; ADC */
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + n + (s > 0xFFFF);                 /* ADC (carry chained) */
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)s;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CHANGE_GFX, hm_bus_rd16(ram, TILE_CHANGES + x));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CHANGE_ROWS, hm_bus_rd8(ram, TILE_CHANGES + (uint16_t)(x + CHG_ROWS)));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS, hm_bus_rd8(ram, TILE_CHANGES + (uint16_t)(x + CHG_COLS)));
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, TILE_CHANGES + (uint16_t)(x + CHG_TYPE));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CHANGE_TYPE, r->a);
  r->x = (uint16_t)(x + CHG_TYPE);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DrawTileChange ($81:A83A, JSL, RTL). A = tile change, X/Y = position in
 * pixels. Copies its graphics (rows x columns of 16x16 tiles, each 2x2
 * tilemap entries) from $A6:A096 into the BG1 tilemap at $7E:2000. The
 * tilemap is 32 entries wide per screen and the map is $0181 screens wide
 * (1, 2 or 4); crossing to the next 32-entry screen skips $40 bytes.
 * Leftovers: $72-$7A pointers, $86 start, $88 row stride, $8E/$90 the
 * screen-crossing counters; A = the final $7E, X = $80, Y = rows, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_83A_CHANGES 0xA88A   /* JSL ReadTileChange at $81:A887 */

void hm_DrawTileChange(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t change = r->a;
  push16(ram, r, change);                                /* PHA */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DRAW_COL, (uint16_t)((r->x >> 4) << 2));
  uint16_t row = (uint16_t)((r->y >> 4) << 7), stride = 0x40;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DRAW_ROW, row);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DRAW_STRIDE, stride);
  uint8_t width = hm_bus_rd8(ram, ((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + HM_MAP_WIDTH);
  if (width != 1) {
    row = (uint16_t)(row << 1); stride = (uint16_t)(stride << 1);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DRAW_ROW, row); hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DRAW_STRIDE, stride);
    if (width != 2) {
      row = (uint16_t)(row << 1); stride = (uint16_t)(stride << 1);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DRAW_ROW, row); hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DRAW_STRIDE, stride);
    }
  }
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DRAW_START, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DRAW_COL) + row));
  r->a = pull16(ram, r);                                 /* PLA */
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_83A_CHANGES, 0x81);
  hm_ReadTileChange(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);

  uint16_t cols4 = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS) << 2);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS, cols4);
  uint16_t src = (uint16_t)((uint16_t)TILE_GRAPHICS + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_GFX));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR, src); hm_dp_w16(ram, r, GFX_ROW_PTR, src);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOURCE_BANK) = 0xA6; *hm_dp(ram, r, GFX_ROW_PTR_BANK) = 0xA6;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TILEMAP_PTR, (uint16_t)(BG1_TILEMAP + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DRAW_START)));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, TILEMAP_PTR_BANK) = 0x7E;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SCREEN_SKIP, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CROSSED, 0);

  uint16_t rows = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_ROWS);
  uint16_t y = 0;
  do {
    push16(ram, r, y);                                   /* PHY */
    for (uint16_t pass = 0; pass != 2; pass++) {         /* the two halves */
      push16(ram, r, pass);                              /* PHA */
      uint16_t sy = 0, dx = 0;
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CROSSED, 0);
      do {
        uint16_t v = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR, sy));
        push16(ram, r, sy);                              /* PHY; TXY */
        hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, TILEMAP_PTR, dx), v);
        sy = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 2);             /* PLY; INY; INY */
        dx = (uint16_t)(dx + 2);
        pull16(ram, r); push16(ram, r, pass);            /* PLA; PHA */
        uint16_t crossed = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CROSSED) + 2);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CROSSED, crossed);
        if ((uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_GFX) + crossed) & 0x0040) {
          hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SCREEN_SKIP, 0x40);          /* next screen */
          hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CROSSED, (uint16_t)(crossed + 0x40));
          sy = (uint16_t)(sy + 0x40);
        }
      } while (dx != hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS));
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR) + 0x40));
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TILEMAP_PTR, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TILEMAP_PTR) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DRAW_STRIDE)));
      pull16(ram, r);                                    /* PLA */
      r->x = dx;
    }
    uint32_t next = (uint32_t)hm_dp_r16(ram, r, GFX_ROW_PTR) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS);
    next = (next & 0xFFFF) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SCREEN_SKIP) + (next > 0xFFFF);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, GFX_ROW_PTR, (uint16_t)next);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR, (uint16_t)next);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SCREEN_SKIP, 0);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_GFX) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CROSSED));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CHANGE_GFX, r->a);
    y = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);                  /* PLY; INY */
  } while (y != rows);
  r->y = y;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SetTileTypeBlock ($82:B060, JSL, RTL). A (8-bit) = a tile type; writes it into
 * the map's tile types ($09B6) for a block of $86 columns x $88 rows of
 * tiles whose top-left corner is X, Y (pixels). The per-tile offsets are
 * kept 8-bit in $8E/$90 but read back as 16-bit words, so the bytes $8F
 * and $91 left by whoever ran before count too (they are 0 in practice).
 * Leftovers: $99 = type, $82/$84 = X/Y; A = (index high byte : type),
 * X = $86, Y = $88, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_B060_INDEX 0xB090   /* JSR GetTileIndex at $82:B08E */

void hm_SetTileTypeBlock(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t type = (uint8_t)r->a;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, BLOCK_TYPE) = type;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TILE_X, r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TILE_Y, r->y);
  uint16_t row = 0;
  do {
    push16(ram, r, row);                                 /* PHY */
    *hm_dp(ram, r, BLOCK_ROW16) = (uint8_t)(row << 4);
    uint16_t col = 0;
    do {
      push16(ram, r, col);                               /* PHX */
      *hm_dp(ram, r, BLOCK_COL16) = (uint8_t)(col << 4);
      r->x = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TILE_X) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, BLOCK_ROW16));
      r->y = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TILE_Y) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, BLOCK_COL16));
      hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(RET_B060_INDEX >> 8));
      hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)RET_B060_INDEX);
      hm_GetTileIndex(ram, r);
      hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | type);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, (((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + HM_MAP_TILES + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF, type);
      col = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);              /* PLX; INX */
    } while (col != hm_dp_r16(ram, r, BLOCK_COLS));
    row = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);                /* PLY; INY */
  } while (row != hm_dp_r16(ram, r, BLOCK_ROWS));
  r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, BLOCK_COLS);
  r->y = row;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * QueueTileGraphicsDMA ($81:A6C1, JSL, RTL; CODE_81A6C1 in HM-Decomp).
 * A = tile change, X/Y = position. Queues the DMA transfers that copy the
 * change's graphics ($A6:A096 + offset) into the VRAM tilemap: two per
 * tile row (the two halves), $80 bytes each, VRAM address mode $80.
 * The VRAM address: $6000 + 2 col + 64 row, where col / row wrap at 32
 * (the 64x64 window is four 32x32 screens) and the right / bottom screens
 * add $3E0 / $400. The first pair uses DMA channels 2 and 3, the next
 * ones 0 and 1.
 * Leftovers: $7E/$80/$82/$84 (ReadTileChange, then $80 = 4 cols, $82 = 2 rows),
 * $72/$75 source pointers, $86 base, $92 = 0; A = the last source, X =
 * rows*2, Y = 4 cols, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_6C1_CHANGES 0xA747   /* JSL ReadTileChange at $81:A744 */
#define RET_6C1_DMA_A   0xA788   /* JSL AddProgrammedDMA at $81:A785 */
#define RET_6C1_DMA_B   0xA7B7   /* ... at $81:A7B4 */

/* col or row: wrap at 32 */
static uint16_t screen_part(uint16_t v) { return v >= 0x20 ? (uint16_t)(v - 0x20) : v; }
static bool second_screen(uint16_t v) { return (v >= 0x10 && v < 0x20) || v >= 0x30; }

static void queue_half(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t channel, uint16_t row_x, uint16_t ret)
{
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = channel;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS) = BBAD_VRAM;             /* VRAM */
  r->y = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS);
  r->x = (uint16_t)((row_x << 5) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, QUEUE_VRAM));
  r->a = 0x0080;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x80);
  hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

void hm_QueueTileGraphicsDMA(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  push16(ram, r, r->a);                                  /* PHA */
  uint16_t col = (uint16_t)(r->x >> 4), row = (uint16_t)(r->y >> 4);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, QUEUE_COL, col);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, QUEUE_ROW, row);
  uint16_t vram = (uint16_t)(VRAM_TILEMAP + (screen_part(col) << 1));
  if (second_screen(col)) vram = (uint16_t)(vram + 0x03E0);
  vram = (uint16_t)(vram + (screen_part(row) << 6));
  if (second_screen(row)) vram = (uint16_t)(vram + 0x0400);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, QUEUE_VRAM, vram);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR, (uint16_t)TILE_GRAPHICS); hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ROW_SOURCE, (uint16_t)TILE_GRAPHICS);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOURCE_BANK) = 0xA6; *hm_dp(ram, r, ROW_SOURCE_BANK) = 0xA6;

  r->a = pull16(ram, r);                                 /* PLA */
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_6C1_CHANGES, 0x81);
  hm_ReadTileChange(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);

  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS) << 2));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CHANGE_ROWS, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_ROWS) << 1));
  uint16_t src = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_GFX));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR, src); hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ROW_SOURCE, src);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, FIRST_CHANNEL) = 2;

  uint16_t x = 0;
  do {
    push16(ram, r, x);                                   /* PHX */
    queue_half(ram, r, *hm_dp(ram, r, FIRST_CHANNEL), x, RET_6C1_DMA_A);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR) + 0x40));
    x = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);                  /* PLX; INX; PHX */
    push16(ram, r, x);
    queue_half(ram, r, (uint8_t)(*hm_dp(ram, r, FIRST_CHANNEL) + 1), x, RET_6C1_DMA_B);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, ROW_SOURCE) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ROW_SOURCE, r->a); hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE_PTR, r->a);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, FIRST_CHANNEL) = 0;
    x = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);                  /* PLX; INX */
  } while (x != hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_ROWS));
  r->x = x;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ChangeMapTile ($81:A688, JSL, RTL; CODE_81A688 in HM-Decomp). A = tile
 * change (0 = nothing), X/Y = position in pixels. Does all of it: queues
 * the VRAM copy, writes the BG1 tilemap in WRAM, and, if the change has a
 * tile type, writes it into $09B6 for the whole block.
 * Leftovers: $86/$88 = columns / rows; registers from SetTileTypeBlock when it
 * runs, otherwise A = 0, X/Y = the position and C from ReadTileChange.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_688_QUEUE   0xA698   /* JSL QueueTileGraphicsDMA at $81:A695 */
#define RET_688_BG1     0xA6A4   /* JSL DrawTileChange at $81:A6A1 */
#define RET_688_CHANGES 0xA6AB   /* JSL ReadTileChange at $81:A6A8 */
#define RET_688_TYPES   0xA6BF   /* JSL SetTileTypeBlock at $81:A6BC */

void hm_ChangeMapTile(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (r->a == 0) { r->c = 1; return; }                    /* CMP #0 */
  uint16_t change = r->a, x = r->x, y = r->y;
  push16(ram, r, y); push16(ram, r, x); push16(ram, r, change);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_688_QUEUE, 0x81);
  hm_QueueTileGraphicsDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r); pull16(ram, r); pull16(ram, r);
  push16(ram, r, y); push16(ram, r, x); push16(ram, r, change);
  r->a = change; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_688_BG1, 0x81);
  hm_DrawTileChange(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = pull16(ram, r);                                 /* PLA */
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_688_CHANGES, 0x81);
  hm_ReadTileChange(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->x = pull16(ram, r);                                 /* PLX; PLY */
  r->y = pull16(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, BLOCK_COLS, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, BLOCK_ROWS, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_ROWS));
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_TYPE);
  if (r->a == 0) return;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_688_TYPES, 0x82);
  hm_SetTileTypeBlock(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * StartMapAnimation ($81:A5E1, JSL, RTL; CODE_81A5E1 in HM-Decomp). A =
 * an entry of the table $81:B963 (3 bytes each: a long pointer to a map
 * animation script). Points $CF-$D1 at it and clears $0989 (the script's
 * wait counter); RunMapAnimation then plays it frame by frame (the magic
 * beans growing, for one).
 * Leftovers: $7E = A in; A = (high byte of the pointer word : bank),
 * X = 3 A + 2, C from the 3 A sum.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void hm_StartMapAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t n = r->a;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ANIM_ENTRY, n);
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(n << 1) + n;       /* ASL; CLC; ADC $7E */
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)sum;
  uint16_t word = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (MAP_ANIMATIONS + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, word);
  x = (uint16_t)(x + MAP_ANIM_BANK_AT);
  uint8_t bank = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (MAP_ANIMATIONS + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM_BANK) = bank;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((word & 0xFF00) | bank);
  r->x = x;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, ((uint32_t)r->db << 16) | ANIMATION_WAIT, 0);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * EditTileOnMap ($82:B03A, JSL, RTL). A (low byte) = a tile type, X / Y =
 * a position in pixels: writes the type into the current map ($09B6 +
 * GetTileIndex). Only the logic map changes, not the picture (that is
 * ChangeMapTile's job).
 * EditFarmTile ($82:B049): the same on the farm's own copy
 * ($7E:A4E6), first setting the width code $0181 = 4 (64 tiles).
 * Leftovers: those of GetTileIndex, with A's low byte = the type. The PHA
 * of the type stays on the stack.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_03A_INDEX   0xB041
#define RET_049_INDEX   0xB057

static uint16_t tile_index_keeping(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t type, uint16_t ret)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, type);                                /* PHA */
  push16(ram, r, ret);                                   /* JSR GetTileIndex */
  hm_GetTileIndex(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r);                                      /* PLA */
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | type);
  return r->x;
}

void hm_EditTileOnMap(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t type = (uint8_t)r->a;
  uint16_t x = tile_index_keeping(ram, r, type, RET_03A_INDEX);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, (((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + HM_MAP_TILES + x) & 0xFFFFFF, type);
}

void hm_EditFarmTile(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t type = (uint8_t)r->a;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, ((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + HM_MAP_WIDTH, 4);
  uint16_t x = tile_index_keeping(ram, r, type, RET_049_INDEX);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_FARM_TILES) + x) & 0xFFFFFF, type);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DrawWholeMap ($82:AF00, JSL, RTL): draw the whole map (64 x 64 tiles of
 * 16 pixels) from its tile types ($09B6). For each tile type t (1-$9F):
 * the drawing is byte +0 of its entry in the property table [$0D] (0:
 * nothing to draw). The types $73-$79 join with their neighbours of the
 * same kind ("autotiling", fences and the like): the four neighbours give
 * a mask (left 8, right 2, up 4, down 1) and DATA8_82B02A[mask] - 1 is
 * added to the drawing. Each tile is drawn with DrawTileChange.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static uint8_t tile_at(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t x)
{
  return hm_bus_rd8(ram, (((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + HM_MAP_TILES + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
}
static bool joins(HmRegs *r, uint8_t t)                    /* CMP #$73; CMP #$7A */
{
  r->c = t >= 0x73;
  if (!r->c) return false;
  r->c = t >= 0x7A;
  return !r->c;
}

void hm_DrawWholeMap(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  for (uint16_t y = 0; y != 0x0400; ) {
    for (uint16_t x = 0; x != 0x0400; ) {
      push16(ram, r, y);                                   /* PHY; PHX */
      push16(ram, r, x);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TILE_X, x);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TILE_Y, y);
      r->x = x; r->y = y;
      push16(ram, r, 0xAF10);                              /* JSR GetTileIndex */
      hm_GetTileIndex(ram, r);
      pull16(ram, r);
      uint16_t at = r->x;
      uint8_t t = tile_at(ram, r, at);
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | t);
      bool draw = false;
      uint8_t pic = 0;
      if (t != 0) {
        r->c = t >= 0xA0;
        if (!r->c) {
          bool fence = joins(r, t);
          if (fence) {
            uint16_t mask = 0;
            static const struct { int16_t d; uint16_t bit; } N[4] = {
              { -1, 8 }, { 1, 2 }, { -0x40, 4 }, { 0x40, 1 } };
            hm_dp_w16(ram, r, JOIN_MASK, 0);
            for (unsigned k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
              push16(ram, r, at);                          /* PHX ... PLX */
              uint16_t nx = (uint16_t)(at + N[k].d);
              r->c = N[k].d < 0 ? at >= (uint16_t)-N[k].d : (uint32_t)at + N[k].d > 0xFFFF;
              r->x = nx;
              uint8_t nt = tile_at(ram, r, nx);
              r->a = (uint16_t)((nx & 0xFF00) | nt);
              pull16(ram, r);
              r->x = at;
              if (joins(r, nt)) {
                mask |= N[k].bit;
                r->a = mask;
                hm_dp_w16(ram, r, JOIN_MASK, mask);
              }
            }
            push16(ram, r, at);                            /* PHX; LDA $86; TAX */
            r->x = mask;
            uint8_t join = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, JOINS + mask) - 1);
            *hm_dp(ram, r, JOIN_ADD) = join;
            pull16(ram, r);
            r->x = at;
            uint16_t yy = (uint16_t)(t << 2);              /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA; ASL; ASL */
            r->c = 0;
            r->y = yy;
            uint8_t base = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_TILE_PROPS, yy));
            uint16_t s = (uint16_t)(base + join);          /* CLC; ADC $94 (8 bits) */
            r->c = s > 0xFF;
            pic = (uint8_t)s;
            draw = true;
          } else {
            uint16_t yy = (uint16_t)(t << 2);
            r->c = 0;
            r->y = yy;
            pic = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_TILE_PROPS, yy));
            r->a = pic;
            draw = pic != 0;
          }
        }
      }
      if (draw) {
        r->a = pic;
        r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TILE_X);
        r->y = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TILE_Y);
        hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xB008, 0x81);
        hm_DrawTileChange(ram, r);
        hm_rtl(ram, r);
      }
      x = pull16(ram, r);                                  /* PLX; PLY */
      y = pull16(ram, r);
      x = (uint16_t)(x + 0x10);
      r->a = x;
      r->c = x >= 0x0400;
      r->x = x;
      r->y = y;
    }
    y = (uint16_t)(y + 0x10);
    r->a = y;
    r->c = y >= 0x0400;
    r->y = y;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SnowFootprints ($81:A58F, JSL, RTL): footprints in the snow. Called every 8
 * steps of the player with $0907 / $0909 = where the player was 8 steps
 * before. In winter, on the farm (maps 0-3) or the mountain ($10-$14), if
 * that tile's type is 1, 2, $A8 or $F6 (snow), the picture of change $11
 * is queued for the VRAM there (QueueTileGraphicsDMA): only the screen
 * changes, not the map, so the prints are gone when the map is loaded
 * again. Leftovers: A, X, Y, C from the last compare or call.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void hm_SnowFootprints(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | season);
  r->c = season >= 3;
  if (season != 3) return;                                 /* not winter */
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | map);
  r->c = map >= 4;
  if (map >= 4) {
    r->c = map >= 0x10;
    if (map < 0x10) return;
    r->c = map >= 0x15;
    if (map >= 0x15) return;
  }
  uint32_t db = (uint32_t)r->db << 16;
  r->a = 0;
  r->x = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db | HM_FOOTPRINT_X);
  r->y = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db | HM_FOOTPRINT_Y);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xA5B7, 0x82);
  hm_GetTileProperty(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = r->x;                                             /* TXA */
  static const uint16_t snow[4] = { 0x0001, 0x0002, 0x00A8, 0x00F6 };
  bool on_snow = false;
  for (int i = 0; i < 4 && !on_snow; i++) {
    r->c = r->a >= snow[i];
    on_snow = r->a == snow[i];
  }
  if (!on_snow) return;
  r->a = 0x0011;
  r->x = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db | HM_FOOTPRINT_X);
  r->y = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db | HM_FOOTPRINT_Y);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xA5DF, 0x81);
  hm_QueueTileGraphicsDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * RunMapAnimation ($81:A600, JSL, RTL): plays the map animation started by
 * StartMapAnimation, one step per call: [$CF-$D1] points at 7-byte steps
 * (tile change, X, Y words, then frames to wait); each is done with
 * ChangeMapTile and $0989 counts the wait down. $FFFF ends it ($CF-$D1 =
 * 0), $FFFE jumps to the long pointer that follows (whose first step is
 * done at once, unchecked).
 * Leftovers: A, X, Y from the last step, C from its add (or a compare).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

void hm_RunMapAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint32_t wait = (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | ANIMATION_WAIT;
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM);
  if (!r->a) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM_BANK));
    if (!(r->a & 0xFF)) return;                            /* no animation */
  }
  uint8_t w = hm_bus_rd8(ram, wait);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | w);
  if (w) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, wait, (uint8_t)(w - 1)); return; }
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, STEP_CHANGE));
  r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF;
  if (r->a == 0xFFFF) {                                    /* the end */
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, 0);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM_BANK) = 0;
    return;
  }
  r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFE;
  if (r->a == 0xFFFE) {                                    /* jump */
    r->y = JUMP_ADDR;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, JUMP_PTR, hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, JUMP_ADDR)));
    r->y = JUMP_BANK;
    uint8_t bank = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, JUMP_BANK));
    *hm_dp(ram, r, JUMP_PTR_BANK) = bank;
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, JUMP_PTR);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, r->a);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | bank);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM_BANK) = bank;
  }
  uint16_t change = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, STEP_CHANGE));
  push16(ram, r, change);
  uint16_t x = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, STEP_X));
  push16(ram, r, x);
  uint16_t y = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, STEP_Y));
  push16(ram, r, y);
  uint8_t frames = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, STEP_FRAMES));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, wait, frames);
  r->y = pull16(ram, r); r->x = pull16(ram, r); r->a = pull16(ram, r);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xA64C, 0x81);
  hm_ChangeMapTile(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  uint32_t next = (uint32_t)hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM) + STEP_BYTES;
  r->c = next > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)next;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM, r->a);
}

/* FreeMapObject ($81:A4F1, JSL, RTL): frees the map object at [$07] (its
 * flags = 0) and clears $0974 (its flags' copy). A's low byte = 0. */
void hm_FreeMapObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->y = 0;
  r->a &= 0xFF00;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, 0), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_ITEM_FLAGS, 0);
}

```

`src/mapevents.c`:

```c
/*
 * mapevents.c — who appears when a map is entered.
 *
 * StartMapEvents ($83:CA98) calls, for the map being entered ($22),
 * its routine from UNK_TableFunctionSelect ($83:CAA9, one word per map).
 * Each routine starts the event scripts of the people and things of that
 * map, depending on the date, the time and the story flags, with
 * StartEventScriptLong (A = the slot, X = the script group, Y = the script).
 *
 * Flags seen so far (16-bit words in $7F:1F64-$7F:1F74):
 *   $7F1F66  bits 0-4: one per girl (Maria, Ann, Nina, Ellen, Eve: which
 *            one the player married, see the houses)
 *   $7F1F6E  bit 1: a story flag about the wife (it moves her between her
 *            parents' house and the farm); bits 2 / 3: first / second
 *            child
 *   $7F1F68, $7F1F6A, $7F1F74: events seen
 *
 * All the routines here are JSR / RTS, entered with 16-bit A, X and Y.
 * Leftovers: those of the last StartEventScriptLong, or of the last test.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* Direct page */
#define SHUFFLE_7E        0x7E   /* 16b: festival_order clears it (not read there) */
#define SHUFFLE_PLACE     0x84   /* 16b: festival_order: the place being swapped */
#define SHUFFLE_OTHER     0x86   /* 16b: and the random place it is swapped with */
#define SHUFFLE_HERE      0x95   /* 8b: and the byte that was at SHUFFLE_PLACE */
#define BUG_DP_60         0x60   /* 16b: where the town's bug stores HM_FLAGS_60 (STA.B $60,
                                    meant to be STA.L $7F1F60) */

/* WRAM of the data bank (through db) */
#define UNKNOWN_09A2      0x09A2 /* 8b: cleared with the festival's shuffle (not traced) */
#define MOST_HEARTS       0x09B3 /* 16b: the most hearts of the five girls (the ending) */

/* LDA #a; LDX #x; LDY #y; JSL StartEventScriptLong at $83:`at` */
static void spawn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = a; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), 0x84);
  hm_StartEventScriptLong(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* LDA.L addr; AND #mask (16 bits): true if any of the bits is set */
static bool flag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t mask)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, addr) & mask);
  return r->a != 0;
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA.L addr; CMP #v: true if equal */
static bool byte_is(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint8_t v)
{
  uint8_t b = hm_bus_rd8(ram, addr);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | b);
  r->c = b >= v;
  return b == v;
}
/* LDA.L addr; CMP #v (16 bits): true if at least v */
static bool word_at_least(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t v)
{
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, addr);
  r->c = r->a >= v;
  return r->c;
}

static uint32_t db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
/* SEP #$20; LDA addr; CMP #v: true if below v */
static bool byte_below(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint8_t v)
{
  uint8_t b = hm_bus_rd8(ram, addr);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | b);
  r->c = b >= v;
  return !r->c;
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA addr (no compare): the byte */
static uint8_t byte_of(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr)
{
  uint8_t b = hm_bus_rd8(ram, addr);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | b);
  return b;
}
/* the married girl's own house: if the player married her ($7F1F66 bit)
 * and $7F1F6E bit 1 is set, only her script (group $22) */
static bool married_here(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t girl)
{
  return flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), girl) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0002);
}
/* winter 10 before 5 pm (season 3, day 10, hour < 17) */
static bool winter_10_morning(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  return byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 3) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x0A) && byte_below(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), 0x11);
}

/* ── one script, always ─────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_MapEvent_E5A2_Map2C(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { spawn(ram, r, 0x0000, 0x0014, 0x0002, 0xE5AF); }
void hm_MapEvent_E5CD_Maps2Dto30(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { spawn(ram, r, 0x0000, 0x001E, 0x0000, 0xE5DA); }
void hm_MapEvent_FlowerFestival(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { spawn(ram, r, 0x0000, 0x000E, 0x0001, 0xE5EC); }
void hm_MapEvent_HarvestFestival(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { spawn(ram, r, 0x0000, 0x0026, 0x0001, 0xE5FE); }
void hm_MapEvent_E6B2_Festival0B(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { spawn(ram, r, 0x0000, 0x0028, 0x0003, 0xE6BF); }
/* E74C: nothing (most of the maps from $3B on) */
void hm_MapEvent_Nothing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { (void)ram; (void)r; }

/* ── one script, if a flag is set ───────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0200)) spawn(ram, r, 0x0000, 0x0014, 0x0001, 0xE59C);
}
void hm_MapEvent_Coop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x4000)) spawn(ram, r, 0x0015, 0x0000, 0x007F, 0xE5C8);
}

/* ── winter 24 (the Starry Night), if the flag of $7F1F74 is set ───── */
static void winter_24(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t mask, uint16_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  if (!byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 3)) return;
  if (!byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x18)) return;
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74), mask)) spawn(ram, r, 0x0000, 0x000F, y, at);
}
void hm_MapEvent_StarryNightMap0A(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { winter_24(ram, r, 0x0001, 0x0001, 0xE62D); }
void hm_MapEvent_StarryNightMap39(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { winter_24(ram, r, 0x0008, 0x0004, 0xE65C); }
void hm_MapEvent_StarryNightMap14(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { winter_24(ram, r, 0x0010, 0x0005, 0xE68B); }

/* E690: spring 1 (the new year) */
void hm_MapEvent_NewYear(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | season);
  if (season) return;
  if (byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 1)) spawn(ram, r, 0x0000, 0x0028, 0x0001, 0xE6AD);
}

/* ── the family at home: the wife (by who she is) and the children ──── */
void hm_MapEvent_ToolShedFamily(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0002)) {
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0002))      spawn(ram, r, 0x0013, 0x0044, 0x0001, 0xE6EE);
    else if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0010)) spawn(ram, r, 0x0013, 0x0044, 0x0004, 0xE6FF);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0004) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_KID1_AGE), 0x003C))
    spawn(ram, r, 0x0014, 0x0045, 0x0002, 0xE724);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0008) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_KID2_AGE), 0x003C))
    spawn(ram, r, 0x0015, 0x0045, 0x0005, 0xE747);
}

/* ── the girls' houses ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Each person has a script in several groups, one per kind of day:
 *   $0B before the first event of the story ($7F1F68 bit 0)
 *   $07 with $0196 bit 3      $06 rain (tomorrow's weather 3) or
 *   $08 with $0196 bit 9          $7F1F64 bit 5
 *   $04 with $0196 bit 1      $02 / $03 Saturday / Sunday (weekday 6 / 0)
 *   $01 any other day (also a weather of 6 or more, the special days)
 *   $27 winter 10 before 5 pm $0F winter 24 (with the $7F1F74 bit)
 * and the married girl ($22) when she is at her parents' house.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/* D4FF, the first house (the script of each group is 1, or 0 / 3) */
static void house_D4FF(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (winter_10_morning(ram, r)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x27, 3, 0xD526); return; }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0B, 1, 0xD541); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0008)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 7, 0, 0xD5C2); return; }
  if (!byte_below(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW), 6)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, 1, 0xD592); return; }
  if (byte_is(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW), 3)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 6, 0, 0xD5D2); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0020)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 6, 0, 0xD5D2); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0200)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 8, 0, 0xD5E2); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0002)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 4, 0, 0xD5B2); return; }
  if (byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY), 6)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 2, 1, 0xD5A2); return; }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, 1, 0xD592);
}
void hm_MapEvent_MariaHouse1(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (married_here(ram, r, 0x0001)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x22, 3, 0xD4FA);
  else house_D4FF(ram, r);
}
void hm_MapEvent_MariaHouse2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (married_here(ram, r, 0x0001)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x22, 4, 0xD60E);
  else house_D4FF(ram, r);
}

/* D613: winter 10, winter 24, then as the others (script 2, or 1 / 12),
 * Sunday too (group 3). It tests $7F1F68 bit 0 a second time (nobody if
 * clear), which can never fail: without it the first test returned. */
void hm_MapEvent_Church(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (winter_10_morning(ram, r)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x27, 2, 0xD63A); return; }
  if (byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 3) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x18) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74), 0x0002)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0F, 2, 0xD669);
    return;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0B, 0x0C, 0xD684); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0008)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 7, 1, 0xD729); return; }
  if (!byte_below(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW), 6)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, 2, 0xD6E9); return; }
  if (byte_is(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW), 3)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 6, 1, 0xD739); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0020)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 6, 1, 0xD739); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0200)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 8, 1, 0xD749); return; }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) return;
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0002)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 4, 1, 0xD719); return; }
  uint8_t day = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY));
  if (day == 0) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 3, 1, 0xD6F9); return; }
  r->c = day >= 6;
  if (day == 6) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 2, 2, 0xD709); return; }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, 2, 0xD6E9);
}

/* The usual day of a person without other cases: the script and the JSL
 * address of each group: $0B (before the first event), 7, 1 (also a
 * weather of 6 or more), 6 (rain), 8, 4. */
typedef struct { uint8_t s0B, s07, s01, s06, s08, s04; uint16_t at0B, at07, at01, at06, at08, at04; } Day;

static void usual_day(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Day *d)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0B, d->s0B, d->at0B); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0008)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 7, d->s07, d->at07); return; }
  if (!byte_below(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW), 6)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, d->s01, d->at01); return; }
  if (byte_is(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW), 3) || flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0020)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 6, d->s06, d->at06);
    return;
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0200)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 8, d->s08, d->at08); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0002)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 4, d->s04, d->at04); return; }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, d->s01, d->at01);
}

/* D776, the second girl's house (script 3, or 2) */
static void house_D776(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Day d = { 3, 2, 3, 2, 2, 2, 0xD78C, 0xD7F3, 0xD7D3, 0xD803, 0xD813, 0xD7E3 };
  usual_day(ram, r, &d);
}
void hm_MapEvent_NinaFlowerShop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (married_here(ram, r, 0x0004)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x22, 7, 0xD771);
  else house_D776(ram, r);
}

{
  if (married_here(ram, r, 0x0004)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x22, 8, 0xD83F);
  else house_D776(ram, r);
}

/* D86C, the third girl's house: $7F1F5E bit 4 first (group $1A) */
static void house_D86C(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Day d = { 2, 3, 4, 3, 3, 3, 0xD89D, 0xD904, 0xD8E4, 0xD914, 0xD924, 0xD8F4 };
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), 0x0010)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x1A, 1, 0xD882); return; }
  usual_day(ram, r, &d);
}
void hm_MapEvent_AnnGeneralStore(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)

/* D97D, the fourth girl's house */
static void house_D97D(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Day d = { 4, 4, 5, 4, 4, 4, 0xD993, 0xD9FA, 0xD9DA, 0xDA0A, 0xDA1A, 0xD9EA };
  usual_day(ram, r, &d);
}
void hm_MapEvent_EllenHouse1(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)

/* DA4B, DAED: two more people with a usual day */
void hm_MapEvent_DA4B_Map25Person(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Day d = { 5, 5, 6, 5, 5, 5, 0xDA61, 0xDAC8, 0xDAA8, 0xDAD8, 0xDAE8, 0xDAB8 };
```
