```c
/* LDA.L $7F1F68; ORA #bit; STA.L: an event seen */
static void seen(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68)) | bit);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), r->a);
}

/* DBB7, the fifth girl's house: winter 24; the first visit (group $0B,
 * then $7F1F68 bit 1); otherwise group 5 */
static void house_DBB7(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 3) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x18) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_74), 0x0004)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0F, 3, 0xDBE1);
    return;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0002)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0B, 7, 0xDBFC);
    seen(ram, r, 0x0002);
    return;
  }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 5, 0, 0xDC19);
}
void hm_MapEvent_EveHouse1(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (married_here(ram, r, 0x0010)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x22, 0x0B, 0xDBB2);
  else house_DBB7(ram, r);
}
void hm_MapEvent_EveHouse2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (married_here(ram, r, 0x0010)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x22, 0x0C, 0xDC45);
  else house_DBB7(ram, r);
}

/* DC4A: the first visit (group $0B, $7F1F68 bit 2); $7F1F5E bit 5 or
 * $7F1F6C bit 4 (group $1D); with $7F1F6C bit 2 a second person in slot
 * 9 (group $1C, script 1, or 2 with $7F1F5E bit 3, and then nobody
 * else); from year 2, in fall and winter, on some days (2-7, 13-17,
 * 25-28) of an ordinary weekday the slot-9 person of group $21; then the
 * usual one (none on the special days of $0196 bits 1 / 3 / 9; Sunday
 * group 3, Saturday group 2, else group 1). */
void hm_MapEvent_Mountain(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0004)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0B, 9, 0xDC60);
    seen(ram, r, 0x0004);
    return;
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), 0x0020)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x1D, 3, 0xDC88); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x0010)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x1D, 1, 0xDCA3); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x0004)) {
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), 0x0008)) { spawn(ram, r, 9, 0x1C, 2, 0xDCD8); return; }
    spawn(ram, r, 9, 0x1C, 1, 0xDCC7);
  } else {
    bool visit = false;
    if (byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)) && !byte_below(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 2)) {
      uint8_t day = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY));
      r->c = day >= 1;
      if (day != 1) {
        static const uint8_t bounds[] = { 0x08, 0x0D, 0x12, 0x19, 0x1D };
        for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
          r->c = day >= bounds[i];
          if (!r->c) { visit = !(i & 1); break; }
        }
      }
    }
    if (visit && !flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x001A) && !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0200)) {
      uint8_t wd = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY));
      if (wd != 0) {
        r->c = wd >= 6;
        if (wd != 6) spawn(ram, r, 9, 0x21, 0, 0xDD39);
      }
    }
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0008)) return;
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0200)) return;
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0002)) return;
  uint8_t wd = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY));
  if (wd == 0) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 3, 2, 0xDD80); return; }
  r->c = wd >= 6;
  if (wd == 6) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 2, 3, 0xDD90); return; }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, 8, 0xDD70);
}

/* DD95: with $7F1F6A bit 12 but not 13, only group $19; the first visit
 * (group $0B, only in the first spring and summer before the 26th; the
 * visit is marked as seen anyway); then the usual day of script 9 / 7 */
void hm_MapEvent_DD95_Map2BPerson(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x2000) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x1000)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x19, 1, 0xDDB4);
    return;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0008)) {
    bool first = false;
    if (!byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR))) {
      uint8_t season = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
      r->c = season >= 2;
      if (!r->c) {
        r->c = season >= 0;
        if (season == 0) first = true;
        else first = byte_below(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x1A);
      }
    }
    if (first) {
      spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0B, 0x0A, 0xDDEB);
      seen(ram, r, 0x0008);
      return;
    }
    seen(ram, r, 0x0008);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0008)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 7, 7, 0xDE4F); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0200)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 8, 7, 0xDE5F); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0002)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 4, 7, 0xDE3F); return; }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, 9, 0xDE2F);
}

/* DE64: group $15 until $7F1F68 bit 13; then with $7F1F64 bit 1 group 1 */
void hm_MapEvent_ElfTunnel(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x2000)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x15, 0, 0xDE7A); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0002)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, 0x0A, 0xDE95);
}

/* DE9B: with $7F1F64 bit 3, a scene (slot $15, script $25 of group 0)
 * that stops the player: $096E = $45, $D2 |= $40, action 0. */
void hm_MapEvent_Barn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0008)) return;
  spawn(ram, r, 0x15, 0, 0x25, 0xDEB1);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x45);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_INTERACTION), 0x45);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES), 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0040);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
}

/* E407, maps $0C-$0F (the crossroads): $7F1F5C bit 7 off and slot $15's script $15;
 * then the first time (group $0A, $7F1F68 bit 4; while $7F1F68 bit 0 is
 * clear, group $0B after that); from the first winter (or year 2) on, a
 * visit of group $0D (first script 0, $7F1F68 bit 6 and $099F = 4; then
 * script 1, until $7F1F68 bit 8, which also clears $7F1F31). */
void hm_MapEvent_Crossroads(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & 0xFF7F);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), r->a);
  spawn(ram, r, 0x15, 0, 0x15, 0xE41F);
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) {
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0010)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0B, 0x0B, 0xE45F); return; }
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0A, 1, 0xE442);
    seen(ram, r, 0x0010);
    return;
  }
  if (!byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)) && !byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 3)) return;
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0040)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0D, 0, 0xE48E);
    seen(ram, r, 0x0040);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x04);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_NAME_FOR), 0x04);
    return;
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0100)) return;
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0D, 1, 0xE4BD);
  r->a &= 0xFF00;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HORSE_MAP), 0);
}

/* E4CB, map $29: until $7F1F6A bit 6, a script at the tile (224, 384)
 * (StartScriptAtTileInFront: slot $10, script $1F). Coming from below ($D8 >= $200)
 * with $D2 bit 11: the bit off and the
 * dog placed on this season's farm at (120, 424), the player's animation
 * = his direction. Then group $1D with $7F1F6C bit 4, group $1B with bit
 * 0, or on Saturday group 2. */
void hm_MapEvent_MountainCave(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0040)) {
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X), 0x00E0);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y), 0x0180);
    r->a = 0x0010; r->x = 0; r->y = 0x001F;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xE4EE, 0x84);
    hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y);
  r->c = r->a >= 0x0200;
  if (r->c) {
    uint16_t state = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE);
    r->a = state & 0x0800;
    if (r->a) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(state & 0xF7FF);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
      uint8_t season = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_MAP), season);
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_X), 0x0078);
      r->a = 0x01A8;
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_Y), 0x01A8);
      r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);       /* LDA #0; CLC; ADC */
      r->c = 0;
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST), r->a);
    }
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x0010)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x1D, 2, 0xE54B); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x0001)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x1B, 1, 0xE566); return; }
  if (byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY), 6)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 2, 4, 0xE580);
}

/* ── D2E0, the town (maps 4-7) ──────────────────────────────────────────
 *   - with $7F1F60 bit 10, group $14 script 3 (and the bit was meant to be
 *     cleared: see the bug);
 *   - fall 20 before 3 pm: slot $15's script $7E, the numbers 0-5 (and two
 *     0s) at $09A4-$09AB shuffled, $09A2 = 0, and group $28 script 2;
 *   - spring 23 before 3 pm group $0E; fall 12 before 3 pm group $26;
 *     winter 10 before 5 pm group $27;
 *   - otherwise slot $15's script $7E until $7F1F6A bit 14, and the usual
 *     day of script 0 (nobody on the special days of $0196 bits 1 / 3 / 9
 *     and on rain).
 * Bug: the code clears bit 10 of $7F1F60 into the direct page ($60, STA.B)
 * instead of $7F1F60 (STA.L), so the flag stays set and this happens
 * every time the town is entered.
 * The shuffle: for each of the first 7 places, swap it with a random one
 * of 9 (RNGReturn0toA(8): 0-7, so places $09AB too).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void festival_order(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SHUFFLE_7E, 0);
  static const uint8_t start[8] = { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 0, 0 };
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, (uint16_t)(HM_FENCE_PIECES + i)), start[i]);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0);
  for (uint16_t y = 0; y != 7; y++) {
    hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(y >> 8)); hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)y);   /* PHY */
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SHUFFLE_PLACE, y);
    uint8_t here = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, (uint16_t)(HM_FENCE_PIECES + y)));
    *hm_dp(ram, r, SHUFFLE_HERE) = here;
    r->x = y;
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 8);
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD37D, 0x80);
    hm_RNGReturn0toA(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    uint16_t other = (uint8_t)r->a;                       /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA */
    r->x = other;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SHUFFLE_OTHER, other);
    uint8_t there = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, (uint16_t)(HM_FENCE_PIECES + other)));
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, (uint16_t)(HM_FENCE_PIECES + y)), there);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, (uint16_t)(HM_FENCE_PIECES + other)), here);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((other & 0xFF00) | here);
    uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);                       /* PLY */
    r->y = (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
    r->c = (uint16_t)(y + 1) >= 7;
  }
  r->y = 7;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, UNKNOWN_09A2), 0);
}

/* SEP #$20; season, day, hour below: a festival morning */
static bool date_before(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t season, uint8_t day, uint8_t hour)
{
  if (season == 0) {
    uint8_t s = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));   /* LDA; BNE */
    if (s) return false;
  } else if (!byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), season)) return false;
  return byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), day) && byte_below(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), hour);
}

void hm_MapEvent_Town(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), 0x0400)) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0xFBFF);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, BUG_DP_60, r->a);                  /* STA.B $60: the bug */
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x14, 3, 0xD2FF);
    return;
  }
  if (date_before(ram, r, 2, 0x14, 0x0F)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0x15, 0, 0x7E, 0xD334);
    festival_order(ram, r);
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x28, 2, 0xD3B3);
    return;
  }
  if (date_before(ram, r, 0, 0x17, 0x0F)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0E, 0, 0xD3DD); return; }
  if (date_before(ram, r, 2, 0x0C, 0x0F)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x26, 0, 0xD409); return; }
  if (date_before(ram, r, 3, 0x0A, 0x11)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x27, 0, 0xD435); return; }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x4000)) spawn(ram, r, 0x15, 0, 0x7E, 0xD44E);
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0B, 0, 0xD468); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0008)) return;
  if (byte_is(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW), 3)) return;
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0020)) return;
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0200)) return;
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0002)) return;
  uint8_t wd = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY));
  if (wd == 0) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 3, 0, 0xD4C2); return; }
  r->c = wd >= 6;
  if (wd == 6) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 2, 0, 0xD4D2); return; }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 1, 0, 0xD4B2);
}

/* ── E76D, map $3C: the days of the introduction ────────────────────────
 * (HM-Decomp has its first $140 bytes as data; disassembled from the ROM.)
 * The player wakes up: 7:00 ($7F1F1C-$7F1F1E = 7, 0, 0), $0915 = 0, the
 * state $D2 = 1 (bit 1 off), action 0, facing 0, $0911 = $0901 = 0, the
 * clock stopped ($0973 = 0), nothing in hand ($091D), stamina full ($0918
 * = $0917), $0925 = 0. Then the step $7F1F49 (0-$1C) says which script of
 * group $47 runs (the step + 1), and the step goes one up; from $1D on,
 * nothing. Steps 7 and $0D also fill the shed ($3D, 0, $12, 0 and $0D, $64,
 * $12, 0) and empty the hands of tools.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* waking up at `hour`:00 with full stamina, standing, facing down, the
 * clock stopped, nothing in hand ($D2 = 1) */
static void wake_up(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t hour)
{
  const uint8_t clock[3] = { hour, 0, 0 };
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR) + i, clock[i]);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_PLAYER_TIMER), 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  uint8_t max = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, HM_MAX_STAMINA));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_CURRENT_STAMINA), max);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_IDLE_TIMER), 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, 0x0001);                /* LDA $D2; ORA #1 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, 0);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_PLAYER_TURN), 0);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_TIME_RUNNING), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND), 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(0xFFFD & hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}

void hm_MapEvent_IntroDays(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wake_up(ram, r, 7);

  uint8_t step = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_INTRO_STEP));
  if (step) r->c = 1;                         /* the CMP chain ends on an equal or above */
  if (step >= 0x1D) return;
  /* each step's code: 24 bytes from $E8AD, 56 for steps 7 and $0D */
  uint16_t at = (uint16_t)(0xE8AD + 0x18 * step);
  if (step > 7) at = (uint16_t)(at + 0x20);
  if (step > 0x0D) at = (uint16_t)(at + 0x20);
  if (step == 7 || step == 0x0D) {
    static const uint8_t shed[2][4] = { { 0x3D, 0x00, 0x12, 0x00 }, { 0x0D, 0x64, 0x12, 0x00 } };
    const uint8_t *s = shed[step == 0x0D];
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + i, s[i]);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | s[3]);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED), 0);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK), 0);
    at = (uint16_t)(at + 0x20);
  }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x47, (uint16_t)(step + 1), (uint16_t)(at + 0x0B));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)(step + 1));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_INTRO_STEP), (uint8_t)(step + 1));
}

/* ── EBA6, maps $3D and $4B: the ending ─────────────────────────────────
 * The player wakes at 6:00 (as in the introduction) and the step
 * $7F1F47 says which part of the ending's slide show comes next. Each part
 * is shown only if it applies; if not, the next one is tried:
 *   0  no wife, happiness below 100, no cows and no chickens: the bad
 *      ending (group $2F; next step $14)
 *   1  $7F1F5E bit 15 on; 7 cows or more ($30)   2  1-6 cows ($31)
 *   3  chickens ($32)   4  the festival cow's affection ($09B5) $C0+ ($33)
 *   5-8  200 or more corn, tomatoes, turnips, potatoes shipped ($34, $35,
 *      $37, $36)
 *   9 / $0A  no wife and happiness 100+ / 800+ ($38, $39)
 *   $0B-$0F  married to Maria, Ann, Nina, Ellen, Eve (groups $3A-$3E: two
 *      scripts for the first four, steps $21-$24 show the second)
 *   $10  no wife, happiness 200+ and the five girls' hearts adding up to
 *      1500+ ($3F)
 *   $11 a child ($40)   $12 two children ($41)
 *   $13  everything: two children, happiness 900+, cows and chickens, the
 *      10 power berries, 10,000 G (money is kept in tens) and 100 hugs of
 *      the dog ($42; $7F1F5E bit 15 off)
 *   $14  the girl with the most hearts ($09B3, the first on a tie) and the
 *      credits (group $46, scripts 0-7; $7F1F5E bit 15 on, off at the end)
 *   $20  the ranch score (RanchMasteryCalculator, which shows script $0C)
 * Steps $1C-$1F (scripts 8-$0B) follow each other, but nothing here leads
 * to them (step $1B goes on to $20).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* spawn, then SEP #$20; LDA #next; STA.L $7F1F47 */
static void part(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t at, uint8_t next)
{
  spawn(ram, r, 0, x, y, at);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | next);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_ENDING_STEP), next);
}
static void flags_5e(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, bool on)
{
  uint16_t v = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E));
  r->a = on ? (uint16_t)(v | 0x8000) : (uint16_t)(v & 0x7FFF);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), r->a);
}
static bool no_wife(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { return !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x001F); }
static bool shipped(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr) { return word_at_least(ram, r, addr, 200); }

void hm_MapEvent_EndingSlideShow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wake_up(ram, r, 6);
  uint8_t step = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_ENDING_STEP));
  if (step) r->c = 1;                         /* the CMP chain ends on an equal or above */
  switch (step) {
  case 0x00:
    if (no_wife(ram, r) && !word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HAPPINESS), 100) &&
        !byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N)) && !byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N))) {
      part(ram, r, 0x2F, 0, 0xED4D, 0x14);
      return;
    }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x01:
    flags_5e(ram, r, true);
    if (!byte_below(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N), 7)) { part(ram, r, 0x30, 0, 0xED7E, 0x02); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x02: {
    uint8_t cows = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N));
    if (cows && byte_below(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N), 7)) { part(ram, r, 0x31, 0, 0xEDA4, 0x03); return; }
  } /* fall through */
  case 0x03:
    if (byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N))) { part(ram, r, 0x32, 0, 0xEDC6, 0x04); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x04:
    if (!byte_below(ram, r, db(r, HM_FESTIVAL_BEST), 0xC0)) { part(ram, r, 0x33, 0, 0xEDE9, 0x05); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x05:
    if (shipped(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPED_CORN))) { part(ram, r, 0x34, 0, 0xEE0C, 0x06); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x06:
    if (shipped(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPED_TOMATOES))) { part(ram, r, 0x35, 0, 0xEE2F, 0x07); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x07:
    if (shipped(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPED_TURNIPS))) { part(ram, r, 0x37, 0, 0xEE52, 0x08); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x08:
    if (shipped(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPED_POTATOES))) { part(ram, r, 0x36, 0, 0xEE75, 0x09); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x09:
    if (no_wife(ram, r) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HAPPINESS), 100)) { part(ram, r, 0x38, 0, 0xEEA1, 0x0A); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x0A:
    if (no_wife(ram, r) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HAPPINESS), 800)) { part(ram, r, 0x39, 0, 0xEECD, 0x0B); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x0B:
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0001)) { part(ram, r, 0x3A, 0, 0xEEF0, 0x21); return; }
    goto girl_2;
  case 0x21:
    part(ram, r, 0x3A, 1, 0xEF08, 0x0C);
    return;
  case 0x0C:
  girl_2:
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0002)) { part(ram, r, 0x3B, 0, 0xEF2B, 0x22); return; }
    goto girl_3;
  case 0x22:
    part(ram, r, 0x3B, 1, 0xEF43, 0x0D);
    return;
  case 0x0D:
  girl_3:
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0004)) { part(ram, r, 0x3C, 0, 0xEF66, 0x23); return; }
    goto girl_4;
  case 0x23:
    part(ram, r, 0x3C, 1, 0xEF7E, 0x0E);
    return;
  case 0x0E:
  girl_4:
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0008)) { part(ram, r, 0x3D, 0, 0xEFA1, 0x24); return; }
    goto girl_5;
  case 0x24:
    part(ram, r, 0x3D, 1, 0xEFB9, 0x0F);
    return;
  case 0x0F:
  girl_5:
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0010)) { part(ram, r, 0x3E, 0, 0xEFDC, 0x10); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x10:
    if (no_wife(ram, r) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HAPPINESS), 200)) {
      uint32_t sum = 0;
      unsigned carry = 0;
      for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {                        /* CLC; ADC x 4 */
        sum = (sum & 0xFFFF) + hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 2 * i) + carry;
        carry = sum > 0xFFFF;
      }
      r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
      r->c = r->a >= 0x05DC;
      if (r->c) { part(ram, r, 0x3F, 0, 0xF022, 0x11); return; }
    }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x11:
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x000C)) { part(ram, r, 0x40, 0, 0xF045, 0x12); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x12:
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0008)) { part(ram, r, 0x41, 0, 0xF068, 0x13); return; }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x13:
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0008) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HAPPINESS), 900) &&
        byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N)) && byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N)) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_POWER_BERRIES), 10)) {
      uint32_t low = (uint32_t)hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_MONEY)) + 0xFC18; /* money - 1000 */
      r->c = low > 0xFFFF;
      uint32_t high = (uint32_t)hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_MONEY_HIGH)) + 0xFF + r->c;
      r->c = high > 0xFF;
      r->a = (uint16_t)((low & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)high);
      if (!(high & 0x80) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_HUGS), 100)) {
        part(ram, r, 0x42, 0, 0xF0C9, 0x14);
        flags_5e(ram, r, false);
        return;
      }
    }
    /* fall through */
  case 0x14: {
    uint16_t best = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE));
    r->a = best;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, MOST_HEARTS), best);
    for (int i = 1; i < 5; i++) {
      uint16_t h = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 2 * i);
      r->c = r->a >= h;                                      /* CMP.L; BCS */
      if (!r->c) { r->a = h; hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, MOST_HEARTS), h); }
    }
    part(ram, r, 0x46, 0, 0xF131, 0x15);
    flags_5e(ram, r, true);
    return;
  }
  case 0x15: part(ram, r, 0x46, 1, 0xF156, 0x16); return;
  case 0x16: part(ram, r, 0x46, 2, 0xF16E, 0x17); return;
  case 0x17: part(ram, r, 0x46, 3, 0xF186, 0x18); return;
  case 0x18: part(ram, r, 0x46, 4, 0xF19E, 0x19); return;
  case 0x19: part(ram, r, 0x46, 5, 0xF1B6, 0x1A); return;
  case 0x1A: part(ram, r, 0x46, 6, 0xF1CE, 0x1B); return;
  case 0x1B: part(ram, r, 0x46, 7, 0xF1E6, 0x20); flags_5e(ram, r, false); return;
  case 0x1C: part(ram, r, 0x46, 8, 0xF20B, 0x1D); return;
  case 0x1D: part(ram, r, 0x46, 9, 0xF223, 0x1E); return;
  case 0x1E: part(ram, r, 0x46, 0x0A, 0xF23B, 0x1F); return;
  case 0x1F: part(ram, r, 0x46, 0x0B, 0xF253, 0x20); flags_5e(ram, r, false); return;
  case 0x20: hm_RanchMasteryCalculator(ram, r); return;   /* JMP */
  default: return;                                        /* $25 (CODE_83F4D7) and up */
  }
}

/* ── CB69, the farm (maps 0-3) ──────────────────────────────────────────
 * In this order:
 *   - the wife at home (Maria, Nina or Ellen: group $44, unless $7F1F6E
 *     bit 1) and the children once 60 days old (as E6C4);
 *   - at 6:00:00 on a visitor day (2-7, 13-17, 25-28; not on the special
 *     days of $0196 bits 1 / 3 / 4) while still single, the first girl
 *     with 200+ hearts whose visit was not seen comes (groups $19-$1D;
 *     each marks her flag and blocks the later ones: Maria $7F1F6A bit
 *     12, Ann bit 14, Nina $7F1F6C bit 0, Ellen bit 2, Eve bit 4);
 *   - $7F1F5A bit 1: a scene (slot 7, script $20) that stops the player;
 *   - the first days: group $0A until the first event ($7F1F68 bit 0),
 *     then group $0C twice ($7F1F68 bits 5 and 7; the second also puts
 *     the dog at (120, 424) on map 0);
 *   - at 6:00:00 the morning visitors of group $24: rain or snow (weather
 *     6+; at 6:00 with seconds not 0 the rest of these is skipped),
 *     $7F1F70 bit 1, $7F1F64 bit 4, and in the first summer before the
 *     20th the first time ($7F1F70 bit 0);
 *   - $7F1F66 bit 6: a scene (slot 9, script $2C; the bit off);
 *   - $7F1F66 bit 7 with some development: slot 0 script $2E;
 *   - $7F1F66 bit 8: two scenes (slots 9 and $0A, scripts $36 / $37);
 *   - $7F1F32 = $15 the first time ($7F1F64 bit 8): a scene (slot $0B,
 *     script $1D);
 *   - from year 2 at 6:00:00 on an ordinary day with 30,000 G or more,
 *     once ($7F1F68 bit 10): group $13;
 *   - from the first winter at 6:00:00 on a Saturday, with $7F1F64 bit 6
 *     or 7, once ($7F1F68 bit 14): group $16;
 *   - in fall on a visitor day with $7F1F64 bit 6 or 7 and $7F1F68 bit
 *     13, until $7F1F6A bit 8: group $18 (and $7F1F6A bit 7 is set: it is
 *     not the bit tested, so this happens every such day);
 *   - $7F1F6E bit 10 with 6+ chickens at 6:00:00 on an ordinary day: group
 *     $29, and from then on ($7F1F6A bit 10) every time the farm is
 *     entered, until $7F1F6A bit 11;
 *   - at 6:00:00 on an ordinary day, one time in nine: group $23, and 2 of
 *     happiness.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static bool six_sharp(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)        /* hour 6, minutes 0, seconds 0 */
{
  return byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), 6) && !byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_MINUTES)) && !byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SECONDS));
}
/* CMP #1; BEQ no; CMP #8; BCC yes; CMP #$0D; BCC no; ... CMP #$1D */
static bool visitor_day(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t day = byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY));
  r->c = day >= 1;
  if (day == 1) return false;
  static const uint8_t bounds[] = { 0x08, 0x0D, 0x12, 0x19, 0x1D };
  for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    r->c = day >= bounds[i];
    if (!r->c) return !(i & 1);
  }
  return false;
}
static void flag_on(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, addr) | bit);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, addr, r->a);
}
/* a scene that stops the player: $096E = code, $D2 |= $40, action 0 */
static void stop_player(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t code)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | code);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_INTERACTION), code);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_INTERACTION_STEP), 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_INTERACTION_FRAMES), 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0040);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
}
/* LDA.L moneyL; CLC; ADC #-n; SEP; LDA.L moneyH; ADC #$FF: true if not negative */
static bool money_at_least(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t minus_n)
{
  uint32_t low = (uint32_t)hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_MONEY)) + minus_n;
  r->c = low > 0xFFFF;
  uint32_t high = (uint32_t)hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_MONEY_HIGH)) + 0xFF + r->c;
  r->c = high > 0xFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((low & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)high);
  return !(high & 0x80);
}
/* a girl's visit: her flag, her group, $09A3 = 0 */
static void girl_visit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t bit, uint16_t x, uint16_t at)
{
  flag_on(ram, r, addr, bit);
  spawn(ram, r, 0, x, 0, at);
  r->a &= 0xFF00;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_VISIT_NIGHTS), 0);
}

static bool girls_visit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x001A)) return false;
  for (uint16_t g = 1; g <= 0x10; g <<= 1) if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), g)) return false;
  if (!six_sharp(ram, r)) return false;
  if (!visitor_day(ram, r)) return false;
  const uint32_t A6 = WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), C6 = WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), W = WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66);
  if (!flag(ram, r, W, 0x0001) && !flag(ram, r, W, 0x0080) && !flag(ram, r, A6, 0x2000) &&
      !flag(ram, r, A6, 0x1000) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE), 200)) {
    girl_visit(ram, r, A6, 0x1000, 0x19, 0xCCDF); return true;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, A6, 0x1000) && !flag(ram, r, W, 0x0002) && !flag(ram, r, A6, 0x8000) &&
      !flag(ram, r, A6, 0x4000) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 2, 200)) {
    girl_visit(ram, r, A6, 0x4000, 0x1A, 0xCD2E); return true;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, A6, 0x1000) && !flag(ram, r, A6, 0x4000) && !flag(ram, r, W, 0x0004) &&
      !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0002) && !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0001) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 4, 200)) {
    girl_visit(ram, r, C6, 0x0001, 0x1B, 0xCD86); return true;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, A6, 0x1000) && !flag(ram, r, A6, 0x4000) && !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0001) &&
      !flag(ram, r, W, 0x0008) && !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0008) && !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0004) &&
      word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 6, 200)) {
    girl_visit(ram, r, C6, 0x0004, 0x1C, 0xCDE7); return true;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, A6, 0x1000) && !flag(ram, r, A6, 0x4000) && !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0001) &&
      !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0004) && !flag(ram, r, W, 0x0010) && !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0020) &&
      !flag(ram, r, C6, 0x0010) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 8, 200)) {
    girl_visit(ram, r, C6, 0x0010, 0x1D, 0xCE51); return true;
  }
  return false;
}

void hm_MapEvent_Farm(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0002)) {
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0001))      spawn(ram, r, 0x13, 0x44, 0, 0xCB9C);
    else if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0004)) spawn(ram, r, 0x13, 0x44, 2, 0xCBAD);
    else if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0008)) spawn(ram, r, 0x13, 0x44, 3, 0xCBBE);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0004) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_KID1_AGE), 0x003C))
    spawn(ram, r, 0x14, 0x45, 1, 0xCBE3);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0008) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_KID2_AGE), 0x003C))
    spawn(ram, r, 0x15, 0x45, 4, 0xCC06);
  if (girls_visit(ram, r)) return;

  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), 0x0002)) { spawn(ram, r, 7, 0, 0x20, 0xCE71); stop_player(ram, r, 0x42); return; }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0A, 2, 0xCEA9); return; }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0020)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0C, 0, 0xCEC4);
    seen(ram, r, 0x0020);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 3);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_NAME_FOR), 3);
    return;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0080)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0C, 1, 0xCEF3);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_X), 0x0078);
    r->a = 0x01A8;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_Y), 0x01A8);
    r->a = 0x0100;                                          /* SEP; LDA #0 */
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_MAP), 0);
    return;
  }
  bool skip_mornings = false;
  if (!byte_below(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_TOMORROW), 6) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), 6) &&
      !byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_MINUTES))) {
    if (!byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SECONDS))) { spawn(ram, r, 6, 0x24, 0, 0xCF3D); return; }
    skip_mornings = true;
  }
  if (!skip_mornings) {
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_70), 0x0002) && six_sharp(ram, r)) { spawn(ram, r, 6, 0x24, 2, 0xCF6E); return; }
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0010) && six_sharp(ram, r)) { spawn(ram, r, 6, 0x24, 3, 0xCF9F); return; }
    if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_70), 0x0001) && !byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 1) &&
        byte_below(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x14) && six_sharp(ram, r)) {
      flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_70), 0x0001);
      spawn(ram, r, 0x0B, 0x24, 1, 0xCFF3);
      return;
    }
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0040)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 9, 0, 0x2C, 0xD00E);
    stop_player(ram, r, 0x47);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & 0xFFBF);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), r->a);
    return;
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0080) && byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_BUILD_NIGHTS))) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0, 0x2E, 0xD05B); return; }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0100)) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & 0xFEFF);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), r->a);
    spawn(ram, r, 9, 0, 0x36, 0xD081);
    spawn(ram, r, 0x0A, 0, 0x37, 0xD090);
    stop_player(ram, r, 0x48);
    return;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0100) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_HORSE_AGE), 0x15)) {
    flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0100);
    spawn(ram, r, 0x0B, 0, 0x1D, 0xD0DD);
    stop_player(ram, r, 0x49);
    return;
  }
  if (byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)) && six_sharp(ram, r) && !flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x001A) &&
      money_at_least(ram, r, 0xF448) && !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0400)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x13, 0, 0xD151);
    seen(ram, r, 0x0400);
    return;
  }
  if ((byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)) || byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 3)) && six_sharp(ram, r) &&
      byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY), 6) && !flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x001A) &&
      flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x00C0) && !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x4000)) {
    seen(ram, r, 0x4000);
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x16, 0, 0xD1C9);
    return;
  }
  if (byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 2) && visitor_day(ram, r) && !flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x001A) &&
      flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x00C0) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x2000) && !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0100)) {
    flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0080);
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x18, 0, 0xD239);
    return;
  }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0800)) {
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0400)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x29, 0, 0xD299); return; }
    if (!flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x001E) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0400) &&
        !byte_below(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_N), 6) && six_sharp(ram, r)) {
      flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0400);
      spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x29, 0, 0xD299);
      return;
    }
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, db(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x001A) || !six_sharp(ram, r)) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 8);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD2C3, 0x80);
  hm_RNGReturn0toA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  if ((uint8_t)r->a) return;                                /* BNE */
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x23, 0, 0xD2D1);
  r->a = 0x0002;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD2DD, 0x83);
  hm_AddPlayerHappiness(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ── DED3, the player's house (maps $15-$17, its three sizes) ───────────
 *   - summer 30 of the third year (year 2): the ending (JMP StartEnding);
 *   - the music of the house after the extensions ($098B = $17 with
 *     $7F1F64 bit 7, $16 with bit 6);
 *   - with $7F1F6C bit 13 (and not bit 14), a script at the tile (156,
 *     144) (StartScriptAtTileInFront: slot $10, script $1F);
 *   - things the night left to do, each one flag of $7F1F6E cleared:
 *     bit 7, song $19 (ChangeMusic) and the nine tiles from (576, 704)
 *     to (608, 736) set to 2 (EditFarmTile); bit 8, song $15;
 *     bit 9, noise $22 of bank 7 twice (after 20 and 30 frames,
 *     PlayEffectWithSongInstrument); bit 5, noise $20 and 60 frames;
 *   - then one scene, the first that fits:
 *       bit 4: group $1F (script 2 with $7F1F5E bit 14; else script 1
 *              with bit 13, and $099F = 5 if the first child is 60 days
 *              old, 6 if not; else script 0);
 *       bit 6 (cleared): a cow's scene: the name of cow $0937 (bytes
 *              $0C-$0F of its record, GetCowPointer) at $0889-$088F,
 *              one letter per word, and group $20;
 *       the wife (first bit of $7F1F66): with her heart below 200 at
 *              6:00:00, unless a child or bit 0 of $7F1F6E, group $22
 *              ($7F1F6E bits 0-1 and $7F1F5E bit 12 set); otherwise
 *              $7F1F5E bit 12 follows $7F1F6E bit 1, or her group $43
 *              (slot $13, script = her number);
 *   - and after the wife, every time: the children 60 days old or more
 *     (group $45: slot $14 script 0, slot $15 script 3) and the man of
 *     group $0A: script 3 with $7F1F60 bit 5, script 0 until $7F1F68 bit
 *     0; script 4 on summer 1 of the second year at 6:00:00, 5 on
 *     summer 29 of the third year at 6:00:00; then group $28 on spring 1,
 *     group $0F on winter 24.
 * The noises and songs wait frames (WaitForNMI): r->p as transition.c
 * gives it (HM_LOOSE).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef void HmFn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);
/* a JSL to a routine that may wait frames: the carry as it is, 8-bit A,
 * 16-bit indexes, D and I of the entry */
static void call_waits(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, HmFn *fn)
{
  uint8_t keep = r->p;
  r->p = (uint8_t)((keep & 0x0C) | 0x20 | (r->c & 1));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->p = keep;
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA #song; JSL ChangeMusic */
static void song(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t s, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | s);
  call_waits(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_ChangeMusic);
}
/* SEP #$20; REP #$10; LDA #effect; LDX #7; LDY #frames; JSL PlayEffectWithSongInstrument */
static void noise(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t effect, uint16_t frames, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | effect);
  r->x = 7; r->y = frames;
  call_waits(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_PlayEffectWithSongInstrument);
}
/* LDA $7F1F6E; AND #~bit; STA $7F1F6E */
static void flag_off(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, addr) & ~bit);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, addr, r->a);
}
static void house_tiles(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t at = 0xDF74;
  for (uint16_t y = 0x02C0; y <= 0x02E0; y += 0x10)
    for (uint16_t x = 0x0240; x <= 0x0260; x += 0x10, at += 0x10) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x02);
      r->x = x; r->y = y;
      hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), 0x82);
      hm_EditFarmTile(ram, r);
      hm_rtl(ram, r);
    }
}
/* cow $0937's name: bytes $0C-$0F of its record to $0889-$088F */
static void cow_scene(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, HM_DEAD_COW));                /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA */
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xE100, 0x83);
  hm_GetCowPointer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    r->y = (uint16_t)(COW_NAME + i);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_ANIMAL_PTR, r->y)); /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA [$72],Y */
    if (i < 3) hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, (uint16_t)(HM_TEXT_NAME + 2 * i)), r->a);
    else hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_TEXT_NAME + 6), (uint8_t)r->a);
  }
  spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x20, 0, 0xE13F);
}
/* the wife's scene; returns when it goes on to the children */
static void wife(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint32_t hearts[5] = { WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE), WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 2, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 4, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 6, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEARTS_BASE) + 8 };
  int girl = -1;
  for (int i = 0; i < 5 && girl < 0; i++)
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), (uint16_t)(1 << i))) girl = i;
  if (girl < 0) return;
  if (!word_at_least(ram, r, hearts[girl], 0x00C8) && six_sharp(ram, r) &&
      !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x000C) && !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0001)) {
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x22, 0, 0xE1F1);
    flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0003);
    flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), 0x1000);
    return;
  }
  flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), 0x1000);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0002)) { flag_on(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), 0x1000); return; }
  for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 5; i++)
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), (uint16_t)(1 << i))) {
      spawn(ram, r, 0x13, 0x43, i, (uint16_t)(0xE27C + 0x11 * i));
      return;
    }
}
/* SEP #$20; year, season, day; 6:00:00 */
static bool morning_of(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t year, uint8_t season, uint8_t day)
{
  return byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR), year) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), season) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), day) &&
         six_sharp(ram, r);
}

void hm_MapEvent_PlayerHouse(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR), 2) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 1) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x1E) && !g_hm_no_ending) {
    hm_StartEnding(ram, r);                                  /* JMP */
    return;
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0080)) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x17);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP), 0x17);
  } else if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0040)) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x16);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP), 0x16);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x2000) && !flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x4000)) {
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X), 0x009C);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y), 0x0090);
    r->a = 0x0010; r->x = 0; r->y = 0x001F;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xDF46, 0x84);
    hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0080)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0080);
    song(ram, r, 0x19, 0xDF64);
    house_tiles(ram, r);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0100)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0100);
    song(ram, r, 0x15, 0xE012);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0200)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0200);
    noise(ram, r, 0x22, 0x0014, 0xE038);
    noise(ram, r, 0x22, 0x001E, 0xE048);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0020)) {
    noise(ram, r, 0x20, 0x003C, 0xE063);
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0020);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0010)) {
    if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), 0x4000)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x1F, 2, 0xE0D6); return; }
    if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E), 0x2000)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x1F, 0, 0xE09C); return; }
    spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x1F, 1, 0xE0AC);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_KID1_AGE));
    r->c = r->a >= 0x003C;
    uint8_t v = r->a == 0x003C ? 5 : 6;
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, HM_NAME_FOR), v);
    return;
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0040)) {
    flag_off(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0040);
    cow_scene(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  wife(ram, r);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0004) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_KID1_AGE), 0x003C))
    spawn(ram, r, 0x14, 0x45, 0, 0xE2E5);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x0008) && word_at_least(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_KID2_AGE), 0x003C))
    spawn(ram, r, 0x15, 0x45, 3, 0xE308);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), 0x0020)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0A, 3, 0xE33B); return; }
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0A, 0, 0xE32B); return; }
  if (morning_of(ram, r, 1, 1, 0x01)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0A, 4, 0xE37B); return; }
  if (morning_of(ram, r, 2, 1, 0x1D)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0A, 5, 0xE3BB); return; }
  if (!byte_of(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x01)) { spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x28, 0, 0xE3DD); return; }
  if (byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON), 3) && byte_is(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY), 0x18)) spawn(ram, r, 0, 0x0F, 0, 0xE401);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * StartMapEvents ($83:CA98, JSL, RTL): the routine of map $22 from
 * UNK_TableFunctionSelect ($83:CAA9), with A = X = $22 x 2. The table has
 * $60 words (the maps go to $56; the rest, and $3B, $3E-$4A, $4C-$5F, are
 * the empty E74C).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void (*const MAP_EVENTS[0x60])(uint8_t *, HmRegs *) = {
  hm_MapEvent_Farm, hm_MapEvent_Farm, hm_MapEvent_Farm, hm_MapEvent_Farm,     /* $00 the farm */
  hm_MapEvent_Town, hm_MapEvent_Town, hm_MapEvent_Town, hm_MapEvent_Town,     /* $04 the town */
  hm_MapEvent_FlowerFestival, hm_MapEvent_HarvestFestival, hm_MapEvent_StarryNightMap0A, hm_MapEvent_E6B2_Festival0B,
  hm_MapEvent_Crossroads, hm_MapEvent_Crossroads, hm_MapEvent_Crossroads, hm_MapEvent_Crossroads,     /* $0C the crossroads */
  hm_MapEvent_Mountain, hm_MapEvent_Mountain, hm_MapEvent_Mountain, hm_MapEvent_Mountain,
  hm_MapEvent_StarryNightMap14, hm_MapEvent_PlayerHouse, hm_MapEvent_PlayerHouse, hm_MapEvent_PlayerHouse,     /* $15 the house */
  hm_MapEvent_MariaHouse1, hm_MapEvent_MariaHouse1, hm_MapEvent_MariaHouse2, hm_MapEvent_Church,
  hm_MapEvent_NinaFlowerShop, hm_MapEvent_NinaHouse, hm_MapEvent_EveHouse1, hm_MapEvent_EveHouse2,
  hm_MapEvent_EllenHouse1, hm_MapEvent_EllenHouse2, hm_MapEvent_AnnGeneralStore, hm_MapEvent_AnnHouse,
  hm_MapEvent_AnimalShop, hm_MapEvent_DA4B_Map25Person, hm_MapEvent_ToolShedFamily, hm_MapEvent_Barn,
  hm_MapEvent_Coop, hm_MapEvent_MountainCave, hm_MapEvent_ElfTunnel, hm_MapEvent_DD95_Map2BPerson,
  hm_MapEvent_E5A2_Map2C, hm_MapEvent_E5CD_Maps2Dto30, hm_MapEvent_E5CD_Maps2Dto30, hm_MapEvent_E5CD_Maps2Dto30,
  hm_MapEvent_E5CD_Maps2Dto30, hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk, hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk, hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk,
  hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk, hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk, hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk, hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk,
  hm_MapEvent_Beanstalk, hm_MapEvent_StarryNightMap39, hm_MapEvent_NewYear, hm_MapEvent_Nothing,
  hm_MapEvent_IntroDays, hm_MapEvent_EndingSlideShow, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing,
  hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing,
  hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing,
  hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_EndingSlideShow,
  hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing,
  hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing,
  hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing,
  hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing, hm_MapEvent_Nothing,
};

void hm_StartMapEvents(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);                   /* SEP #$20; LDA #0; XBA; LDA $22 */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(map << 1);                               /* REP #$20; ASL; TAX */
  r->c = 0;
  r->x = r->a;
  if (map < 0x60) {
    hm_push8(ram, r, 0xCA); hm_push8(ram, r, 0xA7);          /* JSR ($CAA9,X) */
    MAP_EVENTS[map](ram, r);
    hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
  }
}
```

`src/maptiles.c`:

```c
/*
 * maptiles.c — what a map gets on top of its stored layout when it loads:
 * the house extensions and painted walls, the power berry flowers, the
 * tools on the shed wall, the goods on the shop shelves, the fodder in the
 * troughs, the eggs in the coop...
 *
 * RunMapExtras ($81:A9E5, JSL, RTL) calls, through the table
 * $81:A9F6 (one word per map, $22 = the map being loaded), that map's
 * routine (JSR). Maps with nothing to add point at a lone RTS.
 *
 * Every change is a "tile change" of the table $81:B363 (see mapedit.c)
 * stamped at a position in pixels:
 *   ChangeMapTileNoVram   the picture (BG1 tilemap in WRAM) and, if the change has
 *                one, its tile type in the map ($09B6); unlike ChangeMapTile
 *                no VRAM transfer is queued: the whole tilemap is uploaded
 *                after loading.
 *   SetTileTypesFromChange   the tile types of the block one by one, from a second
 *                sheet at $A7:F500 that matches the graphics sheet (16
 *                types per row): for changes made of different tiles (a
 *                house extension with its door).
 *   DrawShelfItem   an item of a shop or of the shed (8-byte records: x, y,
 *                tile change, a byte of $7F1F00-... and its bit), shown
 *                always, only if that bit is set, or only if it is not.
 *
 * Four of the map routines are shown by HM-Decomp as data (`dw` lines):
 * the coop ($81:B121), the mountain cave ($81:B1CF), the elf tunnel
 * ($81:B21E) and map $37 ($81:B26D, an indented label inside the barn's
 * block). They are disassembled here from the ROM.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* ROM tables */
#define TILE_TYPE_SHEET     0xA7F500   /* the tile types, laid out like the graphics sheet */
#define SHED_LIST           ((uint16_t)SHED_ITEM_TABLE) /* the shed's items, 8 bytes each */
#define FLOWER_SHOP_LIST    0xBEEF     /* $81:BEEF: the flower shop's */
#define GENERAL_STORE_LIST  0xBF27     /* $81:BF27: the general store's */
#define ANIMAL_SHOP_LIST    0xBF6F     /* $81:BF6F: the animal shop's */
#define POWER_FLOWER_PLACES 0x81AC49   /* x, y words; 10 places */
#define HEN_BITS            0x81BF97   /* a word per hen: its bit in HM_HEN_EGGS */
#define BARN_TROUGHS        0x81B0ED   /* 4 bytes per barn trough: x, y */
#define COOP_TROUGHS        0x81B19F   /* 4 bytes per coop trough: x, y */
#define MAP_ROUTINES        0x81A9F6   /* a word per map: its routine (bank $81) */

/* Direct page */
#define CHANGE_GFX          0x7E   /* 16b: ReadTileChange's output: the graphics' offset, */
#define CHANGE_COLS         0x80   /* 16b: the columns, */
#define CHANGE_ROWS         0x82   /* 16b: the rows, */
#define CHANGE_TYPE         0x84   /* 16b: the tile type to write (0 = none) */
#define BLOCK_COLS          0x86   /* 16b: SetTileTypeBlock's input: the columns */
#define BLOCK_ROWS          0x88   /* 16b: the rows */
#define BG_RECORD           0x18   /* 16b: GetBackgroundData: the map's graphics record */
#define SHELF_BIT           0x92   /* 8b: DrawShelfItem: the item's bit */
/* $72-$74 is a long pointer: */
#define TYPE_SHEET_PTR      0x72   /* SetTileTypesFromChange: TILE_TYPE_SHEET */
#define SHELF_LIST_PTR      0x72   /* DrawShelfItem: the list of items */
#define LONG_PTR_BANK       0x74   /* its bank */
/* SetTileTypesFromChange's own uses: */
#define TYPES_X             0x8E   /* 16b: the position */
#define TYPES_Y             0x90   /* 16b */
#define TYPE_AT             0x86   /* 16b: the next type to read in the sheet (BLOCK_COLS
                                    * elsewhere) */
#define TYPES_COLS          0x82   /* 16b: the columns (CHANGE_ROWS elsewhere) */
#define TYPES_ROWS          0x84   /* 16b: the rows (CHANGE_TYPE elsewhere) */

static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}
static uint32_t db_(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint16_t rd16(uint8_t *ram, uint32_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, a & 0xFFFFFF); }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, uint32_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, a & 0xFFFFFF); }
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, uint8_t bank, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  push16(ram, r, ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ChangeMapTileNoVram ($81:A7CE, JSL, RTL). A = tile change, X / Y = position.
 * ChangeMapTile without the VRAM part. It starts by reading the change's
 * entry (ReadTileChange) for nothing: DrawTileChange reads it again, and so does
 * the next call.
 * Leftovers: $86 / $88 = columns / rows; registers from SetTileTypeBlock when the
 * change has a tile type, otherwise A = 0, X / Y = the position and C from
 * ReadTileChange.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_7CE_FIRST   0xA7D6
#define RET_7CE_PICTURE 0xA7E2
#define RET_7CE_ENTRY   0xA7E9
#define RET_7CE_TYPES   0xA7FF

void hm_ChangeMapTileNoVram(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t change = r->a, x = r->x, y = r->y;
  push16(ram, r, y); push16(ram, r, x); push16(ram, r, change);
  jsl(ram, r, RET_7CE_FIRST, 0x81, hm_ReadTileChange);
  pull16(ram, r); pull16(ram, r); pull16(ram, r);
  push16(ram, r, y); push16(ram, r, x); push16(ram, r, change);
  r->a = change; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, RET_7CE_PICTURE, 0x81, hm_DrawTileChange);
  r->a = pull16(ram, r);                                  /* PLA */
  jsl(ram, r, RET_7CE_ENTRY, 0x81, hm_ReadTileChange);
  r->x = pull16(ram, r);                                  /* PLX; PLY */
  r->y = pull16(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, BLOCK_COLS, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, BLOCK_ROWS, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_ROWS));
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_TYPE);
  if (r->a == 0) return;
  jsl(ram, r, RET_7CE_TYPES, 0x82, hm_SetTileTypeBlock);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SetTileTypesFromChange ($82:B0A7, JSL, RTL). A = tile change, X / Y = position. For
 * every tile of the block, its type from the sheet at $A7:F500 into the map
 * (EditTileOnMap). The graphics offset of the change ($7E, 4 bytes per
 * tile, $80 per row of the graphics sheet) gives where it starts in the
 * type sheet: (offset mod $80) / 4 + (offset / $80) * 16.
 * Leftovers: $8E / $90 = the position, $72-$74 = $A7:F500, $86 = one past
 * the last type read, $82 / $84 = columns / rows; X / Y = the same, C = 1,
 * A from the last EditTileOnMap.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_0A7_ENTRY   0xB0B0
#define RET_0A7_EDIT    0xB113

void hm_SetTileTypesFromChange(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TYPES_X, r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TYPES_Y, r->y);
  jsl(ram, r, RET_0A7_ENTRY, 0x81, hm_ReadTileChange);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TYPE_SHEET_PTR, (uint16_t)TILE_TYPE_SHEET);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, LONG_PTR_BANK) = (uint8_t)(TILE_TYPE_SHEET >> 16);
  uint16_t graphics = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_GFX);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TYPE_AT, (uint16_t)(((graphics & 0x7F) >> 2) + ((graphics >> 7) << 4)));
  uint16_t rows = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_ROWS), cols = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, CHANGE_COLS);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TYPES_ROWS, rows);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TYPES_COLS, cols);
  uint16_t row = 0;
  do {
    push16(ram, r, row);                                  /* PHY */
    uint16_t col = 0;
    do {
      push16(ram, r, col); push16(ram, r, row);           /* PHX; PHY */
      uint16_t at = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TYPE_AT);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TYPE_AT, (uint16_t)(at + 1));
      uint8_t type = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, TYPE_SHEET_PTR, at));
      hm_push8(ram, r, type);                             /* PLY; PHY; PHA */
      uint32_t px = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(col << 4) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TYPES_X);
      uint32_t py = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(row << 4) + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TYPES_Y);
      r->x = (uint16_t)px;
      r->y = (uint16_t)py;
      r->c = py > 0xFFFF;
      r->a = (uint16_t)((py & 0xFF00) | hm_pull8(ram, r));  /* SEP; PLA */
      jsl(ram, r, RET_0A7_EDIT, 0x82, hm_EditTileOnMap);
      pull16(ram, r);                                     /* PLY; PLX */
      col = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);
    } while (col != hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TYPES_COLS));
    row = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 1);
  } while (row != hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TYPES_ROWS));
  r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TYPES_COLS);
  r->y = row;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DrawShelfItem ($81:B2BB, JSR, RTS). A = item, X = list, Y = how:
 *   lists ($81, 8 bytes per item): 0 the shed $BE0F, 1 the flower shop
 *   $BEEF, 2 the general store $BF27, 3 the animal shop $BF6F (any other X
 *   is the shed too);
 *   Y = 2 always; 1 only if the item's bit in $7F1F00 + its byte is set
 *   (a tool you own, hanging in the shed); 0 only if it is not (still for
 *   sale).
 * The record: +0 x, +2 y, +4 tile change, +6 which byte, +7 its bit.
 * Leftovers when nothing is shown: A = Y's high byte : (byte AND bit), X =
 * the byte number, Y = 8 A, C from comparing Y with 2 and 1; otherwise
 * ChangeMapTileNoVram's.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_2BB_STAMP   0xB361

void hm_DrawShelfItem(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t item = r->a, list = r->x, how = r->y;
  push16(ram, r, how); push16(ram, r, item);              /* PHY; PHA */
  static const uint16_t lists[4] = { SHED_LIST, FLOWER_SHOP_LIST, GENERAL_STORE_LIST, ANIMAL_SHOP_LIST };
  uint16_t at = lists[list < 4 ? list : 0];
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SHELF_LIST_PTR, at);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, LONG_PTR_BANK) = 0x81;
  item = pull16(ram, r);                                  /* PLA */
  r->c = (item >> 13) & 1;                                /* the third ASL */
  uint16_t y = (uint16_t)(item << 3);
  push16(ram, r, y);                                      /* PHY */
  uint8_t byte = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SHELF_LIST_PTR, (uint16_t)(y + 6)));
  uint8_t bit = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SHELF_LIST_PTR, (uint16_t)(y + 7)));
  r->x = byte;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SHELF_BIT) = bit;
  r->y = y = pull16(ram, r);                              /* PLY */
  how = pull16(ram, r);                                   /* PLA */
  r->a = how;
  r->c = how >= 2;
  if (how != 2) {
    bool owned = (rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + byte) & bit) != 0;
    r->c = how >= 1;
    r->a = (uint16_t)((how & 0xFF00) | (rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS) + byte) & bit));
    if (how == 1 ? !owned : owned) return;
  }
  uint16_t px = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SHELF_LIST_PTR, y));
  push16(ram, r, px);
  uint16_t py = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SHELF_LIST_PTR, (uint16_t)(y + 2)));
  push16(ram, r, py);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SHELF_LIST_PTR, (uint16_t)(y + 4)));
  r->y = pull16(ram, r);
  r->x = pull16(ram, r);
  jsl(ram, r, RET_2BB_STAMP, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTileNoVram);
}

/* ── The pieces the map routines are made of ──────────────────────────── */
/* LDA $flags; AND #mask: A is left with the result */
static bool flag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr, uint16_t mask)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, addr) & mask);
  return r->a != 0;
}
/* the picture (and the type, if the change has one) */
static void stamp(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t change, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = change; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTileNoVram);
}
/* the same, keeping A / X / Y on the stack around it (PHA; PHX; PHY) */
static void stamp_kept(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t change, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t ret)
{
  push16(ram, r, change); push16(ram, r, x); push16(ram, r, y);
  stamp(ram, r, change, x, y, ret);
  r->y = pull16(ram, r); r->x = pull16(ram, r); r->a = pull16(ram, r);
}
/* the picture, then every tile's type from the type sheet */
static void stamp_typed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t change, uint16_t x, uint16_t y,
                        uint16_t ret_picture, uint16_t ret_types)
{
  stamp_kept(ram, r, change, x, y, ret_picture);
  jsl(ram, r, ret_types, 0x82, hm_SetTileTypesFromChange);
}
/* an item of a shop or of the shed */
static void item(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n, uint16_t list, uint16_t how, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = n; r->x = list; r->y = how;
  jsr(ram, r, ret, hm_DrawShelfItem);
}
/* LDA !tool_selected; CMP #t; BEQ ...; LDA !tool_backpack; CMP #t; BEQ ...
 * (8-bit A): true when you have it in your hand or in the bag */
static bool carrying(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t tool)
{
  uint8_t hand = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_(r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | hand);
  r->c = hand >= tool;
  if (hand == tool) return true;
  uint8_t bag = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_(r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | bag);
  r->c = bag >= tool;
  return bag == tool;
}
/* an 8-bit LDA.L / CMP #k */
static uint8_t get8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t addr)
{
  uint8_t v = rd8(ram, addr);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
  return v;
}
static bool cmp8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v, uint8_t k) { r->c = v >= k; return v == k; }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReplaceTilesFarm ($81:AAB6, maps 0-3): what you built or found.
 *   $7F1F64 bit 1 / bit 0: two things by the farm (changes $60, $5F);
 *   bit 7 the house's second extension ($54), else bit 6 the first ($53);
 *   one power berry flower ($16) for each berry eaten ($7F1F36), at the
 *   places of $81:AC49 (x, y words; 10 places);
 *   $7F1F66 bits 9-12: the house painted ($59, $58, $5A, $5C, four parts);
 *   $7F1F68 bit 12: $F5.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReplaceTilesFarm(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0002)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x60, 0x0310, 0x0360, 0xAAD0, 0xAAD9);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0001)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x5F, 0x0240, 0x02F0, 0xAAF4, 0xAAFD);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0080))      stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x54, 0x0060, 0x0100, 0xAB1A, 0xAB23);
  else if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0040)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x53, 0x0060, 0x0100, 0xAB42, 0xAB4B);

  if (get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_POWER_BERRIES))) {      /* 8-bit A from here */
    uint8_t n = 0;
    do {
      hm_push8(ram, r, n);                                /* PHA */
      uint16_t at = (uint16_t)(n << 2);                   /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA; ASL; ASL */
      uint16_t x = rd16(ram, POWER_FLOWER_PLACES + at);
      uint16_t y = rd16(ram, POWER_FLOWER_PLACES + at + 2);
      stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x16, x, y, 0xAB7C, 0xAB85);
      n = hm_pull8(ram, r);                               /* PLA */
      r->c = n == 0xFF;                                   /* CLC; ADC #1 */
      n++;
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | n);
    } while (!cmp8(r, n, rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_POWER_BERRIES))));
  }

  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0200)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x59, 0x0080, 0x0130, 0xABAE, 0xABB7);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0400)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x58, 0x0060, 0x0130, 0xABD2, 0xABDB);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x0800)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x5A, 0x0090, 0x0130, 0xABF6, 0xABFF);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66), 0x1000)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0x5C, 0x00B0, 0x0130, 0xAC1A, 0xAC23);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x1000)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0xF5, 0x0120, 0x0140, 0xAC3E, 0xAC47);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReplaceTilesMountain ($81:AC80, maps $10-$13; HM-Decomp says $81:AC7F,
 * which is the RTS of ReplaceTilesForkWinter): with rain or snow, $E2 at
 * ($180, $20); then, if $7F1F64 bit 1, $E1 at ($170, $270) with its types.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReplaceTilesMountain(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, db_(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0002) || flag(ram, r, db_(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0008))
    stamp(ram, r, 0xE2, 0x0180, 0x0020, 0xACC5);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0002)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0xE1, 0x0170, 0x0270, 0xACAC, 0xACB5);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReplaceTilesHouse1 / 2 / 3 ($81:ACCC / AD23 / AD7A, maps $15-$17, the
 * house at each size): $0196 bit 4 → $EE at ($70, $C0); $7F1F6C bit 12 →
 * $FD and the tile type $D7 under it; $7F1F6E bit 14 (the clock) → $FE.
 * Houses 1 and 2 put them at the same places, house 3 elsewhere.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct { uint16_t shell_x, shell_y, clock_x, clock_y, ret[4]; } House;

static void house(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const House *h)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, db_(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS), 0x0010)) stamp(ram, r, 0xEE, 0x0070, 0x00C0, h->ret[0]);
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x1000)) {
    stamp(ram, r, 0xFD, h->shell_x, h->shell_y, h->ret[1]);
    r->a = 0xD7; r->x = h->shell_x; r->y = (uint16_t)(h->shell_y + 0x10);
    jsl(ram, r, h->ret[2], 0x82, hm_EditTileOnMap);
  }
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x4000)) stamp(ram, r, 0xFE, h->clock_x, h->clock_y, h->ret[3]);
}
void hm_ReplaceTilesHouse1(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const House h = { 0x0090, 0x0040, 0x00A0, 0x0030, { 0xACE2, 0xACFA, 0xAD09, 0xAD21 } };
  house(ram, r, &h);
}
void hm_ReplaceTilesHouse2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const House h = { 0x0090, 0x0040, 0x00A0, 0x0030, { 0xAD39, 0xAD51, 0xAD60, 0xAD78 } };
  house(ram, r, &h);
}
void hm_ReplaceTilesHouse3(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const House h = { 0x0140, 0x0050, 0x0150, 0x0040, { 0xAD90, 0xADA8, 0xADB7, 0xADCF } };
  house(ram, r, &h);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReplaceTilesFlowerShop ($81:ADD5, map $1C): only if $7F1F68 bit 0 (the
 * shop is open?). The seeds on the shelves, list 1: in summer items 1-2,
 * in spring 3-4, and in both item 5 always and item 6 if not bought.
 * Quirk: the loops do TYA; CLC; ADC #5 and then TYA again, so the sum is
 * thrown away (item = Y + 1).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void seed_shelf(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t from, uint16_t to, uint16_t ret)
{
  for (uint16_t y = from; y != to; y++) {
    push16(ram, r, y);                                    /* PHY */
    r->c = 0;                                             /* (Y + 5 < $10000) */
    item(ram, r, (uint16_t)(y + 1), 1, 2, ret);
    pull16(ram, r);                                       /* PLY; INY */
  }
  r->y = to;
  r->c = 1;                                               /* CPY */
}
void hm_ReplaceTilesFlowerShop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) return;
  uint8_t season = get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
  if (cmp8(r, season, 1)) seed_shelf(ram, r, 0, 2, 0xAE02);
  season = get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
  if (season == 0) seed_shelf(ram, r, 2, 4, 0xAE2B);
  season = get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
  r->c = season >= 2;
  if (season < 2) item(ram, r, 5, 1, 2, 0xAE4E);
  season = get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
  r->c = season >= 2;
  if (season < 2) item(ram, r, 6, 1, 0, 0xAE68);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReplaceTilesGeneralStore ($81:AE6F, map $22): only if $7F1F68 bit 0.
 * The tools for sale (list 2), each only if not bought yet and not in your
 * hand or bag: 1 the paint ($0D, once the house has its second extension),
 * 2 the milker ($0E), 3 the brush ($0F), 4-7 the gold sickle, hoe, hammer
 * and axe ($11-$14, once $7F1F6A bits 0-3 are set), 8 the sprinkler ($15:
 * from summer day 20 of the first year on).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReplaceTilesGeneralStore(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) return;
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x0D) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0080)) item(ram, r, 1, 2, 0, 0xAEA5);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x0E)) item(ram, r, 2, 2, 0, 0xAEC3);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x0F)) item(ram, r, 3, 2, 0, 0xAEE1);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x11) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0001)) item(ram, r, 4, 2, 0, 0xAF0A);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x12) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0002)) item(ram, r, 5, 2, 0, 0xAF33);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x13) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0004)) item(ram, r, 6, 2, 0, 0xAF5C);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x14) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0008)) item(ram, r, 7, 2, 0, 0xAF85);
  if (carrying(ram, r, 0x15)) return;
  cmp8(r, get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR)), 1);
  if (!r->c) {                                            /* the first year */
    uint8_t season = get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
    if (season == 0) return;                              /* spring: not yet */
    cmp8(r, season, 2);
    if (!r->c) {                                          /* summer: from day 20 */
      cmp8(r, get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY)), 0x14);
      if (!r->c) return;
    }                                                     /* fall, winter: yes */
  }
  item(ram, r, 8, 2, 0, 0xAFBD);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReplaceTilesAnimalShop ($81:AFC0, map $24): only if $7F1F68 bit 0.
 * List 3, each if not bought and not carried: 1 the miracle potion ($0A:
 * only if no cow is pregnant, $7F1F64 bit 2 clear, $7F1F6E bit 12 set and
 * fewer than 12 cows), 2 the medicine ($09), 3 / 4 the chicken / cow
 * fodder ($19 / $1A).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReplaceTilesAnimalShop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x0001)) return;
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0004) && flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E), 0x1000) &&
      !cmp8(r, get8(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_N)), 0x0C) && !carrying(ram, r, 0x0A))
    item(ram, r, 1, 3, 0, 0xB007);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x09)) item(ram, r, 2, 3, 0, 0xB025);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x19)) item(ram, r, 3, 3, 0, 0xB043);
  if (!carrying(ram, r, 0x1A)) item(ram, r, 4, 3, 0, 0xB061);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReplaceTilesToolShed ($81:B064, map $26): the 24 items of list 0 you
 * own, on the wall; and, if $7F1F68 bit 13, $F0 at ($70, $20) with its
 * types.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReplaceTilesToolShed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  for (uint16_t y = 0; y != 0x18; y++) {
    push16(ram, r, y);                                    /* PHY */
    item(ram, r, (uint16_t)(y + 1), 0, 1, 0xB076);
    pull16(ram, r);
  }
  r->y = 0x18;
  r->c = 1;
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68), 0x2000)) stamp_typed(ram, r, 0xF0, 0x0070, 0x0020, 0xB09D, 0xB0A6);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReplaceTilesBarn ($81:B0A8, map $27) and the coop ($81:B121, map $28):
 * item $1A / $19 of list 0 if owned, then fodder ($99) in every trough with
 * food ($0932 / $0934, one bit per trough, the bits of $82:A571), at the
 * places $81:B0ED / $81:B19F (13 / 12 troughs). The coop also shows an egg
 * ($F1) by each hen that laid one ($7F1F45, the bits of $81:BF97), at the
 * hens' places in the coop ($83:CA10).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void by_bits(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n, uint32_t bits, uint32_t food,
                    uint32_t places, uint16_t change, uint16_t ret)
{
  for (uint16_t y = 0; y != n; y++) {
    push16(ram, r, y);                                    /* PHY */
    r->x = (uint16_t)(y << 1);
    if (flag(ram, r, food, rd16(ram, bits + r->x))) {
      r->x = (uint16_t)(y << 2);
      uint16_t px = rd16(ram, places + r->x);
      push16(ram, r, px);
      r->x = (uint16_t)(r->x + 2);
      uint16_t py = rd16(ram, places + r->x);
      push16(ram, r, py);
      r->a = change;
      r->y = pull16(ram, r); r->x = pull16(ram, r);
      jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTileNoVram);
    }
    pull16(ram, r);                                       /* PLY; INY */
  }
  r->y = n;
  r->c = 1;
}
void hm_ReplaceTilesBarn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  item(ram, r, 0x1A, 0, 1, 0xB0B5);
  by_bits(ram, r, 13, FEED_BOX_BITS, db_(r, HM_COW_TROUGHS), BARN_TROUGHS, 0x99, 0xB0E2);
}
void hm_ReplaceTilesCoop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  item(ram, r, 0x19, 0, 1, 0xB12E);
  by_bits(ram, r, 12, FEED_BOX_BITS, db_(r, HM_CHICKEN_TROUGHS), COOP_TROUGHS, 0x99, 0xB15D);
  by_bits(ram, r, 13, HEN_BITS, WRAM_LONG(HM_HEN_EGGS), CHICKEN_PLACES, 0xF1, 0xB194);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The mountain cave ($81:B1CF, map $29): if $7F1F6C bit 0 or 4, $E4 at
 * three places. The elf tunnel ($81:B21E, map $2A): if $7F1F64 bit 1, $EF
 * twice with its types. Map $37 ($81:B26D): the first time ($7F1F5A bit 0,
 * then set), $9B at ($80, $110).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReplaceTilesMountainCave(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x0011)) return;
  stamp_kept(ram, r, 0xE4, 0x0070, 0x0160, 0xB1E9);
  stamp_kept(ram, r, 0xE4, 0x0070, 0x0130, 0xB200);
  stamp_kept(ram, r, 0xE4, 0x0060, 0x0170, 0xB217);
}
void hm_ReplaceTilesElfTunnel(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_64), 0x0002)) return;
  stamp_typed(ram, r, 0xEF, 0x0030, 0x0180, 0xB23B, 0xB244);
  stamp_typed(ram, r, 0xEF, 0x0020, 0x01B0, 0xB256, 0xB25F);
}
void hm_ReplaceTilesMap37(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (flag(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), 0x0001)) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) | 0x0001);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), r->a);
  stamp(ram, r, 0x9B, 0x0080, 0x0110, 0xB291);
}

/* The maps with nothing to add: a lone RTS each. */
void hm_ReplaceTilesNothing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { (void)ram; (void)r; }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * RunMapExtras ($81:A9E5, JSL, RTL): the routine of map $22
 * (maps $00-$5F), called with JSR (A9F6,X).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_9E5_CALL  0xA9F4

void hm_RunMapExtras(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  r->c = (r->a >> 15) & 1;                                /* ASL */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a << 1);
  r->x = r->a;
  uint16_t target = rd16(ram, MAP_ROUTINES + r->x);
  void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *);
  switch (target) {
    case 0xAAB6: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesFarm; break;
    case 0xAC80: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesMountain; break;
    case 0xACCC: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesHouse1; break;
    case 0xAD23: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesHouse2; break;
    case 0xAD7A: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesHouse3; break;
    case 0xADD5: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesFlowerShop; break;
    case 0xAE6F: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesGeneralStore; break;
    case 0xAFC0: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesAnimalShop; break;
    case 0xB064: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesToolShed; break;
    case 0xB0A8: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesBarn; break;
    case 0xB121: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesCoop; break;
    case 0xB1CF: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesMountainCave; break;
    case 0xB21E: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesElfTunnel; break;
    case 0xB26D: fn = hm_ReplaceTilesMap37; break;
    default:     fn = hm_ReplaceTilesNothing; break;  /* a lone RTS */
  }
  jsr(ram, r, RET_9E5_CALL, fn);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * GetBackgroundData ($80:A7AE, JSL, RTL): byte Y of the graphics record of
 * map $22. Maps_Graphics_Table ($80:AA7C) has a word per map, pointing
 * (through the data bank) at its record; $18 = that pointer.
 * Leftovers: A = the pointer's high byte : the byte, X = 2 map, C = 0.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_GetBackgroundData(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->x = (uint16_t)(*hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID) << 1);
  r->c = 0;
  uint16_t record = rd16(ram, MAPS_GRAPHICS_TABLE + r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, BG_RECORD, record);
  uint8_t b = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + record + r->y) & 0xFFFFFF);  /* (dp),Y */
  r->a = (uint16_t)((record & 0xFF00) | b);
}
```
