```c
 * $0984 (flags, routine, +2, +3) and $097A (sprite), $097E (flip),
 * $0980/$0982 (X/Y), then creates its game object and keeps its number.
 * Notes:
 *   - With all 10 map objects in use the game hangs: `BRA` to itself at
 *     $81:A528 (the rewrite just returns; the fuzz always leaves one free).
 *   - If there is no free game object, +4 keeps whatever $A5 held (the
 *     last object created), since CreateGameObject leaves $A5 alone.
 * Leftovers: A = $A5, Y = 4, X and C from CreateGameObject.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_A500_CREATE 0xA580   /* JSL CreateGameObject at $81:A57D */

void hm_SpawnMapObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, (uint16_t)WRAM_LONG(HM_MAP_OBJECTS));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR_BANK) = (uint8_t)(WRAM_LONG(HM_MAP_OBJECTS) >> 16);
  uint16_t n = 0;
  while (hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_FLAGS)) & 1) {
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR) + MAP_OBJECT_SIZE));
    if (++n == MAP_OBJECTS_MAX) return;                  /* the original hangs */
  }

  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_FLAGS), hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM_FLAGS)));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_ROUTINE), hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM_ROUTINE)));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_STATE), hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM_STATE)));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_ITEM), hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM)));
  uint16_t sprite = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM_SPRITE));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_SPRITE), sprite);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_SPRITE_SHOWN), sprite);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_SPRITE, sprite);
  uint16_t flip = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM_FLIP));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_FLIP), flip);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP, flip);
  uint16_t px = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM_X));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_X), px);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_X, px);
  uint16_t py = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ITEM_Y));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_Y), py);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_Y, py);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_PARAM, 0);

  r->a = py; r->x = n; r->y = MOBJ_Y;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_A500_CREATE, 0x85);
  hm_CreateGameObject(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->y = MOBJ_GOBJ;
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_GOBJ), r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ClearItemRecords ($81:A4C7, JSL, RTL): clears the first byte of the
 * 10 records of 16 bytes at $7E:B4E6 (right before the event slots).
 * Leftovers: $07-$09 = $7E:B586, A = $B586, X = 10, Y = 0, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ClearItemRecords(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, (uint16_t)WRAM_LONG(HM_MAP_OBJECTS));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR_BANK) = (uint8_t)(WRAM_LONG(HM_MAP_OBJECTS) >> 16);
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x != MAP_OBJECTS_MAX; x++) {
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, MOBJ_FLAGS), 0);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, MAP_OBJ_PTR) + MAP_OBJECT_SIZE));
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(WRAM_LONG(HM_MAP_OBJECTS) + MAP_OBJECTS_MAX * MAP_OBJECT_SIZE);
  r->x = MAP_OBJECTS_MAX;
  r->y = 0;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Destroying a game object.
 *
 * DestroyGameObject ($85:81A2, JSL, RTL): object $A5 ($A9 = its offset, from
 * Table_GameOBJIndexes at $85:8BE0). If one of its pieces is still waiting
 * in the loader's queue (slot $FF), nothing can be freed yet: $0740 counts
 * one more postponed destruction, $AF = A = $FFFF and it returns. Otherwise
 * every piece gives its graphics slot back, the record is freed (+0 = 0)
 * and A = its +0E. The callers do not retry: the object simply stays.
 *
 * CheckSpritePiecesLoaded ($85:8B7B, JSR, RTS): the check, $AF = 0 (all loaded) or
 * $FFFF. FreeSpritePieces ($85:8B41, JSR, RTS): the freeing; each piece's slot
 * byte becomes $FF. ReleaseSpriteSlot ($85:8C9F, JSR, RTS): one user less for
 * slot $B3 ($7E:A320 + 4 slot).
 * Bug: ReleaseSpriteSlot waits while the slot's count is 0 ("LDA; BEQ" to
 * itself), which would hang the game; a slot in use is never at 0, so it
 * does not happen. The rewrite does not wait (the fuzz never gives 0).
 * Leftovers: see each one; C = 1 at the end of the loops (CPY / CMP).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReleaseSpriteSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t slot = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECE_NUM);
  r->c = (slot >> 14) & 1;                                 /* the second ASL */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(slot << 2);
  uint32_t users = (SLOT_USERS + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, users) - 1);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, users, r->a);
}

/* LDA #0; XBA; LDA +13,X (8-bit), TAY: the number of pieces */
static uint16_t pieces_of(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t x)
{
  r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_COUNT, x));
  return r->a;
}

void hm_CheckSpritePiecesLoaded(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
  uint16_t y = pieces_of(ram, r, x);
  for (;;) {
    r->c = 1;                                              /* CPY #0 */
    if (y == 0) {
      r->a = 0;
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PIECES_QUEUED, 0);
      break;
    }
    uint8_t slot = hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_SLOTS, x));
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | slot);
    r->c = slot == 0xFF;                                   /* CMP #$FF */
    if (slot == 0xFF) {                                    /* still queued */
      uint32_t waits = abs_db(r, POSTPONED_FREES);
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, waits, (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, waits) + 1));
      r->a = 0xFFFF;
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PIECES_QUEUED, 0xFFFF);
      break;
    }
    x++; y--;
  }
  r->x = x; r->y = y;
}

#define RET_B41_SLOT 0x8B6B   /* JSR ReleaseSpriteSlot at $85:8B69 */

void hm_FreeSpritePieces(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
  uint16_t y = pieces_of(ram, r, x);
  while (y != 0) {
    uint8_t slot = hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_SLOTS, x));
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | slot);
    if (slot != 0xFF) {
      *hm_dp(ram, r, PIECE_NUM) = slot;
      *hm_dp(ram, r, PIECE_NUM + 1) = 0;
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0xFF);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_SLOTS, x), 0xFF);
      push16(ram, r, y); push16(ram, r, x);                /* PHY; PHX */
      push16(ram, r, RET_B41_SLOT);
      hm_ReleaseSpriteSlot(ram, r);
      pull16(ram, r);
      x = pull16(ram, r); y = pull16(ram, r);              /* PLX; PLY */
    }
    x++; y--;
  }
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CPY #0 */
  r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
  r->y = 0;
}

#define RET_1A2_CHECK 0x81B0
#define RET_1A2_FREE  0x81BA

void hm_DestroyGameObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t n = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER);
  r->c = (n >> 15) & 1;                                    /* ASL */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 1);
  uint16_t obj = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (GOBJ_OFFSETS + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET, obj);
  push16(ram, r, RET_1A2_CHECK);
  hm_CheckSpritePiecesLoaded(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECES_QUEUED);
  if (r->a) return;                                        /* JMP to an RTL */
  push16(ram, r, RET_1A2_FREE);
  hm_FreeSpritePieces(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
  r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS, r->x), 0);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_NEXT_FRAME, r->x));
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Changing a game object (both JSL, RTL; $A5 = the object, $A9 = its
 * offset from Table_GameOBJIndexes; $77 / $7A = the bank of sprite $A1's
 * table, $86 or $87).
 *
 * MoveGameObject ($85:80B9): moves it: flip $9F, X $9B, Y $9D. $A7 = 0 when
 * done, 1 when the record is not in use (then nothing changes).
 * ChangeGameObjectSprite ($85:8100): gives it another sprite ($A1, with $9F, $A3,
 * $9B, $9D as CreateGameObject): its pieces are freed (unless one is still
 * queued: then nothing, as DestroyGameObject) and the new sprite's are loaded.
 * Leftovers: A = 0 (or $FFFF / the record's first word), X = the offset,
 * C from the last arithmetic.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void sprite_bank(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t sprite = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_SPRITE);
  uint8_t bank = sprite >= FIRST_SPRITE_87 ? 0x87 : 0x86;
  r->c = sprite >= FIRST_SPRITE_87;                        /* CMP #$0262 */
  r->a = (uint16_t)((sprite & 0xFF00) | bank);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY_BANK) = bank;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, PIECE_LIST_BANK) = bank;
}
static uint16_t object_offset(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t n = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER);
  r->c = (n >> 15) & 1;                                    /* ASL */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(n << 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (GOBJ_OFFSETS + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET, r->a);
  return r->a;
}

void hm_MoveGameObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  sprite_bank(ram, r);
  uint16_t x = object_offset(ram, r);
  r->x = x;
  r->a = 1;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_RESULT, 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS, x));
  if (!r->a) return;                                       /* not in use */
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_FLIP, x), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_X, x), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_X));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_Y, x), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_Y));
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_RESULT, 0);
}

#define RET_100_CHECK  0x812B
#define RET_100_FREE   0x8132
#define RET_100_PIECES 0x819B

void hm_ChangeGameObjectSprite(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  sprite_bank(ram, r);
  object_offset(ram, r);
  push16(ram, r, RET_100_CHECK);
  hm_CheckSpritePiecesLoaded(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECES_QUEUED);
  if (r->a) return;                                        /* a piece still queued */
  push16(ram, r, RET_100_FREE);
  hm_FreeSpritePieces(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
  r->y = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER);
  uint16_t x = r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
  uint16_t sprite = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_SPRITE);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_SPRITE, x), sprite);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_FLIP, x), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PARAM, x), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_PARAM));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_X, x), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_X));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_Y, x), hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_Y));
  uint16_t number = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_SPRITE, x));
  uint32_t table = SPRITES_86;
  if (sprite >= FIRST_SPRITE_87) { number = (uint16_t)(number - FIRST_SPRITE_87); table = SPRITES_87; }
  uint16_t entry = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (table + (uint16_t)(number << 1)) & 0xFFFFFF);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY, entry);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_FIRST_FRAME, x), entry);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_NEXT_FRAME, x), (uint16_t)(entry + FRAME_SIZE));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_LIST, x), hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY, FRAME_PIECES)));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_TIMER, x), hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY, FRAME_LASTS)));
  r->x = x; r->y = 2;
  push16(ram, r, RET_100_PIECES);
  hm_LoadGameObjectComponents(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_RESULT, 0);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ReadGameObject ($85:81CB, JSL, RTL): reads object $A5 back into the
 * variables CreateGameObject takes ($A1 sprite, $9F flip, $A3, $9B / $9D
 * position; only if the record is in use), and $A7 = its byte +12 (from
 * the sprite's entry) sign-extended, in use or not.
 * Leftovers: $A9 / X = the offset, A = $A7, C = 1 (CMP #0).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ReadGameObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t x = object_offset(ram, r);
  r->x = x;
  if (hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS, x))) {
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_SPRITE, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_SPRITE, x)));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_FLIP, x)));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_PARAM, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PARAM, x)));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_X, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_X, x)));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_Y, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_Y, x)));
  }
  int8_t b = (int8_t)hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_TIMER, x));
  r->a = (uint16_t)(int16_t)b;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_RESULT, r->a);
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * InvertIfFlippedX / InvertIfFlippedY ($85:8BB0 / $85:8BBC, JSR, RTS): A = a
 * piece's offset inside the sprite; if the object is flipped that way ($9F
 * bit 6 / bit 7) it becomes -A - 16, the mirrored place of a 16-pixel
 * piece. Leftovers: C from that add, or untouched.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void invert_if(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bit)
{
  uint16_t a = r->a;
  push16(ram, r, a);                                       /* PHA */
  if (!(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP) & bit)) { r->a = pull16(ram, r); return; }
  pull16(ram, r);
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(-a) + 0xFFF0;        /* EOR #$FFFF; INC; CLC; ADC #$FFF0 */
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
}
void hm_InvertIfFlippedX(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { invert_if(ram, r, 0x0040); }
void hm_InvertIfFlippedY(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { invert_if(ram, r, 0x0080); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ClearSpriteDataTables ($85:8ED7, JSL, RTL): empties everything about the
 * piece graphics: no slot in use ($7E:A320 counts 0, their +2 words
 * $FFFF), an empty queue ($7E:A220, $BB = $BD = 0, $7E:A420 = $FFFF) and
 * no piece loaded ($7F:0F00-$7F:1EFF = $FF), then $0846 = $0848 = 0.
 * Leftovers: A = $FFFF, X = $1000, Y = 64, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ClearSpriteDataTables(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_LOAD_COPIES), 0xFFFF);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, QUEUE_OUT, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, QUEUE_IN, 0);
  for (uint16_t y = 0; y != 64; y++) {
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, SLOT_USERS + 4 * y, 0);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, SLOT_USERS + SLOT_PIECE + 4 * y, 0xFFFF);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, PIECE_QUEUE + 4 * y, 0xFFFF);
  }
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x != 0x1000; x += 2) hm_bus_wr16(ram, PIECE_SLOT + x, 0xFFFF);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, NEW_SLOTS), 0);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, SEARCH_FROM), 0);
  r->a = 0xFFFF; r->x = 0x1000; r->y = 64; r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AnimateGameObjects ($85:82C7, JSL, RTL): animates the game objects, every
 * frame. A sprite's entry (+0C) is a list of frames, 3 bytes each: the
 * piece list of the frame and how many frames it lasts; a piece list of 0
 * goes back to the first frame (a loop). For each of the $DC objects in
 * use, by its timer +12:
 *   0     the next frame: unless a piece of the current one is still
 *         queued (CheckSpritePiecesLoaded; then it waits), its pieces are freed and
 *         those of the frame at +0E are loaded; +10 = the frame's piece
 *         list, +12 = its duration, +0E = the frame after it;
 *   $FE   the object is freed (its pieces and +00 = 0). Only found right
 *         after the object was created or given a sprite (they copy the
 *         first frame's duration): a later frame of $FE is counted down
 *         as soon as it is loaded, and simply lasts 254 frames;
 *   $FF   stays on this frame for ever;
 *   other one frame less (also right after loading a frame).
 * Leftovers: $A9 = $24 x $DC, $AB = $DC, A = $AB, C = 1; X, Y and $75 /
 * $77 / $7A of the last object worked on.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_2C7_CHECK  0x830E   /* JSR CheckSpritePiecesLoaded at $85:830C */
#define RET_2C7_FREE   0x8315   /* JSR FreeSpritePieces at $85:8313 */
#define RET_2C7_LOAD   0x8344   /* JSR LoadGameObjectComponents at $85:8342 */
#define RET_2C7_END    0x8356   /* JSR FreeSpritePieces at $85:8354 */

static void jsr85(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  push16(ram, r, ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
}
static uint8_t gobj8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t field, uint16_t x)   /* 8-bit LDA */
{
  uint8_t v = hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_x(r, (uint16_t)(HM_GAME_OBJECTS + field), x));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
  return v;
}

/* the next frame (.CODE_858303 with a timer of 0); false if it must wait */
static bool next_frame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  jsr85(ram, r, RET_2C7_CHECK, hm_CheckSpritePiecesLoaded);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECES_QUEUED);
  if (r->a) return false;
  jsr85(ram, r, RET_2C7_FREE, hm_FreeSpritePieces);
  uint16_t x = r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY, r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_NEXT_FRAME, x)));
  while ((r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY, FRAME_PIECES))) == 0) /* the end: loop */
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY, r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_FIRST_FRAME, x)));
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_LIST, x), r->a);
  r->y = 2;
  uint8_t lasts = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY, FRAME_LASTS));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | lasts);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_TIMER, x), lasts);
  uint16_t at = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY);
  r->c = (uint32_t)at + FRAME_SIZE > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(at + FRAME_SIZE);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_NEXT_FRAME, x), r->a);
  jsr85(ram, r, RET_2C7_LOAD, hm_LoadGameObjectComponents);
  return true;
}

void hm_AnimateGameObjects(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_INDEX, 0);
  do {
    uint16_t x = r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS, x));
    if (r->a) {
      uint16_t sprite = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_SPRITE, x));
      uint8_t bank = sprite >= FIRST_SPRITE_87 ? 0x87 : 0x86;
      r->c = sprite >= FIRST_SPRITE_87;                    /* CMP #$0262 */
      r->a = (uint16_t)((sprite & 0xFF00) | bank);
      *hm_dp(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY_BANK) = bank;
      *hm_dp(ram, r, PIECE_LIST_BANK) = bank;
      uint8_t timer = gobj8(ram, r, GOBJ_TIMER, x);
      bool count_down = true;
      if (timer == 0) {
        count_down = next_frame(ram, r);
      } else {
        r->c = timer >= 0xFE;                              /* CMP #$FE */
        if (timer == 0xFE) {
          jsr85(ram, r, RET_2C7_END, hm_FreeSpritePieces);
          r->a = 0;
          hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS, r->x), 0);
          count_down = false;
        }
      }
      if (count_down) {                                    /* .CODE_858362 */
        x = r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
        timer = gobj8(ram, r, GOBJ_TIMER, x);
        r->c = timer >= 0xFF;                              /* CMP #$FF */
        if (timer != 0xFF) {
          r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | (uint8_t)(timer - 1));
          hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_TIMER, x), (uint8_t)(timer - 1));
        }
      }
    }
    uint16_t at = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);           /* .CODE_8582D4 */
    r->c = (uint32_t)at + GOBJ_SIZE > 0xFFFF;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET, (uint16_t)(at + GOBJ_SIZE));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_INDEX, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_INDEX) + 1));
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_INDEX);
    r->c = r->a >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT);       /* CMP $DC */
  } while (r->a != hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT));
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * GetOBJOrderToDraw ($85:8377, JSR, RTS): the order the $DC game objects
 * are drawn in ($084C, one byte each), a kind of depth sort around the
 * player's object ($0905): the objects at or below the player (Y, +0A, not
 * smaller than the player's) go first, in order, and the ones above go at
 * the end, from the last place backwards; the player's object goes in the
 * middle, last of the first group. So the player is drawn over everything
 * above it on the screen and under what is in front of it. (The order is
 * only by the side of the player; among themselves objects keep their
 * numbers.)
 * Leftovers: $A9 = the player's Y, $AD = the player's place, $AF = the
 * place before it, $7E = $FFFF; X = $AD, Y = $DC, A = the player's object
 * (8-bit), C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_GetOBJOrderToDraw(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t player = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_GOBJ));
  r->c = (player >> 15) & 1;                               /* ASL */
  uint16_t at = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (GOBJ_OFFSETS + (uint16_t)(player << 1)) & 0xFFFFFF);
  uint16_t player_y = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_Y, at));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ORDER_PLAYER_Y, player_y);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ORDER_FRONT, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ORDER_BACK, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT) - 1));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, 0xFFFF);
  uint16_t x = 0, y = 0;
  do {
    push16(ram, r, x);                                     /* PHX */
    if (y != hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_GOBJ))) {
      uint16_t oy = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_Y, x));
      r->c = oy >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, ORDER_PLAYER_Y);      /* CMP $A9 */
      uint16_t place;
      if (r->c) {
        place = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, ORDER_FRONT);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ORDER_FRONT, (uint16_t)(place + 1));
      } else {
        place = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, ORDER_BACK);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, ORDER_BACK, (uint16_t)(place - 1));
      }
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_x(r, DRAW_ORDER, place), (uint8_t)y);
    }
    uint16_t back = pull16(ram, r);                        /* PLA */
    r->c = (uint32_t)back + GOBJ_SIZE > 0xFFFF;
    x = (uint16_t)(back + GOBJ_SIZE);
    y++;
  } while (y != hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT));         /* CPY $DC */
  r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, ORDER_FRONT);
  r->y = y;
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CPY $DC: equal */
  uint16_t p = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_GOBJ));
  r->a = p;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_x(r, DRAW_ORDER, r->x), (uint8_t)p);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ClearOAMCopy ($85:8647, JSR, RTS) and ClearOAMCopyAgain
 * ($85:8896, the same code twice): empties the WRAM copy of the sprite
 * table (OAM) before it is filled: the 128 sprites ($7E:A000, 4 bytes
 * each) at X = Y = $F0, off the screen, and the high table ($7E:A200, 32
 * bytes) to 0. $B7 = 1 (absolute, data bank).
 * Leftovers: A = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ClearOAMCopy(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 0x200; i += 4) hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) + i, 0xF0F0);
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 0x20; i += 2) hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY_HIGH) + i, 0);
  r->a = 1;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, UNKNOWN_00B7), 1);
}
void hm_ClearOAMCopyAgain(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { hm_ClearOAMCopy(ram, r); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * InitializeOBJs ($85:820F, JSL, RTL): frees all 40 game objects (their
 * first $12 bytes to 0, the piece bytes +14..+23 to $FF), no object handed
 * out ($DC = 0) and the sprite table emptied (ClearOAMCopy). The
 * pieces' graphics slots are not touched. $77 / $7A = the bank of sprite
 * $A1's table, as usual.
 * Leftovers: $0086 (absolute) = $5A0, Y = 40, A = 1 and the rest of
 * ClearOAMCopy; X = $57C, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_20F_PRESETS 0x82C5   /* JSR ClearOAMCopy at $85:82C3 */

void hm_InitializeOBJs(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t sprite = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_SPRITE);
  uint8_t bank = sprite >= FIRST_SPRITE_87 ? 0x87 : 0x86;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY_BANK) = bank;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, PIECE_LIST_BANK) = bank;
  uint32_t counter = abs_db(r, GOBJ_CLEAR_AT);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, counter, 0);
  uint16_t y = 0;
  do {
    uint16_t x = r->x = hm_bus_rd16(ram, counter);
    for (uint16_t f = 0; f < GOBJ_PIECE_SLOTS; f += 2) hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_x(r, (uint16_t)(HM_GAME_OBJECTS + f), x), 0);
    for (uint16_t f = GOBJ_PIECE_SLOTS; f < GOBJ_SIZE; f++) hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_x(r, (uint16_t)(HM_GAME_OBJECTS + f), x), 0xFF);
    uint16_t next = hm_bus_rd16(ram, counter);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, counter, (uint16_t)(next + GOBJ_SIZE));
    y++;
  } while (y != GOBJ_MAX);
  r->y = y;
  r->c = 1;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT, 0);
  push16(ram, r, RET_20F_PRESETS);
  hm_ClearOAMCopy(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The player's own game object ($0905). Its animation number ($0901, the
 * one shown last in $0903) picks a sprite and a flip from DATA8_81D210
 * ($81:D210, 3 bytes each: the sprite, and a byte that x 64 is the flip,
 * kept in $090F).
 *
 * CreatePlayerObject ($81:CFA0, JSL, RTL): creates the object at the player's
 * position (CreateGameObject) and keeps its number in $0905.
 * UpdatePlayerObject ($81:CFE6, JSR, RTS), every frame: moves it to the player
 * (MoveGameObject); if the animation changed, gives it the new sprite
 * (ChangeGameObjectSprite); then ReadPlayerObjectTimer.
 * ReadPlayerObjectTimer ($81:D03D, JSR, RTS): reads the object back (ReadGameObject);
 * $0915 = its timer byte, sign-extended ($A7); at $FFFF (the frame lasts
 * for ever: the animation is over) the game state bit $2000 is cleared.
 * Leftovers: those of the object routines; A = $A5 / $0905 (CFA0), the
 * cleared state or $A7 (D03D), C from the last compare.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* $0903 = $0901; $A1 = its sprite, $090F = $9F = its flip; returns n x 3 */
static void player_sprite(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t anim)
{
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, PLAYER_ANIM_SHOWN), anim);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, anim);
  uint32_t idx = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(anim << 1) + anim;  /* ASL; CLC; ADC $7E */
  r->x = (uint16_t)idx;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_SPRITE, hm_bus_rd16(ram, PLAYER_ANIMS + r->x));
  r->x = (uint16_t)(r->x + 2);
  uint16_t flip = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, PLAYER_ANIMS + r->x) << 6);
  r->c = 0;                                                /* the last ASL */
  r->a = flip;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_FLIP), flip);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP, flip);
}

void hm_CreatePlayerObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t anim = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST));
  player_sprite(ram, r, anim);
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_PARAM, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_X, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_Y, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y));
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xCFDD, 0x85);
  hm_CreateGameObject(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_GOBJ), r->a);
}

void hm_ReadPlayerObjectTimer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_GOBJ)));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD047, 0x85);
  hm_ReadGameObject(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_RESULT);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_TIMER), r->a);
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CMP #$FFFF: >= */
  if (r->a != 0xFFFF) { r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF; return; }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(0xDFFF & hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE)); /* the state's bit $2000 off */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}

void hm_UpdatePlayerObject(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_GOBJ)));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_X, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_Y, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y));
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_FLIP));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP, r->a);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xCFFD, 0x85);
  hm_MoveGameObject(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  uint16_t anim = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST));
  uint16_t shown = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, PLAYER_ANIM_SHOWN));
  r->a = anim;
  r->c = anim >= shown;                                    /* CMP $0903 */
  if (anim != shown) {
    player_sprite(ram, r, anim);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_PLAYER_GOBJ));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_NUMBER, r->a);
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xD038, 0x85);
    hm_ChangeGameObjectSprite(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
  push16(ram, r, 0xD03B);                                  /* JSR ReadPlayerObjectTimer */
  hm_ReadPlayerObjectTimer(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * LoadQueuedSpritePieces ($85:8CB2, JSL, RTL): the loader of the queued pieces (run
 * at the NMI). While the queue ($BB != $BD) has pieces and the budget $C7
 * has $100 bytes left for one more, takes the piece at $BB:
 *   - its slot: the next new one while $0846 < $40 (then $0846 + 1), or
 *     else the first free one ($7E:A320 + 4 slot = 0) from slot $0848
 *     (which turns 1-$40 each piece);
 *   - the slot gets one user and the piece; the piece that was in it, if
 *     any, is no longer loaded ($7F:0F00 + it = $FF); the new one is
 *     ($7F:0F00 + piece = slot), and the slot is written where the queue
 *     said (bank $80);
 *   - a copy for the NMI at $7E:A420 + $BF (6 bytes each, $FFFF after the
 *     last): the piece's graphics (ROM $86:8000 + 2 x the piece's low 6
 *     bits, x $20, + $2000 x bits 6-7, + $8000), its bank ($88 + the
 *     piece's high byte), and the slot's VRAM address ($86:8000 + 2 x
 *     slot, x $10).
 * At the end $0742 = what is left in the queue (entries).
 * Traps (the original spins forever): no free slot; a slot >= $2000; 32
 * pieces in one go. None can happen with the budgets the game gives; the
 * rewrite spins too.
 * Leftovers: $7E, $C1, $C3, $C5, $75 of the last piece, $7A = $80; X the
 * last X; Y the count of the search; C from the last LSR; A's high byte
 * from the last 16-bit load of the loop's test.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void trap(void) { for (;;) { } }

/* the console's multiplier: 8 x 8 bits (STA $4202; STA $4203, with the
 * data bank; the product read back from $4216) */
static uint16_t graphics_times(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t index, uint8_t by)
{
  uint8_t a = (uint8_t)hm_bus_rd16(ram, PIECE_GRAPHICS + 2u * index);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, WRMPYA), a);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, WRMPYB), by);
  return (uint16_t)(a * by);
}

void hm_LoadQueuedSpritePieces(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  *hm_dp(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT_AT_BANK) = 0x80;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, COPY_AT, 0);
  for (;;) {
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, QUEUE_IN);
    if (r->a == hm_dp_r16(ram, r, QUEUE_OUT)) break;
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET);
    if (r->a < 0x0100) break;

    uint16_t at = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, QUEUE_OUT);
    r->x = at;
    uint16_t piece = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (PIECE_QUEUE + at) & 0xFFFFFF);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_PIECE, piece);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT_AT, hm_bus_rd16(ram, (PIECE_QUEUE + QUEUE_SLOT_AT + at) & 0xFFFFFF));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_LOAD_BUDGET) - 0x0100));
    uint16_t next = (uint16_t)(at + 4);
    if (next == 0x0100) next = 0;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, QUEUE_OUT, next);
    uint16_t from = (uint16_t)((hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, SEARCH_FROM)) & 0x3F) + 1);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, SEARCH_FROM), from);

    uint16_t handed = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_db(r, NEW_SLOTS));
    if (handed != 0x0040) {
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT, handed);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT4, (uint16_t)(handed << 2));
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, NEW_SLOTS), (uint16_t)(handed + 1));
    } else {
      uint16_t x = (uint16_t)(from << 2);
      for (r->y = 0; hm_bus_rd16(ram, (SLOT_USERS + x) & 0xFFFFFF) != 0; ) {
        x = (uint16_t)((x + 4) & 0xFF);
        if (++r->y == 0x40) trap();
      }
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT4, x);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT, (uint16_t)(x >> 2));
    }
    uint16_t slot4 = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT4);
    if (slot4 & 0x8000) trap();
    uint16_t slot = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT_AT, 0), (uint8_t)slot);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, LOAD_VRAM) = (uint8_t)slot;
    *hm_dp(ram, r, LOAD_VRAM + 1) = 0;

    r->x = slot4;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (SLOT_USERS + slot4) & 0xFFFFFF, 0x0001);
    uint16_t old = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (SLOT_USERS + SLOT_PIECE + slot4) & 0xFFFFFF);
    if (old != 0xFFFF) {
      push16(ram, r, slot4);                               /* PHX ... PLX */
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, (PIECE_SLOT + old) & 0xFFFFFF, 0xFF);
      pull16(ram, r);
    }
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (SLOT_USERS + SLOT_PIECE + slot4) & 0xFFFFFF, piece);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, (PIECE_SLOT + piece) & 0xFFFFFF, (uint8_t)(slot4 >> 2));

    /* the piece's number: bits 0-5 the graphics, 6-7 a $2000 part, 8-9 the bank */
    uint16_t high = (uint16_t)(piece & 0xFFC0);
    uint16_t part = (uint16_t)(high >> 6);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, (uint16_t)((part >> 2) << 2));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT, (uint16_t)((part >> 2) + 0x88));
    uint16_t low = (uint16_t)(piece - high);
    uint16_t source = graphics_times(ram, r, low, 0x20);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_PIECE, source);
    uint16_t base = (uint16_t)((part & 3) << 13);       /* Table_of_Multof2000 */
    uint16_t sum = (uint16_t)(source + base + 0x8000);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT4, sum);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LOAD_VRAM, graphics_times(ram, r, slot & 0xFF, 0x10));

    uint16_t bf = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, COPY_AT);
    r->x = bf;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_LOAD_COPIES) + bf) & 0xFFFFFF, sum);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_LOAD_COPIES) + COPY_BANK + bf) & 0xFFFFFF, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, LOAD_SLOT));
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_LOAD_COPIES) + COPY_VRAM + bf) & 0xFFFFFF, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, LOAD_VRAM));
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_LOAD_COPIES) + COPY_SIZE + bf) & 0xFFFFFF, 0xFFFF);
    bf = (uint16_t)(bf + COPY_SIZE);
    if (bf == 0x00C0) trap();
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, COPY_AT, bf);
  }
  uint8_t bb = *hm_dp(ram, r, QUEUE_OUT), bd = *hm_dp(ram, r, QUEUE_IN);
  uint8_t left = (uint8_t)(bb >= bd ? bb - bd : bd - bb);
  r->c = (left >> 1) & 1;
  left = (uint8_t)(left >> 2);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | left);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, QUEUE_LEFT), left);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, QUEUE_LEFT + 1), 0);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PrepareOAMData ($85:83E0, JSL, RTL): the sprite table for this frame.
 * The WRAM copy of the OAM is emptied (ClearOAMCopyAgain) and the
 * objects put in drawing order ($084C, GetOBJOrderToDraw). Then, object by
 * object in that order (only the records in use), piece by piece from the
 * last to the first (pieces not loaded, $FF, are skipped):
 *   - the screen position: the object's ($9B, $9D) + the piece's offset in
 *     the sprite's piece list (signed bytes +2 / +3, mirrored by the flip
 *     $9F: InvertIfFlippedX / Y) - the camera ($F5, $F7);
 *   - a piece outside the screen (X not in -16..255, Y not in -16..239) is
 *     left out;
 *   - its 4 bytes at $7E:A000 + $AF: X, Y, the graphics slot's tile number
 *     ($86:8000 + 2 x slot) and the attributes: the palette (byte +4: bits
 *     0-2 x 2), the flip (bits 4-5 to 6-7), priority 2, xor the object's
 *     flip, | the graphic preset ($0195) x 16; the high table at
 *     $7E:A200 + $AF / 16 gets the X high bit ($85:8BD0).
 * Last, the DMA of the table to OAM is set up on channel 4 ($7E:A000, $220
 * bytes, OAM address 0) and flagged in $9A for the NMI.
 * Leftovers: A = $9A's new value with $AF's high byte, X = $220, Y = the
 * object count ($DC), C = 1 (CPY $DC); $AF = $084A = the table's size used.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void set_piece_bank(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t sprite)
{
  uint8_t bank = sprite >= FIRST_SPRITE_87 ? 0x87 : 0x86;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((sprite & 0xFF00) | bank);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SPRITE_ENTRY_BANK) = bank;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, PIECE_LIST_BANK) = bank;
}
/* the gobj record offset of the object drawn n-th */
static uint16_t ordered(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n)
{
  r->x = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_x(r, DRAW_ORDER, n)) << 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, GOBJ_OFFSETS + r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET, r->a);
  return r->a;
}
/* a piece's offset byte, sign-extended, through InvertIfFliped X / Y */
static uint16_t piece_offset(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint16_t ret, void (*flip)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  int8_t off = (int8_t)hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, PIECE_LIST, y));
  r->a = (uint16_t)(int16_t)off;
  push16(ram, r, ret);                                     /* JSR */
  flip(ram, r);
  pull16(ram, r);
  return r->a;
}

void hm_PrepareOAMData(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_piece_bank(ram, r, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_SPRITE));
  push16(ram, r, 0x8401); hm_ClearOAMCopyAgain(ram, r); pull16(ram, r);
  push16(ram, r, 0x8404); hm_GetOBJOrderToDraw(ram, r); pull16(ram, r);

  ordered(ram, r, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_INDEX, 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OAM_USED, 0);
  uint16_t y = 0;
  for (;;) {
    uint16_t obj = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
    r->x = obj;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS, obj));
    if (r->a == 0) {                                       /* not in use: the next one */
      for (;;) {
        y++;
        ordered(ram, r, y);
        r->c = y >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT);
        if (y == hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT)) goto done;
        r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
        r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS, r->x));
        if (r->a) break;
      }
      obj = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
    }
    /* an object */
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OBJ_INDEX, y);
    r->x = obj;
    set_piece_bank(ram, r, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_SPRITE, obj)));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PIECE_LIST, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_LIST, obj)));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_FLIP, obj)));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_X, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_X, obj)));
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_Y, hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_Y, obj)));
    *hm_dp(ram, r, PIECES_LEFT) = hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_COUNT, obj));
    *hm_dp(ram, r, PIECES_LEFT + 1) = 0;
    /* the last piece's entry: list + 1 + 5 (n - 1) */
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PIECE_LIST, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECE_LIST) + 1));
    uint16_t n1 = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECES_LEFT) - 1);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, n1);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_80, (uint16_t)(n1 << 1));
    uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(n1 << 1) + n1;                 /* CLC; ADC $7E */
    s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)s + (uint16_t)(n1 << 1) + (s > 0xFFFF);  /* ADC $80 */
    s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)s + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECE_LIST) + (s > 0xFFFF); /* ADC $78 */
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PIECE_LIST, (uint16_t)s);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OAM_PIECE_AT, (uint16_t)(obj + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECES_LEFT) - 1)); /* the last piece */
    r->c = 1;                                              /* SBC #1: no borrow */

    for (;;) {                                             /* the pieces, last to first */
      y = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_INDEX);
      r->y = y;
      r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECES_LEFT);
      if (r->a == 0) break;
      r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OAM_PIECE_AT);
      uint8_t slot = hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS + GOBJ_PIECE_SLOTS, r->x));
      if (slot != 0xFF) {
        uint16_t dx = piece_offset(ram, r, PIECE_DX, 0x84D6, hm_InvertIfFlippedX);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SCREEN_X, (uint16_t)(dx + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_X) - hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_X)));
        uint16_t dy = piece_offset(ram, r, PIECE_DY, 0x84F7, hm_InvertIfFlippedY);
        uint32_t fy = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(dy + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_OBJ_Y)) - hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_Y);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SCREEN_Y, (uint16_t)fy);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_C5, 3);
        /* the high table: bits for 4 sprites a byte, 16 bytes a word */
        uint16_t at = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OAM_USED);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, (uint16_t)(at & 0xFFE0));
        uint16_t word = (uint16_t)((at & 0xFFE0) >> 4);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_80, word);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEMP_7E, (uint16_t)(at - (at & 0xFFE0)));
        uint16_t high = hm_bus_rd16(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY_HIGH) + word) & 0xFFFFFF);
        hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OAM_HIGH_BITS, high);
        uint16_t fx = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SCREEN_X);
        r->x = word;
        if (fx >= 0x0100) {
          r->x = (uint16_t)((hm_dp_r16(ram, r, TEMP_7E) & 0xFFFC) >> 1);
          high |= hm_bus_rd16(ram, HIGH_X_BITS + r->x);
          hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OAM_HIGH_BITS, high);
        }
        uint16_t fyv = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SCREEN_Y);
        bool on_screen = (fx < g_hm_oam_right || fx >= g_hm_oam_left) && (fyv < 0x00F0 || fyv >= 0xFFF0);
        if (on_screen) {
          r->x = at;
          hm_bus_wr8(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) + at) & 0xFFFFFF, (uint8_t)fx);
          hm_bus_wr8(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) + OAM_Y_BYTE + at) & 0xFFFFFF, (uint8_t)fyv);
          hm_bus_wr16(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY_HIGH) + word) & 0xFFFFFF, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OAM_HIGH_BITS));
          uint8_t b = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, PIECE_LIST, PIECE_ATTR));
          *hm_dp(ram, r, OAM_FLIP_BITS) = b;
          *hm_dp(ram, r, OAM_PALETTE) = (uint8_t)((b << 1) & 0x0E); /* the palette */
          uint8_t f = (uint8_t)(((uint8_t)(b << 2) & 0xC0) >> 1);
          *hm_dp(ram, r, OAM_FLIP_BITS) = f;
          uint8_t attr = (uint8_t)(((uint8_t)(f << 2) | f) & 0xC0);
          attr = (uint8_t)((attr | *hm_dp(ram, r, OAM_PALETTE) | 0x20) ^ *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_OBJ_FLIP));
          hm_bus_wr8(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) + OAM_ATTR_BYTE + at) & 0xFFFFFF, attr);
          uint8_t preset = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, abs_db(r, HM_GRAPHIC_PRESET)) << 4);
          attr = (uint8_t)(preset | hm_bus_rd8(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) + OAM_ATTR_BYTE + at) & 0xFFFFFF));
          hm_bus_wr8(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) + OAM_ATTR_BYTE + at) & 0xFFFFFF, attr);
          r->y = 4;
          r->x = (uint16_t)(slot << 1);
          r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SLOT_TILES + r->x);
          r->x = at;
          hm_bus_wr8(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) + OAM_TILE_BYTE + at) & 0xFFFFFF, (uint8_t)r->a);
          hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OAM_USED, (uint16_t)(at + 4));
        }
      }
      r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECE_LIST) - PIECE_ENTRY_SIZE); /* the piece before */
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PIECE_LIST, r->a);
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OAM_PIECE_AT, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OAM_PIECE_AT) - 1));
      hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PIECES_LEFT, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, PIECES_LEFT) - 1));
    }
    /* no pieces left: the next object (Y = $AB) */
    for (;;) {
      y++;
      ordered(ram, r, y);
      r->c = y >= hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT);
      if (y == hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GOBJ_COUNT)) goto done;
      r->x = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OBJ_OFFSET);
      r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, abs_x(r, HM_GAME_OBJECTS, r->x));
      if (r->a) break;
    }
  }
done:
  r->y = y;
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, OAM_USED);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, HM_OAM_SIZE_USED), r->a);
  r->x = 0;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, OAMADDL), 0);                /* OAM address 0 */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, DMAP4), 0x00);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, BBAD4), 0x04);                 /* OAMDATA */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, A1T4L), (uint8_t)WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, A1T4H), (uint8_t)(WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) >> 8));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, abs_db(r, A1B4), (uint8_t)(WRAM_LONG(HM_OAM_COPY) >> 16));
  r->x = 0x0220;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, abs_db(r, DAS4L), 0x0220);
  uint8_t flag = (uint8_t)(*hm_dp(ram, r, NMI_DMA_CHANNELS) | 0x10);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | flag);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, NMI_DMA_CHANNELS) = flag;
}

```

`src/palette.c`:

```c
/*
 * palette.c — the colours: the palette of each hour and its slow change.
 *
 * The game keeps three copies of the 256 colours (CGRAM) in WRAM:
 *
 *   $7F:0900  what is sent to the console (by DMA, after a change)
 *   $7F:0B00  a palette being prepared (the target of a change, or the
 *             sprite colours of the next map)
 *   $7F:0D00  the colours shown now, used to compute the next step
 *
 * Every map has five palettes, one per part of the day (Time_Palette_Table,
 * $80:BB5C, 6 bytes per map: before 7:00, 7-14, 15-16, 17, 18 and later;
 * $FF = keep the one there is). When the hour changes part,
 * SetTimeOfDayPalette points $04-$06 at the new palette and
 * TransitionTimeOfDayPalettes moves each colour one step (of 32) towards it
 * every 32 frames, until all are equal.
 *
 * A colour is 15 bits: red in bits 0-4, green 5-9, blue 10-14.
 * PalettePointerTable ($80:B9FD) has a 24-bit pointer per palette (3 bytes
 * each).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

#define PALETTE_POINTERS   0x80B9FD   /* PalettePointerTable: 3 bytes per palette */
#define TIME_PALETTES      0x80BB5C   /* 6 bytes per map */
#define SPRITE_COLOURS     0x80BD9C   /* UNK_Table9: 3 colours per season / time */
#define CHILD_COLOURS      0x80BDFC   /* UNK_Table10: 3 colours per baby stage */
#define SPRITE_PALETTES    0xBE44     /* UNK_Table11 (read with the data bank) */

#define PREPARED   0x7F0B00   /* a palette being prepared */
#define SHOWN      0x7F0D00   /* the colours shown now */

#define COUNTDOWN  0x017A   /* frames until the next step (to 32) */
#define NEXT       0x017C   /* the palette being moved to */

/* Direct page */
#define PALETTE_TARGET   0x04   /* 24b $04-$06: the palette the colours move to (0 = none) */
#define PALETTE_TARGET_BANK 0x06
#define DMA_CHANNEL      0x27   /* 8b: AddProgrammedDMA's channel (dma.c) */
#define DMA_B_ADDRESS    0x29   /* 8b: its destination register (B-bus, $21xx) */
#define PALETTE_PTR      0x72   /* 24b $72-$74: the palette being copied; the DMA's source */
#define PALETTE_PTR_BANK 0x74
#define COLOURS_END      0x84   /* 16b: TransitionTimeOfDayPalettes: bytes of colours to move */
/* $92 means a different thing in each routine: */
#define CHANGED          0x92   /* 8b: TransitionTimeOfDayPalettes: 1 = a colour moved */
#define TO_PREPARED      0x92   /* 8b: SetPaletteColour(NoFade), CustomiseSpritePalette:
                                   0 = into HM_CGRAM_SHADOW, else into PREPARED (the night colours) */
/* $7E-$82 are scratch, named per routine: */
#define RED              0x7E   /* 16b: TransitionTimeOfDayPalettes: the colour's red, */
#define GREEN            0x80   /*      its green */
#define BLUE             0x82   /*      and its blue */
#define PART             0x7E   /* 16b: time_palette: the part of the day */
#define MAP_NUMBER       0x80   /* 16b: time_palette, PrepareNightPalette: the map */
#define PALETTE_NUM      0x7E   /* 16b: the palette loaded or moved to */
#define COLOUR_ROW       0x7E   /* 16b: colour_index: the palette row (Y) */
#define COLOUR_OFFSET    0x80   /* 16b: colour_index: 2 x the colour (X) */
#define COLOUR_VALUE     0x82   /* 16b: colour_index: the colour (A) */
#define COPY_END         0x7E   /* 16b: copy_half: $100, the bytes to copy */
#define NIGHT_OFFSET     0x7E   /* 16b: CustomiseSpritePalette: 4 / 6 at night, else 0 */
#define TABLE_INDEX      0x80   /* CustomiseSpritePalette: the entry of the colour table */
#define SEASON_INDEX     0x82   /* 16b: CustomiseSpritePalette: the season (or the map - 8) */

static uint32_t db_addr(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint16_t dp16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a) { return hm_dp_r16(ram, r, a); }
static void set16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a, uint16_t v) { hm_dp_w16(ram, r, a, v); }
static uint8_t lda8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
  return v;
}
static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}

/* palette n -> $72-$74 (or `at`): LDA n; ASL; CLC; ADC n; TAX; ... */
static void palette_pointer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n, unsigned at)
{
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)(n * 3);
  r->c = 0;                                   /* n * 3 never carries here */
  r->x = x;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, PALETTE_POINTERS + x);
  set16(ram, r, at, r->a);
  r->x = x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
  lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, PALETTE_POINTERS + x));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, at + 2) = (uint8_t)r->a;
}

/* the part of the day: 0 before 7:00, 1 7-14, 2 15-16, 3 17, 4 from 18:00 */
static uint16_t part_of_day(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint8_t starts[4] = { 7, 15, 17, 18 };
  uint8_t h = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR)));
  uint16_t x = 0;
  for (; x < 4; x++) {
    r->c = h >= starts[x];
    if (!r->c) break;
  }
  return r->x = x;
}
/* the map's palette for the part of the day: X = $22 * 6 + part */
static uint8_t time_palette(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t part)
{
  set16(ram, r, PART, part);                              /* STX $7E */
  uint16_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);               /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $22 */
  set16(ram, r, MAP_NUMBER, map);
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(map << 2) + map;       /* ASL; ASL; CLC; ADC $80 */
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + map + (s > 0xFFFF);                   /* ADC $80 */
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + part + (s > 0xFFFF);                  /* ADC $7E */
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  r->x = (uint16_t)s;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, TIME_PALETTES + r->x);            /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA.L */
  return (uint8_t)r->a;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SetTimeOfDayPalette ($80:8FC7): start moving to palette A (8 bits).
 * From 18:00 the target is not a palette of the table but $7F:0B00 (the
 * night colours prepared there).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SetTimeOfDayPalette(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)r->a;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, NEXT), n);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, COUNTDOWN), 0);
  r->a = n;                                               /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA */
  set16(ram, r, PALETTE_NUM, n);
  uint8_t h = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR)));
  r->c = h >= 0x12;
  if (r->c) {
    set16(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET, (uint16_t)PREPARED);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET_BANK) = (uint8_t)(PREPARED >> 16);
    r->a = 0x0B7F;
    return;
  }
  palette_pointer(ram, r, n, PALETTE_TARGET);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * TransitionTimeOfDayPalettes ($80:900C), every frame while time runs.
 * Every 32 frames each colour moves one step in red, green and blue towards
 * the target palette [$04]. Only colour 0 and the colours from 12 on (from
 * 16 on when bit 2 of $0196 is clear) are moved: colours 1-11 are left
 * alone. Before 18:00 the first 128 colours (the backgrounds) change, from
 * 18:00 all 256 (the sprites too). When nothing changed any more, the
 * target is dropped and the new palette is noted as loaded.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint16_t step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t now, uint16_t target, unsigned at)
{
  set16(ram, r, at, now);
  r->a = target;
  r->c = target >= now;
  if (target == now) return now;
  now = (uint16_t)(target > now ? now + 1 : now - 1);
  set16(ram, r, at, now);
  lda8(r, 1);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANGED) = 1;
  return now;
}

void hm_FinishTimeOfDayPalette(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set16(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET, 0);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET_BANK) = 0;
  uint8_t next = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, NEXT)));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_LOADED_PALETTE), next);
}

void hm_TransitionTimeOfDayPalettes(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!(lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_TIME_RUNNING))) & 1)) { /* time stopped */
    lda8(r, 0);
    return;
  }
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET);
  if (r->a == 0 && lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET_BANK)) == 0) return; /* nothing to do */
  uint8_t count = lda8(r, (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, COUNTDOWN)) + 1));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, COUNTDOWN), count);
  r->c = count >= 0x20;
  if (count != 0x20) return;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, COUNTDOWN), 0);

  set16(ram, r, COLOURS_END, r->a = 0x0100);
  uint8_t h = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR)));
  r->c = h >= 18;
  if (r->c) set16(ram, r, COLOURS_END, r->a = 0x0200);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANGED) = 0;

  uint16_t y = 0;
  do {
    r->c = y >= 2;
    if (y == 2) {
      y = 0x18;
      r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS)) & 0x0004;
      if (r->a == 0) y = 0x20;
    }
    r->x = y;
    uint32_t from = hm_dp_long(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET, y);
    uint16_t now = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SHOWN + y);
    uint16_t want = hm_bus_rd16(ram, from);
    step(ram, r, now & 0x001F, want & 0x001F, RED);
    step(ram, r, (now & 0x03E0) >> 5, (want & 0x03E0) >> 5, GREEN);
    step(ram, r, (now & 0x7C00) >> 10, (want & 0x7C00) >> 10, BLUE);
    /* ASL $80 x5, ASL $82 x10, then red | green | blue */
    set16(ram, r, GREEN, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, GREEN) << 5));
    set16(ram, r, BLUE, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, BLUE) << 10));
    r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, RED) | dp16(ram, r, GREEN) | dp16(ram, r, BLUE));
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_CGRAM_SHADOW) + y, r->a);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, SHOWN + y, r->a);
    y = (uint16_t)(y + 2);
    r->c = y >= dp16(ram, r, COLOURS_END);
  } while (y != dp16(ram, r, COLOURS_END));
  r->y = y;

  if (lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, CHANGED)) == 0) {            /* all equal: done */
    hm_FinishTimeOfDayPalette(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  /* send the colours: channel 6, to $2122 (CGRAM), from $7F:0900 */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = 6;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS) = BBAD_CGDATA;
  r->y = dp16(ram, r, COLOURS_END);
  r->x = 0;
  set16(ram, r, PALETTE_PTR, (uint16_t)WRAM_LONG(HM_CGRAM_SHADOW));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, PALETTE_PTR_BANK) = (uint8_t)(WRAM_LONG(HM_CGRAM_SHADOW) >> 16);
  r->a = 0x097F;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9155, 0x80);
  hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ClearTimeOfDayPalette ($80:9166): drop the target palette. */
void hm_ClearTimeOfDayPalette(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set16(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET, 0);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, PALETTE_TARGET_BANK) = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SetPaletteColour / SetPaletteColourNoFade ($80:916F / $80:919D): put colour A as colour X
 * of palette row Y (16 rows of 16). With $92 = 0 it goes to $7F:0900
 * (SetPaletteColourNoFade: and to $7F:0D00, so it is not faded away); otherwise only to
 * the prepared palette $7F:0B00.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static uint16_t colour_index(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set16(ram, r, COLOUR_VALUE, r->a);
  set16(ram, r, COLOUR_ROW, r->y);
  set16(ram, r, COLOUR_OFFSET, (uint16_t)(r->x << 1));
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(r->y << 5) + dp16(ram, r, COLOUR_OFFSET);
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = r->x = (uint16_t)s;                              /* TAX */
  lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, TO_PREPARED));
  return r->x;
}
void hm_SetPaletteColour(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t x = colour_index(ram, r);
  bool prepared = (uint8_t)r->a != 0;
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, COLOUR_VALUE);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, ((prepared ? PREPARED : WRAM_LONG(HM_CGRAM_SHADOW)) + x) & 0xFFFFFF, r->a);
}
void hm_SetPaletteColourNoFade(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t x = colour_index(ram, r);
  bool prepared = (uint8_t)r->a != 0;
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, COLOUR_VALUE);
  if (prepared) {
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (PREPARED + x) & 0xFFFFFF, r->a);
  } else {
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (WRAM_LONG(HM_CGRAM_SHADOW) + x) & 0xFFFFFF, r->a);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (SHOWN + x) & 0xFFFFFF, r->a);
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Loading a whole half (128 colours) of palette A: the first half
 * (backgrounds) or the second (sprites), into $7F:0900 and $7F:0D00.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void copy_half(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t to, uint16_t x, bool also_shown)
{
  set16(ram, r, COPY_END, 0x0100);
  uint16_t y = 0;
  do {
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, PALETTE_PTR, y));
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, to + x, r->a);
    if (also_shown) hm_bus_wr16(ram, SHOWN + x, r->a);
    y = (uint16_t)(y + 2);
    x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
  } while (y != 0x0100);
  r->c = 1;                                               /* CPY $7E: equal */
  r->x = x;
  r->y = y;
}
void hm_LoadFirstHalfPaletteToWRAM(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set16(ram, r, PALETTE_NUM, r->a);
  palette_pointer(ram, r, r->a, PALETTE_PTR);
  copy_half(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_CGRAM_SHADOW), 0x0000, true);
}
void hm_LoadSecondHalfPaletteToWRAM(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set16(ram, r, PALETTE_NUM, r->a);
  palette_pointer(ram, r, r->a, PALETTE_PTR);
  copy_half(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_CGRAM_SHADOW), 0x0100, true);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CustomiseSpritePalette ($80:93A4; HM-Decomp's comment says 93A3, which is
 * the RTL before it): three colours of sprite row 15 (10-12) depend on the
 * season (or, on the mountain maps $10-$13, on the map) and on the night;
 * if the wife is pregnant or there is a child, three colours of row 11
 * (8-10) depend on the stage (bits 0-4 of $7F1F66) and on the night.
 * "Night" here is: $92 set, or from 18:00 on a map below $15 or from $31.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static bool night_colours(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, TO_PREPARED)) != 0) return true;
  uint8_t h = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR)));
  r->c = h >= 18;
  if (!r->c) return false;
  uint8_t map = lda8(r, *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID));
  r->c = map >= 0x31;
  if (r->c) return true;
  r->c = map >= 0x15;
  return !r->c;
}
static void three_colours(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t table, uint16_t x, uint16_t first,
                          uint16_t row, const uint16_t ret[3])
{
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    if (i) x = (uint16_t)(pull16(ram, r) + 2);
    r->x = x;
    if (i < 2) push16(ram, r, x);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, table + x);
    r->x = (uint16_t)(first + i);
    r->y = row;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, ret[i], 0x80);
    hm_SetPaletteColourNoFade(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
}
void hm_CustomiseSpritePalette(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t RET_SEASON[3] = { 0x9413, 0x9427, 0x943A };
  static const uint16_t RET_CHILD[3] = { 0x94D8, 0x94EC, 0x94FF };
  set16(ram, r, NIGHT_OFFSET, 0);
  if (night_colours(ram, r)) set16(ram, r, NIGHT_OFFSET, r->a = 0x0004);

  /* the season, or the mountain map */
  r->a = 0;                                               /* LDA #0; XBA */
  uint8_t map = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_MAP_ID)));
  r->c = map >= 4;
  bool mountain = false;
  if (r->c) {
    r->c = map >= 0x10;
    if (r->c) { r->c = map >= 0x14; mountain = !r->c; }
  }
  if (mountain) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(map - 8);                           /* SEC; SBC #8 */
    r->c = 1;
  } else {
    lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)));
  }
  set16(ram, r, SEASON_INDEX, r->a);

  /* X = ((v * 2) + the word at $80) * 2, v = $82 + $7E (8 bits) */
  uint16_t s8 = (uint16_t)(*hm_dp(ram, r, SEASON_INDEX) + *hm_dp(ram, r, NIGHT_OFFSET));
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)s8;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, TABLE_INDEX) = v;
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(v << 1) + dp16(ram, r, TABLE_INDEX);
  three_colours(ram, r, SPRITE_COLOURS, (uint16_t)(s << 1), 0x0A, 0x0F, RET_SEASON);

  /* the baby / child */
  set16(ram, r, NIGHT_OFFSET, 0);
  if (night_colours(ram, r)) set16(ram, r, NIGHT_OFFSET, r->a = 0x0006);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAYS_MARRIED));
  if (r->a == 0) return;
  uint16_t stage = 0;
  for (unsigned bit = 0; bit < 5 && !stage; bit++) {
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & (uint16_t)(1u << bit);
    if (r->a) stage = (uint16_t)(bit + 1);
  }
  if (!stage) return;
  uint16_t n = (uint16_t)(stage + dp16(ram, r, NIGHT_OFFSET)); /* CLC; ADC $7E */
  set16(ram, r, TABLE_INDEX, n);
  uint32_t t = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(n << 1) + n;          /* ASL; CLC; ADC $80 */
  three_colours(ram, r, CHILD_COLOURS, (uint16_t)((uint16_t)t << 1), 0x08, 0x0B, RET_CHILD);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PrepareNightPalette ($80:9241): prepares the night palette of the map
 * in $7F:0B00: the backgrounds from the map's "18:00 and later" palette and
 * the sprites from its night sprite palette (UNK_Table11), then the
 * customised sprite colours (with $92 = 1, into $7F:0B00 too).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PrepareNightPalette(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set16(ram, r, MAP_NUMBER, map);
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(map << 2) + map;
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + map + (s > 0xFFFF);
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + 4 + (s > 0xFFFF);
  r->x = (uint16_t)s;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, TIME_PALETTES + r->x);
  set16(ram, r, PALETTE_NUM, r->a);
  palette_pointer(ram, r, r->a, PALETTE_PTR);
  copy_half(ram, r, PREPARED, 0x0000, false);

  r->a = 0;
  uint16_t m2 = (uint16_t)(*hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID) << 1); /* ASL (8 bits) */
  r->c = m2 > 0xFF;
  r->x = (uint16_t)((m2 & 0xFF) + 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(SPRITE_PALETTES + r->x)));
  set16(ram, r, PALETTE_NUM, r->a);
  palette_pointer(ram, r, r->a, PALETTE_PTR);
  copy_half(ram, r, PREPARED, 0x0100, false);

  lda8(r, 1);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, TO_PREPARED) = 1;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x92E0, 0x80);
  hm_CustomiseSpritePalette(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ChangePaletteByTime ($80:92E2): load the map's palette for this part of
 * the day (backgrounds) and note it as loaded. */
void hm_ChangePaletteByTime(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t n = time_palette(ram, r, part_of_day(ram, r));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_LOADED_PALETTE), n);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9327, 0x80);
  hm_LoadFirstHalfPaletteToWRAM(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* PrepareSpritePalette ($80:9329): the sprites' half of the palette: the
 * map's (day or night) or, with bits $80 / $100 / $200 of $7F1F5E, palette
 * $71 / $72 / $73; then the customised colours. */
void hm_PrepareSpritePalette(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t special[3] = { 0x0080, 0x0100, 0x0200 };
  static const uint16_t ret_load[3] = { 0x9376, 0x9388, 0x939A };
  static const uint16_t ret_custom[3] = { 0x937E, 0x9390, 0x93A2 };
  uint16_t ret1 = 0x9364, ret2 = 0x936C;
  int which = -1;
  for (int i = 0; i < 3 && which < 0; i++) {
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5E)) & special[i];
    if (r->a) which = i;
  }
  if (which >= 0) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(0x71 + which);
    ret1 = ret_load[which];
    ret2 = ret_custom[which];
  } else {
    r->a = 0;
    uint16_t m2 = (uint16_t)(*hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID) << 1); /* ASL (8 bits) */
    r->x = (uint16_t)(m2 & 0xFF);
    uint8_t h = lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR)));
    r->c = h >= 0x12;
    if (r->c) r->x++;
    r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(SPRITE_PALETTES + r->x)));
  }
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret1, 0x80);
  hm_LoadSecondHalfPaletteToWRAM(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, TO_PREPARED) = 0;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret2, 0x80);
  hm_CustomiseSpritePalette(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* SetPaletteToLoad ($80:9501): when the part of the day changes the map's
 * palette (and it is not $FF), start moving to it. */
void hm_SetPaletteToLoad(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t n = time_palette(ram, r, part_of_day(ram, r));
  uint8_t loaded = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_LOADED_PALETTE));
  r->c = n >= loaded;
  if (n == loaded) return;
  r->c = n >= 0xFF;
  if (n == 0xFF) return;
  hm_push8(ram, r, n);                                    /* PHA */
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x954B, 0x80);
  hm_SetTimeOfDayPalette(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  lda8(r, hm_pull8(ram, r));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_LOADED_PALETTE), (uint8_t)r->a);
}

/* Event_TimeOfDayPalette ($84:9356, JSR): script command "move to palette
 * <byte>". */
void hm_Event_TimeOfDayPalette(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t pc = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS) + 1);
  set16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, pc);
  r->a = pc;
  lda8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, 0)));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9369, 0x80);
  hm_SetTimeOfDayPalette(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  uint16_t after = dp16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS);
  r->c = after == 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(after + 1);
  set16(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_POS, r->a);
}
```

`src/people.c`:

```c
/*
 * people.c — the girls, the wife and the children.
 *
 * Hearts: 16-bit, 0..999, at $7F1F1F + 2 i for i = Maria, Ann, Nina,
 * Ellen, Eve (HM_HEARTS_BASE). The wife: $7F1F66 bits 0..4 in the same
 * order (only one is ever set).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* The game's saved state, $7F:1Fxx (ram[] offsets 0x11Fxx) */
#define CHILD1         0x0004
#define CHILD2         0x0008
#define CHILD_BORN     0x0010

/* WRAM of the data bank */
#define MOST_LOVED_NAME 0x008A1  /* 5 x 16b: the text codes of a name */

/* Direct page: $7E is named by its role in each routine */
#define DIVIDEND       0x7E      /* 16b: DivisionUnsigned's dividend, then the
                                    remainder (math.c) */
#define DIVISOR        0x80      /* 16b */
#define MOST_HEARTS    0x7E      /* 16b: FindMostLovedName's result (= DIVIDEND) */
#define AFFECTION_IN   0x7E      /* 16b: AffectionToHearts' A (= DIVIDEND) */

/* ROM tables */
#define HEART_RANGES   0x81D1E8  /* per heart: from, to (words) */

enum { MARIA, ANN, NINA, ELLEN, EVE, GIRLS };

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * FindMostLovedName ($82:8EC6, JSL, RTL; no compiled body). Writes the name
 * of the girl with the most hearts into $08A1-$08AA (five 16-bit text
 * codes; see the text encoding in hm_ram.h's notes: a-z = 00-19, A-Z =
 * 1A-33, B1 = space). On a tie the later girl in the list wins (BCS).
 * HM-Decomp's branch labels are swapped: index 1 writes "Ann", 2 "Nina".
 * Leftovers: $7E = the most hearts, X = $0A, Y = the girl, A = the last
 * code written, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static const uint16_t kGirlNames[GIRLS][5] = {
  { 0x26, 0x00, 0x11, 0x08, 0x00 },   /* "Maria" */
  { 0x1A, 0x0D, 0x0D, 0xB1, 0xB1 },   /* "Ann  " */
  { 0x27, 0x08, 0x0D, 0x00, 0xB1 },   /* "Nina " */
  { 0x1E, 0x0B, 0x0B, 0x04, 0x0D },   /* "Ellen" */
  { 0x1E, 0x15, 0x04, 0xB1, 0xB1 },   /* "Eve  " */
};

void hm_FindMostLovedName(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t best = hm_rd16(ram, HM_HEARTS_BASE);
  unsigned girl = MARIA;
  for (unsigned i = 1; i < GIRLS; i++) {
    uint16_t hearts = hm_rd16(ram, HM_HEARTS_BASE + 2 * i);
    if (hearts >= best) { best = hearts; girl = i; }
  }
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MOST_HEARTS, best);
  for (unsigned k = 0; k < 5; k++)
    hm_wr16(ram, MOST_LOVED_NAME + 2 * k, kGirlNames[girl][k]);
  r->a = kGirlNames[girl][4];
  r->x = 0x0A;
  r->y = (uint16_t)girl;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * WifePregnancyAndChildren ($82:8790, JSL, RTL; no compiled body). Once
 * married, every night:
 *  - $7F1F3B (days married) + 1; every 120th day sets $7F1F6C bit $0080
 *    (the wedding anniversary).
 *  - First child ($7F1F6E bit $0004): the wife needs 450 hearts; second
 *    (bit $0008): 650 hearts and the first child 90 days old. Both need 20
 *    days of marriage and the house at level 2 ($7F1F64 bit $0080).
 *  - A child's age ($7F1F37 / $7F1F39) counts up from conception: at 60
 *    days it is born ($7F1F6E bit $0010, player's happiness +50 / +100;
 *    the first child's birth night skips the second child's count), and
 *    every 120 days after that it has a birthday ($7F1F6C bit $0100/$0200).
 *  - $7F1F6C bits $0080, $0100, $0200 are cleared first: they last a day.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* $7E = n; $80 = 120; JSL DivisionUnsigned. True if n is a multiple of 120. */
static bool every_120_days(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n, uint16_t ret)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DIVIDEND, n);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DIVISOR, 120);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
  hm_DivisionUnsigned(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, DIVIDEND);            /* LDA $7E: the remainder */
  return r->a == 0;
}

static void set_flag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t at, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, at) | bit;
  hm_wr16(ram, at, r->a);
}

/* A child's day. Returns true when it was born tonight (the routine then
 * stops). */
static bool child_day(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t age_at, int16_t joy,
                      uint16_t ret_joy, uint16_t ret_div, uint16_t birthday_bit)
{
  uint16_t age = (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, age_at) + 1);
  hm_wr16(ram, age_at, age);
  r->a = age;
  r->c = age >= 60;
  if (age < 60) return false;
  if (age == 60) {
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6E, CHILD_BORN);
    r->a = (uint16_t)joy;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, ret_joy, 0x83);
    hm_AddPlayerHappiness(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    return true;
  }
  if (every_120_days(ram, r, (uint16_t)(age - 60), ret_div))
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6C, birthday_bit);
  return false;
}

void hm_WifePregnancyAndChildren(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6C, hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6C) & 0xFC7F);
  uint16_t wife = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_66);
  unsigned who = GIRLS;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < GIRLS && who == GIRLS; i++)
    if (wife & (1u << i)) who = i;
  r->a = wife & (1u << (who == GIRLS ? 4 : who));
  if (who == GIRLS) return;                      /* not married */

  uint16_t days = (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_DAYS_MARRIED) + 1);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_DAYS_MARRIED, days);
  if (every_120_days(ram, r, days, 0x87E2))
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6C, 0x0080);
  r->a = wife & (1u << who);

  /* Another child? */
  bool second = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & CHILD1;
  uint16_t hearts = hm_rd16(ram, HM_HEARTS_BASE + 2 * who);
  r->a = hearts;
  r->c = hearts >= (second ? 650 : 450);
  if (r->c) {
    r->c = days >= 20;
    if (r->c && (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_64) & 0x0080)) {
      if (!(hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & CHILD1)) {
        set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6E, CHILD1);
      } else {
        uint16_t age1 = hm_rd16(ram, HM_KID1_AGE);
        r->a = age1;
        r->c = age1 >= 90;
        if (r->c) set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6E, CHILD2);
      }
    } else if (r->c) {
      r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_64) & 0x0080;
    } else {
      r->a = days;
    }
  }

  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & CHILD1;
  if (r->a && child_day(ram, r, HM_KID1_AGE, 50, 0x8955, 0x896C, 0x0100))
    return;
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_6E) & CHILD2;
  if (r->a) child_day(ram, r, HM_KID2_AGE, 100, 0x89AC, 0x89C3, 0x0200);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AffectionToHearts ($81:D1C5, JSR, RTS): how many hearts A affection points
 * are. The table $81:D1E8 has the range of each heart (from, to: words);
 * the answer is the first range whose end is not below A (0-9), or 10.
 * Its callers pass a girl's affection ($7F1F1F Maria...).
 * Leftovers: $7E = A in, A = Y = the hearts, X = 4 hearts + 2 (of the last
 * range looked at), C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_AffectionToHearts(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t points = r->a;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, AFFECTION_IN, points);
  uint16_t y = 0;
  do {
    r->x = (uint16_t)((y << 2) + 2);
    if (hm_bus_rd16(ram, HEART_RANGES + r->x) >= points) break;
    y++;
  } while (y != 10);
  r->y = r->a = y;
  r->c = 1;
}

```

`src/playerinput.c`:

```c
/*
 * playerinput.c — the buttons while walking (input mode 1).
 *
 * PlayerMovementInputs ($84:C6B7) runs every frame while the player can
 * move. HM-Decomp writes it as many labels (PlayerActionKeysPressed,
 * PlayerActionDown..., PlayerKeyA..., ReadEventPad...) joined by JMPs: it is
 * one routine with many exits. The arrows set the action "walk" ($D4 = 1)
 * and the direction ($DA: 0 down, 1 up, 2 right, 3 left; HM-Decomp's button
 * names swap left and right), then one button is looked at, in this order:
 * A, B, Select, X, R, L, Y.
 *
 * During events ($D2 bit $1000) the pad is not read: the event's script
 * presses the buttons in $08FD instead (same bits).
 *
 * Pad bits ($0124 held, $0128 new): B $8000, Y $4000, Select $2000,
 * Start $1000, up $0800, down $0400, left $0200, right $0100, A $0080,
 * X $0040, L $0020, R $0010.
 *
 * Code that nothing runs: after each arrow's JMP there are a few dead
 * instructions, and the block at $84:C852-$84:C934 (it would turn $0911
 * into actions 6 / 7) is never called.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* ROM */
#define CAN_INTERACT 0x84C7B6   /* PlayerActionCanInteract: 1 = no */

enum { K_B = 0x8000, K_Y = 0x4000, K_SELECT = 0x2000, K_UP = 0x0800, K_DOWN = 0x0400,
       K_LEFT = 0x0200, K_RIGHT = 0x0100, K_A = 0x0080, K_X = 0x0040, K_L = 0x0020,
       K_R = 0x0010 };

static uint32_t db_addr(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint16_t dp16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a) { return hm_dp_r16(ram, r, a); }
static void set16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a, uint16_t v) { hm_dp_w16(ram, r, a, v); }
static uint16_t rdw(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, a)); }
static void wrw(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, a), v); }
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, uint8_t bank, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* LDA $D2; AND #bit (A = the result) */
static bool state(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & bit;
  return r->a != 0;
}
/* LDA #v; STA $D4 */
static void act(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v) { r->a = v; set16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, v); }
/* CMP #k: C = A >= k */
static bool is(HmRegs *r, uint16_t k) { r->c = r->a >= k; return r->a == k; }

static void keys_pressed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);
static void key_a(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);
static void key_b(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);
static void key_y(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);

/* the busy states: holding an item ($02), carrying the dog ($10... see A),
 * and $800 — none of R, L, Select, X, Y works then */
static bool busy(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  return state(ram, r, 0x0002) || state(ram, r, 0x0010) || state(ram, r, 0x0800);
}
static void key_r(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                 /* whistle for the horse */
{
  if (busy(ram, r)) return;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68)) & 0x0100;
  if (r->a) act(ram, r, 0x000D);
}
static void key_l(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                 /* whistle for the dog */
{
  if (busy(ram, r)) return;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_68)) & 0x0080;
  if (r->a) act(ram, r, 0x001B);
}
static void key_select(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)            /* show the item in hand */
{
  if (!busy(ram, r)) act(ram, r, 0x000C);
}
static void key_x(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!busy(ram, r)) act(ram, r, 0x001C);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Y: the tool, or fishing (the rod: $0F ready to cast -> $10 casting;
 * $11 waiting -> $0F reel in empty; $12 a bite -> $13 reel in, with one of
 * four catch animations $8B-$8E at random).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void key_y(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (busy(ram, r)) return;
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  if (is(r, 0x000F)) { act(ram, r, 0x0010); return; }
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  if (is(r, 0x0011)) { act(ram, r, 0x000F); return; }
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  if (is(r, 0x0012)) {
    act(ram, r, 0x0013);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x03);
    jsl(ram, r, 0xCDFB, 0x80, hm_RNGReturn0toA);
    uint32_t s = (uint32_t)(uint8_t)r->a + 0x8B;          /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA; CLC; ADC */
    r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
    r->a = (uint16_t)s;
    wrw(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, r->a);
    return;
  }
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x8000;
  if (r->a) return;
  uint8_t tool = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | tool);
  if (!tool) return;
  act(ram, r, 0x000A);                                     /* using a tool */
  jsl(ram, r, 0xCDDB, 0x82, hm_StartToolAnimation);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * B: run; or jump, when the tile in front has property bit $20 (a short
 * jump, 28 pixels) or $40 (a long one, 33 pixels, $D2 bit $200) and there
 * is room to land (CollideMap: the map; CollideEventObjects: objects).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void tile_in_front(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t x, uint16_t y,
                          uint16_t ret_front, uint16_t prop, uint16_t ret_prop)
{
  r->a = a; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, ret_front, 0x81, hm_CalculateTileInFront);
  r->x = rdw(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
  r->y = rdw(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
  r->a = prop;
  jsl(ram, r, ret_prop, 0x82, hm_GetTileProperty);
}
/* $DF / $E1 = the player, no step, $E3 = how far */
static void from_player(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t far)
{
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, far);
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X, dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X));
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y, dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y));
```
