```c
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X, 0);
  set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y, 0);
}
static void key_b(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!state(ram, r, 0x0800)) {
    tile_in_front(ram, r, 0, 7, 7, 0xCA35, 2, 0xCA44);
    uint8_t p = (uint8_t)(r->a & 0x60);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | p);
    if (p) {
      uint16_t far;
      if (p & 0x20) {
        r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x20);
        far = 0x001C;
      } else {
        r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a & 0xFF00);
        set16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0200));
        far = 0x0021;
      }
      from_player(ram, r, far);
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
      jsl(ram, r, 0xCA7B, 0x83, hm_CollideMap);
      if (r->a == 0) {
        set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, 0x0020);
        r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
        jsl(ram, r, 0xCA8C, 0x83, hm_CollideEventObjects);
        if (is(r, 0)) { act(ram, r, 0x0003); return; }    /* jump */
      }
    }
  }
  act(ram, r, 0x0002);                                     /* run */
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * A.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* CODE_84CD16 (JSL, RTL): is the way in direction $0911 blocked? The map
 * (CollideMap), a tile $C0-$CF at either corner, or an object (CollideEventObjects).
 * A = 1 blocked, 0 free. */
static void way_blocked(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  from_player(ram, r, 0x0010);
  r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xCD2F, 0x83, hm_CollideMap);
  bool blocked = r->a != 0;
  if (!blocked) {
    for (unsigned at = HM_COLLIDE_TILE_1; at <= HM_COLLIDE_TILE_2 && !blocked; at += 2) {
      uint16_t v = dp16(ram, r, at);
      r->a = (uint16_t)(v - 0xC0);
      r->c = v >= 0xC0;                                    /* SEC; SBC */
      r->c = r->a >= 0x10;                                 /* CMP #$10 */
      blocked = !r->c;
    }
  }
  if (!blocked) {
    set16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, 0x0010);
    r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN);
    jsl(ram, r, 0xCD60, 0x83, hm_CollideEventObjects);
    blocked = !is(r, 0);
  }
  r->a = blocked ? 1 : 0;
}
/* with something in the arms ($D2 bit $10): put it down on a free side.
 * The two directions tried for each facing, and where to look if neither
 * is free (then the player only turns: $DA = $0911 = facing). */
static void put_down(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const struct { uint16_t first, second, ret1, ret2; } T[4] = {
    { 2, 3, 0xCC4B, 0xCC5C }, { 3, 2, 0xCC7A, 0xCC88 },
    { 0, 1, 0xCCA3, 0xCCB1 }, { 0, 1, 0xCCCB, 0xCCD9 },
  };
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  unsigned f = 0;
  if (!is(r, 0)) { if (is(r, 1)) f = 1; else if (is(r, 2)) f = 2; else if (is(r, 3)) f = 3; }
  bool free_side = false;
  for (unsigned k = 0; k < 2 && !free_side; k++) {
    r->a = k ? T[f].second : T[f].first;
    wrw(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, r->a);
    hm_jsl(ram, r, k ? T[f].ret2 : T[f].ret1, 0x84);
    way_blocked(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
    free_side = r->a == 0;
  }
  if (!free_side) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)f;
    set16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, r->a);
    wrw(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, r->a);
    return;
  }
  act(ram, r, 0x0018);
  wrw(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X));
  wrw(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y));
  r->a = 0x0017; r->x = 0; r->y = 0x0014;
  jsl(ram, r, 0xCD07, 0x84, hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront);               /* the putting-down script */
  wrw(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_1, 0);
  wrw(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2, 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_HORSE_TIMER), 0);
}
/* carrying the dog ($D2 bit $800): let it go in front, if no object is in
 * the way and three points ahead (CalculateTileInFront with three offsets)
 * have no solid property bits and are not tile $FF (the last one, also not
 * $E1 nor $C0-$CF) */
static void let_dog_go(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const struct { uint16_t a, xy, ret_front, ret_prop; } T[3] = {
    { 0, 7, 0xCB5C, 0xCB6B }, { 1, 0x0A, 0xCB8B, 0xCB9A }, { 1, 0, 0xCBBA, 0xCBC9 },
  };
  from_player(ram, r, 0x0010);
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xCB43, 0x83, hm_CollideEventObjects);
  if (!is(r, 0)) return;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    tile_in_front(ram, r, T[i].a, T[i].xy, T[i].xy, T[i].ret_front, 2, T[i].ret_prop);
    uint8_t p = (uint8_t)(r->a & 0x1F);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | p);
    if (p) return;
    if (i == 2) {
      r->c = r->x >= 0xE1;
      if (r->x == 0xE1) return;
    }
    r->c = r->x >= 0xFF;
    if (r->x == 0xFF) return;
  }
  r->c = r->x >= 0xC0;
  if (r->c) {
    r->c = r->x >= 0xD0;
    if (!r->c) return;
  }
  r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_X), r->a);             /* the dog's place */
  r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_Y), r->a);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_MAP), *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID)); /* and map */
  act(ram, r, 0x0016);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(0x0800 ^ 0xFFFF) & dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE);
  set16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
static void key_a(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (state(ram, r, 0x0800)) { let_dog_go(ram, r); return; }
  if (state(ram, r, 0x0010)) { put_down(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0006;
  if (r->a) {                                              /* (in the hot spring?) */
    tile_in_front(ram, r, 0, 7, 7, 0xCB0C, 0, 0xCB1B);
    r->c = r->x >= 0xF5;
    if (r->x == 0xF5) act(ram, r, 0x001A);
    return;
  }
  if (state(ram, r, 0x0002)) { act(ram, r, 0x0005); return; }   /* drop the item */
  tile_in_front(ram, r, 0, 7, 7, 0xCAE1, 2, 0xCAF0);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xCAF4, 0x82, hm_PressAOnTile);               /* what is in front */
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The buttons. `pad` is $0128 (new presses; B is read from $0124, held),
 * or $08FD during events.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void script_buttons(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)        /* CODE_84C804 */
{
  static const struct { uint16_t bit; void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *); } B[] = {
    { K_A, key_a }, { K_B, key_b }, { K_SELECT, key_select }, { K_X, key_x },
    { K_R, key_r }, { K_L, key_l }, { K_Y, key_y },
  };
  r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof B / sizeof B[0]; i++)
    if (r->a & B[i].bit) { B[i].fn(ram, r); return; }
}
static void keys_pressed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)          /* PlayerActionKeysPressed */
{
  if (state(ram, r, 0x1000)) { script_buttons(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  if (is(r, 0x000F)) goto y;                               /* the rod, ready */
  r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW);
  if (r->a & K_A) { key_a(ram, r); return; }
  if (state(ram, r, 0x0020)) return;
  r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD);
  if (r->a & K_B) { key_b(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW);
  if (r->a & K_SELECT) { key_select(ram, r); return; }
  if (r->a & K_X) { key_x(ram, r); return; }
  if (r->a & K_R) { key_r(ram, r); return; }
  if (r->a & K_L) { key_l(ram, r); return; }
y:
  r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW);
  if (r->a & K_Y) key_y(ram, r);
}
/* an arrow: walk that way, then the buttons */
static void walk(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t dir)
{
  act(ram, r, 0x0001);
  set16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, dir);
  r->a = dir;
  wrw(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, dir);
  keys_pressed(ram, r);
}
static bool arrows(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t pad_at)
{
  static const uint16_t bit[4] = { K_DOWN, K_UP, K_RIGHT, K_LEFT };
  for (uint16_t d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
    r->a = rdw(ram, r, pad_at);
    if (r->a & bit[d]) { walk(ram, r, d); return true; }
  }
  return false;
}

/* ReadEventPad ($84:C7D6, also called with JSL from MenuInputs, menu 1):
 * the event's pad, $08FD: an arrow, else a button. */
void hm_ReadEventPad(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (!arrows(ram, r, HM_SCRIPT_BUTTONS)) script_buttons(ram, r);
}

void hm_PlayerMovementInputs(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (state(ram, r, 0x00C4)) return;                       /* can't act now */
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  if (is(r, 0x0003)) return;                               /* in the air */
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & 0x0020;
  if (r->a) return;
  if (state(ram, r, 0x1000)) { hm_ReadEventPad(ram, r); return; }   /* an event's pad */
  if (!state(ram, r, 0x4000)) return;
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  if (is(r, 0x0011) || is(r, 0x0012)) {                    /* fishing: only Y */
    r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_PAD1_NEW);
    if (r->a & K_Y) key_y(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  r->x = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  uint8_t no = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (CAN_INTERACT + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | no);
  if (no) return;                                          /* busy with an action */
  if (!arrows(ram, r, HM_PAD1_HELD)) keys_pressed(ram, r);
}

```

`src/playerstate.c`:

```c
/*
 * playerstate.c — the player each frame (HM-Decomp's PlayerFrame block).
 *
 * PlayerFrame ($81:BFB7, JSL, RTL) runs once a frame. With $D2 bit 0 clear
 * it only does the end of the frame; with $D2 bit 6 an action runs instead
 * (PlayerInteractionSelector, actions.c); otherwise it jumps (table
 * DATA16_81C027) by the player's action ($D4) to its step:
 *
 *   0, 1, 2, 6, 7, $0E  on foot (PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun: walking, running, ...)
 *   3 jumping, 4 picking up, 5 throwing, 8 eating, 9 an idle animation,
 *   $0A using a tool, $0B, $0C (the watch), $0D, $0F-$1B other animations,
 *   $1C swapping the tools.
 *
 * Most steps set the player's animation ($0901, often + his facing) and
 * play it (UpdatePlayerObject); when it ends ($0915 = $FFFF) the action changes.
 * They all end in the frame's end (ResetIdleAnimationTimer, $81:C002):
 * standing still (action 0) goes to the standing step PlayerStandStill; the
 * others clear the idle timer ($0925) and then MoveSecondBackground (the camera),
 * $1E = 0 and the facing back from $0911.
 *
 * MovePlayer moves the player $1E pixels in his facing: the event objects
 * (CollideEventObjects) and the map (CollideMap) can stop him or make him slide round a
 * corner; then the camera follows, and every 8 steps a footprint.
 *
 * As everywhere, the bodies keep A, X, Y and C as the original leaves them.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ────────────────────────────── */
/* Direct page ($00-$FF; the hm_dp_* / dp16 helpers take these offsets) */
#define STEP_SIZE       0x1E       /* 16b: pixels to move this frame */
#define DOOR_MAP_ANIM   0x92       /* 8b: the exit's map animation (0 = none) */
/* CollideEventObjects / CollideMap: their inputs and outputs */
#define MOVE_DEPTH      0x7E       /* 16b, MovePlayer: CollideMap's X or Y, how far the step
                                    * would go into the blocking tile */

/* HM_TOOL_SELECTED ($0921) and HM_TOOL_BACKPACK ($0923, hm_ram.h): the tools in
 * hand and in the bag */
#define JUMP_TOGGLE     0x0971     /* 8b: the slow jump moves every other frame */

/* ROM: the exits (Unk_Table13, $80:B6F5, 8 bytes an exit) */
#define DOOR_DEST       0          /* 8b: the destination map */
#define DOOR_ANIM       2          /* 8b: the map animation (0 = none) */
#define DOOR_FLAGS      3          /* 8b: when the door is shut, + season, festivals */
#define DOOR_ARRIVE_X   4          /* 16b: where he arrives */
#define DOOR_ARRIVE_Y   6          /* 16b */

typedef void Fn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);

static uint32_t db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db(r, a)); }
static uint16_t rd16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, db(r, a)); }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }
static uint16_t dp16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a) { return hm_dp_r16(ram, r, a); }
static void set_dp16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a, uint16_t v) { hm_dp_w16(ram, r, a, v); }

static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, Fn *fn)
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, Fn *fn)
{
  uint16_t ret = (uint16_t)(at + 2);
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(ret >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r);
}

/* JSR UpdatePlayerObject at a: play the player's animation */
static void animate(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at) { jsr(ram, r, at, hm_UpdatePlayerObject); }
/* LDA $0915; CMP #$FFFF: is the animation over? */
static bool anim_over(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TIMER);
  r->c = r->a >= 0xFFFF;
  return r->a == 0xFFFF;
}
/* $0901 = base + facing (CLC; ADC $DA) */
static void animation_facing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t base)
{
  uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)base + dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, r->a);
}
static void animation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  r->a = v;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, v);
}
static void set_action(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a)
{
  r->a = a;
  set_dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, a);
}
static void state_off(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bits)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & ~bits);
  set_dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
static void state_on(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t bits)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | bits);
  set_dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
/* LDA $D2; AND #$8000; BEQ: the step's first frame? (then $D2 bit 15 is set) */
static bool first_frame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x8000);
  if (r->a) return false;
  state_on(ram, r, 0x8000);
  return true;
}
static void long_or(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t at, uint16_t bits)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, at) | bits);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, at, r->a);
}
static void set_step_size(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t n)
{
  set_a8(r, n);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, STEP_SIZE) = n;
}
/* sound effect e of bank 6 (PlaySoundEffect0A) */
static void sound(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t e, uint16_t at)
{
  set_a8(r, e);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT, e);
  set_a8(r, 0x06);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_SOUND_BANK, 0x06);
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x83, hm_PlaySoundEffect0A);
}
static void event_long(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t at)
{
  r->a = a; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, at, 0x84, hm_StartEventScriptLong);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * MovePlayer ($81:CB77, JSR, RTS): move the player. Plays his animation,
 * then by his facing (0 down, 1 up, 2 right, 3 left): unless he is
 * jumping (actions 3, $17, $18) or walked by a script ($D2 bit 7), the
 * event objects ahead (CollideEventObjects with the step in $E7 / $E5) or a solid tile
 * (CollideMap) stop him ($1E = 0). When only one of the front corners is
 * blocked he slides sideways ($1E = 1, facing the free side) if the tile
 * allows it (types 0 and $A0-$AF always; otherwise by which half of the
 * tile he is in); when the front is blocked, $0878 / $087A = the tiles hit
 * and, unless one is a door ($C0-$CF), the step is cut to the edge. Then
 * the move, the camera (PlaceCameraOnMapEntry and the scroll of that direction), and
 * every 8 moves a footprint (SnowFootprints; $0907 / $0909 = where).
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct Dir {
  uint16_t at_objects, at_map;     /* JSL CollideEventObjects, JSL CollideMap */
  uint16_t at_camera, at_scroll;   /* JSL PlaceCameraOnMapEntry, the scroll */
  Fn *scroll;
  bool y_axis;                     /* moves on Y ($D8; step in $E7, Y = depth) */
  bool minus;                      /* towards smaller coordinates */
  uint8_t slide1, slide2;          /* the facing to slide to per corner */
} Dir;

static const Dir k_dirs[4] = {
  { 0xCBE7, 0xCBF7, 0xCC37, 0xCC3B, hm_UpdateBGOffset,        true,  false, 3, 2 },
  { 0xCC8B, 0xCC9B, 0xCCDB, 0xCCDF, hm_ScrollCameraUp,            true,  true,  3, 2 },
  { 0xCD2F, 0xCD3F, 0xCD7F, 0xCD83, hm_ScrollCameraRight, false, false, 1, 0 },
  { 0xCDD3, 0xCDE3, 0xCE23, 0xCE27, hm_ScrollCameraLeft,            false, true,  1, 0 },
};

static void stop_moving(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)               /* $81:CE53 */
{
  set_dp16(ram, r, STEP_SIZE, 0);
}

/* $81:CE2B: one more step; every 8, a footprint */
static void count_step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_STEP_COUNT) + 1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_STEP_COUNT, n);
  set_a8(r, n);
  r->c = n >= 8;
  if (n != 8) return;
  jsl(ram, r, 0xCE3D, 0x81, hm_SnowFootprints);
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_FOOTPRINT_X, r->a);
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_FOOTPRINT_Y, r->a);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_STEP_COUNT, 0);
}

void hm_MovePlayer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  animate(ram, r, 0xCB77);
  uint16_t f = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  r->a = f;
  int d = 0;
  for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    r->c = f >= k;
    if (f == k) { d = k; break; }
  }
  /* the corner slides can turn him; the original would loop for ever if
   * the turns never ended (the guard only stops a run that never would) */
  for (int guard = 0; guard < 4096; guard++) {
    const Dir *dir = &k_dirs[d];
    bool free_move = false;
    static const uint16_t jumps[] = { 0x0003, 0x0017, 0x0018 };
    for (int i = 0; i < 3 && !free_move; i++) {
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
      r->c = r->a >= jumps[i];
      free_move = r->a == jumps[i];
    }
    if (!free_move) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0080);
      free_move = r->a != 0;
    }
    if (!free_move) {
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X); set_dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_X, r->a);
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y); set_dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_Y, r->a);
      if (dir->y_axis) {
        r->a = 0; set_dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X, 0);
        r->a = dp16(ram, r, STEP_SIZE); set_dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y, r->a);
      } else {
        r->a = dp16(ram, r, STEP_SIZE); set_dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_X, r->a);
        r->a = 0; set_dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_STEP_Y, 0);
      }
      set_dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_AHEAD, 0);
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
      jsl(ram, r, dir->at_objects, 0x83, hm_CollideEventObjects);
      r->c = 1;                                              /* CMP #0 */
      if (r->a != 0) { stop_moving(ram, r); return; }
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
      jsl(ram, r, dir->at_map, 0x83, hm_CollideMap);
      uint16_t depth_reg = dir->y_axis ? r->y : r->x;
      set_dp16(ram, r, MOVE_DEPTH, depth_reg);
      int which = 0;
      r->c = r->a >= 1;
      if (r->a == 1) which = 1;
      else { r->c = r->a >= 2; if (r->a == 2) which = 2; }
      if (which) {
        uint16_t v = dp16(ram, r, which == 1 ? HM_COLLIDE_TILE_2 : HM_COLLIDE_TILE_1);
        uint16_t pos = dp16(ram, r, dir->y_axis ? HM_PLAYER_X : HM_PLAYER_Y);
        /* corner 1 ($EB) slides when the half bit (8) of his other
         * coordinate is set, corner 2 ($E9) when it is clear; tile types
         * 0 and $A0-$AF always let him slide */
        bool go;
        {
          r->a = v;
          if (v == 0) go = true;
          else {
            r->c = v >= 0xA0;
            go = false;
            if (v >= 0xA0) { r->c = v >= 0xB0; if (v < 0xB0) go = true; }
            if (!go) {
              r->a = (uint16_t)(pos & 0x0008);
              go = which == 1 ? r->a != 0 : r->a == 0;
            }
          }
        }
        if (go) {
          r->a = 1; set_dp16(ram, r, STEP_SIZE, 1);
          uint8_t nd = which == 1 ? dir->slide1 : dir->slide2;
          r->a = nd; set_dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, nd);
          d = nd;
          continue;
        }
      }
      /* the front: the tiles hit, and the step cut to the edge */
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_TILE_2); wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2, r->a);
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_COLLIDE_TILE_1); wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_1, r->a);
      r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a - 0x00C0);                      /* SEC; SBC #$C0 */
      r->c = r->a >= 0x0010;
      if (r->a < 0x0010) { stop_moving(ram, r); return; }
      set_dp16(ram, r, MOVE_DEPTH, dir->y_axis ? r->y : r->x);
      uint16_t step = dp16(ram, r, STEP_SIZE), depth = dp16(ram, r, MOVE_DEPTH);
      r->c = step >= depth;
      r->a = (uint16_t)(step - depth);
      set_dp16(ram, r, STEP_SIZE, r->a);
    }
    unsigned coord = dir->y_axis ? HM_PLAYER_Y : HM_PLAYER_X;
    uint16_t pos = dp16(ram, r, coord), step = dp16(ram, r, STEP_SIZE);
    if (dir->minus) { r->c = pos >= step; r->a = (uint16_t)(pos - step); }
    else { uint32_t s = (uint32_t)pos + step; r->c = s > 0xFFFF; r->a = (uint16_t)s; }
    set_dp16(ram, r, coord, r->a);
    jsl(ram, r, dir->at_camera, 0x80, hm_PlaceCameraOnMapEntry);
    jsl(ram, r, dir->at_scroll, 0x80, dir->scroll);
    count_step(ram, r);
    return;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The frame's end. ResetIdleAnimationTimer ($81:C002): standing still goes
 * to PlayerStandStill; otherwise CODE_81C00E clears the idle timer and
 * CODE_81C013 runs the camera (MoveSecondBackground), $1E = 0, and the facing ($DA,
 * $0913) back from $0911. RTL.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void frame_end(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                 /* CODE_81C013 */
{
  jsl(ram, r, 0xC013, 0x80, hm_MoveSecondBackground);
  r->a = 0;
  set_dp16(ram, r, STEP_SIZE, 0);
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN);
  set_dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, r->a);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_FACING, r->a);
}
static void not_idle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                  /* CODE_81C00E */
{
  wr8(ram, r, HM_IDLE_TIMER, 0);
  frame_end(ram, r);
}
void hm_ResetIdleAnimationTimer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CMP #0 */
  if (r->a == 0) { hm_PlayerStandStill(ram, r); return; }
  not_idle(ram, r);
}
#define END hm_ResetIdleAnimationTimer

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Standing still (PlayerStandStill): $D2 bit 15 off. With $D2 bit 13 only the
 * animation. With bit 14 (nothing to do) the idle timer runs: at $F0 it
 * goes back to $78 and an idle animation starts (action 9, animation
 * $3C + 2 x facing + 0-2 at random). Otherwise the standing animation
 * for the state: holding something (bit 1) $14, bits 4 / 5 / 8 / 11 $B0
 * / $C0 / $4F / $D0, $7F1F60 bits 1-2 $EA, else 0 (+ facing, except $4F).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerStandStill(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  state_off(ram, r, 0x8000);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x2000);
  if (r->a) { animate(ram, r, 0xC668); not_idle(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x4000);
  if (r->a) {
    uint8_t t = rd8(ram, r, HM_IDLE_TIMER);
    set_a8(r, t);
    r->c = t >= 0xF0;
    if (t == 0xF0) {
      set_a8(r, 0x78);
      wr8(ram, r, HM_IDLE_TIMER, 0x78);
      set_action(ram, r, 9);
      r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
      r->c = r->a >> 15;
      uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)(uint16_t)(r->a << 1) + 0x3C;
      r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
      r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
      wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, r->a);
      set_a8(r, 2);
      jsl(ram, r, 0xC59F, 0x80, hm_RNGReturn0toA);
      r->a = (uint8_t)r->a;                                /* XBA; LDA #0; XBA */
      sum = (uint32_t)r->a + rd16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST);
      r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
      r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
      wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, r->a);
      hm_PlayerIdleAnimation(ram, r);
      return;
    }
    set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(t + 1));
    wr8(ram, r, HM_IDLE_TIMER, (uint8_t)(t + 1));
  }
  static const struct { uint16_t bit, base; bool facing; } pose[] = {
    { 0x0002, 0x0014, true }, { 0x0010, 0x00B0, true }, { 0x0020, 0x00C0, true },
    { 0x0100, 0x004F, false }, { 0x0800, 0x00D0, true },
  };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & pose[i].bit);
    if (r->a) {
      if (pose[i].facing) animation_facing(ram, r, pose[i].base);
      else animation(ram, r, pose[i].base);
      animate(ram, r, 0xC662);
      not_idle(ram, r);
      return;
    }
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0006);
  if (r->a) {
    animation_facing(ram, r, 0x00EA);
    animate(ram, r, 0xC662);
    not_idle(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  animation_facing(ram, r, 0x0000);
  animate(ram, r, 0xC65C);
  frame_end(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Walking (PlayerWalk, action 1), running (PlayerRun, action 2) and
 * being pushed (PlayerPushed, action $0E): the animation for the state
 * (as standing; walking carrying something $28, running $2C...), the
 * step (1 pixel; 2 running; 3 in deep snow, $D2 bit 4) and the move
 * (MovePlayer); then action 0 and $096D = 0. Running only runs with $D2
 * bit 12, or bit 14 without bit 13; and a step sound every 16 frames
 * while running or in snow ($091A).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct Gait { uint16_t bit, base; uint8_t step; bool sound; } Gait;

static void after_move(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)                /* $81:C82A */
{
  set_action(ram, r, 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_HITS, 0);
  not_idle(ram, r);
}
static void step_sound_and_move(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)       /* $81:C806 */
{
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)((rd8(ram, r, HM_STEP_SOUND_TIMER) + 1) & 0x0F);
  set_a8(r, n);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_STEP_SOUND_TIMER, n);
  if (!n) sound(ram, r, 0x05, 0xC823);
  jsr(ram, r, 0xC827, hm_MovePlayer);
  after_move(ram, r);
}

static void gait(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Gait *g, unsigned n, const Gait *dflt, uint16_t at_move)
{
  const Gait *pick = NULL;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < n && !pick; i++) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & g[i].bit);
    if (r->a) pick = &g[i];
  }
  if (!pick) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0006);
    pick = r->a ? &g[n] : dflt;
  }
  animation_facing(ram, r, pick->base);
  set_step_size(ram, r, pick->step);
  if (pick->sound) { step_sound_and_move(ram, r); return; }
  jsr(ram, r, at_move, hm_MovePlayer);
  after_move(ram, r);
}

void hm_PlayerWalk(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Gait g[] = {
    { 0x0002, 0x0028, 1, false }, { 0x0010, 0x00B4, 3, true }, { 0x0020, 0x00C4, 1, false },
    { 0x0800, 0x00D4, 1, false }, { 0, 0x00EE, 1, false },
  };
  static const Gait dflt = { 0, 0x0004, 1, false };
  state_off(ram, r, 0x8000);
  gait(ram, r, g, 4, &dflt, 0xC722);
}

void hm_PlayerRun(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Gait g[] = {
    { 0x0002, 0x002C, 2, true }, { 0x0010, 0x00B4, 3, true }, { 0x0020, 0x00C4, 1, false },
    { 0x0800, 0x00D4, 1, false }, { 0, 0x00EE, 1, false },
  };
  static const Gait dflt = { 0, 0x0008, 2, true };
  state_off(ram, r, 0x8000);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x1000);
  if (!r->a) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x2000);
    if (r->a) { after_move(ram, r); return; }
    r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x4000);
    if (!r->a) { after_move(ram, r); return; }
  }
  gait(ram, r, g, 4, &dflt, 0xC827);
}

void hm_PlayerPushed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  state_off(ram, r, 0x8000);
  animation(ram, r, 0x0045);
  set_step_size(ram, r, 1);
  jsr(ram, r, 0xC857, hm_MovePlayer);
  after_move(ram, r);
}

/* PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun ($81:BFDC; actions 0, 1, 2, 6, 7, $0E): $D2 bit 2 goes to
 * PlayerEatAnimation; then by the action: running, walking, pushed, or the end. */
void hm_PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0004);
  if (r->a) { hm_PlayerEatAnimation(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  r->c = r->a >= 2;
  if (r->a == 2) { hm_PlayerRun(ram, r); return; }
  r->c = r->a >= 1;
  if (r->a == 1) { hm_PlayerWalk(ram, r); return; }
  r->c = r->a >= 0x0E;
  if (r->a == 0x0E) { hm_PlayerPushed(ram, r); return; }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* PlayerEatAnimation ($D2 bit 2): animation $30 + $0924 (its low byte only), and
 * when it ends action 0 and $D2 bit 2 off. */
void hm_PlayerEatAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (first_frame(ram, r)) {
    uint16_t sum = (uint16_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_MEAL_CHOICE) + 0x30);
    r->c = sum > 0xFF;
    set_a8(r, (uint8_t)sum);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, (uint8_t)sum);
  }
  animate(ram, r, 0xCB38);
  if (!anim_over(ram, r)) { not_idle(ram, r); return; }
  set_action(ram, r, 0);
  state_off(ram, r, 0x0004);
  END(ram, r);
}

/* PlayerIdleAnimation (action 9, an idle animation): to its end, then action 0. */
void hm_PlayerIdleAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  animate(ram, r, 0xCB60);
  if (anim_over(ram, r)) set_action(ram, r, 0);
  frame_end(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The other actions: an animation to its end, and what then follows.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* animation, played; when over the action becomes `next` (if >= 0) */
static bool play(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at)
{
  animate(ram, r, at);
  return anim_over(ram, r);
}

/* $1A ($81:C0B5): animation $F2 + facing; then action 0 and event $14 / $45
 * (script 0, or $15 / script 3 with $7F1F60 bit 2); $7F1F60 bits 1-2 off. */
void hm_PlayerState_1A_PutChildBack(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  animation_facing(ram, r, 0x00F2);
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC0C2)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0004);
    if (!r->a) event_long(ram, r, 0x0014, 0x0045, 0x0000, 0xC0EC);
    else event_long(ram, r, 0x0015, 0x0045, 0x0003, 0xC0FD);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0xFFF9);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), r->a);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $17 ($81:C111): facing back from $0913, animation $DC + facing, a step of
 * 1 (MovePlayer); then action 0 and $7F1F5C bit 5. */
void hm_PlayerState_17_PickUpFoal(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_FACING);
  set_dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, r->a);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, r->a);
  animation_facing(ram, r, 0x00DC);
  set_step_size(ram, r, 1);
  jsr(ram, r, 0xC12C, hm_MovePlayer);
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC12F)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    long_or(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), 0x0020);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $18 ($81:C153): animation $E0 + $0911, facing from $0911, a step of 1;
 * then action 0, $D2 bit 4 off and $7F1F5C bit 11. */
void hm_PlayerState_18_PutDownFoal(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint32_t sum = 0x00E0u + rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN);
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, r->a);
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN);
  set_dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, r->a);
  set_step_size(ram, r, 1);
  jsr(ram, r, 0xC16E, hm_MovePlayer);
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC171)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    state_off(ram, r, 0x0010);
    long_or(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), 0x0800);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $16 ($81:C1A1): animation $D8 + facing; then action 0, event $16 / $12
 * at $7F1F2C / $7F1F2E (StartScriptAtTileInFront), $7F1F58 = 1, $0938 = 0. */
void hm_PlayerState_16_ReleaseDog(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  animation_facing(ram, r, 0x00D8);
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC1AE)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_X));
    wr16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, r->a);
    r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_Y));
    wr16(ram, r, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, r->a);
    r->a = 0x0016; r->x = 0; r->y = 0x0012;
    jsl(ram, r, 0xC1DB, 0x84, hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront);
    r->a = 1;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DOG_MOOD), 1);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_DOG_TIMER, 0);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $15, $14, $0F, $10, $12: a fixed animation; when over, the next action */
static void fixed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t anim, uint16_t at, int next)
{
  animation(ram, r, anim);
  if (play(ram, r, at) && next >= 0) set_action(ram, r, (uint16_t)next);
  END(ram, r);
}
void hm_PlayerState_15_BeforeFeelSick(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fixed(ram, r, 0x00CC, 0xC1FA, 0x14); }
void hm_PlayerState_14_FeelSick(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fixed(ram, r, 0x008F, 0xC21B, 0x00); }
void hm_PlayerState_10_CastLine(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fixed(ram, r, 0x0089, 0xC24C, 0x11); }
void hm_PlayerState_12_FishBites(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { fixed(ram, r, 0x008A, 0xC298, 0x11); }
void hm_PlayerState_0F_HoldRod(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  animation(ram, r, 0x0088);
  animate(ram, r, 0xC23C);
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $11 ($81:C263): one chance in 256 x 5 to go on to action $12 */
void hm_PlayerState_11_WaitForBite(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  set_a8(r, 0xFF);
  jsl(ram, r, 0xC269, 0x80, hm_RNGReturn0toA);
  if (!(r->a & 0xFF)) {
    set_a8(r, 0x04);
    jsl(ram, r, 0xC273, 0x80, hm_RNGReturn0toA);
    if (!(r->a & 0xFF)) set_action(ram, r, 0x12);
  }
  animation(ram, r, 0x008E);
  animate(ram, r, 0xC288);
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $13 ($81:C2AF): to the animation's end; then action $0F and the event in
 * slot $14 (freed if in use): script $35 for animation $8B (+2 happiness),
 * $34 for $8C, $33 otherwise. */
void hm_PlayerState_13_ReelInCatch(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC2B1)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0x000F);
    r->a = 0x0014;
    jsl(ram, r, 0xC2CA, 0x84, hm_SetEventSlotPointer);
    r->y = 0;
    set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_EVENT_SLOT, 0)));
    if (r->a & 0xFF) {
      r->a = 0x0014;
      jsl(ram, r, 0xC2DE, 0x84, hm_FreeEventSlot);
    }
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST);
    r->c = r->a >= 0x008B;
    if (r->a == 0x008B) {
      event_long(ram, r, 0x0014, 0, 0x0035, 0xC30E);
      r->a = 2;
      jsl(ram, r, 0xC317, 0x83, hm_AddPlayerHappiness);
    } else {
      r->c = r->a >= 0x008C;
      if (r->a == 0x008C) event_long(ram, r, 0x0014, 0, 0x0034, 0xC329);
      else event_long(ram, r, 0x0014, 0, 0x0033, 0xC2FC);
    }
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $1B / $0D ($81:C333, $81:C364): $7F1F60 bit 4 / $7F1F5C bit 10, then
 * animation $BC + facing; action 0 at its end. */
static void flag_and_bow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t at_flag, uint16_t bit, uint16_t at)
{
  long_or(ram, r, at_flag, bit);
  animation_facing(ram, r, 0x00BC);
  if (play(ram, r, at)) set_action(ram, r, 0);
  END(ram, r);
}
void hm_PlayerState_1B_WhistleDog(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { flag_and_bow(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60), 0x0010, 0xC34D); }
void hm_PlayerState_0D_WhistleHorse(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { flag_and_bow(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), 0x0400, 0xC37E); }

/* $0C ($81:C395): looking at the watch: animation $90 + the tool's number
 * (the tool in hand), and the time's text: $046A unless $7F1F6E bit 14 and
 * not $7F1F60 bit 9; then by the hour, 6 to 18: $046B-$0475, at 17 $0476
 * ($0478 with one of $7F1F66 bits 0-4), at 18 $0477, others $046B. At the
 * animation's end action 0, unless $7F1F5A bit 14. */
void hm_PlayerState_0C_ShowToolAndTime(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (first_frame(ram, r)) {
    uint16_t sum = (uint16_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED) + 0x90);
    r->c = sum > 0xFF;
    r->a = (uint8_t)sum;                                   /* LDA #0; XBA; ...; REP */
    wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, r->a);
    uint16_t text = 0x046A;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6E)) & 0x4000);
    if (r->a) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0200);
      if (!r->a) {
        uint8_t h = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR));
        set_a8(r, h);
        text = 0x046B;
        bool found = false;
        for (uint8_t k = 6; k <= 0x12 && !found; k++) {
          r->c = h >= k;
          if (h != k) continue;
          found = true;
          if (k <= 0x10) text = (uint16_t)(0x046B + (k - 6));
          else if (k == 0x12) text = 0x0477;
          else {
            text = 0x0476;
            for (uint16_t bit = 1; bit <= 0x10; bit = (uint16_t)(bit << 1)) {
              r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_66)) & bit);
              if (r->a) { text = 0x0478; break; }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
    r->x = text;
    set_a8(r, 2);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_INPUT_STATE, 2);
    set_a8(r, 0);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES, 0);
    jsl(ram, r, 0xC4C6, 0x83, hm_StartTextBox);
  }
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC4CA)) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) & 0x4000);
    if (!r->a) set_action(ram, r, 0);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $0B ($81:C4EC): the animation as set; action 0 at its end. */
void hm_PlayerState_0B_Tired(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  first_frame(ram, r);
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC503)) set_action(ram, r, 0);
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $0A ($81:C51A): using a tool: at the animation's end the tool acts
 * (UseToolInHand); at frame $18 of the use ($091B) its sound (ToolUsedSound1). */
void hm_PlayerState_0A_UseTool(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  first_frame(ram, r);
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC531)) jsl(ram, r, 0xC53E, 0x82, hm_UseToolInHand);
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_FRAMES) + 1);
  set_a8(r, n);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_FRAMES, n);
  r->c = n >= 0x18;
  if (n == 0x18) jsl(ram, r, 0xC54F, 0x82, hm_ToolUsedSound1);
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $03 ($81:C86B): a jump: the first frame its animation ($0C, or $20
 * carrying, $B8 in snow, $C8 with $D2 bit 5; + facing) and sound effect 6;
 * the step is 1 (2 with bit 5, or every other frame with $D2 bit 9); at
 * the end action 0, $D2 bit 9 off, and facing left also bit 5. */
void hm_PlayerState_03_Jump(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  bool big = false;
  if (first_frame(ram, r)) {
    static const struct { uint16_t bit, base, at; } jump[] = {
      { 0x0002, 0x0020, 0xC8DF }, { 0x0010, 0x00B8, 0xC8FE }, { 0x0020, 0x00C8, 0xC91D },
    };
    int k = -1;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3 && k < 0; i++) {
      r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & jump[i].bit);
      if (r->a) k = i;
    }
    if (k < 0) {
      animation_facing(ram, r, 0x000C);
      sound(ram, r, 0x06, 0xC8BB);
      wr8(ram, r, JUMP_TOGGLE, 0);
    } else {
      animation_facing(ram, r, jump[k].base);
      sound(ram, r, 0x06, jump[k].at);
      big = k == 2;
    }
  }
  if (big) {
    set_step_size(ram, r, 2);
  } else {
    set_step_size(ram, r, 1);
    r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0200);
    if (r->a) {
      uint8_t t = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, JUMP_TOGGLE) ^ 1);
      set_a8(r, t);
      wr8(ram, r, JUMP_TOGGLE, t);
      if (t) set_step_size(ram, r, 2);
    }
  }
  jsr(ram, r, 0xC951, hm_MovePlayer);
  animate(ram, r, 0xC954);
  if (anim_over(ram, r)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    state_off(ram, r, 0x0200);
    r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
    r->c = r->a >= 3;
    if (r->a == 3) state_off(ram, r, 0x0020);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $04 ($81:C991): picking up: animation $10 + facing and the item down
 * (PutItemDown) the first frame; at the end action 0, holding ($D2 bit 1)
 * and $091E = the item. */
void hm_PlayerState_04_PickUp(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (first_frame(ram, r)) {
    animation_facing(ram, r, 0x0010);
    jsl(ram, r, 0xC9B3, 0x81, hm_PutItemDown);
  }
  if (play(ram, r, 0xC9B7)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    state_on(ram, r, 0x0002);
    set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM_ON_HAND));
    wr8(ram, r, HM_SHOWN_ITEM, (uint8_t)r->a);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $05 ($81:C9DF): throwing: animation $1C + facing and sound effect 7; at
 * the end action 0 and the hands free ($D2 bit 1 off). */
void hm_PlayerState_05_Throw(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (first_frame(ram, r)) {
    animation_facing(ram, r, 0x001C);
    sound(ram, r, 0x07, 0xCA0F);
  }
  if (play(ram, r, 0xCA13)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    state_off(ram, r, 0x0002);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* $08 ($81:CA36): eating item $0984: animation $33 + the item; at the end
 * the hands are free and action 0, but item 2 goes on to action $14; item
 * 8 (the power berry?) also counts in $7F1F36, gives +10 happiness and 10
 * more maximum stamina ($0917), and marks where it was eaten ($7F1F6C bit
 * 14 in the houses $15-$17, $7F1F6A bit 6 on map $29). */
void hm_PlayerState_08_Eat(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (first_frame(ram, r)) {
    uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM) + 0x33;
    r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
    r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
    wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, r->a);
  }
  if (!play(ram, r, 0xCA60)) { END(ram, r); return; }
  uint8_t item = rd8(ram, r, HM_ITEM);
  set_a8(r, item);
  r->c = item >= 2;
  if (item == 2) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0x0014);
    state_off(ram, r, 0x0002);
    END(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  r->c = item >= 8;
  if (item != 8) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    state_off(ram, r, 0x0002);
    END(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  uint8_t n = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_POWER_BERRIES)) + 1);
  set_a8(r, n);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_POWER_BERRIES), n);
  r->a = 0x000A;
  jsl(ram, r, 0xCABB, 0x83, hm_AddPlayerHappiness);
  uint16_t s = (uint16_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_MAX_STAMINA) + 0x0A);
  r->c = s > 0xFF;
  set_a8(r, (uint8_t)s);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_MAX_STAMINA, (uint8_t)s);
  set_action(ram, r, 0);
  state_off(ram, r, 0x0002);
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  bool house = false;
  for (uint8_t k = 0x15; k <= 0x17 && !house; k++) {
    r->c = map >= k;
    house = map == k;
  }
  if (house) long_or(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C), 0x4000);
  else {
    r->c = map >= 0x29;
    if (map == 0x29) long_or(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6A), 0x0040);
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CheckMountainFinds ($80:9D0B, JSL, RTL): the mountain (maps $10-$13), on days
 * without $0196 bits 1, 3, 4. Where the player stands ($0878 / $087A, the
 * tiles under him):
 *   - tile $F9 in spring, $FA in autumn, $FB in winter: one chance in 16,
 *     once a day ($7F1F5C bit 13 / 14 / 15), of a find: event $11 / $2C,
 *     $13 / $2B, $12 / $2A;
 *   - both tiles $F8 (the water's edge) with the fishing rod ($7F1F5A
 *     bit 9), his hands free and not in snow or bit 11: he starts fishing
 *     (action $0F), unless he already is (actions $10-$13).
 * Leftovers: those of the last routine called and the stores after it.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static bool under_player(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t tile)
{
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_1);
  r->c = r->a >= tile;
  if (r->a == tile) return true;
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2);
  r->c = r->a >= tile;
  return r->a == tile;
}
static void mountain_find(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t season, uint16_t bit,
                          uint16_t a, uint16_t x, uint16_t at_rng, uint16_t at_event)
{
  uint8_t s = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
  set_a8(r, s);
  if (season == 0) { if (s) return; }
  else { r->c = s >= season; if (s != season) return; }
  set_a8(r, 0x10);
  jsl(ram, r, at_rng, 0x80, hm_RNGReturn0toA);
  if (r->a & 0xFF) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C)) & bit);
  if (r->a) return;
  long_or(ram, r, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5C), bit);
  event_long(ram, r, a, x, 0x0000, at_event);
}

void hm_CheckMountainFinds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 0x04;
  if (map < 0x04) return;
  r->c = map >= 0x10;
  if (map < 0x10) return;
  r->c = map >= 0x14;
  if (map >= 0x14) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x001A);
  if (r->a) return;
  if (under_player(ram, r, 0x00F9)) {
    mountain_find(ram, r, 0, 0x2000, 0x0011, 0x002C, 0x9E0C, 0x9E39);
    return;
  }
  if (under_player(ram, r, 0x00FA)) {
    mountain_find(ram, r, 2, 0x4000, 0x0013, 0x002B, 0x9E4D, 0x9E77);
    return;
  }
  if (under_player(ram, r, 0x00FB)) {
    mountain_find(ram, r, 3, 0x8000, 0x0012, 0x002A, 0x9E8B, 0x9EB5);
    return;
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) & 0x0200);
  if (!r->a) return;
  static const uint16_t busy[] = { 0x0002, 0x0010, 0x0800 };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & busy[i]);
    if (r->a) return;
  }
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_1);
  r->c = r->a >= 0x00F8;
  if (r->a != 0x00F8) return;
  r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2);
  r->c = r->a >= 0x00F8;
  if (r->a != 0x00F8) return;
  for (uint16_t k = 0x10; k <= 0x13; k++) {
    r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
    r->c = r->a >= k;
    if (r->a == k) return;
  }
  set_action(ram, r, 0x000F);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CheckDoors ($80:9A64, JSL, RTL): the doors. The tiles under the player
 * ($0878 / $087A) are both of the types $C0-$CF (an exit) or the routine
 * leaves; a type from $D0 goes on to CheckMountainFinds (the mountain). Not while
 * $D2 bit 4 or $7F1F60 bits 1-2; with $7F1F6C bit 0, not the exits whose
 * entry has destination $1C.
 * The exit's entry: the tile's property byte ([$0D] + 4 tile) x 8 into the
 * door table (Unk_Table13, $80:B6F5): +0 the destination map, +2 the map
 * animation (0 = none), +3 flags, +4 / +6 the X / Y where he arrives.
 * $098A counts the frames of the walk out:
 *   0: the first; the destination ($098B): + the season (flag 0); flag 6:
 *      on day 1 of spring $3A, on day 24 of winter $39, on days 10-12 + 4
 *      (the festivals). The door is shut (he stays, the tiles under him are
 *      forgotten) in map $0B, or by its flags: 1 from 17:00, 2 before 17:00,
 *      3 on weekdays 1-5, 4 on the 10th of winter or Saturdays, 5 on
 *      Sundays, 7 with $0196 bit 4. Open: the clock stops ($0973 = 0), the
 *      arrival point goes to $017D / $017F and the map animation starts;
 *   1: waits while $00CF;
 *   then up to $0D he walks on (action 1) in his facing (3 = any other);
 *   at $0D: leaving a farm map (below 4) the farm is saved; leaving the
 *      maps $0C-$0F an hour passes (not past 18:00) and HaveLunch; then
 *      $0196 bit 14 (the transition).
 * Leftovers: the original's A, X, Y and C on each path.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

static uint8_t door(uint8_t *ram, uint16_t x) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, DOOR_TABLE + x); }
static bool cmp8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t a, uint8_t v) { r->c = a >= v; return a == v; }

/* LDA $0878; ASL; ASL; TAY; LDA #0; XBA; LDA [$0D],Y; ASL x3; TAX */
static uint16_t door_entry(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t tile = rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_1);
  r->y = (uint16_t)(tile << 2);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_TILE_PROPS, r->y)) << 3);
  r->c = 0;                                       /* a byte x 8 */
  r->x = r->a;
  return r->x;
}
static void door_shut(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  state_off(ram, r, 0x0080);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_1, 0);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2, 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_DOOR_STEP, 0);
}
/* the flags 1-5 and 7 (C as the CMPs leave it: the closed door keeps it) */
static bool shut_by_flags(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t flags)
{
  uint8_t hour = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR)), weekday = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_WEEKDAY));
  uint8_t season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)), day = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY));
  if (flags & 0x02) { r->c = hour >= 0x11; if (r->c) return true; }       /* from 17:00 */
  if (flags & 0x04) { r->c = hour >= 0x11; if (!r->c) return true; }      /* before 17:00 */
  if ((flags & 0x08) && weekday != 0 && !cmp8(r, weekday, 0x06)) return true;
  if (flags & 0x10) {
    if (cmp8(r, season, 0x03) && cmp8(r, day, 0x0A)) return true;
    if (cmp8(r, weekday, 0x06)) return true;
  }
  if ((flags & 0x20) && weekday == 0) return true;
  if ((flags & 0x80) && (rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0010)) return true;
  return false;
}
/* the first frame on the exit; X = the entry */
static void door_open(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t x)
{
  uint8_t flags = door(ram, x + DOOR_FLAGS);
  uint8_t dest = rd8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP);
  if (flags & 0x01) dest = (uint8_t)(dest + hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON)));
  if (flags & 0x40) {                                     /* the festivals */
    uint8_t day = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY)), season = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON));
    if (day == 0x01) { if (season == 0) dest = 0x3A; }
    else if (day == 0x18) { if (season == 3) dest = 0x39; }
    else if (day >= 0x0A && day < 0x0D) dest = (uint8_t)(dest + 4);
  }
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP, dest);
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  if (cmp8(r, map, 0x0B) || shut_by_flags(ram, r, flags)) {
    door_shut(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING, 0);                        /* the clock stops */
  r->x = (uint16_t)(x + DOOR_ARRIVE_Y);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_X, hm_bus_rd16(ram, DOOR_TABLE + x + DOOR_ARRIVE_X));
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_Y, hm_bus_rd16(ram, DOOR_TABLE + x + DOOR_ARRIVE_Y));
  uint8_t animation = *hm_dp(ram, r, DOOR_MAP_ANIM);
  r->a = animation;                                       /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $92 */
  r->c = 1;                                               /* CMP #0 */
  if (animation) jsl(ram, r, 0x9C56, 0x81, hm_StartMapAnimation);
}

void hm_CheckDoors(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const uint16_t under[] = { HM_PLAYER_TILE_1, HM_PLAYER_TILE_2 };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, under[i]);
    r->c = r->a >= 0x00C0;
    if (!r->c) return;
    r->c = r->a >= 0x00D0;
    if (r->c) { hm_CheckMountainFinds(ram, r); return; }
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0010);
  if (r->a) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_60)) & 0x0006);
  if (r->a) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_6C)) & 0x0001);
  if (r->a) {
    uint16_t x = door_entry(ram, r);
    set_a8(r, door(ram, x));
    if (cmp8(r, (uint8_t)r->a, 0x1C)) return;
  }
  set_action(ram, r, 0x0000);
  state_on(ram, r, 0x0080);

  uint8_t step = rd8(ram, r, HM_DOOR_STEP);
  set_a8(r, step);
  bool walk = false;
  if (cmp8(r, step, 0x01)) {
    r->a = rd16(ram, r, HM_MAP_ANIM);
    if (r->a) return;
    walk = true;
  } else if (step >= 0x02) walk = true;
  if (!walk) {                                            /* the first frame */
    set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(step + 1));
    wr8(ram, r, HM_DOOR_STEP, (uint8_t)(step + 1));
    uint16_t x = door_entry(ram, r);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TRANSITION_MAP, door(ram, x));         /* the destination */
    *hm_dp(ram, r, DOOR_MAP_ANIM) = door(ram, x + DOOR_ANIM);
    r->x = (uint16_t)(x + DOOR_FLAGS);
    door_open(ram, r, x);
    return;
  }

  step = rd8(ram, r, HM_DOOR_STEP);
  set_a8(r, step);
  if (!cmp8(r, step, 0x0D)) {                             /* walking out */
    set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(step + 1));
    wr8(ram, r, HM_DOOR_STEP, (uint8_t)(step + 1));
    set_action(ram, r, 0x0001);
    uint16_t facing = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
    r->a = facing;
    if (facing > 2) { r->c = facing >= 2; facing = 3; }
    else r->c = 1;
    set_dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION, facing);
    r->a = facing;
    wr16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_TURN, facing);
    return;
  }
  uint8_t map = rd8(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);                   /* LDA $0022 (absolute) */
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 0x04;
  if (!r->c) jsl(ram, r, 0x9CDC, 0x82, hm_CopyCurrentMapToFarmMap);
  map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 0x0C;
  if (r->c && (r->c = map >= 0x10, !r->c)) {
    uint8_t hour = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR));
    set_a8(r, hour);
    if (!cmp8(r, hour, 0x12)) {
      set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(hour + 1));
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR), (uint8_t)(hour + 1));
      jsl(ram, r, 0x9CFB, 0x82, hm_HaveLunch);
    }
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) | 0x4000);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * $1C ($81:C061): swapping the tool in hand and the one in the bag. The
 * first frame ($D2 bit 15 off, then on) the animation is $90 + the bag's
 * tool; when it is over: action 0, the two tools change places ($0921 /
 * $0923) and the new tool's noises are loaded (ToolUsedSound2, which waits
 * a frame when it changes instruments).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_PlayerState_1C_SwapTools(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x8000);
  if (!r->a) {
    state_on(ram, r, 0x8000);
    uint8_t bag = rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK);
    uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)bag + 0x90;                   /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA; CLC; ADC #$90 */
    r->c = sum > 0xFF;
    r->a = (uint8_t)sum;
    wr16(ram, r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, r->a);                   /* REP #$20; STA */
  }
  animate(ram, r, 0xC08A);
  if (anim_over(ram, r)) {
    set_action(ram, r, 0);
    uint8_t hand = rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED), bag = rd8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK);
    hm_push8(ram, r, hand);                                /* SEP #$20; PHA */
    set_a8(r, bag);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED, bag);
    set_a8(r, hm_pull8(ram, r));                           /* PLA */
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TOOL_BACKPACK, hand);
    r->p = entry;
    jsl(ram, r, 0xC0AE, 0x82, hm_ToolUsedSound2);
    r->p = entry;
  }
  END(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PlayerFrame ($81:BFB7, JSL, RTL): the player each frame (see the top of
 * this file). Without $D2 bit 0 only the frame's end; with bit 6 the
 * pending action (PlayerInteractionSelector); otherwise the step of action
 * $D4 (JMP (DATA16_81C027,X): 29 words; $19 goes straight to the frame's
 * end).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void not_idle_step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { not_idle(ram, r); }
static Fn *const PLAYER_STEPS[29] = {
  hm_PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun, hm_PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun, hm_PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun, hm_PlayerState_03_Jump, hm_PlayerState_04_PickUp,
  hm_PlayerState_05_Throw, hm_PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun, hm_PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun, hm_PlayerState_08_Eat, hm_PlayerIdleAnimation,
  hm_PlayerState_0A_UseTool, hm_PlayerState_0B_Tired, hm_PlayerState_0C_ShowToolAndTime, hm_PlayerState_0D_WhistleHorse, hm_PlayerState_00_StandWalkRun,
  hm_PlayerState_0F_HoldRod, hm_PlayerState_10_CastLine, hm_PlayerState_11_WaitForBite, hm_PlayerState_12_FishBites, hm_PlayerState_13_ReelInCatch,
  hm_PlayerState_14_FeelSick, hm_PlayerState_15_BeforeFeelSick, hm_PlayerState_16_ReleaseDog, hm_PlayerState_17_PickUpFoal, hm_PlayerState_18_PutDownFoal,
  not_idle_step, hm_PlayerState_1A_PutChildBack, hm_PlayerState_1B_WhistleDog, hm_PlayerState_1C_SwapTools };

static void step_of_action(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)        /* CODE_81BFD3 */
{
  uint16_t action = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  r->c = (action & 0x8000) != 0;                           /* ASL; TAX */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(action << 1);
  r->x = r->a;
  if (action < 29) PLAYER_STEPS[action](ram, r);
}

void hm_PlayerFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0001);
  if (!r->a) { hm_ResetIdleAnimationTimer(ram, r); return; }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0040);
  if (r->a) { hm_PlayerInteractionSelector(ram, r); return; }
  step_of_action(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PlayerInteractionSelector ($81:D570, JMP from PlayerFrame): the pending
 * action $096E (JSR through PlayerActionPointerTable, $81:D593: 88 words,
 * actions.c and interact.c); then the idle timer is cleared and, if the
 * time is stopped for the day's end ($0973 bit 1), only the frame's end
 * follows, else the step of the player's action too.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static Fn *const PLAYER_ACTIONS[0x58] = {
  hm_ActionNothing, hm_GetFenceFromStack, hm_ActionNothing, hm_PlayerAction_04_Jingle,
  hm_ActionNothing, hm_PlayerAction_06_MapAnimation11, hm_PlayerAction_07_MapAnimation12, hm_ActionNothing,
  hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing,
  hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_PlayerAction_0F_Tv,
  hm_PlayerAction_10, hm_PlayerAction_11, hm_PlayerAction_12, hm_PlayerAction_13,
  hm_PlayerAction_14, hm_PlayerAction_15, hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing,
  hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing,
  hm_ActionNothing, hm_PlayerAction_1D, hm_PlayerAction_1E, hm_ActionNothing,
  hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing,
  hm_ActionNothing, hm_ActionNothing, hm_PlayerAction_26, hm_PlayerAction_27,
  hm_PlayerAction_28, hm_PlayerAction_29, hm_PlayerAction_2A, hm_PlayerAction_2B,
  hm_PlayerAction_2C, hm_PlayerAction_2D, hm_PlayerAction_2E, hm_PlayerAction_2F,
  hm_PlayerAction_30, hm_PlayerAction_31, hm_PlayerAction_32, hm_PlayerAction_33,
  hm_PlayerAction_34, hm_PlayerAction_35, hm_PlayerAction_36, hm_PlayerAction_37,
  hm_PlayerAction_38, hm_PlayerAction_39, hm_PlayerAction_3A, hm_PlayerAction_3B,
  hm_PlayerAction_3C, hm_PlayerAction_3D, hm_PlayerAction_3E, hm_PlayerAction_3F,
  hm_PlayerAction_40, hm_PlayerAction_41, hm_PlayerAction_42, hm_PlayerAction_43,
  hm_PlayerAction_44, hm_PlayerAction_45, hm_PlayerAction_46, hm_PlayerAction_47,
  hm_PlayerAction_48, hm_PlayerAction_49, hm_PlayerAction_4A, hm_PlayerAction_4B,
  hm_PlayerAction_4C, hm_PlayerAction_4D, hm_PlayerAction_4E, hm_PlayerAction_4F,
  hm_PlayerAction_50, hm_PlayerAction_51, hm_PlayerAction_52, hm_PlayerAction_53,
  hm_PlayerAction_54, hm_PlayerAction_55, hm_PlayerAction_56, hm_PlayerAction_57,
};

void hm_PlayerInteractionSelector(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t action = rd8(ram, r, HM_INTERACTION);            /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA; ASL */
  r->c = action >> 7;
  r->a = (uint8_t)(action << 1);
  r->x = r->a;                                             /* REP #$20; TAX */
  if (action < 0x58) jsr(ram, r, 0xD57E, PLAYER_ACTIONS[action]);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_IDLE_TIMER, 0);                           /* SEP #$20; STZ $0925 */
  uint8_t time = rd8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING);
  set_a8(r, time & 0x02);
  if (time & 0x02) not_idle(ram, r);
  else step_of_action(ram, r);
}

```

`src/reset.c`:

```c
/*
 * reset.c — the power-on (the RESET vector, $80:8428).
 *
 * The CPU starts in emulation mode with interrupts off; RESET switches to
 * native mode, puts the stack at $1F00 and the direct page at 0, writes
 * every register of the CPU and the picture chip with its start value,
 * clears all the WRAM, uploads the sound program to the sound chip and
 * starts it, clears VRAM, OAM and CGRAM, checks the saved games, turns
 * the NMI on and goes to the title (IntroScreen, JML).
 *
 * It never returns and throws the stack away. Its check (HM_TOLOOP, at
 * frame 1 like UploadSoundProgram, whose upload needs the chip's boot ROM:
 * HM_LIVE) stops at the JML and puts the checker's own frame back on the
 * stack (the bytes RESET cleared, and S), so the call can end; the
 * rewrite does the same at its end.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ────────────────────────────── */

/* Direct page */
#define SOUND_PROGRAM     0x0A   /* 24b $0A-$0C: UploadSoundProgram's argument, where
                                    the sound program is */
#define SOUND_PROGRAM_BANK 0x0C  /* 16b: its bank (and a 0 byte) */

/* WRAM of the data bank */
#define STACK_TOP         0x1F00 /* the stack starts here (S), the WRAM's first bank
                                    ends at $2000 */
#define WRAM_LOW_END      0x2000 /* the first $2000 bytes of WRAM, seen in every bank */
#define WRAM_REST         0x7E2000u /* bus address: the rest of bank $7E */
#define WRAM_REST_SIZE    0xE000
#define WRAM_BANK_7F      0x7F0000u /* bus address: the bank $7F, all of it */

typedef void Fn(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r);

static uint32_t db(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db(r, a), v); }
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }

static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint8_t bank, Fn *fn)
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, (uint16_t)(at + 3), bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* The registers, in the order RESET writes them (STZ, or the value):
 * the CPU's ($4200-$421F: the NMI and the DMA off, the I/O port $FF, the
 * multiplier and divider, the timers, FastROM on, and stores to the
 * read-only ones), then the picture chip's ($2100-$2133: the scroll and
 * mode 7 registers twice, VRAM increment after the high byte ($80),
 * colour math $30 / $E0), then stores to its read-only ones and the WRAM
 * port ($2134-$2183). */
typedef struct { uint16_t reg; uint8_t v; } Write;
static const Write REGS[] = {
  { NMITIMEN, 0 }, { MDMAEN, 0 }, { HDMAEN, 0 }, { WRIO, 0xFF },
  { WRMPYA, 0 }, { WRMPYB, 0 }, { WRDIVL, 0 }, { WRDIVH, 0 }, { WRDIVB, 0 },
  { HTIMEL, 0 }, { HTIMEH, 0 }, { VTIMEL, 0 }, { VTIMEH, 0 }, { MDMAEN, 0 }, { HDMAEN, 0 },
  { MEMSEL, 0x01 },
  { RDNMI, 0 }, { TIMEUP, 0 }, { HVBJOY, 0 }, { RDIO, 0 }, { RDDIVL, 0 }, { RDDIVH, 0 },
  { RDMPYL, 0 }, { RDMPYH, 0 }, { JOY1L, 0 }, { JOY1H, 0 }, { JOY2L, 0 }, { JOY2H, 0 },
  { JOY3L, 0 }, { JOY3H, 0 }, { JOY4L, 0 }, { JOY4H, 0 },
  { INIDISP, 0 }, { OBSEL, 0 }, { OAMADDL, 0 }, { OAMADDH, 0 }, { OAMDATA, 0 }, { OAMDATA, 0 },
  { BGMODE, 0 }, { MOSAIC, 0 }, { BG1SC, 0 }, { BG2SC, 0 }, { BG3SC, 0 }, { BG4SC, 0 },
  { BG12NBA, 0 }, { BG34NBA, 0 },
  { BG1HOFS, 0 }, { BG1HOFS, 0 }, { BG1VOFS, 0 }, { BG1VOFS, 0 }, { BG2HOFS, 0 }, { BG2HOFS, 0 },
  { BG2VOFS, 0 }, { BG2VOFS, 0 }, { BG3HOFS, 0 }, { BG3HOFS, 0 }, { BG3VOFS, 0 }, { BG3VOFS, 0 },
  { BG4HOFS, 0 }, { BG4HOFS, 0 }, { BG4VOFS, 0 }, { BG4VOFS, 0 },
  { VMAIN, 0x80 }, { VMADDL, 0 }, { VMADDH, 0 }, { VMDATAL, 0 }, { VMDATAH, 0 }, { M7SEL, 0 },
  { M7A, 0 }, { M7A, 0 }, { M7B, 0 }, { M7B, 0 }, { M7C, 0 }, { M7C, 0 },
  { M7D, 0 }, { M7D, 0 }, { M7X, 0 }, { M7X, 0 }, { M7Y, 0 }, { M7Y, 0 },
  { CGADD, 0 }, { CGDATA, 0 }, { CGDATA, 0 },
  { W12SEL, 0 }, { W34SEL, 0 }, { WOBJSEL, 0 }, { WH0, 0 }, { WH1, 0 }, { WH2, 0 },
  { WH3, 0 }, { WBGLOG, 0 }, { WOBJLOG, 0 }, { TM, 0 }, { TS, 0 }, { TMW, 0 },
  { TSW, 0 }, { CGWSEL, 0x30 }, { CGADSUB, 0 }, { COLDATA, 0xE0 }, { SETINI, 0 },
  { MPYL, 0 }, { MPYM, 0 }, { MPYH, 0 }, { SLHV, 0 }, { RDOAM, 0 }, { RDVRAML, 0 },
  { RDVRAMH, 0 }, { RDCGRAM, 0 }, { RDCGRAM, 0 }, { OPHCT, 0 }, { OPVCT, 0 }, { STAT77, 0 },
  { STAT78, 0 }, { WMDATA, 0 }, { WMADDL, 0 }, { WMADDM, 0 }, { WMADDH, 0 },
};

void hm_RESET(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  /* the checker's frame (not the original's: see above) */
  uint16_t s_in = r->s;
  uint8_t frame[3];
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) frame[i] = ram[(uint16_t)(s_in + 1 + i)];

  r->c = 0;                                                /* SEI; CLC; XCE (native already) */
  r->x = STACK_TOP;                                        /* REP #$30; LDX; TXS */
  r->s = STACK_TOP;
  r->a = 0;                                                /* LDA #0; TCD */
  r->d = 0;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof REGS / sizeof REGS[0]; i++) {   /* SEP #$30 */
    if (REGS[i].v) set_a8(r, REGS[i].v);
    wr8(ram, r, REGS[i].reg, REGS[i].v);
  }
  r->a = 0;                                                /* REP #$30: all the WRAM cleared */
  for (r->x = 0; r->x != WRAM_LOW_END; r->x += 2) wr16(ram, r, r->x, 0);
  for (r->x = 0; r->x != WRAM_REST_SIZE; r->x += 2) hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_REST + r->x, 0);
  r->x = 0;
  do { hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_BANK_7F + r->x, 0); r->x += 2; } while (r->x != 0);
  r->c = 1;                                                /* CPX #0 */
  static const uint16_t PADS[8] = { HM_PAD1_HELD, HM_PAD1_NEW, HM_PAD1_LAST, HM_PAD1_UP, HM_PAD2_HELD, HM_PAD2_NEW, HM_PAD2_LAST, HM_PAD2_UP };
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) wr16(ram, r, PADS[i], 0);
  r->a = 0x8000;                                           /* the sound program at $AD:8000 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOUND_PROGRAM, 0x8000);
  r->a = 0x00AD;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOUND_PROGRAM_BANK, 0x00AD);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x85FC, 0x83, hm_UploadSoundProgram);
  set_a8(r, 0x00);                                         /* SEP #$20 */
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8604, 0x83, hm_SoundCommand0B);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8608, 0x83, hm_LoadDefaultInstruments);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x860C, 0x83, hm_SendSoundData);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8610, 0x80, hm_InitializeScreenStatusVars);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8614, 0x80, hm_ZeroesVRAM);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8618, 0x80, hm_ZeroesOAM);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x861C, 0x80, hm_ZeroesCGRAM);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8620, 0x85, hm_ClearSpriteDataTables);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8624, 0x85, hm_InitializeOBJs);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8628, 0x83, hm_CheckSRAMIntegrity);
  set_a8(r, 0x80);                                         /* SEP #$20; REP #$10 */
  wr8(ram, r, INIDISP, 0x80);                              /* the screen off */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_UNKNOWN_0148, 0);
  wr8(ram, r, NMITIMEN, 0x80);                             /* the NMI on */
  wr8(ram, r, INIDISP, 0);
  /* CLI; JML IntroScreen: the check stops here and puts its frame back */
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) ram[(uint16_t)(s_in + 1 + i)] = frame[i];
  r->s = s_in;
  g_hm_next = 0x82D75E;
}
```

`src/rng.c`:

```c
/*
 * rng.c — the random number generator.
 *
 * GetRNG ($83:8138, JSL, RTL). Harvest Moon keeps 24 bits of state in
 * $7E:0100-0102 (HM_RNG_STATE). Each call shifts the state right by one as
 * a 24-bit LFSR whose feedback bit is bit 1 of (state[1] XOR state[0]), then
 * mixes the three bytes into a new state[0], which is also the result
 * (0..255, returned in A with the high byte cleared).
 *
 * Everything that is "random" in the game goes through here: weather,
 * animal moods, which items grow, what villagers say... Event scripts keep a
 * copy of the last value in $00DE.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* Direct page used by RNGReturn0toA */
#define ROLL_LAST_FACE    0x92   /* 8b: n, then n-1 */
#define ROLL_STEP         0x93   /* 8b: 255 / n */
#define ROLL_VALUE        0x94   /* 8b: what GetRNG gave */
#define DIVIDEND          0x7E   /* 16b: DivisionUnsigned's dividend (math.c) */
#define DIVISOR           0x80   /* 16b: its divisor */

/* ROR through carry, 8-bit, as the 65816 does it. */
static uint8_t ror8(uint8_t v, uint8_t *carry)
{
  uint8_t out = (uint8_t)((v >> 1) | (*carry << 7));
  *carry = v & 1;
  return out;
}

void hm_GetRNG(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t *s0 = &ram[HM_RNG_STATE + 0], *s1 = &ram[HM_RNG_STATE + 1],
          *s2 = &ram[HM_RNG_STATE + 2];

  /* Step the LFSR: shift [s1 s0 s2] right, feeding in bit 1 of s1^s0. */
  uint8_t c = ((*s1 ^ *s0) & 0x02) != 0;
  *s1 = ror8(*s1, &c);
  *s0 = ror8(*s0, &c);
  *s2 = ror8(*s2, &c);

  /* Mix: ((s1 + 0x47) rotated right twice through carry) ^ s0, + s2 + C. */
  unsigned sum = *s1 + 0x47u;
  uint8_t a = (uint8_t)sum;
  c = sum > 0xFF;
  a = ror8(a, &c);
  a = ror8(a, &c);
  a ^= *s0;
  sum = a + *s2 + c;
  a = (uint8_t)sum;
  c = sum > 0xFF;

  *s0 = a;
  r->a = a;          /* REP #$20; AND #$00FF */
  r->c = c;
}

/*
 * RNGReturn0toA ($80:89F9, JSL, RTL). "Roll a die with n faces": A = n
 * (8-bit) in, a number 0..n-1 out in A and X. The game uses it as
 * "1 chance in n" by testing the result for 0 (weather, and much more).
 *
 * How it works: step = 255 / n (DivisionUnsigned), r = GetRNG() (0..255).
 * The result is how many multiples of `step` are still below r:
 * 0 if r <= step, 1 if r <= 2*step, ... capped at n-1.
 *
 * So it is NOT perfectly fair: with n = 6, step = 42 and 0 comes out for
 * r = 0..42 (43 of 256 values) while 5 takes everything above 210 (45).
 * Edge cases: n = 1 always gives 0; n = 0 divides by zero (the hardware
 * answers $FFFF, step = $FF) and also always gives 0.
 *
 * Leftovers the checker compares: $92 = n-1, $93 = step, $94 = r, $7E/$80
 * from the division, the stack bytes (PHA of n and the two JSL frames),
 * 8-bit A/X/Y on exit, Y = 0 and C = 1 (both loop exits compare "≥").
 */
#define RNG_RET_DIVISION  0x8A0E   /* JSL DivisionUnsigned at $80:8A0B */
#define RNG_RET_GETRNG    0x8A16   /* JSL GetRNG at $80:8A13 */

void hm_RNGReturn0toA(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t faces = (uint8_t)r->a;
  r->x &= 0xFF; r->y &= 0xFF;                    /* SEP #$30 */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, ROLL_LAST_FACE) = faces;
  hm_push8(ram, r, faces);                       /* PHA */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, ROLL_STEP) = 0;

  /* step = 255 / faces */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DIVIDEND, 0x00FF);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, DIVISOR, faces);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RNG_RET_DIVISION, 0x83);
  hm_DivisionUnsigned(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  uint8_t step = (uint8_t)r->a;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, ROLL_STEP) = step;

  hm_jsl(ram, r, RNG_RET_GETRNG, 0x83);
  hm_GetRNG(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->x &= 0xFF; r->y &= 0xFF;                    /* SEP #$30 */
  uint8_t roll = (uint8_t)r->a;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, ROLL_VALUE) = roll;

  uint8_t last = (uint8_t)(hm_pull8(ram, r) - 1);  /* PLA; DEC */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, ROLL_LAST_FACE) = last;

  uint8_t result = 0, edge = step;
  while (edge < roll && ++result != last)
    edge = (uint8_t)(edge + step);

  r->x = result;
  r->a = result;                                 /* TXA; high byte is 0 */
  r->c = 1;
}
```

`src/save.c`:

```c
/*
 * save.c — the saved games, in the cartridge's battery RAM (SRAM).
 *
 * Two slots of 4 KB: slot 1 at $70:0000, slot 2 at $70:1000 (SRAM is
 * mapped in banks $70-$7D, see hm_bus_ram). The layout of a slot (what
 * SaveGameSlot writes):
 *
 *   +00  year, season, weekday, day        +04  seed bags (grass, corn,
 *        tomato, potato, turnip), cow feed, chicken feed
 *   +0B  cows, chickens   +0D  tomorrow's weather   +0E  max stamina
 *   +0F  item in hand     +10  water in the can     +11-+1A  more flags
 *   +2E  1 = this slot was saved last   +2F  checksum (16 bits)
 *   +31  shipped corn, tomatoes, turnips, potatoes (16 bits each)
 *   +39  money (24 bits)                +3C  "FARM" (the slot is valid)
 *   +40  wood, fodder, $0196, planted grass, hearts of the 5 girls
 *   +60  event flags $7F1F64-$7F1F6A, dog position, happiness, ...
 *   +78  wife's pregnancy, the children's ages   +7E  dog hugs
 *   +80  names: player, (+84 the shed's items), dog, horse, children
 *   +98  the 13 chickens (8 bytes each)   +100  the 12 cows (16 bytes)
 *   +1C0 the farm map from tile $C0 on, to the end of the slot
 *   (+1B-+2D and +52-+5F: unused. The native build's "one seed at a
 *   time" keeps its seeds in +20 = $5E and +21-+25, its crop bag in
 *   +52-+5A, with +5B = $BA; the wife's help, the last day she helps,
 *   in +5C-+5D, with +5E = $A7.)
 *
 * The checksum is the 16-bit sum of the slot's 2048 words, taken with +2E
 * and +2F-+30 at 0.
 */
#include <string.h>
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

#define SLOT_1        0x700000    /* SRAM: the first slot */
#define SEEDS_MARK_AT 0x20        /* the native build's seeds: +20 = $5E, +21-+25 */
#define SEEDS_MARK    0x5E
#define BAG_AT        0x52        /* the native build's crop bag: +52-+5A, +5B = $BA */
#define WIFE_AT       0x5C        /* the native build's wife's help: +5C-+5D, +5E = $A7 */
#define WIFE_MARK     0xA7
#define BAG_MARK      0xBA
#define SLOT_2        0x701000    /* SRAM: the second slot */

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* WRAM of the data bank (through db_addr) */
#define SAVE_SLOT         0x098E   /* 8b: the slot saved last (0 or 1) */

/* Direct page */
#define SLOT_PTR          0x72   /* 24b $72-$74: the slot in SRAM */
#define SLOT_PTR_BANK     0x74   /* 8b: its bank ($70) */
#define SAVED_SLOT_PTR    0x75   /* 24b $75-$77: LoadGameSlot keeps the slot here while
                                    LoadDefaultFarmMap uses SLOT_PTR */
#define SAVED_SLOT_PTR_BANK 0x77
#define WORK_SUM          0x7E   /* 16b: SaveGameSlot: the checksum, then the slot number */
#define STORED_SUM        0x7E   /* 16b: CheckSRAMIntegrity: the slot's stored checksum */
#define COMPUTED_SUM      0x80   /* 16b: CheckSRAMIntegrity: the sum worked out */
#define SLOT1_FAILED      0x82   /* 16b: 1 = slot 1 was cleared */
#define LAST_SAVED        0x92   /* 8b: the slot's SAVE_LAST_SAVED byte */

/* A slot's fields (offsets from SLOT_1 / SLOT_2) */
#define SAVE_YEAR           0x00
#define SAVE_SEASON         0x01
#define SAVE_WEEKDAY        0x02
#define SAVE_DAY            0x03
#define SAVE_SEEDS_GRASS    0x04   /* the seed bags */
#define SAVE_SEEDS_CORN     0x05
#define SAVE_SEEDS_TOMATO   0x06
#define SAVE_SEEDS_POTATO   0x07
#define SAVE_SEEDS_TURNIP   0x08
#define SAVE_COW_FEED       0x09
#define SAVE_CHICKEN_FEED   0x0A
#define SAVE_COWS_N         0x0B
#define SAVE_CHICKENS_N     0x0C
#define SAVE_WEATHER        0x0D   /* tomorrow's weather */
#define SAVE_MAX_STAMINA    0x0E
#define SAVE_TOOL           0x0F   /* the item in hand */
#define SAVE_WATER          0x10   /* water in the can */
#define SAVE_PREGNANCY_DAYS 0x11
#define SAVE_NEWBORN_HAPPINESS 0x12
#define SAVE_DOG_MAP        0x13
#define SAVE_HORSE_MAP      0x14
#define SAVE_HORSE_AGE      0x15
#define SAVE_BUILD_NIGHTS   0x16
#define SAVE_POWER_BERRIES  0x17
#define SAVE_VISIT_NIGHTS   0x18
#define SAVE_DEAD_COW       0x19
#define SAVE_BACKPACK       0x1A
#define SAVE_LAST_SAVED     0x2E   /* 1 = this slot was saved last */
#define SAVE_CHECKSUM       0x2F   /* 16b */
#define SAVE_SHIPPED_CORN   0x31   /* 16b each */
#define SAVE_SHIPPED_TOMATOES 0x33
#define SAVE_SHIPPED_TURNIPS 0x35
#define SAVE_SHIPPED_POTATOES 0x37
#define SAVE_MONEY          0x39   /* 16b, then */
#define SAVE_MONEY_HIGH     0x3B   /* its third byte */
#define SAVE_FARM_MARK      0x3C   /* "FARM": the slot is valid */
#define SAVE_WOOD           0x40   /* 16b */
#define SAVE_FODDER         0x42
#define SAVE_WEATHER_FLAGS  0x44
#define SAVE_PLANTED_GRASS  0x46
#define SAVE_HEARTS         0x48   /* 5 words: Maria .. Eve */
#define SAVE_FLAGS_64       0x60   /* 16b each: the story flags */
#define SAVE_FLAGS_66       0x62
#define SAVE_FLAGS_68       0x64
#define SAVE_FLAGS_6A       0x66
#define SAVE_DOG_X          0x68
#define SAVE_DOG_Y          0x6A
#define SAVE_HAPPINESS      0x6C
#define SAVE_HEN_EGGS       0x6E
#define SAVE_FLAGS_6C       0x70
#define SAVE_FLAGS_6E       0x72
#define SAVE_FLAGS_70       0x74
#define SAVE_FLAGS_72       0x76
#define SAVE_PREGNANCY      0x78
#define SAVE_KID1_AGE       0x7A
#define SAVE_KID2_AGE       0x7C
#define SAVE_DOG_HUGS       0x7E
#define SAVE_PLAYER_NAME    0x80   /* 4 bytes each */
#define SAVE_SHED           0x84   /* the shed's 4 bytes */
#define SAVE_DOG_NAME       0x88
#define SAVE_HORSE_NAME     0x8C
#define SAVE_KID1_NAME      0x90
#define SAVE_KID2_NAME      0x94
#define SAVE_CHICKEN_RECORDS 0x098 /* the 13 chickens' records */
#define SAVE_COW_RECORDS    0x100  /* the 12 cows' records */
#define SAVE_FARM_MAP       0x1C0  /* the farm map from tile $C0 on */

static uint32_t db_addr(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}
/* $72-$74 = the slot: $70:0000 for A = 0, $70:1000 for anything else.
 * Returns A as the code leaves it (LDA #$1000; SEP; LDA #$70, or the
 * slot number back from the stack). */
static uint16_t point_at_slot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t slot)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, (uint16_t)SLOT_1);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SLOT_PTR_BANK) = (uint8_t)(SLOT_1 >> 16);
  if (slot == 0) return slot;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, (uint16_t)SLOT_2);
  return 0x1070;
}
static uint8_t sram8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, y)); }
static uint16_t sram16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, y)); }
static void sram_w8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, y), v); }
static void sram_w16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, y), v); }

/* What goes where: offset in the slot, the variable, its size, and whether
 * the code reads it with the data bank (LDA.W) or a long address (LDA.L). */
typedef struct { uint16_t at; uint32_t from; uint8_t size, data_bank; } Field;
```
