```c
  /* money */
  { SAVE_MONEY,                WRAM_LONG(HM_MONEY),               2, 0 },
  { SAVE_MONEY_HIGH,           WRAM_LONG(HM_MONEY + 2),           1, 0 },
  /* player's name */
  { SAVE_PLAYER_NAME,          HM_PLAYER_NAME,                       1, 1 },
  { SAVE_PLAYER_NAME + 1,      HM_PLAYER_NAME + 1,                   1, 1 },
  { SAVE_PLAYER_NAME + 2,      HM_PLAYER_NAME + 2,                   1, 1 },
  { SAVE_PLAYER_NAME + 3,      HM_PLAYER_NAME + 3,                   1, 1 },
  /* the shed */
  { SAVE_SHED,                 WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS),          1, 0 },
  { SAVE_SHED + 1,             WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 1),      1, 0 },
  { SAVE_SHED + 2,             WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 2),      1, 0 },
  { SAVE_SHED + 3,             WRAM_LONG(HM_SHED_ITEMS + 3),      1, 0 },
  /* dog's name */
  { SAVE_DOG_NAME,             HM_DOG_NAME,                          1, 1 },
  { SAVE_DOG_NAME + 1,         HM_DOG_NAME + 1,                      1, 1 },
  { SAVE_DOG_NAME + 2,         HM_DOG_NAME + 2,                      1, 1 },
  { SAVE_DOG_NAME + 3,         HM_DOG_NAME + 3,                      1, 1 },
  /* horse's name */
  { SAVE_HORSE_NAME,           HM_HORSE_NAME,                        1, 1 },
  { SAVE_HORSE_NAME + 1,       HM_HORSE_NAME + 1,                    1, 1 },
  { SAVE_HORSE_NAME + 2,       HM_HORSE_NAME + 2,                    1, 1 },
  { SAVE_HORSE_NAME + 3,       HM_HORSE_NAME + 3,                    1, 1 },
  /* first child */
  { SAVE_KID1_NAME,            WRAM_LONG(HM_KID1_NAME),              1, 0 },
  { SAVE_KID1_NAME + 1,        WRAM_LONG(HM_KID1_NAME + 1),          1, 0 },
  { SAVE_KID1_NAME + 2,        WRAM_LONG(HM_KID1_NAME + 2),          1, 0 },
  { SAVE_KID1_NAME + 3,        WRAM_LONG(HM_KID1_NAME + 3),          1, 0 },
  /* second child */
  { SAVE_KID2_NAME,            WRAM_LONG(HM_KID2_NAME),              1, 0 },
  { SAVE_KID2_NAME + 1,        WRAM_LONG(HM_KID2_NAME + 1),          1, 0 },
  { SAVE_KID2_NAME + 2,        WRAM_LONG(HM_KID2_NAME + 2),          1, 0 },
  { SAVE_KID2_NAME + 3,        WRAM_LONG(HM_KID2_NAME + 3),          1, 0 },
};

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * SaveGameSlot ($83:B68E, JSL, RTL). A = the slot (0 or other). Writes the
 * fields above, the animals and the farm, the checksum, and marks this
 * slot as the last saved (+2E = 1 here, 0 in the other one). It does not
 * write "FARM": CheckSRAMIntegrity puts that when it clears a slot.
 * Leftovers: A = (high byte of the slot number : the last +2E written),
 * X = $0F00, Y = $2E, C = 1; $72-$74 = slot 2, $7E = the slot number.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_SaveGameSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t slot = r->a;
  push16(ram, r, slot);                               /* PHA (PLA; PHA again) */
  point_at_slot(ram, r, slot);
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof FIELDS / sizeof FIELDS[0]; i++) {
    const Field *f = &FIELDS[i];
    uint32_t from = f->data_bank ? db_addr(r, (uint16_t)f->from) : f->from;
    if (f->size == 1) sram_w8(ram, r, f->at, hm_bus_rd8(ram, from));
    else              sram_w16(ram, r, f->at, hm_bus_rd16(ram, from));
  }
  if (g_hm_single_seed) {                             /* the native build's seeds */
    sram_w8(ram, r, SEEDS_MARK_AT, SEEDS_MARK);
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 5; i++) sram_w8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(SEEDS_MARK_AT + 1 + i), g_hm_seeds_used[i]);
  }
  if (g_hm_bag_on) {                                  /* the native build's crop bag */
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 9; i++) sram_w8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(BAG_AT + i), g_hm_bag[i]);
    sram_w8(ram, r, BAG_AT + 9, BAG_MARK);
  }
  if (g_hm_wife_on) {                                 /* the native build's wife's help */
    sram_w8(ram, r, WIFE_AT, (uint8_t)g_hm_wife_until);
    sram_w8(ram, r, WIFE_AT + 1, (uint8_t)(g_hm_wife_until >> 8));
    sram_w8(ram, r, WIFE_AT + 2, WIFE_MARK);
  }
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x < 0x68; x++) sram_w8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(SAVE_CHICKEN_RECORDS + x), hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_DATA) + x));
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x < 0xC0; x++) sram_w8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(SAVE_COW_RECORDS + x), hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_DATA) + x));
  for (uint16_t x = 0xC0; x < 0xF00; x++)
    sram_w8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(SAVE_FARM_MAP + x - 0xC0), hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FARM_TILES) + x));

  sram_w8(ram, r, SAVE_LAST_SAVED, 0);
  sram_w16(ram, r, SAVE_CHECKSUM, 0);
  uint16_t sum = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, WORK_SUM, 0);
  for (uint16_t y = 0; y < 0x1000; y += 2) sum = (uint16_t)(sum + sram16(ram, r, y));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, WORK_SUM, sum);
  sram_w16(ram, r, SAVE_CHECKSUM, sum);

  slot = pull16(ram, r);                              /* PLA; STA $7E */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, WORK_SUM, slot);
  point_at_slot(ram, r, 0);
  sram_w8(ram, r, SAVE_LAST_SAVED, slot == 0 ? 1 : 0);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, (uint16_t)SLOT_2);
  sram_w8(ram, r, SAVE_LAST_SAVED, slot == 0 ? 0 : 1);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((slot & 0xFF00) | (slot == 0 ? 0 : 1));
  r->x = 0x0F00;
  r->y = SAVE_LAST_SAVED;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * LoadGameSlotResume ($83:BA45, JSL, RTL). A = the slot. What the title
 * screen shows of a slot: year, season and day; if the day is not 0 and
 * the slot says "FARM", also the player's name ($0881-$0884) and X = 1
 * ("there is a game here"); otherwise X = 0.
 * Leftovers: A = (high byte from the slot pointer code : the last byte
 * read), Y = the last offset read, C from the last compare.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_LoadGameSlotResume(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t slot = r->a;
  push16(ram, r, slot); pull16(ram, r);               /* PHA ... PLA */
  uint16_t a = point_at_slot(ram, r, slot);
  r->c = 1;                                           /* CMP #0 */
  r->x = 0;
  static const struct { uint16_t at; uint32_t to; } DATE[3] = {
    { SAVE_YEAR, WRAM_LONG(HM_YEAR) }, { SAVE_SEASON, WRAM_LONG(HM_SEASON) },
    { SAVE_DAY, WRAM_LONG(HM_DAY) } };
  uint8_t v = 0;
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    r->y = DATE[i].at;
    v = sram8(ram, r, r->y);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, DATE[i].to, v);
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)((a & 0xFF00) | v);
  if (v == 0) return;                                 /* day 0: an empty slot */
  static const char FARM[4] = { 'F', 'A', 'R', 'M' };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    r->y = (uint16_t)(SAVE_FARM_MARK + i);
    v = sram8(ram, r, r->y);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((a & 0xFF00) | v);
    r->c = v >= (uint8_t)FARM[i];
    if (v != (uint8_t)FARM[i]) return;
  }
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    r->y = (uint16_t)(SAVE_PLAYER_NAME + i);
    v = sram8(ram, r, r->y);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(HM_PLAYER_NAME + i)), v);
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)((a & 0xFF00) | v);
  r->x = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CheckSRAMIntegrity ($83:BAD4, JSL, RTL), at power-on. For each slot: it
 * must say "FARM" and its checksum must match; if not, its first 2 KB are
 * cleared and "FARM" is written back. $098E = 1 if slot 2 is valid and was
 * the last saved (its +2E = 1). $7F1F60 bit $0800 is cleared first and set
 * again only when slot 1 failed AND slot 2 failed too (the code checks
 * slot 1's result only on slot 2's failure path; the comment in HM-Decomp
 * says "at least one").
 * $82 = 1 if slot 1 failed, $7E / $80 = slot 2's stored / computed sums,
 * $92 = slot 2's +2E.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static bool slot_valid(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t *a)
{
  static const char FARM[4] = { 'F', 'A', 'R', 'M' };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
    r->y = (uint16_t)(SAVE_FARM_MARK + i);
    uint8_t v = sram8(ram, r, r->y);
    *a = (uint16_t)((*a & 0xFF00) | v);
    r->c = v >= (uint8_t)FARM[i];
    if (v != (uint8_t)FARM[i]) return false;
  }
  uint8_t last = sram8(ram, r, SAVE_LAST_SAVED);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, LAST_SAVED) = last;
  sram_w8(ram, r, SAVE_LAST_SAVED, 0);
  uint16_t stored = sram16(ram, r, SAVE_CHECKSUM);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, STORED_SUM, stored);
  sram_w16(ram, r, SAVE_CHECKSUM, 0);
  uint16_t sum = 0;
  for (uint16_t y = 0; y < 0x1000; y += 2) sum = (uint16_t)(sum + sram16(ram, r, y));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, COMPUTED_SUM, sum);
  *a = stored;
  r->c = stored >= sum;                               /* CMP $80 */
  if (stored != sum) return false;
  sram_w16(ram, r, SAVE_CHECKSUM, stored);
  r->y = SAVE_LAST_SAVED;
  sram_w8(ram, r, SAVE_LAST_SAVED, last);
  *a = (uint16_t)((stored & 0xFF00) | last);
  return true;
}
static void clear_slot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t *a)
{
  for (uint16_t y = 0; y < 0x0800; y += 2) sram_w16(ram, r, y, 0);
  r->c = 1;                                           /* CPY #$0800 */
  static const char FARM[4] = { 'F', 'A', 'R', 'M' };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; i++) sram_w8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(SAVE_FARM_MARK + i), (uint8_t)FARM[i]);
  r->y = SAVE_FARM_MARK + 3;
  *a = 'M';
}

void hm_CheckSRAMIntegrity(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, SAVE_SLOT), 0);
  uint16_t a = (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0xF7FF);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60, a);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SLOT1_FAILED, 0);
  point_at_slot(ram, r, 0);
  a = 0x0070;                                         /* LDA #0; SEP; LDA #$70 */
  if (!slot_valid(ram, r, &a)) {
    clear_slot(ram, r, &a);
    a = 1;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SLOT1_FAILED, 1);
  }
  point_at_slot(ram, r, 1);
  a = 0x1070;
  if (slot_valid(ram, r, &a)) {
    r->c = (uint8_t)a >= 1;                           /* CMP #1 */
    if ((uint8_t)a == 1) hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, SAVE_SLOT), 1);
  } else {
    clear_slot(ram, r, &a);
    a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SLOT1_FAILED);
    if (a) {
      a = (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) | 0x0800);
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60, a);
    }
  }
  r->a = a;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * LoadGameSlot ($83:B2B1, JSL, RTL). A = the slot (0 or other). The
 * inverse of SaveGameSlot: every field above back to its variable, in the
 * same order; each letter of the five names (player, dog, horse,
 * children) also as a 16-bit word in a second copy ($08D5, $08DD, $08E5,
 * $08ED, $08F5: 2 bytes per letter, the high byte 0); the chickens and
 * the cows; the default farm (LoadDefaultFarmMap) and over it the saved
 * part of the farm map (tiles $C0-$EFF). It checks nothing: neither
 * "FARM" nor the checksum (CheckSRAMIntegrity did that at power-on).
 * Leftovers: $75-$77 = the slot, $72-$74 = the default farm map's
 * pointer; A = (LoadDefaultFarmMap's high byte : the last tile), X = $F00,
 * Y = $1000, C = 1.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_LOAD_FARM 0xB677   /* JSL LoadDefaultFarmMap at $83:B674 */

void hm_LoadGameSlot(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t slot = r->a;
  push16(ram, r, slot); pull16(ram, r);               /* PHA ... PLA */
  r->a = point_at_slot(ram, r, slot);
  r->c = 1;                                           /* CMP #0 */
  /* where each name's letters start in the slot, and their 16-bit copies */
  static const struct { uint16_t at, copy; } NAMES[5] = {
    { SAVE_PLAYER_NAME, HM_PLAYER_NAME_WORDS }, { SAVE_DOG_NAME, HM_DOG_NAME_WORDS },
    { SAVE_HORSE_NAME, HM_HORSE_NAME_WORDS }, { SAVE_KID1_NAME, HM_KID1_NAME_WORDS },
    { SAVE_KID2_NAME, HM_KID2_NAME_WORDS } };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof FIELDS / sizeof FIELDS[0]; i++) {
    const Field *f = &FIELDS[i];
    uint32_t to = f->data_bank ? db_addr(r, (uint16_t)f->from) : f->from;
    r->y = f->at;
    for (unsigned n = 0; n < 5; n++)
      if (f->at == NAMES[n].at) r->a = (uint16_t)(r->a >> 8);   /* LDA #0; XBA */
    if (f->size == 1) {
      uint8_t v = sram8(ram, r, f->at);
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, to, v);
      for (unsigned n = 0; n < 5; n++)
        if (f->at >= NAMES[n].at && f->at < NAMES[n].at + 4)
          hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(NAMES[n].copy + 2 * (f->at - NAMES[n].at))), r->a);
    } else {
      r->a = sram16(ram, r, f->at);
      hm_bus_wr16(ram, to, r->a);
    }
  }
  if (g_hm_single_seed) {                             /* the native build's seeds */
    bool marked = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, SEEDS_MARK_AT)) == SEEDS_MARK;
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      uint8_t v = marked ? hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, (uint16_t)(SEEDS_MARK_AT + 1 + i))) : 0;
      g_hm_seeds_used[i] = v < 9 ? v : 0;
    }
  }
  if (g_hm_bag_on) {                                  /* the native build's crop bag */
    bool marked = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, BAG_AT + 9)) == BAG_MARK;
    for (uint16_t i = 0; i < 9; i++)
      g_hm_bag[i] = marked ? hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, (uint16_t)(BAG_AT + i))) : 0;
  }
  if (g_hm_wife_on) {                                 /* the native build's wife's help */
    bool marked = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, WIFE_AT + 2)) == WIFE_MARK;
    g_hm_wife_until = marked ? (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, WIFE_AT)) |
                                          hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SLOT_PTR, WIFE_AT + 1)) << 8) : 0;
  }
  uint16_t x;
  for (x = 0; x < 0x68; x++) {
    uint8_t v = sram8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(SAVE_CHICKEN_RECORDS + x));
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_CHICKEN_DATA) + x, v);
  }
  for (x = 0; x < 0xC0; x++) {
    uint8_t v = sram8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(SAVE_COW_RECORDS + x));
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_COW_DATA) + x, v);
  }
  r->x = 0xC0; r->y = SAVE_FARM_MAP;
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SLOT_PTR);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SAVED_SLOT_PTR, r->a);
  uint8_t bank = *hm_dp(ram, r, SLOT_PTR_BANK);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | bank);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SAVED_SLOT_PTR_BANK) = bank;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_LOAD_FARM, 0x82);
  hm_LoadDefaultFarmMap(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  for (x = 0xC0; x < 0xF00; x++) {
    uint8_t v = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SAVED_SLOT_PTR, (uint16_t)(SAVE_FARM_MAP + x - 0xC0)));
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FARM_TILES) + x, v);
  }
  r->x = 0xF00;
  r->y = 0x1000;
  r->c = 1;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * NewGameSetup ($83:A9BE, JSL, RTL): a new game. The same fields as a
 * saved game get their starting values: year 1 (0), spring, Monday the
 * 1st, one bag of grass seeds, 100 of max stamina, 300 G (30, money is
 * kept in tens), the shed with the basic tools ($0F) and the watering can
 * and the grass seeds ($88); every name "    " (character $B1, also the
 * 16-bit copies of the player's, the dog's and the horse's names), and
 * everything else 0; then the default farm (LoadDefaultFarmMap). The
 * chickens, the cows and the children's 16-bit name copies are left as
 * they are.
 * Quirk: the horse's name is written twice; the code was probably meant
 * to write something else the second time.
 * Leftovers: those of LoadDefaultFarmMap.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_NEW_FARM 0xABEE   /* JSL LoadDefaultFarmMap at $83:ABEB */

static uint16_t new_game_value(uint16_t at)
{
  switch (at) {
  case SAVE_WEEKDAY: case SAVE_DAY: case SAVE_SEEDS_GRASS: return 1; /* weekday, day, grass seeds */
  case SAVE_MAX_STAMINA: return 100;                  /* max stamina */
  case SAVE_MONEY: return 30;                         /* money: 300 G */
  case SAVE_SHED: return 0x0F;                        /* the shed */
  case SAVE_SHED + 1: return 0x88;
  default:
    if (at >= SAVE_PLAYER_NAME && at < SAVE_CHICKEN_RECORDS &&
        (at < SAVE_SHED || at >= SAVE_DOG_NAME)) return 0xB1;        /* names */
    return 0;
  }
}

void hm_NewGameSetup(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  memset(g_hm_seeds_used, 0, sizeof g_hm_seeds_used);  /* the native build's seeds */
  memset(g_hm_bag, 0, sizeof g_hm_bag);                 /* and crop bag */
  g_hm_wife_until = 0;                                  /* and the wife's help */
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof FIELDS / sizeof FIELDS[0]; i++) {
    const Field *f = &FIELDS[i];
    uint32_t to = f->data_bank ? db_addr(r, (uint16_t)f->from) : f->from;
    uint16_t v = new_game_value(f->at);
    if (f->size == 1) hm_bus_wr8(ram, to, (uint8_t)v);
    else              hm_bus_wr16(ram, to, v);
  }
  for (unsigned n = 0; n < 12; n++)                   /* player, dog, horse */
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, (uint16_t)(HM_PLAYER_NAME_WORDS + 2 * n)), 0x00B1);
  r->a = 0x00B1;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_NEW_FARM, 0x82);
  hm_LoadDefaultFarmMap(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

```

`src/scroll.c`:

```c
/*
 * scroll.c — scrolling a big map.
 *
 * A map can be bigger than what the SNES keeps in video memory. The whole
 * map's BG1 tilemap is in WRAM at $7E:2000 (see mapedit.c); VRAM holds a
 * window of it (at $6000, 64 x 32 entries in two halves). When the camera
 * crosses 8 pixels, the row or column of tiles that comes into view is
 * copied from WRAM into a buffer ($0746 / $07C6, two halves of 32 entries)
 * and queued as two DMAs to VRAM:
 *
 *   LoadMapRowBelow  a new row at the bottom   LoadMapRowAbove  a new row at the top
 *   LoadMapColumnRight  a new column at the right LoadMapColumnLeft  a new column at the left
 *
 * Direct page: $10 / $14 the VRAM position of the next column / row,
 * $12 / $16 the WRAM position, $1A the row length, $1C the camera's offset
 * inside the row, $1E the camera speed, $20 / $21 the sub-tile offset in
 * pixels (0-7), $ED / $EF / $F1 / $F3 the camera's limits (left, up, right,
 * down), $F5 / $F7 the camera position.
 *
 * Because the WRAM map is laid out in 32-entry screens, each copy splits
 * into two runs ($7E/$80 for the first half, $82/$84 for the second) that
 * wrap at the end of a screen ($40 bytes).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

#define ROW_BUFFER_1   0x0746   /* DB: the first half's 32 entries */
#define ROW_BUFFER_2   0x07C6   /* DB: the second half's */

/* ── Names of the memory locations used here ──────────────────────────────
 * The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* Direct page */
#define VRAM_COLUMN    0x10   /* 16b: the VRAM position of the next column */
#define WRAM_COLUMN    0x12   /* 16b: its position in the WRAM map */
#define VRAM_ROW       0x14   /* 16b: the VRAM position of the next row */
#define WRAM_ROW       0x16   /* 16b: its position in the WRAM map */
#define ROW_LENGTH     0x1A   /* 16b: the map's row length */
#define ROW_OFFSET     0x1C   /* 16b: the camera's offset inside the row */
#define CAMERA_SPEED   0x1E   /* 16b: pixels per frame */
#define SUB_X          0x20   /* 8b: the sub-tile offset across, 0-7 */
#define SUB_Y          0x21   /* 8b: down */
#define DMA_CHANNEL    0x27   /* 8b: AddProgrammedDMA's channel (dma.c) */
#define DMA_B_ADDRESS  0x29   /* 8b: its destination register (B-bus, $21xx) */
#define RUN1_SOURCE    0x72   /* 24b $72-$74: the first run's source in the map; queue():
                                 the DMA's source (AddProgrammedDMA) */
#define RUN1_SOURCE_BANK 0x74
#define RUN2_SOURCE    0x75   /* 24b $75-$77: the second run's source */
#define RUN2_SOURCE_BANK 0x77
#define RUN1_MAP_AT    0x7E   /* 16b: the first run's place in the map */
#define RUN1_BUFFER_AT 0x80   /* 16b: its place in the buffer */
#define RUN2_MAP_AT    0x82   /* 16b: the second run's place in the map */
#define RUN2_BUFFER_AT 0x84   /* 16b: its place in the buffer */
#define ROW_INNER      0x86   /* 16b: ROW_OFFSET / 4 */

/* Video memory */
#define BG1_MAP        0x2000   /* $7E:2000: the whole map's BG1 tilemap */
#define BG1_VRAM       0x6000   /* VRAM: the window of it (64 x 32 entries) */

static uint32_t db_addr(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static uint16_t dp16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a) { return hm_dp_r16(ram, r, a); }
static void set16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, unsigned a, uint16_t v) { hm_dp_w16(ram, r, a, v); }
static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static void pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r); }

/* the two runs: where they start in the map ($7E, $82) and in the buffer
 * ($80, $84) */
static void runs(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b, uint16_t c, uint16_t d)
{
  set16(ram, r, RUN1_MAP_AT, a); set16(ram, r, RUN1_BUFFER_AT, b); set16(ram, r, RUN2_MAP_AT, c);
  set16(ram, r, RUN2_BUFFER_AT, d);
}

/* 32 entries from [$72] (+$7E) and [$75] (+$82) into the buffers; each run
 * wraps at $40 bytes by moving `wrap` in the map; `step` per entry. */
static void copy_entries(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t step, uint16_t wrap)
{
  for (uint16_t x = 0; x < 0x40; x += 2) {
    push16(ram, r, x);                                  /* PHX */
    if (dp16(ram, r, RUN1_BUFFER_AT) == 0x40) {
      set16(ram, r, RUN1_BUFFER_AT, 0);
      set16(ram, r, RUN1_MAP_AT, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, RUN1_MAP_AT) + wrap));
    }
    if (dp16(ram, r, RUN2_BUFFER_AT) == 0x40) {
      set16(ram, r, RUN2_BUFFER_AT, 0);
      set16(ram, r, RUN2_MAP_AT, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, RUN2_MAP_AT) + wrap));
    }
    uint16_t v = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, RUN1_SOURCE, dp16(ram, r, RUN1_MAP_AT)));
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (db_addr(r, ROW_BUFFER_1) + dp16(ram, r, RUN1_BUFFER_AT)) & 0xFFFFFF, v);
    v = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, RUN2_SOURCE, dp16(ram, r, RUN2_MAP_AT)));
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (db_addr(r, ROW_BUFFER_2) + dp16(ram, r, RUN2_BUFFER_AT)) & 0xFFFFFF, v);
    set16(ram, r, RUN1_MAP_AT, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, RUN1_MAP_AT) + step));
    set16(ram, r, RUN1_BUFFER_AT, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, RUN1_BUFFER_AT) + 2));
    set16(ram, r, RUN2_MAP_AT, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, RUN2_MAP_AT) + step));
    set16(ram, r, RUN2_BUFFER_AT, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, RUN2_BUFFER_AT) + 2));
    pull16(ram, r);                                     /* PLX */
  }
}

/* the two DMAs: channel 0 the first buffer to VRAM $6000 + at, channel 1
 * the second to $6000 + at + half; mode $80 (rows) or $81 (columns:
 * VRAM steps 32 words) */
static void queue(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t at, uint16_t half, uint16_t mode,
                  uint16_t ret1, uint16_t ret2)
{
  static const uint16_t buffer[2] = { ROW_BUFFER_1, ROW_BUFFER_2 };
  for (unsigned ch = 0; ch < 2; ch++) {
    *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = (uint8_t)ch;
    *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_B_ADDRESS) = BBAD_VRAM;
    r->y = 0x0040;
    uint32_t to = (uint32_t)at + BG1_VRAM;              /* CLC; ADC #$6000 (; ADC half) */
    if (ch) to = (to & 0xFFFF) + half + (to > 0xFFFF);
    r->x = (uint16_t)to;
    set16(ram, r, RUN1_SOURCE, buffer[ch]);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, RUN1_SOURCE_BANK) = 0x80;
    r->a = mode;
    hm_jsl(ram, r, ch ? ret2 : ret1, 0x80);
    hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
}

/* the row windows from $12 (LoadMapRowBelow / LoadMapRowAbove) */
static void row_runs(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t v = dp16(ram, r, WRAM_COLUMN);
  if (v < 0x20) runs(ram, r, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  else if (v < 0x60) runs(ram, r, (uint16_t)(v - 0x20), (uint16_t)(v - 0x20), 0, 0);
  else if (v < 0xA0) runs(ram, r, 0x80, 0, (uint16_t)(v - 0x60), (uint16_t)(v - 0x60));
  else if (v < 0xC0) runs(ram, r, (uint16_t)(v - 0x20), (uint16_t)(v - 0xA0), 0x80, 0);
  /* $C0 and more: the runs are left as they are */
}
/* the column windows from $16 (LoadMapColumnRight / LoadMapColumnLeft): the buffer
 * position is the screen row, (offset >> 8) * 2 */
static void column_runs(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t last_mask)
{
  uint16_t v = dp16(ram, r, WRAM_ROW);
  if (v < 0x1000) runs(ram, r, 0, 0, 0, 0);
  else if (v < 0x3000) {
    uint16_t o = (uint16_t)(v - 0x1000);
    runs(ram, r, o, (uint16_t)(((o >> 8) & 0x1F) << 1), 0, 0);
  } else if (v < 0x5000) {
    uint16_t o = (uint16_t)(v - 0x3000);
    runs(ram, r, 0x4000, 0, o, (uint16_t)(((o >> 8) & 0x1F) << 1));
  } else if (v < 0x6000) {
    uint16_t o = (uint16_t)(v - 0x5000);
    runs(ram, r, (uint16_t)(v - 0x1000), (uint16_t)(((o >> 8) & last_mask) << 1), 0x4000, 0);
  }
}
static void sources(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t first, uint16_t second_offset)
{
  set16(ram, r, RUN1_SOURCE, first);
  set16(ram, r, RUN2_SOURCE, (uint16_t)(first + second_offset));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, RUN1_SOURCE_BANK) = 0x7E;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, RUN2_SOURCE_BANK) = 0x7E;
}
/* the next VRAM position: `next`, wrapped from `a` to `a2` and `b` to `b2` */
static void next_position(HmRegs *r, uint8_t *ram, unsigned at, uint16_t next,
                          uint16_t a, uint16_t a2, uint16_t b, uint16_t b2)
{
  r->c = next >= a;
  if (next == a) next = a2;
  else {
    r->c = next >= b;
    if (next == b) next = b2;
  }
  r->a = next;
  set16(ram, r, at, next);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * LoadMapRowBelow ($80:A18D, JSL, RTL): the row below comes into view.
 * Leftovers: A = the new $14, X = 1 (AddProgrammedDMA), Y = $40, C from
 * the wrap compares.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_LoadMapRowBelow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  row_runs(ram, r);
  uint16_t inner = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, ROW_OFFSET) >> 2);
  set16(ram, r, ROW_INNER, inner);
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)BG1_MAP + dp16(ram, r, WRAM_ROW); /* CLC; ADC $16; ADC $1C */
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + dp16(ram, r, ROW_OFFSET) + (s > 0xFFFF);
  uint16_t first = (uint16_t)((uint16_t)s - inner);    /* SEC; SBC $86 */
  sources(ram, r, first, 0x40);
  copy_entries(ram, r, 2, 0x40);
  queue(ram, r, dp16(ram, r, VRAM_ROW), 0x0400, 0x0080, 0xA2B6, 0xA2E3);
  set16(ram, r, WRAM_ROW, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, WRAM_ROW) + dp16(ram, r, ROW_LENGTH)));
  next_position(r, ram, VRAM_ROW, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, VRAM_ROW) + 0x20), 0x0400, 0x0800, 0x0C00, 0x0000);
}

/* LoadMapRowAbove ($80:A308): the row above. */
void hm_LoadMapRowAbove(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  row_runs(ram, r);
  uint16_t inner = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, ROW_OFFSET) >> 2);
  set16(ram, r, ROW_INNER, inner);
  uint16_t first = (uint16_t)(BG1_MAP + dp16(ram, r, WRAM_ROW) - inner);
  sources(ram, r, first, 0x40);
  copy_entries(ram, r, 2, 0x40);
  queue(ram, r, dp16(ram, r, VRAM_ROW), 0x0400, 0x0080, 0xA42F, 0xA45C);
  set16(ram, r, WRAM_ROW, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, WRAM_ROW) - dp16(ram, r, ROW_LENGTH)));
  next_position(r, ram, VRAM_ROW, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, VRAM_ROW) - 0x20), 0xFFE0, 0x0BE0, 0x07E0, 0x03E0);
}

/* LoadMapColumnRight ($80:A481): the column at the right. The second run's source
 * is $72 + $2000 with the carry of the first sum (no CLC). The last window
 * masks the screen row with $0F where LoadMapColumnLeft uses $1F (the same here,
 * the row is below $10). */
void hm_LoadMapColumnRight(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  column_runs(ram, r, 0x0F);
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)BG1_MAP + dp16(ram, r, WRAM_COLUMN); /* CLC; ADC $12; ADC #$60 */
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + 0x60 + (s > 0xFFFF);
  uint16_t first = (uint16_t)s;
  sources(ram, r, first, (uint16_t)(0x2000 + (s > 0xFFFF)));
  copy_entries(ram, r, 0x100, 0x2000);
  queue(ram, r, dp16(ram, r, VRAM_COLUMN), 0x0800, 0x0081, 0xA5C4, 0xA5F1);
  set16(ram, r, WRAM_COLUMN, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, WRAM_COLUMN) + 2));
  next_position(r, ram, VRAM_COLUMN, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, VRAM_COLUMN) + 1), 0x0020, 0x0400, 0x0420, 0x0000);
}

/* LoadMapColumnLeft ($80:A617): the column at the left. */
void hm_LoadMapColumnLeft(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  column_runs(ram, r, 0x1F);
  uint16_t first = (uint16_t)(BG1_MAP + dp16(ram, r, WRAM_COLUMN) - 0x20);
  sources(ram, r, first, 0x2000);
  copy_entries(ram, r, 0x100, 0x2000);
  queue(ram, r, dp16(ram, r, VRAM_COLUMN), 0x0800, 0x0081, 0xA75B, 0xA788);
  set16(ram, r, WRAM_COLUMN, (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, WRAM_COLUMN) - 2));
  uint16_t next = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, VRAM_COLUMN) - 1);
  r->c = next >= 0xFFFF;                              /* CMP #$FFFF */
  if (next == 0xFFFF) next = 0x041F;
  else { r->c = next >= 0x03FF; if (next == 0x03FF) next = 0x001F; }
  r->a = next;
  set16(ram, r, VRAM_COLUMN, next);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * The camera moves: BG1 follows the camera ($F5 / $F7 -> $013C / $013E);
 * unless it is at a limit, the speed $1E is capped to what is left, and
 * (with $0196 bit 0, "the map scrolls") the sub-tile offset advances;
 * every 8 pixels a new row / column is brought in.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
static bool follow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, unsigned pos, uint16_t bg, unsigned low, unsigned high,
                   bool towards_high)
{
  uint16_t p = dp16(ram, r, pos);
  r->a = p;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, bg), p);
  r->c = p >= dp16(ram, r, low);
  if (p == dp16(ram, r, low)) return false;
  r->c = p >= dp16(ram, r, high);
  if (p == dp16(ram, r, high)) return false;
  uint16_t room = p;
  if (!towards_high) {                                 /* LDA limit; SEC; SBC pos */
    room = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, high) - p);
    r->a = room;
  }
  r->c = room >= dp16(ram, r, CAMERA_SPEED);
  if (room < dp16(ram, r, CAMERA_SPEED)) set16(ram, r, CAMERA_SPEED, room);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS)) & 0x0001;
  return r->a != 0;
}
/* forwards: offset += speed; at 8 or more, -8 and a new line */
static bool forwards(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, unsigned sub)
{
  uint16_t s = (uint16_t)(*hm_dp(ram, r, sub) + *hm_dp(ram, r, CAMERA_SPEED));
  r->c = s > 0xFF;
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)s;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, sub) = v;
  r->a = v;
  r->c = v >= 8;
  if (v < 8) return false;
  v = (uint8_t)(v - 8);
  r->a = v;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, sub) = v;
  return true;
}
/* backwards: offset -= speed; below 0, +8 and a new line */
static bool backwards(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, unsigned sub)
{
  uint8_t o = *hm_dp(ram, r, sub), sp = *hm_dp(ram, r, CAMERA_SPEED);
  r->c = o >= sp;
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(o - sp);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, sub) = v;
  r->a = v;
  if (!(v & 0x80)) return false;
  uint16_t s = (uint16_t)(8 + v);
  r->c = s > 0xFF;
  v = (uint8_t)s;
  r->a = v;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, sub) = v;
  return true;
}

/* UpdateBGOffset ($80:A0AB): the camera goes down. */
void hm_UpdateBGOffset(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (follow(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_Y, HM_CAM_Y, HM_CAM_MIN_Y, HM_CAM_MAX_Y, true) && forwards(ram, r, SUB_Y)) {
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xA0DF, 0x80);
    hm_LoadMapRowBelow(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
}
/* ScrollCameraUp ($80:A0E1): the camera goes up. */
void hm_ScrollCameraUp(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (follow(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_Y, HM_CAM_Y, HM_CAM_MIN_Y, HM_CAM_MAX_Y, false) && backwards(ram, r, SUB_Y)) {
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xA11A, 0x80);
    hm_LoadMapRowAbove(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
}
/* ScrollCameraRight ($80:A11C): the camera goes right. */
void hm_ScrollCameraRight(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (follow(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_X, HM_CAM_X, HM_CAM_MIN_X, HM_CAM_MAX_X, true) && forwards(ram, r, SUB_X)) {
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xA150, 0x80);
    hm_LoadMapColumnRight(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
}
/* ScrollCameraLeft ($80:A152): the camera goes left. */
void hm_ScrollCameraLeft(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (follow(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_X, HM_CAM_X, HM_CAM_MIN_X, HM_CAM_MAX_X, false) && backwards(ram, r, SUB_X)) {
    hm_jsl(ram, r, 0xA18B, 0x80);
    hm_LoadMapColumnLeft(ram, r);
    hm_rtl(ram, r);
  }
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * PlaceCameraOnMapEntry ($80:9EBC, JSL, RTL): place the camera on entering a map: the
 * player in the middle of the screen (128 pixels), unless that would show
 * past a limit; then the camera stays at the limit and the player is off
 * centre. $090B / $090D = where the player is on the screen; the sub-tile
 * offset ($20 / $21) is 0 at the low limit, 8 at the high one.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
static void place_axis(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, unsigned pos, unsigned low, unsigned high,
                       uint16_t on_screen, unsigned sub, unsigned cam)
{
  uint16_t want = (uint16_t)(dp16(ram, r, pos) - 0x80);   /* SEC; SBC #$80 */
  uint16_t lo = dp16(ram, r, low);
  uint16_t diff = (uint16_t)(want - lo);                  /* CMP $low */
  bool below = (diff & 0x8000) || diff == 0 || want < lo; /* BMI / BEQ / not BCS */
  if (below) {
    uint16_t a = (uint16_t)(want + 0x80);                 /* CLC; ADC #$80 */
    r->c = (uint32_t)want + 0x80 > 0xFFFF;
    r->c = a >= lo;                                       /* SEC; SBC */
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, on_screen), (uint16_t)(a - lo));
    *hm_dp(ram, r, sub) = 0;
    r->a = lo;
    set16(ram, r, cam, lo);
    return;
  }
  uint16_t hi = dp16(ram, r, high);
  r->c = want >= hi;                                      /* CMP $high */
  if (!r->c) {
    set16(ram, r, cam, want);
    r->a = 0x0080;
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, on_screen), 0x0080);
    return;
  }
  uint16_t a = (uint16_t)(want + 0x80);
  r->c = a >= hi;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, on_screen), (uint16_t)(a - hi));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, sub) = 8;
  r->a = hi;
  set16(ram, r, cam, hi);
}
void hm_PlaceCameraOnMapEntry(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  place_axis(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X, HM_CAM_MIN_X, HM_CAM_MAX_X, HM_PLAYER_SCREEN_X, SUB_X, HM_CAMERA_X);
  place_axis(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y, HM_CAM_MIN_Y, HM_CAM_MAX_Y, HM_PLAYER_SCREEN_Y, SUB_Y, HM_CAMERA_Y);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * MoveSecondBackground ($80:9F61, JSL, RTL): the second background (BG2: $0140 /
 * $0142), every frame.
 *  - In the tool shed (map $26): nothing.
 *  - Maps $31 and up: BG2 follows the camera across; up and down it moves
 *    at half speed, 128 pixels lower (parallax). It also doubles the
 *    camera speed $1E (unless the camera is at a vertical limit).
 *  - Other maps, by $0196: bit 1: BG2 = the camera; bit 2: the clouds:
 *    BG2 moves with the camera (when the camera moves) and every 10 frames
 *    ($091C) drifts one pixel right and one up; bit 3: BG2 = the camera.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */

static uint16_t rdw(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, a)); }
static void wrw(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, a), v); }
/* CMP $a; BEQ / CMP $b; BEQ: at a limit */
static bool at_limit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v, unsigned a, unsigned b)
{
  r->c = v >= dp16(ram, r, a);
  if (v == dp16(ram, r, a)) return true;
  r->c = v >= dp16(ram, r, b);
  return v == dp16(ram, r, b);
}
static void drift(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t t = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_BG2_DRIFT_TIMER)) + 1);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | t);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_BG2_DRIFT_TIMER), t);
  r->c = t >= 0x0A;
  if (t != 0x0A) return;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_BG2_DRIFT_TIMER), 0);
  uint16_t x = rdw(ram, r, HM_BG2_X);
  wrw(ram, r, HM_BG2_X, (uint16_t)(x + 1));
  uint16_t y = rdw(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y);
  r->c = y >= 1;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(y - 1);
  wrw(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y, r->a);
}
static void follow_bg2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wrw(ram, r, HM_BG2_X, dp16(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_X));
  r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_Y);
  wrw(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y, r->a);
}
void hm_MoveSecondBackground(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | map);
  r->c = map >= 0x26;
  if (map == 0x26) return;
  r->c = map >= 0x31;
  if (r->c) {                                             /* parallax maps */
    r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_Y);
    if (at_limit(ram, r, r->a, HM_CAM_MIN_Y, HM_CAM_MAX_Y)) return;
    r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_X);
    wrw(ram, r, HM_BG2_X, r->a);
    uint16_t speed = dp16(ram, r, CAMERA_SPEED);
    r->c = speed >> 15;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(speed << 1);
    set16(ram, r, CAMERA_SPEED, r->a);
    r->a = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
    r->c = r->a >= 2;
    if (r->a == 2) return;
    r->c = r->a >= 3;
    if (r->a == 3) return;
    uint16_t y = dp16(ram, r, HM_CAMERA_Y);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((y >> 1) + 0x80);                   /* LSR; CLC; ADC #$80 */
    r->c = (uint32_t)(y >> 1) + 0x80 > 0xFFFF;
    wrw(ram, r, HM_BG2_Y, r->a);
    return;
  }
  if ((r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0002)) { follow_bg2(ram, r); return; }
  if (!(r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0004)) {
    if ((r->a = rdw(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0008)) follow_bg2(ram, r);
    return;
  }
  /* the clouds: with the camera, then the drift */
  uint16_t dir = dp16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  r->a = dir;
  unsigned d = 4;
  for (unsigned k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    r->c = dir >= k;
    if (dir == k) { d = k; break; }
  }
  if (d < 4) {
    bool vertical = d < 2;
    r->a = dp16(ram, r, vertical ? HM_CAMERA_Y : HM_CAMERA_X);
    if (!at_limit(ram, r, r->a, vertical ? HM_CAM_MIN_Y : HM_CAM_MIN_X,
                  vertical ? HM_CAM_MAX_Y : HM_CAM_MAX_X)) {
      uint16_t at = vertical ? HM_BG2_Y : HM_BG2_X;
      uint16_t v = rdw(ram, r, at), s = dp16(ram, r, CAMERA_SPEED);
      if (d == 0 || d == 2) { r->a = (uint16_t)(v + s); r->c = (uint32_t)v + s > 0xFFFF; }
      else { r->a = (uint16_t)(v - s); r->c = v >= s; }
      wrw(ram, r, at, r->a);
    }
  }
  drift(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AutoMapScrolling ($80:95B3, JSL, RTL): while $0880 counts down, the map
 * scrolls by itself: $F5 += $087C and $F7 += $087E, copied to BG1's scroll
 * ($013C / $013E); a negative Y scroll becomes 0 (but $F7 keeps it).
 * Leftovers: A = the new $F7 (or the 8-bit 0 of the counter), C from the
 * last ADC.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_AutoMapScrolling(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint32_t timer = (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_CAMERA_FRAMES;
  uint8_t t = hm_bus_rd8(ram, timer);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | t);
  if (!t) return;
  t--;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | t);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, timer, t);
  static const uint16_t pos[] = { HM_CAMERA_X, HM_CAMERA_Y }, speed[] = { HM_CAMERA_SPEED_X, HM_CAMERA_SPEED_Y },
                        bg[] = { HM_CAM_X, HM_CAM_Y };
  for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    uint32_t sum = (uint32_t)hm_dp_r16(ram, r, pos[i]) + hm_bus_rd16(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | speed[i]);
    r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
    r->a = (uint16_t)sum;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, pos[i], r->a);
    hm_bus_wr16(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | bg[i], r->a);
  }
  if (r->a & 0x8000) hm_bus_wr16(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_CAM_Y, 0);
}
```

`src/shipping.c`:

```c
/*
 * shipping.c — the shipping at 5 pm.
 *
 * ShippingScene ($82:8131, JSL, RTL; called every in-game hour by
 * UpdateTime): at 17:00, on the farm (maps 0-3), the shipping scene starts:
 * the input is switched off ($019A = 0), $7F1F5A bit 10 marks the scene as
 * running and script $26 is started in event slot 6 (StartEventScriptLong).
 * It then falls into ShippingSceneDialogue.
 *
 * ShippingSceneDialogue ($82:8165, JSL, RTL; also called by UpdateTime
 * every frame while bit 10 is set): once the scene's script has set
 * $7F1F5A bit 11, and no change of map is under way ($D2 bit 6), the
 * shipping text is shown: $031A (the day's shipping), or $031B when the
 * money shipped ($7F1F07-$7F1F09) is 0. Input mode 2 (text), the box
 * height is picked again ($0191 = 0), slot 6 gets script $27 and bit 10 is
 * cleared.
 * Both end at the same RTL (ShippingReturn, $82:81BF).
 * Leftovers: those of the last thing done: a compare (A = its value, C)
 * or the scripts / text routines.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* Direct page: HM_GAME_STATE ($D2, bit 6 = a change of map) and HM_MAP_ID ($22) */
#define SCENE_RUNNING   0x0400    /* HM_FLAGS_5A bit 10: the shipping scene is running */
#define SCENE_DONE      0x0800    /* HM_FLAGS_5A bit 11: its script says to show the text */

static uint32_t db_(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, uint8_t bank, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }

void hm_ShippingSceneDialogue(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) & SCENE_DONE);
  if (!r->a) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0040);
  if (r->a) return;
  r->a = 0x0002;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_(r, HM_INPUT_STATE), 0x0002);
  r->x = 0x031A;                                           /* the day's shipping */
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY));
  if (!r->a) {
    set_a8(r, hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_SHIPPING_MONEY_HIGH)));
    if (!(r->a & 0xFF)) r->x = 0x031B;                     /* nothing shipped */
  }
  set_a8(r, 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES), 0);
  jsl(ram, r, 0x81A2, 0x83, hm_StartTextBox);
  r->a = 0x0006; r->x = 0x0000; r->y = 0x0027;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x81B1, 0x84, hm_StartEventScript);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) & ~SCENE_RUNNING);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), r->a);
}

void hm_ShippingScene(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t hour = hm_bus_rd8(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_HOUR));
  set_a8(r, hour);
  r->c = hour >= 17;
  if (hour != 17) return;
  uint8_t map = *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID);
  set_a8(r, map);
  r->c = map >= 4;
  if (map >= 4) return;                                    /* not on the farm */
  set_a8(r, 0);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_INPUT_STATE), 0);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) | SCENE_RUNNING);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), r->a);
  r->a = 0x0006; r->x = 0x0000; r->y = 0x0026;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x8164, 0x84, hm_StartEventScriptLong);
  hm_ShippingSceneDialogue(ram, r);                        /* falls into it */
}
```

`src/stamina.c`:

```c
/*
 * stamina.c — the player's energy.
 *
 * ChangeStamina ($81:D061, JSL). A = signed 8-bit change (eating lunch is
 * +20, every tool use costs some). Max and current energy are 8-bit
 * (HM_MAX_STAMINA, HM_CURRENT_STAMINA).
 *
 *  - While $7F1F60 bit 3 is set, energy does not change at all.
 *  - Quirk: the 16-bit sign extension of the change ($83) comes from the N
 *    flag the CALLER left (BMI right after two STAs), not from A. Every
 *    caller loads A just before the JSL, so in practice they agree.
 *  - Going to 0 or below: energy 0, game-state bit 3 ("exhausted") set and
 *    the player collapses (animation $4D, action $0B).
 *  - Reaching the maximum: energy = max, bit 3 cleared.
 *  - Otherwise energy += change, bit 3 cleared.
 *
 * Tiredness (HM_EXHAUSTION, 0..3) then follows energy. After a gain it is
 * recomputed: the number of times max can be halved before reaching current
 * energy or less. After a loss it only goes up, one stage at a time: when
 * energy drops to max >> (stage + 1) or below, the stage advances and the
 * player plays the matching tired animation ($4A + stage).
 *
 * Leftovers: frozen: A = 8 and X, Y, C untouched. Otherwise, after a gain A = Y = the new stage, C from the last halving
 * compared; after a loss A = max >> (stage + 1) (stage 3: A = 3, C = 1),
 * Y = stage, or A = $000B, C = 0 when the stage advances. The high byte
 * of A is whatever the energy update left (the game state's, or 0).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* Direct page: scratch ChangeStamina leaves behind */
#define STAMINA_CHANGE        0x92      /* 8b: the change */
#define STAMINA_CHANGE16      0x82      /* 16b $82-$83: the change, sign-extended */
#define STAMINA_CHANGE16_HIGH 0x83      /* 8b: its high byte (from the caller's N) */
#define STAMINA_MAX_COPY      0x7E      /* 16b: the maximum energy */
#define STAMINA_AFTER         0x80      /* 16b: the energy after the change */

#define EXHAUSTED             0x0008    /* HM_GAME_STATE bit */
#define ACTION_TIRED          0x000B
#define ANIM_COLLAPSE         0x004D
#define ANIM_TIRED_BASE       0x4A

void hm_ChangeStamina(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  int8_t change = (int8_t)r->a;
  /* Scratch the original leaves behind: $92 = change, $82/$83 = change
   * sign-extended to 16 bits (with the caller's N, see above). */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, STAMINA_CHANGE) = (uint8_t)change;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, STAMINA_CHANGE16) = (uint8_t)change;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, STAMINA_CHANGE16_HIGH) = r->n ? 0xFF : 0x00;
  if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_60) & 0x0008) {
    r->a = 0x0008;                       /* LDA flags; AND #8: X, Y, C untouched */
    return;
  }

  uint8_t max = ram[HM_MAX_STAMINA];
  uint16_t after = (uint16_t)(ram[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA] + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, STAMINA_CHANGE16));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, STAMINA_MAX_COPY, max);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, STAMINA_AFTER, after);

  /* A after the energy update (only its high byte survives below) */
  uint16_t a;
  uint16_t state = hm_rd16(ram, HM_GAME_STATE);
  if (after == 0 || (after & 0x8000)) {
    ram[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA] = 0;
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_GAME_STATE, state | EXHAUSTED);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, ANIM_COLLAPSE);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, ACTION_TIRED);
    a = ACTION_TIRED;
  } else if (after >= max) {
    ram[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA] = max;
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_GAME_STATE, a = (uint16_t)(state & ~EXHAUSTED));
  } else {
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_GAME_STATE, (uint16_t)(state & ~EXHAUSTED));
    ram[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA] = (uint8_t)(ram[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA] + change);
    a = (uint16_t)((state & ~EXHAUSTED & 0xFF00) | ram[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA]);
  }
  /* SEP #$30. On the real SNES this also clears the high bytes of X and
   * Y; the recompilation (our reference) keeps them, so X comes back with
   * its high byte (Y is reloaded with LDY #0, which clears it, except at
   * stage 3). */
  uint16_t high = a & 0xFF00;

  uint8_t cur = ram[HM_CURRENT_STAMINA];
  uint8_t stage = ram[HM_EXHAUSTION];
  if (change >= 0) {
    /* stage = how many halvings of max stay above current energy */
    uint8_t level = 0, half = max;
    for (;;) {
      half >>= 1;
      r->c = half >= cur;                /* CMP current */
      if (half <= cur) break;
      level++;
    }
    ram[HM_EXHAUSTION] = level;
    r->y = level;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(high | level);     /* TYA */
  } else if (stage == 3) {
    r->c = 1;                            /* CMP #3 */
    r->a = (uint16_t)(high | 3);
  } else {
    uint8_t threshold = (uint8_t)(max >> (stage + 1));
    r->y = stage;
    r->c = threshold >= cur;
    r->a = (uint16_t)(high | threshold);
    if (threshold >= cur) {
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_ANIM_REQUEST, (uint16_t)(stage + ANIM_TIRED_BASE));
      ram[HM_EXHAUSTION] = (uint8_t)(stage + 1);
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, ACTION_TIRED);
      r->a = ACTION_TIRED;
      r->c = 0;                          /* the ADC #$4A */
    }
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * HaveLunch ($82:80AA, JSL, RTL). At 12:00 the player gets +20 energy
 * (ChangeStamina) and, unless busy, sits down to eat: $0924 = which lunch
 * (RNGReturn0toA(3): 0..2) and game-state bits $0004 and $0400 are set.
 * "Busy" is game state $0430 or $0800, or fishing (actions $0F-$13) or
 * jumping ($17, $18).
 * Leftovers: A, X, Y and C of the test it stops at or of the last call
 * (C = 1 on a busy action, from its CMP; past them, action >= $18).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_LUNCH_STAMINA 0x80C0   /* JSL ChangeStamina at $82:80BD */
#define RET_LUNCH_ROLL    0x8118   /* JSL RNGReturn0toA at $82:8115 */

void hm_HaveLunch(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t hour = ram[HM_HOUR];
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | hour);
  r->c = hour >= 12;
  if (hour != 12) return;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 20);       /* LDA #20 (8-bit) */
  r->n = 0;                                      /* ...which clears N */
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_LUNCH_STAMINA, 0x81);
  hm_ChangeStamina(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);

  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0430);
  if (r->a) return;
  uint16_t action = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION);
  r->a = action;
  static const uint16_t busy[] = { 0x0F, 0x10, 0x11, 0x12, 0x13, 0x17, 0x18 };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof busy / sizeof busy[0]; i++) {
    r->c = action >= busy[i];
    if (action == busy[i]) return;
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0800);
  if (r->a) return;

  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 3);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_LUNCH_ROLL, 0x80);
  hm_RNGReturn0toA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | HM_MEAL_CHOICE, (uint8_t)r->a);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0004));
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) | 0x0400);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE, r->a);
}
```

`src/stock.c`:

```c
/*
 * stock.c — the farm's stockpiles and the player's happiness.
 *
 * AddWood ($83:B224), AddGrass ($83:B253) and AddPlayerHappiness ($83:B282)
 * are the same routine on three counters: add A (signed, 16-bit) to the
 * counter, refuse if the result would be negative, cap it at 999.
 *
 *   returns A = 0  done (the counter changed, maybe capped at 999)
 *           A = 1  refused: the result would be negative (nothing changes)
 *
 * The amount is also left in the scratch variable $7E, as the original does.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */

#define STOCK_MAX 999

/* Direct page */
#define STOCK_CHANGE      0x7E   /* 16b scratch: the amount added (left there, as the original does) */
#define MONEY_CHANGE      0x72   /* 24b $72-$74: AddMoney's input, the signed amount */
#define MONEY_CHANGE_BANK 0x74   /* 8b: its third byte */
#define MONEY_SUM         0x75   /* 24b $75-$77: AddMoney's output, the sum */
#define MONEY_SUM_HIGH    0x77   /* 8b: its third byte */

static void add_capped(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t counter)
{
  uint16_t change = r->a;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, STOCK_CHANGE, change);
  unsigned sum = hm_rd16(ram, counter) + change;   /* CLC; ADC */
  uint16_t value = (uint16_t)sum;
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  if (value & 0x8000) {          /* negative: refuse */
    r->a = 1;
  } else if (value >= STOCK_MAX) {
    hm_wr16(ram, counter, STOCK_MAX);
    r->a = 0;
    r->c = 1;                    /* from CMP #999 */
  } else {
    hm_wr16(ram, counter, value);
    r->a = 0;
    r->c = 0;
  }
}

void hm_AddWood(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)            { add_capped(ram, r, HM_STORED_WOOD); }
void hm_AddGrass(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)           { add_capped(ram, r, HM_STORED_GRASS); }
void hm_AddPlayerHappiness(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { add_capped(ram, r, HM_HAPPINESS); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AddMoney ($83:B1C9, JSL, RTL). Adds the signed 24-bit amount in $72-$74
 * to the money ($7F1F04, 24-bit; the game shows it with an extra 0, so
 * this is tens of G). Returns A = 1 and changes nothing if the result
 * would be negative; otherwise caps it at 999999 and returns A = 0.
 * The sum is left in $75-$77. C = 1 when capped, 0 when it fit, the
 * add's carry when negative.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_AddMoney(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint32_t money = hm_rd24(ram, HM_MONEY);
  uint32_t change = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, MONEY_CHANGE) | (uint32_t)*hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_CHANGE_BANK) << 16;
  uint32_t sum = money + change;                 /* 16-bit ADC, then 8-bit ADC */
  uint32_t total = sum & 0xFFFFFF;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MONEY_SUM, (uint16_t)total);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_SUM_HIGH) = (uint8_t)(total >> 16);
  if (total & 0x800000) {                        /* BMI on the top byte */
    r->c = sum > 0xFFFFFF;
    r->a = 1;
    return;
  }
  if (total >= HM_MONEY_MAX) {
    hm_wr24(ram, HM_MONEY, HM_MONEY_MAX);
    r->c = 1;
  } else {
    hm_wr24(ram, HM_MONEY, total);
    r->c = 0;
  }
  r->a = 0;
}
```
