`src/text.c`:

```c
/*
 * text.c — the dialogue box: opening it, the blinking "more text" arrow and
 * closing it.
 *
 * The box is drawn on BG3, the layer for text. While it is open:
 *   $0183  number of the text being shown (index of Text_Pointer_Table)
 *   $0185  VRAM address where the next letter goes ($5010 at the start)
 *   $0187-$0190  the printer's state (cleared when a box opens):
 *          $018A = position of the arrow (0-11, one of 12 places),
 *          $018B = arrow blink: bit 7 = which frame, bits 0-6 = counter
 *   $0191  height of the box in lines of 2 rows (1 or 2), chosen once
 *   $019B  bit 0: a box is open (the printer runs every frame)
 *   $01-$03  long pointer to the text being read
 *   $7F1F5A bit 14 (FLAG5A): "a box is open", other systems wait for it
 * Opening a box scrolls BG3 up (BG3_Map_Offset_Y, $0146) so the box shows
 * and stops the clock; closing it scrolls back and lets the clock run again
 * unless $0196 bit 5 says it was already stopped.
 *
 * Text_Pointer_Table ($83:9BF6) has 3 bytes per text: a long pointer.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"
#include "hm_regs.h"

#define TEXT_POINTERS     0x839BF6
#define ARROW_PLACES      0x83947D   /* 12 words: VRAM address of each arrow place */
#define ARROW_FRAME_0     0x9457     /* $83:9457: 2x2 tilemap entries, arrow up */
#define ARROW_FRAME_1     0x945F     /* $83:945F: the other frame */
#define BOX_OPEN_FLAG     0x4000
#define BLANK_LETTERS     0x9CBBA3   /* ROM: the box's letter tiles, blank */

/* VRAM (word addresses) */
#define VRAM_LETTERS      0x5000     /* the box's letter tiles (the first letter at + $10) */
#define VRAM_WAIT_MARK    0x5528     /* where the "waiting" mark blinks */

/* $0189 is HM_TEXT_TICK (hm_ram.h): the frames between letters (0-4) */
#define NAME_LAST         0x018D     /* the name's letters - 1 */
#define LETTER_WIDTH      0x0190     /* 0 narrow, 1 (ignored, see DrawLetter) */
/* $0973 is HM_TIME_RUNNING (hm_ram.h) */

/* Direct page */
#define TEXT_PTR          0x01       /* long $01-$03: the text being read */
#define TEXT_PTR_BANK     0x03
#define DMA_CHANNEL       0x27       /* AddProgrammedDMA's channel */
#define DMA_BBAD          0x29       /*   its destination register ($21xx) */
#define SOURCE            0x72       /* long $72-$74: the DMA's source; a letter's
                                      * graphics; a number's or a name's address */
#define SOURCE_BANK       0x74
/* $7E and $80 mean a different thing in each routine: */
#define EXTRA_SCROLL      0x7E       /* StartTextBox, CloseTextBox: the scroll for the
                                      * box's lines */
#define BLINK_LETTER      0x7E       /* BlinkTextBoxArrow, BlinkTextCursor: A in */
#define LETTER_COLUMN     0x7E       /* FindLetterGraphics: the code, then 32 (code & 7) */
#define LETTER_ROW        0x80       /* FindLetterGraphics: the group, then the row's offset */
#define CURSOR_STEP       0x80       /* AdvanceLetterCursor: 8 */
#define POWER             0x7E       /* PrintDigit: the power of ten (16b), then the digit */
#define POWER_HIGH        0x80       /*   the power's high byte */

static uint32_t db_addr(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t addr) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | addr; }
static uint8_t rd8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, a)); }
static uint16_t rd16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, db_addr(r, a)); }
static void wr8(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint8_t v) { hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, a), v); }
static void wr16(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t v) { hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, a), v); }

/* How far BG3 scrolls for a box of $0191 lines: $0100 plus 128 per extra
 * line ("LDA #0; XBA; LDA $0191; DEC A", then 7 ASL in 16 bits). */
static uint16_t extra_scroll(uint8_t *ram, const HmRegs *r)
{
  return (uint16_t)((uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES) - 1) << 7);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * StartTextBox ($83:935F, JSL, RTL). X = number of the text. Resets the
 * printer, points $01-$03 at the text, picks the box height once ($0191:
 * 2 lines if $090D < $81, else 1), scrolls BG3 up to show the box, stops
 * the clock (time_running = 0, low byte only) and sets FLAG5A.
 * Leftovers: A = the new $7F1F5A, X = 3 X + 2, C from the last SBC.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_StartTextBox(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t text = r->x;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_NUMBER, text);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_X, VRAM_LETTERS + 0x10);       /* LDA #$5000; CLC; ADC #$10 */
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT, 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE, rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE) | 0x01);
  static const uint16_t cleared[] = { HM_TEXT_TICK, HM_ARROW_BLINK, HM_PRINT_LEFT, HM_LAST_OPTION, HM_ANSWER, LETTER_WIDTH };
  for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof cleared / sizeof cleared[0]; i++)
    wr8(ram, r, cleared[i], 0);

  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)(text * 3);                  /* ASL; CLC; ADC $0183 */
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, TEXT_PTR, hm_bus_rd16(ram, (TEXT_POINTERS + x) & 0xFFFFFF));
  x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, TEXT_PTR_BANK) = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (TEXT_POINTERS + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  r->x = x;

  if (rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES) == 0)
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_LINES, rd16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_SCREEN_Y) < 0x0081 ? 2 : 1);

  uint16_t extra = extra_scroll(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, EXTRA_SCROLL, extra);
  uint16_t y = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_BG3_Y) - 0x0100);       /* SEC; SBC #$0100 */
  r->c = y >= extra;                                              /* SEC; SBC $7E */
  wr16(ram, r, HM_BG3_Y, (uint16_t)(y - extra));

  wr8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING, 0);                                /* STZ time_running (8-bit) */
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) | BOX_OPEN_FLAG);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ClearTextBox ($83:932D, JSL, RTL). Wipes the box: queues a DMA of $0C00
 * bytes of the empty BG3 tilemap ($9C:BBA3) to VRAM $5000 on channel 6 and
 * drops whatever was queued on channel 7 (half of an arrow, DrawTilemapBlock2x2).
 * Leftovers: those of RemoveProgrammedDMA; Y = $0C00.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_32D_ADD     0x9353
#define RET_32D_REMOVE  0x935D

void hm_ClearTextBox(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = 6;
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_BBAD) = BBAD_VRAM;               /* VRAM data port */
  r->x = VRAM_LETTERS;
  r->y = 0x0C00;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE, (uint16_t)BLANK_LETTERS);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOURCE_BANK) = (uint8_t)(BLANK_LETTERS >> 16);
  r->a = 0x0080;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_32D_ADD, 0x80);
  hm_AddProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 7);             /* SEP; LDA #7 */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, DMA_CHANNEL) = 7;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_32D_REMOVE, 0x80);
  hm_RemoveProgrammedDMA(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CloseTextBox ($83:93F9, JSL, RTL; CODE_8393F9 in HM-Decomp). The reverse
 * of StartTextBox: $019B = 0, BG3 scrolls back down, the box is wiped
 * (ClearTextBox), the clock runs again (time_running |= 1) unless $0196
 * bit 5 is set, and FLAG5A is cleared.
 * Leftovers: A = the new $7F1F5A; X, Y, C those of ClearTextBox.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_3F9_WIPE    0x9424

void hm_CloseTextBox(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE, 0);
  uint16_t extra = extra_scroll(ram, r);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, EXTRA_SCROLL, extra);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_BG3_Y, (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_BG3_Y) + 0x0100 + extra));
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_3F9_WIPE, 0x83);
  hm_ClearTextBox(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  if (rd16(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS) & 0x0020)
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING, rd8(ram, r, HM_TIME_RUNNING) | 0x01);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) & ~BOX_OPEN_FLAG);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DrawTextBoxArrow ($83:94D7, JSL, RTL; CODE_8394D7 in HM-Decomp). A = the
 * frame (1 = $83:945F, anything else = $83:9457). Draws the 2x2 arrow at
 * place $018A (at most 11) with DrawTilemapBlock2x2.
 * Leftovers: those of DrawTilemapBlock2x2. The PHA / PLA of A stays on the stack.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_4D7_DRAW    0x951A

void hm_DrawTextBoxArrow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t frame = r->a;
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(frame >> 8));            /* PHA */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)frame);
  uint8_t place = rd8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_PLACE);
  if (place >= 0x0B) place = 0x0B;
  r->x = hm_bus_rd16(ram, ARROW_PLACES + 2u * place);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                 /* PLA */
  uint16_t tiles = frame == 1 ? ARROW_FRAME_1 : ARROW_FRAME_0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE, tiles);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((tiles & 0xFF00) | 0x83);         /* SEP; LDA #$83 */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOURCE_BANK) = 0x83;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_4D7_DRAW, 0x83);
  hm_DrawTilemapBlock2x2(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * BlinkTextBoxArrow ($83:9495, JSR, RTS; CODE_839495 in HM-Decomp). Called
 * every frame while the box waits for a button. $7E = A in. Every 20
 * frames the arrow changes frame ($018B bit 7 flips, the counter restarts);
 * the current frame is drawn and the counter goes up.
 * Leftovers: A = (high byte of DrawTextBoxArrow's A : the new $018B);
 * X, Y, C those of DrawTextBoxArrow.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_495_FRAME0  0x94C1
#define RET_495_FRAME1  0x94CC

void hm_BlinkTextBoxArrow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, BLINK_LETTER, r->a);
  if ((rd16(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK) & 0x007F) == 0x14)
    wr8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK, (uint8_t)((rd8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK) & 0x80) ^ 0x80));
  bool second = rd8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK) & 0x80;
  r->a = second ? 1 : 0;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, second ? RET_495_FRAME1 : RET_495_FRAME0, 0x83);
  hm_DrawTextBoxArrow(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  uint8_t counter = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK) + 1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK, counter);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | counter);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * TextBoxArrow ($83:9447, JSL, RTL; CODE_839447 in HM-Decomp): the long
 * entry to BlinkTextBoxArrow (JSR; RTL).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_447_BLINK   0x944B

void hm_TextBoxArrow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(RET_447_BLINK >> 8));    /* JSR */
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)RET_447_BLINK);
  hm_BlinkTextBoxArrow(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                 /* RTS */
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * Letters. The font is in the ROM in groups of 64 letters (table $83:98AE,
 * a long pointer per group: $94:9843 + $1000 k for groups 0-5, $95:8000 +
 * $1000 (k - 6) for 6-9). In a group, 8 letters per row of $200 bytes,
 * 32 bytes apart; a letter is two 8x8 tiles one above the other, the
 * bottom one $100 bytes after the top one. Codes $BC-$C5 are the digits
 * 0-9, $B1 the "waiting" mark.
 *
 * A letter is not written on a fixed tilemap: the box's tilemap points at
 * tiles in order, and the printer copies each letter's graphics into the
 * next tile ($0185, VRAM; +8 words per letter; a line is 16 tiles, its
 * bottom halves $80 words further, so at $xx80 the cursor jumps $80).
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#define FONT_GROUPS       0x8398AE
#define POWERS_OF_TEN     0x8398D6   /* 8 x 3 bytes: 1, 10, ... 10,000,000 */
#define LETTER_WAITING    0x00B1
#define LETTER_ZERO       0x00BC

static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  push16(ram, r, ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
}
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * FindLetterGraphics ($83:9862, JSR, RTS; CODE_839862 in HM-Decomp).
 * A = letter code; $72-$74 = where its graphics are.
 * Leftovers: A = $72, X = 3 (code / 64) + 2, $7E = 32 (code & 7),
 * $80 = $200 ((code & $3F) / 8), C from the last ADC.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_FindLetterGraphics(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t code = r->a, group = (uint16_t)(code >> 6);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LETTER_COLUMN, code);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LETTER_ROW, group);
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)(group * 3);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE, hm_bus_rd16(ram, FONT_GROUPS + x));
  x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOURCE_BANK) = hm_bus_rd8(ram, FONT_GROUPS + x);
  uint16_t row = (uint16_t)(((code & 0x3F) >> 3) << 9);
  uint16_t column = (uint16_t)((code & 7) << 5);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LETTER_ROW, row);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, LETTER_COLUMN, column);
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)hm_dp_r16(ram, r, SOURCE) + column;     /* CLC; ADC $7E */
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + row + (s >> 16);                             /* ADC $80 */
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)s;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE, r->a);
  r->x = x;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * DrawLetter ($83:9823, JSL, RTL; CODE_839823 in HM-Decomp). A = letter
 * code: copies it to the tile at the cursor $0185 (CopyLetterToVram). Callers
 * pass X = 1 or 0 (a wide letter?), but the routine starts with LDX #0
 * and the width is always 0: one 8x8 tile per half.
 * Leftovers: those of CopyLetterToVram. The PHX of 0 stays on the stack.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_823_FIND    0x982B
#define RET_823_COPY    0x9836

void hm_DrawLetter(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->x = 0;
  push16(ram, r, 0);                                  /* LDX #0; PHX */
  jsr(ram, r, RET_823_FIND, hm_FindLetterGraphics);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                 /* PLX */
  r->a = 0;                                           /* TXA: the width */
  r->x = rd16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_X);
  jsl(ram, r, RET_823_COPY, hm_CopyLetterToVram);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * AdvanceLetterCursor ($83:9838, JSR, RTS; CODE_839838 in HM-Decomp). The
 * cursor $0185 goes one tile (8 words) forward; at the end of a line
 * ($xx80) it skips the $80 words of the bottom halves. Like DrawLetter,
 * it ignores the X its callers pass (LDX #0): $80 = 8 always.
 * Leftovers: X = 0; A = the low byte of $0185 and C from CMP #$80, or
 * A = the new $0185 and C from that ADC.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_AdvanceLetterCursor(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->x = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, CURSOR_STEP, 8);                  /* TXA; ASL x3; ADC #8 */
  uint16_t at = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_X) + 8);
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_X, at);
  if ((at & 0xFF) != 0x80) {
    r->a = at & 0xFF;
    r->c = r->a >= 0x80;
    return;
  }
  uint32_t next = (uint32_t)at + 0x80;
  r->c = next > 0xFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)next;
  wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_X, r->a);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * BlinkTextCursor ($83:975F, JSR, RTS; CODE_83975F in HM-Decomp). Like
 * BlinkTextBoxArrow, but inside the text: every 20 frames it alternates
 * between letter A (in) and the mark $B1 at the cursor. Used while the
 * text waits for a button (codes $00A2 and $FFFE).
 * Leftovers: A = (high byte of DrawLetter's A : the new $018B); X, Y, C
 * those of DrawLetter.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_75F_LETTER  0x978D
#define RET_75F_MARK    0x979B

void hm_BlinkTextCursor(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, BLINK_LETTER, r->a);
  if ((rd16(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK) & 0x007F) == 0x14)
    wr8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK, (uint8_t)((rd8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK) & 0x80) ^ 0x80));
  r->x = 1;
  if (rd8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK) & 0x80) {
    r->a = LETTER_WAITING;
    jsl(ram, r, RET_75F_MARK, hm_DrawLetter);
  } else {
    r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, BLINK_LETTER);
    jsl(ram, r, RET_75F_LETTER, hm_DrawLetter);
  }
  uint8_t counter = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK) + 1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_ARROW_BLINK, counter);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | counter);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PrintDigit ($83:97A6, JSL, RTL; CODE_8397A6 in HM-Decomp). Prints one
 * digit of the 24-bit number at $0192-$0194: the one worth 10^$018C. It
 * counts how many times that power fits (subtracting until the number
 * goes negative, then adding the last one back), leaves the rest in
 * $0192-$0194 and draws the digit. $019B bit 7 = "a digit was already
 * printed": while it is clear, zeros are skipped (no leading zeros).
 * $7E-$7F / $80 = the power, then $7E = the digit.
 * Leftovers if a zero is skipped: A = (high byte of $0192 : 0), X = 0,
 * C = 1 (CPX #0). Otherwise those of DrawLetter.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_7A6_DIGIT   0x9821

void hm_PrintDigit(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t n = rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT);
  uint16_t x = (uint8_t)(n * 3);                       /* 8-bit ASL; CLC; ADC */
  uint16_t power_lo = hm_bus_rd16(ram, POWERS_OF_TEN + x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, POWER, power_lo);
  uint8_t power_hi = hm_bus_rd8(ram, POWERS_OF_TEN + (uint16_t)(x + 2));
  *hm_dp(ram, r, POWER_HIGH) = power_hi;
  uint32_t power = (uint32_t)power_hi << 16 | power_lo;

  uint32_t number = rd16(ram, r, HM_PRINT_NUMBER) | (uint32_t)rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_NUMBER + 2) << 16;
  uint16_t digit = 0;
  for (;;) {
    number = (number - power) & 0xFFFFFF;
    if (number & 0x800000) break;                       /* BMI */
    digit++;
  }
  number = (number + power) & 0xFFFFFF;                 /* add the last one back */
  wr16(ram, r, HM_PRINT_NUMBER, (uint16_t)number);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_NUMBER + 2, (uint8_t)(number >> 16));

  uint8_t flags = rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE);
  if (!(flags & 0x80)) {
    if (digit == 0) {                                   /* a leading zero */
      r->a = (uint16_t)(number & 0xFF00);
      r->x = 0;
      r->c = 1;
      return;
    }
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE, flags | 0x80);
  }
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, POWER, digit);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(LETTER_ZERO + digit);
  r->x = 0;
  jsl(ram, r, RET_7A6_DIGIT, hm_DrawLetter);
}

/* ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
 * PrintTextFrame ($83:951C, JSL, RTL; ADDDDFFFF in HM-Decomp): the text
 * printer, once per frame. The text is a list of 16-bit codes at [$01]
 * ($0187 = which one). A normal code is a letter: one every 5 frames
 * ($0189 counts 0-4), with a sound effect (3, 6, $0A) each. Special codes:
 *   $00A2  wait for a button: the cursor goes to VRAM $5528 and blinks
 *          (bit 3 of $019B)
 *   $00B1  a space: the cursor moves and the next code is read at once
 *   $FFFC n k  a number of n digits, variable k (Text_Number_Pointer_Table,
 *          $83:98EE: 3-byte address and size), one digit per frame
 *   $FFFD n k  a name of n letters (Text_Name_Pointer_Table, $83:9AAE),
 *          one letter every 5 frames, no sound
 *   $FFFE n  a choice of n options: the cursor goes to the place of option
 *          $018F (table $83:98CC) and blinks; $018E = n - 1 (bit 4)
 *   $FFFF  the end (bit 2)
 * $019B: bit 0 printing, bit 1 "a letter was printed this frame", bit 5
 * "waiting at the end of the box": only the arrow blinks (TextBoxArrow),
 * bit 7 "a digit was printed" (no more leading zeros).
 * Codes $BC-$C5 (digits) and $270 are "narrow" ($0190 = 0), others 1; the
 * width is ignored anyway (see DrawLetter).
 * Quirk: after a number or a name, $0187 += 2 is done in 8 bits (only the
 * low byte), so a text longer than 256 codes would jump back.
 * ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ */
#define TEXT_NUMBERS      0x8398EE
#define TEXT_NAMES        0x839AAE
#define CHOICE_PLACES     0x8398CC
#define CODE_WAIT         0x00A2
#define CODE_SPACE        0x00B1
#define CODE_NUMBER       0xFFFC
#define CODE_NAME         0xFFFD
#define CODE_CHOICE       0xFFFE
#define CODE_END          0xFFFF

static uint16_t text_word(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y) { return hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, TEXT_PTR, y)); }
static uint8_t text_byte(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t y) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, TEXT_PTR, y)); }
static void set_a8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v) { r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v); }
static void set_flags_019B(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t bits)
{
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE) | bits);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE, v);
  set_a8(r, v);
}

/* 8395C9: unless a number / name is half-way ($018C), the next code; the
 * cursor moves; $0189 counts the frame. */
static void next_letter(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT) == 0) {
    r->a = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT) + 1);
    wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT, r->a);
  }
  r->a = r->x = rd8(ram, r, LETTER_WIDTH);            /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $0190; TAX */
  jsr(ram, r, 0x95E6, hm_AdvanceLetterCursor);
  uint8_t frames = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_TICK) + 1);   /* 8395E7 */
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_TICK, frames);
  set_a8(r, frames);
}
/* LDA $0187; INC; INC; STA $0187 in 8 bits */
static void skip_two_codes8(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t v = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT) + 2);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT, v);
  set_a8(r, v);
}

static void print_number(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT) == 0) {              /* first digit: copy the value */
    uint16_t y = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT) * 2 + 2);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT, text_byte(ram, r, y)); /* digits */
    y = (uint16_t)(y + 2);
    uint16_t x = (uint16_t)((text_word(ram, r, y) - 1) << 2);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE, hm_bus_rd16(ram, (TEXT_NUMBERS + x) & 0xFFFFFF));
    x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
    *hm_dp(ram, r, SOURCE_BANK) = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (TEXT_NUMBERS + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_NUMBER, 0); wr8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_NUMBER + 1, 0); wr8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_NUMBER + 2, 0);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE, rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE) & 0x7F);
    x = (uint16_t)(x + 1);
    uint8_t size = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (TEXT_NUMBERS + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
    uint16_t i = 0;
    do {                                              /* PHA; LDA [$72],Y; STA $0192,X; ... DEC; BNE */
      hm_push8(ram, r, size);
      wr8(ram, r, (uint16_t)(HM_PRINT_NUMBER + i), hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SOURCE, i)));
      i++;
      hm_pull8(ram, r);
    } while (--size);
    r->x = r->y = i;
  }
  wr8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT, (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT) - 1));
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT));
  jsl(ram, r, 0x9686, hm_PrintDigit);
  wr8(ram, r, LETTER_WIDTH, 0);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_TICK, 0);
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT));
  if (rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT) == 0) skip_two_codes8(ram, r);
  next_letter(ram, r);
}

static void print_name(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT) == 0) {
    uint16_t y = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT) * 2 + 2);
    uint8_t n = text_byte(ram, r, y);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT, n);
    wr8(ram, r, NAME_LAST, (uint8_t)(n - 1));
  }
  uint16_t y = (uint16_t)(rd16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT) * 2 + 4);
  r->y = y;
  uint16_t x = (uint16_t)((text_word(ram, r, y) - 1) << 2);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, SOURCE, hm_bus_rd16(ram, (TEXT_NAMES + x) & 0xFFFFFF));
  x = (uint16_t)(x + 2);
  *hm_dp(ram, r, SOURCE_BANK) = hm_bus_rd8(ram, (TEXT_NAMES + x) & 0xFFFFFF);
  uint8_t left = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT) - 1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT, left);
  uint8_t which = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, NAME_LAST) - left);  /* SEC; SBC $018C */
  r->y = (uint16_t)(which << 1);
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, SOURCE, r->y));
  r->x = 1;
  jsl(ram, r, 0x96FC, hm_DrawLetter);
  wr8(ram, r, LETTER_WIDTH, 1);
  wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_TICK, 0);
  set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT));
  if (rd8(ram, r, HM_PRINT_LEFT) == 0) skip_two_codes8(ram, r);
  next_letter(ram, r);
}

void hm_PrintTextFrame(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t flags = rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE);
  set_a8(r, flags & 0x20);                            /* AND #$20 */
  if (flags & 0x20) {                                 /* JMP CODE_839447 */
    jsr(ram, r, RET_447_BLINK, hm_BlinkTextBoxArrow);
    return;
  }
  if (!(flags & 0x01)) { set_a8(r, 0); return; }      /* AND #$01 */

  for (;;) {                                          /* 839534 */
    set_a8(r, rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE) & 0xFD);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_BOX_STATE, (uint8_t)r->a);
    uint16_t at = rd16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT);
    r->y = (uint16_t)(at << 1);
    uint16_t code = text_word(ram, r, r->y);
    r->a = code;
    r->c = 1;                                         /* the CMP that matched */
    switch (code) {
    case CODE_WAIT:
      set_flags_019B(ram, r, 0x08);
      wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_X, VRAM_WAIT_MARK);
      r->a = CODE_WAIT;
      jsr(ram, r, 0x960A, hm_BlinkTextCursor);
      return;
    case CODE_SPACE:
      r->a = (uint16_t)(at + 1);
      wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_CODE_AT, r->a);
      r->x = 1;
      jsr(ram, r, 0x961D, hm_AdvanceLetterCursor);
      continue;                                       /* JMP 839534 */
    case CODE_NUMBER:
      print_number(ram, r);
      return;
    case CODE_CHOICE: {
      set_flags_019B(ram, r, 0x10);
      uint8_t n = text_byte(ram, r, (uint16_t)(r->y + 2));
      wr8(ram, r, HM_LAST_OPTION, (uint8_t)(n - 1));
      r->y = (uint16_t)(r->y + 2);
      uint16_t x = (uint8_t)(rd8(ram, r, HM_ANSWER) << 1); /* 8-bit ASL */
      r->x = x;
      wr16(ram, r, HM_TEXT_X, hm_bus_rd16(ram, CHOICE_PLACES + x));
      r->a = 0x0275;
      jsr(ram, r, 0x974E, hm_BlinkTextCursor);
      return;
    }
    case CODE_END:
      set_flags_019B(ram, r, 0x04);
      return;
    }
    r->c = code >= CODE_END;                          /* CMP #$FFFF, not equal */

    uint8_t frames = rd8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_TICK);       /* 83956F */
    set_a8(r, frames);
    r->c = frames >= 4;
    if (frames != 4) {                                /* not yet: count the frame */
      wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_TICK, (uint8_t)(frames + 1));
      set_a8(r, (uint8_t)(frames + 1));
      return;
    }
    wr8(ram, r, HM_TEXT_TICK, 0);
    if (code == CODE_NAME) { print_name(ram, r); return; }

    uint8_t narrow = (code >= 0x00BC && code < 0x00C6) || code == 0x0270;
    r->x = (uint16_t)((r->x & 0xFF00) | (narrow ? 0 : 1));   /* SEP #$10; LDX */
    wr8(ram, r, LETTER_WIDTH, (uint8_t)r->x);
    r->a = code;
    jsl(ram, r, 0x95AA, hm_DrawLetter);
    set_a8(r, 6);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT, 3);
    wr8(ram, r, HM_SOUND_BANK, 6);
    jsl(ram, r, 0x95BC, hm_PlaySoundEffect0A);
    set_flags_019B(ram, r, 0x02);
    next_letter(ram, r);
    return;
  }
}
```

`src/toolanim.c`:

```c
/*
 * toolanim.c — pressing Y: the tool's animation.
 *
 * StartToolAnimation ($82:90A8) runs when the player presses Y with a tool in
 * hand. Without stamina ($D2 bit 3) the player only shows the "tired"
 * animation. Otherwise it checks the tile in front (CheckToolSuccessForSound, which also
 * chooses the tool's sound) and calls the tool's animation routine through
 * Tool_Animation_Table ($82:A58B, one per item, the same order as the tools
 * in toolused.c). Each puts the player's animation number in $0901: a base
 * per tool, plus the direction ($DA, 0-3) for the ones that look different
 * when facing each way. What the tool does to the tile comes later, when
 * the animation reaches its moment (UseToolInHand, toolused.c).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

#ifndef SEED_TOSS
#define SEED_TOSS      0x74
#endif

static uint32_t db_addr(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  push16(ram, r, ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                    /* RTS */
}
static void animation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t n)
{
  r->a = n;
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, db_addr(r, HM_ANIM_REQUEST), n);
}
/* LDA #base; CLC; ADC $DA: one animation per direction */
static void facing(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t base)
{
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)base + hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  r->c = s > 0xFFFF;
  animation(ram, r, (uint16_t)s);
}

void hm_ToolAnimationNoAction(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { (void)ram; (void)r; }
void hm_ToolAnimationSickle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)        { facing(ram, r, 0x50); }
void hm_ToolAnimationHoe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)           { facing(ram, r, 0x54); }
void hm_ToolAnimationHammer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)        { facing(ram, r, 0x58); }
void hm_ToolAnimationAxe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)           { facing(ram, r, 0x5C); }
/* the seeds: the spin that sows 9 tiles; with the native build's "one seed
 * at a time" (g_hm_single_seed), a toss to the front instead (the
 * animation of the feed, $74 + facing) */
static void seeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  if (g_hm_single_seed) { facing(ram, r, SEED_TOSS); return; }
  animation(ram, r, 0x46);
}
void hm_ToolAnimationCornSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)     { seeds(ram, r); }
void hm_ToolAnimationTomatoSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   { seeds(ram, r); }
void hm_ToolAnimationPotatoSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   { seeds(ram, r); }
void hm_ToolAnimationTurnipSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   { seeds(ram, r); }
void hm_ToolAnimationCowMedicine(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   { facing(ram, r, 0xAC); }
void hm_ToolAnimationMiraclePotion(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { facing(ram, r, 0xAC); }
/* the bell also calls the cows: $7F1F5A bit $10 */
void hm_ToolAnimationBell(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  facing(ram, r, 0x60);
  r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_bus_rd16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A)) | 0x0010);
  hm_bus_wr16(ram, WRAM_LONG(HM_FLAGS_5A), r->a);
}
void hm_ToolAnimationGrassSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)    { seeds(ram, r); }
void hm_ToolAnimationPaint(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)         { animation(ram, r, 0x44); }
void hm_ToolAnimationMilker(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)        { facing(ram, r, 0x78); }
void hm_ToolAnimationBrush(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)         { facing(ram, r, 0x64); }
/* the watering can: in front of water it fills up (20 uses); empty, a
 * different animation (nothing comes out) */
void hm_ToolAnimationWateringCan(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  jsr(ram, r, 0x91AF, hm_PreCheckToolSuccess);
  uint8_t answer = (uint8_t)r->a;
  r->c = answer >= 2;                                      /* CMP #2 */
  if (answer == 2) {
    facing(ram, r, 0x70);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | 0x14);
    hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_CAN_WATER), 0x14);
    return;
  }
  uint8_t water = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_CAN_WATER));
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | water);
  facing(ram, r, water ? 0x68 : 0x6C);
}
void hm_ToolAnimationGoldSickle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)    { animation(ram, r, 0x48); }
void hm_ToolAnimationGoldHoe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)       { facing(ram, r, 0x7C); }
void hm_ToolAnimationGoldHammer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)    { facing(ram, r, 0x84); }
void hm_ToolAnimationGoldAxe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)       { facing(ram, r, 0x80); }
void hm_ToolAnimationSprinkler(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)     { animation(ram, r, 0x47); }
void hm_ToolAnimationBeans(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)         { facing(ram, r, 0xAC); }
void hm_ToolAnimationGem(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)           { facing(ram, r, 0xAC); }
void hm_ToolAnimationBlueFeather(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   { animation(ram, r, 0xA8); }
void hm_ToolAnimationChickenFeed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   { facing(ram, r, 0x74); }
void hm_ToolAnimationCowFeed(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)       { facing(ram, r, 0x74); }
void hm_ToolAnimationUnusedTool(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)           { animation(ram, r, 0x88); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * StartToolAnimation ($82:90A8, JSL, RTL).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_StartToolAnimation(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static void (*const animate[])(uint8_t *, HmRegs *) = {
    hm_ToolAnimationNoAction, hm_ToolAnimationSickle, hm_ToolAnimationHoe,
    hm_ToolAnimationHammer, hm_ToolAnimationAxe, hm_ToolAnimationCornSeeds,
    hm_ToolAnimationTomatoSeeds, hm_ToolAnimationPotatoSeeds, hm_ToolAnimationTurnipSeeds,
    hm_ToolAnimationCowMedicine, hm_ToolAnimationMiraclePotion, hm_ToolAnimationBell,
    hm_ToolAnimationGrassSeeds, hm_ToolAnimationPaint, hm_ToolAnimationMilker,
    hm_ToolAnimationBrush, hm_ToolAnimationWateringCan, hm_ToolAnimationGoldSickle,
    hm_ToolAnimationGoldHoe, hm_ToolAnimationGoldHammer, hm_ToolAnimationGoldAxe,
    hm_ToolAnimationSprinkler, hm_ToolAnimationBeans, hm_ToolAnimationGem,
    hm_ToolAnimationBlueFeather, hm_ToolAnimationChickenFeed, hm_ToolAnimationCowFeed,
    hm_ToolAnimationUnusedTool,
  };
  r->a = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_GAME_STATE) & 0x0008;
  if (r->a) {                                              /* no stamina */
    animation(ram, r, 0x4D);
    r->a = 0x000B;
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0x000B);           /* action: tired */
    return;
  }
  jsr(ram, r, 0x90BA, hm_CheckToolSuccessForSound);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_TOOL_FRAMES), 0);
  uint8_t item = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_addr(r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED));
  r->c = item >> 7;                                        /* ASL (8 bits) */
  r->a = r->x = (uint8_t)(item << 1);
  if (item < sizeof animate / sizeof animate[0])           /* the game has no more */
    jsr(ram, r, 0x90CA, animate[item]);
}
```

`src/tools.c`:

```c
/*
 * tools.c — does a tool work on the tile in front of the player?
 *
 * Every map has a tile property table, pointed at by the direct-page long
 * pointer $0D-$0F: 4 bytes per tile type (the byte in the map's tile array
 * $09B6). For tile type t:
 *   +1..+2  what the tile does (16 bits; the low byte's bits say which tools
 *           work: 01 sickle, 02 hoe, 04 hammer, 08 axe, 10 water, 20 seeds)
 *   +2 bit 7  "no default": see GetTileProperty
 *   +3      which sides (01..08, by the player's direction) and seasons
 *           (10..80) the first property applies to
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */

/* ROM tables */
#define DIRECTION_FLAG_TABLE  0x82ACFE  /* ROM: dw 01, 02, 04, 08 */
#define SEASON_FLAG_TABLE     0x82AD06  /* ROM: dw 10, 20, 40, 80 */
#define SQUARE_OFFSETS        0x8292FA  /* ROM: dw dx, dy per entry */

/* GetTileProperty's scratch: */
#define PROPERTY_WHICH        0x82      /* 16b: which property word (its A) */
#define PROPERTY_FLAG         0x84      /* 16b: the last direction / season flag tested */
/* CalculateTileInFront's scratch: */
#define FRONT_AHEAD           0x7E      /* 16b: 16 x the tiles ahead */
#define FRONT_EXTRA_X         0x80      /* 16b: its X (the extra pixels across) */
#define FRONT_EXTRA_Y         0x82      /* 16b: its Y (the extra pixels down) */
/* TileAtOffsetFromPlayer's scratch (the same bytes): */
#define OFFSET_X_PIXELS       0x7E      /* 16b: 16 x its X */
#define OFFSET_Y_PIXELS       0x80      /* 16b: 16 x its Y */

static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static uint16_t pull16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);
  return (uint16_t)(lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * GetTileContent ($82:B124, JSL, RTL). X, Y = a position in pixels; returns
 * the tile type there: A = (index high byte : type), X = the tile index.
 * Leftovers as GetTileIndex ($7E, $80, C).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_CONTENT_INDEX 0xB128   /* JSR GetTileIndex at $82:B126 */

void hm_GetTileContent(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(RET_CONTENT_INDEX >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)RET_CONTENT_INDEX);
  hm_GetTileIndex(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);
  uint32_t at = (((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + HM_MAP_TILES + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF;
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | hm_bus_rd8(ram, at));
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * GetTileProperty ($82:AC61, JSL, RTL). X, Y = position, A = which
 * property word (always 1: bytes +1..+2). Returns A = the tile's property,
 * X = the tile type:
 *  - if the tile's side/season byte (+3) matches the player's direction and
 *    the season: the property;
 *  - otherwise, unless +2 has bit 7 set, the same property but X = 0 (the
 *    callers then refuse);
 *  - otherwise A = X = 0. Also A = X = 0 while $7F1F5C bit 3 is set.
 * Leftovers: $82 = A in, $84 = the last flag tested, Y = the table offset.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
#define RET_PROPERTY_CONTENT 0xAC76   /* JSL GetTileContent at $82:AC73 */

void hm_GetTileProperty(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t which = r->a;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PROPERTY_WHICH, which);
  if (hm_rd16(ram, HM_FLAGS_5C) & 0x0008) {
    r->a = 0; r->x = 0;
    return;
  }
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_PROPERTY_CONTENT, 0x82);
  hm_GetTileContent(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  uint16_t type = (uint8_t)r->a;
  r->x = type;
  push16(ram, r, type);                          /* PHX; PHA */
  push16(ram, r, type);
  r->y = (uint16_t)(type * 4 + 3);               /* the side/season byte */
  uint8_t sides = hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_TILE_PROPS, r->y));

  uint16_t dir = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION);
  r->c = dir >> 15;                              /* ASL */
  uint16_t flag = hm_bus_rd16(ram, DIRECTION_FLAG_TABLE + (uint16_t)(dir << 1));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PROPERTY_FLAG, flag);
  bool applies = sides & flag;
  if (applies) {
    r->c = 0;
    flag = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SEASON_FLAG_TABLE + 2u * ram[HM_SEASON]);
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, PROPERTY_FLAG, flag);
    applies = sides & flag;
  }
  if (!applies) {
    r->y = (uint16_t)(r->y - 1);
    if (hm_bus_rd8(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_TILE_PROPS, r->y)) & 0x80) {
      pull16(ram, r); pull16(ram, r);            /* PLA; PLX */
      r->a = 0; r->x = 0;
      return;
    }
  }
  pull16(ram, r);
  r->x = pull16(ram, r);
  uint32_t sum = 4u * type + which;              /* ASL; ASL; ADC $82 */
  r->c = sum > 0xFFFF;
  r->y = (uint16_t)sum;
  r->a = hm_bus_rd16(ram, hm_dp_long(ram, r, HM_TILE_PROPS, r->y));
  if (!applies) r->x = 0;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CheckToolSuccess ($82:AA71, JSL, RTL). X, Y = the tile in front. Returns
 * A = 1 if the tool in hand works there, 0 if not, 2 if the watering can
 * gets refilled (water tiles F0/F9-FD on the farm, maps 0-3, and on maps
 * $3D and up; F0/F4 on the mountain maps $10-$13; no watering at all on
 * maps 04-0F and 14-3C).
 * Paint only works on the farm (maps 0-3), on tile C3 or E2-E4.
 * Quirk: any other item (or none) answers 1, "works".
 * Tiles A0 and up, and 0, never take a tool. C = 1 except where the last
 * comparison leaves it clear (see the code).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static bool property(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = 1;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x82);
  hm_GetTileProperty(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  return true;
}

/* CPX #$A0; BCS fail; CPX #0; BEQ fail; AND #bit; BEQ fail */
static void tool_works_if(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, uint8_t bit)
{
  property(ram, r, ret);
  bool ok = r->x < 0xA0 && r->x != 0 && ((uint8_t)r->a & bit);
  r->c = 1;
  r->a = ok;
}

void hm_CheckToolSuccess(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t tool = hm_bus_rd8(ram, ((uint32_t)r->db << 16) + HM_TOOL_SELECTED);
  switch (tool) {
  case 0x01: case 0x11: tool_works_if(ram, r, 0xAAED, 0x01); return;   /* sickle */
  case 0x02: case 0x12: tool_works_if(ram, r, 0xAB12, 0x02); return;   /* hoe */
  case 0x03: case 0x13: tool_works_if(ram, r, 0xAB37, 0x04); return;   /* hammer */
  case 0x04: case 0x14: tool_works_if(ram, r, 0xAB5C, 0x08); return;   /* axe */
  case 0x15:            tool_works_if(ram, r, 0xABF3, 0x10); return;   /* sprinkler */
  case 0x0C: case 0x05: case 0x06: case 0x07: case 0x08:
                        tool_works_if(ram, r, 0xAC18, 0x20); return;   /* seeds */
  case 0x10: {                                                          /* watering can */
    uint8_t map = ram[HM_MAP_ID];
    if (map >= 0x04 && map < 0x10) { r->a = 0; r->c = 0; return; }
    if (map >= 0x14 && map < 0x3D) { r->a = 0; r->c = 1; return; }
    if (map >= 0x10 && map < 0x14) {                                    /* mountain */
      property(ram, r, 0xAB95);
      if (r->x == 0xF0 || r->x == 0xF4) { r->a = 2; r->c = 1; return; }
      r->a = 0;
      r->c = r->x >= 0xF4;
      return;
    }
    property(ram, r, 0xABAA);
    uint16_t t = r->x;
    if (t == 0xF0 || (t >= 0xF9 && t <= 0xFD)) { r->a = 2; r->c = 1; return; }
    r->c = 1;
    r->a = t < 0xA0 && t != 0 && ((uint8_t)r->a & 0x10);
    return;
  }
  case 0x0D: {                                                          /* paint */
    if (ram[HM_MAP_ID] >= 4) { r->a = 0; r->c = 1; return; }
    property(ram, r, 0xAC45);
    uint16_t t = r->x;
    if (t == 0xC3) { r->a = 1; r->c = 1; return; }
    r->c = t >= 0xE5;                            /* from CPX #$E2 / #$E5 */
    r->a = t >= 0xE2 && t < 0xE5;
    return;
  }
  default:
    r->a = 1;                                    /* quirk: "works" */
    r->c = tool >= 0x0D;
    return;
  }
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * The tile a tool acts on.
 *
 * CalculateTileInFront ($81:D14E, JSL, RTL). A = how many tiles ahead,
 * X / Y = extra pixels sideways / ahead. $0985/$0987 = the player's
 * position ($D6/$D8) moved by 16 A + the extra in the direction the player
 * faces ($DA: 0 down = +Y, 1 up = -Y, 2 = +X, anything else = -X).
 * Leftovers: $7E = 16 A, $80 = X, $82 = Y; A = the coordinate written
 * last, C from its add / subtract (carry chained through both terms).
 *
 * TileAtOffsetFromPlayer ($81:D1A4, JSL, RTL; CODE_81D1A4 in HM-Decomp).
 * X, Y = an offset in tiles; $0985/$0987 = player position + 16 X / 16 Y,
 * whatever the direction. Leftovers: $7E = 16 X, $80 = 16 Y, A = the new Y,
 * C from its add.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
/* CLC; ADC b; ADC c — or SEC; SBC b; SBC c — with the carry chained. */
static uint16_t add2(uint16_t a, uint16_t b, uint16_t c, uint8_t *carry)
{
  uint32_t s = (uint32_t)a + b;
  s = (s & 0xFFFF) + c + (s > 0xFFFF);
  *carry = s > 0xFFFF;
  return (uint16_t)s;
}
static uint16_t sub2(uint16_t a, uint16_t b, uint16_t c, uint8_t *carry)
{
  uint32_t d = (uint32_t)a - b;                   /* borrow = bit 16 */
  uint8_t borrow = (d >> 16) & 1;
  d = (d & 0xFFFF) - c - borrow;
  *carry = !((d >> 16) & 1);
  return (uint16_t)d;
}

void hm_CalculateTileInFront(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t ahead = (uint16_t)(r->a << 4);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, FRONT_AHEAD, ahead);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, FRONT_EXTRA_X, r->x);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, FRONT_EXTRA_Y, r->y);
  uint16_t px = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X), py = hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, px);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, py);
  switch (hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_DIRECTION)) {
  case 0:  r->a = add2(py, ahead, r->y, &r->c); hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, r->a); break;
  case 1:  r->a = sub2(py, ahead, r->y, &r->c); hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, r->a); break;
  case 2:  r->a = add2(px, ahead, r->x, &r->c); hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, r->a); break;
  default: r->a = sub2(px, ahead, r->x, &r->c); hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, r->a); break;
  }
}

void hm_TileAtOffsetFromPlayer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t dx = (uint16_t)(r->x << 4), dy = (uint16_t)(r->y << 4);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OFFSET_X_PIXELS, dx);
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, OFFSET_Y_PIXELS, dy);
  uint32_t x = (uint32_t)hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X) + dx;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, (uint16_t)x);
  uint32_t y = (uint32_t)hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y) + dy;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, (uint16_t)y);
  r->a = (uint16_t)y;
  r->c = y > 0xFFFF;
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * PreCheckToolSuccess / Line / Square ($82:92A0 / $82:92BC / $82:92D6;
 * JSR, RTS): pick the tile, then CheckToolSuccess on it (its A is the
 * answer). Plain: the tile right in front. Line: A + 1 tiles ahead (the
 * gold tools reach further). Square: entry A (0..8) of the offset table
 * $82:92FA, around the player.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void check_tile_in_front(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->x = hm_rd16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X);
  r->y = hm_rd16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x82);
  hm_CheckToolSuccess(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

static void tile_ahead_then_check(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t tiles,
                                  uint16_t ret_front, uint16_t ret_check)
{
  r->a = tiles; r->x = 0; r->y = 0;
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret_front, 0x81);
  hm_CalculateTileInFront(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  check_tile_in_front(ram, r, ret_check);
}

void hm_PreCheckToolSuccess(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  tile_ahead_then_check(ram, r, 1, 0x92AE, 0x92BA);
}

void hm_PreCheckToolSuccessLine(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  tile_ahead_then_check(ram, r, (uint16_t)(r->a + 1), 0x92C8, 0x92D4);
}

void hm_PreCheckToolSuccessSquare(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t at = (uint16_t)(r->a << 2);
  uint16_t dx = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SQUARE_OFFSETS + at);
  push16(ram, r, dx);                            /* PHA ... PLA */
  r->y = hm_bus_rd16(ram, SQUARE_OFFSETS + (uint16_t)(at + 2));
  r->x = pull16(ram, r);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x92EC, 0x81);
  hm_TileAtOffsetFromPlayer(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
  check_tile_in_front(ram, r, 0x92F8);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * CheckToolSuccessForSound ($82:927D, JSR, RTS): PreCheckToolSuccess that also keeps the
 * answer (0 / 1 / 2) in $0922, which picks the sound of the tool.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_CheckToolSuccessForSound(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  tile_ahead_then_check(ram, r, 1, 0x928B, 0x9297);
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, ((uint32_t)r->db << 16) | HM_TOOL_SOUND_CHOICE, (uint8_t)r->a);
}

```

`src/toolsound.c`:

```c
/*
 * toolsound.c — the noise each tool makes.
 *
 * Tool_Noise_Table ($82:9054): 3 bytes per item in hand ($0921): the
 * sound bank ($0115) and two sound effects ($0114), the first when the
 * tool lands on something ($0922 = 0), the second when it does not
 * ($0922 = 1). An effect of 0 is no sound.
 *
 * ToolUsedSound1 ($82:8FB1, JSL, RTL): plays the tool's noise, unless
 * $0922 is 2 (silent). It sets the bank, picks the effect by $0922 and
 * plays it with PlaySoundEffect0A.
 * Leftovers: A, X = where it read the effect, C = 0; with $0922 = 2,
 * A = 2 and C = 1. When the game calls it with an 8-bit X the index wraps
 * at 256 (TAX / INX keep only the low byte).
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

#define TOOL_NOISE_TABLE  0x829054   /* ROM: 3 bytes per item: bank, effect on a hit, on a miss */
#define SONG_INSTRUMENTS  0x80B8CD   /* ROM: per song, its instrument (- 1) */

/* Direct page scratch */
#define NOISE_CHOICE      0x80       /* 16b: ToolUsedSound1's copy of HM_TOOL_SOUND_CHOICE */
#define NOISE_TOOL        0x7E       /* 16b: the item (to make 3 x item) */

#define RET_SOUND1_PLAY  0x8FF1

static uint32_t db_(const HmRegs *r, uint16_t a) { return (uint32_t)r->db << 16 | a; }
static bool x8(const HmRegs *r) { return (r->p & 0x10) != 0; }
static uint16_t idx(const HmRegs *r, unsigned v) { return (uint16_t)(x8(r) ? v & 0xFF : v); }
static uint8_t noise(uint8_t *ram, uint16_t x) { return hm_bus_rd8(ram, (TOOL_NOISE_TABLE + x) & 0xFFFFFF); }

void hm_ToolUsedSound1(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint16_t sound = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_(r, HM_TOOL_SOUND_CHOICE));
  r->a = sound;
  r->c = sound >= 2;                                       /* CMP #2 */
  if (sound == 2) return;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, NOISE_CHOICE, sound);
  uint16_t tool = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_(r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED));
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, NOISE_TOOL, tool);
  r->c = 0;                                                /* ASL, CLC; ADC */
  r->x = idx(r, (uint16_t)(tool * 3));                     /* TAX */
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_SOUND_BANK), noise(ram, r->x)); /* the bank */
  r->x = idx(r, r->x + 1u);                                /* INX */
  uint16_t sum = (uint16_t)(r->x + sound);                 /* TXA; CLC; ADC $80 */
  r->x = idx(r, sum);                                      /* TAX */
  uint8_t effect = noise(ram, r->x);
  r->a = (uint16_t)((sum & 0xFF00) | effect);
  if (!effect) return;
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT), effect);
  hm_jsl(ram, r, RET_SOUND1_PLAY, 0x83);
  hm_PlaySoundEffect0A(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ToolUsedSound2 ($82:8FF3, JSL, RTL): when the item in hand ($0921) is
 * not the last one noted ($0119), its noises' instruments are loaded: the
 * bank ($0115) and, for each of the two effects that is not 0, the effect
 * ($0114) with PrepareSoundEffect (the first also with the instrument of the song
 * playing, $0103 = table $80:B8CD + 1). Then $0119 = the item.
 * The game calls it with 16-bit indexes (PHX / PLX around the first
 * effect would not match otherwise). The ADC that makes 3 x item clears V,
 * which PrepareSoundEffect keeps.
 * Leftovers: A = the item (8-bit), X where it last read the table, C = 0
 * from the ADC or that of the compare / PrepareSoundEffect.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ToolUsedSound2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  uint8_t entry = r->p;
  uint8_t tool = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_(r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED));
  r->a = tool;                                             /* LDA #0; XBA; LDA $0921 */
  uint8_t noted = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_(r, HM_LOADED_TOOL_SOUND));
  r->c = tool >= noted;
  if (tool != noted) {
    hm_dp_w16(ram, r, NOISE_TOOL, tool);                   /* REP #$20; STA $7E */
    r->x = (uint16_t)(tool * 3);                           /* ASL; CLC; ADC $7E; TAX */
    r->c = 0;
    r->a = r->x;
    uint8_t bank = noise(ram, r->x);
    r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | bank);
    if (bank) {
      hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_SOUND_BANK), bank);
      r->x++;
      hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(r->x >> 8));              /* PHX */
      hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)r->x);
      uint8_t first = noise(ram, r->x);
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | first);
      if (first) {
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT), first);
        r->a = hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_(r, HM_SONG_LOADED));
        r->x = r->a;
        uint8_t ins = (uint8_t)(hm_bus_rd8(ram, (SONG_INSTRUMENTS + r->x) & 0xFFFFFF) + 1);
        r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | ins);
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_INSTRUMENT_COUNT), ins);
        r->p = (uint8_t)(entry & ~0x40);
        hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x9037, 0x83);
        hm_PrepareSoundEffect(ram, r);
        hm_rtl(ram, r);
      }
      uint8_t lo = hm_pull8(ram, r);                       /* SEP #$20; REP #$10; PLX; INX */
      r->x = (uint16_t)((lo | hm_pull8(ram, r) << 8) + 1);
      uint8_t second = noise(ram, r->x);
      r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | second);
      if (second) {
        hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_SOUND_EFFECT), second);
        r->p = (uint8_t)(entry & ~0x40);
        hm_jsl(ram, r, 0x904A, 0x83);
        hm_PrepareSoundEffect(ram, r);
        hm_rtl(ram, r);
      }
      r->p = entry;
    }
  }
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | hm_bus_rd8(ram, db_(r, HM_TOOL_SELECTED)));
  hm_bus_wr8(ram, db_(r, HM_LOADED_TOOL_SOUND), (uint8_t)r->a);
}

```

`src/toolused.c`:

```c
/*
 * toolused.c — what each tool does when it lands (the ToolUsed* routines,
 * bank $82; table Tool_Used_Table at $82:A5C3, indexed by the item in hand
 * $0921 and called by UseToolInHand). All are JSR / RTS and start with an
 * 8-bit A.
 *
 * Most follow the same plan:
 *   1. PreCheckToolSuccess (or its Square / Line versions for seeds and the
 *      gold tools): does the tool work on the tile in front ($0985/$0987)?
 *      It leaves A = the answer and X = the tile's type.
 *   2. ChangeMapTile: put the new tile (tilled soil, a stump...).
 *   3. SpawnMapObject: an effect sprite on the tile ($0974-$0982 say which).
 *   4. Sometimes a find (1 chance in n, at most once a day or once ever,
 *      with flags in $7F1F5A-$7F1F6A) that starts an event (StartScriptAtTileInFront).
 *   5. The player goes back to idle ($D4 = 0) and loses stamina:
 *      ChangeStamina with A = $FE (2), $FF (1), $FC (4) or $F8 (8).
 *
 * The gold tools act on several tiles, one per call ($096B counts them):
 * the gold sickle and the seeds on the 9 tiles around the player, the gold
 * hoe on up to 6 tiles in a line (it stops at the first that refuses).
 * The stamina is paid once, after the last tile.
 *
 * $7F1F60 bit 3 also freezes the stamina (see stamina.c): while it is set
 * nothing is ever found either (except by the gold axe, which forgets to
 * check it).
 *
 * About the C flag: when the stamina is frozen ChangeStamina returns
 * without touching C, so what the routine leaves in C is whatever the last
 * comparison on the way set. The rewrites keep it (helpers `is`, `below`,
 * `add_c`, `sub_c`) so the checker can compare it.
 *
 * Every JSR / JSL return address below was read from the ROM
 * (tools/calls.py), never computed by hand.
 */
#include "hm_decomp.h"
#include "hm_ram.h"   /* from the recompilation project */
#include "hm_vars.h"

/* The shared variables (HM_...) are named in hm_vars.h and hm_ram.h. */
/* Direct page */
#define MONEY_CHANGE       0x72     /* 24b $72-$74: AddMoney's input, the amount */
#define MONEY_CHANGE_BANK  0x74     /* 8b: its third byte */
/* WRAM */
#define NO_FINDS           0x0008   /* HM_FLAGS_60 */

enum { SPRING, SUMMER, FALL, WINTER };
#define FARM_MAPS 0x04              /* maps 0-3 are the farm (per season) */
#define MAP_BARN  0x27
#define MAP_COOP  0x28

/* effect sprites */
#define FX_GRASS_CUT  0x00C1
#define FX_CUT        0x00B7
#define FX_STONE      0x00C8
#define FX_BIG_STONE  0x00C9
#define FX_HIT        0x00CB
#define FX_STUMP      0x00B8
#define FX_FEED       0x00C4

/* ── small helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void push16(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t v)
{
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)(v >> 8));
  hm_push8(ram, r, (uint8_t)v);
}
static void jsr(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  push16(ram, r, ret);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_pull8(ram, r); hm_pull8(ram, r);                    /* RTS */
}
static void jsl(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret, uint8_t bank,
                void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  hm_jsl(ram, r, ret, bank);
  fn(ram, r);
  hm_rtl(ram, r);
}
/* CMP / CPX: C = v >= k */
static bool is(HmRegs *r, uint16_t v, uint16_t k) { r->c = v >= k; return v == k; }
static bool below(HmRegs *r, uint16_t v, uint16_t k) { r->c = v >= k; return v < k; }
static uint16_t add_c(HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b)
{
  r->c = (uint32_t)a + b > 0xFFFF;
  return r->a = (uint16_t)(a + b);
}
static uint16_t sub_c(HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t b)
{
  r->c = a >= b;
  return r->a = (uint16_t)(a - b);
}
/* SEP #$20; LDA byte: the low byte of A is replaced */
static uint8_t load8(HmRegs *r, uint8_t v)
{
  r->a = (uint16_t)((r->a & 0xFF00) | v);
  return v;
}
/* LDA flags; AND #bit (A keeps the result) */
static bool test(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t at, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, at) & bit;
  return r->a != 0;
}
/* LDA flags; ORA #bit; STA flags */
static void set_flag(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint32_t at, uint16_t bit)
{
  r->a = hm_rd16(ram, at) | bit;
  hm_wr16(ram, at, r->a);
}
static uint16_t tile_x(uint8_t *ram) { return hm_rd16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X); }
static uint16_t tile_y(uint8_t *ram) { return hm_rd16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y); }
static uint8_t map_id(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { return *hm_dp(ram, r, HM_MAP_ID); }

/* SEP #$20; LDA #faces; JSL RNGReturn0toA: true on the 1-in-faces roll */
static bool one_in(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t faces, uint16_t ret)
{
  load8(r, faces);
  jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x80, hm_RNGReturn0toA);
  return (uint8_t)r->a == 0;                              /* TXA sets Z */
}
/* JSR PreCheckToolSuccess...: true if the tool works (A != 0); X = tile */
static bool tool_works(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret,
                       void (*check)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  jsr(ram, r, ret, check);
  return r->a != 0;
}
/* the multi-tile tools first load the step: LDA #0; XBA; LDA $096B */
static bool tool_works_at_step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret,
                               void (*check)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *))
{
  r->a = ram[HM_SOW_STEP];
  return tool_works(ram, r, ret, check);
}
static void change_tile(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t change, uint16_t x, uint16_t y,
                        uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = change; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x81, hm_ChangeMapTile);
}
static void change_tile_in_front(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t change, uint16_t ret)
{
  change_tile(ram, r, change, tile_x(ram), tile_y(ram), ret);
}
/* an effect sprite at x, y: flags 3 (in use + bit 1), routine 0 */
static void effect(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t sprite,
                   uint16_t ret)
{
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_ITEM_X, x);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_ITEM_Y, y);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_ITEM_SPRITE, sprite);
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_ITEM_FLIP, 0);
  ram[HM_ITEM_FLAGS] = 3; ram[HM_ITEM_ROUTINE] = 0; ram[HM_ITEM_STATE] = 0;
  r->a = 0;
  jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x81, hm_SpawnMapObject);
}
static void effect_in_front(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t sprite, uint16_t ret)
{
  effect(ram, r, tile_x(ram), tile_y(ram), sprite, ret);
}
/* StartScriptAtTileInFront: start event A (X, Y its arguments) */
static void event(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t a, uint16_t x, uint16_t y, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = a; r->x = x; r->y = y;
  jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x84, hm_StartScriptAtTileInFront);
}
static void add(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, void (*fn)(uint8_t *, HmRegs *), uint16_t n,
                uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = n;
  jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83, fn);
}
static void add_money(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t tens_of_g, uint16_t ret)
{
  r->a = tens_of_g;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, MONEY_CHANGE, tens_of_g);
  r->a = 0;                                              /* SEP; LDA #0; STA $74 */
  *hm_dp(ram, r, MONEY_CHANGE_BANK) = 0;
  jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x83, hm_AddMoney);
}
static void idle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  r->a = 0;
  hm_dp_w16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_ACTION, 0);
}
static void lose_stamina(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t stamina, uint16_t ret)
{
  load8(r, stamina);                                     /* SEP #$20; LDA #$Fx */
  r->n = 1;                                              /* ChangeStamina reads N */
  jsl(ram, r, ret, 0x81, hm_ChangeStamina);
}
/* Back to idle, then lose stamina (stamina = $FE: 2, $FF: 1, ...). */
static void tool_finished(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t stamina, uint16_t ret)
{
  idle(ram, r);
  lose_stamina(ram, r, stamina, ret);
}
/* The multi-tile tools: next tile; after the last one, step back to 0 and
 * 8 stamina. Returns at once (RTS) otherwise. */
static void gold_done(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t ret)
{
  ram[HM_SOW_STEP] = 0;
  tool_finished(ram, r, 0xF8, ret);
}
static void gold_step(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint8_t tiles, uint16_t ret)
{
  if (is(r, load8(r, ++ram[HM_SOW_STEP]), tiles))
    gold_done(ram, r, ret);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ToolUsedNoAction ($82:931E) and ToolUsedMilker ($82:9CC0): only back to
 * idle (milking happens elsewhere). ToolUsedUnusedTool ($82:A570): nothing at
 * all (an RTS). Leftover A = 0.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
void hm_ToolUsedNoAction(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { idle(ram, r); }
void hm_ToolUsedMilker(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   { idle(ram, r); }
void hm_ToolUsedUnusedTool(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)      { (void)ram; (void)r; }

/* ToolUsedBell ($82:9B51), ToolUsedBrush ($82:9CC8): idle, 1 stamina. */
void hm_ToolUsedBell(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)  { tool_finished(ram, r, 0xFF, 0x9B5F); }
void hm_ToolUsedBrush(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { tool_finished(ram, r, 0xFF, 0x9CD6); }

/* ToolUsedBlueFeather ($82:A3FD): idle and $7F1F5E bit $0040 (the proposal
 * code reads it). Leftover A = the flags. */
void hm_ToolUsedBlueFeather(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  idle(ram, r);
  set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5E, 0x0040);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * ToolUsedCowMedicine ($82:9B11) / ToolUsedMiraclePotion ($82:9B31): used
 * up (the hand is emptied), 1 stamina, and a flag the cow code reads
 * ($7F1F5A bit $0080 medicine, $0100 potion). Leftover A = the flags.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
static void give_to_cow(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t flag, uint16_t ret)
{
  idle(ram, r);
  ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED] = 0;
  lose_stamina(ram, r, 0xFF, ret);
  set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5A, flag);
}
void hm_ToolUsedCowMedicine(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)   { give_to_cow(ram, r, 0x0080, 0x9B22); }
void hm_ToolUsedMiraclePotion(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r) { give_to_cow(ram, r, 0x0100, 0x9B42); }

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Cutting (sickle and gold sickle). On the farm: a weed (tile 03) becomes
 * ground (change $0E), grass (79) is cut into fodder (+1 grass in the
 * silo, change $52, one tuft less in $092E), anything else becomes change
 * $17; off the farm, change $DD ($DE on tile 35). Then, in summer only and
 * once a day, 1 in 16 a frog jumps out (event $12, +2 happiness; $7F1F5A
 * bit $2000). Neither works in winter.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct CutRets {
  uint16_t grass, grass_tile, grass_fx, tile, fx, roll, frog, happy;
} CutRets;

static void cut(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const CutRets *ret)
{
  uint16_t tile = r->x;
  uint16_t change;
  if (!below(r, load8(r, map_id(ram, r)), FARM_MAPS)) {
    change = is(r, tile, 0x35) ? 0x00DE : 0x00DD;
  } else if (is(r, tile, 0x03)) {
    change = 0x000E;                                     /* weed */
  } else if (is(r, tile, 0x79)) {                        /* grass: fodder */
    add(ram, r, hm_AddGrass, 1, ret->grass);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_GROWN_GRASS_N, r->a = (uint16_t)(hm_rd16(ram, HM_GROWN_GRASS_N) - 1));
    change_tile_in_front(ram, r, 0x0052, ret->grass_tile);
    effect_in_front(ram, r, FX_GRASS_CUT, ret->grass_fx);
    goto frog;
  } else {
    change = 0x0017;
  }
  change_tile_in_front(ram, r, change, ret->tile);
  effect_in_front(ram, r, FX_CUT, ret->fx);
frog:
  if (is(r, load8(r, ram[HM_SEASON]), SUMMER) && !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_60, NO_FINDS)
      && !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5A, 0x2000) && one_in(ram, r, 16, ret->roll)) {
    event(ram, r, 0x0012, 0, 0x0032, ret->frog);
    add(ram, r, hm_AddPlayerHappiness, 2, ret->happy);
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5A, 0x2000);
  }
}

/* ToolUsedSickle ($82:9328) */
void hm_ToolUsedSickle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const CutRets ret = { 0x937C, 0x9394, 0x93C5, 0x93D1, 0x9402, 0x9428, 0x9439, 0x9442 };
  if (tool_works(ram, r, 0x932C, hm_PreCheckToolSuccess)
      && !is(r, load8(r, ram[HM_SEASON]), WINTER))
    cut(ram, r, &ret);
  tool_finished(ram, r, 0xFE, 0x945E);
}

/* ToolUsedGoldSickle ($82:9D42): the 9 tiles around the player, 8 stamina
 * at the end. Quirk: in winter, on a tile it could cut, it returns without
 * advancing the step (A = 3 from the season). */
void hm_ToolUsedGoldSickle(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const CutRets ret = { 0x9D9A, 0x9DB2, 0x9DE3, 0x9DEF, 0x9E20, 0x9E46, 0x9E57, 0x9E60 };
  if (tool_works_at_step(ram, r, 0x9D4E, hm_PreCheckToolSuccessSquare)) {
    if (is(r, load8(r, ram[HM_SEASON]), WINTER)) return;
    cut(ram, r, &ret);
  }
  gold_step(ram, r, 9, 0x9E8C);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Digging (hoe and gold hoe): the tile is tilled (change $17), then,
 * unless NO_FINDS:
 *   - spring / summer, once a day, 1 in 32: a mole (event $11; $7F1F5A
 *     bit $1000; the hoe also clears $093A) — and nothing else this time;
 *   - once a day ($7F1F5C bit $0200), 1 in 16 a coin (10 G, event $0F/$3A)
 *     or else 1 in 16 a money bag (50 G, event $0F/$3B);
 *   - 1 in 64, once a day ($7F1F5C bit $0100): a power berry (event $10),
 *     but only the first two times ever ($7F1F64 bits $0800, $1000).
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct DigRets {
  uint16_t tile, mole_roll, mole, coin_roll, coin, coin_money, bag_roll, bag, bag_money,
           berry_roll, berry;
} DigRets;

static void dig(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const DigRets *ret, bool mole_clears_093a)
{
  change_tile_in_front(ram, r, 0x0017, ret->tile);

  if (below(r, load8(r, ram[HM_SEASON]), FALL) && !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_60, NO_FINDS)
      && !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5A, 0x1000) && one_in(ram, r, 32, ret->mole_roll)) {
    event(ram, r, 0x0011, 0, 0x0030, ret->mole);         /* a mole */
    if (mole_clears_093a) ram[HM_MOLE_TIMER] = 0;
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5A, 0x1000);
    return;
  }

  if (!test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_60, NO_FINDS) && !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5C, 0x0200)) {
    if (one_in(ram, r, 16, ret->coin_roll)) {            /* a coin */
      set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5C, 0x0200);
      event(ram, r, 0x000F, 0, 0x003A, ret->coin);
      add_money(ram, r, 1, ret->coin_money);
      return;
    }
    if (one_in(ram, r, 16, ret->bag_roll)) {             /* a money bag */
      set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5C, 0x0200);
      event(ram, r, 0x000F, 0, 0x003B, ret->bag);
      add_money(ram, r, 5, ret->bag_money);
      return;
    }
  }

  if (one_in(ram, r, 64, ret->berry_roll) && !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_60, NO_FINDS)
      && !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5C, 0x0100)) {
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5C, 0x0100);
    if (!test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x0800)) {
      set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x0800);
    } else {
      if (test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x1000)) return;
      set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x1000);
    }
    event(ram, r, 0x0010, 0, 0x001F, ret->berry);        /* a power berry */
  }
}

/* ToolUsedHoe ($82:9460) */
void hm_ToolUsedHoe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const DigRets ret = { 0x9478, 0x949E, 0x94AF, 0x94E0, 0x94FC, 0x950D, 0x9518,
                               0x9536, 0x9547, 0x9551, 0x95AD };
  if (tool_works(ram, r, 0x9464, hm_PreCheckToolSuccess))
    dig(ram, r, &ret, true);
  tool_finished(ram, r, 0xFE, 0x95BE);
}

/* ToolUsedGoldHoe ($82:9E8E): up to 6 tiles in a line, stopping at the
 * first one it can't till; 8 stamina at the end. */
void hm_ToolUsedGoldHoe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const DigRets ret = { 0x9EAE, 0x9ED6, 0x9EE7, 0x9F13, 0x9F2F, 0x9F40, 0x9F4B,
                               0x9F69, 0x9F7A, 0x9F84, 0x9FE0 };
  if (!tool_works_at_step(ram, r, 0x9E9A, hm_PreCheckToolSuccessLine)) {
    gold_done(ram, r, 0xA003);
    return;
  }
  dig(ram, r, &ret, false);
  gold_step(ram, r, 6, 0xA003);
}

/* The 2x2 big stones and stumps: X = which quarter was hit. The code walks
 * the tile in front to the top-left quarter ($10 pixels per tile): it
 * steps up-left, then right, then down-left, then right, stopping at the
 * first step whose quarter matches. Returns which of the two tile kinds
 * matched (0 / 1), or 2 if none. */
#define NONE 0xFFFF   /* no comparison at this step */
static bool step_matches(HmRegs *r, uint16_t tile, uint16_t a, uint16_t b, int *which)
{
  if (a != NONE && is(r, tile, a)) { *which = 0; return true; }
  if (b != NONE && is(r, tile, b)) { *which = 1; return true; }
  return false;
}
static int find_top_left(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t tile, const uint16_t q[4][2])
{
  int which = 2;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, sub_c(r, tile_x(ram), 0x10));
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, sub_c(r, tile_y(ram), 0x10));
  if (step_matches(r, tile, q[0][0], q[0][1], &which)) return which;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, add_c(r, tile_x(ram), 0x10));
  if (step_matches(r, tile, q[1][0], q[1][1], &which)) return which;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, sub_c(r, tile_x(ram), 0x10));
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, add_c(r, tile_y(ram), 0x10));
  if (step_matches(r, tile, q[2][0], q[2][1], &which)) return which;
  hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, add_c(r, tile_x(ram), 0x10));
  if (step_matches(r, tile, q[3][0], q[3][1], &which)) return which;
  return 2;
}
/* a 2x2 thing broken: change on its top-left tile, effect in its middle */
static void break_2x2(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, uint16_t change, uint16_t fx,
                      uint16_t ret_tile, uint16_t ret_fx)
{
  change_tile_in_front(ram, r, change, ret_tile);
  uint16_t x = add_c(r, tile_x(ram), 8), y = add_c(r, tile_y(ram), 8);
  effect(ram, r, x, y, fx, ret_fx);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Hammering (hammer and gold hammer).
 *   - Small stone (tile 06): change $0E.
 *   - Rock (tile 04): change $0E on the farm, $E3 in the caves (maps $29+),
 *     $DD elsewhere; effect $C8.
 *   - Big stone (the other tiles): the hammer breaks it on the 6th hit
 *     ($096D counts; earlier hits just show effect $CB), the gold hammer
 *     at once: change $0D on the farm / $DF elsewhere on its top-left
 *     corner, effect $C9 in its middle.
 *   - Where the hammer does nothing: on maps $0C-$0F, tile F8 (a rock by
 *     the spring), event $15, and once a day 1 in 4 a power berry (only
 *     once ever: $7F1F64 bit $0200; daily $7F1F5C bit $0080).
 * The hammer costs 2 stamina, the gold hammer 4.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct HammerRets {
  uint16_t check, rock_tile, rock_fx, small_tile, big_tile, big_fx, hit_fx, stamina,
           spring, roll, berry;
} HammerRets;
static const uint16_t BIG_STONE[4][2] = {
  { 0x10, NONE }, { 0x0F, NONE }, { 0x0E, NONE }, { NONE, NONE } };

static void hammer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const HammerRets *ret, bool gold)
{
  if (!tool_works(ram, r, ret->check, hm_PreCheckToolSuccess)) {
    uint8_t map = load8(r, map_id(ram, r));
    if (below(r, map, 0x0C) || !below(r, map, 0x10) || !is(r, r->x, 0x00F8)
        || test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5C, 0x0080))
      goto done;
    r->a = 0x0015; r->x = 0; r->y = 0x0016;
    jsl(ram, r, ret->spring, 0x84, hm_StartEventScript);
    if (!one_in(ram, r, 4, ret->roll) || test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x0200)) goto done;
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x0200);
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, add_c(r, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_X), 0x10));
    hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, sub_c(r, hm_dp_r16(ram, r, HM_PLAYER_Y), 0x10));
    event(ram, r, 0x0010, 0, 0x001F, ret->berry);        /* a power berry */
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_5C, 0x0080);
    goto done;
  }

  uint16_t tile = r->x;
  if (is(r, tile, 0x06)) {                               /* small stone */
    change_tile_in_front(ram, r, 0x000E, ret->small_tile);
    goto done;
  }
  if (is(r, tile, 0x04)) {                               /* rock */
    uint8_t map = load8(r, map_id(ram, r));
    uint16_t change = below(r, map, FARM_MAPS) ? 0x000E
                    : !below(r, load8(r, map), 0x29) ? 0x00E3 : 0x00DD;
    change_tile_in_front(ram, r, change, ret->rock_tile);
    effect_in_front(ram, r, FX_STONE, ret->rock_fx);
    goto done;
  }

  if (!gold) {                                           /* big stone */
    if (!is(r, load8(r, ++ram[HM_TOOL_HITS]), 6)) {
      effect_in_front(ram, r, FX_HIT, ret->hit_fx);
      goto done;
    }
    ram[HM_TOOL_HITS] = 0;
  }
  find_top_left(ram, r, tile, BIG_STONE);
  break_2x2(ram, r, below(r, load8(r, map_id(ram, r)), FARM_MAPS) ? 0x000D : 0x00DF,
            FX_BIG_STONE, ret->big_tile, ret->big_fx);
done:
  tool_finished(ram, r, gold ? 0xFC : 0xFE, ret->stamina);
}

/* ToolUsedHammer ($82:95C0), ToolUsedGoldHammer ($82:A005) */
void hm_ToolUsedHammer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const HammerRets ret = { 0x95C4, 0x95FE, 0x962F, 0x9641, 0x96C2, 0x96FB, 0x972E,
                                  0x973D, 0x976B, 0x9773, 0x97AC };
  hammer(ram, r, &ret, false);
}
void hm_ToolUsedGoldHammer(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const HammerRets ret = { 0xA009, 0xA046, 0xA077, 0xA089, 0xA0F7, 0xA130, 0,
                                  0xA13F, 0xA16D, 0xA175, 0xA1AE };
  hammer(ram, r, &ret, true);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Chopping (axe and gold axe). A stump breaks on the 6th hit of the axe
 * ($096D; earlier hits show effect $CB), at once with the gold axe: +6
 * wood, effect $B8 in its middle, and its top-left corner becomes change
 * $0D on the farm; off the farm $DF (stumps of quarters 09-0C, with once
 * ever 1 in 16 a power berry: $7F1F64 bit $0400) or $E0 (quarters 11-14).
 * Where the axe does nothing: on the mountain maps $10-$13, tile F4, an
 * event (once: $7F1F6A bit $0020; not while $0196 has bits $1A).
 * The axe costs 2 stamina, the gold axe 8.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct AxeRets { uint16_t roll, berry, tile, fx, wood; } AxeRets;
static const uint16_t STUMP[4][2] = { { 0x0C, 0x14 }, { 0x0B, 0x13 }, { 0x0A, 0x12 }, { 0x09, 0x11 } };

static void chop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const AxeRets *ret, bool check_no_finds)
{
  uint16_t change;
  if (find_top_left(ram, r, r->x, STUMP) == 1) {
    change = 0x00E0;
  } else if (below(r, load8(r, map_id(ram, r)), FARM_MAPS)) {
    change = 0x000D;
  } else {
    if ((!check_no_finds || !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_60, NO_FINDS))
        && one_in(ram, r, 16, ret->roll) && !test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x0400)) {
      set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_64, 0x0400);
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, add_c(r, tile_x(ram), 8));
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, add_c(r, tile_y(ram), 8));
      event(ram, r, 0x0010, 0, 0x001F, ret->berry);      /* a power berry */
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_X, sub_c(r, tile_x(ram), 8));
      hm_wr16(ram, HM_TILE_IN_FRONT_Y, sub_c(r, tile_y(ram), 8));
    }
    change = 0x00DF;
  }
  break_2x2(ram, r, change, FX_STUMP, ret->tile, ret->fx);
  add(ram, r, hm_AddWood, 6, ret->wood);
}

/* ToolUsedAxe ($82:97BD) */
void hm_ToolUsedAxe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const AxeRets ret = { 0x9863, 0x989E, 0x98D3, 0x990C, 0x9915 };
  if (!tool_works(ram, r, 0x97C1, hm_PreCheckToolSuccess)) {
    uint8_t map = load8(r, map_id(ram, r));
    if (below(r, map, 0x10) || !below(r, map, 0x14) || !is(r, r->x, 0x00F4)
        || test(ram, r, HM_WEATHER_FLAGS, 0x001A) || test(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6A, 0x0020))
      goto done;
    set_flag(ram, r, HM_FLAGS_6A, 0x0020);
    r->a = 0; r->x = 0x0017; r->y = 0;
    jsl(ram, r, 0x9988, 0x84, hm_StartEventScriptLong);
    goto done;
  }
  if (!is(r, load8(r, ++ram[HM_TOOL_HITS]), 6)) {
    effect_in_front(ram, r, FX_HIT, 0x9948);
    goto done;
  }
  ram[HM_TOOL_HITS] = 0;
  chop(ram, r, &ret, true);
done:
  tool_finished(ram, r, 0xFE, 0x9997);
}

/* ToolUsedGoldAxe ($82:A1BF) */
void hm_ToolUsedGoldAxe(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const AxeRets ret = { 0xA244, 0xA27F, 0xA2B4, 0xA2ED, 0xA2F6 };
  if (tool_works(ram, r, 0xA1C3, hm_PreCheckToolSuccess))
    chop(ram, r, &ret, false);
  tool_finished(ram, r, 0xF8, 0xA305);
}

/* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * Seeds: each call sows one of the 9 tiles around the player ($096B =
 * which one, PreCheckToolSuccessSquare). The crop only takes in its
 * season; otherwise the tile gets change $EB. After the 9th tile, one bag
 * less (empty: the hand is emptied), back to idle and 1 stamina; before
 * that the routine returns right away (A = the step, high byte left over).
 *   corn $19 / tomato $1A: summer;  potato $1B / turnip $1C: spring;
 *   grass $1E: spring and summer (and +1 planted grass), else $ED.
 * ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
typedef struct Sowing {
  uint16_t bag;                         /* its seed count */
  uint16_t ret_check, ret_tile, ret_stamina;
} Sowing;

static void sow_step_done(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Sowing *s)
{
  if (!is(r, load8(r, ++ram[HM_SOW_STEP]), 9)) return;
  ram[HM_SOW_STEP] = 0;
  uint8_t left = load8(r, --ram[s->bag]);
  if (left == 0) ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED] = 0;
  tool_finished(ram, r, 0xFF, s->ret_stamina);
}
/* The native build's "one seed at a time" (g_hm_single_seed, off in the
 * checking build): each use sows only the tile in front, and a bag is 9
 * seeds (g_hm_seeds_used: how many of the open bag are gone, kept in the
 * saved game by SaveGameSlot). The bag goes, and the stamina is paid, at
 * the 9th seed, as when the game sows the 9 tiles at once. */
static bool sow_one_works(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Sowing *s)
{
  return tool_works(ram, r, s->ret_check, hm_PreCheckToolSuccess);
}
static void sow_one_done(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Sowing *s, bool sown)
{
  ram[HM_SOW_STEP] = 0;
  uint8_t *used = &g_hm_seeds_used[s->bag - HM_SEEDS_GRASS_N];
  if (!sown) { idle(ram, r); return; }               /* nothing sown: no seed spent */
  if (++*used < 9) { idle(ram, r); return; }
  *used = 0;
  if (--ram[s->bag] == 0) ram[HM_TOOL_SELECTED] = 0;
  tool_finished(ram, r, 0xFF, s->ret_stamina);
}

static void sow_crop(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r, const Sowing *s, uint16_t crop, uint8_t season)
{
  bool one = g_hm_single_seed;
  bool works = one ? sow_one_works(ram, r, s) : tool_works_at_step(ram, r, s->ret_check, hm_PreCheckToolSuccessSquare);
  if (works) {
    r->x = crop;
    /* corn / tomato: CMP #1; potato / turnip: just LDA (C unchanged) */
    uint8_t now = load8(r, ram[HM_SEASON]);
    bool in_season = season == SUMMER ? is(r, now, SUMMER) : now == SPRING;
    if (!in_season) r->x = 0x00EB;
    change_tile_in_front(ram, r, r->x, s->ret_tile);
  }
  if (one) sow_one_done(ram, r, s, works);
  else sow_step_done(ram, r, s);
}

void hm_ToolUsedCornSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
  static const Sowing s = { HM_SEEDS_CORN_N, 0x99A5, 0x99C9, 0x99F6 };
  sow_crop(ram, r, &s, 0x0019, SUMMER);
}
void hm_ToolUsedTomatoSeeds(uint8_t *ram, HmRegs *r)
{
```
